text.body: <8.1> oṃ namaḥ śivāya namaḥ paramadevāya traiguṇyavijitātmane | śāśvate yogarūpāya saṃsārābhāvahetave | | 1 | | sthitisaṃrodhasargāṇāṃ hetaventa (?) prasāriṇe | ṣaḍviṃśāya pradhānāya mahādevāya dhīmate | | 2 | | prajāṣatermahākṣetre gaṅgākālindisaṅgame | prayāge parame puṇye brahmaṇo lokavartmani | | 3 | | munayaḥ śaṃśitātmānastapasā kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ | tīrthasaṃplavanārthāya paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛtāhnikāḥ | |4| | paurāṇikamapaśyanta sūtaṃ satyaparāyaṇam | snātvā tasminmahātīrthe praṇāmārthamupāgatam | | 5| | dṛṣṭavā te sūtamāyāntamṛṣayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ | āśāsyā sanasaṃveśaṃ tadyogaṃ samakalpayan | | 6 | | sa praṇamya tataḥ sarvān sūtastānmunipuṅgavān | pradattamāsanaṃ bheje sarvadharmasamanvitaḥ | |7 | | tamāsīnamapṛcchante munayastapasaidhitāḥ | brahmasatre purā sādho naimiśāraṇyavāsinām| |8 | | kathitaṃ bhāratākhyānaṃ purāṇaṃ ca paraṃ tvayā| tena naḥ pratibhāsi tvaṃ sākṣātsatyavatīsutaḥ ||6 || sarvāgamaparārthajñaḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ|| dvijapūjārato nityaṃ tena pṛcchāṃ tvamarhasi ||8.1.10|| bhāratākhyānasadṛśaṃ purāṇādyadviśiṣyate|| tattvā pṛcchāma vai janma kārttikeyasya dhīmataḥ ||11|| ime hi munayaḥ sarve tvadupāstiparāyaṇāḥ|| skandasaṃbhavaśuśrūṣā saṃjātautsukyamānasāḥ ||12|| evamuktastadā sūtaḥ saṃsiddhairmunipuṃgavaiḥ|| provācedaṃ munīnsarvānvaco bhūtārthavācakam ||13|| śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kārttikeyasya sambhavam || brahmaṇyatvaṃ samāhātmyaṃ vīryaṃ ca tridaśādhikam ||14|| mumukṣayā paraṃ sthānaṃ yāte śukamahātmani|| sutaśokābhisaṃtapto vyāsastryambakamaikṣata ||15 || dṛṣṭvaiva sa maheśānaṃ vyāso'bhūdvigatavyathaḥ|| vicaransa tadā lokānmuni satyavatīsutaḥ ||16|| meruśṛṅge'tha dadṛśe brahmaṇaḥ sutamagrajam|| sanatkumāraṃ varadaṃ yogaiśvaryasamanvitam ||17|| vimāne ravisaṃkāśe tiṣṭhantamanalaprabham|| munibhiryogasaṃsiddhaistapoyuktairmahātmabhiḥ ||18|| vedavedāṅgatattvajñaiḥ sarvadharmāgamānvitaiḥ|| sakalāvāptavidyaistu caturvaktramivāvṛtam ||19 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ sumahātmānaṃ vyāso munimathāsthitam|| vavande parayā bhaktyā sākṣādiva pitāmaham ||8.1.20|| brahmasūnuratha vyāsaṃ samāyātaṃ mahaujasam|| pariṣvajya paraṃ premṇā provāca vacanaṃ śubham ||21 || diṣṭyā tvamasi dharmajña prasādātpārameśvarāt || apetaśokaḥ samprāptaḥ pṛcchasva pravadāmyaham ||22 || śrutvātha vacanaṃ sūnorbrahmaṇo munipuṃgavaḥ|| idamāha vaco viprāściraṃ yaddhṛdaye sthitam ||23 || kumārasya kathaṃ janma kārttikeyasya dhīmataḥ || kiṃnimittaṃ kuto vāsya icchāmyetaddhi veditum ||24|| kathaṃ rudrasutaścāsau vahnigaṅgāsutaḥ katham|| umāyāstanayaścaiva svāhāyāśca kathaṃ punaḥ|| suparṇyāścātha mātṝṇāṃ kṛttikānāṃ kathaṃ ca saḥ ||25 || kaścāsau pūrvamatpannaḥ kiṃtapāḥ kaśca vikramaḥ|| bhūtasaṃmohanaṃ hyetatkathayasva yathātatham ||26 || sūta uvāca evaṃ sa pṛṣṭastejasvī brahmaṇaḥ putrasattamaḥ|| uvāca sarvaṃ sarvajño vyāsāyākliṣṭakāriṇe || tacchṛṇudhvaṃ yathātattvaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ mayānaghāḥ ||27 || iti skandapurāṇe prathamo'dhyāyaḥ <8.2> sanatkumāra uvāca prapadye devamīśānaṃ sarvajñamaparājitam | mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ viśvasya jagataḥ patim ||1 || śaktirapratighā yasya ii aiśvaryañcaiva sarvaśaḥ | svāmitvañca vibhutvañca svakṛtāni pracakṣate ||2|| tasmai devāya somāya praṇamya prayataḥ śuciḥ | purāṇākhyānajijñāsorvakṣye skandodbhavaṃ śubham ||3 | | dehāvatāro devasya rudrasya paramātmanaḥ | prājāpatyābhiṣekaśca haraṇaṃ śirasastathā ||4| | darśanaṃ ṣaṭkulīyānāṃ cakrasya ca visarjanam | naimiśasyodbhavaścaiva satrasya ca samāpanam | |5|| brahmaṇaścāgamastatra tapasaścaraṇantathā | śarvasya darśanañcaiva devyāścaiva samudbhavaḥ | |6|| satyā vivādaśca tathā dakṣaśāpastathaiva ca | senāyāśca samutpattiryathā devyāḥ svayaṃvaraḥ ||7|| devānāṃ varadānañca vasiṣṭhasya ca dhīmataḥ | parāśarasya cotpattirvyāsasya ca mahātmanaḥ ||8 || vasiṣṭhakauśikābhyāñca vairodbhavasamāpanam | vārāṇasyāśca śūnyatvaṃ kṣetramāhātmyavarṇanam ||9| | rudrasya cātra sānnidhyaṃ nandinaścāpyanugrahaḥ | gaṇānāṃ darśanañcaiva kathanañcāpyaśeṣataḥ ||8.2.1 0 | | kālīvyāharaṇañcaiva tapaścaraṇameva ca | somanandisamutpattirvaradānaṃ tathaiva ca | |1 1 | | gaurītvaṃ putralambhaśca devyā utpattireva ca | kauśikyā bhūtamātṛtvaṃ siṃhasya rathatā tathā ||12|| gauryāśca nilayo vindhye vindhyasūryasamāgamaḥ | agastyasya ca māhātmyaṃ vadhaḥ sundanisundayoḥ ||13 || niśumbhaśumbhanirṇāśo mahiṣasya vadhastayā | abhiṣekaśca kauśikyā........||14|| ........varadānamathāpi ca | andhakasya tathotpattiḥ pṛthivyāścaiva bandhanam ||15|| hiraṇyākṣavadhaścaiva hiraṇyakaśipostathā | balaśaṃśamanaṃ caiva devyāḥ samaya eva ca ||16|| devānāṃ gamanaṃ caivaṃ agnerdūtatvameva ca | devānāṃ varadānaṃ ca śukrasya ca visarjanam ||17|| dūtasya ca tathotpattirdevyāścāndhakadarśanam | śailādidainyasammarddo devyāśca śatarūpatā ||18|| āryāvarapradānaṃ ca śaivādistava eva ca | devasyāgamanaṃ caiva vṛttasya kathanaṃ tathā ||19|| pativratāyāścākhyānaṃ guruśuśraṣaṇasya ca | ākhyānaṃ pañcacūḍāyāstaijasaścāpyadhṛṣyatā ||8.2.20|| dūtasyāgamanaṃ caiva saṃvādotha visarjanam | andhakāsurasaṃvādo mandarāgamanaṃ tathā ||21|| gaṇānāmāgamaścaiva saṃkhyānaśravaṇaṃ tathā | vigrahaścāndhakasyātha yuddhe (?)naṃ mahatā tathā ||22|| śarīrārdhapradānaṃ ca aśokasutasaṃgrahaḥ | bhammasomodbhavaścaiva śmaśānavasatistathā ||23 || utpattiryakṣarājasya kuberasya ca dhīmataḥ| nigraho bhujagendrāṇāṃ śikharasya ca pātanam ||24|| trailokyasya saśakrasya vaśīkaraṇameva ca|| devasenāpradānaṃ ca senāpatyābhiṣecanam || 25|| nāradakhyāgamaścaiva tārakapreṣitasya ha || vadhaśca tārakasyogro yātrā bhadravaṭasya ca ||26|| mahiṣasya vadhaścaiva krauñcasya ca nibarhaṇam|| śakteruddharaṇaṃ caiva tārakasya vadhaḥ śubhaḥ ||27|| devāsurabhayotpattistraipuraṃ yuddhameva ca || prahlādavigrahaścaiva kṛtaghnākhyānameva ca|| mahābhāgyaṃ bāhmaṇānāṃ vistareṇa prakīrtyate ||28|| etajjñātvā yathāvaddhi kumārānucaro bhavet|| balavānmatisampannaḥ putraṃ cāpnoti saṃmatam ||29|| iti skandapurāṇe dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ <8.3> sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇuṣvemāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm|| kathyamānāṃ mayā citrāṃ bahvarthāṃ śrutisaṃmitām|| yāṃ śrutvā pāpakarmāpi gacchecca paramāṃ gatim ||1|| na nāstikāśraddadhāne śaṭhe cāpi kathaṃcana|| imāṃ kathāmanubrūyāttathā cāsūyake nare ||2|| idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dhārmikāyānasūyave|| kathanīyaṃ mahābrahmandevabhaktāya vā bhavet||3|| kathanīyaṃ sadā brahman devabhaktāya vā bhavet | kumārabhaktāya tathā śraddadhānāya caiva hi | |4|| sadā vācyamidaṃ guhyaṃ yatīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | tataḥ provāca...prapannenāntarātmanā | |5| | purā brahmā prajā tvaṣṭuraṇḍesmin saṃprasūyata | sojñānāt pitaraṃ brahmā na veda tamasāvṛtaḥ | |6 | | ahameka iti jñātvā sarvvāṃllokānavaikṣata | na cāpaśyata tatrānyaṃ tapoyogabalānvitaḥ | |7| | putraputreti cāpyukto brahmā śarveṇa dhīmatā | praṇataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||8 | | sa dattvā brahmaṇe śambhuḥ sraṣṭṛtvaṃ jñānasaṃhitam | vibhutvaṃ caiva lokānāmantardhāt parameśvaraḥ | |9 | | tadeṣopaniṣat proktā mayā vyāsa sanātanī | yāṃ śrutvā yogino dhyānāt prapadyante maheśvaram | |8.3.1 0 | | yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe putramagre jñānañca yaḥ prahiṇoti sma tasmai | tamātmasthaṃ yenu paśyanti dhīrāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām| |1 1 | | sa vyāsa pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dīptyā paramayā yutam | putrakāmaḥ prajāhetostapastīvraṃ cacāra ha | |12 | | tasyograyogatapasā yuktasya sumahātmanaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena pitā saṃpratutoṣa ha | | 13 | | darśanaṃ cāgamattasya varadosmī tyuvāca ca | sa tuṣṭāvā nato bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim | |14| | namaḥ paramadevāya devānāmapi vedhase | sraṣṭre vai lokatantrāya brahmaṇaḥ pataye namaḥ | |1 5 | | ekasmai śaktiyuktāya āsaktirahitāya ca | anantāyāprameyāya indriyāviṣayāya ca | |1 6 | | vyāpine vyāptapūrvāya adhiṣṭhātre pracodine | kṛtapracodanāyaiva tattvavinyāsakāriṇe | |17| | pradhānacodakāyaiva guṇānāṃ śaktidāya ca | dṛṣṭidāya ca sarveṣāṃ svayaṃ vai darśanāya ca | |18 | | viṣayagrāhiṇe caiva niyamasya ca kāriṇe | manasaḥ karaṇānāṃ ca kartre vai nigamasya ca ||1 9 | | bhūtānāṃ guṇakartre ca śaktidāya tathaiva ca | kartre hyaṇḍasya mahyañca acintyāyāgrajāya ca | |8.3.2 0 | | aprameya pitarnityaṃ prīto no diśa śakvarīm | aprameyaguṇaiśvaryaśaktayevyāhatāya vai | |21 | | tasyaivaṃ stuvato vyāsa devadevo maheśvaraḥ | tuṣṭovravīt svayaṃ putraṃ brahmāṇaṃ praṇataṃ tadā | |22| | yasmātte viditaṃ vatsa sūkṣmametanmahādyute | tasmād brahmeti lokeṣu nāmnā khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi | |23 | | yasmāccāhaṃ pitetyuktastvayā buddhimatāṃ vara | tasmāt pitāmahatvaṃ te loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati | |24| | prajārthaṃ yacca te taptaṃ tapa ugraṃ suduścaram | tasmātprajāpatitvaṃ te dadāmi prayatātmane | |25 | | evamuktvā sa deveśo sṛjanmūrttimatīḥ striyaḥ | yāstāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārā indriyaiḥ saha | | 26 | | bhāvāśca sarve te devamupatasthuḥ svarūpiṇaḥ | tānuvāca tato devaḥ patiṃ yukttaḥ svatejasā | |27 | | etamadyābhiṣekeṇa sampādayata mā ciram | tābhiḥ svaṃ svaṃ samādāya bhāvaṃ divyamatarkitam | |28 | | abhiṣikto babhūveha prajāpatiratidyutiḥ | tatremaṃ yoginaḥ sūkṣmaṃ dṛṣṭavā divyena cakṣuṣā | |29 | | purāṇaṃ yogatattvajñā gāyanti triguṇānvitam | rūdraḥ sraṣṭā hi sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ tava ca prabho | |8.3.3 0 | | asmābhiśca bhavān sārddhaṃ jagataḥ saṃpravarttakaḥ | sa devastoṣitaḥ samyak paramaiśvaryayogadhṛk | brahmāṇamagrajaṃ putraṃ prājāpatyebhyaṣecayat | |3 1 | | yaḥ kṛtvā bahuvidhamārgayogayuktaṃ tanvākhyaṃ jagadidamādarādyuyoja | taṃ devaṃ paramamanantayogayuktaṃ māyābhiḥ tribhuvanabandhumapramādam | |3 2|| sarveṣāṃ manasi sadāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ paśyantaṃ śubhamaśubhaṃ ca bhūtanātham | taṃ devaṃ praṇatagatiṃ praṇamya bhaktyā nityaṃ vai śaraṇamupaimi sūkṣmasūkṣmam | |3 3 || iti skandapurāṇe brahmaṇaḥ prājāpatyābhiṣecano nāma tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ <8.4> sanatkumāra uvāca prājāpatyaṃ tato labdhvā prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ pracakrame | prajāstāḥ sṛjyamānāśca na vivardhanti tasya ha | | 1 | | sa kurvāṇastathā sṛṣṭiṃ śaktihīnaḥ pitāmahaḥ | sṛṣṭyarthaṃ bhūya evātha tapaścartuṃ pracakrame | |2 | | sṛṣṭihetostapa stasya jñātvā tribhuvaneśvaraḥ | tejasā jagadāviśya ājagāma tadantikam | |3 | | sraṣṭā tasya jagannātho darśayatsvatanau jagat | mahāyogabalaiśvaryo jñānasiddhagaṇāvṛtaḥ | |4| | svayamāgatya deveśo mahābhūtapatirharaḥ | vyāpyeva hi jagat kṛtsnaṃ parameṇa svatejasā | | 5| | śambhuḥ prāha varaṃ vatsa yācasveti pitāmaham | taṃ brahmā lokasṛṣṭyarthaṃ putratve manasā varīt | |6 | | sa jñātvā tasya saṃkalpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ | mūḍhoyamiti sañcintya provāca varadaḥ svayam | |7 | | āgataṃ pitaraṃ mā tvaṃ yasmāt putraṃ samīhase | manmūrttistanayastasmād bhaviṣyati mamājñayā | |8 | | sa ca te putratāṃ yātvā madīyo gaṇanāyakaḥ | rudro vigrahavān bhūtvā mūḍha tvāṃ vinayiṣyati | |9 | | sarvavidyādhipatyaṃ ca yogānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ | balasyādhipatitvaṃ ca astrāṇāṃ ca prayoktṛtā | |8.4.1 0 | | mayā dattāni tasyāśu upasthāsyanti sarvaśaḥ | dhanuḥ pinākaḥ śūlaṃ ca khaṅgaḥ paraśureva ca | |1 1 | | kamaṇḍalustathā daṇḍa astraṃ pāśupataṃ tathā | saṃvarttakāśaniścaiva cakraṃ ca pratisargikam | | 12 | | evaṃ sarvaddhisaṃpannaḥ sutaste sa bhaviṣyati | evamuktvā gate tasminnantardhānaṃ mahātmani | |1 3 | | brahmā cakre tadā ceṣṭiṃ putrakāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ | sa juhvañchramasaṃyuktaḥ pratighātasamanvitaḥ | | 14|| samidyuktena hastena lalāṭaṃ pramamārja ha | samitsaṃyogajastasya svedabindurlalāṭajaḥ | |15| | papāta jvalane tasmin dviguṇaṃ tasya tejasā | taddhi māheśvaraṃ tejaḥ sandhitaṃ brahmaṇi srutam| | 16 || preritaṃ devadevena nipapāta havirbhuji | kṣaṇe tasminmaheśena smṛtvā taṃ varamuttamam | 17| | preṣito gaṇapo rudraḥ sadya evābhavat tadā | tacca saṃsvedajaṃ tejaḥ pūrvaṃ jvalanayojitam | |18 | | bhūtvā lohitamāśveva punarnīlamabhūttadā | nīlalohita itveva tenāsāvabhavat prabhuḥ | | 19| | tryakṣo daśabhujaḥ śrīmān brahmāṇaṃ chādayanniva | śarvādyairnnāmabhirbrahmā tanūbhiśca jalādibhiḥ | |8.4.2 0 || stutvā taṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ nīlalohitamavyayam | jñātvā sarvasṛjaṃ paścānmahābhūtapratiṣṭhatam | |21 | | asṛjadvividhāstvanyāḥ prajāḥ sa jagati prabhuḥ | sopi yogaṃ samāsthāya aiśvaryeṇa samanvitaḥ | |22 | | lokānsarvānsamāviśya dhārayāmāsa sarvadā | brahmaṇopi tataḥ putrā dakṣadharmādayaḥ śubhāḥ | |2 3 | | asṛjyanta prajāssarvā devamānuṣasaṃkulāḥ | atha kālena mahatā kalpetīte punaḥ punaḥ | | |24 | | prajā dhārayato yogādasminkalpa upasthite pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārtāyāṃ pravṛtte sṛṣṭisarjane | | |25| | prajāsu ca vivṛddhāsu prayāge yajataśca ha | brahmaṇaḥ ṣaṭkulīyāste ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | ||26 || marīcayotrayaścaiva vasiṣṭhāḥ kratavastathā | bhṛgavoṅgirasaścaiva tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ||27|| ūcurbrahmāṇamabhyetya sahitāḥ karmaṇontare | bhagavannandhakāreṇa mahatā smaḥ samāvṛtāḥ ||28|| khinnā vivadamānāśca na ca paśyāma yatparam | | etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ deva ciraṃ hṛdi samāsthitam ||29|| tvaṃ hi vettha yathātattvaṃ kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ hi naḥ | kiṃ paraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ balīyām̐ ścāpi sarvataḥ ||8.4.3 0 || kena cādhiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ ko nityaḥ kaśca śāśvataḥ | kaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛteśca pravartakaḥ ||3 1 || kosmān sarveṣu kāryeṣu prayunakti mahāmanāḥ | kasya bhūtāni vaśyāni kaḥ sarvaviniyojakaḥ ||3 2 || kathaṃ paśyema tañcaiva etannaḥ śaṃsa sarvaśaḥ | evamuktastato brahmā sarveṣāmeva sannidhau ||3 3 | | devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām | yakṣāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca ye ca bhūta pravarttakāḥ | | 34| | ...kṣāṇāṃ sapiśācānāṃ ye cānye tatsamīpagāḥ | utthāya prāñjaliḥ prāha rudreti triḥplutaṃ vacaḥ ||3 5|| sa cāpi tapasā śakyo draṣṭuṃ nānyena kenacit saḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ balavāṃścāpi sa smṛtaḥ ||36|| tasya vaśyāni bhūtāni tenedaṃ dhāryate jagat | ...rva.....te namaścakrurmahātmane || 37|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kiṃ tanmahattapo deva yena dṛśyeta sa prabhuḥ | tanno vadasva deveśa varadaṃ cābhidhatsva naḥ ||38|| pitāmaha uvāca satraṃ mahatsamāsadhvaṃ vāṅmanodoṣavarjitāḥ | deśaṃ ca vaḥ pravakṣyāmi yasmindeśe cariṣyatha || 39 || sanatkumāra uvāca tato manomayaṃ cakraṃ sa sṛṣṭvā tānuvāca ha | kṣiptametanmayā cakramanuvrajata mā ciram | |8.4.40 | | yatrāsya nemiḥ śīryeta sa deśastapasaḥ śubhaḥ | tato mumoca taccakraṃ te ca tatsamanuvrajan |41 | | tasya vai vrajataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra nemiraśīryata | naimiśantat smṛtaṃ nāmnā puṇyaṃ sarvatra pūjitam | |42|| tatpūjitandevamanuṣyasiddhai rakṣobhirugrairuragaiśca divyaiḥ | yakṣaiḥ sagandharvapiśācasaṃghaiḥ sarvāpsarobhiśca diteḥ sutaiśca ||43 || vipraiśca dāntaiḥ itihāsaṃ purātanam | brahmaṇaścaiva saṃvādaṃ purā yajñasya caiva hi ||22|| yajñairiṣṭvā purā devo brahmā dīptena tejasā | asṛjatsarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ||23|| sa dṛṣṭvā dīptimāndevo dīptyā paramayā yutaḥ | avekṣamāṇastām̐llokām̐ścaturbhirmukhapaṅkajaiḥ ||24| | devādīn mānuṣādīṃ śca dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā mahāmanāḥ | amanyata na menyosti samo loke na cādhikaḥ ||25|| yohametāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ saptalokapratiṣṭhitāḥ | devamānuṣatiryakṣu grasāmi visṛjāmi ca ||26|| ahaṃ sraṣṭā hi bhūtānāṃ nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate | niyantā lokakartā ca na mamāsti samaḥ kvacit ||27|| tasyaivaṃ manyamānasya yajña āgānmahāmanāḥ | uvāca cainaṃ dīptātmā maivaṃ maṃsthā mahāmate ||28|| ayaṃ hi tava saṃmoho vināśāya bhaviṣyati | na yuktamīdṛśantedya satvasthasyātmayoninaḥ ||29|| sraṣṭā tvañcaiva nānyosti tathāpi na yaśaskaram | ahaṃ dharttā hi bhūtānāṃ bhuvanasya tathaiba ca | |8.5.3 0 || karomi na ca saṃmohaṃ yathā tvaṃ deva katthase | tamuvāca tadā brahmā na tvaṃ dhārayitā vibho ||3 1 | | ahameva hi bhūtānāṃ dharttā hartā tathaiva ca | mayā sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni tvamevātra vimuhyase ||32|| athāgattatra saṃvigno vedaḥ paramadīptimān | uvāca caiva tau vedo naita devamiti prabhuḥ ||33 || ahaṃ śreṣṭho yatkṛtosmi na vadāmyanṛtaṃ kvacit| śṛṇudhvaṃ mama yaḥ karttā bhūtānāṃ yuvayośca ha ||34|| parameśo mahādevo rudraḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ | yenāhaṃ tava dattaśca kṛtastvañca prajāpatiḥ ||35|| yajñoyaṃ yatprasūtiśca ahaṃ yatrāsmi saṃsthitaḥ | sarvaṃ tasmātprasūtaṃ vai nānyaḥ karttāsti naḥ kvacit ||36|| tamevaṃvādinaṃ devo brahmā vedanamabhāṣata | ahaṃ śrutīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ netā sraṣṭā tathaiva ca ||37|| vāyuruvāca brahmalokaṃ samāsādya bhagavān sarvalokapaḥ | bhakṣa bhaikṣamiti procya dvāre samavatiṣṭhata ||1|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ brahmā kapālakarabhūṣaṇam | jñātvā yogena mahatā tuṣṭāva bhuvaneśvaram ||2|| tasya tuṣṭastadā devo varadosmītyabhāṣata | vṛṇīṣva varamavyagro yatte manasi vartate ||3|| brahmovāca icchāmi devadeveśa tvayā cihnamidaṃ kṛtam | yena cihne na lokoyaṃ cihnitaḥ syājjagatpate ||4|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavān vadatāṃ varaḥ | sarvaṃ pratimayaṃ (?) brahmannomiti vyājahāra saḥ ||5|| tasyaivaṃ dhyānamātreṇa vāgiyaṃ divyarūpiṇī | niḥsṛtāḥ vadanāddevī prahvā samavatiṣṭhata ||6|| tāmuvāca tato devī vācā saṃjīvayanniva | yasmāt tvamakṣaro bhūtvā mama vāco viniḥsṛtā ||7|| sarvavidyādhidevī tvaṃ tasmāddevi bhaviṣyasi | yasmād brahmarasaṃ vedaṃ mukhaṃ mama samāśritā ||8|| tasmāt sarasvatītyevaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi | imaṃ lokaṃ rasāmbhobhirbhāvayitvā ca suprabhe ||9|| sarvalokān tārayitā punastvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | yajñabhāgaṃ ca te devā dāsyaṃti sapitāmahāḥ mahaddivyaṃ sarastatra pradṛśyate | mahākapālaṃ viprendrāḥ svargastatrākṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||36|| idaṃ śubhaṃ divyamadharmaśāsanaṃ mahāhradaṃ sendrasurāsurārcitam | mahā kapālaprakṛtopavarṇanaṃ sureśalokādivigāhane hitam ||37|| tapodhanaiḥ siddhagaṇaiśca saṃstutaṃ diviṣṭatulyaṃ dvijarājamaṇḍalam | paṭhennaro yaḥ śṛṇuyācca sarvadā triviṣṭapaṃ gacchati sobhinanditaḥ ||38|| iti skandapurāṇe kapālasaṃsthāpanaṃ nāma saptamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.8> vāyuruvāca evaṃ hyeṣā bhagavatī brahmalokānusāriṇī | yuṣmākaṃ dharmasiddhyarthaṃ vedīmadhyād vyavarttata ||1 || sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ teṣāṃ samāptetha satre varṣasahasrike | pravṛttāyāṃ sarasvatyāmagāttatra pitāmahaḥ ||2|| brahmovāca bhūyoneneha satreṇa yajadhvaṃ devamīśvaram | yadā(?) vo bhavitā vighnastadā niṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ ||3 || vighnaṃ tañcaiva saṃtīrya tapastaptvā ca bhāsvaram | yogaṃ prāpya mahadyuktā stato drakṣyatha śaṅkaram ||4|| tathetyuktvā gate tasmin satrāṇyājahrire tadā | bahūni vividhā kārāṇyabhiyuktā mahāvratāḥ ||5 || nissomāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā kṛtsnāmetāṃ tato dvijāḥ | rājānaṃ somamānāyya abhiṣotumiyeṣire ||6|| atha sopi kṛtastiryagadṛśyena durātmanā | svarbhānunā hataḥ somastataste duḥkhitā bhavan ||7|| te gatvā munayaḥ sarve kalāpagrāmavāsinam | purūravasamānīya rājānantebhyaṣecayan ||8|| ūcuścainaṃ mahābhāgā hṛtaḥ somo hi naḥ prabho | kenāpi tadbhavān kṣipramihānayatu mā ciram ||9|| sa evamukto mṛgayan yadā nāsādayat prabhuḥ | uvāca sa tadā viprān praṇamya bhayapīḍitaḥ ||8.8.1 0 || paramaṃ yatnamāsthāya mayā somobhimārgitaḥ | na ca taṃ vedmi kenāsau kva vā nīta iti prabhuḥ ||11|| tamevaṃvādinaṃ kruddhā ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | ūcuḥ sarve susaṃrabdhā ilāputraṃ mahāmatim ||12|| bhavān rājā kṛtastāta yatosmābhirbhayārditaiḥ | na ca nastadbhayaṃ muktaṃ nāpi śaktosi veditum || 13|| viṣayeṣvabhi saktātmā yogāttaṃ nānupaśyasi | tasmādvirodhamāsthāya dvijebhyo vadhamāpsyasi ||14|| vayameva hi rājānamāneṣyāma sudurvidam | tapasā svena rājendra paśya no balamuttamam ||15|| tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ | astuvanvāgbhiriṣṭābhirgāyatrīṃ vedabhāvinīm ||16|| stuvatāṃ tu tatasteṣāṃ gāyatrī vedabhāvinī | rūpiṇī darśanaṃ prādāduvācedaṃ ca tāndvijān ||17|| tuṣṭāsmi vatsāḥ kiṃ vodya karomi varadāsmi vaḥ | brūta tatkṛtamadyaiva bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||18|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ somo nopahṛto devi kenāpi sudurātmanā | tamānaya namastestu eṣa no vara uttamaḥ ||19|| sanatkumāra uvāca sā tathoktā viniścitya dṛṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā | śyenībhūtā jagāmāśu śvarbhānumasuraṃ prati ||8.8.20|| vyagrāṇāmasurāṇāṃ sā ca gṛhītvā somamāgatā | āgamya tānṛṣīnprāha ayaṃ somobhiṣūyatām ||21|| te tamāsādya ṛṣayaḥ prāpya yajñaphalaṃ mahat | amanyanta taposmākaṃ niṣkalmaṣamiti dvijāḥ ||22|| tatastatra svayaṃ brahmā saha devoragādibhiḥ | āgatya tānṛṣīn prāha tapaḥ kuruta mā ciram ||23 || te saha brahmaṇā gatvā mainākaṃ parvatottamam | sarvairdevagaṇaissārddhaṃ tapaśceruḥ samāhitāḥ | 24|| teṣāṃ kālena mahatā tapasā bhāvitātmanām | yogapravṛttirabhavat sūkṣmayuktā statastu te ||25|| te yuktā brahmaṇā sārdhamṛṣayaḥ saha devataiḥ | maheśvare manaḥ sthāpya niścalopalavat sthitāḥ ||26|| atha teṣāṃ mahādevaḥ pinākī nīlalohitaḥ | abhyagacchata taṃ deśaṃ vimānenārkatejasā | |27| | tadbhāvabhāvitān jñātvā sa bhāvena pareṇa ha | uvāca meghanirhādaḥ śatadundubhinisvanaḥ ||28|| bho bho sabrahmakā devāḥ saviṣṇu ṛṣicāraṇāḥ | divyaṃ cakṣuḥ prayacchāmi paśyadhvaṃ māṃ yathepsitam ||29|| sanatkumāra uvāca apaśyanta tataḥ sarve sūryāyutasamaprabham | vimānaṃ merusaṃkāśaṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitam ||8.8.3 0 || tasya madhyegnirociṣkaṃ sumahaddīptimā sthitam | jvālāmālāparikṣiptamarcirbhirupaśobhitam ||31 || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ pradīptānalalocanam | tretāgni piṅgalajaṭaṃ bhujagābaddhamekhalam ||32|| mṛṣṭakuṇḍalinaṃ caiva śūlāśaktamahākaram | pinākinaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ mudgarāśanidhāriṇam ||33 || asipaṭṭiśahastaṃ ca cakriṇaṃ cordhvamehanam | akṣasūtrakaraṃ caiva duṣprekṣyamakṛtātmabhiḥ ||34|| candrādityagrahaiścaiva kṛtasragupabhūṣaṇam | tamapaśyanta te sarve devā divyena cakṣuṣā | yaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhavenmṛtyurmartyasyāpi kadācana ||35|| tapasā viniyogayoginaḥ praṇamanto bhavamindunirmalam | viyatīśvaradattacakṣuṣaḥ saha devairmunayo mudānvitāḥ ||36|| prasamīkṣya mahāsureśakālaṃ manasā cāpi vicārya durvisahyam | praṇamanta gatātmabhāvacintāḥ saha devairjagadudbhavaṃ stuvantaḥ | ||37|| iti skandapurāṇe rudradarśano nāmāṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.9> sanatkumāra uvāca te dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ brahmendrapramukhāḥ surāḥ | astuvan vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ praṇamya vṛṣavāhanam ||1 || pitāmaha uvāca namaḥ śivāya somāya bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇe | namaḥ śūlāgrahastāya kamaṇḍaludharāya ca ||2|| namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya karāladaśanāya ca | tretāgnidīptanetrāya trinetrāya harāya ca ||3|| namaḥ pinākine caiva namo stvaśanidhāriṇe | vyālayajñopavītāya kuṇḍalābharaṇāya ca ||4|| namaścakradharāyaiva vyāghracarmadharāya ca | kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya sarpamekhaline tathā ||5|| varadātre ca putrāya sarasvatīsuve tathā | somasūryākṣamālāya akṣasūtrakarāya ca ||6|| jvānāmālāsahasrāya ūrdhvaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ parvatavāsāya śirohartre ca me purā ||7|| hālāhalavināśāya kapālavaradhāriṇe | vimānavaravāhāya janakāya mamaiva ca ||8|| varadāya variṣṭhāya śmaśānarataye namaḥ | namo narasya kartre ca sthitikartre namaḥ sadā ||9|| utpattipralayānāṃ ca kartre sarvasahāya ca | ṛṣidaivatanāthāya sarvabhūtādhipāya ca | śivaḥ saumyaśca deveśa bhava no bhakta vatsala ||8.9.10|| sanatkumāra uvāca brahmaṇyathaivaṃ stuvati devadevaḥ sa lokapaḥ | uvāca tuṣṭastāndevānṛṣīṃśca taptaidhitān |11 | u devān pa | | tuṣṭosmyanena vaḥ satya ntapasā ṛṣidevatāḥ | varaṃ brūta pradāsyāmi suniścitya ca ucyatām ||12|| sanatkumāra uvāca atha sarvānabhiprekṣya saṃtuṣṭāḥ tapasaidhitān | darśanenaiva viprendra brahmā vacanamabravīt ||13|| brahmovāca yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa yadi deyo varaśca naḥ | tasmācchivaśca saumyaśca saṃdṛśyaśca bhavasva naḥ ||14|| sukha saṃvyavahāryaśca nityaṃ tuṣṭamanāstathā | sarvakāryeṣu ca sadā hitaḥ pathyaśca śaṃkara ||15|| saha devyā sasūnuśca saha devagaṇairapi | eṣa no dīyatāṃ deva varo varasahasrada ||16|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktaḥ sa bhagavān brahmaṇā devasattamaḥ | svakaṃ tejo mahad divyaṃ vyasṛjat sarvayogavit ||17|| ardhena tejasastasya mukhādulkā sasarja ha | tāmāha bhava nārīti bhagavān viśvarūpadhṛk ||18|| sākāśaṃ dyāṃ ca bhūmiñca mahimnā vyāpya dhiṣṭhitā | upatasthe ca deveśaṃ dīpyamānā yathā taḍit ||19|| tāmāha prahasan devo devīṃ kamalalocanām | brahmāṇaṃ devi varadamārādhaya śucismite ||8.9.20 || sā tatheti pratijñāya tapastaptuṃ pracakrame | rudraśca tānṛṣīnāha śṛṇudhvaṃ mama toṣaṇe ||21|| phalaṃ phalavatāṃ śreṣṭhā yad bravīmi tapodhanāḥ | amarā jarayā tyaktā arogā janmavarjitāḥ ||22|| madbhaktāstapasā yuktā ihaiva ca nivatsyatha | ayaṃ caivāśramaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svarṇaśṛṅgocalottamaḥ ||23|| puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ sthānaṃ vai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | maināke parvate hyasmin svarṇākṣohaṃ yataḥ sthitaḥ ||24|| svarṇākṣīṃ cāsṛjaṃ devīṃ svarṇākṣaṃ tena tatsmṛtam | svarṇākṣa ṛṣayo yūyaṃ ṣaṭkulīyā stapodhanāḥ | |25|| nivatsyatha mayājñaptāḥ svarṇākṣaṃ vai tataśca ha | samantādyojanaṃ kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ | |26 || devagandharvacaritamapsarogaṇasevitam | siṃhebhaśarabhākīrṇaṃ śārdūlarkṣamṛgākulam | | 27| | anekavihagākīrṇaṃ latāvṛkṣakṣupākulam | brahmacārī niyamavān jitakrodho jitātmavān | | 28| | upoṣya triguṇāṃ rātriṃ caruṃ kṛtvā nivedya ca | yatra tatra mṛtaḥ sopi brahmaloke nivatsyati | | 29| | yopyevamevākāmānmāṃ paśyedatra vṛṣadhvajam | gosahasraphalaṃ sopi matprasādādavāpsyati || 8.9.30 | | niyamena mṛtaścātra mayā saha cariṣyati | yāvat sthāsyanti lokāśca mainākaścāpyayaṃ giriḥ | | 31 | | tāvat saha mayā devā matprasādāccariṣyatha | evaṃ sa tānṛṣīnuktvā dṛṣṭavā saumyena cakṣuṣā | paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata | |3 2 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ya imāṃ śṛṇuyānmartyo dvijātīñchrāvayīta vā | sopi tatphalamāsādya carenmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ | | 33 | | jayati jaladavāhaḥ sarvabhūtāntakālaḥ | śamadamaniratānāṃ kleśahartā yatīnām | jananamaraṇahartā ceṣṭatāṃ dhārmikāṇām | vividhakaraṇayuktaḥ khecaraḥ pādacārī ||34| | madanapuravidārī netradantāpahārī | vigatabhayaviṣādaḥ sarvabhūtapraṇetā || satatamabhidadhānaścekitānātmacitaḥ | karacaraṇalalāmaḥ sarvadṛg devadevaḥ || 35 || iti skandapurāṇe varapradāniko nāma navamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.10> sanatkumāra uvāca sā devī tryambakaproktā tatāpa suciraṃ tapaḥ | nirāhārā kadācicca ekaparṇṇāśanā punaḥ ||1 || vāyvāhārā punaścāpi abbhakṣā bhūya eva hi | tāṃ tapaścaraṇe yuktāṃ brahmā jñātvātibhāsvarām ||2|| uvāca brūhi tuṣṭosmi devi kiṃ karavāṇi te | sābravīt tryambakaṃ devaṃ patiṃ prāpyenduvarccasam | vicareyaṃ sukhaṃ deva sarvāṃllokānnamastava ||3|| brahmovāca nahi yena śarīreṇa kriyate paramaṃ tapaḥ| tenaiva parameśosau patiḥ śambhuravāpyate ||4|| tasmāddhi yogādbhavatī dakṣasyeha prajāpateḥ | jāyasva duhitā bhūtvā patiṃ rudramavāpsyasi ||5|| tataḥ sā tadvacaḥ śrutvā yogāddevī manasvinī | dakṣasya duhitā jajñe satīnāmātiyoginī ||6|| tāṃ dakṣastryambakāyaiva dadau bhāryāmaninditām | brahmaṇo vacanādyasyāṃ mānasānasṛjatsutān ||7|| ātmatulyabalāndīptān jarāmaraṇavarjitān | anekāni sahasrāṇi rudrāṇāmamitaujasām ||8|| tāndṛṣṭā mṛjyamānām̐śca brahmā taṃ pratyaṣedhayat | mā srākṣīrdevadeveśa prajā mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ ||9|| anyāḥ sṛjasva bhadrante prajā mṛtyusamanvitāḥ | tena coktaṃ sthitosmīti sthāṇustena tataḥ smṛtaḥ ||8.10.10 || devadeva uvāca na srakṣye mṛtyusaṃyuktāḥ prajā brahman kathañcana | sthitosmi vacanāttedya vaktavyo nāsmi te punaḥ ||11|| ye tvime mānasāḥ sṛṣṭā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ | cariṣyanti mayā sārdha sarva ete hi yājñikāḥ ||12 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha kāle gate vyāsa sa dakṣaḥ śāpakāraṇāt | anyānāhūya jāmātṝnsadārānarccayad gṛhe ||13|| satīṃ saha tryambakeṇa nājuhāva ruṣānvitaḥ | satī jñātvā tu tatsarvaṃ gatvā pitaramabravīt ||14|| ahaṃ jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca jāmātrā saha suvrata| māṃ hitvā nārhasi hyetāḥ saha bhartṛbhirarcitum ||15|| krodhenātha samāviṣṭaḥ sa krodhopahatendriyaḥ | nirīkṣya prābravīd dakṣaścakṣuṣā nirdahanniva ||16|| māmetāḥ sati sasnehāḥ pūjayanti sabhartṛkāḥ | na tvaṃ tathā pūjayase saha bhartrā mahāvrate ||17|| gṛhāṃśca me sapatnīkāḥ praviśanti tapodhanāḥ | śreṣṭho stasmātsadā manye tatastānarcayāmyaham ||18|| tasmād yāṃ te karomyadya śubhāṃ vā yadi vāśubhām | pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa tāṃ putri gaccha vā yatra rocate ||19|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sā krodhadīptāsyā na jagrāhātikopitā | pūjāmasammatāṃ hīnāmidaṃ covāca taṃ śubhā ||8.10.20 | | yasmādasammatāmenāṃ pūjāṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe mayi | ślāghyāṃ caivāpyaduṣṭāñca śreṣṭhāṃ māṃ garhase pitaḥ ||21 || tasmādiyaṃ svakaṃ dehaṃ tyajāmyeṣā tavātmajam | asatkṛtāyāḥ kiṃ medya jovitenāśubhena ha || 22|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ manasā tryambakāya ha | upācedaṃ susaṃrabdhā vacanaṃ vacanāraṇiḥ | |23|| yatrāhamupapadyeyaṃ punardehe svayecchayā | deva tatrāpyasaṃmūḍhā saṃbhūtā dhārmikā satī | |24|| gaccheyaṃ dharmapatnītvaṃ tryambakasyaiva dhīmataḥ | tataḥ sā dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā devyāgneyīṃ samādhinā ||25|| dadāha vai svakaṃ dehaṃ svasamutthena vahninā | tāṃ jñātvā tryambako devīṃ tathābhūtāṃ mahāyaśāḥ ||26|| uvāca dakṣaṃ saṃgamya idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ | yasmātte ninditaścāhaṃ praśastāścetare pṛthak ||27|| jāmātaraḥ sapatnīkāstasmādvaivasvatentare | utpatsyante punaryajñe tava jāmātarastvime ||28|| tvaṃ caiva mama śāpena kṣatriyo bhavitā nṛpa | pracetasāṃ sutaścaiva kanyāyāṃ śākhināṃ punaḥ | dharmavighnañca te tatra kariṣye krūrakarmaṇaḥ ||29|| sanatkumāra uvāca tamuvāca tadā dakṣo dūyatā hṛdayena vai | mayā yadi sutā svā vai proktā tyaktāpi vā punaḥ ||8.10.30|| kiṃ tavātra kṛtaṃ deva ahaṃ tasyāḥ prabhuḥ sadā | yasmāttvaṃ māmabhyaśapastasmāttvamapi śaṅkara | bhuvyeva vatsyase nityaṃ nāntarikṣe kadācana ||3 1 || bhāgaṃ ca tava yajñeṣu dattvā sarve dvijātayaḥ | apasprakṣyanti sarvatra mahādeva mahādyute ||32|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa devaḥ prahasan tamuvāca trilocanaḥ | sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ mūlaṃ bhūrloka ucyate ||33 || tamahaṃ dhārayāmyeko lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | etasmin hi dhṛte lokāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti śāśvatāḥ ||34|| tasmāttiṣṭhāmyahaṃ nityamihaiva na tavecchayā | bhāgāndattvā tathānyebhyo ditsavo me dvijātayaḥ ||35|| apaḥ spṛśanti śuddhyarthaṃ bhāgaṃ yacchanti me tataḥ | śī yaśca dharmasyaivābhivṛddhaye |||36||| dattvā spṛśanti bhūyaśca dharmasyaivābhivṛddhye||36|| yathā hi devanirmālyaṃ śucayo dhārayantyuta | aśuciṃ spraṣṭukāmāśca tyaktvāpaḥ saṃspṛśanti ca ||37|| yathā mamaiva manyeṣāṃ ditsavo brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ | bhāgānapaḥ spṛśanti sma tatra kā paridevanā ||38|| tvantu macchāpanirdagdho viparīto narādhamaḥ | svasyāṃ sutāyāṃ mūḍhātmā putramutpādayiṣyasi ||39|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavāñchaptvā dakṣaṃ devo jagatpatiḥ | virarāma mahātejā jagāma ca yathāgatam ||8.10.40|| somadivākaravahnisamākṣaṃ candranibhānanapadmadalākṣam | govṛṣavāhamameya guṇaughaṃ śāśvataminduvaha praṇatāḥ smaḥ ||41 || ya imaṃ dakṣaśāpāṅka devyāścaivāśarīratām | śṛṇuyād vātha viprān vā śrāvayīta yatavrataḥ | sa sarvapāpanirmukto rudralokamavāpnuyāt ||42|| iti skandapurāṇe dakṣaśāpo nāma daśamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.11> sanatkumāra uvāca kadācit svagṛhaṃ prāptaṃ kaśyapaṃ dvipadāmvaram | apṛcchaddhimavān praśnaṃ loke khyātikaraṃ nu kim | | 1 | | kenākṣayāśca lokāḥ syuḥ khyātiśca paramā mune | tathaiva cārcanīyatvaṃ satsu tat kathayasva me | | 2 | | kaśyapa uvāca apatyena mahābhāga sarvametadavāpyate | mama khyātirapatyena brahmaṇaścarṣibhiḥ saha | | 3 | | kinna paśyasi śailendra yato māṃ paripṛcchasi | varttayiṣyāmi taccāpi yanme dṛṣṭaṃ purācala | |4 | | vārāṇasīmahaṃ gacchannapaśyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ divi | vimānaṃ svanavaddivyamanaupamyamaninditam | | 5 | | tasyādhastādārttanādaṃ garbhasthāne śṛṇomyaham | ................| tānahaṃ tapasā jñātvā tatraivāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ | | 6 | | athāgāttatra śailendra vipro niyamavān śuciḥ | tīrthābhiṣekapūtātmā pare tapasi saṃsthita(?) | |7 | | atha sa vrajamānastu vyāghreṇābhīṣito dvijaḥ | viveśa taṃ tadā deśaṃ sā gartā yatra bhūdhara | |8 | | garttāyā vīraṇastambe lambamānāṃstadā munīn | apaśyadārto duḥkhārttānapṛcchattāṃśca sa dvijaḥ | | 9 | | ke yūyaṃ vīraṇastambe lambamānā hyadhomukhāḥ | duḥkhitāḥ kena mokṣaśca yuṣmākaṃ bhavitānaghāḥ | | 8.11.10 | | pitara ūcuḥ vayantekṛtapuṇyasya pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ | prapitāmahāśca kliśyāmastava duṣṭena karmaṇā |||11|| narakoyaṃ mahābhāga garttārūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ | tvañcāpi vīraṇastambastvayi lambāmahe vayam ||12|| yāvattvaṃ jīvase vipra tāvadeva vayaṃ sthitāḥ | mṛte tvayi gamiṣyāmo narakaṃ pāpacetasaḥ ||13|| yadi tvaṃ dārasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvāpatyaṃ guṇottaram | utpādayasi tenāsmānmucyema vayamekaśaḥ ||14|| nānyena tapasā putra na tīrthānāṃ phalena ca | tat kuruṣva mahābuddhe tārayasva pitṝn bhayāt ||15|| sa tatheti pratijñāya ārādhya ca vṛṣadhvajam | pitṝn garttātsamuddhṛtya gaṇapān pracakāra ha ||16|| svayañca rudradayitaḥ sukeśo nāma nāmataḥ | saṃmato balavāṃścaiva rudrasya ca gaṇapobhavat ||17|| tasmāt kṛtvā tapo ghoramapatyaṃ guṇavad bhṛśam | utpādayasva śailendra tataḥ kīrtimavāpsyasi ||18|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukta ṛṣiṇā śailendro niyame sthitaḥ | tapaścakāra vipulaṃ yena brahmā tutoṣa ha ||19|| tamāgatya tato brahmā varadosmītyamāṣata | brūhi tuṣṭosmi te śaila tapasānena suvrata ||8.11.20|| himavānuvāca bhagavan putramicchāmi guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam | etadvaraṃ prayacchasva yadi tuṣṭosi naḥ prabho ||21|| brahmovāca kanyā bhavitrī śailendra sutā te varavarṇinī | yasyāḥ prabhāvāt sarvatra kīrttimāpsyasi puṣkalām ||22 | | arcitaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tīrthakoṭīsamāvṛtaḥ | pāvanaścaiva puṇyaśca devānāmapi sarvataḥ | jyeṣṭhā ca sā bhavitrī te anye cānu tataḥ śubhe ||23 || sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā tato brahmā tatraivāntaradhīyata | sopi kālena śailendro menāyāmudapādayat ||24|| aparṇāmekaparṇāṃ ca tathā cāpyekapāṭalām | nyagrodhamekaparṇā tu pāṭalaṃ caikapāṭalā ||25|| āśrite dve hyaparṇā tu aniketā tapocarat | śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ duścaraṃ devadānavaiḥ ||26|| āhāramekaparṇena saikaparṇā samācarat | pāṭalena tathaikena vyadadhāccaikapāṭalā ||27|| pūrṇe pūrṇe sahasre tu āhāraṃ te ca cakratuḥ | aparṇā tu nirāhārā tāṃ mātā pratyabhāṣata ||28|| niṣedhayantītyumeti mātṛsnehena duḥkhitā | sā tathoktā tadā mātrā devī duścaracāriṇī | tenaiva nāmnā lokeṣu vikhyātā surapūjitā | |29|| etat tattri kumārīkaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | etāsāṃ tapasā lokān yāvad bhūmirdhariṣyati | |8.11.3 0 || tapaḥśarīrāstāḥ sarvāstisro yogabalānvitāḥ | sarvāścaiva mahāyogāḥ sarvāśca sthirayauvanāḥ ||3 1 || lokānāṃ mātara ścaiva brahmacāriṇya eva ca | anugṛhṇanti lokāṃśca tapasā svena sarvadā ||3 2 || umā tāsāṃ variṣṭhā ca śreṣṭhā ca varavarṇinī | mahāyogabanopetā mahādevamupasthitā ||3 3 | | dattakaścośanāstasyāḥ putraḥ sa bhṛgunandanaḥ | asitasyai kavarṇā tu devalaṃ suṣuve sutam | |34|| yā tu tāsāṃ kumārīṇāṃ tṛtīyā hyekapāṭalā | putraṃ śataśalākasya jaigīṣavyamupasthitā || 35 || tasyāpi śaṃkhalikhitau smṛtau putrāvayonijau | umā tu yā mayā tubhyaṃ kīrtitā varavarṇinī ||3 6|| atha tasyāstapo yogāt trailokyamakhilaṃ tadā | pradhūpitaṃ samālakṣya brahmā vacanamabravīt || 37| | brahmovāca devi kiṃ tapasā lokān tāpayiṣyasi śobhane | tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ mā kṛtvaitad vināśaya ||38 || tvaṃ hi dhārayase lokānimān sarvān svatejasā | brūhi kinte jaganmātaḥ prārthitaṃ saṃprasīda naḥ | |3 9| | devyuvāca yadarthantapaso hyasya caraṇaṃ me pitāmaha | jānīṣe tattvatastanme tataḥ pṛcchasi kiṃ punaḥ ||8.11.40 || brahmovāca yadartha devi tapasā śrāmyase lokabhāvani | sa tvāṃ svayaṃ samāgamya ihaiva varayiṣyati | |41 || sarvadevapatiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ | vayaṃ sadevā yasyeśe vaśyāḥ kiṅkaravādinaḥ ||42|| sadevadevaḥ parameśvareśvaraḥ svayaṃ tavāyāsyati lokapontikam | udārarūpo vikṛto bhirūpavān samānarūpo hi narasya kasyacit ||43 || maheśvaraḥ parvatalokavāsī carācareśaḥ prathamo prameyaḥ | vinendunāpīndu samānavaktro vibhīṣaṇaṃ rūpamihāsthitogryam ||44|| iti skandapurāṇe devyā varapradānaṃ nāma ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.12> tataḥ sa bhagavāndevo brahmā tāmāha susvaram | devi yenaiva sṛṣṭāsi na vinā yastvayā śubhe ||1 | | sa bhartā tava deveśo bhavitā mā tapaḥ kṛthā| tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmā vyāsa gireḥ sutām ||2|| jagāmādarśanaṃ tasyāḥ sā cāpi virarāma ha | sā devī yuktamityevamuktvā svasyāśramasya ha ||3|| dvāri jātamaśokaṃ vai samupāśritya saṃsthitā | athāgāccandratilakastridaśārtiharo haraḥ ||4|| vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya hrasvo bāhuka eva ca | vibhugnanāsiko bhūtvā kubjaḥ keśāntapiṅgalaḥ ||5|| uvāca vikṛtāsyaśca devi tvāṃ varayāmyaham | athomā yogasaṃsiddhā jñātvā śaṅkaramāgatam ||6|| antarbhāvaviśuddhātmā kriyānuṣṭhānalipsayā | tamuvācārghapādyābhyāṃ madhuparkeṇa caiva hi | saṃpūjya sumanonetrā brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇapriyā ||7|| devyuvāca bhagavanna svatantrāsmi pitā mestyaraṇo tathā | tau prabhū mama dāne vai kanyāhaṃ dvijapuṅgava ||8|| gatvā yācasva pitaraṃ mama śailendramavyayam | sa ceddadāti māṃ vipra tubhyaṃ tadrucitaṃ mama ||9| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devastathaiva vikṛtaḥ prabhuḥ | uvāca śailarājaṃ tamumā me yaccha śailapa ||8.12.1 0 || sa taṃ vikṛtarūpeṇa jñātvā rudramathāvyayam | bhītaḥ śāpācca vimanā idaṃ vacanabravīt ||11 || bhagavannāvamanyāmi brāhmaṇān bhūmi daivatān | manīṣitaṃ tu yat pūrvaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahātapaḥ ||12|| svayaṃvaro me duhiturbhavitā vipra pūjitaḥ | varayedyaṃ svayaṃ tatra sa bharttāsyā bhavediti ||13|| sanatkumāra uvāca tacchrutvā śailavacanaṃ bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | devyāḥ samīpamāgatya idamāha mahāmanāḥ ||14|| devi pitrā tavājñaptaḥ svayaṃvara iti śrutam | tatra tvaṃ varayitrī yaṃ sa te bharttā kilānaghe ||15|| tadāpṛcche gamiṣyāmi durllabhā tvaṃ varānane | rūpavantaṃ samutsṛjya vṛṇāthā mādṛśaṃ katham ||16|| sanatkumāra uvāca tenoktā sā tadā tatra bhāvato yattadīritam | bhāvañca rudranihitaṃ prasādaṃ manasastathā ||17|| saṃprāpyovāca deveśaṃ mā tebhūd buddhiranyathā | ahaṃ tvāṃ varayiṣyāmi nānyadbhūtaṃ kathañcana ||18|| athavā testi sandeho mayi vipra kathañcana | ihaiva tvāṃ mahābhāga varayāmi manorathe ||19|| sanatkumāra uvāca gṛhītvā stabakaṃ sā tu hastābhyāṃ tatra saṃsthitam | skandhe śambhoḥ samādhāya devī prāha vṛtosi me ||8.12.20 || tataḥ sa bhagavān devastathā devyā vṛtastadā | uvāca tamaśokaṃ vai vācā saṃjīvayanniva ||21 || yasmāttava supuṣpeṇa stabakena vṛto hyaham | tasmāttvaṃ jarayā tyaktaḥ amaraḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi ||22|| kāmarūpaḥ kāmapuṣpaḥ kāmago dayito mama | sarvābharaṇapuṣpāḍhyaḥ sarvavṛkṣaphalopagaḥ ||23|| sarvānnabhakṣadaścaiva amṛtasrava eva ca | sarvagandhaśca devyāstvaṃ bhaviṣyasi dṛḍhaṃ priyaḥ ||24|| nirbhayaḥ sarvalokeṣu cariṣyasi sunirvṛtaḥ | āśramaṃ cainamatyarthaṃ citrakūṭeti viśrutam ||25 || yobhiyāsyati puṇyārthī sośvamedhamavāpsyati | yatra tatra mṛtaścāpi brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ||26|| yaścātra niyamairyuktaḥ prāṇān samyak parityajet | sa devyāstapasā yukto mahāgaṇapatirbhavet ||27|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā tato deva āpṛcchya himavatsutām | antardadhe jagatsraṣṭā sarvabhūtapa īśvaraḥ ||22|| sāpi devī gate tasmin bhagavatyamitātmani | tata evonmukhī sthitvā śilāyāṃ saṃviveśa ha ||29|| unmukhī sā gate tasminmaheṣvāse prajāpatau | niśeva candrarahitā babhūva vimanāstadā ||8.12.30|| atha śuśrāva sā śabdaṃ bālasyārttasya śailajā | sarasyudakasaṃpūrṇe samīpe svāḥśramasya ha ||31|| sa kṛtvā bālarūpaṃ tu devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ | krīḍāhetoḥ saromadhye grāhagrastobhavattadā ||32| | yogamāyāmathāsthātha prapañcodbhavakāraṇaḥ | tadrūpaṃ saraso madhye kṛtvedaṃ samabhāṣata ||3 3 || trātu māṃ kaścidetyeha grāheṇa hṛtacetasam | dhikkaṣṭaṃ bāla evāhamaprāptotha manoratham || 34| | yāsyāmi nidhanaṃ vaktre grāhasyāsya durātmanaḥ | śocāmi na svakaṃ dehaṃ grāhagrastopi duḥkhitaḥ ||35|| yathā śocāmi pitaraṃ mātarañca tapasvinīm | māṃ śrutvā grāhavadane prāptaṃ nidhanamutsukau ||3 6| | priyaputrāvekaputrau prāṇānnūnaṃ vihāsyataḥ | aho bata mahat kaṣṭaṃ yohaṃ bālokṛtavrataḥ ataptvā tapa evāyaṃ yāsyāmi nidhanaṃ hataḥ | |37| | sanatkumāra uvāca śrutvā tu devī tannādaṃ viprasyārttasya śobhanā | utthāya pradrutā tatra yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ | |38 | | sāpaśyadinduvadanā bālakañcārurūpiṇam | grāheṇa grasyamānaṃ taṃ vepamānamavasthitam ||3 9|| sopi grāhavaraḥ śrīmān dṛṣṭvā devīmupāgatām | taṃ gṛhītvā drutaṃ yāto madhyaṃ sarasa eva hi||8.12.40 || sa kṛṣyamāṇastejasvī nādamārttantadākarot | athāha devī duḥkhārttā bālaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvratā ||41|| grāharāja mahāsatva bālakaṃ hyekaputrakam | visṛjainaṃ mahādaṃṣṭra kṣipraṃ bhīmaparākrama |42| grāha uvāca yo devi divase ṣaṣṭhe prathame samupaiti mām | sa āhāro mama purā vihito lokakartṛbhiḥ ||43 || soyaṃ mama mahābhāge ṣaṣṭhehani girīndraje | brahmaṇā prahito nūnaṃ nainaṃ mokṣye kathañcana ||44| | devyuvāca yanmayā himavacchṛṅge caritaṃ tapa uttamam | tena bāla mimaṃ muñca grāharāja namostu te ||45|| grāha uvāca mā vyayaṃ tapaso devi kārṣīḥ śailendranandane | nainaṃ mocayituṃ śakto devarājopi yaḥ svayam ||46|| mahyamīśena tuṣṭena śarveṇogreṇa śūlinā | amaratvamavadhyatvamakṣayaṃ balameva ca ||47|| svayaṃ grahaṇamokṣaśca jñānañcaivāvyayaṃ punaḥ | dattaṃ tato bravīmi tvāṃ nāyaṃ mokṣamavāpsyati ||48|| athavā te kṛpā devi bhṛśaṃ bāle śubhānane | bravīmi yat kuru tathā tato mokṣamavāpsyati ||49 devyuvāca grāhādhipa vadasvāśu yat satāmavigarhitam | tat kṛtaṃ nātra sandeho mānyā me brāhmaṇā dṛḍham ||8.12.50 || grāha uvāca yat kṛtaṃ vai tapaḥ kiñcidbhavatyā svalpamantataḥ | tat sarvaṃ me prayacchasva tato mokṣamavāpsyati ||51 || devyuvāca janmaprabhṛti yat puṇyaṃ mahāgrāha kṛtaṃ mayā | tatte sarva mayā dattaṃ bālaṃ muñca mamāgrataḥ ||52|| sanatkumāra uvāca prajajvāla tato grāhastapasā tena bṛṃhitaḥ | āditya iva madhyāhne durnirīkṣyastadābhavat |||53|| uvāca cedaṃ hṛṣṭātmā devīṃ lokasya dhāriṇīm | devi kiṃ kṛtametatte aniścitya mahāvrate ||54|| tapaso hyarjanaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasya tyāgo na śasyate | gṛhāṇa tapa etacca bālaṃ cemaṃ śucismite ||55|| tuṣṭosmi te viprabhaktyā varaṃ tasmāddadāmi te | sā tvevamuktā grāheṇa uvācedaṃ mahāvratā | |56|| suvicintya mahāgrāha kṛtaṃ bālasya mokṣaṇam | na viprebhyastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhā me brāhmaṇā matāḥ ||57|| dattvā cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi grāhendra viditaṃ hi te | na hi kaścinnaro grāha pradattaṃ punarāharet ||58|| dattametanmayā tubhyaṃ nādadāmi hi tatpunaḥ | tvayyeva ramatāmetad bālaścāyaṃ vimucyatām ||59|| tathoktastāṃ praśasyātha muktvā bālaṃ namasya ca | devīmādityasadbhāsaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ||8.12.60 || bālopi sarasastīre mukto grāheṇa vai tadā | svapnalabdha ivārtho yastatraivāntaradhīyata ||61| | tapasotha vyayaṃ matvā devī himagirīndrajā | bhūya eva tapaḥ kartumārebhe yatnamāsthitā ||62|| kartukāmāṃ tapo bhūyo jñātvā tāṃ śaṃkaraḥ svayam | provāca vacanaṃ vyāsa mā kṛthāstapa ityuta ||63|| mahyametattapo devi tvayā dattaṃ mahāvrate | tenaitadakṣayaṃ tubhyaṃ bhaviṣyati sahasradhā ||64|| iti labdhvā varaṃ devī tapasokṣayyamuttamam | svayaṃvaramudīkṣantī tasthau prītiyutā satī ||65|| idaṃ paṭhedyo hi naraḥ sadaiva bālānubhāvācaraṇaṃ hi śambhoḥ | sa dehabhedaṃ samavāpya pūto bhaved gaṇastasya kumāratulyaḥ ||66|| iti skandapurāṇe dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.13> sanatkumāra uvāca vistṛte himavatpṛṣṭhe vimānaśatasaṃkule | abhavat sa tu kālena śailaputryāḥ svayaṃvaraḥ ||1|| atha parvatarājosau himavān dhyānakovidaḥ | duhiturdevadevena jñātvā tadabhimantritam ||2|| jānannapi mahāśailaḥ samācārakriyepsayā | svayaṃvaraṃ tato devyāḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat ||3 || devadānavasiddhānāṃ sarvalokanivāsinām | vṛṇuyāt parameśānaṃ samakṣaṃ yena me sutā ||4|| tadeva sukṛtaṃ ślāghyaṃ mamābhyudayasammatam | iti saṃcintya śailendraḥ kṛtvā hṛdi maheśvaram ||5|| ābrahmakeṣu lokeṣu devyāḥ śailendrasattamaḥ | kṛtvā ratnākulaṃ deśaṃ svayaṃvaramacīkarat ||6|| (?) athaivamāghoṣitamātra eva svayaṃvare vyāsa mahīdhraputryāḥ | devādayaḥ sarvajagannivāsāḥ samāyayurdivyagṛhītaveṣāḥ ||7| | praphullapadmāsanasanniviṣṭaḥ siddhairvṛto yogibhiraprameyaiḥ | vijñāpitastena mahīdhrarājā pitāmahastatra samājagāma ||8|| akṣṇāṃ sahasraṃ surarāṭ sa bibhrad divyāṅgahārasragudāttarūpaḥ | airāvataṃ sarvagajendramukhyaṃ sravanmadāsārakṛtapravāham ||9|| āruhya sarvāmararāṭ sa vajraṃ bibhratsamāgāt purataḥ surāṇām | tejaḥ pratāpā 'dhikadivyarūpaḥ prodbhāsayan sarvadiśo vivasvān ||8.13.10|| haimaṃ vimānaṃ sa calatpatāka māruhya āgāt tvaritaṃ javena | maṇipradīptojjvalakuṇḍalaśca vahnyarkatejaḥpratime vimāne ||11|| samabhyagāt kaśyapaviprasūnurāditya ārād bhaganāmadhārī | pīnāṅgayaṣṭiḥ sukṛtāṅgaḥhārastejobalājñāsadṛśaprabhāvaḥ ||12|| daṇḍaṃ samādāya kṛtānta āgādāruhya bhīmaṃ mahiṣaṃ javena | mahāmahīdhrocchraya pīnagātraḥ svarṇādiratnā citacāruveṣaḥ ||13|| samīraṇaḥ sarvajagadvibharttā vimānamāruhya samabhyagāddhi | santāpayansarvasurāsureśām̐stejodhika stejasi sanniviśya ||14|| vahniḥ samabhyetya surendramadhye jvalan pratasthau varaveṣadhārī | nānāmaṇiprajvalitāṅgayaṣṭirjagaccarandivyavimānamagryam ||15|| āruhya sarvadraviṇādhipeśaḥ sa rājarājastvaritobhyagācca | āpyāyayan sarvasurāsureśān kāntyā ca veṣeṇa ca cārurūpaḥ ||16|| jvalanmahāratnavicitrarūpaṃ vimānamāruhya śaśī samāgāt | śyāmāṅgayaṣṭiḥ suvicitraveṣaḥ sarva sragābaddhasugandhimālaḥ ||17|| tārkṣyaṃ samāruhya mahīdhrakalpaṃ gadādharosau tvaritaṃ sametaḥ | tathāśvinau devabhiṣagvarau tau ekaṃ vimānaṃ tvarayābhiruhya ||18|| manoharāvujjvalacāruveṣāvājagmaturdevasadaḥ suvīrau | śeṣaḥ sahasraṃ sphuradagnivarṇaṃ bibhrat phaṭānāṃ jvalanārkatejāḥ | |19|| sārdhaṃ sa nāgairaparairmahātmā vimānamāruhya samabhyagācca | diteḥ sutānāṃ ca mahāsurāṇāṃ vahnyarkaśakrānila tulyabhāsām ||8.13.20|| varānurūpaṃ pravidhāya veṣaṃ vṛndaṃ samāgāt purataḥ surāṇām | gandharvarājaḥ sa ca cārurūpī divyāṅgano divyavimānacārī ||21 || gandharvasaṃghaiḥ sahitopsarobhiḥ śakrājñayā tatra samājagāma | anye ca devāstridivaukaseśāḥ pṛthak pṛthak cārugṛhītaveṣāḥ ||22|| ājagmurāruhya vimānapṛṣṭhaṃ gandharvayakṣoragakinnarāśca | śacīpatistatra surendrasaṃghe rājādhikārādhikalakṣyamūrttiḥ ||23|| rājñāṃ balaiśvaryakṛtapramoho vṛthādhikaṃ yatnamupācakāra | hetustrilokasya jagatprasūti rmātā ca teṣāṃ sasurāsurāṇām ||24|| patnī ca śaṃbhoḥ puruṣasya dhāmno gītā purāṇaiḥ prakṛtiḥ parārthā | dakṣasya kopād himavadgṛhaṃ sā kāryārthamāgāt parameśapatnī ||25|| evaṃ yatastānna viduḥ sureśā mohastatastānpara āviveśa | varārthamājagmu rato vimūḍhā īśena yasmād vṛḍitāḥ kṛtāste ||26|| tataḥ pranṛttābhi rathāpsarobhirgandharvasaṃghaiśca sugītaśabdaiḥ | sthitaiśca nānāvidharūpaveṣai devāsurāditridivokasaṃghaiḥ||27|| vimānapṛṣṭhe maṇihemacitre sthitā calaccāmarabījitāṅgī | sarvartupuṣpāṃ susugandhamālāṃ pragṛhya devī prasabhaṃ pratasthe||28|| sanatkumāra uvāca mālāṃ pragṛhya devyāntu sthitāyāṃ devasaṃsadi | śakrādyairāgatairdevaiḥ svayaṃvara upāgataiḥ ||29|| devyā jijñāsayā śambhurbhūtvā pañcaśikhaḥ śiśuḥ | utsaṅgatalasaṃsupto babhūva sahasā vibhuḥ ||8.13.3 ||34|| stambhitaḥ śiśurūpeṇa devadevena śambhunā | vajraṃ kṣeptuṃ no śaśāka bāhuñcālayituṃ na ca ||35|| bhago nāma tato deva ādityaḥ kāśyapo balī | utkṣipya muśalaṃ dīptaṃ kṣeptumaicchadvimohitaḥ ||38|| tasyāpi daśanāḥ peturdṛṣṭamātrasya śambhunā | yamasya stambhito daṇḍastejo vahneḥ śaśeḥ prabhā ||39|| balaṃ vāyostathānyeṣāṃ tasminsarvadivaukasām | balantejaśca yogañca śīghramutthāya sādaram ||42|| vavande caraṇau śambhorastuvacca pitāmahaḥ| paurāṇaiḥ sāmasaṃgītaiḥ puṇyākhyairguhyanāmabhiḥ ||43|| ajastvamamaro devaḥ sraṣṭā hartā vibhuḥ paraḥ | pradhāna stambhitānsarvadevām̐stānidamāha mahādyutiḥ ||52|| mūḍhāḥ stha devatāḥ sarve nainaṃ buddhyatha śaṃkaram | devadevamihāyātaṃ mamaivotpattikāraṇam ||52|| ayaṃ rudro mahādevaḥ śarvo bhīmaḥ kaparddavān | ugra īśāna ātmā ca ajaḥ śaṃkara eva ca ||53 || devadevaḥ paraṃ dhāma īśaḥ paśupatiḥ patiḥ | jagatsraṣṭā jagaddhartā jagatsaṃsthitikāraṇam ||54|| gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śīghrameta mevāmareśvarāḥ | sārdha namo vedarahasyāya vedāṅgāya namo namaḥ | viṣṭambhanāya śakrasya bāhorvedāṅakurāya ca | |6 | | carācarādhipataye śamanāya namo namaḥ | salileśayaliṅgāya yugāntāyataliṅgine | |7|| namaḥ kapālamālāya kapālasragviṇe namaḥ | namaḥ kapālahastāya daṃṣṭriṇe gadine namaḥ ||8|| namastrailokyanāthāya saptalokanatāya ca | namaḥ khaṭvāṅgahastāya pramathārttiharāya ca ||9|| namo yajñaśirohartre kṛṣṇakeśāpahāriṇe | bhaganetranipātāya pūṣṇo dantaharāya ca | | 8.14.10 | | namaḥ pinākaśūlāsikhaḍgamudgaradhāriṇe | namostu kālakālāya tṛtīyanayanāya ca || 11 || antakāntakṛte caiva namaḥ parvatavāsine | suvarṇaretase caiva śaṃkhakuṇḍaladhāriṇe | | 1 2| | vāḍvale(?)ryoganāśāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ | śaśāṅkādityanetrāya lalāṭanayanāya ca | | 13 || namaḥ śmaśānarataye śmaśānavaradāya ca | namo daivatanāthāya tryambakāya namo namaḥ | |14|| aśanīśatahāsāya brahmaṇyāyājitāya ca | gṛhasthasādhave nityaṃ jaṭine brahmacāriṇe || 1 5| | namo muṇḍārdhagaṇḍāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | salile tapyamānāya yogaiśvaryapradāya ca | | 1 6|| namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya pralayotpattikāriṇe | namonugrahakartre ca sthitikartre namo namaḥ | | 17| | namo rudrāya vasave ādityāyāśvine namaḥ | namaḥ pitretha sādhyāya viśvedevāya vai namaḥ || 18 | | namaḥ śivāya śarvāya ugrāya varadāya ca | namo bhīmāya senānye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || 1 9|| śucaye rerihāṇāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | mahādevāya citrāya namaścitrarathāya ca | |8.14.20 || pradhānāyāprameyāya kāryāya karaṇāya ca | puruṣāya namastestu puruṣecchākarāya ca | |21 | | namaḥ puruṣasaṃyogapradhānaguṇadhāriṇe | pravartakāya prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca sarvaśaḥ | |22|| kṛtākṛtasya saṃ(?)vetre phalasaṃyogadāya ca | kālajñāya ca sarvatra namo niyamacāriṇe ||23 || namo vaiṣamyakartre ca guṇānāṃ vṛttidāya ca | namaste devadeveśa namaste bhūtabhāvana | śivaḥ saumyaḥ sukho draṣṭuṃ bhava somo hi naḥ prabho | |24| | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavāndevo jagatpatirumāpatiḥ | stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvairamarānidamabravīt | |25| | draṣṭuṃ sukhaśca saumyaśca devānāmasmi bho surāḥ | paraṃ brūta yatheṣṭaṃ vo dātāsmi vadatānaghāḥ ||26|| tataste praṇatāḥ sarve ūcuḥ sabrahmakāḥ surāḥ | tathaiva bhagavannastu vara eṣovatiṣṭhatām ||27|| yadā kāryaṃ tadā nastvaṃ dāsyase varamīpsitam | evamastviti tānuktvā visṛjya ca surān haraḥ | lokāṃśca pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ viveśa bhavanaṃ tataḥ ||28|| yastu harotsavamadbhutametaṃ gāyati daivataviprasamakṣam | sopratirūpagaṇeśasamāno dehaviparyayametya sukhī syāt ||29|| sanatkumāra uvāca pārāśarya stavaṃ hīmaṃ śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭheta vā | sa svargalokagago bhūtvā pūjyatemararāḍiva ||8.14.30|| iti skandapurāṇe umāvivāhastavo nāma caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.15> sanatkumāra uvāca praviṣṭe bhavanaṃ deve sūpaviṣṭe varāsane savahnirmanmathaḥ krūro devaṃ veddhumanā bhavat ||1| | tamanācārasaṃyuktaṃ durātmānaṃ kulādhamam | lokān sarvān tāpayānaṃ sarveṣvakaruṇātmakam ||2|| ṛṣīṇāṃ vighnakartāraṃ niyamānāṃ vrataiḥ saha | cakrāhvayasya rūpeṇa ratyā saha samāgatam || 3 || athātatāyinaṃ vyāsa veddhukāmaṃ sureśvaram | nayanena tṛtīyena sāvajñaṃ tamavaikṣata | |4| | tatosya netrajo vahnirjvālāmālāsahasravān | saṃvṛtya ratibhartāramadahat saparicchadam | | 5| | sa dahyamānaḥ karuṇamārttokrośata visvaram | prasādayam̐śca taṃ devaṃ papāta sa mahītale | | 6| | āśu sogniparītāṅgo manmatho lokatāpanaḥ | papāta bhasmasāccaiva kṣaṇena samapadyata ||7| | patnī tu karuṇaṃ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā | devaṃ devīñca rudatī ayācat karuṇāyatī ||8| | tasyāstat krandanaṃ śrutvā devau tau karuṇātmakau | ūcatustāṃ samālokya samāśvāsya ca duḥkhitām | |9| | dagdha eṣa dhruvaṃ bhadre nāsyotpattiriheṣyate | aśarīropi te kāle kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati | |8.15.1 0 || yadā tu viṣṇurbhavitā vasudevasutaḥ śubhe | tadā tasya suto hyeṣa patiste bhavitā rate || 11 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sā taṃ varaṃ labdhvā kāmapatnī śubhānanā | jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ prītiyuktā gataklamā || 1 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ dagdhvā sa kāmaṃ tu śaṅkaro mūḍhacetasam | provāca himavatputrīṃ bhaktyā munivarasya ha || 13 || vasiṣṭho nāma viprendro māṃ kṛtvā hṛdi tapyate | tasyāhaṃ varadānāya prayāsyāmi mahāvrate | | 14| | evamuktvā sa devīṃ tu bhakta prītyā tadā vibhuḥ | jagāma tapato bhyāsaṃ vasiṣṭhasya munervibhuḥ ||1 5|| tato munivaraśreṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ tapatāṃ varam | vasiṣṭhamṛṣiśārdūlaṃ tapyamānaṃ parantapaḥ ||1 6|| pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu jvalamānamivānalam | uvāca bhagavān gatvā brūhi kinte dadānyaham ||17| | dadāmi divyaṃ cakṣuste paśya māṃ sagaṇaṃ dvija | dṛṣṭavā tu sa tamīśānaṃ praṇamya śirasā prabhum | śirasyañjalimādhāya tuṣṭāva hṛṣitānanaḥ | | 18 || vasiṣṭha uvāca namaḥ kanakaliṅgāya vedaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ sahasraliṅgāya vahniliṅgāya vai namaḥ | |1 9| | namaḥ purāṇaliṅgāya śrutiliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ paramaliṅgāya brahmaliṅgāya vai namaḥ ||8.15.20 | | namastrailokyaliṅgāya dāhaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ parvataliṅgāya sthitiliṅgāya vai namaḥ | |2 1 || namo rahasyaliṅgāya saptadvīpādhvaliṅgine | namaḥ sarvārthaliṅgāya sarvalokāṅgaliṅgine ||22 | | namostvavyakta liṅgāya buddhiliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namohaṅkāraliṅgāya bhūtaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | |23 | | nama indriyaliṅgāya namastanmātraliṅgine | namaḥ puruṣaliṅgāya bhāvaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | |24| | namaḥ satvordhvaliṅgāya tamoliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namo rajordhvaliṅgāya sattvaliṅgāya vai namaḥ ||25|| namo gaganaliṅgāya tejoliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namo vāmūrdhvaliṅgāya śabdaliṅgāya vai namaḥ ||26|| nama ṛksnutaliṅgāya yajurliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namastetharvaliṅgāya sāmaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | | 27|| namo yajñāṅgaliṅgāya yajñaliṅgāya vai namaḥ | namastenantaliṅgāya vedānugataliṅgine ||28|| diśa naḥ paramaṃ yogamapatyaṃ matsamaṃ tathā | brahma caivākṣayaṃ deva śamañcaiva paraṃ vibho | akṣayatvaṃ ca vaṃśasya dharme ca matimakṣayām ||29|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavān vyāsa vasiṣṭhenāmitātmanā | stūyamānastutoṣātha tuṣṭaścedaṃ tamabravīt ||8.15.30 || bhagavānuvāca tuṣṭastehaṃ dadāmyetat tava sarvaṃ manogatam | yogaṃ ca paramaṃ sūkṣmamakṣayaṃ sarvakāmikam ||31 || putrañca tvatsamaṃ divyaṃ tapoyogabalānvitam | jñānāni ca ṛṣiśreṣṭha pratibhāsyanti caiva te ||32| | damaḥ śamastathā kīrtistuṣṭirakrodha eva ca | nityaṃ tava bhaviṣyanti amaratvaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||33 || avaśyatva masahyatvamakṣayatvañca sarvadā | vaṃśasya cākṣatirvipra dharme ca matiravyayā | brūhi cānyānapi varān dadāmi ṛṣisattama ||34|| vasiṣṭha uvāca bhagavan viditaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ yadvartanaṃ vibho | bhaviṣyaṃ yena jānīyāṃ tanme deva vidhīyatām ||35| | deva uvāca bhaviṣyaṃ svecchayā kuryāmiti jñātuṃ na śakyate | tadapi matprasādena jñāsyasi nirvṛto bhava ||36|| vasiṣṭha uvāca bhagavan viditaṃ sarva bhaviṣyaṃ devasattama | tasyāpi tattathā deva yathā vā manyase prabho ||37| | devadeva uvāca bhaviṣyaṃ nānyathā kuryāditi me niścitā matiḥ | ........kathaṃ kuryāttadanyathā ||38|| tathā tannātra sandeho vihitaṃ yadyathā mayā | tasmāttenugrahaṃ kartā bhūyaḥ putrastavāvyaya ||39| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā tato devaḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ | paśyatastasya viprarṣeḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata ||8.15.40 || iti skandapurāṇe vasiṣṭhavarapradānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.16> varān sa labdhvā bhagavān vasiṣṭhosmatpitāmahaḥ | kaṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa ātmanaḥ sadṛśadyutim ||1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tenāsau varadānena devadevasya śūlinaḥ | arundhatyāmajanayattapoyogabalānvitam ||2 || brahmiṣṭhaṃ śaktināmānaṃ putraṃ putraśatāgrajam | tasya bālyātprabhṛtyeva vāsiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ||3|| rabhasopagatā bhaktirabhavad govṛṣadhvaje | sa kadācidapatyārthamārādhayadumāpatim ||4|| tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo varadosmītyabhāṣata | atha dṛṣṭavā tamīśānamidamāhānatānanaḥ ||5|| kena stoṣyāmi te deva yastvaṃ sarvajagatpatiḥ | sarvān dhārayase lokānātmanā samayādvibho ||6|| tvameva bhoktā bhojyañca kartā kāryaṃ tathā kriyā | utpādakastathotpādya utpattiścaiva sarvaśaḥ ||7|| ātmānaṃ putranāmānaṃ mama tulyaṃ guṇairvibho | icchāmi dattandeveśa eṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||8| | sanatkumāra uvāca tamevaṃvādinaṃ devaḥ prahasya vadatāṃ varaḥ | uvāca vacasā vyāsa diśaḥ sarvā vinādayan ||9|| tvayāhaṃ yācitaḥ śakte sa ca te saṃbhaviṣyati | tvatsamaḥ sarvavedajñastvadīyo munipuṅgava ||8.16.10|| bījātmā ca tathodbhūtaḥ svayamevāntarātmanā | bījātmanā na bhavati pariṇāmāntaraṅgataḥ ||11|| evaṃ sa ātmanātmā naḥ saṃbhūtopatyasaṃjñitaḥ | svenātmanā na bhavitā pariṇāmāntaraṃ gataḥ ||12|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā tu taṃ devaḥ prahasya ca nirīkṣataḥ | jagāma sahasā yogī adṛśyatvamatidyutiḥ ||13 || tasmin gate mahādeve śaktistava pitāmahaḥ | vacastat pariniścitya evamevetyamanyata ||14|| atha kāletimahati samatīte śubhaprade | tapasā bhāvitaścāpi mahatāgnisamaprabhaḥ ||15|| adṛśyantyāṃ mahāprajña ādadhe garbhamuttamam | tasyāmāpannasatvāyāṃ rājā kalmāṣapādṛṣim | bhakṣayāmāsa saṃrabdho rakṣasā hṛtacetanaḥ ||16|| iti skandapurāṇe ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.17> vyāsa uvāca kasmāt sa rājā tamṛṣiṃ cakhāda tapasānvitam | rakṣasā sa kimartha ca hṛtacetā bhavannṛpaḥ ||1 || vasiṣṭhayājyo rājāsīnnāmnā mitrasahaḥ prabhuḥ | saudāsastasya putrobhūdindracandrasamadyutiḥ ||2| | samāgamyābravīcchaktiścariṣye dīkṣito vratam | tato me niśi rājendra sadaiva piśitāśanam | |3 | | ihāgatasya yaccha tvaṃ śuci sarvaguṇānvitam | suprabhāhāra saṃyuktamekasyaikānta eva ca ||4|| evamastviti tenokte jagāma sa mahāmanāḥ | athāsyāntarhitaṃ rakṣo nṛpaterabhavattadā | |5|| sūdānnā jñāpayat tena tasyārthe munisattama | gate ca divase tāta saṃsmṛtyātha yatātmavān | sūdamāhūya provāca ārtavat sa narādhipaḥ | |6|| saudāsa uvāca mayā mṛtavaso prātarguruputrasya dhīmataḥ | piśitaṃ saṃpratijñātaṃ bhojanaṃ niśi saṃskṛtam ||7|| tatkuruṣva yathākṣipraṃ kālo noparamedyathā | sa evamuktaḥ provāca sūdo mṛtavasustadā ||8|| rājaṃstvayā tvanākhyātaṃ prāgeva narapuṅgava | sāṃprataṃ nāsti piśitaṃ stokamapyabhikāṃkṣitam ||9 || piśitasyaiva cālpasya bahūnāṃ caiva bhūbhujām | amṛtasya(?) pradānācca na kiṃcidavaśiṣyate | |8.17.1 0|| rājovāca jāne sarvopayogaṃ ca jāne cā duṣkṛtaṃ tava | jāne stokaṃ ca piśitaṃ kāryaṃ cedaṃ tathāvidham | mṛgyatāṃ piśitaṃ kṣipraṃ lubdhakaṃ yatra manyase || 11 || sanatkumāra uvāca piśitaṃ mṛgayan yatnānnāpyavindata karhicit | yadā na labdhavān māṃsaṃ tadovāca narādhipam | mṛgayan sāra (?)khi nnosmi śādhi kiṃ karavāṇi te | | 1 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktaḥ sūdena tasmin kāle narādhipaḥ | novāca kiṃcittaṃ sūdaṃ vimanāḥ sa babhūva ha | |1 3 || idamantaramāsādya viśvāmitrasamīritaḥ | rākṣaso rudhiro nāma saṃviveśa narādhipam || 14| | rākṣasena tadāviṣṭo rudhireṇa durātmanā | uvāca sūdaṃ śanakaiḥ karṇamūle mahādyutiḥ | |1 5|| gaccha yatkiṃcidānīya māṃsaṃ mānuṣyakaṃ tataḥ | gārdabhaṃ vāpyathauṣṭraṃ vā śīghraṃ saṃskartumarhasi | | 1 6| | kimasau jñāsyate rātrau tvayā bhūyaśca saṃskṛtam | rasavad gandhavaccaiva kṣiprameva samānaya | | 17|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastu tenātha mānuṣaṃ māṃsamādade | rājāpakāriṇo vyāsa sūdo śiṣṭasya kasyacit | |18| | athārdharātrasamaye bhāskarākāravarcasam | rājānala samaprakhyamapaśyanmunisattamam || 1 9| | sa tamarghyeṇa pādyena āsanāgravareṇa ca | arnayitvā tu vidhivadannamasyopapādayat ||8.17.2 0 || sa tadannaṃ samānītaṃ samālabhya mahātapāḥ | cukopa kṣobhitaṃ cāpi pārthivaṃ prahasanniva | |21 || śaktiruvāca pārthivādhama viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ rākṣasocitam | na dīyate vidhijñena tvaṃ tu māmavamanyase ||22 || yasmāttvaṃ rākṣasamidaṃ mahyaṃ ditsasi bhojanam | tasmāttvaṃ karmaṇānena puruṣādo bhaviṣyasi ||23|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktastejasvī rājā saṃcintya tattadā | uvāca krodharaktākṣo rākṣasāviṣṭhacetanaḥ | |24|| puruṣādo bhavetyevaṃ māmavocad bhavān yataḥ | atastvāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaṃ dvija || 25|| bhakṣayitvā viśuddhyarthaṃ muktaśāpastataḥ param | cariṣyāmi tapaḥ śuddhaṃ saṃyamyendriyasaṃyutam (?) | pitrā tavābhyanujñātaḥ svarge vatsye yathepsitam | |26 | | iti skandapurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmambikākhaṃḍe kalmāṣapādaśāpaḥ saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ <8.18> sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa rājā svaṃ rājyamutsṛjya saha bhāryayā | vanaṃ viveśa tatrābhūt puruṣādo mahābalaḥ ||1 || sobhakṣayata tatrāgre śaktimeva mahāmunim | tato bhrātṛśataṃ tasya vasiṣṭhasyaiva paśyataḥ ||2 | | tataḥ putravadhaṃ ghoraṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmasutaḥ prabhuḥ | notsasarja tataḥ krodhaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ kauśikaṃ prati | |3 || putraśokena mahatā bhṛśamevānvatapyata | sa baddhvā mahatīṃ kaṇṭhe śilāṃ brahmasutaḥ prabhuḥ ||4|| nadyāmātmānamasṛjacchatarātraṃ vasattayā(?) | ...iti tāṃ prāhurmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | |5| | punaḥ pāśairdṛḍhaṃ baddhvā anyasyāmasṛjad vaśī | tasyāṃ vipāśaḥ saṃvṛtto vipāśā sābhavattataḥ ||6 || tato vāpīṃ samāmādya nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ | vāyubhakṣastadā tasthau svadehaṃ paritāpayan | |7|| atha śuśrāva gacchantaṃ dhvanimekasya susvaram | adhīyānasya tatrāsau dhyānamevānvapadyata | |8|| athainaṃ cārusarvāṅgī pīnonnatapayodharā | upatasthegrataḥ patnī śakterdīnānanekṣaṇā ||9 || tāmuvāca kutastvaṃ vai kasyaivaṃ śrūyate dhvaniḥ | sovāca dīnayā vācā vadatāṃ śuśruvaṃ(?) tadā || 8.18.10 || adṛśyantyuvāca yadaiva sutaduḥkhena nirgatosyāśramād guro | tadāprabhṛtyeva cāhaṃ bhagavantamanuvratā || 11 | | adhīyānasya caivāyaṃ dhvaniḥ pautrasya te vibho | udarasthasya śruto me mā duḥkhaṃ duḥsahaṃ kṛthāḥ || 1 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca ….............................… | idānīmasti me vatse jīvitāśeti so bravīt || 13 || || ................|| 14| | ........................| ...............| | 15 | | ................| uvāca cainaṃ duṣṭātman daheyaṃ tvāṃ sabāndhavam | | 16 | | ...........................| dagdhena ca tvayā kiṃ me gaccha muktosi durmate | | 17| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa mukto dīnātmā rākṣasaḥ krūrakarmakṛt | praṇamya sahasā bhīto jagāma kauśikāntikam || 1 8| | niśācare gate rājā praṇamya śirasā munim | prasādayāmāsa tadā sa covācedamarthavat ||1 9|| na doṣastava rājendra rakṣasādhiṣṭhitasya vai | kṛtāstena kṛtāḥ (?) putrā nimittaṃ tatra rākṣasaḥ ||8.18.2 0 || praśādhi rājyaṃ rājendra pitṛpaitāmahaṃ priyam | brūhi kiṃ vā priyaṃ tedya karomi narapuṃgava | |2 1 | | rājovāca icchāmi bhagavan putraṃ tvayo tpāditamacyuta | devyāmasyāṃ mahāsatvaṃ tatkuruṣva mama priyam | |2 2 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamastvityathoktvāsau tasya patnyāṃ mahāvrata | putraṃ ca loṣṭakaṃ nāma janayāmāsa viśrutam ||23 | | taṃ loṣṭakaṃ tato rājye sva putramabhiṣicya saḥ | jagāma vanamevātha sabhāryastapasi sthitaḥ ||24|| vasiṣṭhasyāpi kālena śakteḥ putraḥ pratāpavān | adṛśyantyāṃ bhavatputro nāmnā sa hi parāśaraḥ ||25|| vasiṣṭhaṃ tu tadā dhīmān tātamevābhyamanyata | tāta tāteti ca muhurvyājahāra pitā guruḥ | |26 || tataḥ kadācid vijñāya bhakṣitaṃ rakṣasāśucim | pitaraṃ tapasā maṃtrai rajarakṣakṛtau (?) tadā | |27| tataḥ koṭyaḥ sapaṃcāśadrakṣasāṃ krūrakarmaṇām | juhāvāgnau mahātejāstato brahmābhyagād drutam ||28 || sutamabhyetya saṃpūjya vasiṣṭhasahitaḥ rudrabhāvayutasya ca | na mṛtyukālabahavaḥ (?) kariṣyanti mama vyathām | |68|| sanatkumāra uvāca tamevaṃ vādinaṃ matvā bruvāṇaṃ śuddhayā dhiyā | vyasarjayannadīnātmā dhṛtyā putraṃ mahātapāḥ ||69 || abhivandya pituḥ pādau śirasā sa mahāyaśāḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvṛtya saṃpratasthe viniścitaḥ ||8.20.70 || abhivandya ṛṣīn sarvān sa didṛkṣu rudāradhīḥ | munirdevamanāścaiva praṇatārtiharaṃ śivam | |71 | | iti skandapurāṇe nanditapaḥpraveśo nāma viṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.21> sanatkumāra uvāca nirgatotha tato nandī jagāma saritāṃ varām | bhuvanāmiti vikhyātāṃ sarvalokahitāvahām || 1|| tāṃ praviśya tato dhīmānekāgro dyutimām̐sthitaḥ | sa jajāpa tato rudraṃ mṛtyorbhītaḥ samāhitaḥ | | 2|| japatā tena tatraiva tatpareṇa tadāśiṣā | koṭirekā yadā japtā tadā devastutoṣa ha | |3 || sanatkumāra uvāca sovatīrya tato bhūyaḥ prayatātmā tathaiva ca | jajāpa koṭimanyāṃ tu rudramevānucintayan ||4|| dvitīyāyāṃ tataḥ koṭyāṃ saṃvṛtāyāṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ | abhyājagāma taṃ caiva varadosmītyabhāṣata ||5|| sa prāha bhagavan koṭiṃ tṛtīyāmadhikāmaham | japtumicchāmi deveśa tvatprasādāttvahaṃ vibho ||6|| evamastviti bhūyopi bhagavān pratyuvāca ha | ..jagāma svaṃ veśma devyā saha mahāmatiḥ ||7|| tatastṛtīyāṃ rudrāṇāṃ koṭimanyāṃ jajāpa ha | yugāntādityasaṃkāśaḥ tataḥ samabhavad dvijaḥ | |8 || tasya koṭitraye vyāsa samāpte jvalanatviṣaḥ | somaḥ saha gaṇairdevastaṃ deśamupacakrame ||9|| sa taṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya tadvṛttasalilācca ha | saṃsṛjannagrahastena nandinaṃ kālahābravīt ||8.21.1 0|| devadeva uvāca śailāde varadohaṃ te tapasānena toṣitaḥ | sādhu japtaṃ tvayā dhīman brūhi yatte manogatam ||11|| śailādiruvāca japeyaṃ koṭimanyāṃ vai bhūyopi tava tejasā | varametaṃ vṛṇe deva yadi tuṣṭosi me vibho ||12|| bhagavānuvāca śailāde.....tava tuṣṭosmi sāmbikaḥ | yaṃ tvadya vṛṇuṣe kāmaṃ sarvaṃ taṃ pradadāmi te ||13 || brahmatvamatha viṣṇutvamindratvamathavānyatām | ādityo bhava rudrau vā brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||14|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto devena śirasā pādayornataḥ | tuṣṭāva purakāmāṃgakratuparvatanāśanama ||15|| namo devādhidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ kāmāṃganāśāya nīlakaṃṭhāya vai namaḥ ||1 6| | namastuṣitanāśāya trailokyadamanāya ca | namaḥ kālāgradaṇḍāya ugradaṇḍāya vai namaḥ | | 1 7| | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāya sarvatokṣimukhāya ca | sarvataḥ prabhave caiva sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhate || 18| | namaste rukmavarṇāya tathaivātīndriyāya ca | namaḥ kanakaliṃgāya sarvaliṃgāya vai namaḥ || 1 9| | namaścandrārkavarṇāya yogeśāyājitāya ca | pinākapāṇaye caiva śūlamudgarapāṇaye ||8.21.20 || niṣaṅgiṇe khaḍgine ca paraśvadhadharāya ca | rathine carmiṇe caiva maheśāya ca vai namaḥ | | 21 | | namastriśūlahastāya ugradaṇḍadharāya ca | namo gaṇādhipataye rudrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | | 2 2| | namaḥ sahasranetrāya śatanetrāya vai namaḥ | ādityānāṃ pataye vasūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | |23 | | namaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pataye ākāśapataye namaḥ | namaḥ svarlokapataye umāyāḥ pataye namaḥ ||24| | namo yogādhigamyāya sarvayogapradāya ca | dhyānināṃ dhyāyamānāya (?) dhyānibhiḥ saṃstutāya ca || 25|| mṛtyave kāladaṇḍāya yamāya ca mahātmane | devādhipataye caiva divyasaṃhananāya ca ||26|| yajñāya vasudānāya svargadāya jayāya ca | savitre sarvadevānāṃ dharmāyānekarūpiṇe | |27| | amṛtāya vareṇyāya sarvadevastutāya ca | brahmaṇaśca śirohartre yajñasya ca mahātmanaḥ | |8| | tripuraghnāya cogrāya sarvāśubhaharāya ca | umādehārdharūpāya lalāṭanayanāya ca ||29|| mahiṣāndhakabhartre ca draṣṭre ca parameṣṭhine | brahmaṇe gurave caiva brahmaṇe janakāya ca | |8.21.3 0 | | kumāragurave caiva kumāravaradāya ca | haline muśalaghnāya mahāhāsāya vai namaḥ || 31 || mṛtyupāśāgrahastāya takṣakabrahmasūtriṇe | savidyudghanavātāya tathaiva vṛṣayāyine | |3 2 | | himavadvindhyavāsāya meroḥ pṛṣṭhanivāsine | kailāsavāsine caiva dhaneśvarasakhāya ca ||3 3 | | viṣṇudehārdhadattāya tasyaiva varadāya ca | sarvabhūtā dhiyajñāya sarvabhūtānukampine ||34|| antarbhūtādibhūtāya prāṇināṃ jīvadāya ca | namaste manyamānāya abhimānāya caiva hi ||3 5| | budhyamānāya bodhyāya draṣṭre vai cakṣuṣe namaḥ | namaste sparśayitre ca tathaiva rasanāya ca | |3 6 | | namo ghrāṇāya ghrātre ca śrotre śrotrāya caiva hi | hastine caiva hastāya tathā pādāya pādine ||37| | namostvānandakartre ca ānandāya ca te namaḥ | vācetha vāgmine caiva tanmātrāya mahātmane ||38| | sūkṣmāya caiva sthūlāya satvāya rajase namaḥ | namaśca tapase nityaṃ kṣetrajñāyājitāya ca | | 3 9| | viṣṇave lokakartre ca prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ | namaḥ saptarṣaye caiva tapyamānāya tāpine ||8.21.40 || brahmaṇyāya ca...tathā durvāsase namaḥ | śilpine śilpanāthāya viduṣe viśvakarmaṇe ||41 || atraye bhṛgave caiva vasiṣṭhāya namostu te | bhūtāya bhūtanāthāya...pataye namaḥ ||42 || tiṣṭhate dravate caiva gāyate nṛtyatepi ca | avaśyāyāpyavadhyāya ajarāyāmarāya ca ||43|| akṣayāyāpyayāyaiva tathāpratihatāya ca | anāveśyāya sarveṣāṃ dṛśyādṛśya svarūpiṇe ||44|| sūkṣmebhyaścātisūkṣmāya sarveśāya mahātmane | namaste bhagavan vyakṣa namaste bhagavan śiva ||45|| namaste sarvalokeśa namaste lokabhāvana | na me devādhipatyena brahmatvenāpi vā punaḥ ||46|| na viṣṇutvena deveśa na indratvena bhūtapa | icchāmyahaṃ taveśāna gaṇatvaṃ nityamavyayam ||47| | nityaṃ tvāṃ sagaṇaṃ sāmbaṃ prasannaṃ saparicchadam | draṣṭumicchāmi deveśa eṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||48|| dattvā gatiṃ purā deva tvaṃ vairāvarttanaṃ punaḥ (?) | śaraṇaṃ tvañca me nātha nānyaṃ paśyāmi karhicit ||49|| tvayā tyaktasya caivāśu vināśo nātra saṃśayaḥ | anyāṃ gatiṃ na paśyāmi yosyānyaṃ tentakaṃ śubham ||8.21.50|| anuraktaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca tvatparaṃ tvadupāśrayam | pratīccha māṃ sadā deva eṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||51 || sanatkumāra uvāca ya idaṃ prātarutthāya paṭhedavimanā naraḥ | sa dehabhedamāsādya nandīśvarasamo bhavet ||52| | yaścemaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā dvijātiṣu | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya rudraloke mahīyate ||53 || śrutvā sakṛdapi rhyetaṃ stavaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | yatra tatra mṛto vyāsa na durgatimavāpnuyāt ||54| | yodhītya nityaṃ stavametamagryaṃ devaṃ sadābhyarcayate yatātmā | kiṃ tasya yajñairvividhaiśca dānaistīrthaiḥ sutaptaiśca tathā tapobhiḥ | |55 || iti skandapurāṇe ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ <8.22> sanatkumāra uvāca tatastu devadeveśo bhaktyā paramayā yutam | aśrupūrṇekṣaṇaṃ dīnaṃ pādayoḥ śirasā natam || 1 || karābhyāṃ susukhābhyāṃ taṃ saṃgṛhya paramāttihā | utthāpya nayane soma aśrupūrṇe mamārja ha ||2 || uvāca cainaṃ tuṣṭātmā vacasāpyāyayanniva | nirīkṣya gaṇapān sarvān devyā saha tadā prabhuḥ ||3 || devadeva uvāca jāne bhaktiṃ tava mayi jāne cārttiṃ tavānagha | tasya sarvasya śailāde udarka sanniśāmaya ||4| | amaro jarayā tyakto nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjitaḥ | akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva sapitā sasuhṛjjanaḥ ||5 || mameṣṭo gaṇapaścaiva madvīryo matparākramaḥ | iṣṭo mama sadā caiva mama pārśvagatassadā | | 6|| madrūpaścaiva bhavitā mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | ṛddhimaccaiva te dvīpaṃ kṣīrodamamṛtākaram ||7| | saṃvāsaṃ ca prayacchāmi tatra raṃsyasi sarvadā | kuśeśayamayīṃ mālāmavamucyātmanastataḥ | |8|| ābabandha mahātejā nandine divyarūpiṇīm | sa tayā mālayā nandī babhau kaṇṭhāvasaktayā | | 9|| tryakṣo daśabhujaḥ śrīmān dvitīya iva śaṅkaraḥ | tato haste samādāya hastena bhagavān haraḥ || 8.22.10 | | uvāca brūhi kiṃ tedya dadāni varamuttamam | āśramaścāyamatyartha tapasā tava bhāvitaḥ || 11 || japyeśvara iti khyāto mama guhyo bhaviṣyati | samantād yojanaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ devagaṇairvṛtam || 12 || siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇamapsarogaṇasevitam | siddhikṣetraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 13 | | karmaṇā manasā vācā yatkiñcit kurute naraḥ | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vātra sarvaṃ bhavitṛ tacchubham | | 14|| japyamānaḥ sa tulyo vai rudrāṇāṃ tu bhaviṣyati | yatra tatra mṛtā martyā yāsyanti tvat salokatām | |1 5| | tato jaṭāplutaṃ vāri gṛhītvā hāranirmalam | uktvā nadī bhavasveti visasarja mahātapāḥ ||1 6|| sā tato divyatoyā ca puṇyā maṇijalā śubhā | haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇā cakravākopaśobhitā | |17|| padmotpalavanopetā prārvatata mahānadī | strīrūpadhāriṇī caiva prāñjaliḥ śirasānatā | |1 8| | padmotladalābhākṣī tadā devamupasthitā | tāmuvāca tato devo nadīṃ svayamupasthitām | | 19|| yasmājjaṭodakād devi pravṛttā tvaṃ śubhānane | tasmājjaṭodā nāmnā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi saridvarā | |8.22.20 | | tvayi snānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryācchucciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya rudraloke mahīyate | | 21 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tato devyā....nandīśvaramatiprabham | putrasteyamiti procya pādayostaṃ vyanāmayat | | 22|| sā tamāghrāya śirasi pāṇibhyāṃ parimārjatī | putrapremṇābhyaṣiñcattaṃ srotobhiḥ stanajaistribhiḥ |23|| payasā śaṃkhagaureṇa devī devaṃ nirīkṣatī | tāni srotāṃsi trīṇyasyāḥ srutānyodhavatī nadī | |24|| nadīṃ trisrotasīṃ puṇyāṃ tatastāmavadaddharaḥ | trisrotasāṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣa paramaharṣitaḥ | |25| | nanarda nādāt tasmācca saridanyā tatobhavat | yasmād vṛṣabhanādena pravṛttā sā mahānadī | |26|| tasmāḍ ḍhitkirikāntāṃ vai uvāca vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | jāmbūnadamayaṃ citraṃ svaṃ devaḥ paramādbhutam | |27| | mukuṭañcābabandhāsya kuṇḍale cāmṛtodbhave | taṃ tathābhyarcitaṃ vyomni dṛṣṭavā meghaḥ prabhākaraḥ | |28 | | devopavāhyaḥ siṣive sanādaḥ sataḍidguṇaḥ | tasyābhiṣiktasya tadā pravṛtte srotasī bhṛśam | |29| | yasmācca kuṇḍalāt svarṇāt nadyekā saṃpravartata | svarṇodaketi nāmnā tāṃ mahādevobhyabhāṣata | | 8.22.30 | | jambūnadamayā dyasmād dvitīyā mukuṭā cchubhāt | prāvartata nadī puṇyā prāha jāmbūnadīti tām ||3 1 || etatpañcanadaṃ nām japyeśvarasamīpagam | vyākhyātaṃ phalametāsāṃ jaṭodayā mahātmanā ||3 2 | | tacca pañcanadaṃ divyaṃ devaṃ japyeśvaraṃ ca tam | trirātropoṣito gatvā snātvābhyarcya ca śūlinam | |3 3 || brāhmaṇām̐starpayitvā ca yatra tatra mṛto naraḥ | nandīśvarasyānucaraḥ kṣīrodanilayo bhavet ||34|| yastu japyeśvare prāṇān parityajati dustyajān | niyamenānyathā vāpi sa me gaṇapatirbhavet | |35|| nandīśvarasamo nityaṃ śāśvato hya kṣayovyayaḥ | mama pārśvepyanucaraḥ priyaḥ sanmata eva ca | |3 6|| japyeśvaraṃ paṃcanadaṃ ca tadvai yo mānavobhyetya jahāti deham | sa me sadā syād gaṇapo variṣṭhastvaṣṭrā samaḥ kāntavapuśca nityam ||37| | iti skandapurāṇe dvāviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.23> sanatkumāra uvāca bhagavān devadeveśaḥ sarvabhūtapatirharaḥ | devīmuvāca vāgīśa umāṃ girivarātmajām || 1 || devi nandīśvaraṃ devamabhiṣekṣyāmi bhūtapam | gaṇānāvāhayiṣyāmi kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyasevyaye | |2|| devyuvāca saptalokādhipatyaṃ ca gaṇeśānāṃ tathaiva ca | sarvamarhati deveśa nandī putro mamāgrajaḥ ||3 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devaḥ suraśatruniṣūdanaḥ | prāṅmukhaḥ sa gaṇeśānāmāhvānamakarottadā ||4| | tatassahasraśastatra gaṇādhyakṣā mudā yutāḥ | saṃprāptāḥ sarvalokeśāstatkṣaṇācca mahāmune ||5| | saṃprāptāḥ sarvalokeśā ye rudrāḥ svargavāsinaḥ | anye rudravarā vyāsa yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate | |6| | brahmāṇḍāvaraṇā ye ca ahirbudhnyādayo mune | kapālāṃśiviśokāśca śatanetrāḥ śatānanāḥ ||7| | anantarudrā ye cānye śatavaktrāḥ śatodarāḥ | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāśca sarvadikṣu samāśritāḥ ||8 | | aṇimādiguṇairyuktā brahmasaṃbhūtihetavaḥ | saṃprāptāḥ sarvalokeśāstāñchṛṇuṣva mahāmune | |9|| tataḥ karālavadano bhṛkuṭībhūṣitānanaḥ | śaṃkhahārāmbugauraśca daṃṣṭrī sragvī trilocanaḥ || 8.23.10 | | jaṭāsahasrordhva śikho jvālākeśo mahāhanuḥ | agnyaṃgārakanetraśca bhujagābaddhamekhalaḥ | | 11 || vidyujjihvo mahākāyastathā caivordhvamehanaḥ | sarpayajñopavītī ca paraśvadhadharastathā | | 1 2|| bhujagābaddhamauñjiśca bhujagaireva kaṅkaṇaiḥ | ninādān saṃsṛjānaśca aśanīpātasannibhān || 13 | | ḍiṇḍi rityeva vikhyāto gaṇapaḥ samadṛśyata | ātmanaḥ sadṛśānāñca koṭibhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ ||1 4| | gaṇapānāṃ sureśānāṃ yogināṃ dīptatejasām | tatoparo mahākeśo mahākāyordhvamehanaḥ || 1 5| | tryakṣonalaśataprakhyaḥ aśanīpātanardanaḥ | nṛtyan gāyam̐śca citrāṇi kurvannāṭyā nyanekaśaḥ | | 16 | | jvaladdaṃṣṭro mahāhāso bṛhatskandhaḥ pinākadhṛk | koṭibhirdaśabhissārdhaṃ dviguṇābhirmahātmanām | | 17| | gaṇānāṃ citrarūpāṇāṃ yugapat saṃpradṛśyata | siṃhāsyagajakeśāsyai dvīṃpiśārdūlakānanaiḥ | soṣāḍhirnāma gaṇapo vyāsa tatra samāgataḥ | | 18| | sanatkumāra uvāca athānyo vyāsa saṃprāpto yugāntādityasaprabhaḥ | śatayojanabāhuśca digvāsāścordhvamehanaḥ | | 1 9| | atidīrghotimeḍhraśca lambabhrūḥ sthūlanāsikaḥ | vṛttāsyaśca mahākṣaśca bhṛkuṭīsaṃhatānanaḥ | |8.23.20 | | paṃcayojanavistīrṇo dīrgho vai tāvadeva ca | daṃṣṭrāścatasro vaktreṇa bibhracchaṃkhendupāṇḍarāḥ | |21 || paṃcāgniko rdhvakarṇaśca pāśahasto manojavaḥ | vṛtaḥ koṭiśatenaiva sadṛśānāmadṛśyata | | 22| | bhārabhūtīti vikhyāto mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | gaṇapo devadevasya samīpaṃ sobhyagacchata | |23 | | tataḥ kundenduśaṃkhābhaṃ himarāśyambusannibham | mṛṇālasphaṭiskābhaṃ ca bhasmakakṣāvalambanam ||24| | gṛhītvā cāśanīhāsaṃ tripādaṃ cīravāsasam | śatodaraṃ triśirasaṃ trinetraṃ cordhvamūrdhajam ||25| | jvālāmālogra keśañca vyāghracarmājināmbaram | vāyuvegaṃ mahāhāsaṃ bhujagābaddhamekhalam | |26|| mahoragakṛtāpīḍaṃ śaṃkurdhvamehanam | bhasmapraharaṇaṃ caiva mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahāhanum || 27| | mahāgaṇapatiṃ vīraṃ jvara ityeva viśrutam | koṭīśatavṛtaṃ tañca gaṇapaṃ sonvapaśyata ||28| | tatoparaḥ saumyarūpo bhasmadigdhāṅga eva ca | triśūlapāṇidigvāsā mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | |29|| bahuveṣadharaścaiva dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ | somavarṇa iti khyātaḥ koṭīśatavṛtaḥ prabhuḥ | |8.23.3 0 | | tādṛśānāṃ gaṇādhyakṣo devenāhūta āgataḥ | sahasrajvālabhasmāṃgo mahānetrordhvamehanaḥ | |3 1 || athāparo mahākāyaḥ śūlapāṇirmahābalaḥ | yugāntānalasaṃkāśaḥ sthiraḥ sthirayaśobalaḥ | |3 2 | | candramaulirmahākeśaścaturbāhurvilohitaḥ | ekapādairmahākāyaistryakṣaistaiḥ śūlapāṇibhiḥ | |3 3 || vṛtaḥ koṭīśatenaiva sthāṇustatrābhthavartata | sa mahāpārṣado rudraḥ sarvāsuranibarhaṇaḥ | |34|| tatoparaḥ paṭṭaseno hrasvapādodaraḥ śuciḥ | sahasrabāhucaraṇaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān | |3 5|| karāladaśanaścaiva kṛṣṇasarpāmbaracchadaḥ | tryakṣa ścandrakṛtāpīḍaḥ kaṇṭhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ||3 6 || ugrasena iti khyātaḥ koṭīśatavṛtaḥ sa ca | āgātsamīpaṃ devasya āhūtaḥ svayamīśvaraḥ | |37| | tatoparaḥ samāvede devaṃ candrārdhadhāriṇam | caturvaktro mahātejāścaturviṃśekṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | | 38|| sahasrabāhurjvālāsyo mahānetrordhvamehana | karāladaśana ścaiva śaṃkukarṇo mahānakhaḥ ||39|| asipāṇirmahātejāḥ śatapādaśśatodaraḥ | vidyutkeśotihāsaśca tathaivobhayato gatiḥ ||8.23.40 | | ajaikapāditi khyāto vṛtaḥ koṭiśatena saḥ | kāñcanopalavṛkṣāḍhyaḥ samegha iva parvataḥ | |41 || sanatkumāra uvāca āgāttatoparo vyāsa gaṇapaḥ sumahābalaḥ | sarvato anadastu śatena vai ||54|| āveśano tathāṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiśca pravartanaḥ | mahāravaḥ sahasreṇa gaṇānāṃ gaṇapo vṛtaḥ ||55| | caturmukho dvādaśabhistathā bāhuprahārakaḥ | mahākālaḥ śatenaiva
