apṛcchamahamavyagro nandīśvaramatidyutim | |8|| īśena yat purā devyāḥ kathitaṃ gaṇasattama | tanme brūhi yathātattvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||9| | nandyuvāca śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi pṛcchataste mahāmune | devadevena pārvatyā yat purābhihitaṃ hi tat | | 8.27.10 | | devadeva uvāca śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi suvrate | hitāya devi bhaktānāṃ pṛṣṭastat kathayāmi te | | 11 | | prasādaṃ yastu me devi śubhraṃ kuryādanindite | vidadhāmyarjunaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ śivapurekṣayam | | 12 || vidhānena yathoktena liṅgaṃ me sthāpayecca yaḥ | mayā sahāsau carati nityamaṣṭaguṇānvitaḥ | |1 3 | | kāñcanaṃ truṭimātraṃ vā yo dadyād bahu vā mama | tasya haimavate śṛṅge dadāmi gṛhamuttamam | | 14|| yo me gāṃ vā hiraṇyaṃ vā dadyādavimanāḥ priye | lokān dadāmyahaṃ tasmai sarvakāmasamanvitān || 1 5| | vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayacchenme śvetaṃ nīlamathāpi vā | sa kulānāmubhayatastārayedekaviṃśatim | | 1 6| | gocarmadvayasāṃ vāpi yo me dadyādvasundharām | sa me puraṃ samāsādya gaṇeśaiḥ saha modate | | 17|| yo me puṇyaphalaṃ dadyādātmanā pūrvamarjitam | sonanta phalamāpnoti modate ca triviṣṭape | | 18 || yonuyānaṃ caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ kurute mama | rathena vṛṣayuktena mama loke sa modate | | 1 9|| mahimānopacāraiśca yo māṃ japyaiśca pūjayet | dadāmi brahmaṇo loke vāsaṃ tasya supūjitam || 8.27.20 | | manasā cintayed yaśca pūjayeyamahaṃ haram | aśakto nāsti ca dravyaṃ yasya nityaṃ sumadhyame | |2 1 | | sa tayā śraddhayā pūto vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ | mama lokamavāpnoti bhinne dehe na saṃśaya || 22 | | snāto yaḥ pūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ sadā māmabhigacchati | sa mitraṃ yakṣarājasya yakṣo bhavati vīryavān | |2 3 | | saṃmārjanaṃ paṃcaśataṃ sahasramupalepanam | gandhāśca daśasāhasrā anantaṃ cārcanaṃ smṛtam | | 24 | | abhyaṅgoṣṭaśataṃ caiva snapanaṃ triśataṃ bhavet | gandhodakaṃ paṃcaśataṃ pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca | | 25 | | kṣīraṃ pañcaguṇaṃ devi tasmād bhūyaśca kāpilam | tasmācca sarpiṣā snānaṃ bhūyaḥ paṃcaguṇaṃ tathā | |2 6 | | kṣamāmi devi cāsyāhamaparādhān bahūnapi | bhasmābhiṣekamānantyaṃ guhyaṃ caiva mama priye ||27|| agururdaśasāhasraṃ ṣaṭ sāhasraṃ tu candanam | caturdaśasahasrāṇi dhūpaḥ kālāgaroḥ smṛtaḥ | | 28| | akṣayāstaṇḍulayavāḥ śālayo dviśatāḥ smṛtāḥ | ānantyo gugguluścaiva sahājyena sudhūpitaḥ || 29| | dve sahasre palānāṃ tu mahiṣākṣasya yo dahet | devi saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ same nandisamo bhavet ||8.27.3 0 || dakṣiṇāyāntu yo mūrtau pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ śubhe | nivedayedvarṣamekaṃ sa ca nandisamo bhavet ||3 1|| caravo daśasāhasrā yāvakaśca caturguṇaḥ | śeṣāśca caravaḥ sarve yāvakārdhena saṃmitāḥ ||32|| ghṛtapātramasaṃkhyeyamiha pretya ca śāśvatam | prīṇāti ca pitṝn sarvāna vimāne caiva modate ||33|| chatraṃ patākānicayaṃ śobhayitvā dadāti yaḥ | sopi saṃdīpyate bhūyo ravivattejasā divi ||34|| ubhau pakṣau trayodaśyā maṣṭamyāṃ copavāsikaḥ | upatiṣṭheta māṃ bhaktyā sopahāramanindite ||3 5|| dadāmyasya svakaṃ lokaṃ tuṣṭohaṃ devi śāśvatam | raktapītakavāsobhiḥ puṣpaiśca vividhairapi | pūjitohaṃ sadā bhaktyā putratve kalpayāmi tam ||36|| ekarātraṃ ca yo martyo dīpaṃ dhārayati sthitaḥ | sarvayajñaphalaṃ tasya dadāma śriyameva ca || 37|| mayaiva mohitāḥ sarve lokāḥ sajaḍapaṇḍitāḥ | na māṃ paśyanti rāgāndhāstamasā bahulīkṛtāḥ ||3 8|| dhyānino yogayuktā ye satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | ekāgramanaso dāntāste māṃ paśyanti nityadā ||39|| ye me bhaktāḥ sadā caiva sāṃkhyayogaviśāradāḥ | sarvaṃ paśyanti mayi ca māṃ ca sarvatra yogataḥ | |8.27.40|| trīṃllokān samatikramya brahmalokaṃ tathaiva ca | gacchanti mama te lokaṃ tamo bhitvā sudurbhidam ||41 || na śakyosmyatapoyuktairdraṣṭuṃ munigaṇairapi | dhyānino nityayuktāśca devi paśyanti māṃ budhāḥ ||42|| etāni caiva sarvāṇi kṛtvā karmāṇi sundari | manasā supraśāntena mainaḥ(?) karuṇacetasā ||43 || kāñcanaṃ bhūmigodānaṃ vipre ca pratipādayan | rudro me prīyatu iti hyatulaṃ phalamaśnute ||44|| yāni lokeṣu tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca | pādayostāni suśroṇi sadā sannihitāni me ||45|| brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā caiva kare dakṣiṇataḥ sthitāḥ | yo māṃ sarvagataṃ caiva sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati ||46|| mayyarpitamanā nityaṃ tathā madbhāvabhāvitaḥ | mamaiva sa prabhāvena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | |47|| sarvathā vartamānopi devi yo māṃ smaretsadā | kalmaṣeṇa na yujyeta naraḥ kartā kadācana ||48| | sarvāvasthopi pāpātmā jñānanidrena cetasā | yo 'bhyarcayati bhāṃ nityaṃ sa mamātmasamo bhavet ||49|| ṣaḍaṅgena ca yogena yo māmabhyarcayetsadā | praviśeta sa māṃ kṣipramatra nāsti vicāraṇā ||8.27.5 0|| yopyasajjanarato viyonijaḥ pātakairapi samanvitassadā | sopi madgatamanā madarpaṇo yāti devi gatimapratarkitām ||51 || iti skandapurāṇe īśvarārcanavidhi saptaviṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.28> sanatkumāra uvāca tato vyāsa punardevī patiṃ vratapatiṃ śubhā | apṛcchad vratasaṃbaddhaṃ phalaṃ phalaśatārcitā || 1 || vratānāṃ phalamalpaṃ vā mahad vā yat trilokapa | vrataṃ bhavati yādṛg vā tat prabrūhi maheśvara ||2|| devadeva uvāca mahāphalaṃ yad bhavati yaccāpyalpaphalaṃ śubhe | vrataṃ yādṛk ca yat proktaṃ tacchṛṇu tvamanindite ||3 || caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāmubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuciḥ | saṃvatsaramabhuñjānaḥ śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ ||4|| satrayājiphalaṃ yacca satyavāgṛtugāminām | taccaiva phalamāpnoti yamañcaiva na paśyati ||5|| śayyāsanasthaḥ strīmadhye ratiraktaḥ sukhe rataḥ | sa tapyatyānakhāgrebhyo nityaṃ yo māṃ samāśritaḥ ||6|| madbhaktastapasā yukto māmeva pratipadyate | lokāstasyākṣayā devi yadyapi syāt sa pāpakṛt | |7|| pṛthivībhājane bhuṃkte nityaṃ parvasu yo naraḥ | sa trirātraphalaṃ devi ahorātreṇa vindati ||8|| saṃvatsaraṃ tu yo bhuṃkte nityameva hyatandritaḥ | nivedya pitṛdevebhyaḥ pṛthivyā mekarāḍ bhavet ||9|| navamī maṣṭamīṃ caiva paurṇamāsoṃ trayodaśīm | yo bhuṃkte devi naiteṣu suparvasu naraḥ samām ||8.28.1 0|| gāṇapatyaṃ sa labhate nissapatnamanindite | bhūtānāṃ dayitaścaiva divyaṃ rūpaṃ bibharti ca | |1 1|| śrīvatsaṃ yaśca piṣṭena dadyād hemaphalaṃ śubham | kiret kṛṣṇatilāṃścātra taṇḍulākṣatameva ca | | 1 2| | phalaiśca vividhākārairyathālabdhai rasānvitaiḥ | sa vai varṣasahasrāṇi dviṣaṣṭi divi modate | | 13 | | divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān devataissaha nityaśaḥ | hiriveramayīṃ yo me dadyāt pratikṛtiṃ svakām | | 14|| sarvagandharasairyuktāṃ niryāsaiśca susaṃskṛtām | bhakṣyabhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | | 1 5|| pūrvadakṣiṇayoścātra paścimottarayostathā | pārśveṣu haritālañca kṛṣṇāgarumanaḥśilām | | 16 || candanaṃ caiva dadyādvai yathāsaṃkhyena pūjitam | tasya puṇyaphalaṃ devi śṛṇu yanmattakāśini | | 17|| sarvavyādhivinirmuktastathā niṣkalmaṣaśca ha | varṣakoṭiśatānyaṣṭau divi bhuktvā mahatsukham || 18| | iha loke sukhī jāto māmeva pratipadyate | ratnāvaliṃ tu yo dadyād brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyothaviṭ | | 1 9| | śūdraḥ strī vā sa me loke matsaukhyaṃ prāpnute param | siddhārthakām̐ścāghoreṇa daive pitryetha vā punaḥ | | 8.28.20 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tarpayet sa pitṝnapi | ṛṣīṃśca sarvadevāṃśca rūpañcāpnoti puṣkalam | | 21 | | manvantarañca goloke gokanyābhiḥ sa pūjyate | sarve devāstathā viṣṇurbrahmā ṛṣaya eva ca | |22| | kurvantyarghye hi sānnidhyaṃ tebhyastaddhi viniḥsṛtam | guhyametat paraṃ devi yo vetti sa mahātapāḥ ||23 || tasya prabhāvājjāyeta dhanavān priyadarśanaḥ | prajñārūpaguṇairyuktaḥ saṃvatsaraśatāyuṣaḥ | |24| | kṣīreṇa yo māṃ satataṃ snāpayeta trirudyataḥ| aparādhasahasrantu kṣame tasyāhamantaśaḥ ||25| | yaśca tat snapanaṃ paśyet sa tatpāpaiḥ pramucyate | mānasasya ca japyasya sahasrasya phalaṃ labhet ||26|| saṃvatsaraṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ śuciḥ | gāṇapatyaṃ sa labhate ballabhatvaṃ ca nityaśaḥ ||27|| sarpiṣā yo mamābhyaṅgaṃ karotyavimanā naraḥ | dvisāhasrasya jāpyasya mānasasya phalaṃ labhet ||28| | abhigamyaśca devānāṃ sa bhavecca narottamaḥ | niṣkāṇāṃ ca suvarṇasya sahasrasya phalaṃ labhet ||29| | saṃmārjanaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt saṃvatsaramanuvrataḥ | vitarāmi śubhaṃ lokaṃ nityaṃ tasya dhruvaṃ śivam ||8.28.3 0 || sarvalokakṣaye tasya na kṣayo bhavatīśvari | liṅgapūjāṃ tu yaḥ kuryānmama devi dṛḍhavrataḥ | |3 1 || śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni divi modate | caturṇṇāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ gandhamāghrāti śaṅkaraḥ ||32 || arkasya karavīrasya bilvasya ca bakasya ca | suvarṇaniṣkaṃ puṣpe tu sarvasmin devi kathyate || 33| | sahasre tvarkapuṣpāṇāṃ datte yata kathyate phalam | ekasmin karavīrasya datte puṣpe hi tat phalam ||34|| karavīrasahasrasya bhaveddattasya yat phalam | tadekasya tu padmasya dattasya phalamucyate ||35|| padmānāṃ ca sahasrasya mama dattasya yat phalam | tatphalaṃ labhate patre datte bilvasya śobhane | |36|| bilvapatrasahasraṃ tu datte me yat phalaṃ smṛtam | bakapuṣpe tadekasmin mama datte labhetphalam ||37|| bakapuṣpasahasrasya mama dattasya yat phalam | puṣpe datte tadekasmin labhed dhattūrakasya tu ||38|| nirmālyaṃ yo hi me nityaṃ śirasā dhārayiṣyati | aśucirbhinnamaryādo naraḥ pāpasamanvitaḥ ||39| | svairī caiva tathā mukto niyamaiśca bahiṣkṛtaḥ | narake sa pated ghore tiryagyonau ca saṃbhavet ||8.28.40 || brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā nirmālyaṃ yastu dhārayet | tasya pāpamahaṃ śīghraṃ nāśayāmi mahāvrate ||41 || dīpamālāṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt kārttike māsi vai mama | avasāne ca dīpānāṃ brāhmaṇām̐starpayecchuciḥ ||42|| gāṇapatyaṃ sa labhate dīpyate ca raviryathā | dadyāt kṛṣṇatilām̐ścaiva sahaḥ siddhārthakām̐śca ha ||43|| yo mre devi sadā mūrdhni sa me nandisamo bhavet | ye hi siddhārthakāḥ proktāstathā kṛṣṇatilāśca ye ||44|| sarve te tvanmayā devi guhyametanmayeritam | (?) ||45 | | ...…....na..na… (?) | citro nāma gaṇo mahyaṃ tena sārdhaṃ sa modate || 46 || sarvasaṃpralaye sarvendriyaprasakto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ | sa prayāti divaṃ devi liṅgaṃ yorcayatīha me | |49| | tyaktvā sarvāṇi pāpāni nirdvandvo dagdhakilbiṣaḥ | madāśī rmannamaskāro māmeva pratipadyate ||8.28.50|| sanatkumāra uvāca tato bhagavatī bhūyaḥ patiṃ sarvajagatpatim | apṛcchat puṣpyamāṇā syā kena tvaṃ deva tuṣyase | |51 | | tataḥ prahasyamānāsyaḥ sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ | provāca bhagavān tiṣṭhati | yo hi tattvena tad veda saṃsārāt sa vimucyate | |54|| na ca prakāśayed guhyaṃ nāma me kīrtayennaraḥ | sadā sarvasahetyevaṃ prātaḥ prāñjalirutthitaḥ ||55| | tasmācca kīrtanāt pāpaṃ sarvameva vinirdahet | yaśaḥ kīrttiṃ ca saṃprāpya rudraloke mahīyate ||56|| sarvamālyāni yo dadyān mama mūrtiṣu nityaśaḥ | maṃtreṇa vidhivaccaiva tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||57| | mantraḥ sarvagāya sureśāya sarvadevamayāya ca | namo bhagavate caiva guhyāguhyāya vai sadā | | 58 | | somāya bhūtanāthāya bhāvanāya bhavāya ca | sarvaguhyāya vai svāhā devaguhyamayāya ca | | 59| | sarvaguhyamayo maṃtraḥ svāhā somāya caiva hi | kaṭaṃkaṭāya vai svāhā svāhā devāya śuṣmiṇe | | 8.28.60 | | puṣpāṇyetena mantreṇa yo me nityaṃ nivedayet | sahasraṃ tena jāpyasya mānasasya kṛtaṃ bhavet | | 61 | | athāñjalimamāvāsyāṃ susampūrṇāṃ samāhitaḥ | tilānāṃ caiva kṛṣṇānāṃ sarṣapāṇāṃ ca pārvati | |62 | | arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ yathālābhaṃ prayacchati | idaṃ ca vacanaṃ kuryāt sūryeti va mameti ca ||63 | | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ | arcayitvā ca māṃ devi brāhāṇānna ca tarpayet | |64|| na tatphalamavāpnoti nāhaṃ tuṣyāmi tasya vai | arcayitvā dvijānmāṃ ca yo me nāmāni kīrtayet || 65|| caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi | sopi devi pramucyeta viyoniṃ na sa gacchati | |66| | vāmadeva sudeveti hara gupteti vā punaḥ | umāpate nīlakaṇṭha śānta śrīkaṇṭha gopate | | 67| | śarva | naimiśetha kurukṣetre gaṅgādvāretha puṣkare | snānāt saṃsevanāccāpi na mokṣaḥ prāpyate yataḥ | |5 6| | iha saṃprāpyate yena tata etad viśiṣyate | prayāge vā bhaven mokṣa iha vā matparigrahāt | | 57| yatrāste kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ | divyaṃ cakṣuradāccaiva yenāpaśyat sa śaṃkaram | |3 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha yakṣastadā vyāsa śanairunmīlya locane | apaśyat sagaṇaṃ devaṃ vṛṣaketumupāśritam | |4| | devadeva uvāca varaṃ dadāmi te pūrvaṃ trailokye narśanaṃ tathā | sāratvaṃ ca śarīrasya paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 5| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa labdhvā tu varaṃ śarīreṇākṣatena ca | pādayoḥ praṇatastasthau kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim | | 6| | uvāca ca tadeśena varadosmīti coditaḥ | bhagavan bhaktimavyagrāṃ tvayyananyāṃ vidhatsva me | |7|| annadatvaṃ ca lokānāṃ gāṇapatyaṃ tathākṣayam | avimukte ca te sthāne vaseyaṃ sarvadā yathā | etamicchāmi deveśa dattaṃ varamanuttamam | |8| | devadeva uvāca jarāmaraṇasaṃtyaktaḥ sarvaśokavivarjitaḥ | bhaviṣyasi gaṇādhyakṣo varadaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ | |9| | ajayyaścāpi sarveṣāṃ yogaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | annadaścāpi lokebhyaḥ kṣetrapālo bhaviṣyasi | |8.31.1 0 | | mahābalo mahāsatvo brahmaṇyo tha mama priyaḥ | tryakṣaśca daṇḍapāṇiśca mahāyogī tathaiva ca | | 1 1| | udbhramaḥ saṃbhramaścaiva gaṇau te paricārakau | tavājñayā kariṣyete lokasyodbhramasaṃbhramau | | 1 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavān vyāsa yakṣaṃ kṛtvā gaṇeśvaram | jagāma dhāma deveśaḥ parvataśreṣṭhamanugrahavarepsayā | |1 5|| sabhāryaḥ sasutaścaiva sa hi māṃ sasuhṛjjanaḥ | prapanna stāpasa śreṣṭho mandaraḥ parvatottamaḥ | | 16 | | adya varṣasahasrāṇi pañca divyāni pārvati | tapyate tapatāṃ śreṣṭho mayi sarvātmabhāvataḥ ||17| | devyuvāca naya māmapi deveśa mandaraṃ cārukandaram | na raṃsyehaṃ vinā deva tvayā sarvajagatpate | | 1 8|| tato devaḥ prahasyaināmuvāca parameśvaraḥ | avimuktaṃ na moktavyaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ yātumicchasi ||1 9|| devyuvāca iha caiva nivatsyāmi gamiṣyāmi ca mandaram | avimuktamidaṃ sthānaṃ tato deva bhaviṣyati | |8.31.2 0 || devadeva uvāca evametad varārohe yathā vadasi pārvati | aiśvaryāt sarvagā hi tvaṃ yathāhaṃ devi sarvaśaḥ | |2 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devo vṛṣamāruhya sarvagam | somaḥ sanandī sagaṇo mandaraṃ prayayau haraḥ ||22 | | sa gatvā bhuvaneśānastapyamānaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ | apaśyanmandaraṃ tatra dṛṣṭavā caina muvāca ha | |23 || varadosmi girīśāna tuṣṭaste tapasā bhṛśam | varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭantvaṃ sarvaṃ tat pradadāmi te | |24| | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktaśśarveṇa dṛṣṭvā tribhuvaneśvaram | somaṃ sanandinaṃ caiva praṇamya vṛṣavāhanam || 25| | punaḥ punarharaṃ dṛṣṭavā devīñcaiva punaḥ punaḥ | punaḥ punargaṇañcaiva karametatte vajrameṣyati nānyathā | evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te bhava rājā prajāhitaḥ | |59| | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktastejasvī rājā bhuvi babhūva ha | cyāvaniśca dadhīcosya sakhā samabhavattadā | |8.31.60 || sa tena saha saṃgatya sukhāsīno varāsane | cakre kathā vicitrārthāḥ prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||61 || athābhavattayorvyāsa rāgo jātikṛtaḥ punaḥ | kṣatraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na vā śreṣṭhaṃ brahma śreṣṭhaṃ na veti ca ||62 || kṣupobravīt kṣatramiti dadhīco brahma ceti ha | athū tāṃ kāraṇe cobhau na nyavartata kaścana ||63 | | atha tīkṣṇatayā caiva tapodhikatayā tathā | brāhmaṇatvasya cāgryatvāttathā daivakṛtena ca | | 64| | kuddho dadhīcastaṃ vyāsa vāmahastena mūrdhani | ājaghāna mahātejā vajreṇātaḍayat sa ca ||65|| vajreṇa sa dvidhā chinnaḥ śakramāhvayadavyayaḥ | sovadat tvaṃ mahāyogaḥ śaktaḥ sandhātumātmanā | |66 || svaṃ dehaṃ sa tathābhūtaṃ dadhīco yogamāyayā | sandhayāmāsa śarvañca śaraṇaṃ samapadyata | | 67| | sa sureśvaramārādhya prāpyāvadhyatvamuttamam | vajrāsthitvamabhedyatvamajaratvañca śaṅkarāt ||68| | sarvabhūtānukampitvaṃ mahāyogitvameva ca | punarāgāt kṣupaṃ draṣṭuṃ punaḥ sakhyamabhūt tayoḥ || 69| | rāgo jātikṛto yaśca pūrvavat sa babhūva ha | vāmapādena cāpyenaṃ kṣupa sa samatāḍayat ||8.31.70 | | punaśca vajramādāya sa cainamahanattadā | na cārtiṃ na vyathāṃ tasya tadvajramakaronmune ||71 | | avadhyatvamatho jñātvā kṣupastasya mahātmanaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ samāsādya varārthaṃ samarādhayat ||72|| varadosmīti tuṣṭena viṣṇunā sa ca coditaḥ | provāca praṇato viṣṇumidaṃ vyāsa mahāmanāḥ | |73 | | kṣupa uvāca dadhīco nāma viprarṣiravadhyokṣaya eva ca | sakhā mama hṛṣīkeśa sa ca māmāha nityadā | |74| | bibhemyahaṃ na devasya rākṣasasyāsurasya vā | piśācasyātha yakṣasya vayaso mānuṣasya vā | |75 | | bibhemīti yathā brūyāt tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi | evamukto nareśena sa viṣṇurlokabhāvanaḥ ||76 | | tathāstviti ca taṃ procya dadhīcasyāśramaṃ yayau | sa praviśyāśramaṃ vyāsa dadhīcenābhipūjitaḥ ||77|| abhivādyāñjaliṃ kṛtvā dadhīcamidamabravīt | bhagavan brahmaṇaśreṣṭha pitāmahasamadyute ||78| | varamekaṃ vṛṇehaṃ yaṃ taṃ bhavāndātumarhati | prasāditohaṃ viprendra kṣupeṇa śubhakarmaṇā ||79|| varadosmīti cāpyukto varaṃ vavre mahāmune | proktaṃ tvayā bibhemīti brūhi tan madanugrahāt ||8.31.80 || abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ | avadhyaścāpi sarveṣāṃ mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | |8 1 || abhītastvaṃ tathāpyadya madarthaṃ vada tat prabho | dadhīcaścaiva muktopi viṣṇunā madhuraṃ tadā ||82 || uvāca na bibhemīti bhūyo bhūyo janārdanam | nāhaṃ vakṣye bibhemīti noktaṃ nāpyucyate mayā | |83 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktaścakrapāṇiścyāvaniṃ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | uvāca cakramudyamya bhayamasya vidarśayan ||84| | evameva hi kartavyā ye bhūtvā balavattarāḥ | asvāmina iva premṇā bruvate durbalaṃ janam | |85 || na ced drakṣyasi bhītosmītyetaccakra tatastava | sunasaṃ śira ādāya mahīṃ saṃ prāpayiṣyati ||86|| dadhīciruvāca kiṃ vṛthā cakramudyamya viṣṇo tvaṃ kleśamicchasi | nāhaṃ cakrasya te gamyaḥ prasādāt tryambakasya tu ||87|| kintu jijñāsayā yāmi lokapālaśaraṇyatām | teṣāṃ niṣkriyatāṃ jñātvā tato yāsyāmi śaṃkaram | |88|| evamuktvā cyāvanistu prādravad varuṇaṃ prati | śaraṇaṃ taṃ prapannaśca saṃ prādādabhayaṃ prabhuḥ | |89|| tatra viṣṇośca devasya varuṇasya ca dhīmataḥ | yuddhaṃ samabhavad ghoraṃ bahūnabdān vibhīṣaṇam ||8.31.90 || nigṛhītetha varuṇe cyāvaniryamamabhyayāt | sa cāpyabhayada stasmai viṣṇunā nirjito yudhi ||91 || tatognimabhyayād vyāsa sopi tenābhinirjitaḥ | tataḥ sa muṣṭimādāya kuśānāṃ cyāvanistadā ||92|| svamāśramamupāgamya tiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyabhāṣata | jijñāsārthaṃ lokapālānahaṃ śaraṇa meyivān || 93 || abalāste ca sarvepi mayyeva balamuttamam | adya garvañca darpañca balaṃ yacca tavādbhutam | tatsarvaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi tiṣṭhedānīṃ janārdana ||94|| sanatkumāra uvāca tato yuddhaṃ samabhavat tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | nārāyaṇasya ca vyāsa cyāvaneśca mahātmanaḥ | |95|| yānyastrāṇi śarā ye ca nārāyaṇakaracyutāḥ | yogena tān dadhīcosau kuśamuṣṭau nyayeśayat | |96| | tato viṣṇoryogabalād gātrebhyaḥ saṃprajajñire | devā yuyudhire sarve viṣṇunā saha daṃśitāḥ ||97| | tānapyaśeṣataḥ sarvān sāyudhān saha vāhanaiḥ | kuśamuṣṭau sa saṃkruddho viṣṇuvarjaṃ nyaveśayat | |98|| tatassarvāmarairvyāsa kuśamuṣṭau praveśitaiḥ | yogena tejasā caiva dadhīcena mahātmanā || 99|| viṣṇuṃ saṃvignarūpaṃ tu kopāveśāt pramohitam | tatrāgamya svayaṃ brahmā tadā vacanamabravīt || 8.31.100 | | kintavānena govinda tathā yatnena sadadvije | kṛtenātha dadhīcasya śarvāllabdhavarasya tu | |1 01 | | kinna vetsi yathā hyeṣa prasādāt pārameśvarāt | avadhyatvaṃ suyogitvaṃ guṇaiśvaryatvameva ca | | 10 2| | vajrāsthisāratāñcaiva labdhavān svayamīśvarāt | na caivaṃ tvadvidhā deva brāhmaṇeṣu vikurvate | |1 03 | | tasmādāśu nivartasva kṣamayainaṃ dvijottamam | tato brahmavacaḥ śrutvā sa viṣṇurlokabhāvanaḥ | |1 04|| yogena tadbalaṃ jñātvā dadhīcasya mahātmanaḥ | kṣāmayāmāsa viprendraṃ svaṃ cāvāsamathābhyagāt || 10 5| | brahmāpi tamṛṣiṃ sāntvya pūjayitvā trilokapaḥ | jagāmādarśanaṃ vyāsa saha sarvāmaraistadā || 1 06|| dadhīcopi mahātejāstapastepe svakāśrame | mahādevaprasādārthamugraṃ vāyvambubhojanaḥ || 1 07| | athāsya yuktasya tadā tapasā bhāskaradyuteḥ | tutoṣa bhagavān tryakṣastuṣṭaścaivābravīdidam || 1 08| | devadeva uvāca cyāvane tapasānena tava tuṣṭosmi suvrata | brūhi yatte bhilaṣitaṃ kṛtameva hi tanmayā | | 1 09| | dadhīciruvāca bhagavan yadi tuṣṭosi yadi deyo varaśca me | icchāmi viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ sarvāndevām̐stvayā jitān ||8.31.1 10 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ prahasya varado dadhīcamṛṣisattamam | evamastviti taṃ prāha praṇatārtiharo haraḥ | | 11 1| | tasmindatte tadā tena tryambakeṇa vare śubhe | amanyata sthitaṃ vairaṃ kṣupeṇa saha vai ṛṣiḥ || 112 || dhyāyantaṃ taṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | uvāca varamanyañca brūhi vipra dadāmi te ||1 13 || dadhīciruvāca yasmāt sthitamidaṃ vairaṃ varadānāt tava prabho | iha tasmāttava sthānaṃ nāmnaitena bhavatvaja || 1 14|| devadeva uvāca sthāneśvaramiti khyātaṃ nāmnaitat sthānamuttamam | bhavitṛ krośaparyantaṃ nānāpuṣpalatākulam ||1 1 5| | atra yobhyarcayenmāṃ tu paraṃ niyamamāsthitaḥ | trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak snātvā nadyāṃ tu mānavaḥ || 116 | | brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā ca caruṃ dharmeṇa saṃyutaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto mama lokamavāpnuyāt ||1 17|| sthāṇutīrthaṃ ca bhavitṛ tathaitat pāpanāśanam | aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyatra snātaḥ prāpnoti puṣkalam | |1 18| | ayañcāpi vaṭaḥ śrīmān sthitohaṃ yatra sāṃpratam | varaṃ dātuṃ madākhyāno nāmnā sthāṇuvaṭo mahān | | 11 9|| bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ phalañcāpyasya me śṛṇu | yotra tiṣṭhedahorātraṃ saṃyato niyatāśanaḥ | | 8.31.120 | | cīrṇaṃ svayaṃ bhavettena sthāṇuvratamanuttamam | sarvapāpavinirmukto gaṇapassa bhavenmama | | 121 | | akampano nāma mahān mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | yaśca prāṇānniyamavān yamavānathavā punaḥ ||1 22|| parityajeta manujastasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvabandhavivarjitaḥ| gaṇośvaro nandisamaḥ sa me bhavati sarvagaḥ || 123 | | sthāneśvare yastviha caikarātraṃ sthitvā kṣapet sarvamaśeṣato hi | sa sarvapāpapravimuktacetā gaṇeśvaro me bhavitātibhīmaḥ | |1 24| | iti skandapurāṇe kṣupadadhīcavivādo nāma ekatriṃśattamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.32> sanatkumāra uvāca etasminneva kāle tu vyāsa dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ | ayajat sośvamedhena rājā prācetasātmajaḥ | | 1 || tatra devanikāyānāṃ bhāgadheyāni sarvaśaḥ | havyavāhastadā tatrāvahanmantraissamīritaḥ ||2 | | vahantaṃ tamapaśyacca devī girivarātmajā | anusmarantī tadvairaṃ śāpakāraṇameva ca | | 3 | | uvāca cainaṃ girijā bodhayantī purātanam | śliṣṭaṃ madhurayā vācā kāraṇena samanvitam | |4| | tvaṃ devaḥ sarvadevānāṃ gatiśca śaraṇaṃ tathā | tvayā vinā kathaṃ yajño vartate sarvadevapa | | 5 || devānāṃ bhāgadheyāni vahatyagnirayaṃ bhava | nāyaṃ tava maheśāna kiṃ kāraṇamatidyute | | 6| | na sāmnā sidhyate kāryaṃ vikrameṇa vinā prabho | ayaṃ mūḍhovaliptaśca rājā prācetasātmajaḥ | |7 | | anusmaran pūrvavairaṃ naiva dāsyatyaśāsitaḥ | dadhīcasya varaścāpi tvayā dattastadā prabho | tasyāyamāgataḥ kālastadarthena vidhīyatām | |8| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastadā vyāsa bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | uvāca prahasan devīṃ pitā tava śucismite ||9| | pūrvajanmani suśroṇi prajāpatisutaḥ śubhe | mama tvaṃ bhāvavijñānaṃ kurvatī devi bhāṣase | |8.32.1 0 | | nahi duḥkhaṃ piturloke kaścidicchati bhāmini | evamuktā tadā vyāsa devena vimalātmanā || 11 || lalāṭe bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā tato devyāyatekṣaṇā | krodhāt kareṇa nāsāgraṃ saṃmamarda śucismitā || 12 | | tasyāṃ saṃmṛdyamānāyāṃ nāsikāyāmatiprabhā | jajñe strī bhṛkuṭīvaktrā caturdaṃṣṭrā trilocanā baddhagodhāṃgulitrā ca kavacā baddhamekhalā || 13 || sakhaṅgā sadhanuṣkā ca satūṇīrā patākinī | dvādaśāsyā daśabhujā tanumadhyā tamonibhā ||14| | ghanastanī pṛthukaṭī nāganāsoruravyayā | bhadrakālīti tāṃ prāha devīṃ devī śubhānanā | |1 5|| tatobravīt tadā devameṣā sṛṣṭā mayā prabho | tvamapyanyaṃ sṛja gaṇamanurūpaṃ namostute ||1 6|| tato devastadā skandhaṃ svamavaikṣata bhāsvaram | tasmājjajñe pumān divyastrailokyaṃ pradahanniva | | 17| | bhṛkuṭībhūṣitāsyaśca baddhagodhāṃgulitravān | kavacī baddhatūṇīraḥ śarī khaṅgī śarāsanī || 18| | tryakṣaścaturbhujaścaiva vajrasaṃhanano yuvā | sa sṛṣṭaḥ praṇato bhūtvā harirnāmnā gaṇeśvaraḥ || 1 9| | uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā devadevaṃ sahomayā | ājñāpaya sureśāna yat kartavyaṃ mayā vibho | |8.32.2 0 || tatassa bhagavānāha hariṃ taṃ gaṇanāyakam | prācetasasutasyāsya yajñaṃ gaccha vināśaya ||2 1 || bhadrakālyā sahāśu tvametat kṛtyaṃ gaṇeśvara | tataḥ sa bhagavān devo gaṇeśān kāmarūpiṇaḥ | |22 | | svagātrebhyosṛjad dhīmān nānā rūpadharān gaṇān | pasparśa bāhuṃ samyak ca tasmā jjātā mahābalāḥ ||23 || koṭyastā navatiścaiva śatañcaiva tadā prabhoḥ| sa tām̐ścovāca bhagavān yajñaṃ pramathatānaghāḥ | |24| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastau tena sainyena mahatābhisamāvṛtau | jagmatuḥ sāgaronnāda meghāśaninināditaiḥ ||25| | devopi saha pārvatyā raibhyāśramasamīpataḥ | sthitvāpaśyad gaṇeśānāṃ karma tad yajñanāśanam | |26| | sanatkumāra uvāca vṛkṣāḥ kanakhaleyāstu gaṅgādvārasamīpagāḥ | suvarṇaśṛṃgaśca girirmeruparvatasannibhaḥ ||27| | tasmin pradeśe dakṣasya yajñosāvabhavattadā | gaṇeśvarabalaṃ cāgād bhīmaṃ kālīpurogamam ||28 || te saṃprāpya mahābhāgāḥ sarve dīptānalaprabhāḥ | ūcustaṃ yajamānañca ṛtvijotha munīn surān ||29| | vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasya paramātmanaḥ | ihābhilipsavaḥ prāptā bhāgān yacchadhvamīpsitān | |8.32.3 0 | | tapasā yajñabhāgārhā balena niyamena vā | aiśvaryeṇātha yogena yena tena puro hi vaḥ | |3 1|| sarvañcāsmāsvapi hi tad vayamapyaṃśabhāginaḥ | atha cet svāmino devāstena bhāgārhatāṃ gatāḥ | |3 2|| svāmitve ca balaṃ hetustapo vā nātra saṃśayaḥ | asmāsvevobhayaṃ tacca svāmitvaṃ tena no varam | |3 3 || atha cet kasyacidiyamājñā munisurottamāḥ | bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām | |34|| taṃ brūta yo jñāpayati vetsyāmo hi vayaṃ tataḥ | evamuktāstu hariṇā sarve devapurassarāḥ ||35|| ūcurmantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ vo bhāgaṃ prati gaṇeśvarāḥ | mantrāpyūcuḥ surān yūyaṃ tamopahatacetasaḥ ||36|| yena prathamabhāgārhaṃ nāyajadhvaṃ maheśvaram | mantraiste procyamānāpi naiva bhāgān daduryadā ||37|| tadā yātāstato mantrā brahmalokaṃ sanātanam | tataḥ śakrādayo devāḥ sarve ūcurgaṇeśvarān ||38|| tyaktvā (?).....| yuṣmānnihanmo vikramya sarvānevāgatān yudhi ||39|| teṣāṃ sagarvaṃ tad vākyaṃ śrutvā hariramitrajit | uvāca prahasan sarvānidaṃ vacanasūrjitam ||8.32.40|| mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ | yasmāt prasahya tasmādvo nāśayāmyadya garjitān ||41|| ṛtvigbhirbhāgadheyaiśca saha yajñena codyataḥ | yeṣāṃ ca lavattā vastān sarvān nāśayāmyaham ||42|| evamuktvā sa tejasvī haribhadraḥ pratāpavān | bhadrakālī ca saṃkruddhā abhidudruvatuḥ surān ||43|| gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ | prasthātrā saha hotāramaśvaṃ caiva gaṇeśvarāḥ | |44|| gṛhītvā kupitāḥ sarve gaṅgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ | yajamānañca pāśena baddhvā ninyuryathāsukham | |45|| vedīmanye kuśānanye sruconye camasān pare| vyanāśayam̐ścikṣipuśca śālāścānyebhyadīpayan | |46| | haribhadropi dīptātmā śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam | vyaṣṭaṃbhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām | |47 || bhagasya netre pūṣṇaśca daśanān ruṣitānanaḥ | dhanuṣkoṭyā samāhatya miṣatāṃ saṃnyapātayat ||48 || viṣṇoścakraṃ ca tad ghoraṃ yugāntādityavarcasam | vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā karasthaṃ na cacāla ha ||49 || tuṣitām̐śca tathā devānudyuktān yuddhalālasān | vāyavyāstreṇa saṃhatya pṛthivyāṃ tānnyapātayat | |8.32.5 0 | | anyām̐śca devān devosau sarvān yuddhāya saṃsthitān | mohanenāstravaryeṇe samohayadaninditaḥ ||5 1 || rājānaścāpi ye kecit tatrāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ | tānsarvānastravīryeṇa svagṛhānanayad balāt ||52| | tad pravidhvastakalaśaṃ bhagnayūpasatoraṇam | pradīpitamahāśālaṃ dṛṣṭavā yajñobhidudruve | |53 || taṃ tadā mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ gaganaṃ prati | hariḥ śaraṃ sa sandhāya viśiraskamathākarot ||54| | śaraṃ cāparamādāya vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān | palāyamānaṃ taṃ yajñaṃ sasāra mṛgarūpiṇam | nakṣatrasamatāṃ yātuṃ dvābaddhaṃ vītamabhyagāt | |55 || sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ te nikṛtā vyāsa gaṇaiḥ kālyā tathaiva ca | hariṇā caiva devena sarve śaraṇamāgatāḥ | |56|| tān prapannān tadā sarvān devān samunilokapān | hariḥ kālyā sahaivāha gacchadhvaṃ somamavyam | prasādayadhvaṃ deveśaṃ tato vo bhavitā śamaḥ | |57| | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā hariṇā jagmurdevaṃ pramanyavaḥ | prasādayitumavyagrā duḥkhaśokasamanvitāḥ ||58|| tataste nātidūre tu sāmbaṃ sagaṇamīśvaram | apaśyanta mahātmānaḥ sarve tadgatamānasāḥ ||59| | te taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyoccai stuṣṭuvurdīptatejasam | vāgbhirāhavanīyābhiḥ kṛtvā brahmāṇamagrataḥ || 8.32.60 | | devā ūcuḥ namaste suraśatrudhna surayajñapramardaka | mahāyajña mahāsatva mahākratuśatastuta | |61|| namo yajñavināśāya vedasarvasvadāya ca | śipi viṣṭakṛte viṣṇornarasiṃhābhighātine | | 62| | mandarādrinivāsāya śubhasarvasvadāya ca | mahāvimānayānāya ṛtuvighnakarāya ca | |63 | | mantrāntaḥ karaṇayaiva mantravratakarāya ca | pūṣṇo dantavināśāya bhaganetraharāya ca | |64|| viṣṭambhanāya śakrasya viṣṇoścakrasya caiva hi | namo yajñapraṇetre ca yajñotpattikarāya ca || 65| | varadānādhigamyāya brahmaṇo janakāya ca | vyāghracarmabhṛte tubhyaṃ kṛṣṇacarmāmbarāya ca | |66|| namaḥ sragvaramālāya narapitre tathaiva ca | utpādakāya viṣṇośca jayāya vijayāya ca | |67| | namo manyuvināśāya vīrabhadraprajāya ca | namo harṣāya kopāya gaṇeśvarasṛje namaḥ | | 68 | | namo devānutāpāya mṛgabāṇārpaṇāya ca | namaste bhagavan deva namaste bhagavañchiva ||69| | namaste sarvalokeśa namaste lokabhāvana | tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ yajño devāśca yajñahan | prasīda mā krudhosmākaṃ mā naḥ kṛtvā vināśaya | |8.32.70 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ya imaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ prayataḥ prātarutthitaḥ | na tasya vighnarūpāṇi kadācit | | rājatenāvṛtaṃ divyaṃ prākāreṇenduvarcasā | tasya madhye paraṃ cordhvaṃ ṣaṭkoṭyā vistṛtaṃ puram ||81 || jāmbūnadamayenaiva prākāreṇa susaṃvṛtam | tasya madhye tataścānyat paṃcakoṭī pramāṇataḥ ||82 || indranīlopalenaiva prākāreṇa samāvṛtam | tasya madhye hyapaśyaṃste vibudhā munisattama | |83 || caturyojanakoṭīkaṃ vistārāyāmataḥ samam | vaidūryopalayuktena prākāreṇābhisaṃvṛtam ||84|| nagaraṃ || apare kṣīriṇastatra vṛkṣā vyāsa mahāprabhāḥ | kṣīraṃ kṣaranti te nityaṃ sarve gavyaṃ samanvitāḥ | |9 1 | | sarvā maṇimayī bhūmiḥ śubhā kāñcanavālukā | udbhidānyudakānyatra giri prasravaṇāni ca | | |92|| na teṣu krodho lobho vā yuddhaṃ dveṣotha matsaraḥ | na moho naiva ca stambho na doṣāstatra cāpare | |93 | | tasya madhye puraṃ cānyad dvikoṭīvistṛtaṃ śubham | padmarāgamayenaiva prākāreṇa | | 103 | | pañcākṣa uvāca na bhetavyaṃ surā devaṃ darśayāmyadhunā hi vaḥ | sanatkumāra uvāca ityuktā dadṛśuḥ śarvaṃ sahasā te sahomayā | na caiva tatpuraṃ vyāsa na siṃhaṃ nāpi kiñcana | | 1 04|| || ekena teṣāṃ raudreṇa yūyaṃ sarvepi tarjitāḥ | yadi sarvānahaṃ krodhād visṛjeyaṃ kadācana || 1 07|| na bhaveta na sandehaḥ sarve yūyaṃ kṣaṇāntare iyantu devī yuṣmākaṃ kupitā parvatātmajā | etāṃ prasādayata va nāhaṃ kupyāmi vaḥ surāḥ | |1 08|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktavati svāminyuddhatā tāmralocanā | devī devīṃ mukhād ghorāṃ sasṛje bhayavarddhanīm || 1 09| | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ bhasmakūṭaṃ tu praviṣṭān śaraṇārthinaḥ | surān bhasmaviliptāṅgān devī devīṃ nyaṣedhayat || 1 14|| devyuvāca kālakarṇi nivartasva mā vadhīḥ surasattamān | ete pāśupatī bhūtā bhasmanā digdhamūrtayaḥ || 11 5|| etat paśupatiproktaṃ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ purā | yad bhasmanā pavitreṇa snānaṃ snānebhya uttamam | | 11 6| | ete bhagavatovaśya manugrāhyāḥ surottamāḥ | bhasma yena praviṣṭāstu tasmānmaitān bhayamatyugraṃ tuṣṭuvurhimavatsutām ||1 21 | | devā ūcuḥ haravaramahiṣīṃ mahādevapatnīṃ priyāṃ tryambakasyāmbikāṃ vācamekākṣarāṃ lokasaṃhārakartrīmumāṃ devadevasya pātnīṃ śubhāṃ śaṃkhakundenduhārāmbugaurogradaṃṣṭrāṃ jayāmāhave durnirīkṣyāmacintyogradṛṣṭiṃ viśālekṣaṇāṃ pītakośeyavastrāṃ mahāśūlaghaṇṭāpatākādhvajāṃ divyagandhājyadhūpapriyāṃ kāladaṇḍāsicarmograhastāṃ prapadyāmahe kānasī(ṣṭi) masuramahiṣadāraṇīṃ dāraṇīṃ dundubheḥ sundamārīṃ niśumbhasya mṛtyuṃ vibhāṃ somasūryāgnibhāsāṃ sṛja tkāntimiṣṭapradāṃ śokaduḥkhārtihartrīṃ viśekāmaghorāṃ ghanāmantakasyā devīmumāṃ mātaraṃ diśa tvaṃ sukhaṃ mātarasmāsu tuṣṭā mahādevapatnīṃ śubhāṃ yāṃ vayaṃ cintayāmaikayā saṃvidā dhyāyamānāḥ sadā dāruṇaṃ cāpi sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ yattvayā (?) tacca no nāśayāmbādya tuṣṭā yathā vai tuṣāraṃ mahāsūryadehodbhavā tacca no jātikoṭīsahasreṣu pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ yat kariṣyāma yatkurma tatsarvamevañca dadyāśca naḥ sarvamarthaṃ sakāmaṃ tathārogyamūrjāṃ śriyaṃ jñānavijñānamedhāstathā dhāraṇāṃ tarkamūhāmapohaṃ dhṛtiṃ cāryabhāvaṃ gatiñcaiva divyāṃ tathā dharmanityatvametām̐śca ye cāpyatonye guṇāstām̐śca sarvān juṣasvādya devi tubhyaṃ namaḥ | | 123-144| | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sā kṛtyaṃ tadāyaṃ bhavitā hi vaḥ || 148 || saśirasko diteḥ putrā mantreṇānena sandhitaḥ | tataḥ stotraṃ ca mantraṃ ca sandhānakaramavyayam | dadāvātharvaṇaṃ devaḥ provācedaṃ ca susvaram | | 149| | devadeva uvāca nakṣatrasamatāṃ yātu yajñoyaṃ surasattamāḥ | mṛgānusārī devopi harirasya bhavatvayam | |8.32.1 50 | | bhadrakālī hariścaiva gaṇāśceme mahābalāḥ | sarve bhadrā bhaviṣyanti yuṣmākamamarāssadā ||15 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktā bhagavatā devāste brahmāṇā saha | śirobhiḥ praṇatāssarve śarvamūcuridaṃ vacaḥ | | 152 || eṣa tāvat kratu śreṣṭhastavaiva bhavatu prabho | sarvaḥ surapate deva śatamabhyarcyatevyaya || 153 || bhāgānāṃ sarvayajñeṣu tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmahe | evamuktotha deveśaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sureśvaraḥ ||154|| cakāra rūpaṃ paramaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham | svātmānante tadā devā hyapaśyanta maheśvare ||155|| śirobāhūrupādeṣu vastihastodarādiṣu | avasthitān mahātmāno munīm̐ścaiva tapodhanān ||156|| sa tadrūpaṃ tadā kṛtvā devān provāca śaṃkaraḥ | sarve yūyaṃ mahātmāno maccharīrasamudbhavāḥ ||157|| yuṣmākañca śarīrāṇi manmayāni prapaśyata | tataste devatā vyāsa sarvaṃ rudrātmakaṃ jagat ||158|| ātmānaṃ cāpyapaśyanta vismayāpannacetasaḥ | evaṃ sa teṣāṃ deveśo darśayitvātmano balam | |259|| uvāca suraśārdūlān dṛṣṭā hyetā vibhūtayaḥ | yo yāṃ pūjayate mūrtiṃ bhaktyā paramamayā yutaḥ ||8.32.1 60 || tasya tāṃ mūrttimāsthāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmyahaṃ surāḥ | na bhāgadheyaiḥ kṛtyaṃ me bhāgadheyāni vasmurāḥ | sarvāṇyeva dadāmyadya yāta sarve gatajvarāḥ ||1 61 || devā ūcuḥ guhyametat paraṃ deva tvayāsmākaṃ nidarśitam | evaṃ yo vetsyate martyaḥ sa lokān prāpsyatevyayān ||162|| idaṃ ca bhagavan sthānaṃ bhadreśvaramiti śrutam | bhaviṣyati jagacchreṣṭhaṃ puṇyebhyaḥ puṇyavattamam ||163 || samantād yojanaṃ caivaṃ rudrakṣetraṃ sanātanam | mṛtotra gaṇapo deva vallabhaste bhaviṣyati | |164|| yaścedaṃ kīrttayennityaṃ kalya utthāya yajñahan | śrāvayeccāpi viprebhyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 16 5| | bhadrakarṇahrade cāsmin snātvā yobhyarcayeddharam | sādhayitvā caruṃ caiva bhojayed brāhmaṇān śuciḥ | | 1 66|| sa sarvapāpanirmukto yatra tatra mṛto naraḥ | modatepsarasāṃ madhye divi deva ivāparaḥ || 1 67| | yatra coktaṃ tvayā deva sthitena bhagavan prabho | harabhadreti puṇyoyaṃ tvatprasādād bhavatvaja | |1 68|| aśvamedhasya yatpuṇyaṃ samyagiṣṭasya yajñahan | tadatra deva bhavatu narasyābhyarcataḥ sadā | |1 69| | parityakṣyati yaścātra kaścit prāṇān narottamaḥ | haribhadrasya sa gaṇo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ | 8.32.170 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamastviti sa procya mandaraṃ cārukandaram | jagāma bhagavān śarvaḥ somo gaṇaśatairvṛtaḥ ||171 || devāpi rājñā sahitāstasmim̐sthāne yathāsukham | tasthurbrahmā ca viṣṇuśca jagmaturdevapṛṣṭhataḥ || 172 | | sa gatvā stokamadhvānamubhābhyāṃ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ | nātidūre tataḥ prāha tiṣṭha viṣṇo mahābala ||173 || sa praṇamya tataḥ pādau harasya puruṣottamaḥ | tasthāvāmraṃ samālambya sa kubjassamapadyata || 174| | yasmādāmraṃ samālambya tasmin deśe sthito hariḥ | nirīkṣamāṇo deveśaṃ deśastasmādabhūdasau | 175 | | kuvjāmraka iti khyāto viṣṇoḥ kṣetraṃ samṛddhimat | puṇyaṃ nivartanādviṣṇo gosahasraphalapradam ||176| | nātidūraṃ tato gatvā bhūyo devaḥ pitāmaham | nivarttetyabravīd vyāsa gaganañca samāviśat | |177|| tasmin viyadgate deve brahmā prāñjalirunmukhaḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvṛtya praṇamya prayayau tataḥ | | 178| | yasmāttatra haraṃ tena kurvatā vai pradakṣiṇam | āvarttaḥ svaśarīrasya prakṛtaḥ puṇyakarmaṇā | | 179| | tasmāt sa deśo vikhyāto brahmāvartteti śobhanaḥ | aśvamedhaphalaṃ tatra snātaḥ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 8.32.180 | | sādhayitvā caruṃ cātra bhojayitvā tathā dvijān | prāṇān parityajya tato brahmalokamavāpnuyāt ||181 || tatobhyetya suraissārdhaṃ brahmā viṣṇupurassaraiḥ | bhadreśvare paśupatermahimānamathākarot || 182|| sa liṅgaḥ tatra saṃsthāpya pūjāṃ kṛtvātibhāsvarām | bhadrakarṇahrade snātvā saha devairdivaṃ yayau | | 183 | | taṃ prayāntaṃ tadā dakṣo brahmāṇamidamūcivān | kartavyaṃ kiṃ mayā deva mama tad brūhi pṛcchataḥ ||184|| pitāmaha uvāca prasādaya maheṣvāsaṃ śarvamugraṃ kapardinam | tato yajñasamāptiṃ ca lokāṃśca prāpsyase kṣayān | |185|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto devena brahmaṇā vyāsa tattvataḥ | liṃgaṃ kanakhale kṛtvā rudramabhyarcayat tadā ||186| | tasya saṃvatsaraśate pūrṇe divye prajāpateḥ | mahādevodrijāṃ prāha prahasan girimūrdhani | | 1 87| | prācetasātmajo devi sthitastapasi saṃyataḥ | paśyainaṃ madgateneśe cetasā samavasthitam || 188 || tato dṛṣṭvā mahādevī vāyubhakṣamavasthitam | liṅgeparamayā bhaktyā pūjayantaṃ maheśvaram | |1 89| | uvāca hṛṣitā devī devaṃ sarvasurārcitam | kṛtāñjalipuṭā vyāsa sarvadevapatiṃ patim ||8.32.1 90 | | devyuvāca kṣudroyaṃ duṣṭacetāśca stabdho mānī ca durmatiḥ | viṣṭyā tvayā vinikṛta stvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | | 191|| tadasya duṣṭabhāvasya prapannasya maheśvara | kṣantumarhasi bhaktasya tvāmasyārthe prasādaye || 1 92|| devadeva uvāca tvameva devi yacchāsmai varāniṣṭān yathāsukham | anujñātā mayā subhru tvamevāsya varaṃ diśa | | 193 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastau devadeveśau saṅgatau svagaṇairvṛtau | ūcatuḥ paśya dakṣāvāṃ tuṣṭau divyena cakṣuṣā || 194| | prācetasa mahābhāga varadau svo mahātapaḥ | ................|| 195 || śāpaśāntyarthamet te varaṃ dadmi tavepsitam | yaste yajño gaṇairdhvastaḥ phalaṃ tasya tvamāpnuhi ||1 96| | kāmarūpadharaḥ śrīmān gaṇeśaśca bhavasva me | akṣayaścāmaraścaiva duḥkhaśokavivarjitaḥ | bhaviṣyasi mahābhāga mama caiva samīpagaḥ ||197|| devyuvāca śṛṇuṣva bhūyaḥ kiṃ cānyat prayacchatu maheśvaraḥ | suduṣkaramapi hyeṣa varaṃ dadyāt tvayārthitaḥ ||198|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastadā dakṣo himavatsutayā tayā | prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā idamāha mahāmatiḥ ||199|| dakṣa uvāca yo devastribhuvanajanmanāśakartā yaṃ mūḍhā na viduranuktamekameva | bhaktānāmaśubhaharaṃ pinākapāṇiṃ taṃ devaṃ śaraṇagatā vayaṃ sabhārm ||8.32.20 0|| yojñānādasuratayātimānamohānnāsmābhissaha khalu pūjitodriputryā | yaśśāpaṃ mama ruṣito dadau sureśastaṃ devaṃ śaraṇagatā vayaṃ sabhāryam ||20 1 || yassraṣṭā suragaṇayakṣarākṣasānāṃ siddhānāṃ ditisutadānavendranṝṇām | bhūtānāṃ paśumṛgapakṣipattagānāṃ taṃ devaṃ śaraṇagatā vayaṃ sabhāryam ||202| | yaḥ kodhānmahadasṛjad gaṇeśvareśaṃ siṃhendraṃ harimamitaprabhāvarūpam | patnīṃ cāpyamitaguṇaprabhāvayuktāṃ taṃ devaṃ śaraṇagatā vayaṃ sabhāryam ||203|| yo devān sahavaruṇān savittagopān sabrahmān saśatamakhān saviṣṇuvāyūn | indrāgryān samunimahāyudhān vijigye taṃ devaṃ śaraṇagatā vayaṃ sabhāryam ||204|| yatkiñcittvayi kaluṣaṃ kṛtaṃ ca duṣṭaṃ hyajñānādapi ca hi rāgadoṣamohāt | tatsarvaṃ mama saha bhāryayādya śarvo viśvātmā kṣamatu mahānubhāvabhāvāt ||205|| sanatkumāra uvāca tata evaṃ sa deveśaṃ stutvā sāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ | prasārya bāhū sarveṇa śarīreṇāpatad bhuvi | |206|| taṃ prapannaṃ tadā devo dakṣaṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇam | devyā saha mahābhāga svayamutthāpayad balī ||2 07|| tasyāśrūṇyapatanbhūmau bindubhūtāni tatra vai | tāni saṃhatya viprendra nadī tu samapadyata || 2 08| | tāmuvāca tato devo nadīṃ vai puṇyalakṣaṇām | arjunādaśrubindostvaṃ yasmād devi viniḥsṛtā ||2 09|| tasmāt khyātā bhavitrī tvamarjunā nāmataḥ śubhā | parvaparva samāsādya vahiṣyasi mahāyaśe | | 8.32.210 | | aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāpi tvayi snāto hyavāpsyati | mṛtaśca tava tīresmin niyamenetareṇa vā | |2 11 | | na punarjanma mānuṣye durgatiñcopalapsyate | trirātropoṣito yaśca caruṃ kṛtvā nivedya ca || 212 | | brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet snātastvayi sopi gamiṣyati | gavāṃ lokaṃ mahātejā na ca tasmāt patiṣyati | |21 3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa sṛṣṭvā saritaṃ kṛtvā caivāpyanugraham | tamāśvāsya sureśastu dakṣaṃ prāha nṛpaṃ tadā | |214|| devadeva uvāca gataṃ tasmād bhayaṃ testu gaṇeśo me bhava priyaḥ | brūhi kinte punassādho dadāni varamīpsitam | |2 15 | | sanatkumāra uvāca atha dakṣastadovāca praṇamya śubhayā girā | bhūyo bhūyassamāśvasya nirīkṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ | |2 1 6| | dakṣa uvāca yadi tuṣṭosi me deva bhavatvetad tavāvyaya | sthānaṃ pavitraṃ puṇyaṃ ca vara eṣostu me śiva ||217| | devadeva uvāca ete ca munikanye dve tapa āsthāya duṣkaram | kaṇaissaṃvatsare pūrṇṇe khalena ca yatośanam | |218 || kṛtavatyau mahābhāge tvaṃ ca dakṣa yataḥ sthitaḥ | idaṃ kanakhalaṃ tasmānmama sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 219 || tīrthañcaiva mahatpuṇyaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasannibham | nātra pāpā na ca śaṭhā nāstikā na ca māninaḥ | |8.32.22 0 || lapsyante vai sadā gantuṃ na ca vastuṃ kathaṃcana | mṛtotra na punarjanma lapsyate mama tejasā | |22 1 | | atrābhigamya snātvā ca caruṃ kṛtvā tathaiva ca | sarvapāpavimuktātmā śakraloke mahīyate ||222| | tato gaṇapatiṃ tatra haribhadramayojayat | kālīñcāsmai dadau prītyā bhāryāṃ sarvaguṇoditām | |223 || varām̐śca(?)vipulān divyān dvīpañcāpi ghṛtodakam | bāhujebhyaśca subahūn gaṇebhyaḥ pradadau varān ||224|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa dakṣayajño vai vidhvasto vyāsa śambhunā | yajñasya ca śiraśchinnaṃ yathaitat kathitaṃ tava | |22 5|| vyāsa uvāca sā devīmukhajā ghorā divyā deva bhayaṃkarī | kva vā gatā kathaṃ vāpi hyetadicchāmi veditum ||226|| sanatkumāra uvāca stutā yadā bhagavatī praṇatai ssurasattamaiḥ | tadāsya sāmbikā prāha brūhi kiṅkaravāṇyaham | |227|| tato brahmā mahādevīṃ praṇamya bahumānataḥ | uvāca duhitṛtve me bhavatveṣā sureśvari | |228|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamastvityumā procya tāṃ devīṃ pradadau sutām | mṛtyustvamiti sopyuktvā ghore karmaṇyayojayat ||229|| sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ devīm prāṇāpaharaṇe śubhām | sāpi tatkāryakaraṇe niyuktā brahmaṇā svayam | ūrdhvabāhuḥ sadeveśā sadodyuktā tvayā mayā ||8.32.23 0 || ya idaṃ dakṣayajñasya vidhvaṃsanamanuttamam | bhadreśvarapratiṣṭhāñca dakṣānugrahameva ca | |23 1 || paṭhed vā śṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayīta dvijānapi | sa sarvapāpavirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate | |232| | bhaganayananipātaṃ dakṣayajñe davāgniṃ madanapurahutāśaṃ candralekhojjvalāṅgam | suragurumakhakālaṃ saptalokādhipālaṃ śaraṇamupagatohaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śarmahetoḥ ||23 3 | | iti skandapurāṇe dakṣayajñapramathane dvātriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.33> sanatkumāra uvāca yathā tu vṛṣabho devamavahanmunipuṅgava | tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya vṛṣadhvajam | | 1 | | pūrvameva mahāsatvo dharmo yajña sahāyavān | tatāpa vipulaṃ nyāsatapaḥ paramaduścaram || 2 || himavantaṃ giriṃ prāpya vāyvāhārau babhūvatuḥ | varṣāṇāntu sahasrāṇi daśa dvādaśa caiva tau || 3| | mānuṣāṇi tato bhūyaḥ śākāhārau babhūvatuḥ | tatocirāt taryordevo gaṇaissaha mahādyutiḥ | |4| | savaissamānarūpaistairdarśanaṃ pradadau haraḥ | tām̐stau maheśvarān dṛṣṭavā bahūn vai sadṛśaprabhān | |5|| parasparamamanyetāṃ konveṣāmīśvaro bhavet | tau tadā vīkṣya saṃmantrya smṛtvā caiva punaḥ punaḥ ||6 || madhye maheśvaraṃ teṣāṃ menāte tejasāṃ nidhim | tau taṃ madhye bhavaṃ devaṃ praṇamya bahumānataḥ | śirasorañjalī kṛtvā tuṣṭuvāte mitaujasau ||7| | dharmayajñau ūcatuḥ namastrailokyanāthāya digvāsāyāmṛtātmate | catuṣpathanivāsāya catuṣpatharatāya ca | |8 | | caturvyūhāya devāya trinetrāya bhavāya ca | caturmukhāya śuddhāya jālāntara vicāriṇe ||9|| indrānugrahakartre ca brahmānugrahakāriṇe | ūrdhvaliṅgāya devāya madanāyāmadāya ca ||8.33.1 0 || namo hiraṇyavarṇāya sūryākṣāya tathaiva ca | namaḥ pavitrakeśāya dīrghajihvāya caiva hi || 11 | | namaste naikapādāya ekākṣāya namo namaḥ | namaḥsahasraghaṇṭāya sahasrākṣāya vai namaḥ | | 12 || namaḥ pinākine caiva dhvajine ca namo namaḥ | namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya saṃvarttāya namo namaḥ || 13 || namaḥ stavyāya vai nityaṃ śatrughnāya namo namaḥ | namo bhavāya bhavyāya bhāvanāya namo namaḥ | |14| | namo varāya vai nityaṃ varadāya tathaiva ca | gokarṇāya namo nityamaiśvaryapataye namaḥ ||1 5|| namostu viṣvaksenāya prabhāsāya namo namaḥ | namostu tennadāyaiva prāṇadāya namostu te | | 1 6| | namaḥ pravartakāyaiva padmamālāya vai namaḥ | namo mahārathāyaiva bhairavāya namo namaḥ || 17|| namaścaturmukhāyaiva mahādevāya vai namaḥ | namostu brahmaṇe caiva dhruvāyaiva calāya ca || 18 | | namostu nārīrūpāya subhagāya namo namaḥ | madhyamāya namastestu namaste sarvatastathā || 1 9| | namonumantā mantā tvaṃ sarvabhūtapravartaka | āvayorīpsitān kāmān vidhatsva bhuvaneśvara | |8.33.2 0 | | sanatkumāra uvāca yonena stauti vai nityaṃ niyamena samanvitaḥ | sarvakāmai ssa sampanno yatheṣṭāṃ gatimāpnuyāt ||21 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha devastu tān sarvānanayatprakṛtiṃ gaṇān | nandinaṃ caiva devīñca svayaṃ cātmānamapyuta | uvāca caitau tuṣṭosmi gṛhyatāmīpsito varaḥ ||22|| devau ūcatuḥ yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa yadi deyo varaśca nauḥ jātyantaragatau nityaṃ vaheva tvāṃ sureśvara | |23|| idañca guhyaṃ sthānaṃ nau tapasātīva bhāvitam | tava caiva prasādena bhavet puṇyaṃ sureśvara | |24|| devadeva uvāca idaṃ mama paraṃ guhyaṃ bhavitṛ sthānamuttamam | pañceṣukṣepamātraṃ vai mṛtotra gaṇapo bhavet ||25|| yasmānmadhye bhavosmīti yuvayorarcitaḥ sthitaḥ | tasmānnāmnā tu vikhyātamidaṃ bhavatu madhyamam ||26|| yuvāṃ jātyantaraṃ prāpya pūjitau balavattarau | vāhanatvaṃ mamāsādya lokān sandhārayiṣyathaḥ | |27|| sanatkumāra uvāca tata evaṃ tadā devastāvuktvā devasattamau | jagāma gaṇapaissārdhaṃ mandaraṃ hemakandaram | |28|| gatetha deve sagaṇe kālena bahunā tataḥ | manvantaresmin surabhī rudramārādhayacchubhā | |29|| tayā varṣasahasreṇa tapasā toṣito bhavaḥ | jagāma darśanaṃ vyāsa varadosmīti cābravīt | |8.33.3 0 | | sā vavre putramatulaṃ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ varam | putrām̐ścānyānmahāsatvān yajñiyān surasattamān ||3 1 || tathā duhitṝ ścānyāśca jagaddhātrīḥ suśobhanāḥ | tataḥ sarvaṃ dadau devo hyadṛśyatvaṃ jagāma ca ||3 2 || tasmin gate mahādeve surabhī dīptatejasam | sarvabhūtāgrajaṃ putraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ samasūyata ||3 3 | | ekādaśa tathā rudrān vṛṣabhasyānujān śubhān | sapta kanyāśca tā gā vai jagaddhātrī prasūyata | |34|| vṛṣabhaḥ sa tu saṃgatya nityaṃ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ | pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva tathaiva ca pitāmaham | |3 5| | abhivādyāyate śubhraścaturdiggajasevitam | vanaṃ siddhagaṇāvāsaṃ yatra sā hyamṛtodbhavā | | 36|| dūrvāmṛtarasā divyā chinnadagdhaprasehaṇī | sa kadrācidvane tasmim̐ścaran tṛptastṛḍardditaḥ ||37|| jagāma sāgaraṃ pātuṃ vṛṣarāṭ surabhīsutaḥ | sovagāhya mahā grāsaḥ sāgarasya tadā mahat | |38| | madhyaṃ vyādāya vadanaṃ saruṣaṃ satimiṃgilam | apibat sāgarajalaṃ na ca tṛptimupāgamat ||39|| tasmin pibati daityendrāḥ sannaddhāḥ sāsimārgaṇāḥ | sadhanuṣpāṇayassarve sahasrāṇi caturdaśa | |8.33.40 || niṣpetuśśakrasaṃkāśā yamakālānalopamāḥ | mayaputrā mahāsatvā vṛṣabhaṃ prati vegitāḥ ||41 | tāṃstathā ruṣitāndaityān sāsimudgaratomarān | sahaiva sāgarāmbhobhirapibat sa mahābalaḥ | |42| | tān pītān pīyamānām̐śca dṛṣṭavā hyarṇavavāsinaḥ | vitresuḥ sahasā sarve vineduścāpi duḥkhitāḥ | |43 || tatassamudro bhagavān pīyamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | vaḍavāmukhamāgatya saṃvartaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau |||44| | sa cānalaḥ susaṃrabdho dattvā tasya mahābalaḥ | abhayaṃ vṛṣamāgatya provācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ | |45 || saṃvartta uvāca sarvabhūtaśaraṇyoyaṃ daityānāñcālayaḥ śubhaḥ | nainaṃ hīnaṃ bhavānadbhiḥ kartumarhati vīryavān ||46|| vṛṣabha uvāca na me matirabhūdagne niḥśeṣaṃ kartumambudhim | bhavān tvasya ye yato mantā na kariṣyehaṃ tatodyavai ||47|| yaste darpaśca garvaśca yadbalaṃ yacca pauruṣam | tanme darśaya havyeśa pibāmyenaṃ tavāgrataḥ ||48|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā vṛṣendrastu vaḍavāmukhavāsinam | saṃrambhāt sāgaraṃ pātuṃ niḥśeṣamupacakrame ||49 || anala uvāca na me tvaṃ pratimaḥ śaktau na ca vairaṃ tvayā hi me | yatra kṛtyehamābaddhastatkariṣye tathā hyaham ||8.33.5 0| | na tvaṃ pāsyasi rakṣiṣye sāgaraṃ mama sannidhau | ahaṃ tvāṃ vārayiṣyāmi surabhīsuta katthana ||5 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca tatastaṃ bhagavān vahnirupaplutya mahādyutiḥ | gale jagrāha balavān na cacāla tataḥ sa ca ||52| | yat pītaṃ chardayāmāsa tattoyaṃ dānavairvinā | audareṇāgninā tasya te dagdhāḥ sarva eva hi | |53 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ saṃvartako vahnirnigṛhītaṃ kakudminam | visṛjyovāca gaccheti na tvāṃ hanmi vṛṣeśvara|| 54| | śaktastavāhaṃ dahane hyaśakto me bhavān vadhe | tathāpyahaṃ na garjāmi garjitaiḥ kiṃ balīyasām | |55 || sanatkumāra uvāca visṛjya vṛṣabhaṃ vahnirāśu yātaḥ svamālayam | vṛṣabhopi jagāmeva duḥkhaśokābhisaṃvṛtaḥ || 56| | sovamānena tejasvī mahokṣaḥ surabhīsutaḥ | duḥkhena cābhisannātmā jagāmaivaṃ vicintayan | |57| | abalohaṃ balī vahniryenāhaṃ nikṛtastathā | jīviteśena (?) bhūtvā ca nāhaṃ prāṇairviyojitaḥ | | 5 8| | moghaṃ mama bala sarvaṃ tathā caivābhigarjitam | śarajjaladharasyeva vihīnasyādbhirambare | |59| | adya prāṇānahaṃ tyakṣye niyato vratamāsthitaḥ | yathā na punarevaṃ me mānabhaṅgo bhaviṣyati | |8.33.60 | | śatruṇā nigṛhītasya durbalasya durātmanaḥ | jīvitānmaraṇaṃ manye viśiṣṭaṃ jīvitena kim | |61 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evaṃ cintayannukṣā vācaṃ śuśrāva khācchubhām | saurabheya na bhetavyaṃ yad bravīmi kuruṣva tat ||62 || rudraṃ sarvasureśānaṃ sarvebhyo balavattaram | taṃ prapadyasva deveśaṃ tato jeṣyasi pāvakam || 63 || sa sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | sa te duḥkhamidaṃ sarvaṃ vyapaneṣyati bho vṛṣa ||64|| sanatkumāra uvāca etacchrutvā mahātejāḥ sādhyasya sumahātmanaḥ | himavantaṃ giriṃ prāpya tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 65|| tasya varṣasahasreṇa tatparasya tadāśiṣaḥ | bhagavān sarvabhūteśaḥ sāmbaḥ sagaṇa ūcivān | | 66|| devadeva uvāca saurabheya mahābhāga tuṣṭosmi tava putraka | iṣṭān brūhi varān vatsa dāsye tān subahūnapi | |67|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa devaṃ saṃdṛśya sāmbaṃ sagaṇamīśvaram | praṇamya śirasā pādau prāñjalissusamāhitaḥ | |68| | bhūyo bhūyo nirīkṣyainaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ | uvāca tapasokṣayyamiccheyaṃ vai jagatpate | |69| | balañcānuttamaṃ deva yogaiśvaryantathākṣayam | tvadīyo vāhanaścāhamagninaivaṃ vimānitaḥ | |8.33.70 || saṃvarttakānalañcaiva vaḍavāmukhavāsinam | draṣṭumicchāmi deveśa nigṛhītaṃ tvayāvyaya ||71 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastu tāndattvā varān satyavatīsuta | vāmaṃ pārśvaṃ tathā mṛjya rudramekaṃ sasarja ha | |72| | kirīṭamālinaṃ tryakṣaṃ kuṇḍalāṅgadabhūṣaṇam | mahoraskaṃ kabacinaṃ dhanurhastaṃ mahābalam | baddhagodhāṅgulitraṃ ca khaṅgadivyāstradhāriṇam ||73 | | tamāha rudraṃ gaccheti vaḍavāmukhavāsinam | saṃvarttakānalaṃ baddhvā visphurantamihānaya ||74|| sanatkumāra uvāca vanditvā caraṇau tasya somasya gaṇanāyakaḥ | jagāma sāgaraṃ vegād dadarśa ca hutāśanam ||75|| sa yuddhaṃ balavat kṛtvā sughoraṃ lomaharṣaṇam | saṃvarttakānalaṃ baddhvā devapārśva mupānayat ||76| | vyāsa uvāca kīdṛk tadyuddhamabhavat viṭpateḥ pāvakasya ca | etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ vada tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara | |77| | sanatkumāra uvāca sa gatvā gaṇapaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃvarttakamathānalam | uvāca krodharaktākṣastadā vacanamarthavat | |78|| gaṇapa uvāca svāmī sarvasya jagato devaścandrārdhabhūṣaṇaḥ | ājñāpayati vahne tvāṃ vṛṣamenaṃprasādaya ||79| | praṇātosmīti taṃ brūhi vṛṣabhaṃ sasuhṛjjanaḥ | nideśe tiṣṭha caivāsya yat kartavyaṃ ca tatkuru ||8.33.80 || sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktonalaḥ śrutvā devadevasya tadvacaḥ | uvāca nātisaṃhaṣṭastvidaṃ vacanamarthavat ||8 1 | | anala uvāca niyojyo devadevasya tasyaivāhaṃ sadānugaḥ | na ca māṃ sa niyuktveha yokṣyatenyatra karhicit ||82 | | gaccha madvacanād brūhi bhagavantaṃ trilocanam | yadi māṃ vakṣyati punaḥ kariṣyehaṃ tatastathā | |83 || gaṇeśvara uvāca bāliśā vata ye prājñā balajñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ | ta evamuktā gacchanti yathā māṃ tvaṃ prabhāṣase | |84| | sakṛdājñā balavatāṃ sakṛt
