trailokyadeveśamindraṃ paśyāmi dikpatim | idaṃ pādyamidaṃ cārdhya midamāsanaviṣṭaram ||84|| ayaṃ ca madhuparkaste gṛhyatāṃ sadasaspate | kiṃ karomi tadākhyāhi prārthayasva mahābala | kṛtameva hi tadviddhi yadi syāt sukaraṃ mayā | |85| | śaka uvāca bhakto me pitā vipra sakhābhūt paramaḥ purā | tena snehena dṛṣṭvāhaṃ bhavantaṃ tapasi sthitam | kliśyamānamihāyāto brūhi kinte dadānyaham||86| | upamanyuruvāca devarājyamapi tvatto nāhaṃ kāṃkṣe surottama | mahādevamahaṃ bhaktastasmādicchāmyahaṃ varam ||87|| śakra uvāca mahādevaṃ na paśyanti surāpi sadasaspatim | na taṃ drakṣyasi viprendra brūhi yatte manogatam ||88 | | ahaṃ pituste snehena ihāyāto mahāvrata | dharmato hi suto me tvaṃ brūhi tasmād dadāmyaham ||89| | upamanyuruvāca kṛtaṃ svajanakṛtyaṃ te pūjitosmi tvayā prabho | gaccha nāhamṛte rudrād varaṃ yācenyasaṃbhavam | |8.34.90 || sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktaḥ sa tejasvī śakrarūpī maheśvaraḥ | uvāca tapsyase paścāt kiṃ te rudraḥ kariṣyati ||91 | | gacchāmi svasti te cāstu nirvighnaste bhavatvayam | rudraṃ prati samārambhaḥ smarethāstvaṃ hi māṃ vibho ||92|| sanatkumāra uvāca gate tasmin tadā hīndre rudraḥ svaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | tasyādarśayadavyagra idaṃ covāca susvaram ||93 || rudra uvāca upamanyo mahābhāga paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ | brūhi niścitya manasā varaṃ yāvaddadāmi te ||94| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa dṛṣṭvā deveśaṃ śirasābhipraṇamya ca | uvāca praṇato vākyaṃ manasā saṃpradhārayan ||95| | bhagavan yadi tuṣṭosi sadā suragaṇārcita | yad bravīmi tadīśāna mahyaṃ yaccha namostu te | |96| | dravyaṃ kiṃcidanāśritya mānuṣaṃ divyameva vā | kṣīrodanaṃ samaśnīyāmayācitamupasthitam | |97| | devadeva uvāca anāśrityeha naivāsti kasyacid dvijasattama | tṛṇamapyāśrayaṃ kṛtvā tasmādvada mahāmune ||98| | upamanyuruvāca naivāhamāśraye kiñcit prasādād bhagavam̐stava | tadartha ścāyamārambhastat prayaccha yathārthitam ||99 | | daivadeva uvāca mune kiñcidanāśritya nāsti kṣīrodanaṃ tava | ityuktvā taṃ mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata ||8.34.1 00 || antardhānaṃ tato gatvā jijñāsārthaṃ pinākadhṛk | brahmaṇo rūpamāsthāya bhūya enaṃ tatobravīt | |1 01 || brahmovāca upamanyo mahāprājña sucīrṇaṃ te tapaḥ śubham | tuṣṭosmi te varaṃ brūhi prayacchāmi yathepsitam ||1 02|| upamanyuruvāca bhagavan sarvalokeśa namaste sarvasṛk prabho | sucīrṇaṃ me tapo deva yattvāṃ paśyāmi lokapa || 103 | | maheśvaramahaṃ bhaktastadāśīstatparāyaṇaḥ | tasmādvaraṃ vṛṇe deva tvatto nāhamasaṃśayam | |1 04|| brahmovāca rudraste nādadadvipra kṣoraudanamadurlabham | sa tenyat kuta eveha dāsyate varamuttamam | |1 05| | prājāpatyaṃ suratvaṃ vāpyamaratvamathāpi vā | indratvamatha somatvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ vā dadāni te ||1 06 || lokapālo bhavānastu sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ | brūhi kinte dadānyadya visṛjasva maheśvaram | nāsau dātā taveśānastṛṇamapyekamalpakam ||1 07| | upamanyuruvāca na gṛhītaṃ prabho tena mama kiñcinmahātmanā | īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na svāmī tasya kaścana || 1 08| | icchayā kurute devaḥ sarvakāryāṇi kāryiṇām | dadāti yadi lābho me na dadāti tathāpi ca || 109 || bahunā kiṃ pralaptena tena dattamahaṃ vṛṇe | narakaṃ vā paśutvaṃ vā kiṃ punaryadatonyathā | |8.34.1 10 || tvatto necchāmi viṣṇutvaṃ na śakratvaṃ pitāmaha | gaccha sarvasureśāna mā vṛthā kleśamācara || 111 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto deveśastena brahmarṣiṇā tadā | tasya tatra punarvākyaṃ varārthamavadat prabhuḥ ||1 12 | | upamanyurapīśāne mana ādhāya niścalam | tūṣṇīṃ babhūva devopi tatraivāntaradhīyata | | 113 || tasya tāṃ bhāvanāṃ jñātvā pinākīśastrilocanaḥ | svameva rūpamāsthāya darśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt | | 1 14|| tryakṣo jaṭī viśālākṣaḥ kuṇḍalī dīptalocanaḥ | jvālāmālādharaḥ śrīmān bhujagābaddhamekhalaḥ | | 11 5|| sarpayajñopavītī ca vyāghracarmāmbaracchadaḥ | kṛṣṇājinottarīyaśca kamaṇḍaludharastathā | | 11 6| | daṇḍī śūlī mahāhāso gaṇapairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | uvāca putra putreti tuṣṭosmi tapasā tava | 1 17|| amaro jarayā tyaktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ | kāmarūpadharaḥ śrīmān matprasādād bhaviṣyasi || 119 || dvīpañcemaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ hi kāmagam | kṣīraudana samudreṇa sarvataḥ parivāritam | |1 19 || mahāyogabalo bhūtvā sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ | bhuṃkṣva kṣīraudanaṃ vatsa bandhubhissahitaḥ sadā || 8.34.120 || saptapūrvāṇi sarvāṇi kulāni tava tāpasa | idaṃ caiva kulaṃ sarvamanugṛhaṇāmi suvrata | | 121 | | sarve bhavantu viprarṣe ya ime tava bāndhavāḥ | matprasādānmahāsatvā nityaṃ kṣīraudanāśanāḥ || 1 22|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa tu taṃ varamādāya praṇamya śirasā bhavam | śirasyañjalimādhāya astauṣīt prayatātmavān | |1 23 | | upamanyuruvāca namaḥ sarvāmareśāya viśveśāya namo namaḥ | namaḥ sarvārtihartre ca namaśśokaharāya ca ||1 24 || namaḥ pavanavegāya namaḥ pavanarūpiṇe | namaḥ kāñcanamālāya padmamālāya vai namaḥ | |1 25|| namaḥ suraripughnāya caṇḍavegāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ pitṛsureśāya makhaghnāya ca vai namaḥ | | 1 26|| strīrūpāya namastubhyaṃ sarvarūpadharāya ca | namaḥ kandarpanāśāya viśvasraṣṭre namo namaḥ | |1 27|| namo viśvāya pāśāya namocintyāya caiva hi| tvanno gatiśca śreyaśca tvameva hṛdayaṃ sadā || 1 28|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatastaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya samāśvāsya visṛjya ca | jagāma bhagavān vyāsa sukeśaṃ prati sa prabhuḥ ||1 29|| upamanyuṃ jvalitānalaprakāśaṃ śatamanyuṃ tapasā jigīṣamāṇam | sa cakāra nataṃ harogramanyuṃ varadānena tadā vyapetamanyum ||8.34.1 30 | | iti skandapurāṇe upamanyuvarapradānaṃ nāma catustriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.35> sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devaḥ sukeśaṃ gaṇapaṃ punaḥ | cakāra brāhmaṇaṃ vyāsa tapaḥ satyaparāyaṇam ||1 || vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ sa brāhmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ gaṇeśatvamupāgataḥ | kenāsya tapasā tuṣṭo gaṇeśatvaṃ dadau prabhuḥ | |2|| sanatkumāra uvāca āsīdvasiṣṭhakulajo brāhmaṇassatyavāk śuciḥ | tīrthayātrāsvabhirata upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||3 | | sa kadācidvideśastho vane paśyan pathi sthitam | vyāghraṃ vyāttānanaṃ ghoraṃ nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhaṃ tadā ||4|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ sa tadā viprastyaktvā panthānamāśugaḥ | viveśa mahatīṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ prāṇivarjitām ||5|| tatrāpaśyat sa purato vīraṇastambamāśritān | puruṣām̐llambamānām̐śca krandamānān suduḥkhitān ||6|| tānavākśiraso dṛṣṭvā lambamānāṃstadā dvijān | ke yūyamiti papraccha te caina midamūcire | |7|| pitara ūcuḥ tava smaḥ pitarassarve narakesminnadhomukhāḥ | vīraṇe tvayi lambāmastava doṣeṇa durmate ||8|| putrānicchanti manujāstārayiṣyanti nastvime | narakāditi sa tvannaḥ pātayiṣyasi duḥkhitān | |9| | vipra uvāca mayā tīrthābhigamanāt tapo yat samupārjitam | janmaprabhṛti yaccāpi mayā kiñcit kṛtaṃ śubham | tena yūyamito garttāduddharadhvaṃ pitāmahāḥ || 8.35.10 | | pitara ūcuḥ na vayaṃ tapasā śakyā na yajñairnāpyatonyathā | garttādasmātsamuddhartuṃ yad brūmastatkuruṣva naḥ ||1 1| | apatyaṃ guṇasaṃyuktamutpādaya tapoyutam | tato vayamito garttānmucyema yadi manyase ||1 2|| vipra uvāca ūrdhvaretāhamityetanmayā vratamupākṛtam | na dārānāhariṣyāmi tārayiṣye ca vai pitṝn | | 13 | | tatassa tān tathotsṛjya duḥkhena mahatā vṛtaḥ | jagāma rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ pitarontarhitāstataḥ | |14|| pitṛṣvantarhiteṣvevaṃ vāyubhakṣastadā dvijaḥ | kāṣṭhaloṣṭhopalībhūto nirucchvāsovatiṣṭhata | | 15 || sandhāya mānasaṃ rudre niścalaḥ susamāhitaḥ | hṛdayena japan rudrānākāśe samatiṣṭhata | |1 6| | tasya pūrṇe tadā māsi vātavarṣamabhūnmahat | sarvasatvapramathanaṃ dussahaṃ bhīmaśabdavat || 17| | tena varṣeṇa mahatā naiva tasyābhavattadā | duḥkhaṃ vāpyathavā bhaṅgaḥ samyagevāvatasthivān | | 18| | atha taṃ bhagavān devo māse vartati saptame | viṣṇurūpadharo bhūtvā provāca dvijasattamam || 1 9|| tuṣṭosmi tava bhadrante tapasānena suvrata | varaṃ varaya viprarṣe yaste manasi vartate || 8.35.20 | | sukeśastu tato dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇamupāgatam | abravīcchaṅkarādicche varaṃ na bhavato hyaham ||2 1 || viṣṇuruvāca alametena viprarṣe nirbandhena haraṃ prati | devairapi na śakyosau draṣṭuṃ kimuta mānuṣaiḥ | |22|| sukeśa uvāca draṣṭuṃ śakyo na vā śakyaḥ kimebhirvo vicāritaiḥ | kugrahaḥ sugraho vāhaṃ tathāpīśe mano mama | |23 || śaṃkarādeva cakreśa śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham | varaṃ kāṃkṣe na ca tvatto na cānyasmāt kathañcana ||24| | bhavantopi hi taṃ devaṃ yasmāt sarve samāhitāḥ | arcayadhve stuvadhve ca tasmācchreṣṭhaḥ sa ucyate ||25|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tanniścayaṃ jñātvā saṃtuṣṭo bhagavān haraḥ | viṣṇurūpaṃ parityajya svaṃ rūpa pratyapadyata ||26| | uvāca cainaṃ viprendra gaṇapo me bhavākṣayaḥ | amaro jarayā tyaktaḥ sarvaduḥvivarjitaḥ ||27|| aiśvaryeṇa ca saṃyuktaḥ priyo mama purassaraḥ | imaṃ ca matkṛtaṃ divyaṃ trikūṭaṃ nāma parvatam | |28| | bhavanaiḥ kāñcanairyuktaṃ kāmagaṃ te vadāmyaham | yeṣāṃ kṛte ca putra tvaṃ māṃ toṣayitumudyataḥ | |29|| te ceme pitarassarve suputreṇa tvayānagha | tāritā narakād ghorād gaṇeśaṃ tvāmupasthitāḥ || 8.35.30 | | kiṃkarāste bhaviṣyanti nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjitāḥ | gaṇeśvarāstavaiveme bhaviṣyanti vaśānugāḥ || 31 || sukeśa iti nāmnā ca prathitastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | sadā cāṣṭaguṇaiśvaryasamāyuktaścariṣyasi | |3 2 || sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa dṛṣṭvātha pitṝnnarakāt sasuhṛjjanān | tīrṇān gaṇeśvaratvena punaḥ pūjyena saṃyutān | |3 3|| maheśvaraṃ hṛṣṭamanāḥ śirasā prāñjalirgataḥ | uvāca hṛṣyamāṇāsyastadā vacanakovidaḥ | |34|| sukeśa uvāca bhagavan gaṇapatvaṃ ca labdhamaiśvaryameva ca | amaratvaṃ tathākṣayyaṃ tathaivājaratā varā | |3 5| | pitarastāritāśceme gaṇapāścaiva me kṛtāḥ | nagaśca kāmago hyeṣa labdho me tvatprasādataḥ | |3 6|| icchāmi tvāṃ mahadeva somaṃ sapravareśvaram | sadā sumukha matyarthaṃ sudṛśyaṃ caiva kāmada ||37|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto bhagavān sukeśena mahātmanā | uvācaiva midaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati gaṇeśvara ||3 8 || imaṃ giriṃ samāśritya sahaibhiḥ pravarairvaraiḥ | gaccha sveṣṭāṃ gatiṃ vatsa devān viprām̐śca pālaya | | 39| | visṛjya taṃ tato devaḥ sukeśaṃ gaṇanāyakam | jagāmādarśanaṃ somaḥ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām ||8.35.40 | | sukeśopi girau tasminnagare svargasannibhe | narakāṇāṃ sa tattvārthaṃ pitṝn papraccha yatnataḥ ||41 | | vyāsa uvāca kimarthaṃ gaṇapo brahman tān pitṝn paryapṛcchata | kathañca pitarastatra ācakhyustasya dhīmataḥ ||42 || etadvistaraśastāta saṃkṣepādvā yathātatham | tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi hitaṃ sarvasukhāvaham ||43 | | sūta uvāca sa evamuktaḥ surasṛksutaḥ prabhuḥ rvimānakartā vigataprayojanaḥ | jagāda vākyaṃ suraloka vardhanaḥ purākṛtaṃ (?) duṣkṛtasarvanāśanam ||44| | iti skandapurāṇe sukeśavarapradānaṃ nāma paṃcatriśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.36> sanatkumāra uvāca trikūṭaśikhare tasminnagare devanirmite | āsīnaḥ kāñcane divye vimāne strīsamākule | | 1 || pitṝna sarvān samāhūya saṃpūjya vidhivattadā | sukhopaviṣṭān tān dṛṣṭvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt ||2|| sukeśa uvāca yuṣmākaṃ tejasā sarvamidamaiśvaryamīdṛśam | bhavadbhistatkṛtaṃ devā yenāsmi sukhabhākkṛtaḥ ||3 || pitara ūcuḥ maivaṃ vadānṛtaṃ putra mādharmaste bhavediha | nāsmatprasādādaiśvaryaṃ tava putra kadācana | |4| | vayantu niraye ghore yātyamānāḥ sudāruṇe | tapasā tava vīryeṇa sukhamāpma sudurlabham | |5|| tvayā vayaṃ suputreṇa tāritā nirayād yathā| tathā nānyaṃ prapaśyāmo dhanyo hi tvaṃ suto hi naḥ | |6| | adya varṣasahasrāṇi bahūni niraye vayam | pacyema ghore durvṛttā bandhuḥ syāstvaṃ na no yadi ||7|| bahavaḥ prāṇinaḥ putra yātyante tatra saṃyatāḥ | ati ghore (?)sudurvṛttāstapo yeṣāṃ na vidyate ||8|| sukeśa uvāca pitaro noktapūrvaṃ me mṛṣā na ca vadāmi vai| yathā prabhāvādyuṣmākamaiśvaryaṃ mama tattadā | |9| | śṛṇudhvaṃ vadataḥ samyak māvamadhvaṃ vaco mama | na cāvamanye pitaro devatāḥ kovamanyate || 8.36.10 | | pitaraḥ karma kurvanti satāṃ yat saṃmataṃ bhuvi | nityaṃ cāśāsate caiva prajā naḥ santu puṣkalāḥ || 11 || dhārmikāśca kṛtajñāśca satkarmaratayastathā | ye no narakagartasthān tārayiṣyanti nityaśaḥ | |1 2|| teṣāṃ tatkāryakaraṇāt svadharmācyavanena ca | sa dharmonuṣṭhitaḥ samyak prajā janayate śubhāḥ ||1 3 || dhārmikāśca vadānyāśca kṛtajñāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ | pitṛbhaktāśca sarvatra pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇe ratāḥ | 114|| sohaṃ bhavadbhirdharmeṇa pareṇa ca samādhinā | janitastapasā yukto bhavatāmeva sarvaśaḥ || 15 | | devamārādhya narakāt pitṝm̐stāritavān punaḥ | eṣa prabhāvo yuṣmākaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ ca ha | |1 6| | mamātra kiṃ mahāprajñā anṛtaṃ vātra kiṃ vacaḥ | iyaṃñca vaidikī śubhrā śrutirvedavidāṃ varāḥ | | 17| | pramāṇaṃ yadi manyadhvaṃ ātmanā kṛtamityuta | aṅgādaṅgāt saṃbhavasi hadayādadhijāyase || 18 || ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradāṃ śatam | aṅgebhyohaṃ samutpanno yuṣmākaṃ hadayācca ha || 19| | ātmanāhaṃ tathātmānaṃ yuṣmām̐stārivām̐stataḥ | tasmād bhavanto manyantāṃ sarva eva samādhinā | | 8.36.20 | | tasmāddhi ghorāntarakāttāritāḥ svena karmaṇā | na cānyakarmaṇā kaścidanyastarati durmatiḥ | svakarmaṇā hi jantūnāṃ phalapāko vidhīyate ||2 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatasta evaṃ pitarastena proktā mahātmanā | harṣeṇa sāśrunayanā idamūcustadā vacaḥ || 22| | pitara ūcuḥ tvadanyaḥ ko vadedevaṃ yo na syādīśasaṃmataḥ | yuktametattava vaco dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ ||23 || yo na syādīdṛśaḥ putra kathaṃ taṃ savadevapaḥ | iṣṭaistu yojayet samyag yathā tvāṃ govṛṣadhvajaḥ ||24|| tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ hi no bandhustvaṃ janetā mahāmate | pitā tvameva putrā hi vayaṃ tava na saṃśayaḥ | |25| | atra te vartayiṣyāmaḥ purāvṛttaṃ mahāmate| śrutau smṛtau ca yad gītaṃ tannastvaṃ mantumarhasi ||26|| pitara ūcuḥ putrā hi brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā devā yajata māmiti | te yajanta tadātmānaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā cukopa ha ||27|| uvāca cenān saṃrabdho naṣṭasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatha | te śaptāḥ brahmaṇā sarve sametya ca divaukasaḥ ||28|| duḥkhaśokasamāyuktā dīnāstaṃ tuṣṭuvustadā | prasannaṃ taṃ samālakṣya ta ūcuḥ śirasā natāḥ ||29|| naṣṭasaṃjñā vayaṃ deva tānno yaccha punaḥ prabho | tat kṣamasva ca deveśa ajñānādyat kṛtaṃ hi naḥ ||8.36.30|| athaivamukto devaistairbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | uvāca praṇatān devān sānukrośamidaṃ vacaḥ | |31 || brahmovāca prāyaścittaṃ mahāsatvāścaradhvaṃ niyamena ha | vyabhicārakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ pāpaṃ prahāsyatha ||32|| devā ūcuḥ saiva saṃjñā na no deva vidyate sarvasṛk prabho | yayā jñāsyāmahe tāni prāyaścittāni lokapa | | 33 | | brahmovāca svān putrān paripṛcchadhvaṃ tataḥ śreyamavāpsyatha | punaḥ saṃjñāṃ ca dharmajñā mā kurudhvamatonyathā || 34|| pitara ūcuḥ tataste suraśārdūlāḥ papracchuḥ svān sutām̐stadā | prāyaścittāni dharmām̐śca vedān sāṅgān savistarān | |3 5| | te ca tebhyastadā putrā ācukhyuḥ prayatāḥ śubhāḥ | yāthātathyena tatsarvaṃ parameṇa samādhinā ||3 6| | atha te labdhasaṃjñāśca labdhakāmāstathaiva ca | svānputrānabhyabhāṣanta prīyamāṇā mudā yutāḥ || 37|| devā ūcuḥ putrā na yūyamasmākaṃ vayaṃ putrā hi vaḥ sutāḥ | yairjñānaṃ naṣṭasaṃjñānāṃ kṛtamasmākamavyayam | |38| | tairevamukte tatrāgād brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | uvāca cedaṃ tāndevān sarvāneva mahāyaśāḥ ||39| | brahmovāca vadanti nānṛtaṃ devāḥ satyaṃ deveṣu vartate | sutāścoktā hi vaḥ sarve pitaro nānṛtaṃ hi tat | |8.36.40 || tasmāt pitṛtvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ putrāṇāṃ nityamavyayam | bhaviṣyati na sandeho yūyaṃ putrāśca sarvaśaḥ | |41 | | nahya śiṣyāya kathyante rahasyāni kathaṃcana | ekārthau putraśiṣyau ca tasmāt putrāḥ stha sarvaśaḥ ||42 | | taranti putraiḥ pitaraḥ putrām̐stān tārayanti ca | tārayitvā pitṛtvañca karmaṇā tena yānti te | |43 | | yūyañca tāritāḥ putrairajñānānnarakāttathā | tasmādime hi pitaro yūyaṃ putrāśca sarvaśaḥ | |44| | pāti yasmāt pitā tasmāj janayatyapi vā pitā | putreṣu caitadubhayaṃ pitarastena vo matāḥ | |45 | | tataste brahma...........| ...| |46 | | ..............balāḥ | pitarastān varairiṣṭaiśchandayāmāsurayathāḥ | |47| | pitaraśca tato vavruragre yajanamātmanaḥ | yo noniṣṭvā yajeddevān na sa tatphalamāpnuyāt | |48| | enasā cābhisaṃyukto maha......| .......| |49 | | .....| yathāgataṃ tato jagmurbrahmaṇā saha sarvaśaḥ | | 8.36.50 | | pitara ūcuḥ yathā vayaṃ tvayā putra narakānnaṣṭacetasaḥ | tāritāścetanāvantaḥ punaśca pravarīkṛtāḥ | |51 | | pitā tato bhavān pūjyo yonuyāsi mahā..| ................||5 2 | | .............sattamaḥ | praṇataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā pitṝn vacanamabravīt | |53 | | evametadyathoktaṃ vo nānṛtaṃ vo vacaḥ śubham | paraspara pitṛtvaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ samudāhṛtam | |54| | varaṃ bhūya imaṃ mahyaṃ prayacchata gaṇeśvarāḥ | ...........| etena praśnamiṣṭaṃ hi kathitaṃ dvijasattama (?) ||55|| pitara ūcuḥ nāsti kiṃcidaviditaṃ bhavataḥ pravareśvara | bhavānasmatpramāṇārthaṃ vyākhyātattvamihecchasi || 56 || brūhi yadviditaṃ nosti kathāyiṣyāma taddhi te | śrutaṃ vāpyanubhūtaṃ vā yathāśakti yathātatham ...........| | | 5 7| || sukeśa uvāca bhavanto narake ghore parikliṣṭāḥ sudāruṇe | ataḥ śrutijñāḥ sarveṣāṃ narakāṇāmasaṃśayam | |58| | teṣāṃ satattvaṃ yogañca kālabhedaṃ tathā kramam | tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me | |59 | | kiyanto narakāste ca kiṃ pramāṇāḥ kimāśrayāḥ | kiṃ rūpā ke ca yātyante kathaṃ caiva suduḥkhitāḥ ||8.36.6 0 | | .................| ...............| |61 || kathaṃ ca tapyate janturvācyate (?) ca kathaṃ tathā | kiyatā caiva kālena narakāt sa vimucyate | muktaścottiṣṭhate kena kathaṃ saṃsarate punaḥ | |6 2|| etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa vistareṇa yathātatham | kathayadhvaṃ mahāprajñāḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||63 || tamupendrapitāmaheśvareśapravareśaṃ viditārthatattvakośam | duritāṃkita..muktayogaṃ pratiyogaṃ tvidamāhuragrayogam ||64| | iti skandapurāṇe sukeśa mahābhāgyaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.37> sanatkumāra uvāca tataste pitarastasya pratiṣṭhāṃ svasutaṃ prati || sumarmāṇamiti khyātaṃ kathayāmāsuravyayāḥ ||1 || pitara ūcuḥ ayante janakaḥ putra suśarmā lokaviśrutaḥ | kathāyiṣyati tattvena yattvayā samudāhṛtam | |2 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ suśarmā viprarṣe tamāmantrya mahāmanāḥ | uvācedaṃ mahāsattvaṃ sukeśaṃ gaṇasattamam | |3 | | suśarmovāca sukeśa na vayaṃ sākṣāt patitā narakārṇave | tvayyālambitacittāstu patiṣyāmastvayā vinā | |4| | kintu tadyātanābhītāściṃtayāmastvaharniśam | kīdṛśāste mahāghorā narakāḥ śrutidāruṇāḥ ||5|| tataste kathayiṣyāma yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam | gaṇeśvareśa śṛṇu me narakā ye prakīrtitāḥ ||6|| durāsadā mahādurgāḥ sarva prāṇibhayaṃkarāḥ |. prathamo narakastatra viśruto yamalācalaḥ | |7| | dvitīyaḥ śālmalo nāma tṛtīyaḥ kālasūtrakaḥ | kumbhīpākaścaturthaśca asipatravanoparaḥ ||8|| tathā vaitaraṇī ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamaścāpyayoghanaḥ | aṣṭamaḥ padma ityeva mahāpadmastathāparaḥ ||9|| rauravo daśamaścaiva mahāraurava eva ca | dvādaśaśca tamo nāma tamastamatarastathā | |8.37.1 0 || ete mahānto narakā ucchrāyāśca tathāpare | ekaikasyocchrayā hyaṣṭau narakāstepi kīrtitāḥ || 11 | | ucchrayeṣu saviśrāmā yātanā bhavatīśvara | itareṣu tvaviśrāmo viśeṣo hyeṣa kīrtitaḥ | | 1 2|| teṣāṃ satataduḥkhaṃ tu nṝṇāṃ pāpena karmaṇā | bhedaḥ kṣayācca pāpasya kramasteṣāṃ pravakṣyate ||1 3 | | pramāṇaṃ tu gaṇeśeha na śakyaṃ vaktumekaśaḥ | vibhutvāt karmaṇastasya kṣayādantaṃ prapaśyati ||14|| narake patitaḥ sarvo nāntaṃ tasya prapaśyati | kṣīṇapāpāḥ prapaśyanti yathā tacchṛṇu mevyaya || 1 5| | patito narake ghore duṣkṛtī svena karmaṇā | yātyamāno tikaruṇaṃ diśamekāṃ prapadyate | |1 6| | sa gatvā śīghramadhvānaṃ bahuyojanavistṛtam | bahūnanyā nanāsādya tasyāntaṃ vinivartate || 17| | vinivṛtya tato bhūyo yātyamāno vicetanaḥ | anyā diśaṃ punargatvā tathaiva vinivartate ||18|| evaṃ sarvā diśo gatvā hyantamaprāpya duḥkhitaḥ | yātyate karuṇaṃ tatra na kaścidiha vidyate ||1 9|| yātanānte tvakaruṇaṃ pāpasyānte tataḥ punaḥ | prapaśyate parimitaṃ paricchinnaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||8.37.20|| dvāreṇa mahatā yuktaṃ tatastasmādvimucyate | evaṃ hi narakāssarve hyanantāścākṣayāvyayāḥ ||2 1 || na teṣāṃ parisaṃkhyānaṃ yojanaissaṃvidhīyate | yena kālena tu punarjantuḥ patati duḥkhitaḥ | |22|| yathā caitacchṛṇu vibho kathyamānaṃ mayānagha | kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi kṣayānte duṣṭacetanaḥ | |23 | | vyādhyādhiyuktaḥ kleśena tyajati svāntanūn tataḥ | yamadūtairmahāpāśairbaddhvā duḥkhasamīritaḥ | |24| | viṣameṇa pathā deva nīyate vikṛtākṛtiḥ | ayomayaiḥ kaṇṭakaiśca vidhyamānastatastataḥ ||25|| keśamajjāsthipaṃkaiśca dihyamāna ssamantataḥ | viṣameṣu ca garteṣu prapatanbhidyate punaḥ || 26 | | kvaciccopalavarṣeṇa mahatā sannikīryate | tatra bhinnaśirojānupādabāhūrūbandhanaḥ | |27|| kṛṣyate yamadūtaiśca punaḥ kaṇṭakibhirdrumaiḥ | yātyate bhidyate caiva vallībhiścā vabaddhyate | |28| | evaṃ bahuvidhākārairduḥkhadaiḥ pathibhiḥ prabho | nīyamāno vaśaḥ kleśān prāpnoti yamasādanam | 29|| sa tato yamamaprāpya dūrādeva yamājñayā| citraguptamupāgamya śrāvyate karma yatkṛtam||8.37.30|| somognirvaruṇo vāyuḥ sūryaśceti tadā naram | sākṣiṇastatra jantūnāṃ bruvate yat kṛtākṛtam ||31|| ukto vibhāvitaścaiva citraguptena coṣitaḥ| narake pātyate ārtta ūrdhvapādo hyadhaḥśirāḥ ||32|| tomarai ścātitīkṣaṇāgraiśśaraiścātha paraśvadhaiḥ| bhindipālairmudgaraiśca atibhirdīrghavedhanaiḥ ||33|| parighaiḥ karapatraiśca vajraiṣṭaṃkairhalopalaiḥ| kīlaiśca muśalaiścaiva kṣārapiṣṭena caiva hi||34|| pradīptaiścāyudhairghorairagnivarṣeṇa cāpyuta | hanyamāno divārātraṃ vinadan karuṇaṃ bahu ||35|| varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasreṇa narakaṃ prāpnute śubham| sa tatra patito bhūyo yātyamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ||36|| varṣakoṭimaviśrāntaṃ nirayāntaṃ prapadyate| mahānarakamuktaśca ucchrayāntaramāśritaḥ||37|| śītena vāyunā spṛṣṭaḥ sukhaṃ tatra sa vindati| sa taṃ viśrāmamāsādya vismṛto yātanāṃ tadā ||38|| muhūrttamāhṛte svapne rākṣasenāpakṛṣyate| sa tena kṛṣyamāṇaśca bhūyo duḥkhaśucārditaḥ ||39|| karuṇaṃ bahudhātīva pravilapyāvatiṣṭhate| tato bhūyaḥ samākṛṣya yātanāyāṃ sa rākṣasaḥ||8.37.40|| yātayatyeva taṃ jantuṃ saviśrāmaṃ sacetasam | tatra varṣasahasraṃ vai yātitaḥ punareva saḥ||41|| anyasminnucchraye ghore yātyate tāvadeva hi | evaṃ sa ucchrayān prāpya aṣṭau pāpena karmaṇā ||42 || saṃsāre kṛmikīṭādijantuḥ saṃpratipadyate | ye tu gacchanti tān ghorān narakān puruṣādhamāḥ| |43 || tānahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tava putra samāsataḥ | prathamo yo mayā prokto narako yamalācalaḥ | |44| | yātyante tatra puruṣā mahānirayagāminaḥ | parvatau dvau bhahāsatvasiṃhavyāghrasamākulau ||45| | śarabhebhasamākīrṇau bahusarpasamākulau | pakṣibhirvividhākāraiḥ puruṣaiścodyatāyudhaiḥ ||46| | vṛkṣairaparṇṇaissaṃyuktau sūcībhirvajrakaṇṭakaiḥ | tayorantaramekaṃ vai samaṃ sūcībhirāvṛtam | |47|| ūrdhvābhirvajratuṇḍābhirabhedyābhistathaiva ca | anyataḥ puruṣairghoraiḥ śastrapāṇibhirāvṛtau | |48| | prākāreṇa ca lauhena samantāt parivāritau | ākāśe cāpi lauhena tau jālena samāvṛtau ||49 || yātyante tatra puruṣā ye vai striyamanicchatīm | ākramanti parakyāṃ vai kanyādūṣaka eva ca | | 8.37.50 | | nyāsāpahārakaścaiva tathā māṃsāpahārakaḥ | rasāpahārakaścaiva yaścāpi paradūṣakaḥ | |51 | | indriyagrāmaghātī ca mithyāliṅgī tathaiva ca | mṛgaśvāpadahantā ca pṛṣṭhamāṃsāśinaśca ye | |52 | | vṛthāmāṃsāśino ye ca hiṃsāṃ ye ca prakurvate | ete narādhamāḥ putra gacchanti yamalācalam | |5 3 | | yamaleṣu ca jāteṣu yo na kuryānnarādhamaḥ | prāyaścittamaśuddhātmā sa ca taṃ pratipadyate | |54| | sa prasanno yathoktaistaiḥ puruṣaiḥ samabhidrutaḥ | āyudhaiśchidyamānaśca parvataṃ taṃ prapadyate ||55| | tatra vyāghraiśca kupitaiḥ śarabhaiśca tarakṣubhiḥ | sarpairviḍālaiḥ patagairayastuṇḍaiśca bhakṣyate ||56 | | tairbhakṣyamāṇo yadi ca vṛkṣaṃ samadhirohati | tatra taiḥ kaṇṭakaistīkṣṇairbhidyate pakṣibhiśca ha | |57| | atha cet kandarāṃ tasya guhāṃ vā yātumicchati | tatrāpi hyagninā dagdho duḥkhārtto vinivartate | |58| | atha cedantaraṃ ghoraṃ tayoḥ saṃpratipradyate | tatra sūcībhirugrābhiḥ pādayorbhidyate naraḥ | |59 || bhinnañca taṃ samālakṣya hyaśaktamapasarpaṇe | samāgamamyācalau kṣipraṃ pīḍayetāmatīva hi ||8.37.6 0 | | pīḍyamānocalābhyāṃ sa yantreṇekṣuvadāturaḥ | karuṇaṃ krandamānastu yātanāṃ tāṃ samaśnute | |6 1 || bhakṣitasyātha bhinnasya viluptasya ca pakṣibhiḥ | dagdhasya ca navaṃ bhūyaḥ śarīramabhijāyate | | 62 || evaṃ sa yātyamāno vai bahūnabdān suḥdukhitaḥ | dvāraṃ labdhvā viniryāta ucchrāyeṣu nipātyate | |63 | | yamalācalametamugravegaṃ bahudhāpāpasametakarmayogam | śṛṇuyādya abhīkṣṇaśotivegaṃ sa na yātyeva tamugrapāpayogam | |64 || iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane yamalācalakathanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.38> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śālmalīnarakaṃ punaḥ | yātyante tatra puruṣāḥ subhṛśaṃ pāpakarmiṇaḥ | |1 | | śālmalīnāṃ sahasrāṇi bahūni pravareśvara | uccāssarvāśca tā ghorā bahuyojanavistṛtāḥ ||2 || mahāśākhā mahāpatrā mahākaṇṭakasaṃyutāḥ | lauhena mahatā caiva prākāreṇābhisaṃvṛtāḥ | | 3 | | jālena mahatā sarvā upariṣṭhān samāvṛtāḥ | puruṣāstatra tiṣṭhanti bahavo ruṣitānanāḥ | 44|| vajradaṇḍopaladharā asimudgaradhāriṇaḥ | anyaiśca vividhākārairāyudhairvṛtapāṇayaḥ | | 5| | yātayanti bhṛśaṃ jantūnavaśāste sudāruṇāḥ | chidyamānāśca tatrāpi rākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ ||6|| diśaḥ prapadyate sarvā vedanārtaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | vrajate yatra yatrāsau tatra tatrābhihanyate | |7|| garteṣu patitaṃ caiva rākṣasāḥ prāpya sarvaśaḥ | śastraiśca vividhākārai rnikṛntantyatidāruṇāḥ | |8 || śrāvayantaḥ purānena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ durātmanā | bhartsayantaśca durvṛttaṃ patitaṃ kvacideva hi | | 9 || tata utthāya bhinnāṅgaḥ sonubaddhaśca rākṣasaiḥ | sūcīkaṇṭakasaṃyuktaṃ deśamanyaṃ prapadyate ||8.38.1 0 || tatra sūcībhirugrābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiścāyasaiḥ punaḥ | bhidyamāno nadan duḥkhānnipatatyatiduḥkhitaḥ || 11 | | tatrāpyenaṃ samāsādya vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ | rākṣasābhidravantyeva vairiṇo vairiṇaṃ yathā | | 1 2|| tasmādutthāya vegena vṛkṣaṃ yadyabhirohati | tatra taiḥ kaṇṭakaistīkṣṇairbhidyate chidyatepi ca || 13 || patraiśca vividhākārairayastuṇḍaiśca pakṣibhiḥ | hṛtakarṇākṣināsoṣṭhaḥ patito dharaṇītale || 14|| tatra sūcībhirugrābhiḥ sarvāṅgeṣu vibhidyate | evaṃ bahuvidhākārā yātanāstatra duḥkhitāḥ ||1 5|| prāpnuvanti durācārā ye tānnigadataḥ śṛṇu | agnido garadātā ca viyonau yaśca gacchati ||1 6|| puṃsi yo vocchṛjecchukraṃ viṣado māṃsavikrayī | samudrayāyī duṣṭātmā yaścaiko miṣṭamaśnute || 17|| atithinnārcayedyaśca yaśca mithyāvratī bhavet| brahmojla(?)śca vivāsāśca yopaḥ praviśate dvijaḥ ||18| | ghaṇṭiko grāmayājī ca śūdrādhyāpaka eva ca | tathā vārdhuṣiko lubdho brahmaṇaścaiva vikrayī ||19|| ete gacchanti durvṛttāḥ kūṭaśālmalisaṃjñakam | koṭīdvayena tūttīrṇā varṣāṇāṃ vai punaśca te ||8.38.20 || ucchraye pātitāḥ stokaṃ kālaṃ viśrāmya vai punaḥ | pātyante narake tasmin yāvat kṣīṇaṃ tadenasam | eṣaiva vidhiranyeṣāṃ narakāṇāṃ mune smṛtaḥ | |2 1 | | ya imaṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitopalambhaṃ sukṛtīnāmatidurgamācalam | śṛṇuyāt prayataḥ kutūhalātmā na sa gacchennirayaṃ hi śālmalam ||22|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane kūṭaśālmalikathanaṃ nāma aṣṭatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.39> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi narakaṃ kālasūtrakam | samantānmahatoccena prākāreṇa susaṃvṛtam || 1 | | lohajālena ca tathā ākāśepyabhisaṃvṛtaḥ | yathaikaśca tathā sarve narakā abhisaṃvṛtāḥ || 2|| socchrayāścaiva vijñeyā na vakṣye tānahaṃ punaḥ | lokadruho janāstatra yātyante puruṣādhamāḥ | |3 | | ye haranti striyaṃ vāpivikretā yastathā gavām | dharmasya cātmanaścaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca nindakaḥ | |4| | chadmanā yaśca śāstrāṇi gurubhyopahnavet punaḥ | guruṃ nindati yaścāpi vitara mātaraṃ tathā ||5|| śvaśuraṃ bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tathā cānyān garīyasaḥ | ākrośayati yastānvai tathā cāpyavamanyate | |6 | | āśramāṇāṃ tathā bhettā rahasyānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | adattaṃ yaḥ samādadyāt sa gacched dvija tatra vai | |7| | te tatra patitā ghore narake pāpacetasaḥ | tisraḥ koṭīstu saṃpūrṇā varṣāṇāntu narādhamāḥ | yātyante mṛtyuvacanāt krandamānā vicetasaḥ ||8|| kālasūtreṇa mahatā mitvā mitvā tu duṣkatam | chindantyaṅgāni jantūnāṃ kuṇṭhāgrairāyudhairbhṛśam | |9|| kiṃkaraistairaviśrāntaṃ divārātramatandritaiḥ | pūrṇe kāle tato jaṃturucchrayān pratipadyate | |8.39.1 0| | viśrāmya sa tadā jantuḥ pātyate narake punaḥ | yāvadasya kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kṣīṇaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ | |1 1 || ya imaṃ bahupāpakartṛsūtraṃ śṛṇuyād duṣkaralokakarmasūtram | na sa yāti tadugraduḥkhasūtraṃ narakaṃ tad yamalokakālasūtram | |1 2|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane kālasūtraṃ nāma ūnacatvāriṃśattamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.40> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kumbhīpākaṃ mahābhayam | śrotṝṇāmapi tatkālaṃ bhayadaṃ hyakṛtātmanām | |1 | | āyasyastatra brahmaṇaśca añjanācalasannibhāḥ | kumbhyastailena saṃpūrṇā vahnivarṇāḥ suduḥsahāḥ | |2 | | duṣkṛtīn tāsu taptāsu baddhvā baddhvā mahābalāḥ | kṣipanti rākṣasā ghorāḥ krandamānāḥ subhairavam ||3 || varṣakoṭīścatasraśca pacyante tatra jantavaḥ | ye tānimānnibodha tvamucyamānānmayā vibho ||4|| iṣṭakāpākakārī ca kumbhapākakarastathā | tau vināśayate yaśca agnido yo gṛheṣu ca || 5| | vane khaletha goṣṭhe vā annapānavināśakaḥ | bhojane vighnakārī ca yajñahā yajñadāhakaḥ | | 6| | kūṭakarmakaro yaśca kūṭasākṣī tathaiva ca | mithyāgnicayanī caiva mithyāgnyāharaṇī tathā | |7| | mithyāpākapradātā ca vedānāṃ yaśca dūṣakaḥ | hartopakaraṇānāṃ ca śilpināṃ yo narādhamaḥ | |8| | evaṃ te yātitāstatra viśrāmaṃ punarucchraye | saṃprāpya narake bhūyo nipatanti kṣayāntikam ||9| | ya imaṃ bahuduṣkṛtāntapākaṃ śṛṇuyādvā manujo hi karmapākam | na sa gacchati taṃ durātma pāka narakaṃ sādhanaduḥkhakumbhipākam ||8.40.1 0|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane kumbhīpāko nāma catvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.41> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi asipatravanaṃ punaḥ | narakaṃ pāpakṛdduḥkhaṃ sarvasatvabhayaṃkaram || 1 | | asipatra iti khyātā vṛkṣāstatra durāsadāḥ | bahavaḥ sumahāśākhā ghanāścoccāśca te bhṛśam | |2|| teṣāṃ patrāṇi ghorāṇi tīkṣṇānyasinibhāni ca | āyasebhyo viśiṣṭāni na ca tānyāyasāni hi ||3 || taikṣṇyāttāni viśiṣṭāni chedane ca mahāmate | taiḥ patrairācitāścaiva tathā kaṇṭakinaśca te ||4| | jantavastatra rakṣobhiḥ pāpakarmanibandhanāḥ | vadhyamānāsimuśalaistathaivānyairmahāyudhaiḥ| |5| | agninā dahyamānāśca vṛkṣāṃstān saṃprayānti te | tānāgatān samīkṣyaiva parṇāni prapatantyuta | | 6 || mahāgurūṇi tīkṣṇāni vinikṛntanti tām̐śca ha | te nikṛttaśirogrīvā deśāttasmāt prayānti vai | |7|| te gatā rākṣasairbhūyo bhūyo vṛkṣairdurāsadaiḥ | yātyante varṣakoṭīstu tatra pañca suduḥkhitāḥ ||8| | tato vimuktāstebhyaste ucchrayān saṃviśanti hi | viśrāntāstatra te sarve ucchrayānnarake punaḥ | |9|| pātyante vivaśā mūḍhā yāvat pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam | ye tu taṃ narakaṃ ghoraṃ narā gacchanti pāpinaḥ | | 8.41.10 || tāṃstehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahito dvija | vṛkṣaṃ yaḥ putrakṛtakaṃ vināśayati durmatiḥ ||1 1 || ārāme vātha grāme vā vikrīṇāti ca durmatiḥ | niṣpāditaṃ tathā vṛkṣamāśrame pathi vā punaḥ | |1 2| | taḍāge vā tathodyāne devatāyataneṣu vā | gṛhe prapāyāmathavā nadyāstīre catuṣpathe || 13 | | yatra vā tatra vā jātaṃ yo nāśayati durmatiḥ | pādapān gulmavallīrvā kṣupānatha tṛṇānyapi || 14| | chāyāpuṣpaphalārthaṃ hi svakāryakaraṇāya vā | vināśayati yo mūḍhaḥ sa ca taṃ pratipadyate | |1 5|| yaścāpaharate mūlaṃ puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca | ātmārthaṃ kāmasaṃpattau na devapitṛkāraṇāt || 1 6|| nadīṃ yaścāvarudhnīyāt kūpānyaśca prapūrayet | yaśca parṇatvacāmarthe vṛkṣaṃ chindyānnarādhamaḥ | vināśayedvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ sa ca taṃ pratipadyate || 17| | yaśca chāyāsamāsannān jantūn vai saṃprabādhate | svasthānaṃ ca samāsannān trāsayedvārayedapi | |18| | sarve te taṃ prapadyante socchrayaṃ narakaṃ mahat | uttīrṇāśca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsāraṃ yānti teśubhāḥ || 1 9| | ya imaṃ śṛṇuyādatandritātmā narakaṃ pāpakṛtāmaśarmabhūtam | na sa taṃ samupaiti puṇyakarmā viditātmā hyasipatranāmadheyam ||8.41.2 0 | | iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane asipatravanaṃ nāma ekacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.42> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ vaitaraṇīṃ nadīṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm | śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ putra pāpakarmabhayāvahām ||1 | | nadī vaitaraṇī putra ṭaṅkacchinnataṭā śubhā | keśāsthirudhirāpūrṇā mahākṣārarasā tathā | |2| | ullumpakairgardabhakairmakaraiḥ kacchapairapi | śiśumāraiśca nakraiśca tantukai rākṣasairapi | | 3 | | mahādaṣṭrairmahākāyaiḥ piśitāśaiḥ samākulā | asipatraiśca tairvṛkṣaistīrajātaiḥ samāvṛtā ||4|| śaivalena ca dīrgheṇa vitāneneva saṃvṛtā | tasyāstīre vanaṃ ghoraṃ śarabharkṣasamākulam | |5| | vyāghradvīpisamākīrṇaṃ siṃhebhakharasaṃkulam | tatra duṣkṛtakarmāṇastairvyāghrādibhirarditāḥ | |6|| tāṃ nadīṃ sumahāghorāṃ pātyante duḥkhitāstataḥ | tatra te patitā vatsa tantukaiḥ śaivalena ca ||7|| vitānena ca saṃnaddhā bhakṣyante tai(?)dibhiḥ | kṣārodakena dahyanto nanādayantaśca duḥkhitāḥ ||8|| ṣaḍ varṣakoṭīḥ yātyante yāvat pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ | tato muktāstūcchrayeṣu pātyante vai punaḥ punaḥ | |9|| viśrāntāstatra te sarve ye ucchrayān narake punaḥ | pātyante vivaśā mūḍhā yāvat pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam | |8.42.1 0| | uttīrṇaḥ socchrayānetān saṃsāraṃ pratipradyate | tīrṇontameṣu ca punarnarakeṣu pṛthak pṛthak | koṭirekā tu kālasya varddhate hyuttarottaram | |1 1 | | ucchrayāṇāntu sarveṣāmekaikasya pṛthak pṛthak | sahasraṃ varddhate putra varṣāṇāṃ vai samāsataḥ ||1 2|| ye tu gacchanti taṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ duṣṭacetasaḥ | śṛṇuṣva tānimān samyagucyamānānmayānagha | | 13 || saritaṃ yobhiśapate yaścaināmavamanyate | yaśca nagnaḥ praviśati striyaṃ yaścātra gacchati | |14| | niṣṭhīvedatha mūtraṃ vā purīṣaṃ vāpyathotsṛjet | apaśca harate yastu kṣetrārāmajanopagāḥ || 1 5| | apāṃ setuharaścaiva taḍāgasya ca bhedakaḥ | tathā puṣkariṇīnāṃ ca dūṣako yaśca mānavaḥ | | 16 || duṣṭāmaduṣṭāmathavā yaśca nārīṃ pradūṣayet | padminīṃ yaśca harati nāśayedvāpi durmatiḥ || 17|| sārthasya vātha jantorvā yo janturbhayamāvahet | te sarve narakaṃ ghoraṃ prapadyante narādhamāḥ | |1 8|| ya imāmaśubhapraṇāśanīṃ śṛṇuyānnityamaśuddhabādhanīm | prayataḥ sa na yāti bhāvanīṃ saritaṃ vaitaraṇīmasaṅginīm | |19|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane vaitaraṇīnāma dvicatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.43> ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi narakaṃ pāpanāśanam | ayoghanamitikhyātaṃ sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkaram | | 1 || yatra te puruṣā ghorā yamābhā yamakiṅkarāḥ | mahābalā mahāsatvāḥ sarveyogeśvarāstathā | |2 || ayaskārā yathā piṇḍamayasognipratāpitam | saṃdaṃśenābhisaṃgṛhya sthāpayitvāyase ghane ||3 | | abhighnanti ghanairanyaistathā tatrāpi jantavaḥ | hanyante rākṣasairghoraistarjayadbhiḥ sudāruṇam | |4| | varṣakoṭīstathā sapta yātitāḥ svena karmaṇā | ucchrayeṣu tathā ghorāṃ yātanāṃ prāpnuvanti te | |5|| etad ye yānti puruṣāḥ socchrayaṃ narakaṃ mahat | tānahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi anirdeśyān narādhamān | |6| | pādena hanyāt pitaraṃ mātaraṃ pūjyameva vā | anyāṃ kāñcit striyaṃ vāpi hastenātha kaśādibhiḥ ||7| | tathā pravajitaṃ caiva agniṃ vāpyatha laṃghayet | bālamarthakṛte yaśca mṛtyunā yojayettathā | |8|| striyaṃ vātha pumāṃsaṃ vā klībaṃ vānyannarādhamaḥ | bhrātṝn yaścābhi sandhatte dravye kasmiṃścideva hi ||9|| pitaraṃ vātha durbuddhirmātaraṃ bhaginīmapi | patiryaścaiva bhāryāṃ svāṃ putrāṃścaivābhisaṃdhayet | bhāryā patiṃ vā putrān vā teṣāṃ sā gatirucyate ||8.43.1 0 | | kīlayedyaśca devārcā stīrthāni ca durātmavān | vidyāḥ śāstrāṇi divyāni teṣāṃ sā gatirucyate || 11 | | ya imaṃ bahupāpayogakāraṇaṃ śṛṇuyānnityamasaukhyasarvadāraṇam | prayatassa na yāti taṃ bhayānakaṃ narakaṃ durgamayodhanāvatānakam | |1 2|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane ayoghanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.44> suśarmovāca ataḥ paraṃ padmamahaṃ pravakṣyāmi sudurgamam | sukṛtīnāmalabhyaṃ ca duṣkṛtīnāṃ bhayāvaham ||1 || tatrāgnistāpano nāma dhamyamāna iva jvalan | jantavastatra tāpyante vahnivarṇā bhavanti ca | |2|| padmapatranibhāssarve dhāmyamānāstatastataḥ | tasya madhye mahāstambho lauhaḥ samavatiṣṭhate ||3 || taṃ te gatvā pragūhanti sopyagniratidāruṇaḥ | evaṃ tatrāniśaṃ ghoraṃ yātitāstūcchrayeṣvapi ||4|| narāstaṃ yānti niḥsaṅgaṃ ye tānme tvaṃ niśāmaya | gurubhāryā ca yo gacched gurusvaṃ vā hareta yaḥ ||5|| devadravyaṃ bhakṣayedyo nāśayedvā pyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | brāhmaṇasvaṃ haredyaśca balāddhārayatepi vā ||6| | bāladravyāpahārī ca hartā vā strīdhanasya ca | klībām̐śca tyajate yaśca yo hanyāccharaṇāgatam ||7|| dhanaṃ cāsyābhimanyeta devadravyaharaśca yaḥ | sarvabhakṣa yaḥ syād vai yaśca pānīyavikrayī | |8 || somavikrayikaścaiva agnayutsādaka eva ca | agnipraharaṇo yaśca viṣapraharaṇaśca yaḥ | |9| | aśastraṃ yaśca saṃgrāme hanyācchastreṇa mānavaḥ | yācamānaṃ tathā caiva upaviṣṭamathāpi vā ||8.44.1 0 | | parāṅamukhaṃ ca saṃsaktamanyena saha vādinam | ete sarve narāstatra gacchantyakṛtabuddhayaḥ ||1 1 | | ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāt kṛtāntasadma prayato nityamanekaduḥkhasadma | sa na yāti tamugraśokapadmaṃ narakaṃ mṛtyumivāti kālasadma ||1 2|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane padmo nāma catuścatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.45> suśarmovāca mahāpadmastataścānyo nirayo romaharṣaṇaḥ | yatra te kiṅkarā ghorā yamasya yamasaṃnibhāḥ || 1 | | jantūnāmāyudhaiḥ kuṇṭhai rnighṛṇāḥ pāpakarmiṇām | utkṛtyotkṛtya māṃsāni tebhyo yacchanti vai punaḥ ||2| | te bhakṣayitvā māṃsāni svāni duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ | padmapatranibhā jātā dhāmyante gnau divāniśam | | 3 || analena ca ghoreṇa dravīkṛtamayaḥ punaḥ | mukhepāvṛtya yacchanti dāruṇā yamakiṅkarāḥ ||4| | ayomayāstathā nāryo narāścāgnisamaprabhāḥ | samāśliṣyanti saṅgatya dravamāṇāstatastataḥ ||5|| vṛkṣāśca bahavastatra supuṣyāḥ phalapatriṇaḥ | tānāśrayanti duḥkhārttā agniṃ varṣanti tepi ca ||6| | śilāśca bahvyastatrānyāstāḥ śliṣyanti yadā ca te | tadā tāścāgnivarṇābhā dahante tānbhṛśaṃ narān ||7|| evameṣa mahāpadmo narakaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ | suvarṇahārī yaścaiva mātṛyāyī ca yo naraḥ ||8|| mātā putraṃ ca yobhyeti vedadūṣyavakīrṇikaḥ | matsarī yaśca durvṛttaḥ śramaṇānāñca pūjakaḥ ||9|| vṛṣalo yaḥ śrutiṃ brūyācchṛṇuyādapi vā punaḥ | gṛhaṇīyādvāpi durbuddhirbrāhmaṇān vāvamanyate || 8.45.10 || brāhmaṇebhyo rahasyāni āśramāntarajāni ca | yasminnadhikṛto na syācchṛṇuyādvā paṭheta vā | | 11 || duṣṭaśramaṇanirgranthā tathaivājīvakāśca ye | bhaktastebhyo dvijo yaśca narakaṃ sa prapadyate | |1 2|| yogaṃ parivadedyaśca pitṝnatha pitāmahān | yogeśvarām̐śca durvṛtto yogadharmamathāpi vā || 13 || vedavarṇāśramā yajñā stannindābhirataḥ śaṭhaḥ | nāstiko hetuvādī ca sarvastaṃ pratipadyate | tathyamuktaṃ mayā sarvamevametanna saṃśayaḥ | | 14|| evante yātitāstatra svakarmaphalabandhanāḥ | tataḥ śeṣeṇa saṃbaddhā jāyante kīṭayoniṣu || 1 5|| śṛṇuyād ya imaṃ vicintya dhīmān matimānnityamalobhamohaśokaḥ | sa tu daivavidhipracoditātmā divamevaiti na yāti taṃ kadācid ||1 6|| iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane mahāpadmo nāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.46> ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rauravaṃ narakaṃ punaḥ | yatra te vivaśā baddhāḥ karmaṇā svena jantavaḥ||1 || yātyante duḥkhaśokārtā mahānirayagāminaḥ | ru iti procyate śabdastatrāsau śrūyate yataḥ ||2| | punaḥ punarvā bhīmo hi rauravastena kathyate | pūrṇastu sarvaḥ kārīṣyāj jjvalate sotidāruṇaḥ ||3 || madhye stambhosya lauho vai taptakāñcanasaprabhaḥ | tatra jaṃtuḥrbhṛśaṃ magnaḥ praviśan dahyatevaśaḥ ||4|| ārtanādān prakurvāṇo mūrcchitaḥ patitaḥ punaḥ | tataḥ kleśene mahatā uddhṛtyātmānamātmanā ||5|| bhūyonyaṃ deśamāsādya tathaiva praviśecca saḥ | tatastasmādupotpatya stambhamāśrayate yadi ||6| | tenāpi dahyate bhūyo visṛjya praviśetpunaḥ | evaṃ sa yātyate tatra bahūnabdān suduḥkhitaḥ ||7|| tato visṛṣṭo bhūyaśca ucchrayānpratipadyate | taṃ hi gacchanti puruṣāḥ surāpā dharmadeśakāḥ | |8|| pitṛhā mātṛhā caiva bhrātṛhā guruhā tathā | ...vādebhiratāsteṣāmeva ca nindakāḥ | | 9| | goghnotha damakaścaiva jantūnāṃ bhṛśadāruṇaḥ | galakartā kūṭamānī karmaṇānu karoti yaḥ | | 8.46.10 || parivittiḥ parivettā śmaśānaratireva ca | punarbhūsutasaṃyogī yasyā copapatirgṛhe| ete sarvebhigacchanti narakaṃ rauravaṃ narāḥ | | 11 || ya imaṃ śṛṇuyācca rauravaṃ narakaṃ pāpakṛtāṃ surauravam | niyataṃ prayatotirauravaṃ na sa gacchenmanasāpi rauravam | | 12 iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane rauravaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.47> suśarmovāca mahārauravamanyacca śṛṇu me duṣṭayātanam | yatra dhārāśca toyaṃ ca taḍāgāni ca putraka ||1 | | kārīṣī kanakābhāśca kulyāścāgniprapūritāḥ | āyasā bahavaḥ stambhā vṛkṣāśca bahukaṇṭakāḥ | |2 | | rākṣasā vividhākārāstīkṣṇaśastrāstradhāriṇaḥ | tatra pāpena bahunā jantuḥ samabhipāśitaḥ | |3 || nipatedvikṛtākāraḥ krandamāno muhurmuhuḥ | sa tatra patitaḥ kṣipraṃ rākṣasairbhinnamastakaḥ ||4|| kārīṣyāmagnivarṇāyāṃ pacyate bhṛśadāruṇam | tatassa tena dāhena duḥkhitaḥ paramārtimān ||5| | dāhapraśamanārthāya taḍāge vinimajjati | tatra kṣāreṇa taptena dviguṇaṃ vedanārditaḥ | |6 || vegenotthāya vṛkṣaṃ vā stambhaṃ vāpyadhirohati | tatra taiḥ kaṇṭakaistīkṣṇairāyasaiścāvatakṣitaḥ | |7|| patate hyagnikulyāyāṃ karuṇaṃ bahudhā nadan | evaṃ sa yātyamānastu tṛṣārtto vilapan bahu | |8| | dhārāmāśrayate pātuṃ sāpi tasyāyasaṃ tadā | agnivarṇaṃ vahatyambhastato mūrcchārdito mriyet | 9|| saṃpūrṇayātanaścāpi muktastasmānmahābhayāt ucchrayeṣu tadā janturyātyate bhṛśadāruṇam || 8.47.10 || tatra gacchati rājaghno rājabhāryāvamānakaḥ | āśāṃ dattvā na dadyādyo yaśca tīrthāvadūṣakaḥ | 11 || moṣakaḥ sūcakaścaiva strībhṛto yaśca pāpakṛt | agnau gavi ca yo dānaṃ brāhmaṇe cāpi vārayet| |1 2|| vikrīṇīyāta svabhāryāṃ yo hyapatyaṃ vā narādhamaḥ | harate cāgnibhāṇḍāni yogināṃ caiva kiñcana ||13 || corān vā yonugṛhṇāti manuṣyāstasya ye ca ha | brāhmaṇādhikṛtaścaiva dharmādhikṛta eva ca | |14|| kapilā yasya gauḥ syācca anagnerbrāhmaṇasya ha | mithyāgnihotrī yaścaiva naityake pariveṣakaḥ | |1 5| | rājaputravadhaṃ caiva dubhikṣaṃ yacca cintayet | rāṣṭralopaṃ dāralopaṃ dhanalopaṃ ca yo naraḥ ||1 6 | | deśavidra (ā) vaṇaṃ caiva yaḥ kuryyāḍḍāmarāṇi vā | sarve te narakaṃ yānti mahārauravasaṃjñakam ||17|| ya imaṃ śṛṇuyādabhīkṣṇaśo niyataṃ dharmamatiśca tiṣṭhati | na sa gacchati taṃ bhayāvahaṃ narakaṃ rauravamugrarauravam | | 18 | iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane mahārauravaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.48> suśarmovāca tamo nāmāparo ghoro narakoti bhayaṃkaraḥ | tatra sobhipatannaiva rākṣasairabhihanyate ||1 || asimudgaraśaṃkvagrai rgadāmuśalapaṭṭiśaiḥ | bhayadaiḥ parighaiṣṭaṅkairvajrairṛṣṭiparaśvadhaiḥ | |2|| anyaiśca vividhākārairhataḥ kruddhaiḥ sunirdayaiḥ| mūrchitastamasā grasto narakaṃ taṃ prapadyate | |3 || sa dehena vinaṣṭena tamasā mūcchitākṛtiḥ | duḥkhasantatisaṃnaddho yātanāmaśnute bhṛśam | |4| | yasmāt sa tamasā grasta anāśvastotidāruṇām | yātanāmaśnute jantustamastasmāt sa ucyate ||5| | sarvā bahuvidhākārā yātanā yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | tāstatra samavāpnoti svena pāpena durmatiḥ || 6 || samāptayātanaścāpi santīrṇṇasvena karmaṇā | ucchrayeṣu punarjanturyātyate karmabandhanaḥ | |7|| brahmahā bhrūṇahā caiva surāpo brāhmaṇaśca yaḥ | gavāṃ nipāne yaścaiva pipāsūnāṃ narādhamaḥ ||8| | vighnaṃ karoti mohāndha āhūya bhartsayettu yaḥ | brāhmaṇān dveṣṭi nityaṃ ya arthinaṃ yaśca dūṣayet ||9| | śāstrāṇi harate yaśca goghno yaśca naraḥ smṛtaḥ | kāpilaśca vṛthādṛṣṭirvedadharmārthadūṣakaḥ || 8.48.10 | | brāhmaṇākrośakaścaiva vedadharmārthadūṣakaḥ | nāstikāśca durātmāna ityete taṃ prayānti vai | | 11 | | ya imaṃ śṛṇuyāttamomayaṃ tamasā nityamatandritendriya| na sa yāti tamomayaṃ sadā narakaṃ dāruṇajantuśokadam || 12 || iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane tamonāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.49> suśarmovāca tamastamataraṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ śṛṇvataḥ param | prakāśo yatra naivāsti naiva dṛṣṭiḥ pravartate ||1 | | patanneva narastatra visaṃjñaḥ kriyate tadā | rākṣasairvikṛtākāraistamastena sa cocyate | |2| | tatrāsau patito mūḍho vahninā dahyate bhṛśam | tatopi vegādutthāya dṛṣṭihīno vicetanaḥ ||3 || chidyate bhidyate caiva rākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ | tasmādapi tathaivārttaḥ sonyaṃ deśaṃ prapadyate ||4| | tatrāpi nigṛhītastaiḥ paśumāreṇa māryate | tato bhūyaśca kūpeṣu kṣipto durgeṣvacetanaḥ | |5|| nimagnaścāgnikārīṣyāṃ niṣkūjan sobhijāyate | evaṃ sa yātanā bahvīstvanubhūya suduḥkhitaḥ ||6|| narakāntamanuprāpya ucchrayeṣvabhipātyate | garbhapātanakāraśca rājyakāmaśca yo bhavet ||7|| ihaivānarhamānosau (?) bhṛtyo rājavadhe rataḥ | anācāryaśca yaḥ karma ācāryāṇāṃ prapadyate | |8|| śāstravidyauṣadhīnāṃ ca gadānāmagadaiḥ saha | yo vināśayitā kaścidyaḥ praśaṃsati dānavān ||9| | upadeśaṃ ca yo dveṣādācāryo na prayacchati | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ dustaraṃ taṃ tamomayam | |8.49.1 0 | | kṛtaghnaṃ tu samādāya nārakāḥ sarva eva te | yamaṃ praṇamya bruvate saha tairyamakiṅkaraiḥ | | 11 | | bhagavanna vayaṃ śaktāḥ pāpasyāsya vināśane| upāyamanyaṃ paśyeha prasādaṃ kuru naḥ prabho | | 12 || sa evamukto bhagavān yamaḥ pretādhipastadā | sarvadharmārthakuśalān pṛcchati smarṣisattamān | | 13 || bhagavantaḥ kathaṃ tvasya kṛtaghnasya durātmanaḥ | niṣkṛtiḥ sumahāghorād bhavet pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || 14| | tataste ṛṣayassarve dṛṣṭvā dīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā | yamaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ vai bruvate vacaḥ ||1 5|| brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā | niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ | | 16 || tataḥ sa bhagavāndevo mārtaṇḍatanayo varaḥ | nārakebhyo dadātyājñāṃ sarve yūyamimaṃ naram | | 17|| śodhayiṣyatha gacchadhvaṃ naikā hyasya gatiḥ smṛtā | tataste tasya vacanānnārakāḥ pāpakarmiṇam || 18| | sarveṣvevānupūrvyeṇa yātayantyatidāruṇāḥ | bhartṛpiṇḍāpahartā ca pitṛpiṇḍāpahārakaḥ | |1 9| | | tasmād gṛhītvā vidyāñca dakṣiṇāṃ yo na yacchati ||8.49.20 | | puṣṭaśca yastaṃ nānveti yaśca taṃ ghātayennaraḥ | kṛtasya doṣaṃ vadati sakāmaṃ na karoti ca | |2 1 | | na smarecca kṛtaṃ yastu āśramān yaśca dūṣayet | na puṣṇāti tathā vāhānāśritām̐ścopakāriṇaḥ ||22| | bhṛtyāṃśca karmaniratām̐stathaiva hitakāriṇaḥ | bhāryāṃ karmakarāṇāṃ ca narmāṇi vadate ca yaḥ ||23 || na dattaṃ na hutaṃ kiñcidamuṣminniti yo vadet | sarvām̐stānṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtaghnānabravīnmanuḥ ||24|| kṛtaghnaśca śaṭhaścaiva nāstikochinnasaṃśayaḥ | etān sarvebhigacchanti ya ete kīrtitā mayā ||25| | janetā copanetā ca yaśca vidyāṃ prayacchati | bhayatrātānnadātā ca paṃcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ | |2 6 | | yasteṣāndoṣavaktā ca abhyasūyaka eva ca | tathā drohapravṛttaśca santyajettānnarādhamān ||27|| mitradhrug yaśca duṣṭātmā tasya randhrāvakīrtanaḥ | kṛtopakāriṇe pūrvam̐ na karoti priyaṃ ca yaḥ | |28 || ete sarve narā duṣṭāḥ sarva evāśubhe ratāḥ | narakān saṃprapadyante baddhāḥ pāpena karmaṇā | |29| | ete sarve mayā proktā mahānirayagāminaḥ | ucchrayāneva gacchanti yenye pāpakṛto janāḥ ||8.49.3 0 || ya imaṃ tāmasaṃ ghoraṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭheta vā | adharmaśca nivarteta sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||3 1 || iti skandapurāṇe narakavarṇane tamotitamaṃ nāma ūnapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.50> ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃsāraparivartanam | yathā vai narakāttīrṇāḥ saṃsaranti samāsataḥ | | 1 || prathame narake proktā ye mayā pāpakarmiṇaḥ | śeṣeṇa karmaṇā te tu jāyante kṛmiyoniṣu | |2|| kṛmiyonau parāvṛttāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ samāḥ | tataḥ punarmarkaṭāste jāyantetha tarakṣavaḥ | |3 || tatra tāvat parāvṛttā jāyante goṣu te yadā | tadā tatra śatenaiva janmanāṃ śeṣatastataḥ | |4| | mānuṣeṣūpajāyante tāvadeva na saṃśayaḥ | tatra te kurvate bhūyo yadi kiṃcinna kilbiṣam ||5| | tato viśuddhāṃ jātiṃ te labhante punareva tu | na ca bhūyopi te ghoraṃ saṃsāraṃ prāpnuvanti vai ||6| | dvitīye ye mayā proktāste muktāḥ śeṣakarmaṇā | kṛmikīṭeṣu jāyante sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ṣaṭ ||7|| tathā śatasahasraṃ ca śatānāṃ te punargatāḥ | matsyayonau prasūyante tāvadeva na saṃśayaḥ ||8|| tato vyāghrāśca ṛkṣāśca tato gotvamavāpyate | mānuṣeṣūpapadyante kutsitāḥ svena karmaṇā | |9| | tṛtīye tvatha ye proktā mayā duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ | te muktāḥ karmaṇastasmāccheṣeṇa samaveṣṭitāḥ ||8.50.10 || kṛmikīṭeṣu jāyante sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ṣaṭ | tathaiva daśa cānyāni pakṣiṇastāvadeva ca ||1 1 || tataḥ siṃhāśca sarpāśca gāvaḥ paścācca mānuṣāḥ | caturthe tvatha ye proktā mayā duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ | |12|| te sarve śeṣavantastu jāyante kṛmiyoniṣu | sahasrāṇāṃ śatānyaṣṭau tathā cānyāni ṣoḍaśa || 13 || yonīnāṃ hi tathā bhūyo jāyante te tato mṛgāḥ | mṛgabhāvādvinirmuktā jāyante ca punaḥ kharāḥ ||14|| tatojā gavayāścāpi gāvo mānuṣatāṃ tataḥ | paṃcame ye mayā proktāstepi śeṣeṇa karmaṇā ||1 5|| kṛmikīṭeṣu jāyante janmanāṃ koṭimeva hi | hastiyonau ca tāvaddhi uṣṭreṣvaśveṣu caiva hi | |16|| tato gotvaṃ samāsādya mānuṣyaṃ prāpnuvanti te | ṣaṣṭhāccaiva vinirmuktāstataḥ śeṣeṇa karmaṇā | |17| | jāyante kṛmikīṭeṣu janmanāṃ dviguṇena hi | koṭimekāṃ tato yūkā tato matsyotha sūkaraḥ ||18 || mahiṣatvaṃ tataḥ prāpya gotvājjāyeta mānuṣaḥ | mānuṣatve kutsitaśca vyādhitaścaiva jāyate | |1 9|| saptamācca vinirmuktaḥ kṛmikīṭeṣu jāyate | koṭītrayaṃ tāvadeva vṛkṣatvamadhigacchati ||8.50.2 0 | | tato latā tato gulmastato hastī prajāyate | gotvaṃ ca samanuprāpya jāyate mānuṣastataḥ ||2 1 | | aṣṭamācca vinirmukto baddhaḥ śeṣeṇa karmaṇā | jāyate kṛmikīṭeṣu dve koṭyau dviguṇe ca saḥ | |22|| tataścoṣadhibhāvena vīrutsu ca kuśeṣu ca | tato gotvādvinirmukto jāyate kutsito naraḥ | |23 || navamādapi cottīrṇo baddhaḥ śeṣeṇa karmaṇā | jāyate kṛmikīṭeṣu pañcakoṭīstataḥ khagaḥ | |24|| tato matsyaśca tāvadvai tāvadeva sarīsṛpaḥ | śvā tatastāvadevātha tato bhavati kinnaraḥ || 25| | kinnaratvādvinirmuktastato goṣūpajāyate | tato goyoninirmukto mānuṣeṣūpajāyate ||26| | daśamādapi cottīrṇaḥ ṣaṭ koṭīrjanmanāṃ kṛmiḥ | śeṣeṇa karmaṇā jātastato bhavati vānaraḥ | | 27|| vānarastāvadeveha tāvadeva ca kukkuṭaḥ | tāvadeva ca kākastu jīvaṃjīvaka eva ca | | 28|| vṛkṣadārakamārjārapipilīkāśca jāyate | tato goṣu prajātosau mānuṣeṣūpajāyate | |29| | mahārauravanirmuktaḥ saptakoṭīḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | janmanāṃ kṛmikīṭeṣu jāto matsyatvamaśnute | |8.50.3 0 | | tataḥ śvā gardabhaścaiva bhaināśī (?) śuka eva ca | tato bhavati gauścāpi tataḥ ṣaṇḍhaśca mānuṣe ||3 1 | | tamonarakanirmuktastvaṣṣṭakoṭīḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | janmanāṃ prāpnute janturviṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmiyoniṣu | |3 2 | | tataḥ śvā jāyate bhūyaścakrāhvaśca punaḥ punaḥ | tato maṇḍūkatāṃ prāpya jāyate mṛgapakṣiṣu | |3 3 | | jāyate kinnaraścāpi dvīpī śarabha eva ca | tato gotvaṃ samāsādya mānuṣatvamavāpnute | |34| | tamonarakanirmuktaḥ śeṣeṇaiva hi karmaṇā | jāyate kṛmikīṭeṣu navakoṭiḥ sa janmanām ||3 5|| tato bhavati kākaśca bhāsaścaiva tataḥ param | vāntāśī ca tataḥ pakṣī ulūkaśca tataḥ punaḥ ||3 6| | punarvṛkṣaśca gulmaśca tato bhavati vai mṛgaḥ | tato gaurmanujaścāpi garbhasthaḥ sa vipadyate | |37|| punaḥpunarjāyamānaḥ sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ samāḥ | vyādhitaḥ kutsitaścaiva jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ || 38| | yastu sarvānimān prāpya narakāniha jāyate | sa yoniṣu samastāsu sarvasaṃsāramaśnute ||39| | yadi mānuṣatāṃ yāti kadācit kālaparyayāt | tatrāpi kutsitāṃ yoniṃ bhūyo bhūyaḥ prapadyate | |8.50.40 | | aniṣṭaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ duḥkhito vyādhitastathā | vikṛtaṃ rūpamāpnoti karmaṇā svena dūṣitaḥ ||41 || devabrāhmaṇavidveṣṭā sarvavratabahiṣkṛtaḥ | sarvadharmavinirmuktaḥ sādhvācāravivarjitaḥ | |42| | nirnamaskāraduśśīlaḥ kimbhakṣo brahmanindakaḥ | na tīrthadevāyatanaḥ svadhāsvastivivarjitaḥ | akīrtanīyo lokānāṃ jāyate svena karmaṇā ||43 | | suśarmovāca etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ samāsāt putra sarvaśaḥ | narakāṇāṃ satattvaṃ ca kramabhedo yathāmati ||44| | sanatkumāra uvāca ya imaṃ śṛṇuyād yuktaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu | śrāvayedvā dvijān samyak sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||45|| dhanyaṃ yaśa syamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ sarvārthasādhakam | śravyaṃ ca paṭhitavyaṃ ca satataṃ bhūtimicchatā ||46|| idaṃ tu sarvārthasukhāvahaṃ dhruvaṃ mahānubhāvaṃ sugatipradaṃ śubham | sadaiva vipreṇa samāhitātmanā adhītya dhāryaṃ śrutisammitaṃ dhruvam ||47|| iti skandapurāṇe saṃsāragativarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.51> sanatkumāra uvāca sukeśastu tato vyāsa pituḥ śrutvā sudīnavat | duḥkhita ścintayāmāsa jantunā tāṃ gatiṃ tadā || 1 | | cintayābhiparītātmā duḥkhena ca samāhataḥ | jantūnāṃ mokṣaṇopāyaṃ mūḍhacetā na jajñivān | | 2| | cintāpannaḥ sa tu yadā pitṝm̐ stānnābhyabhāṣata | tadā te pitaraḥ sarve sukeśamidamūcire | |3 || pitara ūcuḥ atīva kiṃ cintayasi kutaścintā tavānagha | īśvarasya sataḥ putra nedaṃ tava vidhīyate ||4| | sukeśa uvāca jantūnāṃ karmajaṃ kleśaṃ śrutvā yuṣmābhirīritam | cintayāmi kathaṃ teṣāṃ mokṣopāyo bhavediti ||5| | pitara ūcuḥ anādṛtya kṣayaṃ putra mokṣasteṣāṃ na vidyate | karmaṇaḥ svakṛtasyeha sa ca bhogāt kṣayo mataḥ ||6|| bhogaśca narakevaśyaṃ jantunā saṃ vidhīyate | na ca te nārakāḥ śakyā harttuṃ karmakṣayaṃ vinā ||7| | aśakyāḥ khalu ye hyarthā na tān prājñassamārabhet | arṇavasya prataraṇaṃ yathā tvāṃ mṛtyumṛcchati ||8|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktaḥ sa tejasvī pitṝm̐ stān hṝcchayāvṛtaḥ | uvāca praṇato bhūtvā māvamadhvaṃ sutaṃ hi mām | |9|| kā śaktirmama tān jantūn balāt tārayituṃ śubhān | mahādevaprasādastān tārayiṣyati durgatīn | |8.51.1 0 || yūyaṃ yathaiva tīrṇāḥ stha narakasthā vicetasaḥ | tathā te jantavassarve tariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | | 11 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastān sa tadāmantrya mahātmā gaṇanāyakaḥ | saṃpraviśya samudrāmbho hyantarjalagatastadā || 12 | | jajāpa rudrān śuddhātmā niścalaḥ susamāhitaḥ | japatastasya yogena yuktasya ca mahātmanaḥ ||1 3 | | trailokyamakhilaṃ vyāsa tapasābhūt pratāpitam | tato devāstadā sarve pitāmahamathābruvan || 14|| kimidaṃ bhagavan sarve tapyāma vivaśā vayam | kasyedaṃ tapaso vīryaṃ kasya yogoyamīdṛśaḥ || 15 || ka eṣa suraśārdūla tapastapyati dāruṇam | yāvadevaṃ na dahati yāvannaiva na kupyate || 1 6|| tāvat sarvānabhiprāyān tasya saṃpādaya prabho | sa evamukto devaistairbhagavān devasattamaḥ | |17| | uvāca mā bhayaṃ vostu nāyaṃ kaścidasaṃmataḥ | sa eṣa devadevasya mahātmā gaṇanāyakaḥ | | 18|| samudrāntarjalāsīno rudrān japati yogavān | na cāsya duṣṭobhiprāyo lokānprati mahābalāḥ | |1 9 || nārakāneva narakāduddhartumabhimanyate | tad yūyaṃ yadi manyadhve gatvā rudraṃ praṇamya ca ||8.51.20|| arthayāmosya devasya kriyatāmīpsito varaḥ | evamastviti te sarve brahmaṇā saha saṃgatāḥ ||21 || gatā mandaramavyagrā nandinā saṃpraveśitāḥ | te dṛṣṭavā devamīśānaṃ stutvedamabruvan vibhum ||22|| sukeśo bhagavan tubhyaṃ vallabho gaṇanāyakaḥ | kāruṇyaṃ prāṇināṃ kṛtvā tapastapyati duścaram | |23 || tasya kāmaṃ sakāmaṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva bhuvaneśvara | teṣāṃ vijñaptimākarṇya devadevastato bhavaḥ ||24|| brahmādyaiḥ sahitobhyāgāt sukeśasya tadāntikam | samudrastatra ye cānye munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||25|| ardhyamādāya śataśo nemuḥ śaṅkaramāgatam | tamasau gaṇapaśreṣṭhaṃ devadeva idaṃ vacaḥ | |26|| provāca madhuraṃ vyāsa manaḥśrotrasukhāvaham | vatsottiṣṭha sukeśa tvaṃ prārthayasva yathepsitam ||27|| sarvaṃ tat saṃpradāsyāmi tvaṃ hi nandisamo mama | tataḥ sukeśa utthāya stutvā ca vṛṣabhadhvajam ||28|| praṇipatya punarvavre kāmaṃ pūrvasamīhitam | narakeṣu narā deva yātyante pāpakāriṇaḥ ||29|| teṣāmupari ceto me duḥkhenārditamīśvara | te yathā pratimucyante sarva eva jagatprabhoḥ | |8.51.3 0 || tathā kuru mamādyaiva vara eṣa mayārthitaḥ | ye cādhunā narā deva yātyante narakeṣu vai ||3 1 || teṣāntu pratimokṣārthaṃ yācehaṃ tvāṃ sureśvara | tatastadarthitaṃ devaḥ prayacchannidamabravīt ||32|| evaṃ bhavatu te vatsa muktā nārakiṇo narāḥ | anayāpi ca bhaktyā tvaṃ kāruṇyena ca vallabhaḥ | |3 3 || sutarāṃ bhava nirvyagraḥ paramaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ | tataste nārakāḥ sarve vimānāni samāśritāḥ ||34|| devadevaṃ tatobhyetya sukeśañca praṇemire | tamuvāca punardevaḥ sukeśaṃ gaṇanāyakam || 35| | yo hi tārayate jantūnāpadaḥ kām̐ścideva tu | teṣāṃ dharmapitā bhūtvā saṃsāraṃ na sa paśyati ||3 6| | manasāpi hi yaḥ prāṇī kleśājjantūnsadecchati | vimoktuṃ sopi dharmātmā sarvaduḥkhaiḥ pramucyate ||37| | yaścopārjya svayaṃ dharmaṃ jantubhyaḥ saṃprayacchati | sukhārthaṃ sopi sarvebhyo duḥkhebhyaḥ saṃpramucyate ||38| | sa tvaṃ pareṇa yogena aiśvaryeṇa ca saṃyutaḥ | jantūnāṃ tāraṇe yuktastvayānyaḥ kaḥ samo bhuvi ||39| | sukeśa uvāca bhagavan tvatprasādānme sarvametad bhaviṣyati | śaktirmama kuto deva tvayaivaitat kṛtaṃ vibho ||8.51.40 || da(na?) cānyadasti karttavyaṃ kṛtyaṃ yanme manogatam | tavāsmi kiṅkaro dāso nāścaryaṃ yanmamedṛśam | |41 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devo visṛjya gaṇanāyakam | abhyagāt mandaraṃ vyāsa vṛtaḥ sarvāmaraistadā ||42 || devā api vimānasthān nārakān vīkṣya sarvaśaḥ | śāntaṃ ca jagato duḥkhaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagmuryathāgatam ||43 || ya imaṃ nārakottāraṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭheta vā | sa duḥkhaṃ samanuprāpya nāvasīdati karhicit | |44| | etadyogavidhānasarvasamayaṃ śrutvā naro nityaśaḥ pāpātmāpi sunirghṛṇaṃ pratibhayaṃ nābhyeti pāpāśrayam | kintvetad ya ihābhyupetya satataṃ śaucānvitaḥ śrāvayet devabrahmaṇavaidyasaṃsadi dṛḍhaṃ bhaktaḥ sadā śaṅkaram ||45| | iti skandapurāṇe nārakīyamokṣaṇe ekapaṃcāśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.52> vyāsa uvāca ke punastaṃ na gacchanti narakaṃ śubhakarmiṇaḥ | pāpeṣvapi ratā brahmannetadicchāmi veditum | | 1 || tathā strīṇāṃ ca kā yuktā gatiḥ paramikā śubhā | kena karmavipākena etadicchāmi veditum | |2| | sanatkumāra uvāca na gacchanti narā yena narakaṃ taṃ suduḥkhitāḥ | pāpakarmaṇyapi ratāstānimān śṛṇu mānada | |3|| nāgnicinnarakaṃ yāti na trisūtrī na govratī | nāśvamedhena yo yaṣṭā go sahasraprado na ca | |4| | na ca svādhyāyanityo yo rudrajāpī ca yo dvijaḥ | brāhmaṇān tārayedyaśca āpado maraṇāntikāt | |5 | | brāhmaṇaṃ vyādhitaṃ dīnamanāthaṃ duḥkhapīḍitam | śuśrūṣedyāvadetena yukto dharmeṇa mānavaḥ ||6 | | brāhmaṇaṃ vāsayedyastu gṛhavāsaparicchadaiḥ | niḥsvaṃ svādhyāyasaṃpannaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati ||7|| tathā gāñcaiva saṃmagnāṃ patitāṃ śaktivarjitām | saṃrakṣati ca yuktātmā sa ca taṃ naiva gacchati | |8| | maheśaṃ yaśca bhāvena parameṇa samādhinā | bhaktyā samarcayennityaṃ sa ca taṃ naiva gacchati | |9|| itareṣāṃ tu saṃsāro bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | brāhmaṇāstaṃ na gacchanti vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ | | 8.52.10 | | ṣaṭkarmaniratā vyāsa ātmadharmavyavasthitāḥ | tapaḥśaucasamāyuktā dayāvanto dṛḍhavratāḥ | |1 1 || pratigrahanivṛttāśca īśabhaktāśca ye dvijāḥ | kṣatriyā ye ca rakṣārthaṃ prajānāṃ nityamudyatāḥ || 1 2| | tyajanti samare prāṇān na te narakagāminaḥ | vaiśyā vārtāsamāyuktā nyāyadharmavyavasthitāḥ | | 13 || yeṣāṃ vṛttiravicchinnā devabrāhmaṇapūjakāḥ | narakaṃ te na paśyanti svargagāste prakīrtitāḥ | | 14|| bhaktā varṇatrayaṃ ye ca śūdrā darpavivarjitāḥ | brāhmaṇāṃśca viśeṣeṇa nityaṃ ye samupāsate ||1 5| | te na paśyanti narakaṃ sugatiñca mṛtā yayuḥ | caturṣvapi ca varṇeṣu manujā bhāvataḥ śivam | |1 6|| śarvārpitakriyāvasthā bhaktā nityamanuvratāḥ | na te prayānti narakaṃ prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim || 17|| prāsādaṃ caiva ye kṛtvā devadevamupāsate | anyānapi pitṝm̐ste tu narakāduddharantyuta ||18|| khanitāḥ puṣkariṇyo yaistaḍāgāni hradāni ca | ropitā vṛkṣaṣaṇḍāśca tepi tān na prayānti hi | | 19|| paritrāṇaṃ dvijātīnāmanyeṣāṃ caiva duḥkhinām | nityaṃ prakurvate ye ca tepi tān na vrajanti hi ||8.52.20 | | akrodhanāśca ye nityaṃ devabrāhmaṇapūjakāḥ | nityaṃ dānaratāścaiva na te gacchantyadhogatim ||21 || satyābhidhānasaṃyuktā duṣṭārambhavivarjitāḥ| svadharmācārasaṃyuktāḥ paśyanti narakaṃ na te ||22|| liṅgārcanaratastasmāt sarvasmāt parimucyate | dhyānī ta sarvadā yo vai gaṇāñjapati vā śuciḥ | |23 | | yogī tu sarsa(rva?)pāpāni kurvannapi na lipyate | strīṇāṃ tu paramo devaḥ patirbhavati sarvadā ||24| | tasmānnānyaṃ prapaśyanti yāḥ kāściddharmacintikāḥ | karmaṇā manasā vācā yad dadāti juhoti vā || 25| | parityajya patiṃ nārī na tasya phalamaśnute | patiśuśrūṣaṇe raktā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ||26 | patau mṛtepi manasā nānyamicchati yā naram | karoti puṇyaṃ yaccāpi patyuḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati | sā nārī narakān sarvān manasāpi na gacchati | |27|| saṃsāraṃ naiva sā ghoraṃ sarvaṃ saṃpratipadyate | anyāsāṃ tu na saṃdeho narakaṃ prati suvrata ||28|| sanatkumāra uvāca sukeśaṃ tvanugṛhyaivaṃ devopi vṛṣavāhanaḥ | ........kāṣṭhakūṭāśramaṃ gataḥ | anujagrāha taṃ vipraṃ kāṣṭhakūṭaṃ tapodhanam ||29|| vyāsa uvāca kiṃ tapastasya bhagavan brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ | kiyatā caiva kālena varaṃ lebhe maheśvarāt ||8.52.3 0 || kasya putraḥ kasya naptā kinnāmā sa ca sattamaḥ | etadicchāmi kathitaṃ bhagavan vistarācchubham ||3 1|| sanatkumāra uvāca gautamasyānvaye vipro nāmnā kṛṣṇa iti prabhuḥ | tasya putrobhavat khyāto bhūmanyuriti nāmataḥ ||3 2 | | tasya patnyabhavat subhrū rātreyī nāmato yaśāḥ | sa kadācit kṛtodvāho bhūmanyurnnāma gautamaḥ | |3 3 || nāvindata sutaṃ tasyāṃ jarayā cābhisaṃvṛtaḥ | sa bhāryāmāha duḥkhārta idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ ||34| | putreṇecchanti lokāṃśca anṛṇāśca bhavantyuta | jarāṃ parigata ścāhaṃ na ca me dṛśyate sutaḥ || 3 5|| sā tvaṃ kañcit sagotraṃ me anujñātā mayā śubhe | abhipadyasva putrārthaṃ yāce tvāṃ prāñjalirnnataḥ ||36 | suyaśovāca na mayā śrutametatte tathā noktaṃ tvayānagha | mādṛśī kathametaddhi manasāpyabhicintayet ||37|| atrīṇāntu kule jātā gautamaṃ kulamāgatā | madvidhā kathametaddhi kuryāt sadbhirvigarhitam ||38|| tapasā dhanamanvicchejjīvitāni sukhāni ca | putrān kulañca lokāṃśca tapaḥ kuru mahāmune ||3 9|| tapasā hi suto labdhaḥ śaktinā sa parāśaraḥ | aurvaśca tapasā svena cyavanena mahāmuniḥ ||8.52.40 || vasiṣṭhena kapiñjalyāmindrapramatireva ca | śilādojanayaccaiva tapasā nandinaṃ sutam ||41 | | tathā bhavānapi tapaḥ karotu susamādhinā | lapsyase tvaṃ sutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahāyogabalānvitam ||42|| māṃ hi dṛṣṭvā purā prāha atrirbrahmasutaḥ svayam | satputriṇī bhavitrīyaṃ na mithyā tad bhaviṣyati | |43 || taposti mayi yatkiñcit tvatprasādāt samarjitam | tena svena ca saṃyukto rudramārādhaya prabho | |44|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktassa tejasvī hriyā paramayā yutaḥ | tayaivaṃ samanujñāto rudraṃ śaraṇamīyivān ||45|| tvaritaṃ sa ca samāgamya narmadāṃ harṣasaṃyutaḥ | tasyāstīre samudviśya tasthau vāyvāśanaḥ samāḥ ||46|| sa tu naivābhavadvipraḥ kṛtārthastena karmaṇā | tatassa duḥkhito bhūyaḥ prāṇāyāmena tasthivān ||47|| varṣamekaṃ tato devastamuvāca tadā vibhuḥ | kimevaṃ kliśyase vipra na tavāsti sutaḥ kvacit ||48|| vyarthasteyaṃ śca(śra?)mastāvannāsti putrastavānagha | sa evamukto nirviṇṇo nirāśaḥ putrajanmani | |49|| cintayāmāsa maraṇaṃ na gantuṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ prati sa kāṣṭhakūṭaṃ saṃbhṛtya gṛhītvāgniṃ suduḥkhitaḥ ||8.52.50 || vilapya bahuduḥkhārtta ātmānaṃ dagdhumaicchata | tasya rudra stamālakṣya vyavasāyaṃ suduṣkaram ||51 || putra putreti gambhīramadṛśya idamabravīt | putraste bhavitā gaccha mā caivaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛthāḥ ||52|| kāṣṭhakūṭeti nāmnā ca bhaviṣyati sa te sutaḥ | atha hṛṣṭamanā vipro gatvā patnyāṃ mahātapāḥ ||53|| utpādayāmāsa sutaṃ kāṣṭhakūṭaṃ mahāmunim | saṃskṛtasya tu kālena tasya buddhirabhūt tataḥ ||54|| aśaktoyaṃ vṛddhabhāvānmāmadhyāpayituṃ pitā | tasmād yāsyāmi cāmatrya pitaraṃ vedakāraṇāt ||55|| sa gatvā mātaraṃ vipraḥ pitarañca mahāyaśāḥ | praṇamya śirasā samyagidaṃ vacanamabravīt | |56| | suto yuvābhyāṃ jātohaṃ dharmahetorna kāmataḥ | āvāṃ tārayitā cāyaṃ tathaiva ca pitāmahān | |57| | santatatiścāpyavicchinnā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | iṣṭām̐śca lokān prāpsyāva suputreṇeti sarvathā ||58|| pitṝṇāñcānṛṇo syāva ityabhīṣṭosmi vāṃ sutaḥ | sohaṃ dharmeṣvakuśalaḥ śrutismṛtibahiṣkṛtaḥ | |59|| karttājñānena tatkarma pitaro yena duḥkhitāḥ | bhavāṃśca niraye magna ściraṃ vatsyati duṣṭavat ||8.52.60 | | bhavānnādhyāpane śaktaḥ sthaviratvād dine dine | putrasnehācca kāryācca na samyag dhārayiṣyāsi ||6 1 || iyaṃ ca jananī nityamekaputroyamityuta| tvayā samyak praśāsyantaṃ naiva māmanumaṃsyate | |62|| sohamanyaṃ tapo nityaṃ niranukrośameva ca | ācāryaṃ matisaṃpannaṃ saṃśrayāmīti me matiḥ | |63 | | na cāpi tad vyavasyāmi yuvayornāsti kaścana | kuryādyaḥ pādayornityaṃ śuśrūṣāmiti cintayan ||64|| na ca nākhyeyametad vāṃ mayā cintā kṛtā śubham | aśubhaṃ vāpi yatkiṃcidyuvāṃ mama gatiḥ parā | |65|| evamuktau tu pitarau putreṇa sumahātmanā | aśrupūrṇekṣaṇau sthitvā muhūrtamidamūcatuḥ | āghrāyāliṅgya saṃmṛjya snehāt priyasutau tadā || 66|| bhūmanyuruvāca śuśrūṣā dvividhā putra pitṝṇāṃ dharmasaṃmitā | yā kartavyā prayatnena sutena sumahātmanā || 67|| aihikī cāṅgaśuśrūṣā yā paratra ca dharmadā | yayā taranti pitaraḥ kāmām̐ścāpnuvatekṣayān | tatraihikaṃ na no hīṣṭaṃ yathā hyāmuṣmikaṃ hitam || 68| | tasmādāmuṣmikaṃ karma yad bhavettat samācara | gacchādhīṣva śrutiñcaiva smṛtiñcaiva sukarmaṇām || 69| | suyaśovāca yathā teyaṃ pitā putra bravīti viditātmavān | tathā kuru yathā devo varadaste bhaved bhavaḥ | |8.52.70 | | udareṇa mayā duḥkhaṃ dhāritastvaṃ mahāmate | tathā ca bahubhiḥ kleśairllabdhaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye ||71 || pitrā ca tapasogreṇa prāṇām̐styaktvātidustyajān | mahādevād bhavām̐llavdhastasya yuktaṃ samācara | |72| | yathā tuṣṭo tvayā putra jīvau jīvena saṃgatau | āvāmubhāvapi syāva tathā samyak samācara ||73 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastābhyāmanujñāta āghrātaścaiva mūrdhani | pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya jagāma sa kṛtātmavān | |74|| sa jagāma tadā tābhyāṃ visṛṣṭaścyavanaṃ prati | ṛgyajurbhyāmivotsṛṣṭā svāhutirvaruṇaṃ prati ||75|| sa tamāsādya tuṣṭena tenāsau saphalaḥ kṛtaḥ | bhāgadheyamiva prāpya devairmantraḥ purassaraḥ ||76| | atha putre gate tasmin pitā diṣṭānta mīyivān | kāṣṭhakūṭastatobhyetya kṛtavidyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ | |77| | apaśyanmātaraṃ dīnāṃ vitoyāmiva padminīm | somahīnāmiva niśāmājñāhīnāmiva śriyam | rudatīmaśrupūrṇākṣīṃ vilapantīṃ suduḥkhitām ||78 || kāṣṭhakūṭastu tāṃ dṛṣṭavā duḥkhena samabhiplutām | jayaṃta iva paulomīṃ śakre naṣṭebravīdidam | |79 | | kāṣṭhakūṭa uvāca śrutaṃ mayedaṃ prāgeva kṛtaṃ caivordhvadehikam | mā śoke mana ādhatsva eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ | |8.52.80 || devānāñca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca yogināñca mahātmanām | martyānāṃ kiṃ punarmātarmā śuca staṃ tapodhanam | |81 | | ahaṃ tenātmanātmā vai sṛṣṭaḥ svenaiva tejasā | paśya māṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ tvaṃ gāyatrīvātmanaḥ sutam | |82 || vedāḥ sarve mayādhītāḥ sāṅgopāṅgāssavistarāḥ | tathopavedāssarve ca adhyātmañcaiva kṛtsnaśaḥ ||83 || yatkiṃcit puruṣairjñeyaṃ tatsarvaṃ jñānameva ca | śrotavyaṃ ca śrutaṃ sarvamupāstāścāpi yoginaḥ ||84|| anenāpi prakarṣeṇa hṛṣyamāṇā mudānvitā | māṃ pālaya mahāsatve gāyatrīva sadā kratum | |85| | sanatkumāra uvāca śrutvā tasya vaca stastadvai mātā tathyaṃ mahātmanaḥ | bhūyastareṇa duḥkhena rudatī tamuvāca ha ||86 | | suyaśovāca putra naitaddhi duḥkhaṃ me mṛtaḥ sa iti saṃmataḥ | sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmetadvihitaṃ martyadharmiṇām | |87|| sa cāpi kṛtakṛtyaśca mahātmā tapasānvitaḥ | na tasya śocyamasmābhiriha kiñciddhi vidyate ||88| | ātmānaṃ putra śocāmi yāhaṃ tena vinā kṛtā | tamevānu mṛtā nāsmi tavāgamanakāṃkṣiṇī ||89|| nārthā na bhogasvajanā na putrā naiva bāndhavāḥ | yoṣitāṃ tatra tiṣṭhanti patiryatrāvatiṣṭhate | |8.52.9 0 | | patiryadi tataḥ sarvaṃ nāsti kiñcit patiṃ vinā | sarvaṃ hi duḥkhadaṃ tāsāṃ yāsāṃ nāsti patiḥ suta | |91 | | idaṃ ca me punarduḥkhaṃ yattvāṃ tena sahādya vai | nābhinandāmi saṃhṛṣṭā sutaṃ śrīravi viṣṇunā ||92|| bahuśaḥ sa hi māmāha kāṣṭhakūṭa ihaiṣyati | kṛtavidyastatastasya varayiṣye snuṣāṃ śubhām ||93 | | kāśyapasyodalasyeyaṃ sutā guṇavatī bhṛśam | tāmahaṃ varayiṣyāmi kāṣṭhakūṭasya suvratām || 94|| tadā drakṣyāmi taṃ putraṃ sapatnīkaṃ dṛḍhavratam | agnīm̐ścaivāhariṣyāmi patnīvantaṃ samīkṣya vai| |95| | patnyāḥ kadāhaṃ putrasya pāṇigrahaṇatoṣitaḥ | śubhāni manasā vācā vidhāsyāmi bahūnyapi ||96|| evaṃ manorathavatastasya putravatastathā | priyaputrasya naivābhūdetad dahati māṃ suta ||97| | mayā tvamuktapūrvaśca gacchanvai tasya sannidhau | jīvau yathā tvāṃ paśyāvastacca naivābhavattathā | |98| | vajrasāramayaṃ medya hṛdayaṃ na hi dīryate yā tvāṃ paśyāmi putreha vinā tenāsatī punaḥ ||99|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sā kurarī yadvadvinā patyā mahāyaśā | vilapya bahuduḥkhārttā papāta dharaṇītale || 8.52.100 || tāṃ kāṣṭhakūṭo duḥkhārtāṃ patitāṃ gatajīvitām | visaṃjñāmagninā dagdhvā vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ | |1 01 | | hā tāta mama durbuddheradharmajñasya caiva hi | ................| | 102| | kva gatosi na medya tvaṃ sabhāryaḥ saṃprabhāṣase | nanu tvayāhaṃ nirdiṣṭo gacchādhīṣveti hṛṣṭavat | | 103 | | sohamadyāgatodhītya kasmānmāṃ nābhibhāṣase | nanu te tapasā labdhaḥ pareṇa ca samādhinā | |1 04| | putrohaṃ devadevādvai rudrāt kiṃ nābhibhāṣase | kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ tāta sahabhāryasya tenagha || 105 | | yanmāṃ sahāmbayāgatya dṛḍhaṃ naivābhinandasi | hā hatosi mayaikena duṣputreṇa durātmanā | 10 6| | arājakamidaṃ manye pitṛghnaṃ māṃ na hanti yat | evaṃ sa vilapan vyāsa ṛṣibhirbahubhistathā | | 1 07|| saṃsthāpitaḥ samāśvaste nākarodudakakriyām | imāṃ pratijñāṃ cakre ca ṛṣimadhye mahātapāḥ | | 1 08| | duṣkarāṃ sarvabhūtānāmupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ | adyaprabhṛti nocchvāsaṃ kariṣyāmi kathañcana | | 10 9| | vāyavo me śarīrasthā na cariṣyanti karhicit | nimeṣonmeṣarahita ekapādordhvabāhumān | | kāṣṭhaloṣṭhopalībhūto bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 8.52.110 | | rudraṃ drakṣyāmi yāvacca yāvacca pitaraṃ tathā | sabhāryaṃ saṃ prapaśyāmi tāvad vratamidaṃ mama | | 111 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa ṛṣibhistaistu dṛśyamāno mahātapāḥ | maheśvaraṃ sadā dhyāyan tatraiva samatiṣṭhata || 11 2| | tasya devaḥ sthitasyaivaṃ pitṛbhaktyā tathāpi ca | tuṣṭo dineṣṭame vyāsa svayamevāha śaṅkaraḥ | | 113 | | devadeva uvāca kāṣṭhakūṭa prayacchāmi divyaṃ cakṣustavānagha | paśya māṃ tvaṃ suviśrabdhamadṛśyaṃ yogināmapi || 1 14| | brūhi putra varaṃ cāpi yaste hṛdi samāhitaḥ | pradāsyāmi na sandehaḥ suniścityābhidhatsva mām ||1 1 5|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa dṛṣṭavā deveśamudyantamiva bhāskaram | papāta pādayorhṛṣṭa idañcovāca susvaram || 11 6| | kāṣṭhakūṭa uvāca bhagavan mṛtyunā mātā pitā ca mama yojitau | jīvetāṃ tāvubhau deva etadicchāmyahaṃ varam || 1 17|| devadeva uvāca tāvubhau narakaṃ ghoraṃ prapannau mṛtyunārditau | na tau śakyau punarjīvau kartumanyadvṛṇīṣva me | |1 18 || kāṣṭhakūṭa uvāca nāhamanyaṃ varaṃ deva kathañcidapi kāmaye | pitrarthoyaṃ samārambhastadvidhatsva namastava | | 119 | | devadeva uvāca śarīraṃ cenmṛtasyāsti tacchakyaṃ jīvitena hi | sayojayitumadyaiva dagdhasyaitanna vidyate | | 8.52.120 | | tayornacāsti vai deho na cānyat karaṇaṃ tathā | yādṛk ca sa pitā tubhyaṃ bhavām̐stādṛk charīrataḥ | śarīrametattvaṃ yaccha tato jīvau bhaviṣyataḥ | | 121 || kāṣṭhakūṭa uvāca tābhyāṃ vai nāstyakartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ cenmataṃ bhavet (?) | śarīraṃ ca vinā dṛṣṭamutthānaṃ vai dhruvasya tu (?) || 1 22| | na cāpi me śarīreṇa vinā tābhyāṃ ratiḥ prabho | tasmād gṛhāṇa devaśa śarīraṃ yadi manyase ||1 23 || tasyaivedaṃ tahādeva aṅgādaṅgaḥ samutthitam | tasmādyacchasva deveśa na me kāryamanena hi || 1 24|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavāndevaḥ prahasya ṛṣisattama | prītātmā pratyuvācedaṃ yuyukṣustaṃ śubhena hi ||1 25|| devadeva uvāca parīkṣeyaṃ kṛtā putra tava dharmavṛtāṃ vara | pitṛbhaktyānayā samyak tuṣṭosmi śṛṇu me vacaḥ ||1 26|| akṣayaścāvyayaścāpi jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ | aiśvaryeṇa ca saṃyuktaḥ priyo me gaṇapo bhavān || 1 27| | kāṣṭhakūṭa iti khyātaḥ sarvayogabalānvitaḥ | kāmagena vimānena matkṛtena cariṣyasi || 1 28| | ime ca ṛṣayaḥ sarva āśramesmin tapasvinaḥ | tavaivānucarā bhūtvā bhaviṣyanti gaṇeśvarāḥ | | 1 29| | akṣayāścāvyayāścaiva mahāyogabalānvitāḥ | aiśvaryeṇa ca tulyāste bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | | 8.52.130 | | ayañca te pitā putra bhūmanyuḥ saha bhāryayā | tavaivānucaro bhūtvā tvatsamaḥ samupasthitaḥ | |1 31 | | śvetañca parvataṃ divyaṃ vimānairupaśobhitam | kāmagaṃ saṃ prayacchāmi nivāsaṃ svargasannibham | | 13 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavāndeva anugṛhya tamūrjjitam | jagāma mandaraṃ bhūyaḥ sopīṣṭaṃ deśamāvrajat | | 133 | | yāvad devī tapoyuktā pituḥ śikharamāsthitā | tāvad deva idaṃ sarvaṃ cakāra kathitaṃ hi yat ||1 3 4|| ya idaṃ devadevasya ceṣṭitaṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ | śrāvayīta dvijān vāpi na sa durgatimāpnuyāt ||1 35|| nityametadadhīyānaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | dehabhedaṃ samāsādya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 13 6| | tha imaṃ bahupāpanāśanaṃ paramaṃ rudrasamīpayojanam | paṭhate ca guṇaprasādhanaṃ sa mṛto yāti na dīnasaṃbhavam | | 1 37|| iti skandapurāṇe | etadicchāmi kathitaṃ sarva vai dvijasattama | |2| | sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu kāle vyatīte hi tapo devyāḥ suduścaram | prayatā prāñjalirbhūtvā samādhāya manastathā ||3 || divākarebhisandhāya cakṣuṣī niṣkāraṇaṃ bhavet | tasmādvayamajānanta etaṃ sarva viparyayam ||14|| kintiṣṭhāmaḥ samudvignā gacchāma brahmaṇontikam | ityuktvā te surāḥ sarve bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ ||15|| vairājabhavanaṃ gatvā brahmāṇaṃ saṃpraṇemire | pūjitā brahmaṇā samyagupaviṣṭā yathārhataḥ ||16|| pṛṣṭāstenāgame hetumūcu rhṛcchokapīḍitāḥ | bhagavan lokatattvaṃ ca sarvaṃ pratyakṣavad vibhoḥ ||17|| lokoyaṃ viparītodya kimarthaṃ śaṃsa naḥ prabho | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhītānāṃ sarvayogavit ||18|| uvāca madhuraṃ ślakṣṇamidaṃ gambhīravadvacaḥ | eṣā haimavatī devī rudrāṇī lokadhāraṇī | tapaścarati yuktātmā yogamāsthāya niścalam ||19|| adya varṣasahasraṃ hi divyaṃ tasyāḥ samādhinā | varṣāṇāṃ dve śate caiva tathānyaccharadāṃ śatam ||8.53.20|| tapaścarantyā yogena tasyaiṣā tapasaḥ surāḥ | prabhāvo yena lokānāṃ viparītatvamāgatam ||21| | devā ūcuḥ yadi tasyāḥ prabhāveṇa mahotpātabhayaṃ tvidam | ato bhūyo dahellokām̐stasmāttāṃ sannivāraya ||22|| sā hi devī tapoyuktā ato bhūyo vibhāvarī | lokānimān sahāsmābhirdahedapi na saṃśayaḥ | |23 || tasmālalokahitārthāya asmākaṃ vacanādapi | tathā kuru yathā sādhvī vinivartteta śobhanā | |24|| pitāmaha uvāca evaṃ bhavatu gacchadhvaṃ nirvṛtā bhavatā naghāḥ | varapradāneneṣṭena rudrāṇīṃ sthāpayāmyaham ||25| | gateṣvatha tu deveṣu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | vimānaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubhraṃ vedikāśatasaṃkulam ||26| | kiṅkiṇījālasannaddhaṃ muktādāmāvabhāsitam | indranīlamayaiḥ stambhai rjālairjāmbūnadaistathā ||27|| ghaṃṭābhirviśvarūpābhiḥ samantāt parivāritam | vajrendranīla vaidūryamahānīlādibhāsitam | | 28|| stūpikābhiśca yogyābhiḥ sphāṭikāṅkābhirāvṛtam| dānāni ca vicitrāṇi kratavaḥ seṣṭayastathā | saptavyāhṛtayaḥ puṇyāstathā lokāśca sarvaśaḥ | | 37| | parvatāścaiva nadyaśca tathā lokasya mātaraḥ | lokapālāḥ prajādhyakṣā dakṣo dharmastathaiva ca ||38 | | bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | marīciraṅgirāścaiva ruciścaiva mahāyaśāḥ ||3 9|| ṛbhuḥ sanātanaścaiva virājaśca mahātapāḥ | pitaraścaiva devāśca brahmaṇo yāḥ prasūtayaḥ | dūrād dṛṣṭisukhaṃ dṛṣṭavā sabhāsthānidamabravīt | |2|| idaṃ rudragṛhaṃ śubhramadṛśyaṃ sukṛtāmapi | devānāmapi paśyadhvaṃ bhāskarākāravarcasam | |3 || idaṃ praviśya devānāṃ yajñaśrī rnāpasarpati | jayaśca nityaṃ yuddheṣu dharmaśca sumahānapi | |4| | etat sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃ tena manasānupamadyuti | na hyasya sadṛśaṃ kiñcidaṇḍesmin vidyate gṛham | |5|| idaṃ praviśya dharmātmā bhūyo duḥkhaṃ na vindati | na cāpi janma prāpnoti nityamaiśvaryago hi saḥ | |6| | anirdeśyamidaṃ yogād yogināmapi nityaśaḥ | anyastu kuta evedaṃ varṇayīta mahānapi ||7| | etadasmadvimānasya vāyunābhyāhataṃ ruṣā | vardhate giriṇā sārdhaṃ vindhyasya śikharaṃ yathā | |8|| etadasmadvimānasya mārgamāvṛtyadhiṣṭhitam | ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhastācca devadevasya tejasā || 9|| etadandhaṃ tamaḥ kṛtvā medhosau jīvanaḥ svayam (?) | devaṃ śarvamugraṃ kapardinam | te caiva ṛṣayaḥ sarve vimānasthā susaṃyatāḥ | |1 2 | | prakāśaṃ cakrire sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam | tatassa meghaḥ svaṃ sthānamagamad vṛṣṭisarjanaḥ | |1 3 || diśaśca ||17| | nandyuvāca yūyaṃ jñātā bhagavatā yena kāryeṇa cāgatāḥ | kurudhvaṃ kila tacchīghraṃ kāloyaṃ tasya vartate | |18| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa kṛtvā manasā namaskāraṃ hi śambhave | devadevājñayā yohamāgato mandarādiha | devyā varapradānārthamanujñā kriyatāṃ mama | | 31 | | gaṇeśvarā ūcuḥ devyā dātā svayaṃ devo varāniṣṭān mahāmanāḥ | varaṃ hi devī tvanyasmān manasāpi na cintayet ||3 2|| śakto devonugrahītuṃ jagatsarvaṃ maheśvaraḥ | tvāmapyeṣonugṛhaṇāti kimu devīṃ jagatpatiḥ || 33 | | pitāmaha uvāca aśakto na mahādevo varaṃ dātuṃ mahāmanāḥ | ya evaṃ cintayed devaṃ na bhavet sa kathañcana ||34|| na devī bhagavatpārśvādicchate kila pārvatī | varāniṣṭām̐stato devo māmiha praiṣayacchivaḥ | |3 5 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha te yuktamanaso yuktaṃ pratyakṣamīśvarāḥ | maheśvaramapaśyanta kṛtānujñaṃ ca lokapam ||3 6| | niyuktāśca punaḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ lokakāraṇam | ūcurgaṇeśvarām̐statra viditārthā mahāmune | |37| | preṣito devadevena jñātosmābhiḥ pitāmaha | tvaṃ viśasvādhunā deva pārvatyā varaditsayā ||38| | avatīrya vimānāttu tataḥ śīghraṃ pitāmahaḥ | nililye śikhare tasminnānādhātuvicitrite | |3 9| | atha sopaladhātunirjharo girirājotimahāśiloccayaḥ | caturvaktramupāgatam ||2|| brahmovāca lokasya jananī bhūtvā dhārayitvā jagattathā | kimidaṃ tapasā bhūyo lokaṃ dagdhumihecchasi | | 3 | | mā sṛṣṭvā jagadetattvaṃ tapasyantī vināśaya | buddhvaivaṃ dhārayasvemaṃ lokaṃ devi namastava | |4|| tvatto rudreṇa lokoyamahañcaiva purānaghe | sṛṣṭāḥ smo varade devi mā naḥ kṛtvā vināśaya ||5| | tapasā tava rudrāṇi jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | tapyate grīṣmamadhyāhne jalāt padmamivoddhṛtam | |6 || kiṃ vā te hṛdaye devi yadyapi syāt suduṣkaram | varaṃ vṛṇīhi sarvāṇi dātāsmi himavatsute | |7| | devyuvāca varadosi yadīśāna mama deva caturmukha | ayaṃ bhaktonuraktaśca mama nityaṃ priyaḥ prabho | |8|| vyāghrosya tāvadyacchasva tato dāsyasi me varam | adya varṣasahasraṃ vai sthitasyāsya mamāgrataḥ | | 9| | dhyāyato nimiṣasyaiva stabdhakarṇasya lokapa | asmai dhatsva varaṃ deva nāsmi tāvadvarārthinī | |8.55.1 0 || pitāmaha uvāca eṣa tiryag durātmā ca tvāṃ bhakṣayitumāgataḥ | nāsya śuddhaṃ mano devi krūroyaṃ pāpacetanaḥ | paśyainaṃ duṣṭamanasaṃ hi somanandirvaradastasya haraśca somanandī|| 39 || iti skandapurāṇe somanandidevyorvarapradānaṃ nāma paṃcapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.56> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan yattvayākhyātaṃ pūrvaṃ narakavarṇane | duṣkṛtaṃ karma kṛtvā tu narā narakagāminaḥ | |1 || bhavanti sukṛtāḥ sarve svargasaukhyasamāyutāḥ | brāhmaṇā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtvā gatvā durgatimāpadam ||2| | kathaṃ bhūyaḥ samāyanti svargasaukhyaphalaṃ mahat | yonīrvā kathamāgamya bahvīḥ saṃkarajātiṣu | bhūyaḥ sukṛtino bhūtvā prāpnuvanti śubhāṃ gatim ||3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa purāvṛttaṃ daśārṇeṣu tu yacchrutam | saptānāṃ dvijaśipyāṇāmaśubhaṃ śubhameva ca | |4| | āsīt suparvā vikhyātaḥ kauśiko brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ | dhārmikaśca vadānyaśca vidvān vipraiḥ sapūjitaḥ | |5 | | tasya śiṣyā babhūvurhi sapta durmedhasaśca te | guruśuśrūṣaṇesaktā nāmatastānnibodha me ||6| | ātreyaḥ kaṇḍaro nāma upamanyuśca dāmanaḥ | śāṇḍilyaścaiva hālobhūd gārgyaśca vidalastathā | |7|| śaiśiro gautamaścaiva daṇḍakīlaśca kāśyapaḥ | vidarbhaścaiva hārīta itīme sapta viśrutāḥ | |8 || upādhyāyotha tānviprān provācedaṃ mahātapāḥ | acirād gāmito gatvā yājyadattāṃ surūpiṇīm | |9|| gatvānayata homārthe śīghraṃ māhiṣmatīṃ purīm | ta evamuktāstenaiva māhiṣmatyāstvatandritāḥ | | 8.56.10 || gāmādāya nivartanto mṛttikāvatimantaśaḥ | anāvṛṣṭyā tatastetu durbhikṣe parivartati || 11 | | kṣudhāparigatāḥ sarve kiṃbhakṣāḥ saṃbabhūvire | saptamehani saṃjāte nirāhārāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || 12 || amantrayanta gāmetāṃ bhakṣayāma kimāsyate | teṣāṃ yaḥ kaṇḍaro nāma ātreyakulasaṃbhavaḥ || 13 || sa tānuvāca mā dhenuṃ bhakṣayāma gurorimām | gurorarthe hi naḥ ślāghyā mṛtyurapyavicakṣaṇāḥ | |14|| mā guroḥ krodhanirdagdhā yāsyāma nidhanaṃ vayam | te yadā tadvaco naiva jagṛhuḥ kṣutprapīḍitāḥ || 15| | sa tadovāca bhūyastānidaṃ vacanamarthavat | yadi vovadhṛtaṃ viprā bhakṣaṇesyāstapodhanāḥ || 1 6|| mā vṛthā bhakṣayāmaināṃ pitrarthe prokṣayāmahe | mā no doṣadvayeneha lopo bhavatu śobhanāḥ || 17|| evaṃ hyalpena doṣeṇa vayaṃ yokṣyema sarvathā | ta evamuktāḥ samyaktu vacastasyāvadhārya ca | |18| | prokṣayāmāsuravyagrā pitrarthe tāṃ payasvinīm | tataḥ saṃskṛtya vidhivad nivedya ca mahāmune | |1 9|| hutāgnayastato bhūtvā pratyekamupabhujya ca | vatsamekaṃ gale baddhvā āninyurgurave tadā | |8.56.2 0 | | atha dṛṣṭavā sa taṃ vatsaṃ dhenuṃ papraccha tāndvijaḥ | ta ūcuḥ pathi śārdūlovadhīttāmiti nirghṛṇāḥ ||21 || atha teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śaṃkayā ca durātmanām | divyena cakṣuṣāpaśyad bhakṣitāṃ tairmahātapāḥ | | 22 | | sataḥ sa roṣād raktākṣo nirdahanniva tām̐stadā | uvāca vatsaṃ dṛṣṭavā ca kṛpayā bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ ||2 3 | | yuṣmābhirbhakṣitā sā hi tathyaṃ na kathitaṃ ca me | karmaṇā tena tasmādvo gatiḥ kaṣṭā bhaviṣyati | |24| | prasāditaḥ sa taiḥ śiṣyairbrāhmaṇaḥ sumahādyutiḥ | kṛpayā sa ca tānāha bhūyaḥ sarvānidaṃ vacaḥ ||25|| yaduktaṃ tanmayā tathyaṃ na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati | yeṣāṃ tu kṛtavantaḥ sthastedhyavasyanti yacchubham ||2 6|| matsamīpe ca na stheyamidānīṃ vaḥ kathañcana | dṛṣṭavā vatsamimaṃ bālaṃ mā vo dhakṣyāmi gacchata ||27|| atha te sahitāḥ sarve naṣṭasaṃjñā vicetasaḥ | kālena samayujyanta cintayanto gurorvacaḥ | |28| | daśārṇā nāma sā vyāsa sarit puṇyajalā śubhā | tasyāstīre vanaṃ divyaṃ viśrutaṃ tat subhāsvaram ||29| | tatra vyādhobhavacchūraḥ kṣupako nāma vīryavān | tasya putrābhavam̐ste vai citakāyāṃ mahābalāḥ ||8.56.3 0 || citakā saṃprasūtā tu putrām̐stān sapta saṃmatān | vyādhāḥ sarvebhavaṃste vai caitakā iti viśrutāḥ || 3 1| | caranti sadhanuṣkāste nighnanto mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | siṃhān vyāghrān gajām̐ścaiva varāhādīm̐śca sarvaśaḥ | |3 2|| teṣāṃ nāmāni yāni sma vyādhatve tāni me śṛṇu | kāṇḍārorjunako nāma damanaḥ siṃhakobhavat | |3 3 || hālobhūd vyāghrakaścaiva vidalaḥ śarabhastathā | śaiśiro himavām̐ścaiva hastiko daṇḍakīlakaḥ | |34|| vidarbho vajrakaścaiva nāmānyetāni teṣu hi | ekaśa steṭavīṃ ghorāṃ caranti piśitāśanāḥ | |35|| hiṃsrāḥ satvāntakāḥ sarve yoniṃ duṣṭāmupāgatāḥ | kadācidvicarantaste mṛgān ghnantastathaiva ca | |3 6 || upādhyāyāśramaṃ prāptāḥ karmaṇā sukṛtena ha | tatra teṣāṃ bhayodvignāḥ sarva evābhavan mṛgāḥ | |37| | mṛgān bhītān samālakṣya sa vipraḥ sumahātapāḥ | nyavaikṣata diśaḥ sarvā vyādhām̐ścāpaśyadāgatān || 38|| svaśiṣyām̐stān parijñāya dhyānād vyādhatvamāgatān | provāca karuṇāviṣṭasteṣāmeva śubhepsayā | |3 9|| śuśrūṣitaḥ purā viprairyuṣmābhirahamādarāt | karmaṇā tena cedānīṃ gobadhyākṛtaśāpataḥ | |8.56.40 | | vyādhatvamiha saṃprāptāḥ kutsitaṃ hiṃsravṛtti yat | sā ca gauḥ pitṛkāryeṇa bhakṣitā vo na hiṃsayā | |41 || tasmād yūyamito bhraṣṭā jātismaraṇasaṃyutāḥ | mṛgāḥ kālañjare bhūtvā cakravākāḥ punaḥ sare ||42 | | dvīpe tataḥ punarhaṃsā bhūtvā vai mānase hrade | bhūyaśca mānuṣā bhūtvā jātau jātau sacetanāḥ ||43 | | yogayuktā mahātmāno matprasādādatandritāḥ | sarvakilbiṣanirmuktā brahmalokamavāpsyatha | |44|| etacchrutvā tatasteṣāṃ pūrvā smṛtirajāyata | upādhyāyoyamasmākamiti buddhau tadā bhavat ||45|| tataḥ karma jugupsantaḥ pūrvajātikṛtaṃ ca yat | pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya daśārṇāmabhito yayuḥ ||46| | daśārṇātīramāsādya saṃmantrya ca parasparam | jātiṃ pūrvāṃ smarantaste mṛtyumeva pravavrire ||47|| niścitānāṃ tatasteṣāṃ kāṇḍaro yobhavad dvijaḥ | vyādhorjunakanāmā sa idaṃ vacanamabravīt ||48|| bhavanto yanmayā pūrvamuktāstanna kṛtaṃ hi vaḥ | idānīṃ samanuprāptaṃ māvamanyata me vacaḥ ||49|| śreyo vohaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ kurutaiva ca | jātimetāṃ vimokṣyāma yena hāsyāma na smṛtim | |8.56.50 || putrānicchanti pitaraḥ puṣṭyarthaṃ tāraṇāya ca | vayaṃ ca janitāstena vyādhena sumahātmanā ||51 | | saṃvarddhitāśca kleśena mātrā pitrā tathaiva ca | anāpṛcchya kathaṃ tau tu mṛtyumicchāmahe vayam ||52| | te yūyaṃ yadi manyadhvaṃ tāvāpṛcchya visarjitāḥ | yokṣyāma śreyasātmānametadvo hitamuttamam | |53 | | na cedvisarjayetāṃ tau tayoḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ | tatastāvaddhi tiṣṭhāmo yāvat kālena tau mṛtau | |54| | tato vayaṃ kṛtātmāno hyanṛṇāḥ sarvathāpi ca | gamiṣyāmo gatiṃ puṇyāmetannaḥ śreya uttamam ||55| | evamastviti te sarve gṛhītvā tasya tadvacaḥ | cintayantaḥ puro janma gṛhānevābhijagmire ||56| | tānāgatān pitā dṛṣṭvā mātā ca citakā tadā | tuṣṭyā paramayā yuktā idaṃ tānūcaturvacaḥ ||57| | putrakāḥ sucirādadya yūyamabhyāgatā gṛham | adyāvāṃ sudṛḍhaṃ mūḍhau kiṃ ciraṃ kṛtamityuta ||58|| citakovāca kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ pitā vodya
