putrasnehena putrakāḥ | nātti māṃsamidaṃ pakbaṃ surāñca na pibatyayam | |59|| sanatkumāra uvāca tepi jātiṃ jugupsantaḥ sarve vai pāpayonayaḥ | idamūcuḥ kṣupaṃ caiva citakāñca śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 8.56.60 | | bhavantośnantvavighnena puṣṭaye śāntayepi ca | nāśnīmo vayamadyeha śvo bhokṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ ||61 | | tatastau vṛddhabhāvena na bubhukṣāsahau tadā | āhārayetāmāhāraṃ sutuṣṭau ca babhūvatuḥ || 62| | tau tu tuṣṭau samālakṣya sarvetha śirasā natāḥ | ūcuḥ prayatnato vākyamaikamatyena te tadā | | 63 | | pitarau parinirviṇṇā vayametena janmanā | icchāmastat parityaktuṃ tannaḥ saṃmantumarhathaḥ ||64|| teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pitā tānidamabravīt | pariṣvajya sutān sarvān bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ | |65| | ahamāsaṃ purā putrā brāhmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ | divodāsasya rājarṣeḥ sakhā paramasaṃmataḥ | |66| | sa kadācidvane ramye dhanuṣā kurute bhṛśam | .........||| 67| | yogyāttamahamāhedaṃ na tvaṃ vetsi dhanurnṛpa | ajānan kimidaṃ kleśaṃ vyarthameva karoṣi ca ||68| | provāca rājā viprāṇāṃ mantrajñānaṃ vidhīyate | āmantraṇe bhojane ca vācā ca kuśalā dvijāḥ ||69|| ...........| sa mayā hasatā prokta ānayasva dhanurmama ||8.56.70 | | yāvat kṣipāmi lakṣyāya śaraṃ yatra bravīṣi mām | sa tathoktastadā mahyaṃ saśaraṃ dhanurarpayat ||71| | tenoktaṃ lakṣyamuddiśya śaraḥ kṣipto mayā tataḥ | tatrābhavat sthito vipro mṛgacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ ||72 | | sa tena viddhastejasvī mamāra sahasaiva ca | sohaṃ taṃ mṛtamālakṣya rājñā tena visarjitaḥ | |73 || brahmavadhyābhayād ghorāt pitaraṃ paripṛṣṭavān | provāca na bhayaṃ testi brahmavadhyā kutastava ||74|| jātyantaraśataṃ gatvā dṛṣṭametat svayaṃbhuvā | tatohaṃ parayā bhaktyā pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ||75| | anayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ sthito vai bahulāḥ samāḥ | sa kadācit pitā cāpi mama kālena saṃyutaḥ |76|| avatasthe ca tatraiva anayaiva sahānaghāḥ | atha kālena mahatā gavāhaṃ vinipātitaḥ ||77| | agnisthaṃ cāvarūḍhaiṣā rudantī māṃ śubhekṣaṇā | sohaṃ gavā hataśceti mṛgacārivadhena ca | | |78 || vyādhajanmani vipratvād bhraṣṭaḥ pāpena jajñivān | jātosmi janmanāṃ putrāḥ sahasraṃ bhṛśadāruṇam ||79| | pitṛbhaktyā ca hi tayā samyagārādhanena ca | nānaśanme smṛtiḥ putrā jñānaṃ cāpi pravartate | |8.56.80|| jānāmi brāhmaṇān bhraṣṭān sarvān vai gokṛtena vaḥ | guroścaivānuśāpena bhraṣṭasajñām̐stathaiva ca | |81 | | paścāttadājñayā putrān sarvānvai muktacetasaḥ | labdhasaṃjñām̐stathā caiva sarvānadya mahābalāḥ ||82|| mātā ceyaṃ hi vo vetti sādhvī nityaṃ pativratā | yadahaṃ vo bravīmyadya tatkurudhvaṃ mama priyama | |83 || avāpsyatha tataḥ śreyaḥ sarve yūyamatandritāḥ | anāmayā viśokāśca na ca saṃjñāṃ prahāsyatha | |84| | putrā janmedamantyaṃ me manuṣyeṣu na saṃśayaḥ | ito mṛtena gantavyaṃ mayā brahmasadaḥ śubham | |85| | te yūyaṃ māṃ pratīkṣadhvaṃ kaṃcitkālamatandritāḥ | svargate mayi yacchreyastatkariṣyatha mā śucaḥ | ||86|| avaśyañca sutairmātā pitā caiva suduḥkhitau | śuśrūṣitavyau nānyosti dharmosmād balavattaraḥ ||87| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste vismitā bhūtvā naṣṭaśokā vimatsarāḥ | taṃ kālaṃ paryupāsanta yāvattau jahatustvasūn||88|| tayoratītayoḥ samyak kṛtvā te hyaurdhvadehikam | daśārṇāyāṃ mahānadyāṃ vidhinānaśanena ha ||89| | asādhayanta ātmānaṃ vyādhāḥ saptāpi te tadā | kālañjare girau bhūyo mṛgāḥ saptaiva jajñire | |8.56.90 || smarantastatra te jātiṃ marutprapatanena ha | sādhayitvā tadātmānaṃ cakravākeṣu jajñire ||9 1 | | mṛgatve yāni nāmāni teṣāṃ tāni nibodha me | dīrghajīvī hyanādhṛṣṭo vāyuvegobhikampanaḥ ||92 || śrīpārśvaḥ śaṃkhapāccaiva somalakṣyaśca saptamaḥ | jātiṃ smarantaste pūrvāmanyonyamabhimānya ca | |93 | | sahitāḥ sahasā prāṇān marutprapatanājjahuḥ | te saptasaṃkhyā vyādheṣu mṛgeṣu ca tathā punaḥ | |94|| janma prāpya punarjātāḥ śaradvīpe khagāstataḥ | śaradvīpamiti khyātaṃ kāmpilyeṣu saraḥ śubham | |95|| tatrāpi cakravākāste saptājāyanta sodarāḥ | maruddevaḥ śikhaṃḍī ca rathanemisvarastathā | śikhī jīvotha vṛkṣaśca dhvaja ityeva te smṛtāḥ ||96 || teṣāṃ tatropapannānāṃ kadācidaṇuhaḥ svayam | kāmpilyako mahātejā rājā taṃ deśamāgamat | |97| | sa tatsaraḥ samāsādya strībhiḥ sahaḥ mudānvitaḥ | reme mandākinīṃ prāpya apsarobhirivāmaraḥ ||98| | taṃ krīḍamānaṃ saṃdṛśya maruddevasya tatra vai | cakravākasya tasyāsīt spṛhā tān viṣayān prati ||99| | yadyasyāhaṃ sutaḥ syāṃ vai prāpnuyāṃ rājyameva ca | tatohaṃ viṣayānetān prāpnuyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | |8.56.1 00 || tasya taccintitaṃ jñātvā dvitīyaścakrasāhvayaḥ | śikhaṃḍīti samākhyātaḥ sa tamāha tadā hasan | | 101 | | bhavatā rājaputratvaṃ rājyaṃ caiva vicintitam | tatrāhaṃ te purodhāḥ syāṃ mamāpyeṣa manorathaḥ || 10 2| | tābhyāṃ taccintitaṃ jñātvā rathanemisvarastataḥ | acintayata tatrāhaṃ sacivaḥ syāṃ tava prabho | |1 03 | | sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tathā cintayatāṃ trayāṇāmitare tataḥ | cakrāhvayāstadā kruddhā idaṃ tānabruvan vacaḥ || 1 04|| acintanīyaṃ yuṣmābhiścintitaṃ viṣayārthibhiḥ | tasmād yūyamito muktā avāpsyatha manoratham | |1 05| | tāñchaptvā dīnamanasaḥ samālakṣya punaśca te | yena tadrājaputratvaṃ cintitaṃ rājyameva ca | |1 0 6|| kṛpayā tamidaṃ vākyamabruvannaṣṭacetasam | bahusāntvaguṇopetaṃ svayaṃ duḥkhitavadyathā | | 1 07|| vayaṃ tava prabhāveṇa tīrṇāḥ kṛcchramidaṃ prabho | bhavān matipradosmākaṃ setubhūto mato hi naḥ ||1 08| | bhavān yadi hi na brūyāt pitṝṇāṃ gaurnivedyatām | śuśrūṣemaśca na pitṝn na sma saṃjñā tato bhavet | |1 09|| tava prabhāvādetanno yaugaiśvaryapravartanam | tato vayaṃ punaḥ śreyastava brūmaḥ śṛṇuṣva naḥ ||8.56.1 10 || tāvattvaṃ saktahṛdayo bhaviṣyasi narādhipa | yāvadasmadvacastatthyaṃ na śroṣyasi sahāyavān | yogajñānamavāpyaiva prāpsyase ca gatiṃ śubhāma | |1 11 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste sahitāḥ sarve yuktātmāno mahākhagāḥ | khagatvaṃ saṃparityajya yonimanyāṃ prapedire(?) ||1 12|| sarve tataste munikopadagdhā vyādhā mṛgāścakrasamāhvayāśca | jātāḥ punarmānuṣavigraheṣu yogeśvarāste traya eva rājye ||1 13 | | iti skandapurāṇe saptavyādhopākhyāne kauśikaśāpe ṣaṭpañcāśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.57> sanatkumāra uvāca catvāraste tu śāstāraḥ khagāḥ svacchandataḥ punaḥ | yāyāvarasyaḥ viprasya sutā jātā mahātmanaḥ | | 1 || teṣu jāteṣu viprosāvakleśena mahātapāḥ | vṛttiṃ samānayāmāsa teṣāṃ bhāgyapuraḥsaraḥ | | 2| | cīrṇavedavratāste tu vedānsāṅgānadhītya ca | yogameva nyaṣevanta tanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ ||3 | | itarepi trayo vyāsa karmaṇā svena coditāḥ | pratyapadyanta tajjanma yat purā tai rvicintitam||4|| prathamo hyaṇuhājjajñe brahmadatta iti smṛtaḥ | ekoṇuhasya putrobhūd dvitīyastatpurodhasaḥ | |5|| tṛtīyaḥ sacivasyātha trayaste janma tad gatāḥ | trayognaya ivāsaṃste lokāstraya ivāthavā | avarddhanta mahātmāna strayaste sāgarā iva | |6|| teṣāmavāptavidyānāṃ yogyānāṃ ca svakarmaṇi | pitaraḥ svāni karmāṇi pradadurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||7|| aṇuhaḥ pradadau rājyaṃ brahmadattāya puṣkalam | kīrtimatyā ca sahitastato vanamagācya saḥ ||8| | purodhā dhṛtarātastu putraṃ sve karmaṇi prabhuḥ | sthāpayitvā jagāmātha paṃcālaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ | |9|| sacivopi sudhanvā tu brahmadhanvānamacyutam | putraṃ sve karmaṇi sthāpya jagāma saha bhāryayā || 8.57.1 0| | gateṣu teṣu svām̐llokān brahmadattaḥ pratāpavān | pañcālabrahmadhanvabhyāṃ saha rājyaṃ cakāra ha ||1 1 || praśāsatastathā rājyaṃ yajato bhuñjataśca ha | jagmuḥ sukhena bahulāḥ samāḥ sukṛtinastadā ||12|| atha kālena mahatā sabhāryaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ | tasthau sa veśmani sukhaṃ kubera iva puṣpake | |13 || tataḥ sarvarutajñātā pipīlaṃ kāmakāraṇāt | pipīlikāyāñcāṭūni kurvāṇaṃ sonvapaśyata || 14| | sa tu jñānād viniścintya kṛmiyonāvapīdṛśam | vivṛtaṃ śabdavaccaiva hāsamutsṛjatānagha | |1 5| | tattasya hasitaṃ dṛṣṭvā patnī nīlotpalekṣaṇā | cukopa kimidaṃ medya vikṛtaṃ lakṣitaṃ tvayā || 16 || tāṃ sa rājā samāvignaḥ priyāṃ prāṇairgarīyasīm | prasādayanna caivāsya prasīdata śubhānanā ||17|| sā yadā bahu tathyañca ucyamānā na tuṣyati | tadā tasyāḥ prasādārthe sa viṣṇuṃ saṃprasādayat | |18|| devaṃ sālavanaṃ gatvā pañcālena sahaiva saḥ | brahmadhanvapurovāho rathena mahatā mahān | |1 9| | tatrāsau saptame tvahni viṣṇunābhivisarjitaḥ | jagāma naraśārdūlaḥ kāmpilyaṃ svaṃ purottamam ||8.57.20 || etasminneva kāle tu catvāro brāhmaṇāḥ śubhāḥ | yogena mahatā yuktā idamūcuḥ parasparam ||21 | | vayaṃ kṛtārthāḥ kiṃ kāryamiha tiṣṭhāma mānuṣe | gacchāma brahmayoniṃ svāṃ mucyāmosmānmahābhayāt ||22|| avasīdanti te caiva trayosmākaṃ sahavratāḥ | bodhayāmeha tām̐ścaiva yathā neyuḥ parābhavam ||23 || tataste pitaraṃ sarve praṇamyocurdvijātayaḥ | vayaṃ yogeśvarāstāta siddhā vai svena karmaṇā | |24|| āpṛcchāmo gamiṣyāmaḥ svāṃ yoniṃ brahmanirmitām | tyaktvemān mānuṣān dehānna visarjaya namastava ||25|| pitrovāca putrānicchanti pitarastārayiṣyanti no bhayāt | bhayaṃ taccaihikaṃ putrāḥ paratra ca durāsadam | |26|| te yūyamṛṇasaṃyuktā amuktvā svaṃ nibandhanam | kathaṃ gacchatha bhadraṃ vo nādharmaṃ paripaśyatha | |20|| sutā ūcuḥ vayaṃ yogeśvarāstāta lokām̐stubhyamanāmayān | prayacchāmo na saṃdeho yatra gatvā na śocasi ||28|| asmābhistvaṃ kathaṃ putrairbrahmatvaṃ nāpnuyāḥ pitaḥ | ihāpi loke dravyaṃ te vidhāsyāmastathā śṛṇu ||29|| idaṃ tvaṃ patramādāya brahmadattasya darśaya | sa vācayanneva nṛpo vṛttiṃ te saṃvidhāsyati ||8.57.3 0 | | sanatkumāra uvāca prabhāvajñastatasteṣāṃ pitā sa munipuṅgava | mene tadvai tathā sarvamanumene ca tatpunaḥ | |3 1 || athāsanāni baddhvā te yuktā jagmustapodhanāḥ | jyotirbhūtānapaśyacca pitā teṣāmatidyutiḥ | |32|| sa tu lekhaṃ samādāya putrānsvānabhicintayan | kāmpilyamagamattūrṇaṃ didṛkṣurnṛpasattamam || 33 || sa ca rājā sālavanā dāgataḥ prāviśat puram | brāhmaṇo dūrata ścāsya taṃ lekhaṃ samadarśayata ||34|| nimittāni ca saṃlakṣya śubhāni sa narādhipaḥ | lekhamānayatetyuktvā dhārayāmāsa taṃ ratham ||3 5| | sa puradvārasaṃsthastu rathena mahatā tadā | brahmadhanva dhṛtacchatraḥ pañcālā vījitānanaḥ ||3 6 || gṛhītvā lekhamavyagramavācayata taṃ tadā | ślokadvayaṃ cāpyabhavattasmim̐llekhe śubhapradam ||37|| ye te gurukṛtācchāpād govadhenāvapīḍitāḥ | pitṛbhaktyā kṛtajñānā jātāḥ sarve śubhodayāḥ ||38| | saptavyādhā daśārṇeṣu mṛgāḥ kālañjare girau | cakravākāḥ śaradvīpe haṃsāḥ sarasi mānase ||3 9| | tepi jātāḥ kurukṣetre brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ | prasthitā dīrghamadhvānaṃ yūyaṃ kimavasīdatha | |8.57.40 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ślokadvayaṃ tathā śrutvā trayaste viṣapītavat | mohaṃ tadā tu saṃprāpya labdhasaṃjñā viśanpuram ||41|| te praviśya purañcaiva veśma caivāpyatandritāḥ | iti ceti ca saṃcintya vanāya dadhire manaḥ | |42| | sā ca patnī mahābhāgā abhigamya narādhipam | idamāha mudā yuktā rājānaṃ sasuhṛjjanam | |43|| bhavān yogeśvaro bhūtvā sakto bhogeṣu sarvaśaḥ | prabodhārthaṃ tatohante krodhamāhārayantadā ||44|| jānāmi tvāṃ rutajñañca jānāmi tvāṃ khagantathā | atohaṃ jānatī rājan pratibodhārthamudyatā ||45|| tasmādvipramimañcaiva teṣāṃ pitaramavyayam | dhanena yojayasvādya putraṃ rājyebhiṣicya ca | |46| | śvo gacchāva vanaṃ rājana mā kālaṃ pratipālaya | rājā tatkṛtyamakhilaṃ kṛtvā patnyā sahavrataḥ | |47| | jagāma vanamuddiśya yogena ca divaṃ yayau | paṃcālopi gate tasmin tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram ||48 | | cakāra pāraṇaṃ caiva yakṣatvaṃ cāpyavāpa ha | brahmadhanvā ca kālena sumahātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ ||49| | himavattanayāṃ devīṃ tapasā samapaśyata | varadāṃ tāṃ tadā dṛṣṭavā brahmadhanvābravīcchubhām ||8.57.50 || icchāmi kāmarūpitvaṃ tvadbhaktiṃ caiva nityadā | kṛcchraṃ mahacca prāptasya tvayaivoddharaṇaṃ tataḥ ||51 || evamastviti sā coktvā jagāmeṣṭāṃ gatiṃ tadā | bahmadhanvāpi mattobhūnmadanena durātmavān ||52| | sa bhūtvā dhārmikaḥ pūrvamadharmeṇābhipīḍitaḥ | abhimene sa kanyāśca ṛṣīpatnīśca sarvaśaḥ ||53 | | bhartṛrūpeṇa gatvā ca kāmena sa vimohitaḥ | na ca kaścidvijānāti tathā vartantamantaśaḥ | |54| | atha hāla iti khyāto mṛgacārī mahātapāḥ | tasya patnī sudharmābhūnnāmnā rūpavatī dṛḍham ||55|| kathayanti hi tāṃ devāḥ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ | asamā rūpatonyābhistriṣu lokeṣu bhāminī || 56| | na ca tasya sabhāryasya antaraṃ sa bubodha ha | kasmin kāle bhavettasyā virahaḥ patinā saha ||57| sa brahmadhanvā tāṃ śrutvā tathā rūpavatīṃ satīm | patyāsyā virahākāṃkṣī vyāghrarūpaṃ cakāra ha ||58 || kṛtvā ca sumahadrūpaṃ vikṛtaṃ bhairavaṃ tadā | atrasayat mṛgān vyāsa darśanena subāliśaḥ ||59| | tad vyāghrabhayasaṃtrastamṛgayūthaṃ tadā vibho | manonilajavavyagramadṛśyaṃ saṃprapadyata ||8.57.60 | | mṛgaiḥ saha ca hālopi jīvitaiṣī tadā gataḥ | sudharmā brāhmaṇī sāpi bhayād vyāghrasya bhāminī ||6 1 | | strīsvabhāvācca patitā nānvagacchanmṛgavrajam | ekākinīñca tāṃ dṛṣṭavā brahmadhanvā durātmavān ||62|| vyāghrarūpaṃ samutsṛjya tāmidaṃ pratyabhāṣata | mṛdunā sāntvayuktena vacasā bhayapīḍitām ||3 3 || mā bhīrbhavatu te bhadre patistehaṃ sumadhyame | mṛgarājo gatosau ca samāśvasa mama priye || 64|| taṃ samāśvasya sāpaśyat patirūpaṃ mahāyaśā | hṛdā cācintayad dṛṣṭo mayāsau tairmṛgaiḥ saha ||65 || jīvitaiṣī palāyan vai kutoyaṃ punarāgataḥ | devendro mā durācāraḥ sadā dharṣatyatandritaḥ ||66|| soyaṃ kāmayituṃ prāptaḥ kinna syādantaraiṣivān | tasmād drakṣyāmyahaṃ samyag duṣṭaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā||67|| sanatkumāra uvāca etasminnantare sotha brahmadhanvā karegrahīt | tāmidaṃ cocivān haṣṭaḥ kiṃ tvaṃ cintayase hṛdā ||68| | na māmāliṅgasedya tvaṃ mṛtyorāsyādvinirgatam | nanu tehaṃ priyo bhartā mā krudho varavarṇini ||69|| tatastāṃ sa tadā dauṣṭyāt kapole samajighrata | pariṣvajya ca duṣṭātmā gātrairgātrāṇyapīḍayat ||8.57.70|| nīvīṃ vyasraṃ sayaccaiva adharaṃ cāpibad balāt | bubudhe sā ca taṃ duṣṭaṃ karmaṇā tena śobhanā ||71 || sudharmovāca na tvaṃ mama patirmūḍha śakrastvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | na bhūyo madanasyāsmi viṣayohaṃ sudurmate||72|| sa tayāpyevamuktastu avadhūtaśca sarvaśaḥ | papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe svaṃ ca rūpaṃ prapadyata ||73| | tataḥ sā krodhatāmrākṣī dhakṣyamāṇeva cakṣuṣā | nirīkṣya vadanaṃ subhrūridaṃ vacanamabravīt ||74| | ṛṣipatnyastvayā bahvyo vyaṃsitāḥ duṣṭacetasā | na mādṛśī tvayā kācidanyā hyasāditā purā ||75|| idānīṃ karmaṇastasya pūrvamācaritasya te | phalaṃ prāptamidaṃ paśya matsakāśād durāsadam |||76|| yadeva rūpaṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ mṛgānatrāsayo balāt | vicariṣyasi tenaiva rūpeṇa bahulāḥ samāḥ | |77| | aśaktaścāpi hantuṃ tvaṃ bhavitā mānuṣaṃ kvacit | ṣaṣṭhe ca kāle saṃprāpte mṛgaṃ bhakṣyamavāpsyasi ||78| | sanatkumāra uvāca abhivyāhṛtya taṃ krūraṃ śubhācārā manasvinī | jagāma tānmṛgām̐stveva tataḥ patimapaśyata | |79| | sopi duḥkhena santapto manvānastāṃ hateti ca | vilapanneva tāṃ dṛṣṭavā pariṣvajyedamabravīt ||8.57.80 || diṣṭyā tvamasi saṃprāptā mṛtyorāsyādviniḥsṛtā | kaccinna tena dṛṣṭāsi mṛgarājena śobhane | |81 | | sudharmovāca nāsau mṛgendro durbuddhiḥ kopyasau kāmarūpavān | madarthaṃ samanuprāpto mayā dagdhaḥ pataṅgavat ||82| | sa śāpānmama duṣṭātmā śārdūlaprakṛtiṃ gataḥ | rājeva śaktiśāpena saudāso rākṣasīṃ tanum | |83 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā hālo dharmārthatattvavit | divyena cakṣuṣāpaśyad brahmadhanvānamavyayam | |84|| tāmuvāca satīṃ bhāryāmidaṃ sa karuṇātmakaḥ | kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ tvayātreyi sadbhiḥ karma vigarhitam ||85|| mahatastapasastedya kṣayoyaṃ sumahān kṛtaḥ | na duṣyanti striyaḥ sādhvi nadyo yadvad vigāhanaiḥ ||86|| na caiva śakyaṃ dharmeṇa saṃguptāṃ tvāṃ pramarditum | yathā viṣeṇa saṃchannamannaṃ bhoktuṃ hi mānavaiḥ | |87| | atra te varttayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ mahātape | yat pativratayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ dīptena tejasā ||88| | āsīd bhalandano nāma ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ | vidvām̐ścaiva dayāvām̐śca pṛthivīvad vyavasthitaḥ | |89 || ṛgnāmnī tasya bhāryābhūd vāsiṣṭhī puṇyalakṣaṇā | rūpeṇāpratimā sādhvī na tasyāḥ strīḥ samā kvacit ||8.57.90 | | pativratā mahābhāgā sarvadharmaviduttamā | tasyāḥ patimṛte nānyaddaivataṃ bhuvi vidyate || 91 | | apaśyata kadācidvai devāstau kamalekṣaṇām | tasyā rūpaguṇonmattā lebhurna dhṛtimekaśaḥ | |92| | na śakyate ca sā prāptuṃ na dūtībhirna karmaṇā | na dānena na saṃmānai rna balena na sevayā ||93 || vahnistāmagnyagārasthāṃ praviṣṭāmagrahīcchubhām | na cāpi sāhamasmīti na ca nāsmītyathābravīt ||94|| na krodho nāpi darposyā na māno na ca matsaraḥ | tasyāḥ priyamabhūnnānyat patimevānvacintayat | | 95 || vibhāvasurapi vyaktamiyaṃ māmicchatīti ha | abhyupetya na duṣṭeti bhāvena surasattamaḥ ||96| | atha hitvā svakaṃ dehamadehaḥ samapadyata | evaṃ vai bhāskaro vāyurvaruṇaścandra eva ca ||97| | sarve videhāḥ saṃvṛttāstatastāṃ saṃprasādayan | sāpi tānnāvadat kiñcit puruṣānaghaśaṃkayā | |98 | | bhartuścākathayat sarvaṃ sa tānidamuvāca ha | iyaṃ patnī mahābhāgā mama sarvāṅgasundarī | |99| | neyaṃ kupyati yuṣmākaṃ jāne hyasyā vrataṃ śubham | mattopi vo bhayaṃ nāsti nāhaṃ kupye kathañcana || 8.57.100 || matprasādādvidehāpi dehavanto bhaviṣyatha | tataste dehavanto vai tuṣṭuvustaṃ bhalandanam | | 101 | | ūcurvaraṃ vṛṇīṣvādya tuṣṭāḥ smastava sarvathā | sovāca rajasā nāryaḥ śuddhyantu madanugrahāt || 102 || karmaṇā ca vimucyantāṃ vyavahāryā bhavantu ca | sarvaśaucā bhaveyuśca aduṣṭāḥ sarvakarmasu || 103 | | hāla uvāca tataste taṃ namaskṛtya sabhāryaṃ brahmavādinam | jagmurdevāḥ praśaṃsantaḥ sarve vahnipurogamāḥ | | 1 04| | evaṃ tvamapi dharmajñe nityaṃ patimanuvratā | kastvāṃ samartho devopi spraṣṭumanye kuto janāḥ ||1 05| | tīrthabhūtāḥ striyaścāpi na duṣyanti kathañcana | madrūpaṃ kṛtavān yasmāttasmācchāpaṃ na cārhati | |1 0 6| | tasmātkariṣye tasyāhamadṛṣṭasyāpi śobhane | anugrahaṃ dharmayuktaṃ yena śreyo hyavāpsyati || 1 07| | vyāghrasyāpi priye tasya smṛtirnityaṃ bhaviṣyati | sarvakāryeṣu dharmeṣu dharmeṇa ca cariṣyati ||1 08|| yatosya kāmarūpitvaṃ yena mattaḥ sadā hyabhūt | tata eva punaḥ śreyaḥ prāpsyate madanugrahāt || 109|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa eṣa vyāsa duṣṭātmā viśvāmitrāśrame rataḥ | agrāraṇye sadā hyāsīddevyā gaṇāpatiḥ kṛtaḥ ||8.57.1 1 0|| ya idaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ dhārayecchrāvayīta vā | satataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vyāsa yogaiśvaryamavāpnuyāt ||1 1 1|| yogeśvaratvaṃ kāṃkṣadbhiretadadhyeyamantaśaḥ | janmāntaraṃ samāsādya prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ ||112|| śṛṇuyācca imaṃ satataṃ prayataḥ śucirekamanā manujaḥ | priyavatsa hi śakrasamānavapuḥ sukṛtena kṛtena pumān ||1 1 3|| iti skandapurāṇe saptapaṃcāśo’dhyāyaḥ <8.58> vyāsa uvāca varān gṛhītvā rudrāṇī tasmiñchikharisattame | akarot kimiti brūhi sarvaṃ devyā viceṣṭitam ||1|| sanatkumāra uvāca svayambhuvi gate devī tapaso virarāma ha | sā tuṣṭā varalābhena cintayantī tadā varam ||2|| nyavaikṣata diśaḥ sarvāḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇā | kasyaitat kathayāmīti devaṃ hitveti cābravīt ||3 || śāstrajñaṃ kañciduddiśya yathārthaṃ śāstracintakaḥ | putralabhbhakṛtaṃ harṣaṃ cintayantyā muhurmuhuḥ | |4|| apatajjalamatyarthaṃ śītalaṃ su sugandhi ca | bahvabhūt sarasi svacchaṃ tasyāstattejasā jalam | | 5 | | śiṣye buddhiguṇeneva guruṇā jñānamāhitam | vigāhamānā sā devī tatsaro vimalodakam | | 6 | | reje viyanmadhyagatā dīpteva savituḥ prabhā | vigāhamānā vyajahat kṛṣṇāṃ kośīṃ tadānaghā | |7| | sā vireje tayā muktā kalevendorghanātyaye | tasyāḥ kośyāḥ samabhavat kauśikī lokaviśrutā | viśvaṃ sisṛkṣato dhāturdehādiva purā niśā | |8| | vimbādharā tīkṣṇasucārudaṃṣṭrā prasannatārādhipacāruvaktrā | sujātanīlāṃcitadīrghakeśī kiñcitsamabhyunnataromarājī ||9| | susaṃsthitābhyāṃ caraṇāmbujābhyāṃ pradakṣiṇāvartanimagnanābhiḥ | vigūḍhajānvasthiśirā sugulphā vinākṛtevāmburuheṇa lakṣmīḥ | | 8.58.10 || prasannarūpā prathamodgatastanī praphullanīlāmbujacārulocanā | susaṃskṛtairvajramaṇipravekibhirvibhūṣitā cābharaṇaissumadhyamā || 11 || sāṅgadā baddhakeyūrā kaṭakodbhāsitatviṣā | bibhartti sā bhujānaṣṭau sāyudhānaparājitā || 12 | | baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇā kavacaṃ bibhratī śubham | durbhedyaṃ sahajaṃ bhāsvat sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ ||1 3 || nibaddhatūṇīrayugā pragṛhītaśarāsanā | vasānā padmakiñjalkarucire vāsasī tadā | |14| | jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śirasyādhāya cāñjalim | vyajñāpayata sā devī brūhi kiṅkaravāṇi te || 1 5| | mūrdhnyupāghrāya tāṃ devīṃ pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam | bhavānī prāha saṃhṛṣṭā mūrttisthānaṃ mamāvyaye ||1 6| | jarāmaraṇahīnā tvaṃ śokaduḥkhavivarjitā | bhaviṣyasi mahāyogā saṃyugeṣvaparājitā || 17| | kauśikīti ca nāmnā tvaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi | anyaiścanāmabhiḥ ślāghyairguṇakarmābhisaṃśrayaiḥ ||18|| tava bhaktāḥ smariṣyanti yeti durgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ | durgāṇi te tariṣyanti tvatprasādādvarānane | |19| | varā vareṇyā varadā durgā sarvārthasādhanī | itthaṃ tvāṃ nāmabhirdivyaiḥ stoṣyanti munayaḥ sadā | |8.58.20 || jāpaiḥ praṇatibhirhomairupahāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ | prāṇinaḥ pūjayiṣyanti bhavatīṃ bhuvi sarvadā ||21 || siṃhayuktaṃ tato devī rathamādityavarcasam | sasarja sapatākaṃ ca kiṃkiṇījālamaṇḍitam | vindhyaṃ girivaraṃ cāsyā nivāsāya samādiśat ||22| | sanatkumāra uvāca saiva muktā tadā devī praṇamya bhuvaneśvarīm | āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ kārtasvaramayaṃ śubham | | 23 || vyomagena rathenātha nānāratnāṃśumālinā | jagāmāśu tato vindhyaṃ nānādrumalatānvitam | |24| | vihaṅgavirutairvindhyaḥ svāgateneva kauśikīm | apūjayadameyāṃ tāṃ tatra prāptāṃ tadānaghām | |25|| vāribhirvimalaiḥ śoktaṃnirjharodaraniḥsṛtaiḥ | sa puṣpanikaraiḥ puṇyairarghañcāsyai dadanniva | | 26| | atha mṛgapatināgaṃ trastaparyantanāgaṃ cakitahariṇayūthakṣuṇṇadarbhāṅkurāgram | varamahiṣaviṣāṇacchinnagulmāvatānaṃ girivaramati ramyaṃ kauśikī sābhyapaśyat | |27|| vyarocayata sā devī vāsāya śikharaṃ gireḥ | utphullaṃ pādapālīnavihaṅgagaṇanāditam | |28| | nirjharodakasaṃparkaharitopalaśādvalam | nānādrumalatāpuṣpasurabhīkṛtamārutam || 29 || tuhinanikaraśītairnirjharāmbupravāhairnicitapṛthunitambottuṅgaparyantasānum | girivaraśikharaṃ tatsādhyuvāsātha devī kusumitataruśākhāśliṣṭamattadvirepham | |8.58.3 0 | | ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ | kauśikyāḥ saṃbhavaṃ samyak sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||3 1 || iti skandapurāṇe kauśikīsambhavo nāma aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.59> sanatkumāra uvāca tatastāṃ kauśikīṃ tatra prasthāpya himavatsutā | vireme tapasastīvrāt sasnau ca vidhivattadā ||1 | | vasānā vāsasī śukle divya sraganulepanā | pārśvasthaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya provāca varadāsmi te | | 2|| evamuktavatīṃ devīṃ śikharī mūrttimān tadā | praṇipatya varaṃ vavre mayi sānnidhyamastu te ||3 | | nāma caiva mama khyātiṃ tava nāmā bhilakṣitam | yātu lokeṣu sarveṣu tvatprasādānmaheśvari | |4|| agniśca varadāṃ vavre māgāḥ kopaṃ mayīśvari | sadā puṣpaphalatvaṃ ca vṛkṣāstāṃ tatra vavrire ||5| | suprasannā bhavāsmākaṃ tvayi bhaktiśca nostviti | tatastāṃ vavrire devīṃ sarvāśca paricārikāḥ | |6 || upāsyamānā bahvībhirdevatābhirgirīndrajā | abhibhūyānyatejāṃsi bhānavīva babhau prabhā | |7|| hṛdayepi sthitā patyuḥ patyau hṛdayasaṃsthite | sā vai girīndratanayā viyuktā smītyamanyata ||8| | atha sā tejasāṃ dhāma patiṃ sarvajagatpatim | varadā varadaṃ draṣṭuṃ gamanāyopacakrame | |9|| namaskṛtā tadvanadevatābhiḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya samiddhamagnim | ṛṣīm̐stato vandyatamābhivandya janañca teṣāṃ pratipūjya pūjyam ||8.59.1 0 | | utpapāta tato vyoma sā sārddhaṃ somanandinā | siṃhena ca jagaddhātrī gaṇaiḥ parijanena ca | | 11 | | viyati jaladavṛndān vikṣipantī svadhāmnā himajalakaṇaśītairvījyamānā marudbhiḥ | girivaratanayā sā patyureva smarantī madanadahanamūrterāśu pārśvaṃ jagāma || 12 | | iti skandapurāṇe ūnaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.60> sūta uvāca athāsau brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ vyāsaḥ prāha kṛtāñjaliḥ | kimarthaṃ kauśikī vindhyaṃ devyā saṃpreṣitā tadā | | 1 | | evamuktastadā dhīmān vyāsena brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | yathāvṛttaṃ purā sarvamākhyātumupacakrame ||2 | | ārirādhayiṣurdevīṃ vindhyastepe purā tapaḥ | tatastuṣṭābravīnvindhyaṃ pārvatī varadāsmi te | |3 | | mayi vāsostu te nityamevamādityarodhanaḥ | vavre girīndratanayāṃ prāha sā ca tathāstviti ||4|| svatanuṃ sā dvidhābhūtāmagnerdīptāṃ śikhāmiva | dāhāya dānavendrāṇāṃ prāhiṇot kauśikīmataḥ | |5 | | atha taṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūnumuvāca munisattamaḥ | girirvindhyo mahāprajña kathamādityarodhanaḥ | | 6| | sanatkumāraḥ provāca pṛṣṭo vyāsena dhīmatā | śṛṇu yasmādabhūdvindhyo girirādityarodhanaḥ | |7 || purā vindhyobravīt sūryaṃ kasmāttvaṃ na karoṣi mām| | pradakṣiṇaṃ yathā meruṃ kā tevajñā mayi prabho | |8|| sa uvāca tadā vindhyaṃ naivaṃ kartuṃ hi śakyate | pratyākhyātaḥ sa sūryeṇa vindhyo giriravardhata | ruddhā tasya sthito mārgaṃ tasmādādityarodhanaḥ | |9 || naṣṭāloke tato loke devāḥ saṃvignacetasaḥ | agastyamupasaṃgamya vākyamūcuḥ samāhitāḥ | | 8.60.10 | | saviturmārgamāvṛtya girirvindhyo vyavasthitaḥ | taṃ vāraya mahāprājña gatirnaḥ sarvadā bhavān | | 11 || tatogastyo giriṃ gatvā provācetthaṃ mahātapāḥ | yāsyāmi dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ panthānaṃ dehi parvata || 1 2|| yāvatpratinivartteyaṃ tāvacca sthātumarhasi | tataḥ prabhṛti caiveha nābhūdāgamanaṃ muneḥ ||1 3|| atha papraccha taṃ vyāsaḥ pitāmahasutaṃ prabhum | kauśikī prahitā vindhyaṃ dānāvānāṃ vināśane ||14|| ke te kasya kimarthaṃ vā kauśikyā dānavā hatāḥ | etat sarvaṃ samāsena mune me vaktumarhasi ||1 5|| pitāmahasuto dhīmān vyāsenaivaṃ pracoditaḥ | praśnametaṃ samāsena vyākhyātumupacakrame || 16 | | devāsure purātīte saṃyuge paramādbhute | sundo nisundaśca sutau niśumbhasya babhūvatuḥ | | 17| | hatān niśamya tau bandhūnsuraiḥ sarvānmahāhave | devānprati susaṃkruddhau garjantau govṛṣāviva || 18 || siṃhāviva mahāsattvau hṛtadaṃṣṭrānakhāyudhau | śvasantau saviṣāvugrau bhagnadaṃṣṭrāvivoragau || 19|| aśaktau tau surairyoddhuṃ hatapakṣau mahāsurau | suparṇāviva saṃkruddhau chinnapakṣau mahābalau ||8.60.2 0 || ...ṇaḥ sutau caitau gokarṇaṃ prati jagmatuḥ | ārirādhayiṣū devaṃ brahmāṇamamitaujasau | |2 1 || athovāca tato vyāso gokarṇaṃ kathayasva me | kasmindeśe kimarthaṃ vā kena votpāditaṃ purā ||22|| provāca brāhmaṇaḥ sūnurvyāsenaivaṃ pracoditaḥ | śṛṇu vatsa samāsena puṇyaṃ gokarṇasaṃbhavam ||23 | | hate triśirasi tvaṣṭā putre jyāyasi vajriṇā | bṛtraṃ nāma tataḥ putramasṛjattapasāṃ nidhiḥ | |24| | pralambabāhuṃ vṛttāsyaṃ pīnavistīrṇavakṣasan | suśliṣṭajānu sahanuṃ jaladadhvānanisvanam ||25| | svakṣaṃ supārśvaṃ sukaṭiṃ dīrgharaktāntalocanam | samare sarvadevānāṃ jetāramaparājitam | |26 || sa nirjityāmarān sarvān jagrāsendraṃ mahādyutiḥ | tato maharṣibhiḥ sṛṣṭā jṛmbhikā taṃ samāviśat ||27|| tasyātha jṛmbhamāṇasya nirjagāma śatakratuḥ | vadanādāśu saṃkṣipya svāṃ tanuṃ yogamāyayā | |28 || tasya yogabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīryaṃ śauryaṃ ca saṃyuge | tato bhītāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | |29| | tāndṛṣṭvā sa tadā bhītānamarān suravidviṣaḥ | provācāśu prajeśānaḥ padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ ||8.60.3 0 | | parājitān vo jānāmi vṛtreṇa raṇamūrdhani | upāyaṃ taṃ na paśyāmi yenāsau jīyate yudhi | |3 1ḥ | yāsyāma sahitāḥ sarve devaṃ draṣṭumumāpatim | viśveśvaraṃ vidhātāraṃ varadaṃ bhaktavatsalam ||3 2|| sa naḥ praṇāmairbhaktyā ca stutyā cārādhitaḥ prabhuḥ | mahādevo mahāyogī śambhuḥ śāntiṃ vidhāsyati ||33|| athottasthuḥ surāḥ sarve devadevaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ | apaśyanto viceruśca mahīṃ sodadhiparvatām ||34|| atha viṣṇurmahāyogī devīṃ himavataḥ sutām | apaśyat pāṃśudigdhāṅgīmāsīnāṃ bālarūpiṇīm | |35|| lekhāmiva navāmindoḥ prātaḥ sūryaprabhāmiva | haviṣā hūyamānasya tanvīmagneḥ śikhāmiva ||36|| vijñāya sa tadā yogānmahāyogāṃ sureśvarīm | īśvaro jagato viṣṇurjiṣṇustuṣṭāva pārvatīm ||37|| viṣṇuruvāca tvaṃ sraṣṭrī sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃhartrī tvaṃ sureśvari | tvamasya jagato dhātrī nityā prakṛtiravyayā | |38|| tvaṃ prabhā śarvarī jyotsnā kīrtistuṣṭirumā dhṛtiḥ | buddhimedhā smṛtiḥ prajñā sandhyā kāntiḥ stutirmatiḥ ||39|| tvamīśā devi devānāṃ gaṇamātā gaṇāmbikā | bhadrakālī mahāgaurī kauśikī vindhyavāsinī ||8.60.40 | | durgā khyātirmahāvidyā gāyatrī tvaṃ sarasvatī | svāhā svadhā mahāmāyā lakṣmīryogeśvareśvarī ||41 || ulkā satī gireḥ putrī maitreyī brahmacāriṇī | tāpasī revatī ṣaṣṭhī varāvarasahasradā | |42 | | kundakārmukasāraṅgakokilāśokapallavaiḥ | tulyāsi dantabhrū netrasvarapāṇibhirīśvari | |43 || pramattotphullapūrṇantān nāgotpalaniśākarān | viśinakṣi sadā devi gatilocanakāntibhiḥ ||44| | śirobhirmahiṣodbhrāntaraktaparyantalocanaiḥ | nṛbhiḥ kṣititalanyastakarajānumirijyase ||45|| mattānyapuṣṭākalavalgubhāṣitā dvirephamālāsitacārumūrdhajā | praphullapuṣpastabakodgatastanī virājase kalpalateva puṣpitā ||46|| devi devībhiraniśaṃ bhaktyābhivandyase divi | ijyase munibhiḥ śaśvad girije girimūrdhasu ||47|| arcyase ddhigandharvairgandhapuṣpotkaraiḥ sadā | sadāgatipathaṃ prāptā prāptyā ca stūyasenaghe ||48|| bhāsi siṃhaṃ samārūḍhā calatpiṅgalakesaram | dīptā prabheva sāvitrī merumūrdhānamāsthitā ||49|| jighāṃsatī raṇe daityāñcharaughairbhāsyajihmagaiḥ | ravermūrtistamāṃsīva vikiranto gabhastibhiḥ ||8.60.50|| paraśuṃ śitamudagṛhya devadānavasaṃyuge | bhrājase devi saṃkruddhā pāṭayantīva rodasī ||51|| atha sā śaiśavaṃ hitvā tanumanyāṃ samādade | ekīkṛtāmivākāśe saṃhatiṃ sarvatejasām | |52|| dīptāmapi sukhālokāṃ śāntāmapi savibhramām | bālāmapi jagaddhātrīṃ tanvīmapi susaṃhatām ||53|| uvācedaṃ ca sā prītā varadāsmi tava prabho | evamuktastayā sotha provācāmbhodanisvanaḥ ||54|| śaraṇye devi bhaktānāṃ śaraṇāgatavatsale | bhavāni bhava me nityaṃ suprasannā maheśvari ||55|| kathayasva ca deveśaṃ śāśvataṃ sthāṇumavyayam | viśvātmānaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvayogeśvareśvaram ||56|| tathāstviti pratijñāya kathayāmāsa śaṃkaram | mṛgayūthasya madhyasthaṃ krīḍantaṃ mṛgarūpiṇam ||57| | ekaśṛṅgaṃ mahāgrīvamekākṣamamitaujasam | ekapādaṃ susaṃśliṣṭamāpāṇḍukapilodaram | |58| | atha viṣṇurdrutaṃ gatvā śṛṅge jagrāha taṃ prabhum | tasminneva tato brahmā jagrāhendraśca vīryavān ||59| | tridhā tadabhavacchṛṅgaṃ calitaṃ dīptatejasam | trayāṇāṃ suramukhyānāṃ pṛthak pāṇiṣu saṃsthitam | |8.60.60 | | athādṛśyastadā śarvastānuvāca surottamān | yadarthamāgatā yūyaṃ tad brūta surasattamāḥ ||61 || athovāca tadā brahmā parameśaṃ vṛṣadhvajam | rājyaṃ punaravāpnotu hatvā vṛtraṃ purandaraḥ | | 62 || tatastānamarān tatra vṛṣaketuḥ samāgatān | svareṇa vāridadhvānagambhīreṇābravīttataḥ | |63 || vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ tejaḥ phenamācakṣyate surāḥ | śiraśchetsyati vṛtrasya tadādāya śatakratuḥ | |64| | hṛṣīkeśotha tatkhaṇḍamanayat svaṃ niketanam | nyaveśayata tatraiva vārijodarasaṃbhavaḥ || 65|| nīyamānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca khaṇḍamākhaṇḍalena tu | rakṣasāmadhipaḥ śrīmān jagrāhātha daśānanaḥ ||66|| cakāra sandhyāmudadhau dakṣiṇe nyasya tattadā | na vicālayituṃ śaktaḥ sandhyāmāsthāya rāvaṇaḥ| |67|| tatpuṇyaṃ devadevasya vyāsa kṣetraṃ mahādyute | gokarṇamiti nāmāsya cakāra kamalāsanaḥ || 68| | tatra gatvā naro bhaktyā praṇipatya maheśvaram | aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | |69|| gokarṇamuttaraṃ vyāsa sthāpitaṃ padmayoninā | udanvataḥ sthitaṃ tīre svayameva tu dakṣiṇe ||8.60.70|| yaḥ śṛṇoti naro nityaṃ puṇyagokarṇasaṃbhavam | sarvapāpavidhūtātmā sa yātiparamāṃ gatim ||71 || atha tau dānavau vyāsa gokarṇamabhijagmatuḥ | tatra ceraturatyugraṃ tapombupavanāśanau ||72|| kasyacittvatha kālasya viditvograṃ tayostapaḥ | ājagāma tayoḥ pārśvaṃ brahmā suranamaskṛtaḥ ||73|| atha tau viśvadhātāraṃ caturvaktraṃ pitāmaham | apaśyatāṃ mahābāhū brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam ||74|| śuklāmbaradharaṃ dīptaṃ śuklasraganulepanam | ekīkṛtamasaṃprekṣyaṃ tejo dinakṛtāmivam ||75|| prītosmi yuvayoḥ putrāvathovāca pitāmahaḥ | anena tapasogreṇa varaṃ brūta mabhīpsitam ||76|| amaratvaṃ tu vavrāte tau praṇamya pitāmaham | brahmāthāha vinā devānamṛtatvaṃ na vidyate ||77|| avaśyameṣyo yuvayormṛtyurekena kenacit | athāmaratvaṃ vavrāte parasparavadhaṃ vinā ||78|| evamastviti tābhyāṃ taṃ varaṃ dattvā pitāmahaḥ | haṃsayuktena yānena jagāma svaṃ niketanam ||79|| asurāvapi tau tasmāttapasogrādvirematuḥ | ājagmaturniketaṃ svaṃ varaṃ labdhvā pitāmahāt ||8.60.80|| varadānaṃ tato jñātvā daityāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ | ājagmurdānavāścaiva tayoḥ pārśvaṃ mudānvitāḥ ||81 || keśī muro mayaḥ śambhuḥ kārtasvaramahāravau | indraśatruḥ katirdhundhustvilvalo namucirdrumaḥ ||82 | | vātāpī dundubhirmeghaḥ prabhuranye ca dānavāḥ | sarve kavacinaḥ śūrā gadāparighapāṇayaḥ | |83 | | ūcuśca śokamagnānāmasmākaṃ śatrutāpanau | yuvāṃ plavāvivāyātau śokasāgaratāraṇau ||84|| purepratibhaye ramye kāntāṃ nāma tataḥ sabhām | ājagmustuṣṭamanaso dānavendrāḥ samāgatāḥ | |85| | tasyāṃ praśaste vistīrṇe śātakaumbhe varāsane | āsasāda mahābāhuḥ sundo dānavasattamaḥ | |8 6|| nisundonyattato bheje hemaratnamayaṃ śubham | āsasāda tato dhīmān kārtasvaramayaṃ mayaḥ||87|| anye ca dānavā bhejurāsanāni tadā mune | hemaratnavicitrāṇi bhāsvanti ca mahānti ca | |88 || vireje sā sabhā tatra dānavendraiḥ samāgataiḥ | sabalākaistaḍitvadbhiḥ pralaye dyaurivāmbudaiḥ | |89 || athonnāmya śiro ratnamarīcipariveṣavat | sundo vacanamāhetthamammodarucirasvanaḥ | |8.60.90 || dānavendrāḥ kariṣyāmi sarveṣāmaśrumārjanam | vijitya daivataiḥ sārddhamindramāhavamūrdhani ||91 | | prayāma daṃśitāḥ sarve sajjībhavata dānavāḥ | trailokyavijayaṃ kartumudyatāyudhapāṇayaḥ | |92 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prabhuḥ prāhāsureśvaram | yajñairvrataistapobhiśca niyamaiścāsuradviṣaḥ ||93|| āpyāyayanti saṃrabdhāḥ śaśvadvarṇāśramā bhuvi | tāneva prathamaṃ hatvā tato jeṣyāma devatāḥ ||94|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prāhurdānavasattamāḥ | āyatiṃ prathamaṃ hatvā vijeṣyāmastatomarān ||95|| athovāca tadā dhundhurmeghadundubhinisvanaḥ | rājānugāmī lokoyamapāpo badhyate katham ||96|| asmatto daivatai rājyaṃ lokaṃ hatvā purā hatam | vikrameṇaiva nirjitya daityarājyaṃ surairhṛtam ||97|| tathā tebhyo vayamapi protthitadhvajasaṃkule | āneṣyāmo raṇe jitvā śriyamāvignalocanām ||98|| apakāre sati same svabhāvena manasvinām | tejo vijṛmbhate dīptaṃ śaktimatsveva sarvadā ||99|| atha dhundhorvacaḥ śrutvā muro murajanisvanaḥ | uccairutkṣipya mūrdhānaṃ provāca prahasanniva || 8.60.10 0|| purābhavan mahātmāno dānavendrā mahābalāḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurvṛtraḥ prahlādo namucirbaliḥ | |1 01 || koṭiśo dānavāścānye mahāsatvā mahābalāḥ | yaiḥ kṛtā prasabhaṃ lakṣmīḥ svavakṣaḥsthalavāsinī ||1 02|| alpāvaśeṣairadhunā yuṣmābhirasurottamāḥ | kathamānīyate rājyaṃ surānnirjitya saṃyuge | |1 03| | iṣṭārthasādhakenāśu deśakālāvirodhinā | upāyena parīpsadhvaṃ rājyamanyena kenacit || 1 04|| etachrutvā tadā vākyamaṃśumālī mahāsuraḥ | provāca madhuraṃ ślakṣṇamarthānugamidaṃ vacaḥ | |1 05|| sāparādhā balīyāṃso baddhavairāśca dānavaiḥ | jayinaḥ śrīmadonmattāḥ sāma deveṣvanarthakam | |1 0 6|| sureṣu mānasī siddhirvibhutā bhuvanatraye | aṇimādyairguṇairyogasteṣu dānamapārthakam | | 1 07| | ekārthā nārthinaḥ sarve saṃhatāścāsuradviṣaḥ | na te bhedayituṃ śakyā dānaiste dānavottamāḥ | |1 08| | mantraprabhāvaśaktibhyā mutsāhena pareṇa ca | saṃpannāḥ sarvathā devā na yuddhaṃ taiḥ saheṣyate | | 1 09|| yukto dānavamukhyānāṃ hīna sandhiḥ suraissaha | sthānavṛddhiṃ parīpsūnāṃ kṣīṇānāmadhunā bhṛśam | |8.60.1 10 || athāha tejasā svena tejāṃsi suravidviṣām | abhibhūya sadasyuccairaṃśumānaṃśumāniva | |1 11 | | praṇāmapūrvaḥ kriyate hīnasandhiḥ kurājabhiḥ | na cakrurdānavāḥ pūrvaṃ kurvate na ca sāṃpratam | | 1 12|| śirāṃsi dānavendrāṇāṃ kathaṃ yāsyanti namratām | sumeroriva śṛṅgāṇi bhānumantyucchritāni ca ||113 | | ādāsyāmotha vā rājyaṃ devānnirjitya saṃyuge | prāpsyāmo vā gatiṃ puṇyāṃ nihatāḥ samaremaraiḥ ||1 14|| itthamaṃśumataḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ vākyārthakovidaḥ | gambhīramarthavat prāha mahiṣo vadatāṃ varaḥ | |1 1 5| | viditaṃ vaḥ samastānāṃ pūrvajā bhavatāṃ yathā | hatā dānavaśārdūlā vikramaikarasāḥ suraiḥ || 11 6| | tadalaṃ dānavaśreṣṭhā vṛttyā vognipataṅgayoḥ | sandhāya daivataissārdha vṛttiṃ kurmaḥ svakarmabhiḥ ||1 17|| jyāyobhirdānavā devai randhravyasanavarjitaiḥ | vigraheṇa kathaṃ siddhimicchatha srastaśaktayaḥ | | 1 18|| guṇātiśayayuktānāṃ yānamabhyuccaye sati | mantrotsāhaprabhāvāṇāmavāptau deśakālayoḥ || 11 9| | atha saṃbhūya yānena manyadhve siddhimātmanaḥ | daṃśitāḥ samare yattāḥ sametā yakṣarākṣasaiḥ | | 8.60.120 || rakṣāṃsi hutaśeṣāṇi jvalane śaktisūnunā | śritāni daivatānyeva bhītānyabalavanti ca ||1 21 | | āyattā sarvadā yakṣāḥ kuberesurasattamāḥ | sa cāpi suramukhyānāṃ kurute kāryamudyataḥ || 1 22|| anyatra daityaśatrubhyo bhuvaneṣu balīyasaḥ | abhāvādasuraśreṣṭhā dvaidhībhāvo na vidyate || 123 | | mahiṣe sadasi svasthamityuktavati dānave | vispaṣṭamarthavadvākyaṃ drumaḥ prāha mahāsuraḥ | | 1 24| | samare nirjitaiḥ pūrvamasmābhirabalaissaha | jayinaḥ śaktisaṃpannāḥ saṃdhāsyante kathaṃ surāḥ | |125| | saṃvidhāyāśu durgāṇi parvatānudakāni ca | vijaye satataṃ yuktā vigṛhyāsanamāsmahe ||226|| nāśayantaḥ sadā yajñān vratāni niyamāṃstathā | varṇāśramāṃśca lokesmin jighāṃsantaḥ samantataḥ | | 1 27| | tato lokavināśena vicchinne satkriyāpathe | viditvāpacitān devānabhiyāsyāma daṃśitāḥ | |1 28| | atha te tasya vacanaṃ sarva evānumenire | āsannamṛtyavopathyamannaṃ prāṇabhṛto yathā || 1 29| | uttasthurlokanāśāya matiṃ kṛtvāmaradviṣaḥ | udanvanta ivodvelāḥ pralaye mārutākulāḥ || 8.60.130 | | jalada iva sunīlaḥ pīnavṛttonnatāṅgo himakarakaraśubhrāṃ hārayaṣṭiṃ dadhānaḥ | udapatadatha sundastvāsanāt svāttadānīṃ jaladhiriva vighūrṇan phenamālī yugānte | |1 31 | | tadanu tadanujombuvāhanīlaḥ parighabhujaḥ pṛthuraktadīrghanetraḥ | ajahadavimanāḥ svamāsanāntaṃ pratibhayakṛd dviṣatāṃ tadā nisundaḥ | | 13 2|| iti skandapurāṇe daityodyogo nāma ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.61> sanatkumāra uvāca atha dānavamukhyānāṃ lokanāśāya niryayau | mattavāraṇasambādhaṃ rathāśvavalitaṃ balam || 1 || tattadā dānavānīkaṃ visasāra diśo diśaḥ| pralaye mārutoddhūtamaudanvatamivodakam || 2 | | nijaghnurbrāhmaṇān kecit kecinniṣpipiṣurviśaḥ | tustubhuḥ kṣatriyānanye śūdrānanye babhakṣire | | 3 | | jaglasurllilihurnnedurbabhañjuśca samantataḥ | yajñeṣvannaṃ havirnādān yūpām̐ścāmaravidviṣaḥ | |4| | svadhītavedādhyayanābhināditān munipravekācitagulmapādapān | prabhūtacīrājinadarbhasaṃcayān nikāmaparyantahimāmbunirjharān | | 5|| upāntanīvāragavedhukācitān prasuptaviśvastamṛgarkṣavānarān | habirbhujo dhūmavitānasaṃkulān visṛtya cānye pravijaghnurāśramān ||6|| kecinmunīnāmasurā jīrṇoragasamatviṣaḥ | jaṭāḥ saṃgṛhya lulucuḥ kṣālitāstīrthavāriṇā | |7 | | pātayitvāsurāḥ keciccaraṇaiḥ pipiṣuḥ kṣitau | ṛṣīnātmavināśāya hutāśān jvalitāniva ||8|| śirāṃsi munipatnīnāṃ karaiḥ kecit talaistathā | pūtāni vāribhiḥ puṇyaiḥ paspṛśurdānavādhamāḥ ||9| | atha te jagṛhuryātrāṃ jñātvābhyudayamātmanaḥ | vikṣiptaṃ lokanāśāya balamāhūya sarvaśaḥ ||8.61.1 0 | | praśastehani nakṣatre muhūrtte ca jayānvite | sannāhabherīrāhatya kriyāścakrurjayāvahāḥ || 11 || sannāhyān balino sattānānāyya varavāraṇān | samyagabhyarcya varmāṇi babandhurvidhināsurāḥ || 1 2|| yantrāṇi dhautairnārācaiḥ pūrṇānyāsanapārśvayoḥ | babandhuḥ śaktipūrṇām̐śca veṇūn tiryagavasthitān ||1 3 || tomarān kaṇapān śaṃkūn śūlacakraparaśvadhān | ābabandhurniyuktāśca madhyamāsanapārśvayoḥ | | 14|| sajjāni paramāstrāṇi bāladhīm̐śca susaṃskṛtān | saṃpūrṇān gandhavāsobhirniśitāgraiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ ||1 5|| sannāhyānakuśām̐llauhān bālendusadṛśadyutīn | graiveyeṣu sitām̐ścakrurmadhye mastakapiṇḍayoḥ | |1 6 || kṣurapramālāṃ saṃyastāṃ śātakumbhamayīṃ śubhām | ābabandhuśca kumbheṣu gajānāṃ gajasādinaḥ ||17|| vaijayantīpatākāśca vicitrāḥ svabhilakṣitāḥ | ucchrayāmāsurāyattā dantyanīkasya dānavāḥ ||18|| ghaṇṭā vāraṇamukhyānāmāsasajju rmahāsvanāḥ | cāmarāṇi sudīrghāṇi haṃsāṃśurucirāṇi ca | |1 9| | ekaikasya catasraśca kareṇvaścārudarśanāḥ | sthāpitāḥ purato daityaiḥ paravāraṇavāraṇāḥ | |8.61.2 0 || yūno yuvabhirārūḍhān śikṣitānastrakovidaiḥ | cakruragresarānaśvān varmiṇo lohajālinaḥ ||21 || varmiṇo baddhakavacāñchitanistriṃśadhāriṇaḥ | teṣāṃ purassarān pattīnanuyātām̐śca dhanvibhiḥ || 22| | daityayodhāstataścānye varmiṇo lohajālinaḥ | ārūḍhā baddhanistriṃśāḥ snātapītām̐sturaṅgaḥmān | |23 || kecidvinītairyuvabhiḥ snapitaiḥ kṛtamaṅgalaiḥ | rathān saṃyojayāmāsuraśvairagrajavaistadā | |24|| āyudhān sapatākām̐śca kiṃkiṇījālanāditān | adhitasthustadā kecid rathān hāṭakasaṃskṛtān ||25 | | evaṃ tat kalpitaṃ śrutvā sainyaṃ sainyanamaskṛtaḥ | sundo dānavaśārdūlo niryayau kṛtamaṅgalaḥ | | 26 | | svīṣaṃ sukūbaraṃ svakṣaṃ śātakumbhamayaṃ varam | nānāmaṇimayaiścitrairbhaktipuṣpamṛgadvijaiḥ | | 27| | yuktaṃ paramasaṃhṛṣṭairmanovegaisturaṅgamaiḥ | āruhyātha rathaṃ divyaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam ||28|| kavacī baddhanistriṃśo vidhūtasitacāmaraḥ | abhitaḥ stūyamānaśca sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ ||29 || nisundopi madaśyāmakapolālīnaṣaṭpadam | āruhya nirjagāmāśu sāṃgrāmikamanekapam || 8.61.30 | | anye ca dānavāstatra rathairaśvairmataṅgajaiḥ | niryayuḥ paramaprītā yuddhaśauṇḍāḥ sudaṃśitāḥ ||3 1 | | balasyāgresaraṃ kṛtvā tārakākṣaṃ mahāsuram | sahitaṃ bahubhiḥ śūrai rathanāgāśvapattibhiḥ | | 3 2|| pṛṣṭhataḥ saṃvidhāyāśu balonmattaṃ mahāsuram | balena caturaṅgeṇa mahiṣaṃ pārṣṇirakṣiṇam | |3 3 | | pārśvayorubhayornyasya meghasvanamahāsvanau | sainyena mahatā dṛptau dānavāvarisūdanau ||34| | madhye sundo nisundaśca mayaḥ śambhuḥ kharo muraḥ | sannaddhā balinaḥ śūrā parasainyavidāraṇāḥ | |3 5| | pratasthire susaṃyattā divaṃ dānavasattamāḥ | pralaye mārutoddhūtā ghanāḥ saṃvarttakā iva | |3 6| | teṣāmāgamanaṃ jñātvā saha svarlokavāsibhiḥ | apasṛtya jagāmāśu janasthānaṃ śatakratuḥ | | 37| | mero śikharamāruhya sarvetha sahitāstadā | senā niveśayāmāsurnandane te suradviṣaḥ || 38|| atha sainyasya daityendrā rakṣāmādhāya sarvaśaḥ | pravibhaktānasaṃbādhānāvāsān jagṛhustataḥ ||3 9 || dattānujñāstataḥ sarve dānavā dānavottamaiḥ | sannāhyamapaninyuste sarvopakaraṇaṃ tadā ||8.61.40 || ārūḍhā gajakanyāsu varmāṇi mumucuḥ śanaiḥ | āyudhānyapanīyāśu sainikā mattadantinām ||41 || sannāhānapaninyuśca mumucuḥ kavacāni ca | tanutrāṇi ca citrāṇi tadā dānavasainikāḥ | |42|| apeta kakṣān mātaṅgān snātapītān gataklamān | babandhuḥ kalpavṛkṣeṣu keciddānavasainikāḥ | |43 || kecit kalpadrumānnāgā madasaṃlīnaṣaṭapadāḥ | babhaṃjurbalinastrastamattodbhrāntavihaṅgamān ||44|| cukraśurbalinaḥ kecinmadaśyāmān mataṅgajāḥ | kapolān kalpavṛkṣeṣu puṣpālīnālipaṃktiṣu ||45|| nāgā jagāhire kecinmattā mandākinīṃ nadīm | haimavārijakiñjalkapiñjaropāntarodhasam ||46|| vimuktasāṅgrāmikavarmajālān prasannacittān parighṛṣṭakāyān | nipītatoyānapanītakhedān babandhuraśvānpṛthagaśvabandhāḥ ||47|| atha sūkṣmāṇi vāsāṃsi citrāśca paramāḥsrajaḥ | āninyuḥ kalpavṛkṣebhyaḥ phalāni madhurāṇi ca ||48|| haimāni kecit padmāni tadrajoruṇamūrttayaḥ| babhañjurdānavā hṛṣṭā gatā mandākinīṃ nadīm | |49|| āninyuḥ sainikāḥ kecinmandārakusumotkarān | phalānyājahrire kecit svādūni ca bahūni ca ||8.61.50 || tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ bherīrāhatya dānavāḥ | tenaiva vidhinā yattāḥ prajagmuramarāvatīm ||51 || tatastūryaninādena gajānāṃ bṛṃhitena ca | siṃhanādaiśca daityānāṃ cacālevāmarāvatī ||52|| atha śūnyāṃ samudvīkṣya purīṃ dānavasattamāḥ | itthamūcuḥ susaṃhṛṣṭā nadanto bhairavasvanam ||53 | | jayati vibudhaśatruḥ sundadaityendrasiṃhaḥ kaṭhinarucirabāhuḥ pīnavistīrṇavakṣāḥ | śatamakhapurajetā cārupṛthvāyatākṣaḥ sajalaghananinādo mattanāgendragāmī ||54|| tadanu jayati cāruprāntaraktāyatākṣo mṛgapatigatilīlaḥ saṃyugeṣvapradhṛṣyaḥ | tridaśavaravijetā dānavendro nisundaḥ prahatamurajanādaḥ pīnadīrghorubāhuḥ | |55|| iti skandapurāṇe amarāvatīpraveśo nāma ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.62> sanatkumāra uvāca atha nirjitya daityendrau divaṃ vikramaśālinau | jagmatuḥ sahitau daityairvindhyaṃ tuṅgaśiloccayam ||1 || saṃpūjya vidhivaddaityān prasthāpya bhrātarau tadā | remāte vindhyapādeṣu phullapādapasānuṣu ||2|| daityābhyāmatha vijñāya brahmā suraparābhavam | vicintyaikamanāḥ samyag vadhopāyaṃ tayostadā ||3 || tilaṃ tilaṃ samādāya ratnebhyaścārudarśanām | sasarja kamanīyāṅgīmaṅganāṃ valgunisvanām ||4|| tilottameti tasyāśca nāma cakre pitāmahaḥ | divyānāmapi sā strīṇāmupameva tadā babhau ||5|| atisaṃpūrṇavaktrāṃ tāmatīṃdīvaralocanām | atihaṃsasvanālāpāmatimattebhagāminīm ||6|| lakṣmīrnirīkṣya savrīḍā paṅkajenāvṛṇonmukham | vapurbhiścaiva cārvaṅgyāstrepurudyānadevatāḥ ||7|| tāmutpādya tato dhātā pākaśāsanamabravīt | śambhunā madanaḥ pūrvaṃ nirdagdho locanāgninā | |8|| tasya prodbhūtaye yāma sarve pārśva pinākinaḥ | tamārādhya tataḥ kurmmo yathā syānmadanaḥ punaḥ | |9|| atha te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ tayā cāsuravidviṣaḥ | jagmurvindhyagireḥ śṛṅgaṃ yatrāste bhagavān haraḥ ||8.62.10 || tatra śarvamapaśyanto dadhyuste surasattamāḥ | gṛṇantaḥ praṇavaṃ sarve śivasanyastacetasaḥ || 11 || atha liṅgaṃ samuttasthau teṣāṃ madhye divaukasām | susaṃhataṃ susaṃśliṣṭaṃ samūhastejasāmiva | |12| | uccacāra tadā tasmāduccairvāg viśadākṣarā | nirdagdhoyaṃ mayā pāpastapasvijanakaṇṭakaḥ || 13 | | yuṣmadarthe vimokṣyāmi kāryaṃ voyaṃ kariṣyati | karotu paritaśceyaṃ māṃ pradakṣiṇamaṅganā || 14|| evamuktā maheśena sā cakāra pradakṣiṇām | sannidhāyāñjaliṃ mūrdhni raktendīvarakomalam ||15|| neme mūrtiṃ tadā pūrvāṃ nissasāra tato mukham | tryakṣaṃ prasannabimboṣṭhamamitadyuti kāntimat | | 1 6| | atha tejo viniḥsṛtya vadanendoḥ pinākinaḥ | tāṃ viveśāṅganāmāśu śaradbhāskarabhāsvaram | |17|| atha sā dakṣiṇāṃ mūrttiṃ praṇeme cārudarśanā | nirjagāma tadā dīptaṃ mukhaṃ suragurostataḥ | |1 8|| vāribhārālasāmbhodarucimad bhīmanisvanam | karāladaśaśanodbhāsi dīptaraktāntalocanam || 19 || atyādityaṃ tatastejo mukhānniḥsṛtya dakṣiṇāt | dṛśyamānaṃ suraissarvairviveśa pramadottamām | | 8.62.20 | | praṇeme sā tatastasya paścimāṃ mūrttimañjasā || niścakrāma tatastasyā mukhaṃ tryakṣamanuttamam || 21 || tatastejo viniḥsṛtya mukhendormadanadviṣaḥ | dīpyamānaṃ viveśāśu tāmeva pramadottamām | |22 | | uttarāṃ mūtimāgatya praṇeme sā kṛtāñjaliḥ | tasyā mukhaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ suprasannaṃ viniryayau ||2 3 | | tasmāttejo viniḥsṛtya sūryadīptānalaprabham| viveśa pramadāmāśu tāmeva varavarṇinīm ||24| | mukhāni devadevasya surāṇāmarthasiddhaye | catvāri niryayurdikṣu na tasyā rūpavismayāt | |25|| ātmasaṃsthaṃ purā tejo dagdhvā yanmadanaṃ kṛtam | anujagrāha deveśastena tāṃ pramadottamām ||3 6|| abravīcca surān sarvām̐statredaṃ vacanaṃ śivaḥ | yasmādiyaṃ māṃ yuṣmāṃśca maṇḍalena pradakṣiṇam | |27| | cakre sarvān suraśreṣṭhāḥ sthānaṃ tasmādidaṃ mama | bhaviṣyati girau vindhye maṇḍaleśvarasaṃjñitam | | 28 || maṃḍaleśvarametacca yaḥ karoti pradākṣiṇam | pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā mahī bhavet | sānnidhyaṃ sarvadā hyasmin kariṣyāmi varapradaḥ ||29| | maṇḍaleśvaramīśānaṃ dṛṣṭavā tu prayato naraḥ | aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya mama lokamavāpsyati | |8.62.3 0 | | naikasiddhasamākīrṇaṃ kinnaroragasevitam | yuṣmābhiḥ sarvadā yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati mama priyam || 31 || eṣā tilottamā caiva yadarthaṃ surasattamāḥ | sṛṣṭā yuṣmābhiravyagrā tadvaḥ kāryaṃ kariṣyati | |3 2 | | etāmavekṣya tau daityau mohitau madanārditau | anyonyaṃ yāsyato nāśameṣā caiva bhaviṣyati | |3 3 || ajarā cāmarā caiva sarvāpsaravarā śubhā | pūjyā ceha sadā sthāne vandyā caiva bhaviṣyati ||34| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamukte maheśena surāḥ suprītacetasaḥ | tāṃ striyaṃ preṣayāmāsurvadhārthaṃ daityayostadā || 35|| sahāyān pradadau cāsyai brahmā kamalavāhanaḥ | krodhaṃ darpamṛtūtsarvān mātsaryaṃ madameva caḥ | |3 6|| kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca mohañca viṣādañcāmitadyutiḥ | atha saṃpreṣayitvā tu devatāstāṃ tilottamām ||37| | ātmānaṃ piṇḍayāmāsurdevāste sarva eva hi | kaḥ kaḥ katama āyāta ihādyeti surarṣabhāḥ | | 38|| tato madhye sthitaṃ natvā bhūyaste parameśvaram | piṇḍyamāneṣu deveṣu yasmānmadhye samāsthitaḥ | |3 9| | piṇḍāreśvara ityeva tatrāsāvabhavattataḥ | piṇḍāreśvaramīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā tu mānavaḥ | |8.62.40 || sarvāśubhavinirmukto dehabhede gaṇo bhavet | pṛthivyāṃ yāni liṅgāni caturmukhāyatanāni ca | |41 | | tāni sarvāṇi dṛśyāni idaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavanti hi | tatastā devatāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtvā kāryamatandritāḥ ||42|| praṇasya(mya) parameśānaṃ svāni sadmāni bhejire | sāpi cārumukhāpāṅgī pīnonnatapayodharā ||43 || ākṣipantīva cetāṃsi surāṇāṃ vibhramaistadā | pratasthe dakṣiṇāmāśāmāsāte yatra dānavau ||44|| vindhyapādeṣu ramyeṣu vihagodgītasānuṣu | bhramantāvatha daityendrau sthitāṃ dadṛśatustu tām ||45|| aśokaśākhāmutphullāmālambyonmattaṣaṭpadām | vasānāmaṃśukaṃ citramābaddha maṇimekhalām ||46| | gāyantīṃ madhuraṃ raktaṃ samaṃ kalamanākulam | tāramandrātitāraiśca svaraiḥ samyagalaṃkṛtam | |47|| sākṣādiva tapaḥsiddhiṃ śriyaṃ mūrttimatīmiva | prāptāmiva ratiṃ sākṣāt kāntiṃ cāndramasīmiva ||48| | mamaiveyaṃ mamaiveya miti tau dānavottamau | abhisṛtya tu tau devīṃ pāṇyorjagṛhatuḥ samam ||49|| atha darpamadakrodhamātsaryāviṣṭacetasau | tau cukrudhaturatyarthamanyonyasyāsurottamau || 8.62.50 | | tayorgadentakaḥ kālo mṛtyuścāviviśurdrutam | pragṛhyātha gade kruddhāvanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ | | 51 || athaikaikena tau tatra prahāreṇābhitāḍitau | viṣaṇṇau bhinnasarvāṅgau śivaśāpavimohitau ||52 || visaṃjñau patitau bhūmau chinnamūlāviva drumau | atha niryayatustatra kāmopahatacetasau ||53|| ātmānau saha śukreṇa tayordānavamukhyayoḥ | tau tadā nirgatau tatra tayorjīvau durātmanoḥ ||54|| balinau cārusarvāṅgau bālāvāśu babhūvatuḥ | ekastatrābravīdbālaḥ śuṃbhohaṃ dviṣatāmiti ||55|| niśuṃbhopyahamanyastu bālastatrāvadattadā | atha vindhyaḥ samāsādya bālau tāvamitadyutī ||56|| ādideśātmanaḥ patnīṃ pāhi tvaṃ bālakāviti | vavṛdhātetha tau tatra dānavendrasutāvubhau ||57|| kṛṣṇapakṣakṣaye yadvad yugapacchaśisāgarau | buddhvā tau ca tadā janma dānavābhyāmarindamau ||58|| tapaśceraturatyugraṃ parṇāmbupavanāśanau | tapasārādhitastābhyāṃ tatrāgatyābravītprabhuḥ ||59|| tuṣṭāsmi yuvayoḥ putrau varaṃ kiṃ vā dadānyaham | vavrāte tau varaṃ vīrāvajayyā vadhyatāṃ sadā ||8.62.60|| prārthanāṃ tāṃ tayoḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ | avaśyaṃ putrayoreṣyaṃ maraṇaṃ yenakenacit ||61|| surebhyonyatra daityendrāvamaratvaṃ na vidyate | ityuktavantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vavrāte dānavau varam ||62|| ubhāvapi suniścitya saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhau | jaganmātuśca yā kanyā vinā tasyāḥ pitāmaha ||63| | mā bhūtāmāvayordeva sadā mṛtyuparājayau | evamastviti tau procya daityendratanayāvubhau ||64|| viśvasya jagataḥ sraṣṭā tatraivāntaradhīyata | atha tau tapasastīvrādviramya kṛtamaṅgalau||65| | maulinau baddhakavacau hārāṅgadavibhūṣitau | haricandanadigdhāṅgau pītakauśeyavāsasau ||66|| vindhyaprastheṣu ramyeṣu ceraturdānavottamau | pitāmahād varaprāptiṃ śrutvā śuṃbhaniśuṃbhayoḥ ||67|| ājagmurdānavā hṛṣṭāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ | śaṃbhurmayo ghanaḥ keśirnarako namucirdrumaḥ | |68 || anye ca koṭiśo dṛptā hataśeṣāḥ suradviṣaḥ | vindhyaprasthe niṣeduste sametāḥ sarvadānavāḥ | |69|| nānādrumalatāgulmavikīrṇakusumotkare | dhanvino baddhanistriṃśāścitrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||8.62.70 || sendracāpāstaḍitvanto nabhasīva balāhakāḥ | athovāca mayastatra dānavo dānavottamau ||71 || pitṛbhyāṃ yuvayorbhuktaṃ trailokyamakhilaṃ purā | yuvābhyāmadhunā daityo kasmānnādīyate punaḥ | |72|| sametānamarān sarvānnirjitya raṇamūrdhani | ye sahāyā hi vāṃ pitro rbabhūvuḥ suravidviṣaḥ ||73 || ta evāmī balonmattāḥ sahāyā yuvayoryudhi | ityuktavati daityendre maye śumbho mahāsuraḥ | |74| | niśumbhasya mukhaṃ prekṣya vākyamitthaṃ tadābravīt | bhūrlokamakhilaṃ daityā yuṣmābhiḥ saha sāṃpratam | |75| | saṃvibhajya surānsarvāñjeṣyāmo raṇamūrdhani | jambūdvīpaṃ svayaṃ sotha jagrāhāsurasattamaḥ ||76 | | śākadvīpaṃ niśumbhāya dadau bhrātre kanīyase | śālmalidvīpagomedau dānavebhyo dadau prabhuḥ | |77|| krauñcadvīpakuśadvīpau daityebhyaḥ pradadau ca saḥ | daityendraḥ puṣkaradvīpaṃ bhārgavāya nyavedayat ||78| | evaṃ prativibhajyāśu bhūrlokamakhilaṃ tadā | ijyāñjalinamaskārān yajñān sarvāśca satkriyāḥ ||79|| ācchidya daivatebhyaste jagṛhurdaityadānavāḥ | babhūvātha tato yajñaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ||8.62.80 | | āgatya taṃ tadā yajñaṃ mamṛduḥ suraśatravaḥ | ādhipatyaṃ hi naḥ kṛtsne bhūrloke kaśyapādhunā | |8 1 | | sarvāvasthāsu yajñesminnasmān tvaṃ yaṣṭumarhasi | evamuktastato daityairmārīcaḥ kaśyapastadā | |82| | gambhīramarthavadvākyamuvācetthaṃ smayanniva | trailokyamātmanaḥ kṛtvā jitvā sarvāmarān raṇe ||83 | | yajñabhāgām̐stato daityāḥ sarvānādātumarhatha | evamuktāstadā tena daityadānavasattamāḥ | |84|| balaṃ sarvaṃ samādāya kṛtvā sāṅagrāmikīḥ kriyāḥ | praśasteṣu kṛtācārā muhūrtta rkṣadineṣu te ||85| | rathairnāgaisturaṅgaiśca niryayurdaityadānavāḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ purataḥ samyak pārśvayorubhayorapi | |86| | vidhāya rakṣo saṃyattā yayurdevān jigīṣavaḥ | teṣāmāgamanaṃ jñātvā dviṣatāṃ pākaśāsanaḥ | |87|| saṃhatānāṃ susaṃyatto yuddhvā nākaṃ jigīṣatām | vidhiṃ vidhāya svapure samastaṃ daurgakarmikam | |88|| puṇyeṣu tithinakṣatramuhūrtta karaṇeṣu saḥ | munīn vidhivadabhyarcya namaskṛtvā pinākine | |89|| sārdhaṃ suragaṇaiḥ sarverniryayau kṛtamaṅgalaḥ | himavacchikharākāraṃ caturdantamanekapam ||8.62.90 || āruhyairāvataṃ śaśvanmadatoyaughavarṣiṇam | mahatāhaimadaṇḍena ratnāṃśupariveṣiṇā | |91 || ucchritenātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena bhāsvatā | vījyamānaḥ śaraccandrakiraṇotkaranirmalaiḥ ||92|| cāmarai ratnadaṇḍāṃśusamūhakhacitodaraiḥ | āśīrbhirjayaśabdaiśca munibhiḥ parivarddhitaḥ |93 || abhitaḥ stūyamānaśca sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ | athāvakāśe vistīrṇe same pādapavarjite ||94|| racayāmāsa devānāṃ padmavyūhaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | marudbhiḥ sahitaṃ kṛtvā kaṇikāyāṃ śatakratumra||95|| patreṣu ca vasūn rudrānādityām̐śca nyaveśayat | keśareṣu yamaṃ kālaṃ kuberavaruṇāvapi | |96 || anantaṃ sahitaṃ nāgairnāle gururakalpayat | devānanyān sametām̐śca rakṣogandharvasenayā ||97|| punaḥ saraḥ sa padmasya paritaḥ paryakalpayat | atha dānavatūryāṇāṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā divaukasaḥ | |98|| ājaghnurmuditā bherīrnedurnādām̐śca saṃghaśaḥ | vimiśrān tūryaśabdena śrutvā nādān divaukasām ||99|| saṃyattāḥ sutarāṃ cakruḥ prayatnaṃ dānaveśvarāḥ | atha te dānavā dṛṣṭvā padmavyūhaṃ divaukasām ||8.62.1 0 0|| papracchurbhārgavaṃ tatra tadbhedamamitaujasaḥ | sa pṛṣṭo dānavaśreṣṭhairvyūhabhedamanākulaḥ | | 101 | | vicintya bhārgavo dhīmānītthamāhāsurām̐stadā | vikīrṇāḥ paritaḥ sarve tuṣāranikarā iva | | 102 | | padmavyūhaṃ surendrāṇāṃ hata samyak suradviṣaḥ | evamuktāstato daityā bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā | | 103 || siṃhanādaṃ vinadyāśu paritastebhisaṃpatan | tato yuddhaṃ samabhavad devadānavasainyayoḥ | | 1 04| | āyudhairvividhaistīkṣṇaiḥ parasparamabhidhnatoḥ | sādinaḥ sādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ nāgā nāgai rathā rathaiḥ || 10 5| | pattayaḥ pattibhirdṛptairdṛptā yuyudhire yudhi | kecidvibhinnā nārācaiśchinnāḥ kecit paraśvadhaiḥ || 10 6| | nipeturvyasavo yaudhāḥ senayorubhayorapi | chindhi bhindhi sahedānīṃ tiṣṭha mūḍha kva gacchasi | | 107 || iti vācaḥ sumuttasthuryudhi yodhairudīritāḥ | vasārudhirasaṃsiktaṃ tanutrāvaraṇācitam | | 10 8| | hatanāgāśvakalalaṃ tadbabhūva raṇājiram | atha tairdānavaistatra pīḍyamānā divaukasaḥ | | 109 | | savraṇā hatabhūyiṣṭhāḥ śakramevābhiśiśriyuḥ | anantaṃ nāgamukhyāśca kuberaṃ yakṣarākṣasāḥ | | 8.62.110 | | bhinne vyūheya devānāṃ prahṛṣṭā daityadānavāḥ | siṃhanādān vinadyoccai stūryāṇyāhatya bhūyaśaḥ | | 111 | | abhyadravantaḥ saṃyattāḥ samare pākaśāsanam | athotthāpya gajaṃ śakro vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | | 112 | | cūrṇayāmāsa saṃkruddho vetyadānavavāhinīm | dadāha dānavāmākaṃ paritaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | | 11 3 | | nidāghasamaye dīptaḥ śuṣkakakṣamivānalaḥ | atha śumbhaḥ samabhetya samare śakramabravīt | |1 14|| dṛṣṭosyadya mayā śakra na jīvan pratiyāsyasi | athāgatya tadā brahmā prāhetthaṃ surasattamān | |1 15| | na yoddhavyaṃ surā daityairavadhyā vaḥ suradviṣaḥ | na yoddhavyaṃ na yoddhavyaṃ surā daityairmahābalaiḥ | | 11 6|| pūrvalabdhavarā hyete avadhyāśca suradviṣaḥ | antardadhustatastasya vākyaṃ śrutvā divaukasaḥ | vihāya samaraṃ sarve kṣipraṃ sabalavāhanāḥ | | 117 || atha daityāḥ susaṃhṛṣṭāstūryāṇyāhatya bhūyaśaḥ | neduruccairvacaścedamūcuḥ samaraśālinaḥ | | 1 18|| turagakhurapuṭāntakṣuṇṇareṇvandhakāre dviradarathaninādatrastapādātavṛnde | vigatabhayaviṣādaḥ saṃyuge śuṃbhasiṃho jayati suravijetā vārivāhorunādaḥ | | 1 19| | tadanu jayati dīrghapīnathubāhuḥ pṛthurucironnatasaṃhatoruvakṣāḥ | mṛgapatigamanombuvāhanādaḥ samaravare vijayī niśuṃbhasiṃhaḥ | |8.62.1 20 || iti skandapurāṇe devāsurasaṃgrāme śuṃbhaniśuṃbhavijayo nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.63> atha nirjitya samare devān devadviṣastadā | ājagmuḥ sahitā vindhyaṃ śikharālīnatoyadam | | 1 | | prasthāpya vidhivat sarvān tau tadā daityadānavān | remāte sahitau vindhye kinnarodgītakandare | 2 | | ārakṣikastayostatra mūko nāma mahāsuraḥ | apaśyacchikhare devīṃ jvalantīmiva tejasā | |3 | | puṇyalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ puṇyābharaṇabhūṣitām | āgatāṃ tatra tāṃ siddhiṃ puṇyānāṃ karmaṇāmiva | |4|| atha mūkastadā devīṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ | dṛṣṭvā jagāma manasā śuṃbhaṃ dānavasattamam ||5 | | yatheyaṃ cārusarvāṅgī pradhānā sarvayoṣitām | tathā puṃsāṃ pradhānosau śumbho daityendracandramāḥ | | 6| | vistīrṇavakṣasastasya viśālajaghanasthalā | anurūpā bhavet patnī dīrghākṣasyāsitekṣaṇā | |7| | iti saṃcintya manasā tāmuvāca sumadhyamām | kā tvaṃ trasta samudbhrāntasṛgaśāva vilocane | |8| | kaḥ pitā tenavadyāṅgi kā vā mātā tavānaghe | kimarthaṃ vā vasasyatra girau dānavasevite ||9| | evamuktāśca mūkena mahāyogā sureśvarī | vijñāya manasā kālaṃ prāptaṃ śuṃbhaniśuṃbhayoḥ || 8.63.10 | | smitapūrvamidaṃ prāha vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradā | mānuṣīṃ māṃ vijānīhi girāvasmin kṛtālayām | | 11 || ātreyaḥ svargato vidvān pitā cakracaro mama | vihāya māṃ puro bālāṃ mātāpyanugatā patim || 12 | | ājñaptāsmi tadā mātrā pradāyāstrāṇi dānava | vasa vindhye girau ramye yogaṃ ca kuru sarvadā | |1 3 | | sāhaṃ vacanamāryāyāḥ pālayantī nagottame | vasāmi siṃhaśārdūla mātaṅgamṛgasevite ||14| | iti devyā vacaḥ śrutvā mūkaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ | jagāma dānavaśreṣṭhaṃ śumbhaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛtatvaraḥ | | 1 5| | atha śuṃbhaṃ samāsādya harṣeṇotphullalocanaḥ | ācacakṣa ivākārairapūrvaṃ ratnadarśanam | | 1 6|| taṃ dṛṣṭavā vismayotphullaṃ raktāyatavilocanaḥ | mūkamāha tadā śuṃbhaḥ kasmāttuṣṭosi dānava | | 17|| evamuktaḥ sa śuṃbhena mūko vacanamabravīt | apūrvamadya dṛṣṭaṃ me strīratnaṃ śikhare gireḥ | |18|| na tādṛśī manuṣyeṣu na deveṣvapi sundarī | na rakṣassu na yakṣeṣu na gandharvapureṣu vā | | 1 9|| na nāgeṣu na siddheṣu na daityapativeśmasu | dṛṣṭapūrvā mayā rājan yādṛśī sā varāṃganā | |8.63.2 0| | kā tvaṃ kasya kimarthaṃ vā vasasīha girāviti | pṛṣṭābravīnmayā vākyamātreyaduhitā hyaham | |2 1 | | vasāmi cātra vindhyasya śikhare māturājñayā | iti bharttuḥ samākhyāya virarāma sa dānavaḥ | | 22|| atha śuṃbhasya hṛdaye mūkasya vacasā saha | kāmovakāśamakarodvināśāya suradviṣām ||2 3 | | tataḥ provāca daityendraḥ kāmākulitamānasaḥ | gaccha mūka madarthe tāṃ pralobhaya sumadhyamām | |24|| evamuktaḥ sa śuṃbhena drutamutthāya dānavaḥ | prayayau yatra sā devī prāganenābhilakṣitā ||25|| taṃ dṛṣṭavā dānavaṃ devī kṛtāñjalimupasthitam | kimarthamāgatosīti mūkaṃ pṛṣṭavatī tadā | |26|| evaṃ pṛṣṭotha kauśikyā prāhetthaṃ mūkadānavaḥ | ārye dūtosmi śumbhasya tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ ||27|| atha devī smitaṃ kṛtvā prasannamabhivīkṣya tam | itthamāhāgataṃ dūtaṃ kiṃ sa āhā sureśvaraḥ ||28|| iti pṛṣṭastadā devyā prāha mūkaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | ārye daityeśvaraḥ śuṃbhaḥ patnītvena vṛṇoti te ||29|| tasya dānavasiṃhasya jetuḥ śakrasya saṃyuge | bhavāgryā sarvapatnīnāṃ patnī mṛgavilocane ||8.63.3 0 || evamuktā tadā tena vihasyāhāmareśvarī | svabāhūnavalokyetthaṃ yuddhaśulkā mavehi mām ||31| | māṃ vinirjitya daityosau patnīṃ vai kartumarhati | mayā vā nihato yātu kākagomāyubhakṣyatām ||32|| evamuktavatīṃ devīmāha mūko hasanniva | patyā dānavadaityānāṃ kiṃ te yuddhena bhāmini | |33|| kruddhasya yasya samare na śaśāka nirīkṣitum | mukhamairāvataskandhagatopi balavṛtrahā ||34|| śrutvā tad vacanaṃ tasya prāha devī smayanniva (?) | tṛṇāni mama daityendrāḥ sarvepi raṇamūrdhani ||35| | nivedayasva śuṃbhasya gaccha tvaṃ dānavādhama | dautyenāsi yataḥ prāpto mayāto na vihanyase ||36|| atha praṇamya tāṃ mūko yayau pārśvaṃ suradviṣaḥ | anujñātaśca tenāsāvākhyātumupacakrame ||37|| sā mayā prārthitā kanyā tvadarthe dānavottama | uvāca yuddhaśulkāsmi jitvā māṃ netumarhasi ||38|| bhūyaścoktavatī rājan garvamālambya sāṅganā | tṛṇāni mama saṃgrāme daityā iti savismayā | |39|| tattadā vacanaṃ tasyā mūkenoktaṃ niśāmya saḥ | krodhāddarpācca kāmācca mamṛṣe nāsurottamaḥ ||8.63.40|| athotthāya sabhāṃ ramyāmagacchaddānavādhipaḥ | sphāṭikastambhanirvyūhāṃ vicitramaṇitoraṇām ||41 || tasyāṃ siṃhāsane haime svāstīrṇe mahati sthire | niṣasāda mahābāhuḥ sukhāyāṃ varuṇo yathā ||42|| anu tasya niśuṃbhopi niṣasāda varāsane | ratnāṅgadāṃśunivahacchuritoraḥsthalastadā ||43|| tayoranu mahāsatvā viviśurdaityadānavāḥ | darīṃ himavato ramyāṃ vāriśyāmā ivāmbudāḥ ||44|| atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu daityadānavarājasu | provāca vacanaṃ śumbho ghanastanitanisvanaḥ ||45|| ārakṣiko giro vindhye madīyo mūkadānavaḥ | vindhyasya śikhare kanyāṃ dṛṣṭavān cārurūpiṇīm ||46|| yuddhaśulkāhamityāha na madarthenena sārthitā | tṛṇāni mama daityendrā bhūyaścoktavatī kila ||47|| jitvā tāṃ prasabhaṃ kanyāṃ samare garvaśālinīm | viceṣṭamānā mavaśāmadyaivānetumutsahe ||48|| atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śaṃbhurnāma mahāsuraḥ | prahasyoccairmahābāhuridamāhāsureśvaram | |49|| vāmaprakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ svabhāvena varāṅganāḥ | parisāntvyā sakṛd rājan tāṃ tvamādātumarhasi ||8.63.50|| śrutvātha vacanaṃ śambhormayo dānavasattamaḥ | provācābhinavotphullanīlanīrajalocanaḥ ||51|| ākāraḥ kaḥ punastasyāḥ kā vā ceṣṭā surādhipa | pārśvasthāni ca kānyasyāḥ sadopakaraṇāni vā | |52|| ityuktavati daityendre maye mattebhavikrame | atha daityapatirmūkaṃ pārśvasthaṃ samacodayat | |13 | | yaṃ praśnaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐statra mayo matimatāṃ varaḥ | mūkastu taṃ tadā sarvamākhyātumupacakrame ||54|| sadā susaṃsthitā vyakṣā karāladaśanānanā | aṣṭabāhurghanaśyāmā sunāsā valgunisvanā | |55|| sārśvasthāni sadā tasyāḥ sarvapraharaṇāni ca | tanutrāṇi ca mukhyāni citrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ||56|| atyādityaṃ vapustasyāḥ kāntiścātiniśākarā | ityākhyāya tadā mūko vireme daityasaṃsadi ||57|| atha dīrghaṃ viniḥśvasya tadā maya mahāsuraḥ | provāca sadasi svantaṃ vaco vacanakovidaḥ | |58|| nūnamutpāditā devaiḥ kṛtyā yudhi parājitaiḥ | vindhyaṃ mahīdhramāyātā vināśāya suradviṣām ||59|| tadalaṃ te tayā rājan santi kanyāḥ sumadhyamāḥ | dīrghākṣyaścārusarvāṅgyo daityadānavaveśmasu ||8.63.60 || samyagāhṛtya tā rājannanurūpāḥ kalasvanāḥ | yatheṣṭaṃ krīḍa satataṃ prāsādodarasaṃsthitaḥ ||61 || evamukte tadā vākye mayenāsurasaṃsadi | prāha vākyaṃ tadā śumbho vihasyetthaṃ mahāsuraḥ ||62|| yadi sā daivataiḥ sṛṣṭā kṛtyā dānavaśāsane | ahatvā dānavānāśu tadā sā na viraṃsyate ||63|| yāvadeva na kṛtyāsmānabhiyuṃkte kṛtodyamā | tāvadeva prasahyāśu tāṃ vaśe kartumarhatha ||64|| tatonumenire sarve daityadānavasattamāḥ | vacanaṃ daityarājasya kālenābhipracoditāḥ ||65|| atha sadasi samastān daityasiṃhām̐stadānīṃ tridaśapativijetā vākyametad vihṛtya | udapatadavalambisvacchaśubhroruhāro navajalabharanamraḥ prāvṛṣīvāmbuvāhaḥ ||66|| iti skandapurāṇe (mahadara?) saṃvāde triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.64> sanatkumāra uvāca āhatya bherīḥ sannahya ditijā dānavāśca te | tadā sannāhayāmāsū rathanāgaturaṅgamān ||1|| gṛhītatoyānānīya tato daityā mataṅgajān | madasphātikarān dattvā dhūpām̐śca kavalāni ca ||2|| tathā kakṣāśca sannāhyā graiveyām̐śca susaṃskṛtān | aṃkuśān sarvalohām̐śca hemaratnapariṣkṛtān ||3|| kareṇuṣu samārūḍhāḥ samantād gajasādinaḥ | ābabandhurvicitrāṇi varmāṇi vidhivattadā | |4|| tiryagūrdhvamukhān sasyag babandhustomareṣudhīn | āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi babandhurubhayorapi | |5| | pārśvayorāsanānāṃ tu trayāṇāmapi bhāgaśaḥ | vaijayantīpatākāśca samucchiśriyire tataḥ | |6|| turaṅgān snātapītām̐śca varmiṇo baddhabāladhīn | ārūḍhā baddhanistriṃśā dānavā lohajālinaḥ | |7|| ārūḍhā rathinaḥ kecid rathān yuktaturaṅgamān | sāyudhānsapatākām̐śca prayastān svakṣakūbarān | |8| | atha śuṃbho niśuṃbhaśca bhrātarau dānaveśvarau | āruhya baddhakavacau balonmattau mahāsurau | |9 | | sāṃgrāmikau susaṃyattau rathau valgatturaṅgamau | sāyudhau sapatākau ca kārttasvaramayau pṛthak | | 8.64.10 | | nirjagmaturmahoraskau prayuktajayamaṅgalau | māgadhairvandibhiḥ sūtaiḥ stūyamānau puraḥsaraiḥ | | 11 | | tato yātuṃ samārabdhāstūryāṇyāhatya saṃghaśaḥ | yatrāste kauśikī devī taṃ śailamabhitosurāḥ || 1 2|| atha dānavasiṃhānāṃ dhvajāḥ peturyiyāsatām | aśivañca śivā nedurdīptāyāṃ diśi saṃsthitāḥ || 13 | | papāta nabhaso reṇuḥ kapotodaradhūsaraḥ | upariṣṭācca senāyā babhramurgṛdhravāyasāḥ || 14|| pratīpañca vavau teṣāṃ rajogarbhaḥ samīraṇaḥ | rarāsa paruṣaṃ vyoma cacāla ca vasundharā | |1 5|| parājayanimittāni budhyamānāḥ suradviṣaḥ | abhijagmuḥ kṛtāntena kṛṣyamāṇā ivāvaśāḥ ||16|| ādideśātha daityendro mūkamārakṣikaṃ tadā | gṛhāṇa śulkamiti tāṃ brūhi gatvā sumadhyamām | | 17|| sa gatvā vacanāttasya praṇamyovāca kauśikīm | śulkaṃ kila gṛhāṇārye dīyamānaṃ suradviṣā || 18| | evamastviti sā procya taṃ visṛjya ca dānavam | vyavardhata mahāyogā yogamāsthāya kauśikī ||19|| atha tasyāḥ samutpedu rgātrebhyaḥ pramadottamāḥ | baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇāḥ sāyudhā bhīmadarśanāḥ | |8.64.20 | | vāyasī vāyasāsyānāṃ strīṇāṃ koṭyā samāvṛtā | upakā kokilā syābhistāvatībhirmahābalā | |21 || pracaṇḍā siṃhavaktrābhirdevībhirabhisaṃvṛtā | ugrā vyāghramukhābhiśca paritaḥ parirakṣitā ||22 || jayā ca gajavaktrābhirjayantī ca mahābalā | devībhiḥ śikhivaktrābhirameyā bhirvṛtānaghā ||23 | | jayamānāśvavaktrābhirhaṃsāsyābhiḥ prabhāvṛtā | prabhāvatī ca cakrāhvavadanābhirmahābalā ||24| | śivā gomāyuvaktrābhiraśivā vidviṣāṃ raṇe | saramā śvamukhībhiśca vṛtā paramadurjayā ||25|| vijayā śyenavaktrābhiḥ sarvataḥ parirakṣitā | kaṃkāsyābhirvṛtā mṛtyurhantrībhiḥ samare ripūn ||26|| niyatirmadguvaktrābhi rdurjayābhiḥ parairyudhi | aśaniḥ kukkuṭāsyābhirbahvībhirabhināditā | | 27| | revatī vṛṣadaṃśā ca pūtanā kaṭapūtanā | ālambā kinnarī ṣaṣṭhī śakunirmukhamaṇḍikā | |28| | alakṣmīradhṛtirlakṣmīḥ potakī vānarī spṛhā | etāścānyāśca kauśikyāḥ saṃbabhūvurmahābalāḥ | |29| | nānāveṣadharābhiśca bahvībhiḥ parito vṛtā | bibhratībhirvicitrāṇi kavacānyāyudhāni ca ||8.64.3 0 | | sasarja kauśikī tūrṇaṃ haimānsāṃgrāmikān rathān | yuktānaśvairmanovegaiḥ sāyudhānucchritadhvajān | |3 1 || vājinaḥ sopakaraṇān madonmattān mataṅgajān | āyudhāni tanutrāṇi tūryāṇi vividhāni ca | |3 2| | uvāca ca mahāyogā tā devīḥ purataḥ sthitāḥ | devyaḥ śuṃbho niśuṃbhaśca bhrātarau devakaṇṭakau ||3 3 | | netuṃ māṃ kila saṃgrāme vijitya raṇamūrdhani | āgatau tau balonmattau sahitau daityadānavaiḥ | | 34| | tāvahaṃ vinihaṃsyāmi śeṣān hata suradviṣaḥ | ajarāścāmarāścaiva bhaviṣyatha mahābalāḥ ||3 5| | iti tābhyo varaṃ dattvā samādiśya ca tāstadā | devīrdevī mahābhāgā yuddhāya kṛtaniścayā | |3 6|| atha sā svarathaṃ mahārathaṃ manasācintayadacyutā tadā | tamupasthitamāśu cintitaṃ pradadau yaṃ girirājanandanā ||37| | jvaladagnisamānavarccasaṃ parito ratnamayūkhamālinam | purataḥ samavekṣya kauśikī sukṛtaṃ hemamayaṃ nabhaścaram | |38| | vividhāyudhavarmasaṃyutaṃ pracalatpiṅgasaṭākalāpibhiḥ | samare jayibhirdviṣadbalaṃ yuktaṃ kesaribhirmahābalaiḥ ||3 9| | nṛtyanmayūreṇa vikīrṇabhāsā samucchritenātitarāṃ dṛḍhena | haimena ratnadyutibhāsvareṇa dhvajapravekeṇa virājamānam | |8.64.40 | | jagrāha vijayā chatraṃ siṃhī sūtā tadābhavat | jayantī ca jayā cāsyā dadhatuścāmarāṇyatha | |41 | | tataḥ sā baddhakavacā vividhāyudhadhāriṇī | āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ srutāśīrjayamaṅgalā | |42 | | saṃpūrṇacandradyutinātha mūrdhni samucchritenātapavāraṇena | saṃvījyamānā ca vicitradaṇḍaiḥ sucāmarairindumarīcigauraiḥ | |43 | | tatastāstūryamāhatya nedurnādān pṛthagvidhān | devyā devyaḥ susaṃyuktā babhūvuśca purassarāḥ | |44| | tena nādena daityānāṃ hṛdayāni cakampire | visasarja śakṛnmūtraṃ hastyaśvañcāsure bale | |85| | cakampa iva bhūrlokaścukṣubhuḥ sāgarā iva | vicelurivaśailendrāḥ pūritaṃ va nabhastalam | |46|| tadā taddevatānīkaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam | vireje vinadattūryaṃ sitanistriṃśasaṃkulam | |47|| balākāpaṃktiśabalaṃ sendracāpaṃ mahāsvanam | nabhasye māsi sataḍid vṛndaṃ jalamucāmiva | |48|| tato jagāma saṃyacchad daityendrābhimukhaṃ tadā | javena devatānīkaṃ saṃkṣipyeva diśo daśa | |49 | | atha dadṛśuranīkamāgataṃ suraripavo vividhocchritadhvajam | pratibhayajananaṃ mahāsvanaṃ pralaya ivāmbudavṛndamunnatam || 8.64.50 | | iti skandapurāṇe śumbhaniśumbhayuddhe sainyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.65> sanatkumāra uvāca atha tā devatāḥ kruddhā daityānagresarām̐stadā | nijaghnurvividhaiḥ śastraiste ca tā vibhidu ryudhi | | 1 | | daityā nānāyudhopetā devīrjaghnu stadā raṇe | abalā balino vīrāḥ samaremaravidviṣaḥ ||2 || turaṅgiṇasturaṅgasthāḥ padātīṃśca padātayaḥ | rathino rathasaṃsthāśca gajasthā gajasādinaḥ ||3 | | rathā nāgāsturaṅgāśca rathān nāgān turaṅgamān | padātīḥ sādinaḥ śūrāḥ sādinīśca padātayaḥ ||4| | devyopi yudhi saṃkruddhāḥ pattisādiratha dvipān | nirjaghnurdānavendrāṇāṃ prāsaśakti paraśvadhaiḥ ||5|| pādaiśca pipiṣuḥ śūrānnipātya bhuvi dānavān | vibhidurmuṣṭibhiḥ kāścicchirāṃsi suravidviṣām ||6|| vidāryoraḥsthalaṃ kāścit samare darpaśālinām | papuśca rudhiraṃ devyaḥ prāṇaissaha suradviṣām ||7| | chinnām̐śca khaṇḍaśaḥ kecid hetīnutthāya vegitāḥ | nirjaghnu rdevatāḥ kruddhā muṣṭibhirvajrasaṃhataiḥ ||8| | kecinmadāmbuniṣyandaśyāmagaṇḍasthalā gajāḥ | pipiṣuḥ paramakruddhāḥ samare devatārathān ||9 || kapolabhittisaṃlīnamattaṣaṭpadapaṃktayaḥ | hatārohā gajāḥ kecinnirjaghnurdaityadevatāḥ || 8.65.1 0|| varmiṇaḥ kecidudbhrāntaśitanistriṃśapāṇayaḥ | cicchidurdevatānīkaṃ devatā dānavānapi | |1 1 || mattāḥ praticchannamukhām̐śca kecid gandhena vijñāya gajān gajendrāḥ | ghrātvā tu gandhaṃ sahasābhijaghnurādhoraṇairapyabhisaṃgṛhītāḥ || 1 2| | visphāryamāṇāni mahādhanūṃṣi mahābalairdānakyodhamukhyaiḥ | tāraṃ viresuḥ samarājireṣu krauñcā iva vyomni śaranniśāsu | |1 3 || tūryasvanairjyātalasannipātairnāgāśvanādai rathanemighoṣaiḥ | saṃpūrṇakuñjodara kandarosau vindhyaścacāleva tadā samagraḥ ||14| | devyaḥ samutsārya raṇe ripūṇāmuccairvineduḥ prasabhaṃ balāni | neduśca nādān parihṛṣṭacittāḥ protsārya devīryudhi daityayodhāḥ || 15 | | balāni kiñcitkṣatajokṣitāni pracakrire tatra gatāgatāni | mahāvanānīva samīraṇena samīritānyudgatapallavāni || 1 6| | chinnāni vaktrāṇi purassarāṇāṃ vicitrahaimābharaṇojjvalāni | devībhirājau patitāni rejurnikṛttanālāni yathāmbujāni || 17|| pratyāhatā vidrutabhītanāgā sā devatābhirnihatāśvayodhā | daityendrasiṃhaiḥ pratisannivṛttairdolāyamāneva camūrbabhūva | |18| | hatā nipetuḥ samare nadanto devadviṣāmañjanaśailakalpāḥ | devobhirābaddhavicitraghaṇṭā marmātigairvāṇavarairgajendrāḥ | |1 9 || balāni teṣāmabhisṛtya vegādabhyāhatānyāśvapaserurājau | mahodadhiṃ prāpya vivṛddhikāle pratyāhatānīva sarijjalāni ||8.65.20 || devyaśca daityāśca mahāsamāje virejirenyonyavisaktavāṇāḥ | saṃsaktabhāsopagame ghanānāmabhre samūhā iva tārakāṇām ||21 | | udghuṣya nāmānyatha dānavendrā nirjagmurāśu svabalādrathasthāḥ | kruddhāḥ suyattā rathināṃ variṣṭhā visphārya citrāṇi śarāsanāni ||22|| devyopi saṃyattatarā rathasthāḥ kruddhā javenātha tadābhisasruḥ | meghasvanaṃ pratyudiyāya ṣaṣṭhī kārtasvaraṃ mṛtyurudīrṇakopā | | 23|| drumeṇa lakṣmīratha saṃyugasthā mayena kāntiḥ saramā mureṇa | ghanena caṇḍā niyatiḥ khareṇa prabhāvatī dhundhumayāt saroṣā ||24| | daityā yuyutsotsukamānasāste devīḥ samāyāssabhujaissaśastraiḥ | abhyāyayuḥ śīghramamṛṣyamāṇāḥ khyātāvalepāḥ svarathaissuyattāḥ || 25 | | jyotiḥprakāśāntapanīyapuṃkhānākarṇapūrṇāyatacāpamuktān | saṃpreṣayāmāsuradīnasatvā bāṇapravekānyudhi devatānām | | 26| | devyotha teṣāṃ niśitānsupuṃkhānmarmacchido dūragamānsupatrān | āgacchatāṃ dānavayūthapānāṃ bāṇānanantānsasṛjustathaiva | |27 || te bāṇamukhyā vividhā virejuranyonyamuktā vyatiṣajyamānāḥ | te pūrṇamāsyāṃ vighane dinānte bhāsaḥ samūḍhā iva cāndrasaurāḥ || 28| | chinnā nipeturyudhi devatābhirbhujāḥ saśastrā ditijādhipānām | nirastabhogā nibiḍā bṛhanto nigīrṇajihvā iva pannagendrāḥ | |29| | meghasvanasyātha raṇe tadānīṃ kruddhā śaraughānvisasarja ṣaṣṭhī | āgacchatastānabhitaḥ pṛṣatkaiściccheda daityaḥ śataśontarikṣe | | 8.65.30 | | bāṇānathodvīkṣya tadā nikṛttān laghīyasonyānvisasarja tūrṇam | daityopi tānāpatataḥ pṛṣatkānvrātaiḥ śarāṇāṃ bahuśaścakartta | | 31 || nikṛtya bāṇānditijaḥ punastān cikṣepa ṣaṣṭhyā daśa rukmapuṃkhān | tānāśu ṣaṣṭhī prativārya daityaṃ vivyādha ṣaṣṭhyā tapanīyapuṃkhaiḥ ||3 2|| sa tairvibhinno rudhirāktamūrtiḥ pravihvalaḥ ca kiṃcidavāg babhūva | apākarottaṃ samarāt svasūto rathena jāmbūnadacitritena ||3 3 | | kārtasvanaḥ kāñcanacitrapuṃkhān sasarja devyāḥ samare pṛṣatkān | ciccheda tān mṛtyurudārapuṃkhairanāgatā neva śarāñcharaughaiḥ ||34|| chittvā śarām̐stasya śarairvicitrairvivyādha taṃ vakṣasi pañcaṣaṣṭhyā | bhinnaḥ sa tairāśu tathā vireje vyomnyarkapādairiva vārivāhaḥ ||35|| aśvāṃśca tasyāśu jaghāna mṛtyuḥ pṛthak pṛṣatkai stapanīyapuṃkhaiḥ | āplutya daityotha rathāddhatāśvātpragṛhya carmāsivarañca dhautam | |3 6| | kruddho nitāntāyataraktanetro vegena devīmabhitaḥ sasāra | taccarma tasyāpatataḥ śaraughaiścakartta mṛtyuḥ śataśaśśitāgraiḥ ||37| | sa kṛttacarmāvaraṇo surendro nistriṃśamudyamya niśātadhāram | abhyadravanmṛtyumabhūttadānīṃ khe rohiṇīṃ megha ivābhividyut || 38|| tamāpatantaṃ yudhi kālakalpaṃ mṛtyuḥ śarairugrabhujaṅgakalpaiḥ | jaghāna marmasvabhilakṣiteṣu vyayojayaccāsubhirenamāśu | | 3 9|| lakṣmīrdrumaṃ bāṇavarairajayyā samākiradvāraṇarājalīlam | karṇāntamuktai rniśitairajihmai raṇājire cārusuvarṇapuṃkhaiḥ ||8.65.40 || ajihmagāste vividhāḥ supatritā drumasya gātreṣu nipeturāhave | sa tairvicitraiḥ śuśubhe viṣaktairmahādrumaḥ pakṣigaṇarivāśritaiḥ ||41 | | lakṣmīṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣādhiposau vivyādha bāṇairdaśabhiḥ supuṃkhaiḥ | vaktre sa pūrṇendusamānavakttrāṃ bāhvoḥ pṛthak cāṣṭaśatena dhīraḥ | |42 || acintayantīṣu varānvarāsyā mukhesya tīkṣṇānnicakhāna bāṇān | anyānasakhyām̐śca pṛthak śarīre supatritān hāṭakamṛṣṭapuṃkhān ||43 || lakṣmyāstato daityapatiḥ śitena bhallena ciccheda rathe dhvajāgram | aśvāṃśca tasyāścaturaścaturbhiḥ sūtaṃ ca vivyādha śareṇa tūrṇam | |44| | nārācamādāya tatosya lakṣmīrjaghāna sūtaṃ yudhi devaśatroḥ | vivyādha vāhām̐śca pṛthakpṛṣatkaidhvajañca ciccheda rathasya tūrṇam ||45|| yantrā vinā tasya rathaṃ tadānīṃ te sāyakairapratimaiḥ prataptāḥ | saṃgrāmabhūmerapaninyuraśvāḥ prāṇāniva svān parirakṣamāṇāḥ ||46| | kāntirmayaṃ bāṇaśatairavākiranmayaśca kāntiṃ niśitaiḥ śaraughaiḥ | nīhārapātairiva sāndhakāraṃ tadā tayorantaramāsa tatra | |47| | ādānasandhānavikarṣaṇeṣu sthānakramapragrahatejaneṣu | śikṣāguṇaistāvaparaspareṇa viśeṣayāmāsaturājimadhye ||48| | kāntirmayāstānnicakarta bāṇānmayaśca kāntyā viśikhānvimṛṣṭān | chidraṃ samāsedaturapradhṛṣyau kiñcinna tau yatra parasparasya ||49|| aśveṣu sūte sarathe dhvaje ca sarveṣu gātrāvayaveṣu cāsya | ajihmagān hāṭakamṛṣṭapuṃkhān mayasya kāntirnicakhāna bāṇān ||8.65.50 || mayaśca kāntiṃ sarathāsasūtāṃ sacārucitradhvajavājimukhyām | saṃchādayāmāsa śitaiḥ pṛṣatkairvanasthalīṃ megha ivāmbuvarṣaiḥ | |51 | | kruddhātha kāntiḥ samare mayasya nārācamukhyena supatritena | sūtaṃ jaghānāśu ripostadānīmaṣṭābhiraṣṭau turagām̐śca bāṇaiḥ ||52|| hatāśvasūto viratho mayotha nistriṃśamādāya niśātadhāram | jñātvaiva kāntyā samare prabhāvaṃ vihāya yuddhaṃ viyadutpapāta | |53 | | vivyādha tīkṣṇaiḥ saramā raṇājire bāṇairmuraṃ dānavadaityayūthapam | daityopi bāṇaiḥ saramāmajihmagairabhyāhanad gṛdhramayūrapatribhiḥ || 54|| kruddhātha devī niśitena tasya ciccheda bhallena dhanurvicitram | anyaddhanuḥ sotha tadā gṛhītvā vivyādha devyāścaturasturaṅgān| |55| | te vihvalāḥ śoṇitamudvamanto daityendrabāṇābhihatāsturaṅgāḥ | bhūmau nipetuḥ samare śvasantaḥ prāṇāñjahuścāśu samaṃ samastāḥ | |56 || kruddhātha devī saramāsurasya nistriṃśamudyamya supītadhāram | utpatya khaṃ tasya tadā jaghāna yantāramaśvām̐śca mahāpramāṇān ||57|| murotha vegena tadāntarikṣamutpatya kopānnihatāśvasūtaḥ | vivyādha devīṃ daśabhiḥsutīkṣṇaiḥ śarairurasyugrabhujaṅgakalpaiḥ | |58| | acintayitvā saramā śarām̐stān dhanurviciccheda tadā murasya | sa kṛttadhanvā viyatīndraśatrurantardadhe saṃyugamāśu hitvā ||59| | vivyādha caṇḍā ghanamāpatantaṃ śaraiḥ śitāgrairyudhi rukmapuṃkhaiḥ | viddhaḥ sa tairdaityapatirbabhāse karairivendorasitaḥ payodaḥ ||8.65.6 0| | abhyadravattānavicintya vāṇām̐ścaṇḍāṃ ghanaḥ sāyakajālavarṣī | āgacchatastasya śaraissupatrairvivyādha caṇḍā rathavājimukhyān ||61 || ciccheda daityopi samucchritāgraṃ dhvajaṃ turaṅgām̐śca jaghāna devyāḥ | hitvā rathau tāvavatīrya bhūmau gṛhītacarmāsivarau prayattau ||62 || viceraturmaṇḍalamājimadhye bhūmiṃ tadāgrāṅgulibhiḥ spṛśantau | tām̐stām̐śca mārgān laghupādacārau chidraṃ na cānyonyamavāpatustau ||63 || abhiplutoccaplutasiṃhapātān nivṛttakākrīḍitakordhvabāhūn | khagāpayātābhihatāpayātān niṣaṇṇakāviddhaśirobhighātān ||64| | utplutya vegena tadātha tasya śirodharāmāśu cakarta caṇḍā | sa kṛttamūrdhā nipapāta tasyāṃ saṃgrāmabhūmāvurasāśu daityaḥ | |65|| sa śoṇitādigdhavapustadānīṃ ghanaḥ parāsuḥ patito dharaṇyām | rarāja sandhyācchuritorumūrttirviyadgato nīla ivāmbuvāhaḥ ||66 | | vivyādha tīkṣṇairniryatiḥ supatraiḥ kharaṃ śarairvakṣasi hemapuṃkhaiḥ | āyodhane saṃmukhamāpatantaṃ bhallena cāsya dhvajamuccakarta | |67|| viddhaḥ sa tairabhyapatansaroṣo devīṃ jighāṃsuḥ samarerihantā | gurvī gadāṃ cāśu tadā gṛhītvā cikṣepa devyā rudhirāktamūrttiḥ ||68 | | sā dānavāgryeṇa gadā pramuktā vicitrahemojjvalacārughaṇṭā | saṃcūrṇayāmāsa rathaṃ niyatyāḥ sūtaṃ dhvajaṃ cāśu samucchritāgram ||69|| utpatya tūrṇaṃ niyatiḥ svavāhāt krodhena saṃraktavilolanetrā | abhyetya taṃ dānavayodhamukhyaṃ khaḍgena madhyesya śiraḥ paphāla ||8.65.70 || sa dānavo visphuṭitottamāṅgaḥ kṣitau vireje srutaraktadhāraḥ | vajreṇa bhinnaḥ śikharāgradeśe giriryathā dhāturasapravāhī ||71 | | prabhāvatī dhundhumajihmayātaiḥ śilīmukhairabhyahanatsupatraiḥ | urasyudārā daśabhiḥ śitāgrairghanāghanavrātasamānavarṇaiḥ ||72| | jaghāna sā ṣoḍaśa devatāresturaṅgamān ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ | nihatya caikena rathesya sūtamekena cāsya dhvajamuccakarta ||73|| dhundhurgadāṃ bhārasahasragurvī cikṣepa kārtasvaracārughaṇṭām | tāmāpatantīṃ śataśaścakartta prabhāvatī daityapatipramuktām | |74| | ādāya daityaḥ parighaṃ mahāntamāplutya vāhādabhitaḥ sasāra | devīmasāvañjanaśailanīlo raṇājire kāla ivāttadaṇḍaḥ | |75| | abhyāpatantaṃ yudhi dānavendraṃ devī śarairabhyahanat supatraiḥ | devyā samastānavicintya bāṇānabhyetya tāmāhavamūrdhni roṣāt ||76|| udbhrāmya vaivasvatadaṇḍakalpaṃ lauhaṃ prayastaṃ parighorubāhuḥ | nyapātayattaṃ parighaṃ rathesyā girernitambe kuliśaṃ yathendraḥ ||77| | acūrṇayattaṃ rathamāśu devyāḥ sāśvaṃ sasūtadhvajahemacakram | kālāyasosau parighosurāsto vegena tatrāpasasāra devī ||78|| dṛṣṭā sa tāṃ tatra tadāpayātāṃ tameva lauhaṃ parighaṃ gṛhītvā | abhyadravad dānavayodhamukhyo divīva citrāmasitaḥ payodaḥ | |79| | utpatya sā divyavarāstramuktaiḥ kṣurapramukhyaiḥ parighañcakarta | udyamya muṣṭiṃ nibiḍaṃ tatosyā bhūyotha daityo viyadutpapāta ||8.65.80 | | taṃ marmagairmarmasu bāṇamukhyaiḥ saṃtāḍayaddānavamāśu devī | bhinnaḥ sa tairmarmagamaiḥ supuṃkhairantardadhe dānavayodhamukhyaḥ ||81 || atha samaramapāsya yodhamukhyairvihataparākramapauruṣairapetaiḥ | surapatiripavo vinadya nādān dviradavarānadhitasthurāttaśastrāḥ ||82| | iti skandapurāṇe śuṃbhaniśuṃbhasaṃgrāme devīyuddha nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.66> sanatkumāra uvāca devyopi teṣāṃ viditaprayatnā gajottamānāruruhuḥ sayatnāḥ | śucīnmadāmbusravataḥ sudantān praśastagātrāmbarahastapakṣān (?) ||1 || supuṣkarānunnatavṛttakumbhān subāladhīnañcitacārukarṇān | sudantaveṣṭān kalaviṅkanetrānsuvakṣasaḥ svāsanapṛṣṭhavaṃśān ||2|| sāṅgrāmikānagrajavān vayaḥsthānsuśikṣitānunnatapūrvakāyān | ābaddhavarmāyudhacitraghaṇṭān samucchritorudhvajavaijayantīn ||3 || tāsāṃ patākādhvajaśobhitāni vicitranānāyudhabhūṣaṇāni | mātaṅgavṛndāni tadā babhūvurvane vanānīva samāgatāni | |4| | daityāpi te vāraṇamūrdhni ṣaṇṇā visphārayanto vibabhurdhanūṃṣi | sendrāyudhāḥ sāśaniśabdagarbhāḥ śaileṣu meghā iva sannilīnāḥ ||5|| sainyāni tānyāhanane gajānāmādhoraṇairāśvabhicoditāni | anyonyamāpeturabhīritāni vātena vṛndāni yathā ghanānām | |6 || vegena nāgānabhisṛtya nāgā madānmadaśyāmamukhānviṣāṇaiḥ | lohābhinaddhairbisakāṇḍagauraiḥ śambūkadeśeṣvabhijaghnurājau ||7| | prasārya hastānabhitaśca keciddānānugandhaṃ dviradābhiseruḥ | ādhoraṇairaṅkuśapāśavāgbhi ravidhyamānāpi madābhidṛptāḥ ||8|| chinnāni peturniśitaiḥ kṣurapraiḥ samucchritānyātapavāraṇāni | citrāḥ patākā vividhā dhvajāśca paraspareṇāhanane gajebhyaḥ ||13 || yodhā nipetuḥ pariniṣṭananto viddhāḥ śarairmarmasu devatābhiḥ | saphenamāsyai rudhiraṃ vamanto dhanūṃṣi sajjāni karairdadhānāḥ | |8.66.1 0 | | nāgā nipetuḥ paritobhipadya marmātigairbāṇavarairvibhinnāḥ | devībhirājau ditijādhipānāṃ vātābhinunnā iva gaṇḍaśailāḥ ||1 1 || mātaṅgamukhyānpatitān parāsūn raṇājire nīlagirīndrakalpān | gandhena nāgāḥ samadāḥ parītya vinamya kecid vadanairvineduḥ | |12|| chinnāni vaktrāṇi sakuṇḍalāni bhujāssaśastrāśca sucandanāktāḥ | peturgajebhyosurayūthapānāṃ devībhirājau niśitaiḥ kṣuraprai || 13 | | cukūjuruccaiḥ parito dhanūṃṣi vinedurāhatya surārimukhyāḥ | vipusphururjyāḥ parikṛṣya muktāḥ śarābhividdhāśca gajā niṣeduḥ | | 14|| nāgaiḥ patadbhirviśikhābhividdhaiḥ samucchritorudhvajacārupṛṣṭhaiḥ | āstīryate bhūranilapranunnaiḥ satālavṛkṣairiva śailapādaiḥ || 15|| nāgā gajānāhananebhijaghnurdaityāśca devīrditijām̐śca devyaḥ | daityān gajendrā dviradāṃśca daityāḥ kruddhāḥ saroṣānabhisṛtya tatra || 16|| śastrābhitaptaiḥ patitaissamantānmātaṅgavṛndairgirisānukalpaiḥ | sañcārayogyā na babhūva bhūmirāyoghane daivatadānavānāma ||17 || abhyaditāni svabalāni dṛṣṭvā devībhirājau nihatadvipāni | śumbho niśumbhaśca samājabhūmimājagmaturdaityapatī rathasthau || 18| | agresaraiḥ pattituraṅganāgairvrātaiśca devadviṣatāmupetau | visphārayantau dhanuṣī vicitre yuddhāya yattau parighorubāhū | | 1 9|| jñātvā tayorāgamanaṃ tadānīṃ devī calatpiṅgalakeśarāḍhyān | sañcodayāmāsa rathasya siṃhān visphārayantī samare dhanūṃṣi ||8.66.2 0|| jyāniṃ javasyātha turaṅgamāṇāṃ madapramoṣañca mahādvipānām | cetovimohaṃ suravidviṣāṃ ca cāpasvanenaiva cakāra devī ||21 || ājau samāsthāya paraṃ prayatnaṃ śarāḥ surāṇāṃ ripubhiḥ samastāḥ | aprāpya devīṃ patitāḥ pṛthivyāṃ parājayaṃ prāhurivāsurāṇām | |22| | gabhastibhiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāni vyāpnoti yadvat savitā dineṣu | tadvaccharaughairditijādhipānāṃ raṇājire vyāpa balāni devī ||23 | | nipeturāśu vyasavasturaṅgamā vicaskhalurmattagajāḥ kṣaranmadāḥ | cakampire yodhavarāḥ suradviṣāṃ samaṃ samastāḥ samare śarāhatāḥ ||24|| arccirbhiriddhairjvalito yathānalaḥ kakṣāṇi śuṣkāṇi dahatyavāritaḥ | dīptaiḥ śaroghaiḥ samaremaradviṣāṃ sainyāni tadvat pradadāha kauśikī ||25|| chāyāṃ yathā sthāvarajaṃgamānāṃ madhyandinelpāṃ kurute vivasvān | devī tathā tāṃ dhvajinīṃ ripūṇāmalpāvaśiṣṭāṃ samare cakāra ||26|| āhūya devīmatha dānavādhipau visphārya cāpe mahatī bhiseratuḥ | tīkṣṇaiḥ supatrairviśikhaiśca kauśikīṃ saṃchādayāmāsaturāhavājire ||27| | cāpeṣu yattau hariṣu dhvajeṣu mahābhujau krodhaparītacittau | daityeśvarau saṃyati devatāyā nicakhnaturvāṇavarānsupatrān | |28|| daiteśvarāstānatha sāyakaughānacintayitvā ripudarpahantrī | vivyādha daityau yudhi
