rukmapuṃkhaissuparvabhirvāṇavaraistupatraiḥ ||29|| daityāvapīṣūnavicintya śūrau gade pragṛhyojjvalacārughaṇṭe | udbhrāmya yatnātiśayena devyā raṇājire cikṣipaturbṛhatyau ||8.66.3 0 | | te vyomni bāṇaiśśataśo nikṛtya suparvabhirhāṭakacārupuṃkhaiḥ | viccheda devī kavace vicitre tayoḥ kṣuraprairaparaiḥ śitāgraiḥ ||3 1 || jaghāna cāśvānatha sārathī ca dhvajau ca citrau rathayoścakartta | cakhāna cānyānapi satpṛṣatkān suradviṣo rmarmasu hemapuṃkhān ||32|| śuṃbho niśuṃbhaśca rathāvapāsya daityeśvarau bāṇavarābhitaptau | ādāya nistriṃśavarau tadānīmutpetaturvyoma śitāsinīlam ||33|| atha nabhasi vimeghe dhautaniśtriṃśanīle drutataramabhisṛtya grīvayoḥ saṃpragṛhya | dititanayapatī tau niṣpipeṣāśu devī vigatabhayaviṣādaiḥ stūyamānā munīndraiḥ ||34| | asṛgatha vadanābhyāmudvamantau saphenaṃ sapadi vihatavīryau piṣṭasarvāṅgasandhī | asubhirapagataistau raktaparyantanetrau kṣititalamabhitastau petaturdaityasiṃhau ||35| | iti skandapurāṇe śuṃbhaniśuṃbhanipātana nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.67> sanatkumāra uvāca ājagmuḥ kauśikīṃ draṣṭumatha vindhyaṃ divaukasaḥ | ādityā vasavo rudrā marutvān marutośvinau ||1 || dharmāṅgirośano dakṣavasiṣṭhabhṛgukaśyapāḥ | pulastyapulahāgastyasanakātrisanandanāḥ ||2|| apsaroyakṣagarnvāḥ siddhā nāgā mahoragāḥ | upavedāśca yajñāśca vedā vidyā sarasvatī ||3|| samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailāstīrthāni vividhāni ca | mātaro lokapālāśca nakṣatrāṇi dhruvo grahāḥ ||4| | athocurdevatā devīṃ dyutimatyo mahādyutim | prahṛṣṭā hṛṣṭamanasāmāsīnāmasuradviṣaḥ ||5| | dānavendrau mahāsatvau tvayā trailokyakaṇṭakau | nighnatyā devi lokānāṃ duḥkhaśalyamapākṛtam ||6|| ṛṣayaḥ pāvanaṃ devi havirjuhvati sāmpratam | chandāṃsyadhīyate coccairācaranti vratāni ca ||7|| yajñoyamadhunā viprairijyate bahudakṣiṇaḥ | uṭajeṣu ca viśvastā munayaḥ śerate sukham | |8| | āsate nirbhayā devi santaḥ sanmārgamāśritāḥ | āvirbhūtaḥ punarloke vicchinnaḥ satkriyāpathaḥ ||9|| lokapālāḥ śirāṃsyuccaistvatprasādācca bibhrati | pṛktaḥ puṣparajobhiśca sukho vāti samīraṇaḥ ||8.67.1 0 || jalāni devi saritaḥ svacchāni śiśirāṇi ca | tvatprasādānmahāyoge vahanti vigataklamāḥ | |1 1 | | idānīñca punarjātā girayo girijātmaje | vijvarāḥ śiśirasvādunirjjharodakavāhinaḥ | |1 2|| phaṇān svastikacakrāṅkānuccairdadhati bhoginaḥ | udanvantaśca viśvāsādidānīṃ sukhamāsate || 13 | | bhramantyapsaraso devi tvatprasādācca sāṃpratam | saccetovimale vyomni vilāsālasalocanāḥ | | 14|| siddhāṅganāśca sevante viśvastā devi sāṃpratam | śikhareṣu mahīdhrāṇāmutphullān candanadrumān | | 1 5|| svabhāvānmadhupānācca raktotpalavilocanāḥ | vicarantyadhunā yakṣā gandhamādanasānuṣu || 16| | sukhaṃ bibhartti vasudhāmidānīṃ vigataklamaḥ | śeṣaḥ phaṇaiḥ sva ratnāṃśuvitānapariveṣibhiḥ || 17|| mātā tvamasi lokānāṃ bhītānāmabhayapradā | vṛṇu devi varāniṣṭānabhiṣicyasva cācyute | |18|| evamuktā surairdevī prāha kiñcit smayanniva | icchāmi pitaraṃ draṣṭumasamagrendumaulinam || 1 9| | suprasannaṃ prasannāñca jananīṃ śailanandanām | pitṛbhyāṃ cādhvanujñātā mabhiṣekṣyatha māṃ tataḥ | |8.67.20 || evamuktāḥ surā dadhyuravyagramanasastadā | sapatnīkaṃ mahādevamamitadyutipauruṣam ||21|| atha te dadṛśurdevā devadevamumāpatim | tejasāmiva sarveṣāṃ saṃghātaṃ purataḥ sthitam ||22 || jaṭānāṃ prāntababhrūṇāṃ śirasā bhāramunnatam | bibhrāṇaṃ jvalitaṃ vahniṃ dīptānāmarciṣāmiva ||23 || karpūrabhaṅgagaureṇa snātaṃ puṇyena bhasmanā | prāntahemalatājālaṃ raupyaṃ girimivocchritam |||24|| tejasā svena tejāṃsi tirayantaṃ divaukasām | madhyandine pradīpānāmarcīṃṣīva divākaram ||25|| sudhāmbusyandinīṃ tanvīmekataḥ pariveṣiṇīm | dadhānaṃ maulinā kiñcitkuṭilāmaindavīṃ kalām ||26| | vijihmāmujjvalāṃ gurvīṃ dhūsarāṃ bhasmareṇunā | saiṃhīṃ vasānamālambā mīṣadbhaṅgavatīṃ tvacam | |27| | churitopāntakāyena phaṇaratnamarīcibhiḥ | mahatā bhogapatinā vakṣaḥsthalavisarpiṇā ||28 || bhavānīṃ cāsya pārśvasthāṃ dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā | vasānāmaṃśukaṃ raktaṃ kalpapādapasaṃbhavam ||29|| mandāramālāmutphullāṃ mattālikulasevitām | dadhānāmuttamāṅgena svareṇūtkarapiñjarām ||8.67.3 0 || svaḥśilpighaṭitaiścitrai ratnāṃśupariveṣibhiḥ | śātakuṃbhamayaiḥ ślāghyairbhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ | |3 1 || bibhratīṃ rucirāṃ śuddhāṃ śaraccandrāṃśunirmalām | śirodhareṇāmahatīmekāvalimanuttamām ||32|| athotthāya surāssarve kauśikīṃ cānatānanā | tayoścaraṇapadmeṣu nipetustuṣṭamānasāḥ | |33 | | athodvīkṣya mahādevaḥ kauśikīmidamabravīt | ajeyā sarvabhūtānāṃ mahāyogā mahādyutiḥ ||34|| vicariṣyasi lokām̐stvaṃ sarvatrāpratighātinī | imāśca devatāḥ sarvāstvatprasādādanindite ||35| | bhaktyā balyupahāraiśca pūjayiṣyanti mānavāḥ | varadā cāpi bhaktānāṃ bhaviṣyasi sadānaghe | |3 6| | abhiṣicyasva ca kṣipraṃ surairasurasūdani | kṛtsnaṃ rakṣa ca bhūrlokaṃ pūjyamānā sadāvyaye ||37| | śarvāṇī ca pariṣvajya mūrdhni cāghrāya kauśikīm | prāha prītā mahābhāgā matprabhāvād bhaviṣyasi ||38|| arcayanti yathā māṃ ca surā yakṣā mahoragāḥ | gandharvā munayaḥ siddhāstathā tvāmapyanindite | |3 9| | arcayiṣyanti sarvatra bhaktāḥ stosyanti cāvyaye | evaṃ tasyai varaṃ dattvā girijāvṛṣabhadhvajau ||8.67.40 || namaskṛtau tadā devairantardadhaturavyayau | athendro viśvakarmāṇamādideśa tadā prabhuḥ | |41 | | sudharmeva sabhā divyā kriyatāmiha sāmpratam | ṛtūm̐śca sarvām̐ statretthamādideśa śatakratuḥ ||42|| nānāpuṣpotkaraiḥ kṣipraṃ bhūmiḥ samyag vibhūṣyatām | kṣupagulmalatāvṛkṣa puṣpareṇusugandhayaḥ ||43 | | ākṣipanto manāṃsyatra sukhā vāntu samīraṇāḥ | siñcantu vāribhiḥ puṇyairvindhyaprasthaṃ payomucaḥ | |44|| tāraṃ nadantu śikhinaḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ sarvatodiśam | nṛtyantu paritaścitrāndarśayantaḥ pṛthagvidhān ||45|| rasānbhāvānvilāsām̐śca sarvepyapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | pratisāryā suvīṇāśca gandharvā madhurasvaram | |46 || layatālasamaṃ geyaṃ gāyantu ca samantataḥ | āhanyantāṃ samantācca devadundubhayo bhṛśam | |47|| pāṇibhiḥ kaṭhinaistūrṇaṃ citrarūpā mahāsvanāḥ | mandānilasamuddhūtā līnālikulapaṃktayaḥ | |48|| patantvasminpradeśe ca divyāḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ | ucchriyantāṃ samantācca patākāścitramūrtayaḥ ||49| | dhvajāśca vividhākārā hemadaṇḍāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ | athāśu nirmame tatra viśvakarmā mahādyutiḥ | |8.67.50 | | nānāratnojjvalastambhāṃ vicitramaṇivedikām | vajrasphaṭikaniryūhāṃ jāmbūnadamayīṃ śubhām ||51 | | indranīlorusopānāṃ muktādāmāvalambinīma | sadhvajāṃ sapatākāṃ ca ghaṇṭāsvana nināditām ||52| | taponiyamayajñānāṃ sākṣāt siddhimivodgatām | bhinnakālāni puṣpāṇi dadṛśurdevatāstadā ||53 || samaṃ supuṇyagandhīni vicitrāṇi bahūni ca | puṣpakiñjalkagarbhāśca sukhasparśāḥ sugandhayaḥ ||54| | nādayanto muhurghaṇṭā vavustatra samīraṇāḥ | prajaguḥ suragandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | |55|| ṛṣayastuṣṭuvurgībhiḥ puṇyābhiḥ kauśikīṃ tadā | sarvaratnauṣadhairgandhaiḥ pūrṇāḥ puṇyaiśca vāribhiḥ || 56|| ānītāstatra kalaśā hemaratnamayāḥ śubhāḥ | padmarāgamayaiḥ siṃhaiścaturbhirvajrakeśaraiḥ | |57|| ucchvasadbhiriva śrīmaduhyamānaṃ hiraṇmayam | sarvaratnaprabhājālakhacitopāntamaṇḍalam | |58|| kalpayāmāsa devyāśca viśvakarmā varāsanam | stutibhirjayaśabdaiśca stūyamānā samantataḥ ||59|| ṛṣibhirdevatābhiśca devadevasutā tataḥ | tasmin siṃhāsane divye niṣasādātha kauśikī | |8.67.60 || kṛtasvastyayanā vipraiḥ suhute jātavedasi | vasānā vāsasī śukle kalpadrumasamudbhave ||61|| muktādāmāvabaddhāṅgī śuklasraganulepanā | tataḥ saptarṣayo viṣṇurdharmo yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||62|| ādityāḥ kaśyapo rudrā lokapālā hutāśanāḥ | śailendrāḥ pṛthivī gaṅgā candramā marutośvinau ||63 | | samudrā vasavo lakṣmīḥ sandhyā kīrtiḥ sarasvatī | nāgendrā vihageśāśca vividhāśca saridvarāḥ ||64|| ādāya kalaśān sarbānabhyaṣiñcanta kauśikīm | pūrṇendubimbapratimaṃ ratnadaṇḍaṃ mahādyutim ||65|| jagrāha vitataṃ chatraṃ svayameva śatakratuḥ | cāmarairhemadaṇḍaiśca dīrghaiścandrāṃśunirmalaiḥ ||66|| bījayāmāsu rāyastairlokapālāstadāvyayām | uvāca ca tataḥ śrīmān kauśikīṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ||67|| pāhi kṛtsnāṃ bhuvaṃ devi bhaginī tvaṃ mamāvyaye | bhaktānanugṛhāṇeśe jahi cāmarakaṇṭakān | vicarasva samastāṃśca lokān siddhagaṇārcitā | |68|| iti vacanamathoktvā kauśikīṃ devarājastridaśagaṇasametaḥ śubhraloloruhāraḥ | udapatadatha vindhyādvikṣipanvyomni nīlān salilabharavinamrānambuvāhānsamantāt | |69|| ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā satsamāgame | iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||8.67.70 || iti skandapurāṇe kauśikyabhiṣeko nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.68> sanatkumāra uvāca atha tā devatā devī kauśikī dehasaṃbhavāḥ | nyaveśayanmahābhāgā deśeṣu nagareṣu ca ||1 || bahuputrāṃ pralambo ca laṅkāyāṃ sannyaveśayat | lambauṣṭhīṃ vṛṣadaṃśāṃ ca kinnarīṃ caiva siṃhale ||2|| gokarṇe revatīṃ devīṃ pāṇḍyeṣu mukhamaṇḍikām | ābhīreṣvaśivāṃ caiva śāntiṃ ca varaṇātaṭe ||3 | | vatsagulme prabhāṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ kolagirāvapi | upakāṃ pārasīkeṣu vāyasīṃ yavaneṣu ca ||4|| pracaṇḍāṃ ca tuṣāreṣu kośaleṣu ca lambikām | jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva svapure saṃnyaveśayat | |5| | prabhāvatīṃ kaliṅgeṣu jayantīṃ nāgasāhvaye | kāśmīreṣu ca sā ṣaṣṭhīṃ saramāṃ malayeṣu ca ||6|| pūtanāṃ ca supīreṣu mṛtyuṃ pṛṣṭapure tathā | koṭīvarṣe bāhumāṃsāṃ pauṇḍreṣu kaṭapūtanām ||7|| aspṛṣṭāṃ madhyadeśe tu kinnarīṃ barbareṣu ca | vārāṇasyāṃ nirāyāsyāṃ citraghaṇṭāṃ ca kauśikīm ||8|| mahākālīṃ mahākāle vānarīṃ śabareṣu ca | śeṣāśca devatāḥ sarvā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca | |9|| karvaṭeṣu mahīdhreṣu kauśikī saṃnyaveśayat | kasyacittvatha kālasya svarṇākṣe hi mahātapāḥ || 8.68.1 0| | yatra viṣṇurvaraṃ lebhe devamārādhya śaṅkaram | cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma dviṣatāmantakopamam || 11 || ṛṣirāste mahābhāgaḥ śaradvānnāma gautamaḥ | tasya yajñaṃ jagāmātha devī tena nimantritā | | 1 2|| tasyāstatrāgamaṃ jñātvā sūnuḥ śumbhasya vīryavān | ājagāmāśu taṃ deśaṃ mahiṣo nāma dānavaḥ | | 13 || susaṃhataḥ pṛthūrasko mahāgrīvaḥ subāladhiḥ | vaktra(kra?)śṛṅgaḥ pṛthukhuro viśālocchritamastakaḥ | | 14|| baddhavairāśayaḥ krū ro mahāsatvotidurjayaḥ | vajraniṣpeṣaparuṣaṃ nardamāno mahāsvanaḥ | |1 5| | añjanādrisamaprakhyo yuyutsurbaladarpitaḥ | devyāḥ panthānamāvārya dānavendrasutaḥ sthitaḥ | | 16 || vijñāya tasyāgamanaṃ yogeśā vindhyavāsinī | jagāma tvaritā tatra yatrāsau dānavādhamaḥ | | 17| | atha dṛṣṭvā sa tāṃ devīṃ krodhādraktatarekṣaṇaḥ | abhyājagāma vegena yatnamāsthāya dānavaḥ || 18|| udvāladhistīkṣṇaviṣāṇakoṭiḥ supīnavakṣāḥ kaṭhinordhvakarṇaḥ | abhyāpatad guggulatāmranetro javena devīmasitādrikalpaḥ || 1 9|| taṃ kauśikī vīkṣya tadāpatantaṃ daityendraputraṃ mahiṣaṃ saroṣam | cukrodha tāmrāyatacārunetrā sthitā dharaṇyāmasurendrahantrī || ||8.68.20 | | abhyetya tāṃ dānavarājasūnurbalena mattaḥ parameṇa devīm | abhyāhanadvakṣasi lolahāre śṛṃgeṇa śakrāyudhakarkaśena | |2 1 || viṣahya taṃ tasya tadā prahāraṃ jagrāha śṛṅge mahiṣaṃ kareṇa | udbhrāmya coccaiḥ paritaḥ saroṣā nyapātayad bhūmitale śvasantam | |22|| udgṛhya sā bāladhimindraśatroḥ kṛtvā ca pādaṃ śirasi prasahya | triśūlamādāya bibheda pṛṣṭhe vyayojayaccāsubhirāśu daityam ||23 | | kuliśakaṭhinaśṛṅgaṃ nīlajīmūtakalpaṃ mahiṣamatha nihatya prauḍhadarpantadānīm | vividhakusumavṛṣṭyā sarvataḥ kīryamāṇā dharaṇidharamagacchat kauśikī sannivāsam | |24|| iti skandapurāṇe mahiṣāsuravadho nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.69> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan sarvalokajña pitāmahasamadyute | tapaḥ kṛtvā tadā devī puṣkalaṃ himavatsutā || 1 | | varaṃ yathepsitaṃ labdhvā brahmaṇo gauravarṇatām | kimanyadakarodvipra tapasonte mahāmune | |2 | | somanandī ca śārdūlaḥ kimavāpa varaṃ śubham | etanme pṛcchato brūhi bhaktāya praṇatāya ca | |3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ paramaṃ brahma śāśvatam | yaṃ paṭhanti sadā sāṃkhyāḥ puruṣaṃ paṃcaviṃśakam ||4|| yoginaścaiva ṣaḍviṃśaṃ brahmādyāśca divaukasaḥ | praṇamya parayā bhaktyā śirasā taṃ trilocanam | |5| | gauryā samāgamo vyāsa śaṅkarasya yathābhavat | tat pravakṣyāmi te sarvaṃ śṛṇu yogavidāṃ vara | | 6 || tasmin himavataḥ śṛṅge tapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram | gaurāṅgī sā tadā bhūtvā śuddhahemasamaprabhā ||7| | darśane śaṅkarasyātha śarvāṇī matimādadhe | mandaraṃ girimāgamya sahitā somanandinā | |8| | apaśyadbhavane bharturdvāramūle samāsthitam | nandinaṃ gaṇapaṃ devī dīptapaṭṭiśadhāriṇam ||9|| tato nandīśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktaṃ premṇā girīndrajā | ehi vatsa cirād dṛṣṭastvamityuktavatī tadā ||8.69.1 0|| nandī saṃprekṣya tāṃ cāpi gaurāṅgīṃ hemasaprabhām | harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ pādayorapatad bhṛśam ||1 1|| praṇamya sa tadā dhīmānastuvat parvatātmajām | namaḥ siddhyai mahādevyai rataye gataye namaḥ ||12|| tvaṃ kriyā kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca prakṛtirmuktireva ca | kāntirdyutistathā tuṣṭiśśāntiḥ svastyayanaṃ param ||13 || dakṣiṇā niyatirmṛtyuḥ sandhyā vidyudahaḥ kṣapā | pṛthivī kauśikī śrīśca śarvāṇī śarvavallabhā ||14|| gaṇamātā ditiścaiva pavitrā vindhyavāsinī | kṛṣṇā kātyāyanī gaurī bhūtamātā tatheśvarī ||15|| bhava devi prasannā me bhaktasya praṇatasya ca | atha devī tadā dṛṣṭvā nandinaṃ pādayornatam ||16|| provāca varadāsmīti sa ca vavre varaṃ śubham | prasannāṃ nityameva tvāmicchāmi varamuttamam ||17|| evamastviti sā procya praviveśāyatekṣaṇā | agratosyā yayau nandī somanandī ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||18|| candralekhobhayormadhye grahayoriva sā babhau | dūrādeva samālokya devadevo mudānvitaḥ ||19|| ājagāma mahātejāḥ saṃbhramotphullalocanaḥ | papāta pādayordevī devadevasya dhīmataḥ ||8.69.20|| atha devastadāyātāṃ devīṃ girivarātmajām | samuvāca suraśreṣṭhaḥ samālokya muhurmuhuḥ ||21 || diṣṭyāsi prītavadanā diṣṭyā ca saphalaṃ tapaḥ | diṣṭyā cedaṃ varaṃ varṇaṃ gauraṃ kanakasaprabham | |22| | priyannaḥ sarvathā devi paramaṃ yattvamāgatā | pratijñāṃ pūrayitveha śārdūloyaṃ kutaśca te ||23 || evamuktā tadā devī bhartrā praṇayapeśalam | kathayāmāsa devāya sarvañcaritamātmanaḥ ||24| | devyuvāca prāgahaṃ yattvayā deva kṛṣṇavarṇeti bhāṣitā | tadā manyuparītāṅgī gauravarṇasamīpsayā | |25| | himavacchikharaṃ gatvā tapohaṃ mahadāsthitā | cintayantī sadaiva tvāmekapādena saṃsthitā ||26|| yasminniva dine tatra tapohaṃ samupāśritā | tasminnevaiṣa śārdūlaḥ somanandī mamāgrataḥ | |27|| vyatiṣṭhata mahādeva bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tattapoyuktāhamāsthitā ||28|| tāvantaṃ kālameṣopi mamātiṣṭhat samīpataḥ | stabdhalāṅgūlanetrāsyo nirāhāro vilokayan ||29|| āgatastapasaścānte brahmā mama varapradaḥ | tamahaṃ pūrvamasyārthe varaṃ saṃprārthaya vibho| |8.69.3 0|| tenāyamamaro deva jarāśokavivarjitaḥ | mamaivānucaraḥ pārśve kṛto yogī ca śaṅkara | varṇaṃ cedamadarava tavādeśāta pitāmahaḥ | |3 1 || devadeva uvāca parituṣṭosmi te devi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam | mṛgendroyaṃ gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ somanandī mahābalaḥ ||3 2 || yādṛśo mama nandīśastādṛśaste bhaviṣyati | yadanyad brūhi tatsarvaṃ kariṣyāmi tava priye | |3 3 | | devyuvāca yasmindeśe mahādeva tapaścaritamuttamam | taṃ bhūyopi tvayā sārddhaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi śaṅkara | |34| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktasya pārvatyā provāca parameśvaraḥ | rocate cārusarvāṅgi gantuṃ tatra mamāvyaye ||3 5|| ramyaṃ taddhimavacchṛṅga taptaṃ yatra tapastvayā | nandinaṃ sa tadāhūya gaṇapām̐śca sahasraśaḥ || 3 6| | jagāma sahito devyā himavantaṃ mahāgirim | devairvidyādharaissiddhairgandharvairmunisattamaiḥ | |37| | vandyamānosakṛddevaḥ stūyamānaśca sarvaśaḥ | nandinaḥ pṛṣṭhamārūḍhaḥ prakrīḍitagaṇeśvaraḥ ||38|| himavadgirimāgamya taṃ pradeśamupāgamata | sa taṃ śikharamāsādya ramya dhātuvibhūṣitam | |3 9 || tutoṣa paramaprīto reme ca sagaṇeśvaraḥ | āgataṃ tamatho dṛṣṭvā mūrtimānacalastadā | upatasthe mahādevaṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ | |8.69.40 | | kṛtvā tadarghakuṇḍantu tasmiñchikharasattame | varadānena śailendramanvagṛhaṇāt pinākadhṛk | |41 || amaro jarayā tyaktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ | abhedyaścaiva vajreṇa matprasādād bhaviṣyasi ||42|| puṇyastvamacalaśreṣṭha bhavitā pāpamocanaḥ | gaurīśikhara ityeva loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi | |43|| dūrādeva nagaśreṣṭha dṛṣṭvā tvāmucchritaṃ janāḥ | savapāpairvimokṣyante yāsyanti ca parāṃ gatim ||44|| trirātramuṣito yastvāmabhiruhya śucivrataḥ | dṛṣṭvā gaurīmathābhyarcya brāhmaṇaṃ tarpayiṣyati ||45|| nārī vātha naro vāpi lokaṃ gauryāḥ sa yāsyati | yaśceha tyakṣyate prāṇānniyamena samāhitaḥ ||46| | sa gāṇapatyaṃ saṃprāpya mayā sārdhaṃ cariṣyati | gauryāścātraiva sānnidhyaṃ sarvadā te bhaviṣyati ||47 || sanatkumāra uvāca ityuktvā taṃ nagaśreṣṭhaṃ devadevastrilocanaḥ | pārvatyā sahitastatra paricakrāma sarvataḥ ||48|| athāpaśyacchilāṃ vyāsa sauvarṇāṃ maṇibhūṣitām | kathayāmāsa tāṃ devyai śilāṃ paśyeti sa prabhuḥ ||49|| tamāha devī deveśamiha taptaṃ mayā tapaḥ | priyamevaṃ mama sthānaṃ somanandina eva ca ||8.69.50|| atha tāmanujagrāha śilāṃ prītyā bhavastadā | śucirasyāṃ nirāhāraṃ trirātraṃ yaḥ kariṣyati ||51| | bhavettaptaṃ tapastena lokañca tava yāsyati | ekapādena yo martyastiṣṭhedekamahaḥ śuciḥ ||52|| tapanābhimukho bhūtvā tvadbhaktastvatparāyaṇaḥ | sopi yāsyati te lokaṃ gaṇapaśca bhaviṣyati | |53 || prāṇān parityajedyaśca śilāyāmiha dustyajān | sopi taptatapā bhūtvā brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati | |54| | imañca parvatoddeśamāspadaṃ somanandinaḥ | yobhigacchedahorātraṃ sopi nandisamo bhavet ||55|| athāpṛcchat punardevaḥ pārvatīṃ vicarana prabhuḥ | kathametāni kuṇḍāni babhūvuriha śailajai | |56| | evaṃ pṛṣṭā punardevī vākyametajjagāda ha | yadāhamāgatā deva tapastaptumiha prabho | |57| | stanayoḥ prasrute dhāre mahatyau me tadāsakṛt | ete tābhyāṃ kṛte kuṇḍe sitatoye mahāplave | |58|| tapastaptumalaṅkarānahaṃ tyaktavatī yadā | tadā tebhyaḥ srutā deva jaladhārāpatad drutam || 59|| tathā cedamapāṃ kuṇḍaṃ dvitīyaṃ me kṛtaṃ śubham | brahmaṇaśca yadā labdhaṃ gauravarṇatvamuttamamra | |8.69.6 0 | | śarīrānme tadā deva kṛṣṇā kośī viniṣkramat | tasyāṃ kośyāṃ samutpannametat kuṇḍaṃ tṛtīyakam ||61 || asmin pradeśe deveśa tvāmabhyarcya yathāvidhi | havirbhirmantrayuktābhiragnikāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā || 62|| imāni pādapasthāni valkalāni samāsate | idaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śubhraṃ sthāpitaṃ tat purā mayā | |63|| atha śrutvā mahādevaḥ pārvatyā vacanaṃ prabhuḥ | pratyuvāca tadā devīṃ prītyā paramayā yutaḥ | |64|| stanatoyena yat pūrṇe tava kuṇḍe śaśiprabhe | stanakuṇḍeti tenaite yāsyete khyātimuttamām ||65|| upavāsī naro yotra snātvābhyarcya ca devatāḥ | tarpayitvā pitṝnsarvān brāhmaṇānbhojayiṣyati ||66|| tad bhavedakṣayaṃ tasya gaṇaścaiva bhaviṣyati | alaṃkārāt srutā dhārā yeyaṃ tava varānane | |67|| eṣālaṃkāradhāreti nāmnā khyātiṃ gamiṣyati | asyāṃ snātvā naro yastu pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati ||68|| akṣayaṃ tad bhavecchrāddhamaśvamedhañca vindati | nīlatoyamidaṃ yatte mahat kuṇḍaṃ śubhodakam ||69|| nīlakuṇḍamiti khyātimetat sarvatra yāsyati | yosminniyamavān snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ ||8.69.70 || tasyākṣayaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ pāpebhyassa pramucyate | mṛtaśca sa naro devi yatra tatra yathā tathā ||71|| kauśikyā vindhyavāsinyā mahāgaṇapatirbhavet | agnikāryamiha snātvā yaḥ kuryād brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ ||72|| agnihotraṃ hutaṃ tena bhaved dvādaśavārṣikam | evamuktvā mahādevaḥ protthāya munisattama ||73|| gṛhītvā pādapasthāni valkalāni tadā prabhuḥ | nadī bhaveti saṃprocya cikṣepa prahasanniva ||74| | tānyabhūvaṃstadā vyāsa nadī svacchajalā śubhā | taṭajairvividhairvṛkṣairhaṃsacakrāhvaśobhitā ||75|| tāmuvāca suraśreṣṭhaḥ puṇyatoyāṃ mahānadīm | cīrebhyo nissṛtā yasmāt tvamatra saritāṃ varā ||76|| loke puṇyatamā tasmānniścīreti bhaviṣyasi | tvayi snātvā naraḥ kṣipraṃ sarvapāpairvimucyate ||77|| pitṝnsantarpayedyastu śrāddhaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ bhavet | kapilāñcātra yo dadyād brāhmaṇāya samāhitaḥ | |78| | gosahasraphalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati varānane | agramāruhya yasmāttvamatra taptavatī tapaḥ ||79|| agrāraṇyamiti khyātimetadyāsyati sarvataḥ | mahāphalaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham | |8.69.80 | | pañcayojanasaṃsthānaṃ gaurīśikharamuttamam | ihopoṣya śuciḥ snātvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||81 || dehabhedaṃ samāsādya vimānastho virājate | kṛṣṇājinaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ tava ||82 | | idaṃ drakṣyati yo vipraḥ svargastasya na durlabhaḥ | yatphalaṃ naimiśāraṇye puṣkareṣu ca yatphalam | |83 || tadeva labhate devi dṛṣṭavā kṛṣṇājinaṃ dvijaḥ | vatsyāmi caiva satataṃ tvayā sārdhamiha priye |84|| āvāmiha sthitau devi yorcayiṣyati mānavaḥ | āvayorgaṇapo bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ cariṣyati ||85 | | evaṃ nagendraṃ sa tadānugṛhya munīndra sārdhaṃ girirājaputryā | devaissasiddhairanugamyamānaḥ śarvaḥ punarmandaramājagāma ||86 || iti skandapurāṇe devīsamāgame kośīśilāstanakuṇḍājinagaurī śikharavarapradānaṃ nāma ūnasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.70> vyāsa uvāca sa gatvā mandaraṃ bhūyo giriputryā saha prabhuḥ | yaccakāra mahādevastanme brūhi mahāmune | | 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca mandaraṃ girimāgatya pārvatyā sahito haraḥ | reme hiraṇmaye divye sarvaratnavibhūṣite ||2 || cārusopānasaṃkīrṇe citrapaṭṭaśilātale | tasmin puravare śreṣṭhe manasā nirmite tadā | |3 || gaṇeśvarairmahāyogairnandīśvarapurogamaiḥ | siddhairmunivaraiścaiva sevyamāno jagatpatiḥ ||4|| uvāsa sahito devyā vandyamānastathaiva ca | tasyaivaṃ dīvyato vyāsa devadevasya dhīmataḥ ||5|| sahasrākṣaḥ śaśāṅkaśca vāyuścaiva tadā gatāḥ | samāgamya puradvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā te nandinaṃ sthitam || 6|| ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā śaṅkaraṃ saṃ didṛkṣavaḥ | yathā paśyāma deveśaṃ nandin tatkartumarhasi | |7| | atha nandī samāgatya dvāramūle samāsthitaḥ | śambhornivedayāmāsa trīndevān tu samāgatān ||8| | viśantviti samājñapte devadevena nandini | viviśuste trayo devāḥ śaṅkarasyāntikaṃ tadā ||9|| praṇamya sahitāstasthuḥ paśyanto varadaṃ vibhum | atha tānprāha lokeśaḥ śirobhiḥ praṇatān sthitān | |8.70.10|| kā vaḥ kartavyatā devāḥ kimarthaṃ yūyamāgatāḥ | brūta dāsyāmi tatsarvaṃ yadyanmṛgayathāmarāḥ || 11 || atha devaḥ sahasrākṣo vacaḥ provāca śaṅkaram | hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hantumasurendraṃ mahābalam || 12|| yaccakāra vapurviṣṇurnārasiṃhaṃ bhayānakam | taṃ hatvāpi sa daityendraṃ viṣṇuḥ parabalārdanaḥ ||1 3| | tadrūpaṃ naiva santyajya svaṃ veṣamakarod vibho | tena rūpeṇa deveśa krūreṇāpi hitepsunā ||14|| na vayaṃ nirvṛtā bhūtvā trāsāttiṣṭhāma śaṃkara | sa yathā siṃharūpaṃ tatparityajati mādhavaḥ || 1 5| | prasādaṃ nastathā kartumarhasi tvaṃ surottama | atha provāca taṃ śakraṃ devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk ||1 6|| siṃharūpaṃ yathā śakra viṣṇustyakṣyati bhīṣaṇam | kariṣyāmi tathā śakra vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ||17|| atha vāyustadā devaṃ vyajñāpayata śaṃkaram | aśarīro yathā na syāṃ tathā me kartumarhasi | |18|| śrutvā pavanavijñaptiṃ devastasmai trilocanaḥ | śarīraṃ sumahat prādādyenāsau mūrtimānabhūt | |1 9| | vijñāpitaṃ śaśāṅkena tato vyāsa mahātmanā | dakṣeṇāhaṃ purā śapto yakṣmadeho bhaviṣyasi ||8.70.20| | sa yathā yakṣmahīnaḥ syāṃ prasādaṃ me tathā kuru | vijñaptiṃ śaśinaḥ śrutvā devastasmai vacaḥ prabhuḥ ||21 || idaṃ prāha mahātejāḥ śaśine praṇatāya tu | tapaḥ kṛtvā prabhāse tvaṃ yakṣyahīno bhaviṣyasi ||22| | iti labdhvā varaṃ sarve trayopi surasattamāḥ | vāyusomasahasrākṣāḥ svāni veśmāni bhejire | |23 || vyāsa uvāca bhagavansa kathaṃ tena narasiṃhena sūditaḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ kiṃprabhāvaśca sobhavat | kiṃ vīryaṃ kiṃ tapaścāsya śaṃsaitat pṛcchato mama ||24|| sanatkumāra uvāca ditirnāmābhavat patnī kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ | dakṣasya duhitā vyāsa sā jajñe tanayadvayam | |25|| hiraṇyakaśipuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ kanīyasam | abhiṣiktaḥ sa daityānāṃ rājābhūd brahmaṇā purā ||26 || dānavānāmathendratve vipracittirmahābalaḥ | sahasrākṣaśca devānāmetadindratrayaṃ babhau ||27| | atha teṣāṃ tadā vyāsa trailokyaṃ saṃpraśāsatām | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ śakrarājyajihīrṣayā ||28| | trailokyamātmasāt kartuṃ matiṃ tapasi sandadhe | sa gatvā dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ śrīparvatasamāsthitaḥ ||29|| tapastīvraṃ mahattepe daityarājo mahābalaḥ | svaraktena juhāvāgnau saṃmiśrāḥ samidhaścarūn ||8.70.3 0 || ūrdhvabāhunirālambo divā sūryārpitekṣaṇaḥ | ekapādonimeṣaśca sotiṣṭhat kṛtaniścayaḥ ||3 1 || dve sahasre tadābdānāṃ divyānāṃ sthitavānbalī | mahatā tapasā tasya trailokyaṃ saṃpracukṣubhe ||32| | athābhyetya suraśreṣṭho brahmā kamalavāhanaḥ | iṣṭaṃ vṛṇu varaṃ rājanniti provāca sādaram ||33 || taṃ dṛṣṭatvā daityarājastu brahmāṇaṃ varadaṃ prabhum | varaṃ prārthitavān vyāsa śṛṇu yādṛśamīpsitama ||34| | bhagavanyadi tuṣṭosi vara eṣostu me vibho | amaraḥ syāmavadhyaśca jarāhīno mahābalaḥ ||35|| na śastreṇa nacāstreṇa na rātrau na divā tathā | naivārdreṇa na śuṣkeṇa na puṃsā na ca yoṣitā | |36|| abravīt sontaraṃ vrahmā sa cainaṃ samabhāṣata | ataśca yonyathā mṛtyurbhaviṣyati sa me prabho ||37|| evamastviti taṃ procya brahmā suravarottamaḥ | jagāmātmapuraṃ kṣipraṃ śāntaḥ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||38|| sopi sarvāsuraśreṣṭho hiraṇyakaśipustadā | jitvā śakraṃ svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra ditinandanaḥ ||39|| trailokyamātmasāt kṛtvā jitvā sarvāndivaukasaḥ | ātmanaivābhavacchakraḥ svayaṃ vāyuḥ svayaṃ yamaḥ | dhaneśo varuṇo vahnissarva evābhavat svayam ||8.70.40|| praṇamadhvaṃ yajadhvaṃ māṃ brahmāhaṃ sapurandaraḥ | iti prāha ṛṣīnsarvānsiddhānviprāṃśca sosuraḥ ||41|| vyāsa uvāca śrīparvata iti prokto yastvayā munisattama | kathaṃ śrīparvatosau vai kiṃ puṇyaṃ tatra kiṃ phalam ||42|| sanatkumāra uvāca hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi suvrata | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo yatra tepe mahattapaḥ ||43|| girau tasminmahāpuṇye devadevo bṛṣadhvajaḥ | umayā sahito devyā reme nityaṃ mahādyutiḥ ||4|| tiṣṭhatastatra devasya devī girivarātmajā | tapaḥsiddhān mahāyogān jvalanādityavarccasaḥ ||45|| kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ śambhossapraṇāmaṃ mahāmune | gacchatastānmuhurdṛṣṭvā papraccha bhuvaneśvaram ||46|| ka ete deva saṃsiddhā yogīśāstvāṃ praṇemire | tato devaḥ prahasyaināmuvāca parameśvaraḥ | |47|| yogasiddhā mahātmāno yoge pāśupate sthitāḥ | ya ihārādhya māṃ devi jahuḥ prāṇānnarottamāḥ ||48| | ta ete siddhadehārthāḥ svachandagaticāriṇaḥ | mokṣasiddheḥ parāṃ niṣṭhāṃ gantāraḥ paramaṃ padam | |49|| atha sañcintya suciraṃ vismayāyatalocanā | devaṃ provāca śarvāṇī vacaḥ paramapūjitam ||8.70.50 || yathāhamapi deveśa prāpnuyāṃ siddhimīdṛśīm | kariṣyāmi tathā yatnameṣā cāsmi gatā vibho | | 51 || tataḥ kṛtvā śriyo rūpaṃ devī paramaśobhanā | mahattatra tapastepe sahasraṃ parivatsarān | |52|| devaścāsyā varaṃ prādāttaiḥ samānaṃ mahādyutiḥ | kṛtsnasyādhyātmatantrasya mayā proktasya bhāmini | |53 || mahāyogeśvarī siddhā parārthajñā bhaviṣyasi | ayañca parvataḥ śrīmānnāmnā tava bhaviṣyati | |54|| śrīparvata iti khyātaścitrarūpavibhūṣitaḥ | samantādyojanaśataṃ mahāpuṇyo bhaviṣyati | |55| | ihāgamya ca yo devi tvāṃ māṃ ca girinandane | śuciḥ snātvārcayenmarttyaḥ sa lokaṃ mama yāsyati ||56|| yastviha tyakṣyate prāṇāñchrīgirāvacalottame | trinetraḥ kāmago bhūtvā gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt | |57| | ihāgatya ca ye śailaṃ kariṣyanti pradakṣiṇam | śarvāyatanasaṃyuktaṃ bhaviṣyanti ca te gaṇāḥ ||58|| atiśayaramaṇīye siddhasaṃghairupete surabhikusumacitre śrīgirau ye pumāṃsaḥ | vyapagatamaladoṣā māṃ prapaśyanti śuddhā viyati vihagayuktaiste vimānaiḥ prayānti ||5 9 || iti skandapurāṇe śrīgirivarapradānaṃ nāma saptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ <8.71> sanatkumāra uvāca śāsatastasya daityasya hiraṇyakaśipostadā | agāt kālo mahān vyāsa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ||1 || darpeṇa mahatāviṣṭaḥ śrīmadodvṛttacetanaḥ | avamene surānsarvān na ca dharmamavaikṣata ||2| | sa devān sahitān sarvāñchakrādyān krodhamūrcchitaḥ | cālitānapi rājye sve kṛcchramāpādayad bhṛśam ||3 | | santāpyamānāste sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa pitāmaha mahādyute ||4| | hiraṇyakaśipurdaityastvatto labdhavaronagha | trailokyaṃ kṛtsnamākramya rājyaṃ no hṛtavāndivaḥ | |5 || aniśaṃ cāvamānannaḥ prayuṃkte vairayātanam | tena vidrāvitāssarve śaraṇaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ||6| | prasādaṃ kuru deveśa sa na syānno yathā ripuḥ | tyaktadharmā jagacchatrurhiraṇyakaśipurbalī | |7|| evaṃ proktastadā devairdevaḥ kamalavāhanaḥ | provācedaṃ mahāprajña devānāṃ priyakṛdvacaḥ ||8| | kṣīṇaṃ tad daityarājasya tapastasya durātmanaḥ | kṛcchraṃ gamitavān yo vo rājyañca hṛtavān ripuḥ | |9 | | tenāhaṃ prārthitaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvāvadhyatvamuttamam | antaraṃ bhāṣitaścāsau mayā saṃjñāvimohitaḥ | | 8.71.10 | | yadaivāntaramāhātha daityarājo vicetanaḥ | tadaiva manasā toṣamahamāgāṃ mahābalāḥ | |1 1 || te yūyamadya gacchadhvaṃ viṣṇorbhavanamuttamam | taṃ brūta sahitāssarve tasya nāśārthamacyutam | | 1 2|| narasiṃhavapuḥ kṛtvā sakṛdāhatya haṃsyati | hiraṇyakaśipuṃ daityaṃ tato nirvṛtimeṣyatha || 13 | | evamastviti te sarve praṇipatya pitāmaham | ājagmuḥ sahitā devā viṣṇorbhavanamādṛtāḥ | |14|| atha dṛṣṭvā mahātejā viṣṇurdevānupasthitān | uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā vacaścoktimanoharam ||1 5 | | svāgataṃ bhavatāmastu kimarthaṃ yūyamāgatāḥ | pūjyā bhavantassarve me suhṛdotigarīyasaḥ ||1 6| | yadvo manogataṃ kiñcinmayā kāryaṃ divaukasaḥ | kṣipraṃ tad brūta saṃkṣiptaṃ kartāhamavicāritam ||17|| viṣṇunaivaṃ tadā proktā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | ūcuḥ prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ saṃstuvanto janārdanam | |18|| hiraṇyakaśipordeva daityarājo mahābalāt | bhayaṃ naḥ sumahajjātaṃ rājyaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ divaḥ | |19| | avamānaḥ prayuktaśca tenāsmabhyaṃ surottama | bhunakti sa jagat kṛtsnaṃ brahmadviṭ kaśyapātmajaḥ ||8.71.2 0 || sa yathā vadhyate daityastvayā sarvārisūdana | tathā kuru hṛṣīkeśa varoyaṃ naḥ pradīyatām ||21 || tato viṣṇuściraṃ dhyātvā vadhopāyaṃ pracintya ca | prāha devān suraśreṣṭho vacasāpyāyayanniva | |22| | evamastu suraśreṣṭhāḥ sarvaṃ kartāsmi vo vacaḥ mahābalasya daityendro yato yuṣmānvadāmyaham | |23 | | āviśantu bhavantopi śarīraṃ mama suvratāḥ | sarvadevamayo bhūtvā dṛptaṃ haṃsyāmi vo ripum | |24|| tato devāstadā sarve viviśurvaiṣṇavīṃ tanum | sa cāpi balavān bhūtvā rūpaṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam | |25| | nārasiṃhaṃ mahātejā nakhadaṃṣṭrāvibhūṣaṇam | jagāma vilasan viṣṇurhiraṣyakaśipoḥ puram ||26|| udyānaṃ sa bahistasya sarvartukusumairvṛtam | nṛsiṃho daityasiṃhasya dṛṣṭvā tasthau suvismitaḥ ||27|| campakāśokajātībhiḥ kadambairbakulairapi | tathā surabhipuṣpaiśca samantādupaśobhitam | |28|| sarobhiḥ padmasaṃchannairhaṃsacakrāhvaśobhitaiḥ | vṛkṣaiḥ kāmaphalaiścaiva vaibhrājasadṛśaṃ vanam ||29|| tadbabhañja nṛsiṃhastu khelagāmī madotkaṭaḥ | sarāṃsi kṣobhayāmāsa karīva sa madolbaṇaḥ ||8.71.3 0 || sa reje vanamadhyasthaḥ parisarpannitastataḥ | meroracalarājasya sthitaṃ śṛṅgamivocchritam ||3 1 || athābhyetya nṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ vanapālā ruṣānvitāḥ | balino vārayāmāsustām̐ścaivābhyahanad balī ||32|| hataśeṣāstatastatra pravilīnāstu yesurāḥ | te gatvā kathayāmāsurhiraṇyakaśipostadā | | 33 | | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityarājo mahābalaḥ | prahlādañcānuhrādañca namuciṃ bāṣkaliṃ balim | |34| vipracittipradhānām̐śca sarvānāhūya dānavān | provāca tvaritaṃ gatvā baddhvā siṃhaṃ mamāntikam | |3 5|| samānayata daityendrā na hantavyaḥ kathañcana | krīḍanaṃ siṃhapotosau devyā mama bhaviṣyati || 36 | | iti śrutvāsurāssarve vipracittipurogamāḥ | udyānaṃ sahitā gatvā nṛsiṃhaṃ dadṛśuḥ sthitam ||37|| dūrasthāścikṣipuḥ pāśām̐stām̐nsa ciccheda mādhavaḥ | atha vidrāvayāmāsa dānavān keśarī bhṛśam ||3 8|| tato hatasahāyāste daityā vimanaso yayuḥ | pārśvaṃ dānavarājasya sarvañcākathayam̐stadā ||3 9 | atha kruddhaḥ svayaṃ rājā hiraṇyakaśipurbalī | rathamāsthāya sannaddhā nṛsiṃhaṃ prādravadruṣā | |8.71.40 | | sa rathaḥ siṃharājena sāyudhaḥ parvatopamaḥ | saṃbhrāmya pātitastūrṇaṃ cūrṇamāgānmahītale ||41 | | tato bhagnaratho daityaḥ krodhātsaṃraktalocanaḥ | vṛkṣamutpāṭya vegena nṛsiṃhāya vyasarjayat | |42| | athāsau patito gātre siṃharājasya pādapaḥ | mṛtkhaṇḍa iva pāṣāṇe kṣiptaścūrṇaṃ jagāma ha ||43 || gṛhītvā sa tadā siṃho hiraṇyaśipuṃ sakṛt | talenāhatya taṃ prāṇairvyayojayata satvaram ||44|| siṃhanādaṃ mahat kṛtvā nakhairvajramayairvibhuḥ | uro bibheda daityasya mahāśailopamaṃ hariḥ | |45|| hate tasminmahādaitye viṣṇunā śaktinandana | dānavā na hatāḥ ye tu viviśuste rasātalam | |46|| divo rājyaṃ punaḥ śakro lebhe niṣkaṇṭakaṃ mahat | divaukasaśca sarve te svāni rājyāni bhejire ||47| | athāgatya tato devaḥ śūlapāṇirvṛṣadhvajaḥ | surairvijñāpito vyāsa yatte kathitavānaham ||48 || viṣṇostyājayituṃ rūpaṃ saiṃhamadbhutakarmaṇaḥ | śarabhassa tadā bhūtvā himavacchikharopamaḥ ||49|| caturbhiḥ pṛṣṭhajaiḥ pādaistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ | narasiṃhasamīpaṃ tu gatvāgarjat samāhitaḥ ||8.71.50 | | atha siṃhastadā dṛṣṭvā śarabhaṃ samupasthitam | krodhena mahatāviṣṭastalenainamatāḍayat | |51 || sa hatastena siṃhena śarabho naiva cukṣubhe | tataḥ śarabhamāhatya vajradehaṃ mahābalama | |52|| ātmanaivāgamat kṛcchraṃ sparśāttasya mahātmanaḥ | tato viṣṇuściraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā śaṅkaramāgatam ||53 || praṇamya śirasā taṃ vai stotumevaṃ pracakrame | namaḥ śarvāya rudrāya senānye śarmadāya ca ||54|| namaḥ paramadevāya brahmaṇe paramāya ca | kālāya yamarūpāya kāladaṇḍāya vai namaḥ ||55|| namaḥ lāntakartre ca kālekālaharāya ca | namaḥ pinākahastāya raudrabāṇadharāya ca ||56|| caṇḍāya vāmadevāya sarvayogeśvarāya ca | namo vidyādhipataye brahmaṇaḥ pataye namaḥ ||57|| namosuravaraghnāya kālacakrāya te namaḥ | saṃvarttakāgnicakrāya pralayāntakarāya ca ||58| | naranārāyaṇeśāya naranārāyaṇātmane | mamaiva varadātre ca sarvakāmapradāya ca ||59|| śarabhāya surūpāya vyāghracarmasuvāsase | nandīśvaragaṇeśāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||8.71.60 || indriyāṇāmatheśāya manasaspataye namaḥ | namaḥ pradhānapataye surāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ ||61|| namostu bhāvapataye tattvānāṃ pataye namaḥ | carācarāṇāṃ pataye bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||62|| trailokyapataye caiva lokānāṃ pataye namaḥ | yogadāya namo mahyaṃ tathaivaiśvaryadāya ca | |63 | | avadhyatvapradātre ca tathaivājapyadāya ca | bhagavaṃstvatpratiṣṭhosmi tvanniṣṭhastvatparāyaṇaḥ | śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapannohaṃ prasīda mama sarvadā ||64| | ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | sa rudralokamāsādya devasya gaṇapo bhavet | |65|| dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | śrāvaṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāsya tathānusmaraṇaṃ sadā | |66|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evaṃ stūyamānastu viṣṇunā bhuvaneśvaraḥ | hṛṣīkeśamuvācedaṃ vacaḥ paramapūjitam ||67|| tubhyaṃ viṣṇo mayā dattaḥ puṇyo hyeṣa varaḥ śubhaḥ | ayonau sajjamānasya svayonau pratipādanam | |68| | sa tvaṃ viṣṇurmahātejā matto labdhavarassadā | velāyāṃ tvāṃ samudrastu tiryagyonimasūta yaḥ (?) || 69| | kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ | ehi gaccha śubhāṃ yonimātmanaḥ paramādbhutām | |8.71.70 | | tatastamākramat pādaiḥ siṃhaṃ śarabhasattamaḥ | ayojayacca dehena punardivyena keśavam | |71 | | viṣṇavetha varaṃ dattvā daityaghnaṃ sa vṛṣadhvajaḥ | prakṛtistho bhavetyuktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ||72|| datvā tasmai varamanupamaṃ viṣṇave lokadhātā daityaghnatvaṃ surapuravadhūlocanaiḥ pīyamānaḥ | nīlāmbhodadyutinibhamuraḥ prodvahacchūlapāṇirdhāma svīyaṃ paramamunibhirvandyamāno jagāma | |73 || iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyakaśipūpākhyāne śarabhakṛtanarasiṃhoddhārākhyānaṃ nāma ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.72> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan sarvayogajña śrutamākhyānamuttamam | parataḥ śrotumicchāmi yad vṛttaṃ munisattama | |1 || apanīya tadā viṣṇoḥ siṃharūpaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ | kimanyadakaroddhīmānetadicchāmi veditum | |2 | | sanatkumāra uvāca svayoniṃ viṣṇumānīya devadevo bhavastadā | mandare sahito devyā vicacāra mahādyutiḥ ||3 | | ramyān sa kānanoddeśān gireḥ prasravaṇāni ca | alañcakāra deveśaḥ parisarpan samantataḥ ||4|| vanaprekṣārataṃ devaṃ jñātvā śaṅkaramavyayam | śarattatra vasantaśca dvāvṛtū samupasthitau ||5| | tato mahīruhāḥ sarve sarāṃsi ca samantataḥ | nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi mumucussahasā samam ||6|| kamalotpalasaṃchannāḥ ṣaṭpadavrātasevitāḥ | haṃsasārasasaṃvāsā vāpyastatra manoharāḥ ||7|| gandhāḍhyā jātayaḥ kṣipraṃ babhūvuḥ saha campakaiḥ | aśokā gandhapuṣpāśca tathā caivātimuktakāḥ ||8|| upatasthuḥ samaṃ devaṃ sarvagandhasukhānilāḥ | sarvartukusumākīrṇaṃ dṛṣṭavā tadvanamuttamam | |9|| puṣpāṇyādāya deveśaḥ svayameva jagatpatiḥ | alañcakāra hṛṣṭātmā devīṃ himagireḥ sutām ||8.72.1 0 || nandīśvarañca pārśvasthamātmānañca sureśvaraḥ | tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ pārvatī praṇayādidam | | 11 || vacaḥ provāca jananī kṛtsnasya jagatovyayā | yathā me dehajaḥ putro bhavitā govṛṣadhvaja ||1 2|| tvadvīryastvatprabhāvaśca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ | tathā kuru mahādeva yadi te priyatā mayi | |1 3|| evamuktastadā devyā devadevastrilocanaḥ | provācedaṃ mahātejā devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā | |14|| evaṃ bhavatu deveśe vijñaptiṃ saphalāmimām | kariṣyāmi taveśāni putraste sa bhavedyathā | |15|| śreṣṭhaḥ sarvasureśānāṃ mahāyogabalānvitaḥ | kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ yasya vaśe sthāsyati bhāmini | | 1 6|| gacchantyā tat tapaḥ karttuṃ varaḥ pūrvamapi tvayā | prārthito hyeṣa putrārthaṃ tenāvaśyaṃ dadāmi te | | 17|| evamuktvā tu tau devau girijābhuvaneśvarau | nandīśena tadā sārdhaṃ vicarantau jagadgurū ||18|| sarvodyānāni paśyantau vindhyamājagmaturgirim | athāgamya tu vindhyasya sauvarṇaṃ śikharottamam | | 1 9| | darīkandarasaṃkīrṇaṃ nānānirjharasaṃyutam | sataḍinmeghasaṃghāta ghanīkṛtaśiloccayam | |8.72.20 || nānāvṛkṣaśilopetaṃ nānākusumasaṃyutam | nānākhagaravāmodaṃ hemaratnojjvalaṃ śubham ||21 || mānasaṃ tasya madhye tu puraṃ sṛṣṭvā maharddhimat | maṇihemamayaṃ divyaṃ devāsuravimohanam ||2 2 | | paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktau yutau viviśatuḥ puram | nandinañca tato devī samājñāpayadavyayā | 23 | | vatsa nandin tathā dvāre tiṣṭhestvaṃ gaṇapeśvara | viśenneha vathā kaścit sūkṣmo vāyurapi sthitaḥ | |24| | kṛtvā śirasi tāmājñāṃ nandīśo gaṇapādhipaḥ | abhavad dvāramūlasthaḥ kṛtvā tejotidussaham | |25|| yogayuktau tadā devau parāṃ mūrttiṃ samāsthitau | kṛtsnasya jagato yonī pārvatībhuvaneśvarau ||2 6 | | tasthatuḥ suciraṃ kālaṃ tanayārthaṃ mahādyutī | sa na śakyo mayā vaktuṃ brahmaṇā vā mahāmune ||27| | suyogo yobhavad devyā devadevasya śūlinaḥ | brahmaṇo madvidhānāñca śreṣṭhosau parameśvaraḥ | | 28| | avaśyaṃ tvāgame vācyaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam | ato vakṣyāmi te vyāsa priyaḥ śiṣyaśca me bhavān || 29|| yogasandhānamāsthāya tayorevaṃ mahāmune | atītaṃ sthitayordivyaṃ sahasraṃ śaradāmabhūt ||8.72.3 0 || tatobhavannimittāni ghorāṇi trāsanāni ca | cacāla pṛthivī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā | |3 1 | | nadyaḥ śoṣaṃ tadā jagmuścukṣubhe saritāṃ patiḥ | tapano niṣprabhaścāsīd vavāvuṣṇaḥ samīraṇaḥ ||3 2 || peturulkā mahāghorā diśaścāsansudāruṇāḥ | evamutpātavitrastā śubhahetorvasundharā ||3 3 || jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ gatvā cārttiṃ nyavedayat | utpātā dāruṇā deva babhūvurbahavo bhṛśam ||34|| tenātīva samudvignā tvāmadya śaraṇaṃ gatā | atha viṣṇuḥ surānsarvānidamaśrāvayat prabhuḥ | |35|| tato divaukasaḥ sarve bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ | ekatra saṃgatā bhūtvā cakrurbahuvidhāḥ kathāḥ ||3 6|| mahābuddhirathāhedaṃ vākyamaṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ | śrīkaṇṭho bhagavāneṣa devadevastrilocanaḥ ||37|| yuktobhūddhimavatputryā tanayārthaṃ mahādyutiḥ | divyaṃ varṣasahasrantu yogena parameṣṭhinaḥ | |38|| agādyuktasya pārvatyā babhūvurdāruṇāstataḥ | utpātā jagatastrāsāścintyate kimihāparam ||39|| gacchāma sahitāḥ sarve stotuṃ bhaktyā vṛṣadhvajam | yathā ca dehajaḥ putro bhaved devyāḥ sureśvarāḥ ||8.72.40 || vijñāpayāma deveśaṃ tathā śīghramihāmarāḥ | tato vaivasvataḥ prāha vacaḥ krodhābhiniḥsṛtam ||41|| kimarthaṃ bhṛśamudvignā bhavantassarva eva hi | yadyasau devadevasya tanayosmāsu bhaktimān | |42 || utpatsyati na ca drogdhā tataḥ kṣaṃsyāma taṃ surāḥ | atha cetkarkaśosmāsu drogdhā vā sa bhaviṣyati ||43 | | tata enamahaṃ baddhvā kālapāśena bālakam | .āneṣye svavaśaṃ krūraṃ mṛtyunā sahitomarāḥ ||44|| na cetpurandaro vajraṃ tasya kṣepsyati mūrdhani | dvidhā yena kṛto mūḍhaḥ prāṇāṃstyakṣyati dustyajān ||45| | bruvatastasya bahvevaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | viṣṇuḥ provāca dharmātmā vacāṃsi paramārthavit ||46|| aho tvayā suviśrabdhaṃ procyate bhāskarātmaja | paramārthamavijñāya krodhasya vaśavartinā | |47| | tanayaḥ kila yaḥ śambhorgirijāyāṃ bhaviṣyati | sa mūḍha iva yaḥ kaścid bhavitā vaśagastava | |48 || kimasau mānavonyo vā janma mṛtyusamanvitaḥ | utpatsyati raveḥ putra yena syādvaśagastava | |49|| kālenāparipūrṇena mānavasyāpi bhānuja | na tvaṃ nāśayitā nāma kimu putrasya śūlinaḥ ||8.72.50 | | tejo bhagavataḥ śambhoryad bhaviṣyatyanuttamam | sa kathaṃ vadhyatāṃ yāyāt tava śakrasya vo vibho | |51 || bravīmi vo hitaṃ devāḥ kriyate yadi madvacaḥ | prayāma sahitāssarve taṃ prasādayituṃ haram ||52 || yo naḥ svayaṃvare datto varastiṣṭhati śaṅkare | tameva varayiṣyāmo varamagryaṃ pinākinam | |53 || yathā na dehajo devyāstanayaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati | nāsmākamahitaṃ śambhuḥ putramutpādayiṣyati | |54| | vayameva sutāssarve śaṅkarasyāgrajā vibhoḥ | na śakyastapasā draṣṭuṃ na jñānena sureśvarāḥ ||55|| bhaktyā paramayā draṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ syātsa vṛṣadhvajaḥ | āgacchadhvaṃ gamiṣyāmo yatra tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ | |56| | parāṃ bhaktiṃ samāsthāya yathā paśyeya śaṅkaram | hutabhuk caiva no devastatsakāśaṃ pravekṣyati ||57|| sarveṣāmeva vijñaptyā surāṇāṃ surasattamāḥ | iti śrutvā vacastasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ||58|| bṛhaspatipurogāste hṛṣṭātmāno divaukasaḥ | sādhusādhviti santuṣṭā vacāṃsyūcuḥ surottamāḥ ||59|| tato viṣṇusahāyāṃste gatvā tacchṛṃgamuttamam | ūcurhutāśanaṃ devaṃ vacaḥ stutipurassaram | |8.72.6 0 | | tvamagne sarvadevānāṃ hitakṛtsarvatovyayaḥ | praviśya trāhi naḥ sarvāñchaṅkarāya nivedaya | |61 || tathā kuryāssuraśreṣṭha yena nirgamya śaṅkaraḥ | asmānnirīkṣate devaḥ prahvān bhaktimataḥ sthitān ||62 | | ityuktassa suraissarvaiḥ pratyuvāca hutāśanaḥ | akartavyaṃ hi me devā na yuṣmānprati vidyate | |63 | | pārvatyā saha saṃyuktaṃ devadeveśvaraṃ param | na me śaktirharaṃ draṣṭuṃ bhavantaścākulā bhṛśam ||64|| yuṣmadvākyamalaḍghyañca kṛcchrametadatīva me | pravekṣye dūtavaddevāḥ kariṣye sāhasaṃ mahat | ityuktvā sa jagāmāśu bhavanaṃ tatkapardinaḥ | | 65| | tatrāpaśyat sthitaṃ dvāre nandinaṃ paramaujasam | dvāramākramya tiṣṭhantaṃ dīptapaṭṭiśadhāriṇam ||66| | taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa tadā vahniḥ samālokya samantataḥ | nāsti kaścidihopāyaḥ sūkṣmajantorapi sthite ||67| | praveṣṭumiti sañcintya tameva śaraṇaṃ yayau | nandinaṃ hutabhug devastuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 68|| namo gaṇādhipataye namaścaṇḍāya śūline | namassenādhipataye namaḥ śarvātmane sadā ||69|| hālāhalāya rudrāya nīlarudrāya vai namaḥ | namo ii(?)tirudrāya tathaivārdrapaṭāya ca ||8.72.70 | | namaste svapnarudrāya bhasmarudrāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śmaśānarudrāya koṭīrudrāya te namaḥ | |71 || namaḥ piṅgalarudrāya rudrādhipataye namaḥ | namaḥ pramatharudrāya bhūtarudrāya te namaḥ ||72|| virūpākṣāya rudrāya śvetarudrāya te namaḥ | namaste satataṃ deva namaste satataṃ śiva | |73 || namaste satataṃ saumya namaste bhaktavatsala | mama bhaktasya deva tvaṃ devānāṃ hitamicchataḥ | |74|| varado bhava nandīśa mā naḥ krodhaṃ kṛthāḥ prabho | tato nandīśvaraḥ prāha stuvantamanalaṃ sthitam ||75|| prītastavānayā vahne bhaktyāhaṃ surasattama | brūhi kinte priyendeva karavāṇi hutāśana | |76|| atha provāca vahnistaṃ varadaṃ nandinaṃ sthitam | yadi tuṣṭosi me deva deyo yadi varaśca me ||77|| devakāryeṇa deveśa praveṣṭuṃ dīyatāṃ mama | bhavanaṃ devadevasya vara eṣostu me vibho | 78|| taṃ nandī pratyuvācedaṃ kṛcchraṃ deyo varo hyayam | na taṃ śakṣyasi deveśaṃ draṣṭuṃ tvaṃ yogamāsthitam ||79|| saha devyā maheśānaṃ sraṣṭāraṃ jagatovyayam | tathāpyeṣa mayā tubhyaṃ deya eva varonala | |8.72.80 | | gaccha sūkṣmataro bhūtvā durālakṣyo hutāśana | praviśya niṣkrama kṣipramavijñātāgamakriyaḥ ||81 | | sa nandinābhyanujñāto jātavedā mudā yutaḥ | jyotiḥ sūkṣmataro bhūtvā bhāskarasyāṃśunā saha ||82|| praviśya bhavanaṃ śambhormaṇistambhamathāviśat | vāhneyamaṇimadhyasthaṃ stambhaṃ taṃ bhāsayan muhuḥ ||83 || sopaśyattatra deveśaṃ devīñca bhuvaneśvarīm | tuṣṭāva manasā devau tatosau havyavāhanaḥ ||84| | tathā saṃstūyamānaśca prītiṃ devyāśca darśayan | vīkṣya stabhbhaṃ haro devīṃ vākyametadabhāṣata ||85| | eṣa stambhamaṇirdevi bhrājamāna iva priye | saṃstauti māṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ dadānyasmai varaṃ śubham ||86|| devyuvāca evaṃ kuru mahādeva bhaktasyāsya sureśvara | stuvatastvā mayā sārdhaṃ prayaccha varamuttamam | |87|| devadeva uvāca prītohaṃ maṇimadhyastha bhaktyā te vinayena ca | brūhi kāryaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati | |88|| agniruvāca devāstvāṃ draṣṭumicchanti bahiḥsthā bhuvaneśvara | bhagavam̐ste yathā sarve paśyeyustvāṃ tathā kuru ||89| | devadeva uvāca evamastu suraśreṣṭha nirgatya tridivaukasām | dadāmi darśanaṃ vahne bhavataḥ priyakāmyayā | |8.72.90 | | tatheti samanujñāto vahnistasmād vinirgataḥ | devebhyaḥ kāryamāvedya tasthau yogaṃ samāsthitaḥ ||91| | atha niṣkramya bhagavān devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk | jagāma tvaritaṃ tatra yatra devāḥ samāsate | |92|| atha dṛṣṭavā mahādevaṃ devāssarve vṛṣadhvajam | praṇemurmūrdhabhirhaṣṭāstuṣṭuvuśca mudā yutāḥ | |93 || namassahasranetrāya sahasracaraṇāya ca | mahatāṃ pataye nityaṃ devānāṃ pataye namaḥ | |94|| namaḥ śmaśānarataye vyāghracarmasuvāsase | brahmaṇaśca śirohartre viṣṇorvai varadāya ca ||95| | namo dakṣamakhaghnāya namaste tryambakāya ca | namo bhūtādhipataye pradhānamathanāya ca | |96|| pinākapāṇaye nityaṃ sarvayogātmayogine | namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya sapatnīkāya vai namaḥ | |97|| namaḥ kāmeṣvasaktāya kāmasaktāya vai namaḥ | namassarvāya śarvāya daṇḍine jaṭine namaḥ | namaḥ sarvātmabhūtāya diśa no yanmanogatam ||98| | evaṃ saṃstūyamānotha sarvaireva surottamaiḥ | pratyuvāca mahādevastānsurānpraṇatān sthitān | |99| | parituṣṭosmi bho devā brūta kiṃ pradadāni vaḥ | punaḥ praṇamya te devāḥ prāhurvacanamuttamam | | 8.72.100 || yo nassvayaṃvare deva varo dattastvayā vibho | taṃ prārthayāma sahitāstanno dātuṃ tvamarhasi | |1 01 || devyā ya eṣa putrārthaṃ yogaste bhuvaneśvara | kṛtobdāni bahūni sma taṃ saṃhara namastava | |1 0 2|| aśubhāni nimittāni dṛśyante sumahādyute | pṛthivī duḥsthitā deva vayañca bhṛśamākulāḥ ||10 3 || tenaiṣa na yathā devyā dehe sañjāyate sutaḥ | jāyeta ca yathā deva tathā naḥ kartumarhasi | | 1 04| | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevobravīdvacaḥ | mahāneṣa varaḥ sarvaiḥ prārthitaḥ surapuṅgavaiḥ || 10 5| | tathāpi ca prayacchāmi yuṣmatpriyacikīrṣayā | mahāntaṃ kintvidaṃ kālaṃ tejassandhāritaṃ mayā ||1 06 || asya prapaśyata sthānamamoghaṃ hyetaduttamam | athaivamuktā devena te devā munisattama | |1 07|| babhūvussahitāstūṣṇīṃ surā brahmapurogamāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye tadā vahniḥ provāca bhuvaneśvaram || 1 08| | juhudhyetatparantejo mayi deva trilokapa | juhāvāgnau tatastejastadā svīyaṃ paraṃ bhavaḥ | |1 09| | hutvā tasmintataḥ kṛtsnaṃ tuṣṭobhūtparameśvaraḥ | varaṃ vṛṇu hutāśa tvamiti provāca śaṅkaraḥ ||8.72.1 10 || tato vahniḥ praṇamyeśaṃ varānabhyarthayad vibhum | iccheyametaṃ putrante mama nāmnā prakīrtitam | | 111 | | śāpasyāhamagamyaḥ syāṃ paśyeyaṃ tvāñca nityaśaḥ | dhārayeyaṃ sukhenaitadutsṛjeyañca śaṅkara || 1 12| | sarvabhakṣopyalepaḥ syāṃ pāpanna ca bhavenmama | mayi devāśca yajñāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ yāntu śūladhṛk || 113|| ahaṃ bhūteśvaraśca syāmahaṃ paśupatiśca ha | ahaṃ tava tanuḥ syāñca tvanmūrttistvadupāśrayaḥ ||114|| varamicchāmi deveśa dīyamānamimaṃ tvayā | evamastviti tatsarvaṃ vahnaye pradadau vibhuḥ ||1 15| | visṛjya ca tato devān devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ | punarviveśa bhavanaṃ devī cainamabhāṣata || 11 6| | kva gatvā tvamihāyātaḥ kṣipraṃ tribhuvaneśvara | kintad gurutaraṃ kāryaṃ yena nirgatavānasi || 1 17| | tataḥ provāca deveśaḥ pārvatīṃ ruṣitānanām | gatosmi tvarito devi devairvijñāpitaḥ priye ||1 18|| bahiḥsthaiḥ padmapatrākṣi bhaktimadbhissuduḥkhitaiḥ | athovāca tato devī devaṃ sarvajagatpatim || 1 19|| kathaṃ tvamāgatāndeva bahiḥsthān tridivaukasaḥ | jñātavānasi santrastān kenākhyātañca te vibho ||8.72.120 | | devadeva uvāca praviśya hutabhug devi maṇistambhaṃ samāsthitaḥ | nyavedayatstuvanmahyaṃ sarvāndevānbahiḥsthitān ||121|| tavaivānujñayā devi tasmai datto varo mayā | tato bhagavatī kruddhā nandinaṃ prāha pārvatī | | 1 22|| kathaṃ praviṣṭaste vahnirdvārasthasyeha durmate | tatassāsya bhṛśaṃ kruddhā śravaṇa nyastamutpalam ||123 || gṛhītvā vajrasaṃkāśaṃ nandīśāya vyasarjayat | dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ prajvalattattadotpalam | |1 24|| vadhārthaṃ nandino ghoraṃ prasasāra sphuṭanniva | hato nandīśvara iti procyotthāya ca śaṅkaraḥ | |125|| bhadraṃ bhavotpalakṣipramityuktvā gṛhṇadutpalam | athomāpi tato devī pratyāpattiñjagāma ha ||126|| aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ krodhavaśānmayā | kathañcinna hato nandī mahāgaṇapanāyakaḥ ||127|| tad gṛhītvā tato hastād devasya śravaṇotpalam | cikṣepa tvaritaṃ devī bhadraṃ bhavatu te saraḥ | |1 28|| evamuktvā tataḥ kṣiptaṃ devyā tacchravaṇotpalam | vindhyapṛṣṭhe sarastatra bahupadmotpalaṃ babhau || 129|| haṃsasārasasaṃkīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam | nāmnā bhadrotpalamiti hemaśṛṅgasamīpataḥ ||8.72.130 || tatra snātvā naraḥ kṣipraṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | tatrākṣayaṃ sadā dānaṃ pitṛtarpaṇameva ca ||13 1 || mṛtaścātra naro yāti nandīśvarasalokatām | tato devaṃ punardevī vākyamāha gireḥ sutā ||132|| kimūcustvāṃ surā deva kīdṛśaṃ cārcayan varam | kathayāmāsa deveśastato devyai bṛṣadhvajaḥ ||133|| devairvijñāpito devi nirgatohaṃ varānane | devyā ya eṣa putrārthaṃ yogaste bhuvaneśvara ||1 34|| aśubhānyatra dṛśyante dāruṇāni sahasraśaḥ | santrastā pṛthivī kṛtsnā vayañca bhṛśamākulāḥ | |1 35 || tenaiṣa na yathā devyā garbhe sañjāyate sutaḥ | bhavecca tanayaḥ ślāghyo vara eṣa pradīyatām || 13 6| | tatognau tadadbhutaṃ tejo mayā putrārthamīśvari | sutaste bhavitā śrīmān ṣaṭśirā dvādaśekṣaṇaḥ | | 1 37|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaśāpa girijāmarān | yasmānmama suto dehe nepsitaṃ tairdurātmabhiḥ | svāsu patnīṣu tasmātte na prāpsyanti surāḥ sutam ||1 38| | pṛthivī cāpi saṃmūḍhā macchāpopahatendriyā | bahūnpatīnsamāsādya na putraṃ prāpsyate kvacit | |1 39 | | sanatkumāra uvāca virarāma tato devī śaptvā devānsavāsavān | kaiṭabhā nāma nāmnā ca puṇyā naikavarapradā | |8.72.140 || vindhyasya śikhare haime tatrābhūd garijā śubhā | puṇyamāyatanaṃ taddhi śilāñca ramaṇāhvayām | |141 | | yobhigacchennaro vyāsa mṛtassa gaṇapo bhavet | athājagmuḥ surāssarve sārdhaṃ tatra havirbhujā | | 142| | vivarṇāḥ kaśmalopetāḥ sagarbhā lajjayānvitāḥ | tāndvāḥsthānāgatānnandī śaṅkarāya nyavedayat | |143 || praviśya samanujñātā devamūcurdivaukasaḥ | tejo na śaknumaḥ soḍhumidaṃ tribhuvaneśvara || 144|| trāhi naḥ suralokeśa yathā syāma gatajvarāḥ | andhakaścāsurotyarthaṃ tapyate duścaraṃ tapaḥ | bhayañca nastato deva dṛśyate sumahadvibho ||145 || devadeva uvāca mā bhīrbhavatu vo devā haniṣyāmyahamandhakam | yuṣmadarthe parākrāntaṃ hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ varam ||146| | yūyañca merumadhyasthaṃ vanaṃ yāta suvistṛtam | nāmnā śaravaṇaṃ nāma puṇyaṃ dvādaśayojanam | | 147|| yuṣmākaṃ tatra saṃbhidya kukṣīndaivatapuṅgavāḥ | madīyaṃ tatparaṃ tejo nirgamiṣyati dīptimat | | 148|| suvarṇatvaṃ ca yāsyanti kukṣayo vaḥ surottamāḥ | tataste tadvacaḥ śrutvā praṇamya śirasā bhavam ||149 | | śrīmantaṃ merumājagmuḥ śaradhānaṃ ca tacchubham | yatra teṣāṃ tadā bhittvā kukṣīntejo nirakramīt ||8.72.1 50 || yugāntānalasaṃkāśaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ surāsuraiḥ | meruścaivābhavat kṣipraṃ śrīmānati manoharaḥ ||1 51 || sarvaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ cakre tejo māheśvaraṃ param | vāti gandhavaho divyassarvartukusumāvahaḥ | | 1 52| | teṣāñca kukṣibhedāste suvarṇatvaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ | svarge dundubhayo divyā neduḥ svayamanāhatāḥ | | 153 | | puṣpāṇāṃ vṛṣṭayaḥ petussugandhīnāmanekaśaḥ| namaskāraiśca bhūtānāmadṛśyānāmabhūtsvanaḥ || 1 54| | evamādīni paśyantaḥ śṛṇvantaśca surottamāḥ | gatvā pinākine hṛṣṭāssarvamāvedya suvrata | preṣitāḥ sthāṇunā jagmuḥ svām̐llokān hṛṣitānanāḥ | |155|| śrutvā devairabhihitamidaṃ prītiyuktairvacogryaṃ prītā devī hṛdayamahitā putrajanmapravṛttim | jñātvā tasthau vibudhavaradā yogamātā vidhātrī tuṣṭiñcāgāddhṛdi suraśiraḥspṛṣṭapādāravindā ||1 56|| iti skandapurāṇe skandajanmapravṛttirnāma dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.73> vyāsa uvāca andhakaḥ kasya putrosau kiṃ vīryaḥ kiṃ parākramaḥ | kathañca nihataḥ saṃkhye sarvametadvadasva me || 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa mahābuddhe sarvametadyathābhavat | andhakasya purāvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te dvija ||2 || kaśyapasya sutau dityāṃ daityau tau saṃbabhūvatuḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣastatonujaḥ | |3|| jyeṣṭhastatrābhavadrājā hiraṇyakaśipustadā | tasminvinihate vīre narasiṃhena dhīmatā ||4| | hiraṇyākṣobhavadrājā sarvadaityanamaskṛtaḥ | aputraḥ sa tapastepe putrahetoriti śrutiḥ ||5|| sa śaṃkukarṇaṃ saṃprāpya sindhusāgarasaṅgame | tapastepe diteḥ putro devaṃ draṣṭuṃ pinākinam | |6|| vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ tadabhavaddivyaṃ pavitraṃ lokaviśrutam | śaṃkukarṇaṃ maheśasya kṣetraṃ sarvārthasādhakam | yatphalaṃ puṇyasaṃpacca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi | |7|| sanatkumāra uvāca purā hi bhagavāndevaḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ | sindhusāgaramāgamya lokānugrahahetave ||8|| tapaḥkartuṃ samārebhe yadacintyaṃ surāsuraiḥ | daśasvapi tato dikṣu rakṣaṇārthaṃ jagatpatiḥ | |9 | | sthāpayāmāsa gaṇapān nikumbhādīnsahasraśaḥ | śakukarṇaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ sthūlākṣaṃ sthūlanāsikam || 8.73.10 | | hrasvapādakaraṃ caiva dāritāsyaṃ vibhīṣaṇam | śārdūlacarmasaṃchannaṃ dvīpicarmottaracchadam | |1 1 | | śaṃkukarṇamiti khyātaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sumahābalam | samāhūya samīpantu bhagavānidamabravīt || 1 2|| svaistvaṃ gaṇeśvaraissārdhaṃ na viśeyuryathā surāḥ| tathā pāhi vanaṃ vatsa yāvadetad vrataṃ mama | |1 3 || evaṃ sa kṛtvā rakṣāṃ tu mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ | tapastepe mahattatra ghoraṃ paramaduścaram || 14| | athājagmussurāstatra sarve śakrapurogamāḥ | niruddhāḥ śakukarṇena na celuḥ padamagrataḥ | | 15 | | devā ūcuḥ bho gaṇeśā vayaṃ devaṃ śarvamugraṃ kapardinam | draṣṭuṃ kāryeṇa saṃprāptāstanno darśayatānaghāḥ | ākulāstamapaśyanto naśyāma pramatheśvarāḥ | |1 6 | | śaṃkukarṇa uvāca na yuṣmābhiḥ surāḥ śakyo devo draṣṭuṃ kathañcana | tapaḥ kuruta bhadra vastato drakṣyatha śaṅkaram || 17|| devā ūcuḥ mā lokānāṃ vināśaḥ syād gaṇeśvara mahādyute | iti prayaccha no dvāraṃ prasādaṃ kuru naḥ prabho | | 18|| śaṃkukarṇa uvāca lokā naśyantu yūyaṃ vā na praveśaḥ pradīyate | vinaṣṭān punareveśaḥ srakṣyate bhuvaneśvaraḥ | | 1 9| | sraṣṭā sa eva bhūtānāṃ sa vināśayitā tathā | taṃ vinā kaḥ surāḥ śakto lokānnāśayituṃ vibhum | |8.73.20 || yacchāma na vayaṃ dvāramājñā naḥ pārameśvarī | ta evamuktāḥ saṃcintya jagmurbrahmasadaḥ surāḥ ||21 | | tato nivedayāmāsurbrahmaṇaste surottamāḥ | atha brahmā surānāha mayā saha punaḥ surāḥ | |22 | | gacchadhvaṃ gaṇapān yāvat pratyāpattiṃ nayāmi vaḥ | tataste brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ viṣṇunā ca divaukasaḥ ||23 || tameva punarājagmustiṣṭhate yatra śaṅkaraḥ | atha tānpunarevāsau rurodha gaṇapeśvaraḥ | |24| | śaṃkukarṇo gaṇādhyakṣastejasā prajvalanniva | atha brahmā tamāhedaṃ sāntvamarthayutaṃ vacaḥ || 25|| gaṇeśvara na devānāṃ dauṣṭyaṃ kiñciddhi vidyate | tava prasādātpaśyantu devā devaṃ vṛṣadhvajam | |26| | śirasā praṇātāstubhyaṃ devāścendrapurogamāḥ | ahaṃ ca viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ prayācema gaṇeśvara ||27|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ sa gaṇeśvaraḥ | kruddhaḥ paṭṭiśamudyamya vacaḥ provāca niṣṭhuram | |28|| na me gurutaro devāḥ praṇāmo bhavatāṃ nvayam | ājñā garīyasī śambhorna praveśosti kaścana ||29 | | pratiṣiddhān kathaṃ brahmanniyuktā rakṣaṇāya ca | īśājñāṃ samatikramya prayacchāma praveśanam ||8.73.3 0 | | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ | ekāntaṃ prayayau brahmā lajjayā parayānvitaḥ ||3 1 || devāḥ sarve tato dṛṣṭvā vrīḍāyuktaṃ pitāmaham | kruddhā manyuparītāṅgā vākyamūcurgaṇeśvaram | | 32 || gaṇādhipa na te lajjā gurumākrośase katham | naivaṃ tvāṃ vibruvantaṃ hi śaṃsyate vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||3 3 | | avamānaṃ punarmaivaṃ tvamasmākaṃ kṛthā gaṇa | mādya te vayamudyuktā nāśayiṣyāma jīvitam | |34| | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkukarṇo ruṣānvitaḥ | vacaḥ provāca saṃkruddhastiryag vīkṣya divaukasaḥ ||3 5 | | guravaḥ kiṃ bhavanto me yena śaṅkemarādhipāḥ | prasādya śaṅkaraṃ yūyaṃ gatā devatvamuttamam | |3 6 || gaṇabhūtāḥ sureśasya yūyamapyamarottamāḥ | vayamapyatiyogīśā gaṇapāstasya śūlinaḥ || 37| | samānā yūyamasmākaṃ hīnā vā tridivaukasaḥ | yasmādvayaṃ sureśānaṃ paśyāmonucarāma ca ||38| | sarvaireva suraistasmādvayaṃ pūjyāḥ sadādhikāḥ | paśyāmo nirbhayā yūyaṃ praveśaṃ kurutāmarāḥ ||39| | yāvadadya gaṇeśānāṃ balaṃ drakṣyatha dāruṇam | yadvo balaṃ ca yogaśca yattapo yaśca vaḥ śramaḥ ||8.73.40 || tatsarvaṃ darśayadhvaṃ vai tato drakṣyatha me balam | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve devāḥ sugarvitāḥ | |41 || pragṛhītāyudhāḥ kṣipraṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ vidudruvuḥ | teṣāmāpatatāṃ vyāsa surāṇāṃ śūramāninām ||42|| balaṃ jagrāha yogena śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ | nigṛhītabalāste tu sarva eva surottamāḥ ||43 || nāśaknuvan padaṃ dātuṃ tasthuḥ stambhā ivācalāḥ | nigṛhīteṣu deveṣu viṣṇuḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ ||44| | abhidudrāva vegena śaṃkukarṇaṃ gaṇeśvaram | sa yogena tadā viṣṇordehamastambhayadbalī ||45|| sa yogaṃ punarāsthāya viṣṇuraiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ | yuyudhe śaṃkukarṇena sa cainaṃ pratyayudhyata | |46 | | tayostu yogeśvarayo ryuktayormunisattama | babhūva sumahad yuddhaṃ yogenaiva parasparam ||47|| vinigṛhya sa taṃ viṣṇuṃ gaṇeśaḥ śarvavallabhaḥ | pitaraṃ mama yogena yuyodha paramādbhutaḥ | |48| | sa sūkṣmaṃ yogamāsthāya brahmā bhūtānyathāviśat | yadyadviśatyasau bhūtaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||49 | | tatra tatra sthitaṃ hyagre śakukarṇamavaikṣata | sa bhūtāni samutsṛjya tanmātrāṇyāviśat prabhuḥ | |8.73.50 | | indriyāṇyatha tattvāni bhāvām̐ścaiva pitāmahaḥ | tatra tatra sa yogātmā yogaṃ paramamāsthitam ||51 | | apaśyat sthūlaśirasaṃ śakukarṇaṃ mahābalam | athāsminnantare vyāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ | |52| | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu prayayau dvādaśātmakam | samāptaṃ cābhavad vyāsa vrataṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ | |53|| sa samāpte vrate tasmin yugāntāgnisamadyutiḥ | avaikṣata diśaḥ sarvā jīvayanniva śaṅkaraḥ ||54|| sopaśyannigṛhītām̐stān sarvāneva divaukasaḥ | sāmnaiva sa tadā devaḥ śakukarṇaṃ nyavārayat ||55|| samyagājñā kṛtā vatsa tvayā me gaṇapeśvara | muñca devānimānsarvān māvamaṃsthā gaṇeśvara | |56 || evaṃ devena saṃproktaḥ śaṃkukarṇo gaṇādhipaḥ | vimucya devatāḥ sarvāstastho devasamīpataḥ ||57|| surā api tadā sarve vrīḍayā parayā yutāḥ | praṇemurdevadeveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā vibhum ||58| | tāṃstadā vrīḍitāndevaḥ prahasya viditātmavān | uvāca brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ viṣṇumābhāṣya susvaram ||59| | gaṇeśvaroyaṃ deveśā macchāsanaparassadā | yadanena kṛtaṃ kiñcid vyetu tadvaḥ surottamāḥ | kartavyaṃ yacca tad brūta yadarthaṃ yūyamāgatāḥ ||8.73.60 || brahmovāca śaṃkukarṇo hyayaṃ śrīmāna gaṇeśo yena no balam | hataṃ yogena deveśa varosmai saṃpradīyatām | asmabhyaṃ parato dadyāssadā darśanamātmanaḥ ||61 || devadeva uvāca asyaivedaṃ bhavennāmnā pavitraṃ lokaviśrutam | śaṃkukarṇamiti khyātaṃ tathā sthūleśvaraṃ śubham ||62|| samantādyojanamitaṃ sarvatīrthasamanvitam | sarvayajñaphalairjuṣṭaṃ sarvadānaphalairyutam | |63 | | yotrāgatya caruṃ kṛtvā māṃ yatnenārcayiṣyati | ahorātropavāsena mama lokaṃ sa yāsyati | |64| | yatkiñcinniyamaṃ kṛtvā yotra saṃvatsaraṃ vaset | sa yogaṃ paramaṃ prāpya śaṃkukarṇasamo bhavet | |65|| yaśca prāṇāniha kṣetre tyajenniyamamāsthitaḥ | sa dehabhedamāsādya mahāgaṇapatirbhavet | |66| | pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhamiha dattaṃ bhaviṣyati | iyaṃ caiśvaryasaṃpannāstapoyogabalānvitāḥ | |67 || nityaṃ drakṣyatha māṃ devāḥ prayāta vigatajvarāḥ | tato devo varaṃ dattvā devebhyaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ ||68| | prakāmaṃ darśanaṃ nityaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata | gate tasminmahādeve brahmā suravarairvṛtaḥ || 69| | tatra liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya cakre tīrthānyanekaśaḥ | daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ pañcāśvamedhikam ||8.73.70 | | surāṇāṃ caiva tīrthāni kṛtvā svabhavanaṃ yayau | etatte kathitaṃ vyāsa sindhusāgarasaṅgame | |71 || paraṃ bhagavataḥ sthānaṃ pavitraṃ lokaviśrutam | siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇamapsarogaṇasevitam ||72 || bahupuṣpaphalopetaṃ sadā vihaganāditam | tasmin gatvā vane vyāsa hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | |73 || putrahetostapastepe dhyāyamānastrilocanam | atha devastadā gatvā sagaṇo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | |74| | ramyaṃ himagireḥ śṛṃgaṃ mainākamiti viśrutam | tasthau paramayogīśaḥ paraṃ brahma sanātanam ||75|| tasyāgatya tadā devī saṃsthitā pṛṣṭhataḥ śanaiḥ | karābhyāṃ padmatulyābhyāṃ netre śambhornyamīlayat ||76 || jānīte neti saṃcintya krīḍārthaṃ himavatsutā | atha tasmin kṣaṇe vyāsa jagadandhamajāyata ||77|| apradṛśyaṃ hi tamasā tathābhūtaṃ purā yathā | atha devastadā buddhvā tṛtīyaṃ netramavyayam | |78| | lalāṭesṛjadūrdhvasthaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham | tejasā tasya netrasya sa girirbhasmasādabhūt | |79 || pārvatī pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā dagdhaṃ pinākinā | apanīya karau tasthau viṣaṇṇā patipārśvataḥ | |8.73.80 || atha devastadā dṛṣṭvā viṣaṇṇavadanāmumām | saumyena cakṣuṣāpaśyacchailaṃ taṃ punareva tu | |8 1 || sa tathā dṛṣṭamātrastu punaḥ paurāṇikobhavat | prakṛtisthaṃ punardṛṣṭvā devī pitaramavyayam | praṇamyovāca bhartāraṃ hṛṣitāsyā girīndrajā | |82 || śaila eṣa tvayā deva kimarthaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtaḥ | kimarthaṃ prakṛtisthaśca punareva kṛtaḥ prabho ||83 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā provāca parameśvaraḥ | locane me tvayā devi yasminkāle nimīlite | |84|| andhāssamabhavam̐llokāstadā sarve tamovṛtāḥ | prakāśārthaṃ tato devi netrametanmayā kṛtam ||85| | lalāṭe sumahadyena dagdhoyamacalottamaḥ | tvāñca dīnāṃ pitṛvadhādupalakṣya tataḥ śubhe | |86 || priyārthaṃ tava suśroṇi prakṛtisthaḥ punaḥ kṛtaḥ | asmiṃśca tamasā graste loke tīvreṇa sarvataḥ ||87| | utpannondhaḥ prabhāveṇa mama devi tathaiva ca | tapyamānāya dāsyāmi hiraṇyākṣāya taṃ sutam ||88 || evamuktvā sa bhagavān pragṛhyāndhaṃ gaṇairvṛtaḥ | sindhusāgaramāgamya hiraṇyākṣamuvāca ha ||89|| paśya māṃ tvaṃ diteḥ putra cakṣurdivyaṃ dadāmi te | śarvohamāgato daitya varaṃ brūhi yathepsitam | |8.73.90 | | sa protthāya hiraṇyākṣaḥ praṇamya śirasā bhavam | varaṃ saṃprārthayad devaṃ putraṃ dattveti satvaram ||91 || tamuvāca suraśreṣṭhaḥ śirasā pādayornatam | ayante suraśārdūla putraḥ putraśatāgrajaḥ ||92| | māvajñāmandha ityasya kuryāstvamasurādhipa | bhavitā te mahāneṣa tapovīrthabalānvitaḥ ||93 | | na kasyacitvayaṃ vadhyo mattonyasya bhaviṣyati | tataḥ sa bhagavāndevastasmai dattvā sutaṃ śubham ||94|| jagāma śikharaṃ ramyaṃ mainākaṃ punareva tu | ādāyāndhaṃ sutaṃ sopi hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ ||95|| svamaśmakapuraṃ yātvā bhāryāmāha manasvinīm | ayaṃ tubhyaṃ suto devi datto bhagavatā svayam | |96|| saṃvarddhayainaṃ yogena mā pramādaṃ kṛthāḥ kvacit | tasyāḥ snehena taṃ dṛṣṭavā stanābhyāṃ prasnutaṃ payaḥ ||97|| saṃvardhyamānaḥ kālena sondhakaḥ samavarddhata | yadā tu yauvanaṃ prāptastadaivaṃ samacintayat ||98| | dhig jīvitaṃ mamāndhasya mṛtyureva varo mama | yohamandho na paśyāmi gṛha saṃbandhibāndhavān | |99|| dhanyāste puruṣā loke ye svayaṃ yāntyaviklavāḥ | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭavā mukhaṃ bandhūnābhāṣya hi yathāsukham ||8.73.1 00 | | kāryaṃ bhavecca loṣṭena tṛṇenātha śavena vā | na mayānugṛhītena dhiṅmāmaśubhakāriṇam | |1 01 | | sutasnehādayaṃ daityaḥ sadā māṃ rakṣate pitā | hantavyaṃ na vihantyeṣa koṣakṣayakaraṃ hi mām ||1 02 || nāyaṃ snehena saṃmūḍho jānātīmāṃ mama vyathām | ahameva kariṣyāmi yatkāryaṃ buddhimattamaiḥ || 103 | | tapo mahatsamāsthāya cakṣuṣmān bhavitā hyaham | sa evaṃ pariniścintya bahudhāndhaḥ subuddhimān ||1 04|| āmantrya sahitaṃ mātrā pitaraṃ taṃ praṇamya ca | jagāma tapase dhīmān saṃkalpya kṛtaniścayaḥ | | 1 05|| pitrā śokapariplutekṣaṇamukhenāyāsakhinnātmanā mātrā cāsakṛdaśrupātamukhayā saṃvīkṣyamāṇaściram | tattīvrādhṛtikhedadṛṣṭiviraha prakṣveḍitondhaḥ śvasan dhyāyandevamumāpatiṃ sa tapase yāto gṛhādandhakaḥ || 106 || iti skandapurāṇe andhakopākhyāne tapaḥprayāṇaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.74> sanatkumāra uvāca atha gatvā sa viprendra hiraṇyākṣasutastadā | gaṅgādvāraṃ śubhadvāraṃ tapovanamanuttamam ||1 || divyaṃ kanakhalaṃ nāma yatra hairaṇvatī nadī | vṛkṣāḥ kanakhalā yatra sarva eva hi kāñcanāḥ ||2|| yatra dakṣaḥ purā yajñamayajad daivataissaha | mahādevena yatrāsya yajño vinihataḥ purā | | 3 | | tatrāsau devamabhyarcya snātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ | namaskṛtvā daivatebhya idaṃ vacanamabravīt | |4| | andhaka uvāca yesmin tapovane devā bhūtāni vividhāni ca | sarvāṃstāñcharaṇaṃ yāmi tapaḥsiddhiṃ diśantu me ||5|| adyaprabhṛti karttāsmi tapa ugraṃ suduścaram | varān yenāpnuyāmiṣṭānmṛtyuṃ vā prāṇanāśanama | |6|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktvā tu tataḥ pārāśarya mahābalaḥ | saṃvatsaraṃ vāyubhakṣo babhūva klamavarjitaḥ ||7| | tathā triṣavaṇa snāyī juhvānognīm̐stathaiva ca | devārcanarataścaiva japahomaparastathā ||8| | varṣe varṣe tu saṃpūrṇe svāṅgādutkṛtya kārṣikam | piśitasya tadā bhāgaṃ juhāvāgnau mahāsuraḥ ||9| | evaṃ tasyāgamaddivyaṃ sahasraṃ munisattama | juhvataḥ svāni māṃsāni varṣāṇāṃ pratyahaṃ tadā | | 8.74.10 || sosuraḥ śaṃkhahārāmbusudhākundendupāṇḍaraḥ | babhūvāsthisirāśeṣaḥ kevalaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ | |1 1 | | sa tena tapasā yukto bhāskaraṃ niṣprabhaṃ tadā | somaṃ ca grahatārābhissaha cakre mitātmavān || 1 2| | sa eva bhāskaro yadvat prakāśayati tejasā | aśoṣayat palvalāni nadīkūpasarāṃsi ca || 13 || pavanaṃ stambhayāmāsa sondhakastapasā tadā | vyomni siddhā na gacchanti vimānāni ca petire | |14|| tasya tattapaso rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavā vighnaśatānyuta | akarot sahasā śakro vikriyāṃ na ca sonvagāt ||15|| tato brahmā tamabhyetya provācāndhakadānavam | mahāsura tapo ghoraṃ tvayā taptaṃ mahābala | tuṣṭosmi te mahābāho cakṣuṣmānbhava suvrata | |16|| śarīraṃ prakṛtiṃ yātu yathāpūrvañca tesura | brūhi cānyaṃ varaṃ bhūyo yaste manasi saṃsthitaḥ || 17|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa cakṣuṣmām̐stadā bhūtvā śarīreṇākṣatena ca | uvāca praṇataḥ sākṣād brahmāṇaṃ lokabhāvanam | | 18|| andhaka uvāca bhagavan yadi tuṣṭosi yadi me caritaṃ tapaḥ | apratidvandvatāṃ saṃkhye daivatebhyaḥ pitāmaha ||1 9| | mahābalatvaṃ māyāśca tathā cāmaratāmapi | etadicchāmi deveśa yadi tvaṃ varado mama | |8.74.20 || sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya bhagavān vibhuḥ | hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ prāha punareva vacaḥ śubham ||21 || amaratvaṃ na daityasya dadāmi ditinandana | sāntaraṃ tu bhavettatte svayamevottaraṃ vada ||2 2 | | andhaka uvāca yā strī syāllokamātā vai praṇameyaṃ na tāṃ yadi | tadā syānmama mṛtyustu mṛtyuhīnonyathā hyaham ||23 || brahmovāca evametad bhavatu te tvayā proktaṃ yadadya vai | andhako bhava nāmnā tvaṃ loke khyātiṃ ca yāsyasi ||24| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā sa bhagavānandhakaṃ devakaṇṭakam | jagāma svaṃ tadāvāsaṃ virarāmāndhakaśca saḥ | |25 | | sa gaṅgāmbhobhirāplutya devamiṣṭvā yathāvidhi | agniṃ hutvā tato dhīmānanumānya tapovanam | sahāyaitsaha daityendro jagāma piturantikam ||26|| sa hṛṣṭacetāstapasā mahābalo vivṛddhakāmaḥ suraśatrutoṣaṇaḥ | pitussakāśaṃ punareva dīptimānagacchaduddhūtabalāhakopamaḥ ||27|| iti skandapurāṇe andhakavaralābho nāma catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.75> sanatkumāra uvāca soṣṭābhirdānavaissārdhaṃ gatvā tatpuramantike | nivedayāmāsa pituḥ kṛtārthondhaka āgataḥ || 1 || priyākhyātustato vyāsa hiraṇyākṣosureśvaraḥ | dadau ratnānyanekāni tathā kāmānabhīpsitān ||2| | svayaṃ rājā tadā sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhiḥ sahavāhanaiḥ | saha strībhiryayau tūrṇaṃ somastārāgaṇairiva || 3 | | sa gatvā nātidūretha vane sāśokacampake | āsasāda sutaṃ śrīmān somo budhamivāparam | |4| | kṛtārthaṃ sa sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭobhūddānaveśvaraḥ | snehātsa taṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt ||5 | | kathaṃ kena ca kālena ke ca labdhā varāstvayā | pṛṣṭaḥ sa kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttamaśeṣataḥ | |6| | tasya tadvaradānañca tathā māhātmyameva ca | śrutvā tesuraśārdūlāḥ praṇeduḥ sāgarā iva ||7| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastaṃ rathamāropya hiraṇyākṣondhakaṃ sutam | suhṛdbhistaiḥ sahaivāśu praviveśa svakaṃ puram ||8|| sa putrasahito bhāti daityaḥ saṃpūrṇamānasaḥ | caran rāśimivādityo yathā saha śanaiścaraḥ | |9| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ praviśya daityendraḥ suhṛdvargamuvāca saḥ | adhvaryuriva sānnāyye yathānyānṛtvijaḥ sthitān || 8.75.10 || hiraṇyākṣa uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ yadidānīṃ me kṛtyaṃ hṛdi nakṣatramasmākaṃ balakāraṇam | adyaiva daṃśitāḥ sarve drutaṃ niryāta dānavāḥ ||41 || atha te dānavāḥ śīghraṃ vāhanāni mudā yutāḥ | prāvārayanta saṃgrāme yogyāni ripubādhane | |42| | śīghraṃ kurudhvaṃ sajjāni gacchāmo daivatānprati | teṣāṃ sutumulaḥ śabdo bāhanānāṃ babhūva ha | |43 || mandavātapreritasya kṣīrodasya svano yathā | mamāśvastava siṃhoyaṃ mamāyaṃ gajayūthapaḥ | |44|| rathoyaṃ kasya saṃpanno yuddhopakaraṇairbhṛśam | ehi niryāhi vegena muhūrtaṃ pratipālaya ||45|| niryāntu sarve daityendrā yāsyāmaḥ pṛṣṭhato vayam | āroha svaṃ rathaṃ vīra kiṃ rathena mamādya vai | padātireva saṃgrāme haṃsyāmyadya suradviṣaḥ | |46 | | evaṃ teṣāmamūcchabdaḥ sumanojñaḥ suradviṣām | vaṃśavīṇāsvanonmiśraḥ pralāpa iva yoṣitām ||47| | atha śukrastadābhetya bhṛgoḥ putro mahātapāḥ | hiraṇyākṣamuvācedaṃ harṣayandānaveśvaram | |48| | mayā śāntiḥ kṛtā tedya rakṣā ca saha dānavaiḥ | jahi sarvānsurān yuddhe na tavāsti parājayaḥ ||49|| ahaṃ tvā svena tapasā sahabhṛtyaṃ sabāndhavam | dhārayiṣyāmi yudhyantaṃ lokānyajña ivāparaḥ || 8.77.50 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śukraṃ mūrdhnā praṇamya ca | bhārgavaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā nirjagāma sa mandirāt ||51 || tato bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ | sāḍastamā(?) diṇḍimāśca bhāṇḍāśca paṭahaiḥ saha | |52 || jhaṃrjharyo dardurāścaiva sunavā mardalāstathā | kaṭaṃkaṭāḥ pepukāśca tathā caivaikapuṣkalāḥ | | 53 || pañcākṣāḥ saridhīkāśca mukundā murajāstathā | labhakā jalamattāśca avādyanta sahasraśaḥ | |54| | gāyanaiścaiva gāyadbhiḥ stuvadbhiḥ sūtamāgadhaiḥ | divyābhiḥ kulavṛddhābhiḥ strībhiśca kṛtamaṅgalā || 55| | dvārya paśyan rathaṃ klṛptaṃ yayā devamayaṃ haraḥ | śatanalvapramāṇāṅkaṃ divyaṃ jāmbūnadaṃ dṛḍham | |56 || asaṃgaturagaiḥ śvetaistrisāhasrairmanojavaiḥ | amaraiḥ kāmagairdivyaiḥ śramaduḥkhavivarjitaiḥ ||57| | yantā rathasya tasyasilmakaro nāma viśrutaḥ | putro garutmato vyāsa khagaḥ kāmagamaḥśubhaḥ || 58| | tamasau rājaśabdena āśīrbhiścābhipūjitaḥ| āruroha rathaṃ rājā ekacakraṃ yathā raviḥ |||59|| kavacī baddhatūṇīraḥ śarī khaḍgī śarāsanī | baddhagodhāṃgulitraśca kaṇṭhatrāṇakṛtastathā | |8.77.6 0|| dhvajena mahatā caiva chatreṇa ca vibhūṣitaḥ | bahvībhirvaijayantībhiḥ sabalāka ivāmbudaḥ ||61|| tasya chatraṃ tadā bhāti kirīṭopari saṃsthitam | āviṣkṛtapayodābhaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī ||62| | khaṭvāṅgastasya cābhāti dhvajo divamivākraman | trailokyasyopaghātārthaṃ keturdīpta ivoditaḥ ||63 || tādṛgeva ratho hyāsīt sutasya sumahātmanaḥ | andhakasya tadā vyāsa mahājaladanisvanaḥ |||64|| atha yāhīti tenoktau rathayantā suradviṣaḥ | trisāhasrān hayāgryām̐stu rathe prasyacūcudat(?) ||65|| pracoditāstamūḍhuste javanā vātaraṃhasaḥ | hayāḥ kāmagamāḥ sapta raveriva mahāratham ||66|| tasyāgratastadā śukro rathenāmbudanādinā | udgacchata iva vyomni tasyābhūd yathā budhaḥ ||67| | dakṣiṇe tasya pārśve ca abhūdandhakadānavaḥ | dakṣiṇāyanamāsādya yathā lokasya bhāskaraḥ ||68| | dvitīyaṃ pārśvamāśritya vipracittirabhūt sthitaḥ | bhāratasyeva varṣasya himavān parvatottamaḥ ||69 || pṛṣṭhataścāgrataścaiva yathāprīti yayustadā | apare dānavāḥ śūrāḥ śaśāṅkasya yathā grahāḥ | |8.77.70 || tatsainyaṃ pracalad bhāti vrajatāṃ munisattama | savidyutstanayitnūnāmabhbhodānāmivātyaye | |71 || hayahreṣitaśabdañca mattadvirada bṛṃhitam | valgitāsphoṭitotkruṣṭaṃ siṃhanādoddhataṃ yayau ||72| | taddhi tūryaravasiṃhanāditairaśvaheṣitagajograbṛṃhitaiḥ | bāhuśabdakucitāvanāditairyāti dānavabalaṃ bhayāvaham ||73 || iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣaniryāṇaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.78> kṛṣṇadvaipāyana uvāca bhagavan ditiputreṣu prayāteṣvamarāvatīm | amarāḥ kimakurvan ta etadicchāmi deditum ||1 | | kathamantarhitaṃ teṣāṃ ko mantraśceṣṭitaṃ ca kim | uttaraṃ kiñca devāste pratyapadyanta yatnataḥ ||2|| dhārmikāśca vadānyāśca vidvāṃsaśchinnasaṃśayāḥ | iṣṭāḥ sarvasya lokasya kimakurvata devatāḥ | | 3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa yathā devā uttaraṃ pratipedire | asurāṇāñca yadyuktaṃ pratyakurvata daṃśitāḥ ||4|| udyukteṣveva daityeṣu devānāṃ bhayasūcakāḥ | saṃjajñiremarāvatyāmutpātā dāruṇā bhṛśam | |5| piśitāśāḥ khagāstatra bhramantyupari sarvataḥ | mamlurmālyāni devānāṃ gandhaścaivāśubhaṃ vavau| |6| | hayādayo na heṣante vimanāśca gajobhavat | anabhraṃ bhayadaṃ sarvamapatadrudhiraṃ bahu | |7| | āyudhāni ca dīpyante sadhūmaṃ śaktinandana | kabandhāśca tathāditye yuddhaṃ cātra pradṛśyate ||8|| dvayoḥ puruṣayorvyāsa hāhākāraśca sarvaśaḥ | devānāmaratiñcaiva cittaṃ cāpi samaśnute ||9|| sphuranti vāmanetrāṇi jṛmbhikā copajāyate | vayāṃsi ca vikūjanti bhayadānyapare yathā | agniśca dīpyate tatra saśabdo rūkṣa eva ca || 8.78.10 || etām̐ścānyāṃśca vividhānutpātānbhayasūcakān | dṛṣṭvā prāha guruṃ śakro bṛhaspatimidaṃ vacaḥ ||11 || bhagavan kimidaṃ ghoraṃ bhayaṃ naḥ samupasthitam | yadime sūcayantyugrā utpātā naḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||1 2 || neme niṣkāraṇaṃ manye na cāpyalpaṃ hi taddhi naḥ | yadime sūcayantyugrāḥ kalpānta iva dāruṇāḥ | | 13 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ | nirīkṣya buddhyā saṃcintya provācedaṃ tato vacaḥ | |14|| yad bhavānāha tattathyaṃ neme niṣkāraṇaṃ tathā | nimittamatra sumahad bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 15|| nimittamādidaityendro hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā | sa hato narasiṃhena prāptaṃ rājyaṃ ca naḥ punaḥ ||1 6|| adya varṣasahasrāṇi dvādaśaiva sunirvṛtaiḥ | yuṣmābhirakhilā lokā bhujyante sumahātmabhiḥ ||17|| daityādhipā nirutsāhā dānavaiḥ saha śerate | pātāle danuputrāśca duḥkhaśokasamāhatāḥ | |18|| hiraṇyākṣastu daityendro hiraṇyakaśiporvaraḥ | sa nūnaṃ bhrāturanvicchan hatasya pratikāritām | |1 9| | sarvairabhyeti daityendrairdānavaiśca samāvṛtaḥ | saputrapautro daityendro mahābalaparākramaḥ ||8.78.20 || andhakaścāsya putropi brahmaṇā hyamaraḥ kṛtaḥ | na sa śakyo yuvā hantuṃ tato vo bhayamutthitam ||21 || tadbhavantaḥ susannaddhāḥ sarve yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ | pratīkṣadhvaṃ mahāsatvā yāvadautpātikaṃ sthitam ||22 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakraḥ sarvān tadā surān | uvāca sajjībhavata yuddhāya kṛtaniścayāḥ ||23 || bhayaṃ mahadidaṃ prāptaṃ mā tiṣṭhata nirudyamāḥ | mā naḥ saṃprāpya daityeṃdrā hanyurmattānivāmarāḥ ||24|| atha vāyustadābhyetya śakraṃ sarvāsurāntakam | uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā devānāmeva saṃsadi | |25|| eṣa daityo hiraṇyākṣaḥ sarvāsurasamāvṛtaḥ | āyāti devatā hantuṃ bhrāturvadhamanusmaran ||26| | tadbhavān daṃśitaḥ samyak sahāsmābhirmahābalaḥ | jayāyottiṣṭha devendra vināśāya suradviṣām ||27|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān vyāsa mahātmā devarāṭ svayam | abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ jāmbūnadavibhūṣitam ||28|| dattaṃ mantreṇa vidhivat putreṇāṅgirasaḥ svayam | ābabaddhātmanā śakro meghadundubhinisvanaḥ | |29| | sa tena kavacena sma bhāti śakraḥ pratāpavān | savidyudulkairambhodairbaddho merurivācalaḥ | |8.78.3 0 | | tato godhāṃgulitrāṇi talatraṃ caiva bhāsuram | ābabaddha svayaṃ mantraistasya devo bṛhaspatiḥ | | 31 | | iṣudhīnakṣayām̐ścaiva khaṅgaḥ caivāmṛtodbhavam | ābabaddhāsya mantreṇa yadajaryaṃ śarādibhiḥ | |3 2 | | tatosmai saśaraṃ cāpaṃ pañcavajraṃ sudāruṇam | mantrābhimantritaṃ samyak pradadau jayavarddhanam || 3 3| | maṃgalāni tatastasya darśayāmāsa vīryavān | ghaṭañca pūrṇamastrañca airāvatamathāpi ca | | 34|| kalpitaṃ bahubhirdivyairācāryaiḥ kalpavāsibhiḥ | arcitaṃ dhūpitaṃ caiva dhūpitaṃ krodhadarpaṇaiḥ | |3 5| | tatastaṃ sa tadā deva āruroha mataṅgajam | bhadralakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ caturdantaṃ kṣaranmadam | |3 6 | | ārūḍhaḥ sa tadā bhāti airāvatagajaṃ vibhuḥ | udayācalamaulistha udyanniva divākaraḥ ||37 | | pāṇḍareṇātapatreṇa surarāṭ saṃbabhau tadā | śvetaparvatarājosau śaśineva mahāmune ||38 | | cāmarābījitaṃ bhāti tasya vaktramatiprabham | haṃsasaṃbījitaṃ phullaṃ śaradīva mahotpalam | |39| | tasya pārśve jayantaśca putraḥ śakrasya dhārmikaḥ | kārtikeya ivābhāti rudrasya dayitaḥ sutaḥ ||8.78.40 | | tato yamaśca puṇḍreṇa mahiṣeṇa mahābalaḥ | kāladaṇḍaṃ puraskṛtya koṭībhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ | |41 || nirjagāma kuberaśca rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | yakṣaiḥ puṇyajanaiścāpi tathānyairdevatairapi ||42| | teṣāṃ dvādaśa koṭyastāḥ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ | śatāni ca tathāśītistathaivāṣṭādhikā punaḥ ||43 || varuṇo niryayau devaḥ putrāṇāṃ daśabhiḥ śataiḥ | yādobhiste vṛtāḥ sarve koṭyastāścaikaviṃśatiḥ ||44|| analaśca tato devaḥ koṭībhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ | niryayau saha putreṇa sasuhṛdvargabāndhavaḥ ||45|| tato vāyurmahātejāḥ sarvavyāpī mahājavaḥ | akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhirnirjagāma mahābalaḥ ||46|| ādityā niryayuḥ sarve dvādaśākṣauhiṇīvṛtāḥ | ekaikaśaśca te vyāsa sarve divyāstrayodhinaḥ ||47|| tathā rudrāśca nirjagmurmahāmāyāmahābalāḥ | ekaikaśastadā sarve ṣoḍaśākṣauhiṇīvṛtāḥ ||48| | vasavo daśabhiścaiva aṣṭābhiścāśvināvubhau | tathaivāṃgiraso devāḥ sarve tekṣauhiṇīvṛtāḥ | |49|| yāmā dāmāśca sādhyāśca lekhā ye ca mahābalāḥ | tepi koṭīśataiḥ sarve daśabhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ ||8.78.50|| abhūvan viṃśatiḥ koṭyo gandharvāṇāṃ mahātmanām | pannagānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ khagānāṃ caiva viṃśatiḥ ||51 || piśācānāṃ ca koṭyastāḥ paṃcāśattatra saṃgatāḥ | rājñāṃ sa........nāṃ mahātmanām ||52| | etaddevabalaṃ de haṃ sarvamabhūttatrābhisaṃgatam | dṛṣṭvā tad bahvaparyantaṃ devānāṃ balamuttamam ||53 || uvāca jīvajīvānāṃ rājā paramadharmavit | bhagavan kriyatāṃ vyūho yasmātteṣāṃ durātmanām | |54|| adhṛṣyaścāprameyaśca yanna vetti ca bhārgavaḥ | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bṛhadbuddhirbṛhaspatiḥ | |55 || uvāca devatādhyakṣaṃ śakraṃ daivatasannidhau | na tadasti maheṣvāsa mayi yad bhārgavo mahān ||56|| na vetti yasya vā bhedaṃ na kuryāt pākaśāsana | uśanāḥ sa tu yadvetti mahāyogī mahāyaśāḥ ||57|| na caiva tadahaṃ vedmi matto varataro hi saḥ | sa tu tīkṣṇatayā caiva mānāccaiva śacīpate ||58|| pramādaṃ kurute teṣu na ca sarvatra labhyate | ahaṃ ca vijñabhāvena mārdavena pareṇa ca ||59|| apramattaśca sarvatra tava sainyaiśca rakṣitaḥ | buddhyā tamatiricyāmi vibudheśvara nityaśaḥ ||8.78.60 | | tasmāttehaṃ kariṣyāmi vyūhaṃ śyenamatiprabham | yena tāndānavān saṃkhye kañcit kālaṃ vijeṣyatha | |61 || tataḥ sa bhagavān jīvaścakre vyūhamatiprabham | śyenaṃ nāma mahāyogī devānāṃ hitamādadhat ||62| | grīvāyāṃ tasya saṃcakre vitteśaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā | analaṃ caiva vāyuñca jayantaṃ caiva śakrajam | |63 || śiraścūḍāṃ yamaṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ kālaṃ ca tāvubhau | vaktraṃ tasyākarojjīva ścandrasūryau ca cakṣuṣī ||64|| ekaṃ pakṣaṃ cakārāsya rudrānsarvānsa vai dvijaḥ | dvitīyaṃ pakṣamādityānmadhyaṃ tasya purandaram ||65|| pādau ca vasavastasya aśvinau ca mahātalau | gandharvāḥ pannagāścaiva nakhān tasya samāśritāḥ | |66|| pakṣiṇaśca mahāsatvāḥ piśācāśca mahābalāḥ | pucchaṃ tasyākarot sarpān devānanyām̐stadodaram ||67| | rājānastasya pādasthāstale bhūtān nyaveśayata | mahābalānmahotsāhānsarvān devān sabhāsadaḥ | |68|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa kṛtvā taṃ khagavyūhaṃ mantreṇaivābhimantrya ca | uvāca devarājaṃ taṃ bṛhaspatiridaṃ vacaḥ | |69 || kalpitoyaṃ mayā vyūhaḥ kṛtvā rākṣasapārthivam (?) | ataḥ paraṃ vidhānasya karma nāsmāsu vidyate | |8.78.70 | | jaya śatrūn raṇe śakra devatairabhirakṣitaḥ | mayā cārthavaṇairmantraistapasāṃ ca balena ca ||71 || kuru karma yathāśakti hyamaro hyasi pārthiva | devāścāpyamarāḥ sarve yudhyantu surapārthiva | |72 | | bhāgyānno jaya lābhāya nānyatra surapuṃgava | jahi śatrūn mahābāho mābhīrbhavatu te raṇe | |73 || tataḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahā ḍiṇḍimāstathā | āḍambarāśca nambhā(?)śca kṛkavā goviṣāṇakāḥ ||74| | mardalāḥ pepukāścitrā nedu stūryāṇi sarvaśaḥ | tena śabdena yodhānāṃ yuddhaharṣo mahānabhūt | siṃhanādā nakurvan te vāditāsphoṭitāni ca | |75|| devāstataḥ śaṃkhamṛdaṅgavādyairamoghasarvāyudhadīptahastāḥ | nirjagmurindrādisurapradhānā jayaiṣiṇaḥ śatruvadhepsavaśca ||76| | iti skandapurāṇe vyūharacano nāmaṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.79> sanatkumāra uvāca vyūḍhe surāṇāṃ sainyetha sthite yuddhāya daṃśite | dānavānāṃ balaṃ ghoraṃ samadṛśyata bhīṣaṇam | |1 | | tad dānavabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | siṃhanādānakurvam̐ste vāditraravamiśritān ||2|| sa nādaḥ sumahān vyāsa sāgarasyeva mathyataḥ | āpūrayajjagat sarvaṃ yugāntāmbudanisvanaḥ || 3| | tato dānavaśārdūlāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā surottamān | vyūhya sainyaṃ sthitān samyag vīkṣāñcakruḥ parasparam ||4|| tān vīkṣamāṇān sandṛśya sthito dānavayūthapāna | uvāca bhārgavaṃ vyāsa hiraṇyanayanaḥ svayam ||5| | ete vyūhamimaṃ kṛtvā devāstiṣṭhantyabhītavat | manyante dānavān yuddhe vayaṃ jeṣyāma sarvaśaḥ ||6|| sa bhavānyuktamasyaiva devavyūhasya bhedakam | kuru māyāprativyūhamasmākamapi mā ciram ||7|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamastviti sa procya hyardhacandrañcakāra saḥ | khagasya tasya yacchettuṃ śiraḥ kāyādiyeṣa ca ||8 || cakāra tasya śṛṃge tu prahlādāndhakadānavau | dhārān nivātakavacānpaulomānkālakāsutān ||9|| virocanaṃ baliṃ caiva vipracittiṃ sahānujaiḥ | prahlādabhrātaraṃ caiva sasuhṛdvargabāndhavān | |8.79.1 0 || pṛṣṭhaṃ cakre mahāyogī madhyaṃ rājānameva ca | uvāca cainaṃ viśrabdho bhārgavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ||1 1 | | hiraṇyākṣamidaṃ yuktaṃ kāle pathyañca sarvaśaḥ | daivatabhavyūhabhettāyaṃ mahāvyūho hi vaḥ kṛtaḥ ||1 2| | yuktaṃ kuruta bhadraṃ vo mayā nu paripālitāḥ | parasparaṃ ca rakṣantaḥ sarve citrāstrayodhinaḥ | mahāmāyāḥ surāḥ sarve yathā naivābhimanyata ||1 3 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ | āḍambarā ḍiṇḍimāśca paṭahāśca mahāsvanāḥ ||14| | nānāvidhāni cānyāni prāvādyanta sahasraśaḥ | devānāṃ dānavānāñca madasatvapradāni vai ||1 5|| tataḥ pramathnatetyuktā dānavā dānaveśvaraiḥ | mamardurdevatānīkaṃ prahatāḥ sarvaśastathā ||1 6 | | devāstepi ca saṃyattāstapoyogabalānvitāḥ | dānavān vividhaiḥ śastrairabhijaghnuḥ kṛtāgasaḥ || 17|| asīnāṃ pātyamānānāṃ śirasāṃ hastināmapi | āsīcchabdo mahāghoro vaṃśānāmiva pāṭyatām || 18 || vikṛṣyatāṃ ca dhanuṣāṃ bāṇānāṃ ca vimucyatām | āsīttatra mahāñchabdo girīṇāmiva bhidyatām || 19|| gacchadbhirbhindipālaiśca śaktibhistomaraistathā | ākāśamabhavat sarvaṃ khadyotairiva saṃvṛtam ||8.79.2 0 || śirobhiścaraṇaiścaiva bāhubhiśca nipātitaiḥ | kṣaṇena yuddhabhūmiḥ sā viṣamā samapadyata ||21 || dantibhiḥ parvatākārai rhayavaryairathottamaiḥ | kabandhaiścābhinṛtyadbhirdurnirīkṣyamabhūdraṇe | |22| | ātapatraiśca hāraiśca kavacaistalacai (?) rapi | niṣkasūtraiḥ sumukuṭaiḥ keyūraiḥ kuṇḍalairapi | |23 || kaṇṭhatrāṇairvicitraiśca dukūlairmaṇibhiśca ha | kuthābhiśca vicitrābhirbhujaiḥ sābharaṇairapi | |24|| muśalaiḥ śūladaṇḍaiśca ghaṇṭābhiścāṃkuśairapi | vibhāti bhūtalaṃ tatra jyotirbhirdyaurivāvṛtam ||25| | kruddhaḥ keśeṣu saṃgṛhya virathopi mahārathaḥ | rathinaṃ rathamāplutya nijaghāna balādbalī ||26|| tatra cānyo gaje cāśurabhihatya mahābhujaḥ | rathaṃ cikṣepa ca vṛtaiḥ (?) kuśamuṣṭimivādhvare ayamādhāvataḥ paśya gajasya bhujamācchinat | sa tenaiva gajenorvyāṃ papāta viniṣūditaḥ | |32|| ayamanyena saṃyukta anyenāgatya ghātitaḥ | sa cāpyanyena devena sopyanyena punarhataḥ ||3 3 || ete padātayaścānye bahavaḥ saṃhatā bhṛśam | rathinaṃ mohayitvā tu jaghnurenamabhītavat | |34|| evamākāśagāḥ siddhā ṛṣayaścāraṇāstathā | śādhathanti ramante ca smayanti ca japanti ca | |35 | |
