kārmukāṇi vikarṣataḥ | ciccheda yugapad vyāsa tadadbhutamivābhavat ||8.80.2 0 || vicchinnadhanvā sa kruddhastomarāṇi tadāsṛjat | cikṣepa tāni vegena vāyuranyāṃ diśaṃ punaḥ | |2 1 | | hayām̐śca punarevāsya śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ | sasūtān paramāyasto hyanayadyamasādanam || 22 || sa rathādbalijaḥ krodhādavaplutya mahābalaḥ | gadāṃ gṛhītvā vegena śvasanaṃ samupādravat | |23 | | tasyāpatata evāśu sagadasyānilastathā | śarairāśīviṣākārairgadāṃ tāṃ samakṛntata ||24|| sa nikṛttagadaścāpi bāṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ | pragṛhya tu gadāmanyāṃ cikṣepa ca jahāsa ca || 25|| tāmāpatantīṃ vegena gadāṃ bāṇasya khecarīm | ākṣipya vāyurvyadhamadanyāṃ diśamadīnavat | |2 6 || virathaṃ tamathālakṣya vāyunā ca bhṛśārdditam17 | putraṃ balirdrutaṃ vyāsa svarathe samapādayat | |27|| tāvekarathasaṃyattau babhaturdānaveśvarau | sūryācandramasau yadvat pūrṇamāsyāṃ samāgatau ||28| | atha teṣāñca teṣāñca tadyuddhamabhavattadā | ...................| tānniruddhānathājñāya lokapālairmahābalaiḥ | |29| | nivātakavacāḥ sarve kālakeyāśca daṃśitāḥ | paulomāḥ saiṃhikeyāśca śambaraḥ kālaśambaraḥ | |8.80.3 0 | | andhakaśca mahādaityo hiraṇyākṣaśca viśrutaḥ | sarve vyūhamamuñcanto dānavā yuddhalālasāḥ || 31 andhako yamamabhyetya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt | mahatā sa rathenaitya dhanurvisphālya cāsakṛt ||34|| yamaṃ lalāṭe daśabhirbāṇairvivyādha vīryavān | pañcabhirmahiṣaṃ cāsya ṣaḍbhiḥ kālaṃ tathāgrataḥ ||3 5 || mṛtyuñca daśabhiścaiva kṛtāntaṃ caiva saptabhiḥ | bhrāmayan sa punaścāpamindrāyudhasamaprabham ||3 6| | nanādāmbudavaccaiva punarvivyādha daivatam | hiraṇyākṣasuto jyeṣṭho hyandhakohaṃ mahābalaḥ | | cakruḥ sādhvandhaketyevaṃ cukruśuśca muhurmuhuḥ | andhakopi tadābhyetya nardamāno yathārṇavaḥ | |44| | talenāhatya mahiṣādyamaṃ bhūmau nyapātayat | tato hāhākṛtaṃ devairgṛhṇagṛhṇeti dānavaiḥ ||45|| vyūhabhaṃgaśca devānāmabhavacchaktinandana | atha mṛtyuśca kālaśca kṛtāntaśceti te trayaḥ ||46| | andhakaṃ bahubhiḥ pāśairbabandhuḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ | pāśām̐ścaiva sa daityendro vicchidya sumahābalaḥ | bāhupāśena balavānkṛtāntamavabadhnata | |47| | sa baddho bāhupāśena kṛtāntaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ | utkṣipyāndhakamuddhūto nināya balavān balāt ||48| | taṃ nīyamānaṃ saṃprekṣya hiraṇyākṣaḥ sutaṃ svakam | jaghāna sāyakaistīkṣṇaiḥ kṛtāntaṃ subhṛśaṃ dṛḍham | |49| | tasya gātrāṇi sarvāṇi sandhīm̐ścaiva mahābalaḥ | vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiḥ sa viṣṭabdho vyatiṣṭhata | |8.80.50 || taṃ bāṇairvivṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | rakṣantaḥ samapadyanta bhīmodyatakarāyudhāḥ || 51 || atha kikhara mṛdaṃgaveṇuvīṇāpaṇavasughoṣakaḍiṇḍimānakānām | asurasurabale mahān tadānīṃ samabhavadugrataraḥ sa tūryanādaḥ | |52 || iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.81> sanatkumāra uvāca hiraṇyākṣastadāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā devendramagrataḥ | uvāca rathayantāramindraṃ prati nayasva mām ||1|| sa tena coditastasya codayānastadā hayān | anayattaṃ surendrāya hutaṃ bhāgaṃ yathānalaḥ ||2|| sa gajaskandhagaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sureśvaram | śarapāte tadā sthitvā provācāsurapuṃgavaḥ ||3|| śakra yatte balaṃ kiñcit tadvidarśaya mā ciram | pūrvadevā vayaṃ caiva trailokyaṃ cākhilaṃ hi naḥ ||4|| jyeṣṭhakramāgataṃ kṛtvā nyāyena ca surottama | te yūyaṃ nyāyamutsṛjya hatvā me bhrātaraṃ punaḥ | |5|| viśrambheṇa śaṭhā bhūtvā paścād devatvamāgatāḥ | ime vayaṃ pūrvadevā na vā yūyañca devatāḥ ||6|| yudhyatāṃ vodya sarveṣāṃ jīvitāni harāmyaham | sahānugaistvāmihādya hatvā kṛtvā baliṃ tathā ||7|| bhaviṣyāmyanṛṇo bhrāturyastvayā māyayā hataḥ | sa evamuktvā balavaddhanurākṛṣya vīryavān | lalāṭe pañcabhirvyāsa vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||8|| sa viddhastena devānāṃ lalāṭe pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ | rājā babhau yathā meruḥ sūryapādaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||9|| atha tasya tadā śakraḥ punaścaṅkramato dhanuḥ | ciccheda vajramādāya punaścainamatāḍayat ||8.81.1 0 || sa tena suprahāreṇa diśo dīptā hyapaśyataḥ | anyacca dhanurādāya punareva vyakarṣata | |1 1 || tadapyasyācchinadrājā tathānyad bhūya eva ca | atha śaktiṃ samādāya cikṣepa ruṣitastadā | |1 2| | tāmāpatantīṃ dīptāsyāmugrāṃ mṛtyoriva svasām | vajreṇa rājā ciccheda tadadbhutamivābhavat ||1 3 || gadāmanyāṃ samudyamya hiraṇyākṣastadā śubhām | abhidudrāva vegena kruddhaḥ siṃha iva dvipam ||14| | tasyāpatata evāśu gadāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām | ciccheda bahudhā rājā dharmārthāviva nāstikaḥ ||15| | athainaṃ vipracittiśca śinirbāṣkalireva ca | mayaśca sambaraścaiva asilomā ca dānavaḥ | |1 6|| tāraśca kārakaścaiva tathendradamanaḥ sa ca | kālanemiśca ṣaṇḍaśca vipākaḥ pāka eva ca ||17| | ilvalo namuciścaiva vātāpī kālamuṃjikaḥ | ete sarve mahāmāyā devendramabhidudruvuḥ | | 18|| tānāpatata evātha rudrādityāḥ pramanyavaḥ | rurudhurvijane yadvad gajān siṃhāḥ samūrjitāḥ || 19| | teṣāṃ teṣāṃ ca saṃgrāmaḥ sughoraḥ samapadyata | araṇyenyonyasaṃpātānmattānāṃ dantināmiva ||8.81.2 0 || tatrāṃśo nāma ādityo rathenāmbudanādinā | āyamya kārmukaṃ vyāsa dānavān samupādravat | |21 | | sa vipracittiṃ daśabhiḥ śiniṃ pañcabhireva ca | tribhiśca vāṣkaliṃ saṃkhye mayaṃ pañcabhireva ca ||22| | saṃvaraṃ caiva viṃśatyā asilomānameva ca | tāraṃ ca tārakaṃ caiva ilvalaṃ namuciṃ tathā | |23 || vātāpiṃ cendradamanaṃ vipākaṃ pākameva ca | kālanemiṃ ca ṣaṇḍaṃ ca tathā cāmīsṛmuñjikam ||24| | etānsarvān sa vivyādha daśabhirdaśabhiḥ śaraiḥ | vikarṣatāṃ ca saṃgrāme ādityo laghuhastavān | dhanūṃṣi yugapaddevaściccheda ca nanāda ca | |25| | tata eṣāṃ punarvāhān sūtān divyān jayadhvajān | prahasanniva viprendra sāyakairbahudhākarot | |26| | te hatāśvā maheṣvāsā hatasūtāśca sarvaśaḥ | vegena khaṅginaḥ sarve aṃśamevābhidudruvuḥ ||27| | tānmūrttīniva śailendrān garjato jaladāniva | asaṃbhrāntastadādityo jānuṣvevāvapūrayat ||28| | śarapūritagulphāste jānuṣveva ca dānavāḥ | aṃśamutsṛjya vegena jagmuranyāṃ diśaṃ tadā ||29|| tato devāstadā cakrurmahāntaṃ tūryanisvanam | siṃhanādāśca vipulān bāhuśabdām̐śca puṣkalān | |8.81.3 0 | | aṃśopyāyamya bhagavān dhanurindrāyudhopamam | dānavānāṃ sadaityānāmakarot kadanaṃ mahat ||3 1 || śirāṃsi dānavendrāṇāmaṃśaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ | apātayat phalānīva pakvāni śvasano yathā | |32 || dhāvanti kecidaṃśena aśiraskāḥ śaraiḥ kṛtāḥ | gatvā vegena saṃgrāmāt patantyūrvyāṃ gatāsavaḥ ||33 || apare bāhubhiśchinnairūrubhiśca mahābalāḥ | patitā niṣṭanantyugraṃ nirayasthā yathā narāḥ ||34|| śarapūritasarvāṅgāḥ śarasaṃbaddhabandhanāḥ | bhramanti tatra tatraiva saṃsāra iva dehinaḥ ||35 || na sa tatrāsti daityo vā dānavo vā mahābalaḥ | yaṃ śarā na viśantyugrā aṃśasya sumahātmanaḥ ||3 6| | bandhujīvavanaṃ yadvad vanamābhāti puṣpitam | aśokakiṃśukānāṃ vā tathā daityabalaṃ babhau | |37|| ayamaṃśoyamaṃśeti netyayaṃ cāyamityuta | sarvamaṃśamayaṃ daityā hyapaśyanta bhayārditāḥ | |38| | sopi nityāyatadhanuḥ pariveṣīva bhāskaraḥ | yaṃ yataḥ paśyate daityaṃ taṃ taṃ vivyādha patribhiḥ | |3 9| | nādadānastadā hyaṃśaḥ sandadhānastathāpi vā | na vikarṣandhanuścaiva lakṣyate daityadānavaiḥ | |8.81.40 | | śuṣkamivendhanaṃ mahad ||42|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.82> sanatkumāra uvāca tāṃstathāṃśena daityendrān kālyamānānitastataḥ | dṛṣṭvā balo mahāmāyo yantāramidamabravīt | |1 | | | sordyamānastadā devairbalī danāvapuṃgavaḥ | |22 || vṛkṣaiḥ kānanajairvyāsa yuyudhe bhīmavikramaḥ | tāndrumām̐ste tadākṣiptān balena bahudhā śubhān ||23 || kracuḥśarairdevatendrāstataḥ sa girimāvrajat | gṛhītvā sa mahacchṛṅgaṃ samṛgavyālakinnaram ||24|| cikṣepa sumahānādaṃ prakurvāṇotidāruṇam | tathā patan sa vegena pavano balavān balāt ||25|| jahāra śṛṅgaṃ taccāpi papātāsuramūrdhani | dānavānāṃ tadā koṭimekāṃ vīryavatāṃ yudhi ||26 || jaghāna balamuktaṃ tad giriśṛṅgaṃ mahāsvanam | tān hatān dānavāstena śṛṃgeṇa ditinandanān ||27| | dṛṣṭvā devāṃśca tānugrānabhajyanta sahasraśaḥ | rathairaśvairgajaiścaiva tathā caiva padātayaḥ ||28| | utsṛjya vāhanānyanye jīvitābhyarthinastadā | pramuñcanto mahānādān palāyanta sahasraśaḥ | |29| | drabatastān tadābhyetya hiraṇyākṣaḥ sa dānavaḥ (?) | vipracittiśca danujaḥ prahlādaśca mahābalaḥ | |8.82.3 0|| maya..ndhako daityastārakaḥ śakratāpanaḥ | ūcire dānavān sarvān daityāṃśca bhayavihvalān ||3 1 || bho bho dānavaśārdūlā daityāśca suraśatravaḥ | kiṃ palāyatha tiṣṭhadhvaṃ mā bhayaṃ vostu dānavāḥ ||32| | kva gatā dānavā yūyaṃ sukhaṃ lapsyatha vā na vā | ete balamajānanto devāḥ pūrvaṃ mahābalāḥ | |33 | | na pramardanti pātāle sthitānnāpyasurottamāḥ | niḥśeṣān pramathiṣyanti pātālepi kulādhamāḥ ||34|| mā yāta vinivartadhvaṃ rirakṣiṣata sarvaśaḥ | suyuddhenātmano daityā mā bhayaṃ votra jīvite ||3 5|| kva gataṃ danujatvaṃ vaḥ kva gatā daityatā ca vaḥ | kva ca vairaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ kva rājyaharaṇaṃ gatam ||3 6| ||| yad dhairyaṃ yaśca vo darpaḥ kulaṃ janma ca yaddhi vaḥ | yacca vo garjitaṃ pūrvaṃ tasya kāloyamāgataḥ | |37|| tadā bruvata yada daityā na bālā vayamityuta | vayamekaikaśo yogyā devānāṃ nāśanepi ca ||38|| tasya kāloyamadyeha prāptaḥ kiṃ vipalāyatha | tat sarvaṃ garjitaṃ vodya jānāmyahamataḥ param | |39|| śaradambudavad daityā vyarthaṃ mā yāta bhīriha nivartadhvamadharmajñā yudhyadhvaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ||8.82.40 | | vīkṣadhvaṃ me saputrasya mahat karma kulādhamāḥ | kaśyapasya sutaḥ śrīmān hiraṇyākṣosmi dānavāḥ ||41 | | andhakaśca sutoyaṃ me brahmadattavaraḥ śubhaḥ | hiraṇyakaśiporvīryaṃ yadabhūdasurottamāḥ ||42 | | dviguṇaṃ tanmamāpyasti vīkṣadhvaṃ tadaśaṃkitāḥ | adya caitān mayā sarvān hatān paśyata dānavāḥ ||43 || saṃgrāme yadi tiṣṭhanti sarve devā mamāgrataḥ | adya trailokyamavyagraṃ hateṣvasuraśatruṣu | |44| | vijvarā bhokṣyatha sukhaṃ mayendreṇāsurottamāḥ | mā vostu bhayamadyeha yathā tiṣṭhanti sādhavaḥ | saputraṃ māṃ yudhi yathā vīkṣamāṇāstu tiṣṭhata ||45 | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā viprendra gajāstotrārditā iva | vinivṛttāḥ punaḥ sarve lajjayātisamāvṛtāḥ | |46| | te chatrasaṃchāditavaktrapadmā lajjāsamāviṣṭavirāgavaktrāḥ | na tasya rājño mukhatovatasthustimerivārttāḥ salilelpamīnāḥ ||47|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe asurākrośano nāma dvadyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.83> sanatkumāra uvāca atha te dānavā vyāsa nivṛttā raṇamūrdhani | duṣkaraṃ taṃ tadā cakrurvegaṃ nadya ivārṇave | | 1 | | prahrādaścānuhrādaśca śini rbāṣkala eva ca | virocano balirbāṇo balonyo devakaṇṭakaḥ ||2|| vipracittiśca ṣaṇḍaśca hradaśca sa śatodaraḥ | yamosuraśca vyaṃsaśca śatāvartto hutodaraḥ ||3 || keśī ca namuciścaiva tathendradamanosuraḥ | mayo murastārakākṣo vidyunmālī prabhākaraḥ | |4|| tāraśca tārakaścaiva bakaścāṭiśca viśrutaḥ | mūkaścaiva kubhaścaiva kārtasvanamahāravau ||5|| vātāpī celvalaścaiva tathaivelvakabalvalau | ketuśca śataketuśca rāhuḥ svarbhānureva ca ||6|| śambaro namuciścaiva kālaśambara eva ca | dundubhirmahiṣaścaiva śatadundubhireva ca | |7|| kālanemī vipākaśca pāko duryodhanastathā | hastī sundanisundau ca śarabhaḥ kāla eva ca ||8|| vṛṣaparvā śatākrandaḥ śatāvarttotha dhenukaḥ | pralambaśca bakaścaiva gajo hālāhalastathā ||9|| saiṃhikeyāśca vikhyātāḥ paulomāḥ kālakāsutāḥ | nivātakavacāścaiva bāleyāśca tathā gaṇāḥ | |8.83.1 0|| bāṇasya ca sutāḥ sarve kālakhaṃjāśca viśrutāḥ | vṛtro vṛttaśca sagaṇastathānye sumahābalāḥ ||1 1 || tasya sainyasya viprendra nardataḥ saṃbabhau tadā | vegaḥ sa sindhurājasya velāṃ prati yathā mahān ||12|| vāditraravasaṃmiśraiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ supuṣkalaiḥ | rathanemihayānāṃ ca gajānāṃ bṛṃhitaiḥ saha || 13 | | sa śabdastumulo vyāsa trailokyamavapūrayat | devāhyapi susaṃyattāḥ sarvodyogena saṃsthitāḥ | |14|| pratyagṛhṇanta tān daityān krodhatāmrāyatekṣaṇāḥ | ….............|| 15 | | asibhiḥ pātyamānaiśca śataghnībhiśca sarvataḥ | ulkābhiriva tad vyoma cicitramabhavattadā | |1 6| | śarāsibhinnakṛttāni patantyurvyāṃ śirāṃsi hi | tālebhya iva pakvāni phalāni munisattama || 17| | mukuṭairhārakeyūraiḥ śroṇīsūtraiśca saprabhaiḥ | niṣkairdukūlaiḥ kaṭakairaṃgulīyaiḥ sakuṇḍalaiḥ | |18|| uracchadaiḥ kaṅkatībhiḥ karapālaiśca dantinām | vyajanairbālavṛntaiśca chatrairmaṇibhireva ca | |1 9|| paṭṭaiśca kāñcanairdivyaiḥ kavacaiśca mahāprabhaiḥ | śirobhiścaraṇaiścaiva karairvaktrairmahāprabhaiḥ ||8.83.2 0 || pratodaiśca kuthābhiśca yoktraiśca kanakojjvalaiḥ | tatra yuddhaniśā bhāti tārābhirdyaurivāparā ||21|| tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva me yāsi nāsti mokṣastavādya vai | sthitohaṃ praharasveti na me bhīstiṣṭha megrataḥ ||22| | kiṃ garjasi vṛthā vyomni śaradīva balāhakāḥ | karmaṇā darśaya kṣipraṃ garjitaṃ tedya niṣphalam | |23 | | naivaṃ prahriyate mūḍha mā vīkṣasva dṛḍho bhava | tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva gantāsi mama hatvā priyaṃ sutam | |24|| sthitosmyeṣa nayiṣyāmi tvāmadya yamasādanam | adya te ratāṃ sarvāṃ devādhama sudussahām ||25|| nāśayiṣyanti madbāṇāstiṣṭha tiṣṭha mamāgrataḥ | dānavādhama devosmi nāsmi bhītohamāhave ||26| | evaṃ vadanto yuyudhuryathā mattā mahāgajāḥ | parasparavadhāsaktā yodhāstatra sahasraśaḥ ||27|| anyonyamevamābhāṣya praiṣayanyamasādanam | siddhāśca cāraṇāścaiva vyomni sarve vyavasthitāḥ ||28|| sādhayanti ramante ca nadanti ca yathāmbudāḥ | mamāyaṃ dānavaḥ saṃkhye hato bhartā vinirmitaḥ ||29|| ayaṃ devastava patirmā pārakye manaḥ kṛthāḥ | kimevaṃ lobhayuktāsi śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ parīkṣase | |8.83.3 0 || svayaṃgrāho na cehāsti lekhyaṃ vācaya mā tvara | asantuṣṭaṃ manaḥ kinte saṃtuṣṭā bhava sundari ||3 1 || bhāgoyaṃ te surairdattastaṃ gṛhītvā vrajālayam | evamapsarasaścātra vadanti ca hasanti ca ||3 2|| samare nihate yodhe kurvanti kalahaṃ tathā | mekhalāvalayonmiśraṃ tāsāṃ tat kalabhāṣitam ||3 3 | | śrutvā śrutvā ca te yodhā yuyudhurbhayavarjitāḥ | valgitā sphoṭitaiścaiva diśaḥ sarvā vyanādayan ||34|| tat tapravāditagajopabṛṃhitavalgitākupitasiṃhanāditam | devadānavabhayapravarttanaṃ jīvitāntakaramābabhau raṇam ||3 5 || iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.84> sanatkumāra uvāca sa yuddhayajñastatrāgryo rājyārthamabhavattadā | tatra yajvā svayaṃ devaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān ||1|| saha devaiḥ surādhyakṣaḥ kuśāstasya śarā matāḥ | āyudhāni vicitrāṇi sruvā yairhūyate haviḥ | |2 | | haviḥ prāṇāḥ samākhyātā agnirmṛtyurmahāprabhā | mantrāścāstrāṇi divyāni puroḍāśāḥ śirāṃsyapi | | 3 | | somastatra jayobhūnnu rudrāścādhvaryavobhavan | ādityā bahvṛcaścāsan hotraṃ ca vasubhiḥ kṛtam | |4|| brahmā samabhavaccātra svayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | śāmitraṃ cāśvinau tau tu yajña evaṃ vyavarttata | |5|| paśustatrābhavaddaityo hiraṇyākṣaḥ sahānugaḥ | evaṃ babhau tadā yajño daityānāṃ śiśirādhipaḥ(?) || 6|| hiraṇyākṣobhavadyajvā daityadānavanāyakaḥ | vipracittirabhūd hotā prasthātāraśca dānavāḥ ||7|| udgātā caiva prahlādaḥ śukro brahmā ca suvrataḥ | paśurindraḥ sahasrākṣa evaṃ soyajadavyayaḥ | |8| | tasmim̐stadā mahāyajñe vartamāne mahābhaye | indraḥ samāsadaddaityaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam ||9 || vāyurabhyāyayau tūrṇaṃ vipracittiṃ mahābalaḥ | saktobhūt saṃvareṇāṃśo balena bhaga eva ca ||8.84.1 0| | virocanena pūṣā ca mitro balimathāsajat | bāṇena varuṇaḥ sārdhamandhakena yamassaha | |1 1 | | jayantenelvalaḥ sārdhaṃ mayena saha candramāḥ | ahirbudhnyena rāhuśca kāpālī śataketunā | |1 2 || ajaikapāt kālanemiṃ jvaraḥ kārtasvanena ca | prahlādenāryamā sārdhamanuhlādena vai dharaḥ | | 13 || dhruvo hradena saṃsakto hyanye cānyairmahābalāḥ | hiraṇyākṣastadendrasya dṛḍhamāyamya kārmukam ||14| | vivyādha gajamekena kumbhadeśe mahābalaḥ | devendraṃ pañcabhirbāṇairjatrudeśe samāhanat | ṣaḍbhirlalāṭe vivyādha gajaṃ bhūyaśca saptabhiḥ | |1 5| | sa gajastaiḥ śarairbhinnaḥ kṣaran rudhiramābabhau | gairikāmbuparisrāvī śvetaḥ parvatarāḍiva || 1 6|| tasya kruddhastadā śakro vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | prahāramadadad vyāsa gaṇḍadeśe nanāda ca | | 17| | sa vajraghātaṃ daityendraḥ puṣpaghātamivorjitam | acintayānaḥ sagajaṃ śakramevārdayadbalī | | 1 8|| gajopi tena nirbhinnaḥ kṣaradrudhira ābabhau | haviṣevānalaḥ krodhāt prajajvāla jagarja ca | |1 9|| sa vegaṃ mahadāsthāya aṃkuśena ca coditaḥ | hiraṇyākṣarathaṃ tūrṇaṃ jagrāha rathakūbare || 8.84.20 || gṛhītvā sa tamutkṣipya cikṣepa gajasattamaḥ | meruśṛṃgamivotkṣipya sameghaṃ śvetakuṇḍalī | |2 1 | | gatvā muhūrttaṃ vegena patan rathavaro babhau | svarbhānunā hataḥ pūrvaṃ saratho bhāskaro yathā | |22 | | tatra samyak sthitaṃ bhūmau hiraṇyākṣarathaṃ punaḥ | ājagāma gajastūrṇaṃ jighṛkṣurmunisattama | | 23 | | prasāritakaro dantī stabdhadṛkkarṇabāladhiḥ | abhyadhāvata vegena garutmāniva pannagam | |24| | tamāpatantaṃ vegena samīkṣyāsurasattamaḥ | babhāra sa tadā vyomni garutmāniva pannagam | |25|| taṃ tu maṇḍalamāvṛttaṃ gajopyanu tathaiva hi | stabdhadṛkkarṇalāṃgūlaḥ prasāritakarobhramat | |26|| hāhākṛtamabhūt sarvaṃ sādhusādhviti cobhayoḥ | balayordevadaityānāṃ mūkavaccābhavatpunaḥ || 27|| sādhu daityeti cānyeṣāṃ hiraṇyākṣeti caiva hi | sa gajaskandhago bhāti bhraman suragaṇeśvaraḥ ||28|| sapakṣa iva śailendre mahiṣograṃ samāsthitaḥ | hiraṇyākṣaśca daityendro bhramitvā trirmahāsuraḥ | |29|| gajaṃ drutamivotsārya rathe tasthau mahābalaḥ | yudhyamānastu daityendro dṛḍhamāyamya kārmukam | |8.84.3 0 | | devarājaṃ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ samantāt paryavārayat | sa taiḥ śaraistadā vyāsa marmasaṃdhiṣu tāḍitaḥ ||3 1 | | vajreṇa śatadhā tasya kavacaṃ pravyaśātayat | hayānāṃ caiva yoktrāṇi sarvāṇyeva tvakṛntata ||3 2|| raśmīm̐śca sūtahastasthān pratodaṃ caiva kāñcanam | ciccheda vahudhā śakraḥ prahasanniva vīryavān | |33 || chinnayoktrāstatosyāśvāḥ svachandāḥ saṃpratasthire | hiraṇyākṣopyavaplutya gadayā samatāḍayat ||34|| gajaṃ surapatiṃ caiva khaṅgena sa mahāsuraḥ | sa gajastena ghātena tyaktvā taṃ rathasattamam | | 35|| śakṛnmūtraṃ sṛjan vyāsa prādravad balavāṃstadā | mardayāno nadam̐ścaiva bhrāmayan surasattamam ||3 6 || asinābhyāhataścāpi devarājo mahābalaḥ | nārttimānabhavat saṃkhye na.......| |37| | sa dānavendraprahatena dantinā mahābalaḥ prasrutadānagandhinā | amṛṣyamāṇaḥ prayayau pramāthinā hiraṇyanetreṇa yudhi pramāthitaḥ ||38|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ | <8.85> sanatkumāra uvāca vipracittirmahāmāyo vāyuṃ bahubhirāśugaiḥ | avākiraddanusuto vṛṣṭyeva hi jalapradaḥ | |1 || saṃchādayan tadā vyāsa maṇḍalīkṛtakārmukaḥ | iṣūm̐ścikṣepa tīkṣṇāgrāñchalabhān sāgaro yathā ||2|| dhārā balāhakādyadva jjyotsnāścandramaso yathā | raśmayo bhāskarādyadvad himaṃ himagireriva || 3 || tathā te śarasaṃghātā dhanuṣo maṇḍalīkṛtāt | vipracitterviniṣpetu........||4| | bhāskaraṃ chādayānām̐stāñcharānāpatato balī | bhagavānanilo vegādasureṣu nyapātayat ||5|| taiḥ śaraistasya daityasya dānavā bahavo hatāḥ | chinnāśca niṣṭanantyurvyāṃ nirayasthā yathā narāḥ | |6 || tāṃstathā nihatān dṛṣṭvā vipracittirmahāsuraḥ | avaplutya rathād vāyorbāhuyuddhamayudhyata ||7|| tasya yuddhaprasaktasya vāyorbalamavardhata | amanyanta surāścaiva nigṛhītaṃ danoḥ sutam ||8|| athotpatya tadā vegād gadayā pavanaṃ dṛḍham | atāḍayat hiraṇyākṣo gaṇḍadeśe mahābalaḥ | |9| | sa tena suprahāreṇa hiraṇyākṣasya...| …nyanna kiñcicca tata eva sa dānavam ||8.85.10|| parityajya yayau tūrṇamanyadeśaṃ mahābalaḥ | aṃśasaṃvarayoścāpi sumahanmunisattama ||11|| yuddhaṃ samabhavad ghoraṃ draṣṭṝṇāṃ tuṣṭivardhanam | aṃśosyāpatatastūrṇam̐ saṃvarasya mahābalaḥ ||12|| darśayam̐llāghavaṃ samyag dhvajaṃ ciccheda kāṃcanam | dhanuśca paṃcadhā kṛtvā hyānninye yamakṣayam || 13 || tatosya sāratheḥ kāyācchiro bhūmāvapātayat | bhūya enaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā sāyakānāmavidhyata ||14|| sa māyāṃ tāmasīṃ ghorāṃ samāviśyāśu dānavaḥ | upalaiścāpi vajraiśca gadābhiḥ parighairapi ||15|| kaṃkaṭaiḥ karavālaiśca bhindipālairayoghanaiḥ | jaghāna sarathaṃ devamaṃśaṃ vyāsa raṇājire |16|| sa saṃdṛśya samantācca pātyamānaṃ mahābhayam | aṃśo mūḍho raṇaṃ tyaktvā prayayāvanyato bhayāt ||17|| bhago balaṃ samāsādya rathenāmbudanādinā | tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti taṃ daityamuktvā vivyādha patriṇā ||18|| sa sāyakaṃ samādāya balosuramahārathaḥ | bhagaṃ hastatale tūrṇam̐ nirbibheda rarāsa ca ||19|| tata enaṃ samāsādya māyayā prahasanniva | āāhatyorasi pādena svarathaṃ punarāvrajat ||8.85.20|| tasya tallāghavaṃ śauryamamūḍhatvaṃ savīryatām | dṛṣṭvā devāsurāḥ sarve sādhusādhvityapūjayan ||21|| bhagopi lajjayāviṣṭaḥ padā tenāhatastadā | muśalena hyām̐stasya rathañcaiva sasārathim |22|| nāmaśeṣām̐stadā kṛtvā vinanāda yathāmbudaḥ | syandanaṃ tu balastyaktvā cūrṇitaṃ sahayaṃ tadā ||23|| bhagasya kārmuka divyaṃ bhūmisthaścācchinad balī | tata enaṃ pṛṣatkena lalāṭe samatāḍayat ||24|| hastayośca punarvyāsa śarairvivyādha saptabhiḥ | gṛhṇataḥ kārmukaṃ cāsya pṛṣṭhadeśe balocchinat |25|| punaścānyat punaścānyat sa jagrāha tato bhagaḥ|| muśalaṃ kālamūlaṃ tat sarvaghātyanalaprabham ||26|| hatosīti tamuktvaiva cikṣepa balanāśanam | tamāpatantaṃ muśalaṃ balo dānavapuṃgavaḥ ||27|| śarairviṣṭambhayāmāsa nandī mṛtyuṃ yathātmanaḥ | atha pratihtaṃ matvā muśalaṃ sosuraḥ punaḥ ||28|| dhanuṣkoṭayā bhagaṃ mūrdhni balavān samatāḍayat | rathaśca saha sūtena gṛhītvā kūbare punaḥ || 29|| cikṣepa dakṣiṇasyāṃ sa vāyurgirimivārṇave | pūṣā virocanaṃ devaḥ śarairbahubhirāśugaiḥ ||8.85.30|| vivyādha samare kruddhaḥ sa ca taṃ pratyavidhyata | saptabhirniśitairbāṇai(?)riṣubhirmarmabhedibhiḥ ||31|| kruddhaḥ pūṣā tathākṛṣya balavān kārmukaṃ mahat | _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ||||32|| jīvitāntakaraṃ ghoraṃ yugāntādityavarcasam | mumoca ripumuddiśya hṛtastvamiti cocivān |33|| tamāpatantaṃ bahudhā nadantaṃ diśaśca sarvā avabhāsayantam | ulkāḥ sphuliṃgāśca samudgirantaṃ yayau ripūn vegavadutpatantam (?) |34|| sa cāpyavaplutya mahāsurendro dṛṣṭvā tamādityasamānabhāsam | matvāviṣahyaṃ svarathaṃ vihāya viyat samāviśya tatovatasthe ||35|| tattasya sūtañca hyopapannaṃ mahārathaṃ sarvagamastravaryam | kṛtvāśu bhasmeva yathā hutāśo jagāma khaṃ divyamadṛśyarūpam |36|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.86> sanatkumāra uvāca tato dagdharathaḥ khastho dānavaḥ sa virocanaḥ | vegenāsiṃ viniṣkṛṣya sa pūṣṇo niśitāñcharān ||1|| cicchedāpatataḥ sarvān kārmukaṃ caiva vīryavān | tathā cainaṃ punarmūdhni khaṅgena samatāḍayat ||2|| sa tena suprahāreṇa kṣaradrudhiramastakaḥ | rathopasthe papātāśu vṛttotsava iva dhvajaḥ ||3|| patitaṃ taṃ sa daityendraḥ pragṛhyāśu mahābalaḥ | cikṣepa devarājānaṃ nardamānaḥ payodavat ||4|| baliṃ vivyādha mitraśca jatrudeśe śaraistribhiḥ | balirekena bhallena tasya ciccheda kārmukam ||5|| athainaṃ punaranyena hṛdaye samatāḍayat | sa mūḍho mṛtakalpaśca rathopasthe sasāda ha ||6|| taṃ sārathirmṛtyubhayād viṣaṇṇaṃ samupasthitam | apovāha tadā vyāsa tato daityā vicukruśuḥ ||7|| bāṇaṃ vivyādha varuṇaḥ pṛṣatkānāṃ śatena ha | sa kārmukaśatāni sma pañca bāṇaḥ pratāpavān ||8|| ākṛṣya yugapat kruddhaḥ śarāṃścikṣepa tāvataḥ | tānāpatata evātha varuṇo laghuhstavān ||9|| ekaikaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā bāṇaṃ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ | tatosya kārmukān sarvān varuṇaḥ prahasan balī ||8.86.10|| ciccheda sāyakaistīkṣṇaistadadbhutamivābhavat | atha chinnadhanurdetyastasya cikṣepa vai gadām ||11|| chinnāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tāṃ bhūyo gadāḥ paścāsṛjad balī | sa ekasyāṃ tadā saktastā gadā nābhyavaikṣata ||12|| avikṣatāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ petustasya tatopari | kācinmukuṭamāmardya nipapāta mahītale ||13|| kācicca kārmukaṃ ghoraṃ hstadeśān nyapātayat || 7 || kācid dhvajaṃ dṛḍhaṃ divyaṃ cikṣepa dharaṇītale ||14|| kācidrathaṃ tadāhatya pāṃsugrāsaṃ cakāra ha | urasyūrūdare kaṭayāmaparāstasya tā gadāḥ ||15|| pataṃtyaḥ sumahāghorā ārtiṃ cakrurmahābhayāḥ | evaṃ sa tena virathaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛcchreṇa dhīmatā ||16|| varuṇastaṃ samutsṛjya jagāmānyadraṇājiram | yamondhakaṃ samāsādya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti coditaḥ |||||17|| atha tasya tato daṇḍaṃ rathaṃ prati samutsṛjat || 7 || sa rathaṃ tasya saṃcūrṇaṃ kṛtvā śatasahasraśaḥ||18|| yamahstaṃ punargatvā tathaiva samatiṣṭhata | andhakopi rathaṃ tyaktvā gadāpāṇirmahābalaḥ ||19|| yamaṃ samabhidudrāva krodhādvahnimivotsṛjan | | sa tasya dhāvato vegāt pitṛrājo yamaḥ svayam ||8.86.20|| daṇḍenaiva gadāmugrāṃ bhasmasāyujyamānayat | sa prahasya tadā cainamuvāca prasabhaṃ yamaḥ ||21|| bhavato dhāma yadabhūttate vinihataṃ mayā | sāṃprataṃ tvāmapi punanneṣyāmyadya svamālayam |22|| ahaṃ hi sarvalokasya maraṇe heturīśvaraḥ | mayā vairaṃ samāsādya kvānte jīvaṃ vimokṣyase || adya tvā nihaniṣyāmi sudṛḍhaṃ kriyatāṃ jagat (?) ||23|| athavādya gato bandhaṃ pūrvaṃ cāndhaka matpuram | agre draṣṭāsi tatraiva sarvānetān suradviṣaḥ ||24|| sanatkumāra uvāca athaivaṃvādinaṃ yuddhaṃ hyabhītondhakadānavaḥ | uvāca taṃ yamaṃ kruddhaṃ krodhād dīptānalekṣaṇaḥ ||25|| hiraṇyākṣasuto dṛpta andhakosmi surāntakaḥ | mahāyogabalopeto nāsmi prākṛtadānavaḥ ||26|| aṃgādyena samutkṛtya bhāgān māṃsasya kārṣikān | saṃvatsaraśatānyaṣṭau pañca caiva hutonalaḥ ||27|| tuṣṭo brahmā dadau yasya sadaivāmaratāṃ śubhām | sohaṃ nāmnā mahāsatvo mṛtyūtsedho na saṃśayaḥ ||28|| na tvaṃ mama kṛto mṛtyuḥ siṃhasyeva vane śaśaḥ | ahaṃ tu bhavitā mṛtyustava nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||29|| adya tvāhaṃ durātmānaṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram | hatvā śreyo vidhāsyāmi trailokyasyeti me matiḥ ||8.86.30|| devānāñca bhavānnityaṃ hantavyo vipriye sthitaḥ | teṣāmapi priyo hyadya bhaviṣyati hate tyayi |31|| na tvayāsāditaṃ pūrvaṃ haratā jīvitāni hi | kiñcid bhūtaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ tena tvaṃ nirbhayaḥ sadā ||32|| devāstava bhayād bhītā aśaktastvadvadhe tataḥ | amṛtādīni lipsanti pūjayanti sadā ca te ||33|| adya tvayi hate krūre nirdvandvāstepi sāmarāt | amṛte na tathā prītiṃ kariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||34|| adya garvaśca darpaśca yogamāhātmyameva ca | prāṇaiḥ sahaiva dehānte nāśayiṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ ||35|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamasurendreṇa tarjito bhāskarātmajaḥ | daṇḍenāsuraśārdūlamuttamāṃgebhyatāḍayat || 36 || kālaśca taṃ kareṇaiva hṛdaye samatāḍayat | mṛtyuścāśaninā kṣipraṃ śirasyevābhyatāḍayat ||37|| kaṇṭhe ca niyatistasya pāśaṃ cikṣepa dāruṇam | kṛtāntaḥ parighenaiva gaṇḍadeśe samāhanat ||38|| sa tairamoghairyāmaiśca prahatondhakadānavaḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭayā yathā kaścinnārtimānabhavattathā ||39|| na pāśāstasya līyante daṇḍo vā parighopi vā | anyāni cāsya tīvrāṇi na duḥkhāya bhavantyuta ||8.86.40|| tatassarvaistadotkruṣṭaṃ dānavaiḥ sarvatodiśam | avādyanta ca tūryāṇi mumude cāndhako bhṛśam |41|| sa teṣāṃ tuṣṭiśabdena madavīryasamīritaḥ || vinadyāmbudavad vyāsa yamamevābhidudruve ||42|| sa gatvā tasya vegena hanyamānopi kiṃkaraiḥ | āājaghāna mahāvego muṣṭinorasi taṃ yamam ||43|| punaśca mahiṣaṃ tasya śirasyabhihanatpadā | tāvubhau vihvalau tatra bhramitvā kiñcidantaram |44|| hitvāndhakaṃ tatastūrṇaṃ yayaturmunisattama | jayantaścelvalaṃ prāpya vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ||45 || tasyelvalaścakartāśu dhvajaṃ ratnavibhūṣitam | hayānāṃ caiva yoktrāṇi pratodaṃ caiva kāñcanam |46|| vinā yoktrairhayāstasya rathaṃ tyaktvā samuddhatāḥ | lānā vijagmurheṣanto jayanto virathobhavat ||47|| sa rathaṃ saṃparityajya bhūsthaḥ śakrātmajaḥ prabhuḥ | ilvalasya hayānsūtaṃ dhvajañcaiva nyapātayat | |48|| athobhau virathau bhūtvā hyanyonyavijayaiṣiṇau || avidhyetāṃ tadā yasya kārmuke sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ |49|| parasparavinirmuktānubhau saṃvārya sāyakān | astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya nedatuḥ sāgarāviva ||8.86.50|| atha śakrasutaḥ śrīmām̐llabdhvā tasya tadāntaram | dhanuściccheda bhallena nanāda ca punaḥ punaḥ ||51|| sa vikṛttadhanurdaityaḥ khaṅgaṃ dīptānalaprabham | bhrāmayitvā vicikṣepa tamapyasyācchinattadā ||52|| gṛhītvānyasya patitāṃ gadāṃ hemavibhūṣitām | bhrāmayitvā tu cikṣepa sāpadudrāva vegavat ||53|| sa yāvattāṃ gadāṃ ghorāṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ | viciccheda diteḥ putrastāvadasyācchinaddhanuḥ ||54|| atha yāvatsa nistriṃśaṃ jagrāhāditinandanaḥ | tāvadenaṃ padā daityo vāmenorasyatāḍayat ||55|| tameva tasya jagrāha pādaṃ sa ca mahābalaḥ | jayanto bhrāmayaccainaṃ nardamāno yathāmbudaḥ ||56|| tato hāhākṛtamabhūdasurāṇāṃ bale mahat | yāta trāyata daityendramilvalaṃ śīghramityuta ||57|| devānāṃ sihanādāśca śaṃkhaśabdāśca puṣkalāḥ | tūryāṇi cāpyavādyanta sādhusādhviti cābhavat ||58|| jayantopi yathā cakraṃ vidhātā balavām̐stadā | bhrāmayāmāsa detyendraṃ yugāntāmbudavannadan ||59|| atha svayaṃ hiraṇyākṣaḥ sondhako balireva ca | bāṇotha vipracittiśca śaṃbarotha virocanaḥ || 8.86.60 | | kālakeyāśca te daityāḥ paulomāḥ siṃhikāsutāḥ | nivātakavacāścainaṃ samantāt paryavārayan ||61|| sa taiḥ śarairgadābhiśca parighairdīghavedhanaiḥ || anyaiśca bahubhiścitrairāyudhaiḥ prahato bhṛśam ||62|| sa hanyamānastaṃ devo jayantaḥ śakranandanaḥ | hiraṇyākṣapathe kṣiptvā prādravad yena devatāḥ ||63|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.87> sanatkumāra uvāca | mayaścandramasaṃ devamārdayat krodhamūrcchitaḥ | śarairāśīviṣākārairnardamāno yathāmbudaḥ ||1|| tasyāsyatastato bāṇān candramāḥ prahasanniva | ekaikaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā mayaṃ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ ||2|| tata enaṃ pṛṣatkena lalāṭe samavidhyata | jahāsa ca punardevastasya lajjāṃ samādadhat ||3|| sa tasya hasataḥ śīghraṃ lalāṭe kaṃkapatriṇā | vivyādha bhṛśamāyasto yathā vighno yatavratam ||4|| tatosya deva uddiśya dhvajaṃ ciccheda nādayan | cakrarakṣām̐śca nistriṃśairanayad yamasādanam ||5|| tasya taccāpalaṃ vīkṣya mayo dānavasattamaḥ | māyāṃ divyāṃ samāsthāya rāhuḥ samabhavattadā ||6|| sa rāhubhūto daityendro deveśaṃ śaśalakṣaṇam | abhyadravad yathā rāhū rathenāmbudanādinā ||7|| sa tāṃ māyāṃ tadā jñātvā devo hyamṛtasaṃbhavaḥ || aparvavad viyatsthaṃ vai taṃ śaraistribhirārdayat ||8|| sopi daityo mahāmāyastāñcharānmāyayaiva tu | vārayannabhidudrāva śītaraśmiṃ mahāsuraḥ ||9|| tatosya syandanaṃ divyaṃ nāgayantṛ mahāprabham | gṛhītvā kūbare daityaścikṣepa ca rarāsa ca ||8.87.10|| ahirbudhnaḥ samāsādya rāhuścandramaso graham | viśikhaiḥ paṃcabhirviddhā dhvajamasya nyapātayat ||11|| tasyotpatya rathādrāhurgadayā bhīmarūpayā | dhanurdhvajaṃ hyām̐ścaiva samacūrṇayadavyayaḥ ||12|| aśaniṃ śataghaṃṭāṃ sa dīptāṃ mṛtyoriva snuṣām jagrāha bhṛśamāyastaḥ pāśaṃ mṛtyorivāntakaḥ ||13|| bhrāmayitvā sa tāmugrāṃ yamadaṇḍanibhāṃ balāt | cikṣepa rāhumuddiśya vidyutaṃ megharāḍiva ||14|| sā jvalantī maholkeva meghāśanirivojjvalā | papāta rāhoḥ śirasi yathā vajraṃ śiloccaye ||15|| atha tena prahāreṇa nārttimānabhavat sa vai | sa prahasya bhṛśaṃ rāhurvegaṃ cakre mahābalaḥ ||16|| ahirbudhnaṃ prati kruddho nāgānāmiva pakṣirāṭ | āpatantaṃ sa vīkṣyaiva bhagavāndevasattamaḥ ||17|| jagāma tasya panthānaṃ muktvānyena yathoragaḥ | śataketuśca taṃ vīro rathenāmbudanādinā ||18|| abhyadravadraṇe kruddhastiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt | āādhāvatosya kāpālī hṛdayaṃ kaṃkapatribhiḥ ||19|| bibheda kuliśaḥ kṣipto giriśrṛṃgamivocchitam | sa bhinnahṛdayastena rudreṇa grahsattamaḥ ||8.87.20|| papāta svarathe mūḍhaḥ śakradhvaja ivocchritaḥ | tato hāhākṛtaṃ daityairgṛhṇagṛhṇeti cāpyuta ||21|| sādhu sādhviti devāśca vinedurjaladā iva | athāndhako hiraṇyākṣo vipracittirvirocanaḥ ||22|| śambaraścelvalaścaiva bāṇo balirathāpi ca | kālakeyāssapaulomā nivātakavacāśca ye |23| anye ca bahavo daityāstaṃ rudraṃ paryavārayan | te śaraiśca gadābhiśca muśalaiḥ prāśatomaraiḥ |24|| nyavārayanta taṃ devaṃ tarjayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | sa hanyamānastairdevo bahubhirmunisattama | apāsartata vegena samīpāt suravidviṣām |25|| ajaikapāt kālanemiṃ gadinaṃ gadayāsaham | samāhvayata daityendraṃ madhuṃ viṣṇurivorjitam |26|| tau suyuddhau gadāhastau maṃḍalāni mahābalau | anyonyavijaye saktau grahāviva viceratuḥ ||27|| kālanemistu saṃkruddho gadāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām | śataghaṃṭāṭṭahāsāṃ ca mṛtyorjihvāmivādbhutām ||28|| bhrāmayitvāsakṛd daityo nardamāno yathā vṛṣaḥ | mumoca rudramuddiśya skandaḥ śaktimivācale |29|| śakramuktāmivāyāntīmaśaniṃ parvatopari | vidyutaṃ vā mahāśaktāṃ (?) sa rudro bhīmavikramaḥ ||8.87.30|| vañcayāmāsa vegena śveto mṛtyumivāgatām | tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cāpyuktvā rudraḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ ||31|| bhrāmayitvā gadāṃ ghorāṃ daityasyoparyapātayat | sa tayā gadayā daityo dīptayā bhīmarūpayā |32|| hato mūrdhni diśaḥ sarvā hāridrāḥ samapaśyata | atha daityastadā samyag bhrāmayan sa gadāṃ punaḥ ||33|| maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi darśayitvā mahābalaḥ | ajaikapādaṃ gadayā skandhadeśe vyatāḍayat ||34|| sa cāpyavahatastena yathā vajreṇa bhūdharaḥ | viveśa bhūmiṃ duḥkhārttastadadbhutamivābhavat ||35|| utthāya ca sa vegena rudraḥ kruddho mahābalaḥ | avasavyaṃ caran daityasavyato maṇḍalecaraḥ |36|| bhrāmayitvā gadāṃ bhūyo daityasyoparyapātayat | sa daityastena ghātena bhramitvā trirmahābalaḥ||37|| saṃstabhya gadayā bhūyo rudraṃ kukṣāvatāḍayat || 9 || sa tayā gadayā nunno yathā vāyvīrito nagaḥ ||38|| papāta bhūmau vegena śataśrṛṃgo yathā purā | patitaṃ tu tatobhyetya pade jagrāha suvratam ||39|| bhrāmayitvā ca cikṣepa sa cāmṛtyuravasthitaḥ (?) kārtasvanaṃ jvaraścogro rudraḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ ||8.87.40|| jaghāna niśitairbhallairdaśabhiḥ stanayoḥ samam || 7 || kārtasvanaśca bāṇena kārmukaṃ tasya dīptimat | ciccheda bahudhā cainaṃ punarvivyādha patribhiḥ ||41|| ........rudropi daṇḍaṃ sarvārthasādhakam | bhrāmayitvāśu cikṣepa kārtasvanarathaṃ prati |||42|| taṃ yugāntānalaprakhyaṃ śatasūryānalaprabham | jaghāna śarajālena megho vṛṣṭayā yathācalam ||43|| hanyamānaśca tairdaṇḍo haviṣeddha ivānalaḥ | bhūyastaraṃ prajajvāla vegavaccāpyadhāvata ||44|| tamapratihataṃ daṇḍaṃ jñātvā kārtasvanassa tu || rathamutsṛjya vegena āākāśasthobhavadbalī |45|| daṇḍaśca rathamabhyetya sahayaṃ saha yantṛṇā | sadhvajaṃ sapatākaśca bhasma kṛtvā yayau punaḥ |||46|| yāvad daṇḍo na patati rathenaiti ca taṃ prati | tāvat kārttasvano rudraṃ śarairabhyadravad balī |47|| chittvā dhvajaṃ dhanuścāsya tathā yoktrāṇi vājinām | virathaṃ taṃ jvaraṃ kṛtvā asinā mūrdhnyatāḍayat ||48|| asighātaparītātmā sa rudraḥ śatrusaṃsadam | tyaktvānyato yayau tūrṇaṃ padātirmunisattama |49|| sosighātaviparītacetano raktacandanavilepanaprabhaḥ || taṃ vihāya ripumagryavikramaṃ drudve surabalaṃ yatastataḥ ||8.87.50|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.88> sanatkumāra uvāca aryamā bahubhirbāṇaiḥ prahlādaṃ daityapuṃgavam | ājaghāna rathaṃ ghoraṃ dhvajaścāsya vyaśātayat ||1|| prahlādopyaryamantaṃ vai rathaṃ tyaktvaiva vīryavān | pradudrāva yathā rāhuḥ samaye timirāpaham ||2|| āādhāvantaṃ ca vegena vihastaṃ ripumaryamā | jaghāna bahubhirbāṇairvṛṣṭyā megho yathācalam ||3|| śarānagaṇayanneva hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | krodhānmānācca darpācca vegena samadhāvata ||54|| gṛhītvā kūbare tasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam | citrepa saha sūtena tato harṣānnināda ca ||5|| anuhrādo dharaṃ prāpya tena viddhaḥ stanāntare | asiṃ niṣkṛṣya vegena dharasya rathamāsadat ||6|| dhvajaṃ tasya hayām̐ścaiva sārathiṃ dhanureva ca | chittvā skandhe dharaṃ caiva punaḥ svarathamabhyagāt ||7|| karmaṇā tena daityasya dharobhūd bhṛśamarditaḥ | evamanyaiśca daityendrairanye devā mahābalāḥ ||8|| nirjitāstarjitāścaiva yuddhāya ca punaḥ sthitāḥ | tataḥ saṃkulamevābhūddevānāṃ dānavaissaha ||9|| parasparajigīṣūṇāṃ yuddhaṃ bhīrubhayāvaham | tato bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṭahāsekyapuṣkalāḥ ||8.88.10|| jharjharyaḥ pepukāścaiva ḍiṇḍimā goviṣāṇakāḥ | avādyanta bale vyāsa ubhayeṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||11|| tatosṛgoghapravahā patākadhvajapādapā | gajāśvagrāhabahulā rathapravarakacchapā ||12|| keśaśaivālabahulā dhanurjyākṛtatantukā | niṣṭanacchastramaṇḍūkā dukūlacchatraphenilā ||13|| uṣṇīṣavarahaṃsā ca karapādaśiropalā || hārakeyūrasikatā mukuṭotphullapaṃkajā ||14|| medosrakaphapaṃkā ca prāṇajīvitanāśanī | prāvartata nadī ghorā hastyaśvarathavāhinī ||15|| tasyāṃ snāyanti rakṣāṃsi pibanti ca ramanti ca | nṛtyanti cāpi vividhā bhīrūṇāṃ bhayadāstathā ||16|| gṛdhrā gomāyavaścaiva śvāno mārjāravāyasāḥ || cakṣūṃṣi karapādāntraṃ bhakṣayantībhiremire ||17|| mamāyaṃ hastinaḥ pādo mamāyaṃ medapaṭṭakaḥ | mamāyaṃ ca karaḥ śukro bāhuśca rudhirasyadaḥ ||18|| mamāyaṃ tava nāyaṃ ca gṛhṇa paśyeti caiva hi | kalahaṃ cakrire tatra krūrāḥ piśitabhojanāḥ ||19|| tyaktvānye ca hatām̐statra svadehān sumahārathāḥ | vimānaiḥ strījanākīrṇaiḥ prayayubrahmaṇaḥ sadaḥ ||8.88.20|| apare pāpakarmāṇo hanyamānā ruṣāndhitaiḥ | patanti narake ghore krandamānā muhurmuhuḥ ||21|| kecidārttāsvaraṃ kṛtvā.....ṣārditāḥ || mriyante puruṣā yuddhe śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ||22|| daśantaśca tṛṇānyanye bhrātaḥ putreti cāpare | krandamānā janā bhītāḥ prāṇān kṛcchreṇa tatyajuḥ ||23|| saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāḥ kecid devāsuramahārathāḥ | śarasannatamarmāṇaḥ patantyurvyām̐ drumā iva ||24|| aśivāni śivā neduraṭṭahāsām̐śva rākṣasāḥ | āārttanādām̐śca puruṣāstathaiva gajavājinaḥ |25|| siṃhanādāśca śūrāṇāṃ bāhuśabdāśca puṣkalāḥ | dhanuṣāṃ kṛṣyamāṇānāṃ śabdā vādyaravāstathā ||26|| athendraśca dhaneśaśca yamaḥ kālaśca vīryavān | varuṇo marutaścaiva viśvedevāśca sarvaśaḥ ||27|| mitraścaiva jayantaśca bhagaḥ pūṣāryamā tathā | kāpālī cāpi yo rudro vasavaśva mahābalāḥ ||28|| nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca pṛśnayaśca surottamāḥ | ete cānye ca devānāṃ pravarā bāhuśālinaḥ |29|| dānavānāṃ bale vegaṃ balavanto bhicakrire | sāgarā iva garjanto yugānte analā iva ||8.88.30|| prabhañjanā ivākāle mahānta iva cācalāḥ | vṛṣabhā iva nardanto bṛhanta iva kuñjarāḥ ||31|| grasantaśca yathā grāhāśchindanto makarā iva | varṣamāṇā iva ghanāḥ siṃhā iva ca nardinaḥ || dānavānāṃ balaṃ sarve vegenaivābhyavārayan ||32|| taddevavegaprahatābhivegaṃ balaṃ sayatnaṃ danudānavānām | bhavatyanādhāramatiprasaktaṃ tṛṇaṃ yathā vahnimukhāvasaktam |33 || iti skandapurāṇe yuddheṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.89> sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadveganunnānāṃ bhagnānāṃ kliśyatāṃ punaḥ || trāṇārthamatidīptākṣo hiraṇyākṣograhītpadam ||1|| andhakaśca mahāmāyo bhrātaraścāsya tatsamāḥ | śataṃ rathasahasrāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapalāyinām ||2|| prahlādaśca sahabhrātā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | vipracitiḥ sahabhrātā saiṃhikeyaiśca taissaha ||3|| gṛhṇa gṛhṇeti nardanto devān pratyudyayustadā | teṣāṃ teṣāṃ ca saṃgrāmaḥ sughoraḥ samapadyata ||4|| grāhāṇāmiva kāṇḍe ca gajānāmiva vā vane | indrastvaṣṭā ca pūṣā ca hiraṇyākṣamavārayan ||5|| saṃgatya sāyakaistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvamarmasvatāḍayan | teṣāṃ dhanūṃṣi citrāṇi asyatāṃ tu divaukasām ||6|| māyābalena daityendro vyaṣṭambhayata dīptimān | tāni viṣṭambhitāni sma tadā daityena māyayā |7|| nānamanti yathā pūrvaṃ tataste hyākulābhavan | sopi daityo mahāmāyo naditvā meghanisvanam ||8|| babandha teṣāṃ gātrāṇi samantādastramāyayā | tān baddhām̐śca samīkṣyaivamakarmaṇyānmahābalān ||9|| yantāro vāhanaiḥ kṣipraṃ jahrustasmādraṇājirāt | atha kālo yamaścaiva dhaneśo mitra eva ca ||8.89.10|| varuṇo vasavaḥ sarve aśvinau ca mahābalau | pragṛhītāyudhāḥ kruddhā stiṣṭhatiṣṭhetivādinaḥ ||11|| abhyadravanta vegena hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahāsuram | teṣāmāpatatāṃ saṃkhye sa daityaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||12|| sarveṣāṃ sāyakaistīkṣṇairbibheda kavacān yudhi | te bhinnakavacāḥ sarve krodhāt prajvalitānanāḥ ||13|| sasarjurastramukhyāni tadāpratihatānyuta || yamo daṇḍaṃ sasarjāsya tathā kālaśca...||14|| dhaneśaścāśaniṃ ghoraṃ varuṇaḥ pāśameva ca | bhagaśca muśalaṃ ghoramanye cānyām̐stathāmarāḥ ||15|| tān sa daityo hasanneva sāyakairmarmabhedibhiḥ | vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā śakrahastaṃ yathā bhavaḥ ||16|| sādhuvādām̐stato hṛṣṭā dānavānāṃ mahārathāḥ | samaṃ cakruśca saṃpūjya hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahāsuram ||17|| apare naitadāścaryaṃ ditiputrasya saṃyuge | kaśyapena prasūtasya rājñosmākaṃ ca svāminaḥ (?) ||18|| apare siṃhanādām̐śva bāhuśabdām̐śca puṣkalān | cakrurhṛṣṭāśca vādyāni tathā sarvāṇyavādayan ||19|| evaṃ hi saṃprahṛṣṭānāṃ dānavānāṃ mahāhave | pārāśarya giro bahvyaḥ śrūyante stuti...|| 8.89.20 || teṣāṃ praharṣaṃ jñātvetthaṃ devabhaṃgaṃ ca taṃ tadā | sarvaprāṇicaro vāyurasurānabhidudruve ||21|| sahasranalvamātreṇa sa rathena prabhaṃjanaḥ | samantād dhvajayuktena patākāśatamālinā24 |22|| javena yantṛṇāṃ yatnānnigṛhītena śabdavān | prapūrayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ sahasā pratyadṛśyata ||23|| sa pañcabhiḥ śaraistīkṣṇairdaityarājamathāvyathaḥ || āhṛtya yojane tasmāddeśāt kṣipramavāsṛjat ||24|| andhakaśca tataḥ ṣaṣṭyā vipracittiśca saptabhiḥ || mayaṃ pañcāśatā viddhvā saptabhiḥ saptabhiḥ punaḥ ||25|| daityāśca dānavaścaiva sarvān vivyādha tatkṣaṇāt | punaḥ pulomaputrām̐śca nivātakavacānapi ||26|| te tena bahubhirviddhāḥ śarairasurapuṃgavāḥ | dikṣu sarvāsu vikṣiptā yojanāntaritāḥ sthitāḥ ||27|| yānyām̐śca te vimuñcanti gadāmuśalapaṭṭiśān | tānsarvān bhagavān vāyurdānavoparyapātayat ||28|| te hatā hanyamānāśca sbamuktairāyudhaibhṛśam | āārttanādān prakurvāṇāḥ prādravanta diśo diśaḥ ||29|| sopi vāyurmahāvego babhaṃja rathasattamān | pāṃśuvarṣeṇa ca punaścakṣūṃṣyeṣāmapūrayat ||8.89.30|| tataste bhayasantrastā notsasarjustadā śarān | śastrāṇi ca tathānyāni yuṃjaśaścāvatasthire |||31|| tasya tatkarma saṃvīkṣya hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca dānavān sarvān garhayan ditinandanaḥ ||32|| dhigvo daityā balaṃ sarvaṃ dhigdarpā dhikparākramāḥ | visṛjya raṇamavyagrā yāta strīkarma sevata ||33|| ye yūyaṃ raṇamadhyasthā jīvite sati bāliśāḥ | ekena vāyunā bhagnā dhigvastanmantritaṃ purā ||34|| athavā yanmayā proktaṃ yūyaṃ bālā ratiklamāḥ || 7 || tattathā nāsti sandeho bālairiva hi vaḥ kṛtam | |35|| tiṣṭhadhvaṃ bālavat sarve rakṣanto jīvitaṃ svakam | ahameko vijeṣyāmi vāyumenaṃ prapaśyata ||36|| tataḥ sa parvato bhūtvā ditiputraḥ pratāpavān | samantād vāyuvegaṃ taṃ samavārayadavyayaḥ ||37|| ...tvānilaṃ jñātvā parvatena nivāritam | andhako bāhupāśena avaplutyābabandha tam ||38|| sa baddho bāhupāśena tadā vāyuḥ pratāpavān | saṃpragṛhyāndhakaṃ śīghramutpapāta vihāyamā ||39|| tasyotpatitamātrasya pragṛhyāndhakadānavam | rāhurgadāṃ mahāraudrāṃ kṣipraṃ mūrdhni nyapātayat | abhyetya pādayoścaiva vipracitirmahābalaḥ ||8.89.40|| jagrāha sumahāgrāho matsyāniva mahārṇave | sa tena suprahāreṇa vihvalaḥ prāṇigocaraḥ ||41|| skandhe keśābhisaṃyukto bhrāmito vipracittinā | sa bhrāmyamāṇo vibabhau srastahārasragambaraḥ |42|| alātamiva sandīptaṃ niśāyāṃ munisattama | bhrāmyamāṇaṃ samālakṣya punardevāḥ savāsavāḥ |43|| vegaścakrurmahāvegā gṛhṇagṛhṇeti vādinaḥ | vipracittistu tān daityaḥ saṃrabdhānudyatāyudhān |44|| ālakṣya subahūn saṃkhye garjamānaḥ payodavat | abhīkṣṇaṃ bhīmasaṃhrādaṃ vāyuṃ dānavayūthapaḥ |45|| cikṣepa śakramuddiśya girau vajraṃ yathaiva saḥ | sa cāpi tena vikṣipto labdhasaṃjño mahābalaḥ |46|| vidhāya vegaṃ devendramupatasthe kṛtāñjaliḥ | tato vāyuśca devāśca sarva eva sahānugāḥ |||47|| abhyadravanta daityendrān pragṛhītavarāyudhāḥ | teṣāṃ teṣāñca saṃgrāmaḥ sughoraḥ samapadyata ||48|| siṃhānāmiva dṛptānāṃ vijane śarabhaiḥ saha | tatra kecidvinihatāḥ suprahāreṇa mūrcchitāḥ |49|| sādhusādhviti bhāṣantaḥ prāṇānūrdhvaṃ vitatyajuḥ | apare danudetyendrā mudā yuktā mahābalāḥ ||8.89.50|| pareṇābhyāhataṃ śūraṃ samarakṣan suputravat | | keciddhatvāpi subahūn devadānavasattamāḥ ||51|| avikṣatāḥ śitaiḥ śastrairātmānaṃ garhayantyuta | aśastraṃ kecidabhyetya devadaityā mahābalāḥ ||52|| dharmayuddhamabhīpsantastyaktvā śastrāṇyayodhayan | bahvastatra daityendrā yuyudhurbhīmavikramāḥ ||53|| devāśca nāhatā ye vai nābhighnanti kadācana | padātayastatra sarve yodhayanti padātibhiḥ ||54|| sādinaḥ sādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ rathino rathibhiḥ saha | gajino gajibhiśceva tathā yuddhamavartata ||55|| evaṃ teṣāṃ hi saṃgrāmo devānāṃ dānavaissaha | āvartata śatānyaṣṭau varṣāṇi sumahābhayaḥ ||56|| atha daityo mahāmāyo gajenāmbudavarccasā | tomaraṃ sumahad bibhradyugāntānalavarccasam ||57|| kokilāñjanameghābho vidruto yo virocanaḥ | sobhyadravattadā devānātisavyānivotthitān (?) |||58|| sa gajena prabhinnena mukhāḍambaraghoṣiṇā | abhidudrāva devendraṃ tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt ||59|| tasyāpatata evātha bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ | jatrudeśe śaraṃ ghoraṃ nicakhāna rarāsa ca ||8.89.60|| anubhūya prahāraṃ taṃ sa daityo bhīmavikramaḥ | tasyāsya tomareṇātha bibheda karamunnatam ||61|| athāsya tomarodbhinnāddhastāddhastāddhemavibhūṣitam|| 62|| papāta taddhanurdivyaṃ mahāśanisamaprabham ||62|| tatosya bhūyo daityendro vyākulasya tadā gajam | tomareṇa bibhedāśu kubhbhadeśe mahābalaḥ ||63|| sa bhinnastena daityena vane matta iva dvipaḥ | anaṃkuśaḥ śanairghṛsvaṃ balaṃ hyanivāritaḥ (?) ||64|| ................| te tathā vadhyamānāstu ādityā daityadānavaiḥ | bhayārditā diśaḥ sarvāḥ palāyante sma sarvaśaḥ ||65|| tataḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśva vādyāni vividhānyapi | ................| sihnādām̐śca saṃcakru rdaityadānavasaṃmatāḥ (?) ||66|| tacchinnabhinnapravidāritāntaraṃ gajena daityaiśca punarviloḍitam | balaṃ mahaddaivatapālitaṃ babhau yathārṇavo mandaramanthavikṣataḥ |||67|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.90> sanatkumāra uvāca taddevasainyaṃ saṃdṛśya daityadānavayūthapaiḥ | vadhyamānaṃ bhṛśaṃ vyāsa vyāghairiva mṛgān vane ||1|| timirārirmahātejāḥ somaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ | tigmavarṣmā suśītārcciḥ svayaṃ pavanasārathiḥ ||2|| tau baddhakavacau samyak śarāsanadharāvubhau | baddhagodhāṃgulitrau ca tathā baddheṣudhī ca tau |3|| sakhaṅgau ca saghaṇṭau ca sapatākau gajāviva | ubhau vīrau mahāvīyau yoddhuṃ daityān vyavasthitau ||4|| somastu daśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ sāyakairmarmabhedibhiḥ | vivyādha hṛdaye daityaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahāsuram ||5|| sa bhinnahṛdayo daityaḥ somena dṛḍhamuddhataḥ | mohaṃ samāviśad vyāsa krauñcaḥ śaktyeva parvataḥ ||6|| taṃ tathābhisamīkṣyaiva rathaṃ yantā sahāsuram | apovāha mahāmāyaṃ dhaneśaṃ nidhayo yathā ||7|| tato hāhākṛtaṃ daityairdaivataiḥ sādhusādhviti | gṛhṇagṛhṇeti daityaiśca mā gṛhṇeti ca daivataiḥ ||8|| tato bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṇavā goviṣāṇakāḥ | avādyanta surāṇāṃ vai harṣarāgapravartanāḥ ||9|| athāndhakaśca tāraśca tārako namucistathā | vipracittiḥ śaṃbaraśca mahāmāyaśca dānavaḥ ||8.90.10|| dhundhuḥ kārtasvanaścaiva rāhuścaiva mahābalaḥ | śataketuḥ śatāvartaḥ pulomā vilvalastathā ||11|| vātāpī kālanemiśca śatāvartaḥ(?) śatodaraḥ | mahāpāśvoṃdaraścaiva musuṇḍaḥ suṇḍha eva ca ||12|| durlomā vakrabandhaśca viromā rodha eva ca | mārīcaśca subāhuśca śvetakuṇḍalireva ca ||13|| vṛṣaparvātikāyaśca śarabhaḥ siṃha eva ca | narāntako devahanastathā yajñahanaśca yaḥ ||14|| daityau sundanisundau ca śakratāpana eva ca | prahlādaścānuhrādaśca śinirbāṣkala eva ca || 15|| virocano balirbāṇo vātāśvaśca mahābalaḥ | mayotha tārakākṣaśca vidyunmālī prabhākaraḥ ||16|| dundubhirmahiṣaścaiva ariṣṭo riṣṭa eva ca | keśī ca dhenukaścaiva ajako vyaṃsa eva ca ||17|| tathā gaganamūrdhā ca asilomā ca dānavaḥ | sūcīlomā tuhuṇḍaśca huṇḍaśca paratāpanaḥ ||18|| hastī duryodhanaścaiva vipākaḥ pāka eva ca | balo murotha narako mūkendradamanāvapi |19|| aśvagrīvaḥ sambaraśca tathānyaḥ kālasaṃvaraḥ | śālvaḥ śatabhujaścaiva drumo vthāghraśca dānavaḥ ||8.90.20|| madhuśca kaiṭabhaścaiva mahāsaṃgara eva ca | chāyāgrahaśca vikhyātaḥ seṃhikeyāśca viśrutāḥ ||21|| hālāhlāśca te sarve baliputrāśca viśrutāḥ | tathā mayasutāḥ sarve nivātakavacāśca ye ||22|| paulomāḥ kālakeyāśca vipracitisutāśca ye | ete cānye ca bahuśo daityadānavasaṃmatāḥ ||23|| sarve candramasaṃ devaṃ prati vegaṃ pracakrire | mahiṣā iva...hastinaḥ śarabhaṃ yathā ||24|| vighnā yataprataṃ yadvat kāmā mokṣāśritaṃ yathā | indriyārthā yathā yogamanarthā duḥkhitaṃ yathā ||25|| nāgā iva garutmantaṃ bhramarā iva pādapam | tathā te dānavāḥ sarve pragṛhītavarāyudhāḥ ||26|| dudruvuḥ śiśiraṃ devaṃ mahājaladanisvanāḥ | teṣāmāpatatāṃ vyāsa timirārirhasanniva ||27|| udyatānyāyudhāni sma śaraiściccheda sarvaśaḥ | tataḥ sa tān punardevaḥ sarvāneva ruṣānvitaḥ ||28|| hṛdayeṣu śaraistīkṣṇairbibheda ca rarāsa ca | tuṣāreṇa ca śītena tārādhipatiravyayaḥ ||29|| ājaghānāsurān sarvān krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | te śaraiśca vinirbhinnāḥ śītena ca bhṛśārditāḥ |||8.90.30 || sthitāstatraiva daityendrāścitrapaṭṭārpitā iva | candropi devaḥ samare maṇḍalīkṛtakārmukaḥ ||31|| bibheda sarvān daityendrān nardamānaḥ payodavat | yaḥ kaściddānavo vāpi daityo vā munisattama |32|| sarve eva śarān tasya dadhire śaśinastadā || yatkiñciccālayatyaṅgaṃ tatra daityaḥ kadācana ||33|| tattat tīkṣṇaiḥ śarairdevo bibheda ca rarāsa ca | bruvato daityayodhasya yatra kvacana saṃyuge ||34|| nicakhāna śarānaṣṭau mukhe tasyāpi candramāḥ | niṣpandāste sthitāḥ sarve mūkavaccāsurottamāḥ | śaranirbhinnasarvāṅgāścitrapaṭṭārpitā iva |35|| yathā sa bhagavān devaścandramā dānavārdanaḥ | tathaiva bhagavān vahnirārdayad dānavān yudhi ||36|| tadrathāśvagajayodhasaṃkulaṃ prakṣaradrudhirabinduvihvalam | sīdate gajakulopamaṃ balaṃ paṃkalagnamiva sarvamulbaṇam ||37|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddha navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.91> sanatkumāra utrāca tasminbale tathā tena somenāpratimaujasā | hanyamāne mahāmāyaḥ samāśvasya tadāsuraḥ ||1|| hiraṇyākṣo diteḥ putra idamāha ruṣānvitaḥ | garutmataḥ sutaṃ vīraṃ rathayantāramāhave ||2|| khageśvara na te lajjā bhavatīha raṇārṇave | yanmāṃ rathena saṃgrāmāt tvaṃ harasyanyatodya vai ||3|| kiṃ vakṣyantyasurāḥ sarve daityāścaiva mahābalāḥ | rājāsmākaṃ jitaḥ saṃkhye śatrubhiḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ||4|| jīvitaiṣī parityajya bālānasmān ḍhurātmavān | raṇādapagataḥ kvāpi dhiṅ māmaśubhakāriṇam ||5|| kaśyapasya suto bhūtvā bhrātā daityasya saṃmataḥ || hiraṇyakaśipordaityo mahāyogabalānvitaḥ || 1 ||6|| agrataḥ sarvadaityānāṃ dānavānāṃ tathaiva ca | rājā svāmī ca śūraśca nirjitaḥ śatrubhiḥ katham ||7|| athavā devapakṣasya tvaṃ putro vai garutmataḥ | tameva pakṣaṃ bhajase na māṃ tvaṃ parirakṣase |8| nāhaṃ tava na śaktodya śiraḥ kāyāt sakuṇḍalam | khaṅgenānena tīkṣṇena chettuṃ khagakulādhama ||9|| mitraṃ tvaṃ mama mandasya purā bālasakheti ca | | ataḥ kṛtvābhirakṣāmi gaccha muktosi doṣavān ||8.91.10|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rathayantā khageśvaraḥ | | uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahāsuram ||11|| mā krudho dānavaśreṣṭha nāsmi daitya tavāhitaḥ | tadopavāhitaḥ kṣipraṃ raṇād rakṣārthameva hi ||12|| sūtāḥ śāstravidaścaiva bruvate dānaveśvara | dampatī rathiyantārau parasparamanuvratau ||13|| rathinā śastraghātebhyo rakṣyo yantā yathā priyā | tena caiva ratho rakṣyo yathā bharttā jayāvahaḥ ||14| | sa bhavān ripuṇā bhinno hyavabaddhaśca saṃyuge | aśaktaḥ syāditītyevaṃ mayā kṣipramapohitaḥ ||15|| āāśvasya balamādhāya punaryuddhena daṃśitaḥ | ripūñjeṣyasi saṃgrāme tvevaṃ tvamapavāhitaḥ ||16|| ye hi kālepayānti sma kāle cāyānti daṃśitāḥ | teṣānnāsulabho daitya jayo yuddhe mahātmanām ||17|| na cāhamahitaḥ satyaṃ hitakṛt tava nityadā | mā śaṅkāṃ kuru daityendra śape satyena sarvataḥ ||18|| na cāpyaviditaṃ tedya kṛto yat śapathaḥ purā | tathaivāmṛtapaścāhaṃ na mṛtyurmama vidyate ||19|| ahaṃ garutmataḥ putro devān hitvāsurān śritaḥ | tavaiva daitya snehena mā śaṅkāṃ tvaṃ kṛthā mayi ||8.91.20|| etadbalaṃ candramasā vahninā copapīḍitam | trāhi kṣipraṃ mahābāho na śokaṃ kartumarhasi ||21|| māyāmatha samāsthāya dhanuṣā vā balena vā | jahi śatrūnmahārāja mā ruṣantu diteḥ sutāḥ ||22|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa taṃ pariṣvajya pakṣirājaṃ mahāsuraḥ | abhidudrāva vegena rathenāmbudanādinā |23|| tasyāpatata evātha savahniścandramāstathā | śarairāśīviṣākārairdhvajaṃ cicchidaturyudhi ||24|| tato lalāṭe viddhvainaṃ tau devau śaśipāvakau | yugāntāmbudavad vyāsa nādamuccaiḥ pracakratuḥ ||25|| tayostallāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | āgneyenāstramukhyena śiśiraṃ tad vyaśātayat ||26|| tuṣāravarṣaṇaṃ dagdhvā tatosau māyayā punaḥ | saṃmohayitvā vegena rāhurbhūtvābhidudruve ||27|| sa rāhuṇā tadā tena grasyamānaḥ khageśvaraḥ | raṇaṃ tyaktvānyato yātastato detyo nanāda ha ||28|| dānavā hyapi te sarve naṣṭe tasmin himāśaye | samāśvasya punaścakruryuddhaṃ suragaṇaiḥ saha | tembudāśanisannādāḥ samudrasamanāditāḥ |29|| daityadānavamahārathāḥ pravarasādina āśvasantaḥ | ..taneva yuddhakāṃkṣiṇo daṃṣṭriṇa iva mahāgajā vanasamāśritāḥ ||8.91.30|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddha ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.92> sanatkumāra uvāca nakṣatrādhipatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān havyavāhanaḥ | vidrutaṃ dānavabhayāt padātiryoddhumudyataḥ ||1|| sa śarairdānavarathaṃ sasūtaṃ sahavājinam | sadhvajaṃ sapatākañca bhasmasāyujyamānayat ||2|| tatosya kārmukaṃ divyaṃ śareṇānataparvaṇā | vijyaṃ cakāra saṃkruddhastiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt ||3|| athāndhakaśca rāhuśca prahlādo maya eva ca | anye ca dānavaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛśānuṃ paryavārayan ||4|| sovaplutya tadā teṣāṃ dhanūṃṣi ca ca rathām̐stathā | dhvajāni ca vicitrāṇi dadāha ca rarāsa ca |||5|| kavacāni vicitrāṇi śirāṃsi ca vasūttamaḥ | dadāha vikṛtākāro nādayan sarvatodiśaḥ ||6|| hāheti nadatāṃ tatra bhagavān hyavyavāhanaḥ | jihvā dahn babhau vyāsa guhāyāṃ dīpavat sthitaḥ ||7|| keṣāñcit pradahat tāni dānavānāṃ mukhāni saḥ | paṅkajānīva phullāni timirārirmahāprabhaḥ ||8|| keṣāñcittu gajendrāṇāṃ karān kāñcanabhūṣitān | dadāha bhagavān vahnirdāvāgnirbhujagāniva ||9|| śarān śarāśanāñcaiva tathā khaṅgaparicchadān | dadāha bhagavān vahnirhastyaśvamapi sarvaśaḥ ||8.92.10|| te hanyamānā daityendrā viśastrā duḥkhitā bhṛśam | bhramanti vitanutrāśca tatra tatraiva … ||11|| teṣāṃ vahnipradīptānāṃ dahyatāṃ suravidviṣām | hiraṇyākṣaḥ svayaṃ rājā parjanyaḥ samapadyata ||12|| sa meghabhūto daityendrastamagniṃ vṛṣṭibhistadā | praśāmayata vegena saṃvarttaka ivāmbudaḥ ||13|| taṃ praśāntaṃ tadālakṣya vidhuraṃ hṛvyavāhnam | vipracittiḥ śaraistīkṣṇairlalāṭe samavākirat ||14|| tatosya nadato bhūyo mayo dānavasattamaḥ | mukhe śarān mahāghorānnicakhāna mahāsuraḥ ||15|| tasya tena tadā vyāsa mukhe bhinnasya dāruṇaḥ | uttasthau vāyuvad dhūmaḥ śarīrādañjanopamaḥ ||16|| tena dhūmena khañcaiva divaṃ bhūścaiva sarvaśaḥ | pūritā mahatā vyāsa na prājñāyata kiṃcana ||17|| tena śabdena saṃjñābhirnāmaviśrāvaṇairapi | karasparśaistadā nyonyamanayadyamasādanam ||18|| na devo jñāyate tatra na daityo dānavopi vā | ajānantastatastatra saṃsthāmetāṃ pracakrire | | 19 | | āṭiṃ daityāḥ prakurvanta baka ityeva devatāḥ | bakaṃ vadanti ye tatra daityāstān vyahnam̐stadā ||8.92.20|| āāṭiṃ bruvāṇaśca surā ityevaṃ tad vyavartata | evaṃbhūtamabhūdyuddhaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrakam || 7 || mahadbhayaṃ vai daityānāmandhakāre suraissaha ||21|| tadandhakāre sumahābhayaṃkaraṃ tadābhavadyuddhamatīva dāruṇam | jagadvināśāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇāṃ surāsurāṇāṃ rudhiraughanisravam ||22|| iti skandapurāṇe yuddhe dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.93> sanatkumāra uvāca athāsau tena kālena keturagneḥ samutthitaḥ | vāyunābhihataścaiva agacchad vilayaṃ bhṛśam ||1 || tataḥ samabhavad vyoma vimalaṃ sarvameva hi | apaśyanta surāssarve daityāścaiva parasparam ||2 || tataḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahāḍambarāstathā | sughoṣakā ḍiṇḍimāśca bhagnā bheryaśca sarvaśaḥ ||3|| baladvayepyavādyanta śataśotha sahasraśaḥ | atha śakraśca devendro yamo vaiśravaṇastathā ||4|| pūṣā bhagaśca dvāvetau aryamā mitra eva ca | jayanto marutaścaiva rudrādityāśca sarvaśaḥ ||5 || vegena sumahāvegā mamṛdurdānavaṃ balam | tatra cāmīkarābhāsaṃ pragṛhya balavaddhanuḥ ||6|| yamo daṇḍena daityendrānanayadyamasādanam | sa pañcabhiḥ śarairviddhvā hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam ||7|| aśvām̐ścaikaikaśaḥ sarvān jahāsa ca nanāda ca | tasya sarve tadāyastā daityadānavasattamāḥ | |8|| śarānāśīviṣākārān vyasṛjan vikṛtāśanān | tān sa ciccheda samare tridhaikaikaṃ laghukriyaḥ ||9 || punaśca viśikhairghorairardayat prahasanniva | tatondhakasya yantāraṃ rathañca sahavājibhiḥ | |8.93.1 0|| kiṃkareṇa mahāvīryo yamo ninye svakaṃ puram | tatondhako gadāpāṇiryugāntāmbudavannadan ||1 1 || abhyadhāvadyamaṃ tūrṇama tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt | tasya vajreṇa devendro gadāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām ||1 2|| bibheda śatadhā vyāsa sāpatad bhuvyavasthitā | taṃ viśastraṃ vikavacaṃ kṛtvā te devasattamāḥ ||1 3 || yugapacchastravarṣeṇa tāḍayāmāsurāhave | yamo daṇḍena taṃ mūrdhni śakro vajreṇa cāhanat ||14|| vittadośaninā caiva pāśena varuṇastathā | anye cānyaistathā devā hyamoghairāyudhottamaiḥ ||1 5|| abhyadhāvannasaṃrabdhā hatastvamiti vādinaḥ | na caiva tasya daityasya duḥkhaṃ tatrābhavattadā || 16| | sopi daityastatotpatya puṇḍasyāsthāya pṛṣṭhataḥ | yamaṃ muṣṭiprahāreṇa puṇḍād bhūmāvapātayat || 17|| tathendrasya gajaṃ bhūyo pucche saṃgṛhya vegavān | bhrāmayitvākṣipad dūre naṣṭastvamiti cābravīt ||18|| tato dhaneśasya punaḥ śivikāṃ kāmagāminīm | ākṣipya bahudhā daityo vyadhamat krodhamūrchitaḥ | |1 9|| tato gajairgajān nighnat padātīm̐śca padātibhiḥ | rathaṃ rathena ca raṇe hayām̐śca hayasādibhiḥ | |8.93.20 || punargaje mahendrasya hanyamānopi saṃyuge | samutplutya tadā śakraṃ gajaskandhānnyapātayat ||21 || tasya tat karma saṃvīkṣya dānavendrasya saṃyuge | sarve devā diśaḥ sarvāḥ pranaṣṭā jīvitārthinaḥ ||22 || pūrveṇa bhagavānindraḥ sahādityaḥ salokapaḥ | dakṣiṇena tathā rudrā vasavaścāśvināvapi ||23 || pratīcīṃ yakṣarakṣāṃsi piśācāḥ pannagaiḥ saha | uttareṇa tathānye ca prapadyanta yathā mṛgāḥ ||24|| teṣu bhagneṣu daityendrāḥ pṛṣṭhato vikṛtāyudhāḥ | abhyadhāvanta garjanto bhayaṃ teṣāṃ vyadarśayan ||25| | tato muhūrttaṃ te gatvā hiraṇyākṣeṇa vāritāḥ | nivṛttāḥ samatiṣṭhanta sarvemarṣavaśaṃ gatāḥ | | 26|| athovāca tataḥ kruddhān hiraṇyākṣo hasanniva | daityadānavanāthām̐stānidaṃ vacanakovidaḥ ||27|| kimebhirabalairadya yuṣmākaṃ daityadānavāḥ | avabaddhaiśca ruddhaiśca mṛtasaṃjñairdurātmabhiḥ ||28 || hatāste nātra sandeho yeṣāṃ rājyamidaṃ dhṛtam | naiṣāṃ jīvitamadyāsti mā tvaradhvaṃ subāliśāḥ ||29 | abalānapi saṃrabdhānnirāśān jīvitaiṣiṇaḥ | avaddhyeti balāccaiva durjayāśca na saṃśayaḥ(?) ||8.93.3 0 || saṅgamokṣannidānīñca la.....sava (?) | ........ityuvāca sadośanāḥ (?) ||3 1|| yadetadrājyamityāhuḥ prāṇā hyete mahātmanāma | sa teṣāṃ harati prāṇān yasteṣāṃ rājyamāharet ||32|| teṣāmadya hṛ.......tasamaiḥ suraiḥ | āpūrayāma sthānāni devānāṃ dānaveśvarāḥ ||33 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste sahiraṇyākṣāḥ prāviśannamarāvatīm | ratnāni jagṛhurvyāsa vijayaṃ cāvaghoṣayan | |34| | ārakṣamāmanustatra cakṣurāptaiśca tesurāḥ | āśvāsayanta paurāṃśca tathā prakṛtayaśca ha ||3 5|| ..miti tathārgheṇa tathaivopāyanairvaraiḥ | āśīrbhiścāsuraśreṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ praṇemire | |36| | tān samāśvāsya daityendro hyadhyasya ca varāsanam | kāryāṇi kṛtvā sarveṣāmagacchad varuṇālayam ||37|| te siṃhanādairvividhaiśca vādyaiḥ pravalganāsphoṭitakūjitaiśca | mahāsurā dānavarājasiṃhaṃ jagmussamantāt parivārya sarve ||38| | iti skandapurāṇe varuṇālayagamane triṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.94> sanatkumāra uvāca tamāpatantaṃ vegena garutmantamivāhave | dṛṣṭavā varuṇaputrāste pitrā saha vidudruvuḥ || 1 | | daityāścāpi hi te sarve prāpya tadvaruṇālayam | vyūḍhaskandhā vyatiṣṭhanta vyasṛjaṃstatpuraṃ prati ||2| | dūtaṃ vātāpinaṃ caiva rājñā preṣitamūrjitam | sa gatvā tāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ praviśya ca mahāsuraḥ || 3 | | pauraiḥ supūjito vyāsa prāhedaṃ tān sugarvitaḥ | rājā sarvasya lokasya daityadānavanandanaḥ ||4| | kaśyapasya sutaḥ śrīmān hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | jitvā sarvān surān saṃkhye ājñāpayati vassadā ||5| | yūyaṃ śṛṇuta sarve me ājñāṃ kuruta caiva hi | ānayadhvaṃ ca ratnāni parityajata devatāḥ | |6| | devapakṣotra yaḥ kaścit pure prativasatyuta | abhayaṃ tasya yacchāmi yātu devānabhītavat | |7| | nāradādyāśca ṛṣayastaṃ samāsādya daityakam | ūcustamasuraṃ vyāsa sāntvayuktamidaṃ tadā | |8| | rājā bhojo virāṭ samrāṭ bhūpatiḥ kṣatriyo nṛpaḥ | ya ebhiḥ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastannārccayate budhaḥ ||9|| sa tvaṃ rājā ca bhojaśca virāṭ samrāṭ tathaiva ca | bhūpatiḥ kṣatriyaścaiva nṛpaḥ sarvasahastathā ||8.94.1 0|| nirjitāḥ sumahāvīryāstvayā devāḥ savāsavāḥ | kastvayā sadṛśo loke bāhyaikaṃ rudramīśvaram ||11 || tvaṃ pātā sarvalokānāṃ harttā sraṣṭā tathaiva ca | kastavājñāṃ mahārāja pratihanyād durātmavān ||12|| vayaṃ ca sarve daityendra varamicchāma dānava | varadastvaṃ hi bhūtānāmasmākaṃ varado bhava ||13|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā varadosmīti sobravīt | ūcuste daityarājānaṃ tadā vacanakovidāḥ ||14| | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ yadetaduktaṃ bhavatā narakavyādhimṛtyuṣu | na tathā tad bhaved daitya eṣa no dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||15|| daitya uvāca mama pratijñā viprendrāḥ pūrvameva tapodhanāḥ | lokānāṃ sukhamedheyaṃ rājā lokasya yadyaham ||16|| na tathā tat kariṣyāmi yadyahaṃ munisattamāḥ | mithyāpratijñaḥ syāṃ cāhamasatyaśca durātmavān | |17|| tasmādanyad bhavanto māṃ vara yācantu supriyam | kartāsmi taṃ tathā sarvaṃ yācehaṃ śirasā ha vaḥ | |1 8| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te | hiraṇyākṣamidaṃ vyāsa punarevābruvan vibhum ||19|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ lokadharmapravṛttyarthaṃ brahmaṇā daityapuṃgava | kṛtametat purā sarvaṃ dharmaścāpi pravartitaḥ ||8.94.20|| samīkṣya caitallokasya dharmaścāpi pravarttitaḥ | nābhūtastad bhaved daitya iti no varado bhava ||21|| pratijñā prabhavet sā yallokānāṃ duḥkhavarjanam | tacca tasmānna naśyeta brahmaṇaḥ kṛtiravyayā ||22|| yāvattvaṃ daitya lokasya rājā hyasi prabhuśca ha | evaṃ tvayānṛṇatvaṃ ca brahmaṇodya kṛtaṃ bhavet ||23|| teṣāṃ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣīn niścitya daityarāṭ | ye drohāḥśakrapakṣāśca mamājñābhaṅgakāriṇaḥ | 24|| teṣāmeva bhavenmṛtyurnarakeṣu ca yātanāḥ | etadāha tadā rājā te cāpyūcurnarādhipam | |25|| evamastviti tāṃścoktvā yātanāmokṣamādiśat | sa muktvā nārakān sarvān dadau sthānasya rakṣaṇam ||26|| pitṛrājānamanagha vipracittiṃ mahābalam | tatovaghuṣya sa jayaṃ pūjayitvā tu tāndvijān | jagāma dhanadāvāsaṃ hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ ||27|| te tāṃ dhaneśasya purīṃ mahābalā vinādayaṃtoṃndhakapālitāstadā | hiraṇyanetraṃ parivārya dānavāstadābhijagmurjaladā ivācalam ||28|| iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣadigvijaye yamalokābhigamano nāma caturṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.95> sanatkumāra uvāca tathā laṅkāṃ samāsādya dhaneśasya purīṃ śubhām | adūre tasthuruddhūtāḥ sannaddhakavacāyudhāḥ ||1|| avasthitām̐stathā dṛṣṭvā dānavān baladarpitān | laṅkānivāsinaḥ sarve nidhipālāstathaiva ca ||2|| nidhayaḥ śaṃkhapadmādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | arghaṃ ratnāni cādāya dānavāya nyavedayan ||3|| ūcuśca tava daityendra vayaṃ vaśyā na saṃśayaḥ | kiṅkarāśca praśādhyasmān yathāvaddānaveśvara ||4|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca mā bhīrbhavatu vo yakṣā mama yūyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | ayaṃ rājā hi vaḥ śreṣṭho hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ ||5|| prahlādo devasaṃghānāṃ sarveṣāṃ viprabādhanaḥ | tatastaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya dhaneśaṃ daityapuṅgavam || 6|| anyeṣāṃ devasaṃghānāṃ sthānānyāpūrayatpunaḥ | saṃsthāpya sarvasthāneṣu sthānino dānaveśvarān ||7|| andhakantvamarāvatyāmindratvenābhyaṣecayat | bhūrllokañcākhilaṃ daityaḥ svayamevānvaśāsata ||8|| bhūyaśca dhanurādāya saśaraṃ sūryasannibhaḥ | daityendro medinīṃ prāha mamātmānaṃ vidarśaya ||9|| sā bhītā tasya daityasya vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ | jayetyuktvāgratastasthau viṣṇorlakṣmīrivāparā ||8.95.1 0 || tāṃ mṛgīmiva śārdūlo bhujaṅgīmiva pakṣirāṭ | śārdūlīṃ siṃha iva ca siṃhīṃ śarabharāḍiva ||11 || haṃsīṃ kāka iva kṣudro mayūrī madgurāḍiva | tathā tāṃ sa diteḥ putro jagrāha ruṣitānanaḥ | uvāca caiva saṃrabdhastāṃ devīṃ bhayavihvalām | | 1 2|| tavāhaṃ vasudhe bharttā brahmaṇā prakṛtaḥ śubhe | mānyaṃ patiṃ tvamicchethā rakṣiṣyehaṃ tato hi te | |1 3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tato rasātalaṃ gatvā svapurasya samīpataḥ | babaddha nāgapāśaistāṃ duṣṭāmiva yathāṅganām ||14|| tatocalena daityendraḥ śaṃkhena sumahābalaḥ | ārttāṃ rurodha duṣṭaśca kandarāmiva vīryavān ||15|| tatosyā rakṣaṇe nityamudyuktān rakṣiṇo dadhau| kiṅkarānnāma daityendrān sahasrāṇi caturdaśa || 16 || sa tathā tadvidhāyaiva daityendrastuṣṭimān babhau | kṛṣībala iva kṣetraṃ suniṣpannaṃ samīkṣya ca | | 17|| kṛtakṛtyohamityeva buddhiṃ cakre sa pārthivaḥ | saṃyujya svasutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ dāraiḥ sādhurivātmavān | |18| | antaraṃ na ca tasyānyaḥ kaścitprāpnoti suvrata | svasahāyasya viprasya yathā dambhena vartataḥ | |19| | yajadhvaṃ dānavāssarve viprānpūjayateti ca | devañca śūlinaṃ sarve namasyata punaḥ punaḥ ||8.95.20 || dharmameva niṣevadhvamiti sojñāpayattadā | na tasyā dhārmikaḥ kaścid daityo vā dānavopi vā ||21|| rājyebhavad durācārastasmin rājyaṃ praśāsati | svayameva sa vāyuśca candraśāḥ sūrya eva ca | | 22 | | abhavad vyāsa lokeṣu tapobalasamanvitaḥ | oṣadhyaḥ svavamudbhūtāstasmin rājani śāsati | | 23 | | vinā kṛṣṭiṃ saṃ bhavanti sarvalokasya sādhikāḥ | sa eva tāssamādāya kṣaraṃ nayati daityarāṭ | | 24| | sa evāmardayaccāpi nināya ca punargṛhān| sa eva daṇḍikobhūcca daṇḍaścaiva sa eva hi | | 25 | | sa eva yogāt sarvatra caurād rakṣati nityadā | na tasya vyādhitaḥ kaścinmriyate vāpi kaścana | | 26 | | paradāraprasakto vā piśuno vāpi karhici tu | hiṃsakā na ca tasyāsanna cāpyadhārmikāḥ kvacit | | 27| | palvalāni taḍāgāni saritprasravaṇāni ca | vinā vṛṣṭyā bhavantyete sarvatraiva ca susthitam | | 28 | | na santi tasya rakṣāṃsi na piśācāśca hiṃsriṇaḥ | ītayaśca na santyasya na dvandvāni ca kānicit | | 29 | | na juhvate tadā vahniṃ viprāstasmim̐stu rājani | nādhīyate yajante vā ekavarṇamabhūttadā | | 8.95.30 | | bhṛgavo yebhavan viprā dānavānāṃ mudāvahāḥ | adhīyate yajante ca evaṃ ta vyāsa sarvaśaḥ | | 31 | | hṛṣṭapuṣṭamabhūt sarvaṃ vyādhiduḥkhavivarjitam | varṇāśrama parityaktaṃ sarvalokasamaṃ jagat | | 32 | | tannṛtyagītotsavanityayuktaṃ sukhaprasuptaṃ ratikāryayuktam | jagad babhau rājani daityadeve hiraṇyanetre ditinandaneti ||33 || iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣarājyavarṇano nāma pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.96> vyāsa uvāca tathā rājani daityendre trailokyādhipatau śubhe | dhayayāñcaiva baddhāyāṃ sukhitāsu prajāsu ca ||1|| sthānebhyaścyāvitā devā hyapratiṣṭhā mahābalāḥ | kimakurvata duḥkhārttā etanme śaṃsa sarvaśaḥ ||2|| sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇuṣva dharma (?) devānāmavasthā yā babhūva ha | yadakurvata duḥkhārttāstatra sarve yathākramam ||3|| havyavāhognirabhavaddevānāṃ bhāgavarddhanaḥ | taṃ nirasya tadā daityo vahnimanyaṃ cakāra ha ||4|| tasminkarmaṇi viprendra mantrāstadanugābhavan | daityadānavabhāgānāṃ vaktāraḥ śubhasādhakāḥ | |5|| tato yajñaḥ svayaṃ daityānupatasthe mahātmanaḥ | yajñe gate ca daityendrāndevāḥ sarve mṛtā iva ||6|| abhavannaṣṭasaṃjñāśca mandavīryaparākramāḥ | niḥśrīkāśca nirudyogā nirākrandā samutsukāḥ ||7|| mantradagdhā yathā sarpā vajrapiṣṭā yathācalāḥ | garutmatābhisandaṣṭāḥ pannagā iva nirviṣāḥ ||8|| vihīnādbhiryathā vṛkṣā bāndhavairvāpi yoṣitaḥ | tathā te daivatā vyāsa hṛtarājyā hṛtaśriyaḥ | |9| | cintayanti hṛdā caiva śuṣyanti vilapanti ca | atha devaḥ svayambhūstān jñātvā devām̐stathāvidhān | | 8.96.10 | | vimānenārkavarṇena provācedaṃ pitāmahaḥ | bho devā naṣṭasaṃjñā stha kimarthaṃ duḥkhitā bhṛśam | tapoyogabalaṃ vodya dadāmi surapuṅgavāḥ ||11 || yūyaṃ lokasya kartāro hartāraścaiva sarvaśaḥ | na yuktaṃ bhavatāmetat klībavat sthātumadya vai | |12| | svīyaṃ yogaṃ madīyañca tyaktvā duḥkhaṃ mahābalāḥ | pratipadyata mā śoke svayaṃ devāḥ pravartata ||13 || na tamo bhāskarādyuktaṃ na somāduṣṇatā yathā | nāgneryathā tuṣāraśca nāmṛtaṃ bhujagādapi ||14| | nāsādhoḥ sādhubhāvaśca na kulīnādaśobhanam | nādharmo niyamebhyaśca na vedebhyaśca durmatiḥ || 1 5|| tathā na yuktaṃ yuṣmākamidaṃ devā mahātmanām | āpatsu na viṣīdanti ye kecittejasā sthitāḥ | |16|| te yūyamāpadaṃ prāpya na śokaṃ kartumarhatha | mā bhavantovasīdantu rājyaṃ bhūyo bhaviṣyati || 17|| mahāyogabalopeto hiraṇyākṣodya devatāḥ | aśakyo hantumalpena tejasā ditinandanaḥ | |18|| pratīkṣantu bhavantosya tapasaḥ kṣayamavyayāḥ | kṣīṇe tapasi daityendraṃ yuddhe viṣṇurvadhiṣyati ||1 9| | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evaṃ brahmaṇā proktā labdhayogāḥ sureśvarāḥ | praṇamya sarvabhūtānāṃ sraṣṭāramidamabruvan | |8.96.20 | | hṛtāni no mahāyogasthānāni ditinandanaiḥ | kva tiṣṭhāma vayaṃ brūhi diśa naḥ sthānamavyayam ||21 || brahmovāca hṛtāni sarvasthānāni yuṣmākaṃ viditañca me | śṛṇudhvaṃ yatra vastavyaṃ yuṣmābhiryogamāyayā ||22|| yūyaṃ sarve śarīreṣu yogād viśata sattamāḥ | prajānāṃ sarvato devāstato vṛttimavāpsyatha ||23|| teṣāmaśitapītaiśca saṃskāraiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ | pṛthivī nāgabaddhāpi yuṣmānāpyāyayiṣyati ||24|| sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā devena devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | tathā cakruryathovāca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||25|| tevartayanta satataṃ tatrasthāḥ surasattamāḥ | caturyugamupāsanto lokadhāturmate sthitāḥ | |26|| atha yogād hiraṇyākṣaḥ prajāsu samavāsthitān | surānapaśyadyogātmā cukrodha ca sa tānprati ||27|| yasminyasminnapaśyacca suraṃ sa samavasthitam | avadhīttaṃ tamabhyetya tadā dānavasattamaḥ || 28|| ahaṃ prajāḥ sadodyukto rakṣāmi satataṃ bhayāt | mamaiva tā durācārā vidviṣo vardhayantyuta || 29 || kṛtaghnāḥ svāmighātinyo duṣpūrā duṣṭacetasaḥ | mama śatrūnimā duṣṭānannapānādibhissadā | | 8.96.30 | | āpyāyayanti durvṛttā daṇḍārhā me tatastu tāḥ | ……..........| yatra tatra gatāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sarvatra sovadhīt | | 31 || palvalāni taḍāgāni nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca | sarvāṇyeva tadā yogādaśoṣayata dānavaḥ | | 32 || oṣadhyokṛṣṭapacyāśca yā hyāsam̐stasya suvrata | vyanāśayat sa tāścāpi vṛkṣavallīrapothayat | |3 3 || tannaṣṭavṛkṣakṣupavallipallavaṃ tṛṇauṣadhīprasravaṇodakāśayam | sarittaḍāgāvaṭaśuṣkapalvalaṃ jagad babhau kacchapapṛṣṭhasannibham praṇaṣṭavarṇāśramadharmasaṃyamaṃ vinaṣṭaghoṣavrajapakṣimānuṣam | dvipāśvapatyādigaṇairvināditaṃ yugāntakālāgnimudagravajjagat iti skandapurāṇe brahmaṇo vākyaṃ nāma ṣaṇnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.97> sanatkumāra uvāca tathābhūtaṃ jagad dṛṣṭvā devāste duḥkhapīḍitāḥ | vairājaṃ lokamāsādya bhūyopaśyan pitāmaham | | 1 || te sarve samupāgamya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ | ūcuste karma daityasya sarvameva suduḥkhitāḥ ||2| | nivedya ca punardevamūcuste lokakāraṇam | bhagavan hṛtarājyāśca durbalāśca tathā vibho | |3 | | asamarthā vayaṃ tasya sthātuṃ daityasya saṃyuge | na ca sthānaṃ prapaśyāmo yatra tiṣṭhāma vijvarāḥ | |4|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhītānāṃ tridivaukasām | uvāca bhagavān brahmā sarvāneva divaukasaḥ ||5| | na bhetavyaṃ surāstasya yoginaḥ sumahātmanaḥ | samāptaṃ tapasaḥ sarvaṃ phalaṃ daityasya tasya tat ||6| | kālastasyābhisaṃprāpto jīvitāntakaraḥ surāḥ | tasmāt sarve mayā sārdhaṃ yāta viṣṇuṃ prayācata ||7|| bhavanto nirbalā hyadya aśaktāstasya bādhane | viṣṇuḥ śaktaḥ sa taṃ daityaṃ jīvitāccyāvayiṣyati ||8|| pūrvaṃ hi jāte tasmim̐stu vāguvācāśarīriṇī | nāyaṃ vadhyo manuṣyasya na devasya kathañcana ||9|| nāpi tiryakṣu jātasya na bhūmau na ca tejasi | nākāśe nāpi lokeṣu mahātmāyaṃ bhaviṣyati | |8.97.1 0 || sa eṣa devā daityeśo mahātmā dhārmikastadā | avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vadhyo duḥkhād bhaviṣyati || 11 || vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya na daivaṃ nāpi mānuṣam | na ca tiryakṣu tajjātaṃ naravārāhamasti vai | | 12 | | pātāle ca praviśyaiva nāsau bhūrnāpi khaṃ hi tat | na tejo nāpi lokosau sarvato muktameva tat || 13 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste hṛṣitāḥ sarve praṇamya ca pitāmaham | ūcurgacchāma deveśa kālotikramate hi naḥ | |14|| tataste sarva evaitya śvetaṃ parvatasattamam | viṣṇuṃ sahiṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuñca dānavāyutamardanam | |1 5|| astuvan vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ praṇamya bahumānataḥ | namaḥ sarvaripughnāya dānavāntakarāya ca ||1 6| | namo jitāya devāya vaikuṇṭhāya mahātmane | namo nirdhūtarajame namaḥ satyāya caiva hi ||17|| namaḥ sādhyāya devāya namo dhāmne suvedhase | namo yamāya devāya jayāya ca namo namaḥ | | 18 | | namaścāditiputrāya naranārāyaṇāya ca | namassumataye caiva namaścaivāstu viṣṇave | |1 9|| namo vāmanarūpāya kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāya ca | namo rāmāya rāmāya dattātreyāya vai namaḥ | |8.97.2 0 || namaste narasiṃhāya dhātre caiva namo namaḥ | namaḥ sādhyāya vedāya cakriṇe vai namo namaḥ | |21 || namaḥ śakunihantre ca namo dāmodarāya ca | salile tapyamānāya nāgaśayyāpriyāya ca | | 22 | | namaḥ kapilarūpāya mahate puruṣāya ca | namo jīmūtarūpāya mahādevapriyāya ca | |2 3 | | namo rudrārdharūpāya tathomārūpiṇe namaḥ | cakramudgarahastāya maheśvaragaṇāya ca | |24| | śipiviṣṭāya ca sadā namaḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe | dhundhumārāya śūrāya madhukaiṭabhaghātine ||25| | caturbhujāya kṛṣṇāya ratnakaustubhadhāriṇe | trivikramaviyatsthāya pītavāsaḥ suvāsase | |26|| namaḥ puruṣaghātāya gadākhaḍgogradhāriṇe | yogine yajamānāya bhṛgupatnīpramāthine | |27|| vṛṣarūpāya satatamādityānāṃ varāya ca | cekitānāya dāntāya śauriṇe vṛṣṇibandhave ||28|| murāśvagrīvanāśāya tathaivāsurasūdine | namaste śārṅga dhanuṣe saubhaśālvavighātine ||29|| namaste padmanābhāya brahmadehapraveśine | namo jayāya śarvāya rudradattavarāya ca ||8.97.3 0|| namaḥ sarveśvarāyaiva naṣṭadharmapravartine | puruṣāya vareṇyāya namaste śatabāhave ||3 1| | tava prasādāt kṛcchraṃ vai tarāma puruṣottama | hṛtarājyā vayaṃ sarve na tvaṃ vetsi mahābhuja | hiraṇyākṣeṇa vaikuṇṭha taṃ nāśaya mahābhuja | |3 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca ya idaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ stotraṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | kīrtayetsatataṃ martyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||33|| mṛtaśca sarvalokeṣu varṣakoṭicaturdaśa | pūjitaḥ sarvadevaiśca modate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||34|| kīrtayatyeva ya imaṃ prāṇibhyo vipramucyate | sa mṛtyulokamaprāpya carate duḥkhavarjitaḥ ||35| | sanatkumāra uvāca .........| uvāca suraśārdūlānidaṃ saṃpūjayansadā | | 36 | | itaḥ sa daityo durbuddhirdevān dveṣṭi sahāyavān | kriyatāṃ martyarūpaṃ me vārāhaṃ māṃ vidhāryatām | | 37 | | mahātmā sa ca daityendro balavān dhārmikaśca ha | na ca śakyo mayaikena hantuṃ satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ | | 38 | | sarvadevamayaṃ rūpaṃ vārāhaṃ nandivardhanam | tatsamāsthāya hantāsmi daityendraṃ taṃ mahābalam | |3 9| | tena rūpeṇa sarveṣāmasmākaṃ devasattamāḥ | brahmā brahmatvamāpannaḥ prasthātā yama ityapi | |8.97.40 | | udgātā tatra varuṇo hiraṇyākṣastataḥ paśuḥ | śamitāhaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yaśastasya mahābalaḥ | |41 | | adya
