||45| | iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣavadhopāyo nāma saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.98> sanatkumāra uvāca atha te suraśārdūlāstasya rūpaṃ pracakrire | .........| saptalokamayaṃ tasya śarīraṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ||1 || asthīni parvatāḥ sarve nadyo nāḍyaśca tasya tu | rudhiraṃ cābdhayaḥ sapta kaphapittānilā guṇāḥ ||2|| purīṣaṃ cāpyoṣadhayo dharmo retaḥ kṛtosya tu | mūtraṃ tasyābhavanmeghā vāyavaḥ sapta koṣṭhagāḥ || 3 || śirastasyābhavan sādhyā rudro mūrdhānamāsthitaḥ (?) | lalāṭe tasya dharmobhūt nāsikā vāyurātmavān ||4|| sūryācandramasau netre śrotre tasya diśobhavan | bhruvostasyābhavan prāṇā ahorātraṃ ca pakṣmaṇī | |5|| āsyaṃ tasyāgnirabhavat vaḍavā mukhasaṃsthitā | oṣṭhebhūdantarikṣaṃ ca dantāśca bhujagābhavan ||6| | catvāryastrāṇi daṃṣṭrāśca kṛtāni sumahānti vai | astraṃ pāśupataṃ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ cakrameva ca | |7|| brahmadaṇḍaṃ tṛtīyañca caturthaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śiraḥ | grīvā tasyābhavatsomo rudraḥ skandhe ca saṃsthitaḥ ||8|| gaṇḍe cāpi tathādityā hastau rudraiśca nirmitau | aṃgulyastasya kīrtiśca lakṣmīḥ siddhistathaiva ca | |9|| ....pravṛttiśca nakhāścāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ | yamadaṇḍaḥ kāladaṇḍo mṛtyudaṇḍastathaiva ca | |8.98.1 0 || rudradaṇḍaśca catvāro bāhupādāḥ kṛtāḥ prabhoḥ | sādhyā devo urastasya hṛdayaṃ soma ityapi || 11 | | udaraṃ tasya bhūtāni mahānti ṛṣisattama | nābhistasyābhavanmātā aditirbrahmasattama ||12|| śiśnaṃ prajāpatistasya mitropānebhavat sthitaḥ | vasavastasya pārśveṣu tathā dharmaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||13 || mṛtyuḥ kālo yamaścaiva hastapādatalāśritāḥ | aśvinau tasya lāṅgūlaṃ pitaraḥ sandhiṣu sthitāḥ ||14|| niyatiḥ kālapāśaśca kṛtāntakalahāvapi | vyādhayaścāpi ye kecid dṛṣṭiṃ tasya samāśritāḥ || 15|| yakṣāśca rākṣasāścaiva gandharvāḥ pannagaiḥ sahaḥ | sarve tvacaṃ samāśritya saṃhatāḥ samavasthitāḥ | | 16 || tathā sarvāṇi chandāṃsi vedā iṣṭaya eva ca | romakūpeṣu sarvāṇi tāni tasthuḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||17| | dānāni niyamāścaiva yamāḥ sarvāśca mātaraḥ | sthānābhimānino devāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaśca ha | | 18|| sarve romāṇi tasyāsan varāhasya mahātmanaḥ | aṅgulyastasya pādābhyāṃ viśvedevābhavam̐stathā ||19|| bhṛgavoṅgirasaścaiva devāstasyābhavaṃstadā | romāntareṣu ṛṣayaḥ sarveṣvaṅgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ | |8.98.20 || evaṃ samabhavad vyāsa varāho nandivardhanaḥ | sa bhāti tena rūpeṇa dyāṃ bhuvañcāpi saṃspṛśan | |21|| purā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānuddhariṣyan mahīmimām | sa reje tena rūpeṇa dīptimān madhusūdanaḥ | |22| | niśāyāṃ saṃpradīpto hi himavāniva parvataḥ | tatastamṛṣayassarve tapasā mahatā tadā ||23 || svena svenābhisaṃprāpya tejastasyābhyadīpayan | sa viṣṇustejasā teṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ paramaujasām | |24| | saṃprajajvāla kālānte yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ | nādaṃ kṛtvā ca sumahaccālayāno mahītalam | |25|| uvāca tān ṛṣīnsarvān hanmi daityaṃ suradviṣam | hatvā taṃ daityarājaṃ vai siṃhaṃ śarabharāḍiva ||26|| mocayiṣye mahīṃ vignāṃ praviśyādya rasātalam | svasthāne sthāpayitvā ca datvā rājyaṃ divaukasām japadhvaṃ vijayāyādya śivāya ca tapodhanāḥ ||27| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | uvāca balamādhatsva daityosau sumahābalaḥ ||28|| āsthāya yatnaṃ sumahadapramattaḥ sureśvara | jahi taṃ daityarājaṃ vai kṛcchrametanmataṃ mama ||29|| na tasya sadṛśo daityo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā | mahābaloyaṃ daityendrastapoyogasamanvitaḥ |||8.98.30|| tato devastadā vyāsa bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | suraiḥ sabrahmakaistatra ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ ||3 1|| uktaḥ praṇamya deveśo viṣṇumāpyāyaya prabho | tejasā svena sarveśa yathā hanyāt suradviṣam ||32|| bhagavānuvāca tasmin kāle sureśābhāḥ sarve tejomayaṃ harim | pravekṣyanti tato daityaṃ kṣiprameva nihaṃsyati ||33 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tato brahmā svayaṃ tasya rakṣāṃ cakre mahātmanaḥ | yathāvattāṃ nibodhādya vadato me śucivrata | |34| | brahmovāca rakṣantu tvāṃ vidhātā ca dhātā ca ṛṣisattama | rudraḥ sraṣṭā ca sarveṣāṃ karmāṇi tava yudhyataḥ | |3 5 || kapālī tālaketuśca gandhādhipatireva ca | rasasyādhipatiścaiva sūkṣmarūpaśca rakṣatu | |3 6|| sparśavettā ca yaḥ sūkṣmo nādavām̐śca mahāmanāḥ | indriyādhipatiścaiva nīlalohita eva ca | |37|| rakṣatu tvāṃ mahāyogī bījādhipatireva ca | bījādhiṣṭhānamālaśca cetanāpatireva ca ||38|| pravṛtteśca nivṛtteśca kālavettā ca yaḥ prabhuḥ | dharmādharmagatiścaiva kartṝṇāṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ | |39| | guṇānāṃ vṛttido yaśca anapekṣaśca karmasu | niyamasya ca yaḥ kartā karmavettā ca karmaṇām ||8.98.40 | | vinā ca karaṇairyaśca karaṇārthaṃ pravartate | sarvajñaḥ sarvago yaśca adhiṣṭhātā ca yaḥ svayam ||41 || yena nādhiṣṭhitaṃ kiñcit kathañcinnāpi vidyate | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ | sarvataḥ śrutimām̐ścaiva sarvatogatiravyayaḥ | |42 | | aiśvaryamakṣayaṃ yasya sahasrākṛtayastathā | yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ tatvānāñca mahāyaśāḥ | |43| | saṃsārasyāsya yaḥ kartā tathaiva ca nivartakaḥ | yaṃ sāṃkhyā nābhijānanti yogino viditāgamāḥ ||44| | tuṣṭayo jñātayo nityaṃ māyayā mohayan prajāḥ | otaprotāni caitasmin tattvāni sumahātmani | |45|| puruṣādīni sarvāṇi yo vyāptaśca na kenacit | yamajñātvā na mokṣosti yena baddhamidaṃ jagat ||46|| yenāhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ prajāpatiḥ | tvaṃ yajñaścaiva viṣṇuśca yena sṛṣṭāḥ purātana ||47|| sa te balañca sumahadūrjjaṃ tejaśca yacchatu | akāmalabdhāṃ sarvatra smṛtiṃ cāstre mahāmanāḥ ||48 | | rakṣāṃ ca sarvago devo yudhyataste prayacchatu | kṛtarakṣo mayā samyaggaccha daityaṃ vināśaya ||49| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastaṃ stutibhirviprāstasya romāntarasthitāḥ | astuvan vāgbhiriṣṭābhirdevāśca bahumānataḥ ||8.98.50 || sarvāṇi ca jayetyūcurbhūtāni vividhāni ca | anāhatāstato vyomni devadundubhayaḥ śubhāḥ ||51 || vinedustatra divyāśca varāho yatra sobhavat | surabhīṇāñca puṣpāṇāṃ varāhopari sarvataḥ | vṛṣṭayaḥ peturatyarthaṃ devānāṃ harṣavardhanāḥ ||52|| tataḥ siddhiriti procya kṛtvā rudrāya vai namaḥ | japañjayāvahaṃ rudraṃ sa yayau varuṇālayam | |53 | | sa sevyamāno munibhistapodhanaistathā śakuntairbahubhirjayāvahaiḥ | mṛgaiśca divyairbahubhiḥ pradakṣiṇairjayāya devaḥ prayayau mahārṇavam ||54|| iti skandapurāṇe varāhasya varuṇālayagamanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.99> sanatkumāra uvāca sa saṃprayāto dharmātmā nardamāno yathā ghanaḥ | sarvalokamayo devo varāho nandivardhanaḥ || 1 || apaśyat sāgarañcaiva saṃprāpyātibalastadā | nardamānaṃ yathā meghaṃ līyamānaṃ mṛgendravat | |2| | nartakīmiva nṛtyantaṃ valgantaṃ caiva yodhavat | maṇḍalairbahubhiścitraiścarantaṃ vasudhāṃ tathā | | 3 | | niyuddhakuśalaṃ yadvad gadāyuddhaviśāradam | tadā tadbahudhā citramapaśyannandivardhanaḥ ||4| | sa tamargheṇa deveśaṃ sarvalokamayaṃ vibhum | pūjayāmāsa devām̐śca ṛṣayo ye ca saṃgatāḥ ||5 || sa jayāya pragṛhyainamanumānya mahodadhim | nivartya sarvabhūtāni praviveśa mahārṇavam | |6| | vigāhamānaḥ sakrīḍamarṇavaṃ vibabhau vibhuḥ | saraḥ sumahadāsādya yathā matto mahāgajaḥ ||7| | saṃpraviśya sudūrañca sodṛśyaḥ samapadyata | bhūmilekhāvṛtaḥ sūryo yathā saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ ||8|| tatontarjalamāviśya kṣobhayāṇo mahārṇavam | jalacandrakavad vyāsa adṛśyata sa lokapaiḥ | |9| | timintimiṅgilañcaiva timiṅgalagilānapi | tathaiva tadgilānanyān gardabhān hastino hyapi ||8.99.1 0 || makarām̐ścaiva śaṃkhām̐śca tathaivāśvamukhānapi | tathā vai pakṣisaṃkāśān mānuṣānapi cāparān ||1 1 | | rathacakraprakārām̐śca siṃhavyāghramukhānapi | śarabharkṣaviḍālāsyān matsyānbahuvidhām̐stathā || 12|| bhrāmayansumahātejā jagāma sumahābalaḥ | kutūhalāttamāviśya kecidāghrāya caiva hi ||1 3 || daśanti matsyā dīptāsyāḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ | sa pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya divyaṃ hayaśiraḥ śubham | |14 || kṣaṇānmainākamadhyena gatvā bhogavatīmapi | varuṇasya purīṃ gatvā payonāthasya dhīmataḥ | |1 5|| parjanyaṃ diggajaṃ prāpya kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam | surabhīpuramāsādya gā dṛṣṭvā caiva suprabhāḥ || 1 6| | yāḥ kṣaranti sadā vyāsa sudhāmamṛtameva ca | kṣīrodaṃ tatsaro divyaṃ phenapā yatra te dvijāḥ | | 17|| tasmin sarasi tat pītvā yaśomṛtasamaprabham | pūjitaḥ phenapaiḥ samyak tāṃ rātriṃ tatra sovasat | |1 8 || uṣitvā tatra sogacchat kaṅkasya puramavyayam | vāsukeśca puraṃ prāpya takṣakasya ca dhīmataḥ ||1 9| | tatra śeṣasya deveśo vindatāmaratāmiti | ramyāṃ manojñāṃ divyāñca svargādapi ca tāṃ varām | |8.99.20 || śrutvānantaśca taṃ rājā argheṇa samapūjayat | praṇamya bahumānācca upāmantrayadavyayaḥ | |21 || taṃ pūjayānaṃ madhuhā prītyā paramayā yutaḥ | uvāca lokakāryasya na vighnaṃ kartumarhasi | |22|| mahatkāryamidaṃ deva kartavyaṃ tridivaukasām | bhūyo vayaṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ kariṣyāma yadīcchasi | mā ca kāloyamudyukto daityasya na bhavediti ||23 || sanatkumāra uvāca tato visṛjya taṃ nāgaṃ rasātalamupāgamat | tatra sāgarapo daityaḥ suprabhontarjalecaraḥ ||24|| apaśyattaṃ tadāyāntaṃ hiraṇyākṣapuraṃ prati | gātreṣu devānsūkṣmām̐śca varāhasyānvavaikṣata ||25|| tasmintaccāsya rūpeṇa bhayānnainamupāgamat | tejasā cāpi viṣṭabdho durātmā tasya sosuraḥ ||26|| āvedayiṣyantasmai hi hiraṇyākṣāya satvaram | cakre vegaṃ pratipuraṃ varāhasya tadāgrataḥ ||27|| sa yātukāmo ditijādhirājaṃ varāharūpaṃ tamanantamantakam | jagāma daityāya sa jīvitāntaṃ yathānilaḥ pradyutadānamālyavān ||28|| iti skandapurāṇe varāhasya sāgarapraveśo nāmaikonaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.100> sanatkumāra uvāca tasminbhaye samāpanne vināśabhayasūcakāḥ | hiraṇyākṣapure ghorā utpātā hyabhavan tadā ||1 || aṭṭālakā viśīryante devatāścāhasanniva | śivā nadanti daityānāṃ gṛheṣu ca sabhāsu ca ||2| | akasmāccābhavattatra paurāṇāṃ bhairavo ravaḥ | pādapāśca vinā vātaṃ patantyunmūlitā bhuvi | bhāskaraśca kabandhābho yuddhañcāpyatra dṛśyate ||3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca etānyanyāni ca tadā nimittāni mahānti ca | saṃlakṣya rājā daityānāmasurānidamabravīta ||4|| nimittānyabhi lakṣyante mahāntyasurapuṅgavāḥ | naiva tānyanimittāni dṛśyate ca bhayaṃ mahat ||5|| hṛtarājyāśca deveśā na te sthāsyanti niṣkriyāḥ | nūnante kiñcidāśritya kurvanti samaraṃ prati ||6|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahlādosurasattamaḥ | praṇamya pitaraṃ samyagidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||7|| prahlāda uvāca sutohaṃ tava daityendra pitā tvaṃ mama dharmataḥ | na tavāsmadvidhairbuddhirādheyā daityasattama ||8|| tathāpi tu vayaṃ prītyā icchanto rājyamakṣayam | vakṣyāmo bālabhāvena tanna saṃsmarttumarhasi ||9|| adya rātrau mayā svapne dṛṣṭosau nararūpavān | varāharūpaṃ saṃgatya bhavantaṃ nigṛhītavān | na tathā tadyathā syāddhi tathā tvaṃ samyagācara ||8.100.10|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca evametanna sandeho bhavānyaddharmatastadā | dṛṣṭavām̐stadyathātattvamevametanna saṃśayaḥ ||11|| ahamadya gataḥ svapne tryambakasya niveśane | tataḥ sa māmidaṃ prāha bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ ||12|| etāvad bhavato daitya rājyamindratvameva ca | yacchemāṃ tvaṃ priyāṃ putra sahayakṣāya suprabhām ||13|| kṣiprametāṃ prayacchādya mukuṭaṃ hārameva ca | keyūrāṅgadakaṃ caiva khaṅgaṃ rucakameva ca ||14|| kaṭake śāsanañcaiva dukūlañca tathotarīm | anicchato me saṃgṛhya śakrasya pradadau tadā ||15| | tato māṃ bhagavānāha matsamīpe tvayā sadā | kalyaṃ prabhṛti vastavyaṃ kinte rājyena daityapa ||1 6|| yadetaddhi mayā dṛṣṭaṃ na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati | sarvathā nāsti daityānāṃ mayaikena bhavaṃ tviha ||17|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityāḥ sarve tadābruvan | mithyaitat svapnagatayo mithyā rājan prakīrtitāḥ | | 18 || andhakaḥ sahitosmābhiryotsyate daivataiḥ saha | yovadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ balavānajitaśca ha | |19|| tamāśritya vayaṃ sarve yotsyāmo vijvarāḥ sukham | mā yudhyatu bhavānsārdhaṃ suraiḥ surabalārdana ||8.100.20 || tvayi prāṇāḥ sthitāssarve daityānāṃ dānavaissaha | tvayi jīvati jīvāmastvañcennāsi kuto vayama | tyaktvā vādya puraṃ sarve praviśāma mahodadhim ||21|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ | prahasya tānidaṃ samyaguvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ ||22|| sraṣṭā yaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dātā harttā tathaiva ca | vihitaṃ tena yat pūrvaṃ tatkuryāt konyathā punaḥ ||23|| yadi mṛtyuravaśyaṃ me vihitastena dānavāḥ | ayudhyamānamāsīnametyāsau mā vadhiṣyati ||24|| vīkṣadhvaṃ tanmama sthānaṃ sarva evāsurottamāḥ | yatra tiṣṭhantamabhyetya na mā mṛtyurnayiṣyati ||25|| athavā naiva mṛtyurme vihitastena dānavāḥ | yudhyamānaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ naiva māṃ sa nayiṣyati ||26|| mādṛśaḥ kathamevaitat kuryāt sadbhirvigarhitam | bāle mṛtyuṃ samāveśya tataścātmāntarekṣaṇam ||27|| raṇe ripūṇāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtvaikaścāpyanekaśaḥ | pṛṣṭhaṃ dadyāt punasteṣāṃ mādṛśo dānaveśvarāḥ ||28|| vipracittiruvāca devā hyanekaśaḥ sarve jitā naṣṭāśca sarvaśaḥ | punaścāyānti na yathā tathā sarve yatāmahe ||29|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca amaraṃ devatā jñātvā svamātmānaṃ sudurlabham | jīvantaḥ sucireṇāpi bhūyo lapsyāmahe vayam ||8.100.3 0 || rājyameva vijānanto vipalāyanti nityaśaḥ | asmākamamaratvantu naivāstyasurasattamāḥ ||31 || naṣṭānāmapyatosmākaṃ jīvitāśā na vidyate | tasyāmasatyāṃ paśyāma yat prāptaṃ taddhi no varam ||32|| mā kṛthā nāśane buddhiṃ yuddhe buddhiḥ sthitā mama | suyuddhena raṇe prāṇā yāntu mā klībavaddhi naḥ ||33|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāmevantu vadatāṃ sabhāyāṃ suravidviṣām | vegaśvāsābhisaṃrabdho dānavaḥ pratyadṛśyata ||34|| samyak santrāsita iva mṛgarājena nirjane | karīva siṃhapādena garuḍeneva pannagaḥ | | 3 5| | tadā sa baddhamuṣṭiśca diśaḥ sarvā vilokayan | vegena niḥśvasan gatvā dvāri dvāḥsthamabhāṣata | |3 6|| dānava uvāca āvedaya sabhāpāla rājñe prāptonalaḥ svayam | sāgarārakṣikaḥ kṣipramakālaṃ śīghramucyate ||37|| tataḥ prahasya taṃ dvāḥsthaḥ sabhāpālobhibhāṣya tam | uvāca mā bhīrbhavatu kuto bhīste mahāsura ||38|| neha siṃhosti coro vā nānyaḥ śvāpada ityapi | na gāvaḥ paśavonye vā bhayaṃ tyaja samāśvasa | |3 9|| sa tathā tena saṃprokto śāntaścāsurasattamaḥ | kruddhaḥ śabdaṃ tadā cakre mahāntaṃ nādayan diśaḥ ||8.100.40 || ..........................| tebhigamya tadā vyāsa rājānaṃ dānaveśvaram | ūcureṣa kimapyadya dṛṣṭaṃ kathayatesuraḥ | |1 | | sa rājan samyagāśvāsya daityamenaṃ mahāyaśaḥ| dānavānāṃ hitārthāya pṛcchasva ditinandana | |42| | teṣāṃ sa rājā viprendra dānavānāṃ mahābalaḥ | śrutvā taṃ dānavaṃ vyāsa idaṃ vacanamabravīt | |43 || bhayaṃ na śaknute daitya matsamīpebhivartitum | brūhi sarvaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ samāśvasya tathātatham ||44|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa dānavo vyāsa rājānaṃ vigatajvaraḥ | praṇamya prāñjalirvākyamidaṃ samyaguvāca ha ||45| | nityaṃ jayatu no rājā dānavānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ | naśyantu vidviṣaḥ sarve yesmākamahitāvahāḥ | |46|| ahaṃ tavājñayā sarvaṃ vicarāmi dine dine | sāgarāntaṃ mahārāja puruṣaissaha saṃgataḥ | |47|| sodya paśyāmyahaṃ tatra varāhaṃ daityapuṅgava | meruśṛṅgapratīkāśaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam ||48|| tasya gātreṣu dṛśyante sūkṣmarūpadharāḥ sthitāḥ | sarve surā mahārāja ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | |49|| mahābalastvaṃ rājendra devānāṃ bhayadaḥ sadā | tvattopi sumahān bhīmastādṛṅ naiveha vidyate | |8.100.50 || na dṛṣṭo na śruto vāpi vapuṣā daityapuṅgava | ahaṃ tenāhato dṛṣṭyā nyapataṃ bhūtale bhṛśam ||51 || srastahārāmbaro bhītaḥ kuliśeneva tāḍitaḥ | ye mamānucarāścāsan dānavā bhīmavikramāḥ | |52| | te sarve tasya vegena patitā gatajīvitāḥ | sa eṣobhyeti rājendra tavaiva nagaraṃ prati | |53 || cālayan vasudhāṃ sarvāṃ kṣobhayan sāgarāṃstathā | jalecarām̐śca daityendra jīvitairviprayojayan ||54|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahlādosurasattamaḥ | uvāca daityarājānamidaṃ vacanamarthavat ||55 || prahlāda uvāca yādṛśaṃ tadvarāhasya tasya rūpaṃ mayā śrutam | sarvadevamayaṃ rājan varāhoprākṛto mataḥ | |56 || tasmāttvayā vidhātavyaṃ yathā no na sa mohayet | viniścitya ca daityendra mā ciraṃ tadvidhīyatām ||57|| suvyaktaṃ brahmaṇā tasya cakralāṅgaladhāriṇaḥ | sarvadevamayaṃ rūpaṃ vārāhamidamīhitam ||58|| bhavānavadhyassarveṣāṃ devānāṃ dānaveśvara | aśaktaistairiyaṃ māyā sṛṣṭā vai na tadanyathā ||59|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca daityāndanujānidaṃ vacanamarthavat ||8.100.60|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca yadyeṣa bhrātṛhantā me ihāyāti durātmavān | pūrṇaḥ syādadya sucirādyo me hṛdi manorathaḥ ||61|| adyāhaṃ taṃ durātmānaṃ bhrātṛhantāramāhave | chittvā chittvā kariṣyāmi baliṃ paśupateḥ śubham ||62|| adya tasya vicitrākṣaṃ śiraḥ kāyāt sakuṇḍalam | utkṛtya daityā dāsyāmi rudrāya paramātmane ||63 || mayā nāsāditaḥ pūrvaṃ tasminyuddhe sa keśavaḥ | adyāhaṃ taṃ samāsādya neṣyāmi yamasādanam ||64|| atha tasminhate sarve nirāśā bhayavihvalāḥ | mamaivā kāryatāṃ gatvā devā yāsyanti dāsatām ||65 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa dānavāñchūrān daityām̐śca sumahābalān | uvāca nāmnā vikhyātān kiṅkarānnāma dānavān ||66|| daśa tāni sahasrāṇi gacchadhvaṃ taṃ mahābalāḥ | jānīta koyamityevaṃ tato yāsyāmyahaṃ svayam | |67|| te tathoktā mahāmāyā hṛṣṭāḥ sarve vinirgatāḥ | baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇāḥ sannaddhāstu padātayaḥ ||68| | te hemacitrāmbarahārasūtrā mahābalā dānavadaityaputrāḥ | vinādayanto bahudhātikopitā yathaiva nāgāḥ saviṣā viniryayuḥ ||69||| iti skandapurāṇe kiṅkarādeśanaṃ nāma śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.101> sanatkumāra uvāca tebhinirgatya vegena daṃśitā daityadānavāḥ | varāhaṃ prati saṃjagmurmṛgāḥ siṃhamivāturāḥ ||1|| te varāhadṛśā tena nīyamānāsureśvarāḥ | ābhānti vyāsa sannaddhāḥ prokṣitāḥ paśavo yathā ||2|| tānnihatya kṛtāntena mṛtyunā cāvapāśitān | nināya sa tadā daityān paśūniva yathā naraḥ ||3 || gatvā te yojanānyaṣṭau uttīrṇaṃ sāgarāmbhasaḥ | varāhaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve siṃhaṃ kṣudramṛgā iva ||4|| te muhūrtaṃ nirīkṣyaiva paribabhrussamantataḥ | visphārayantaścāpāni saṃkruddhā daityadānavāḥ ||5|| tānāpatata evātha nirīkṣya sa samantataḥ | varāhendrastadā daityān prāhedaṃ sumahābalaḥ ||6|| varāha uvāca kiṃ mā yūyaṃ diteḥ putrā abhidravatha sarvaśaḥ | dūṣayāmi na vaḥ kiñcidasuhṛnna ca vo hyaham ||7|| athaivaṃvādinaṃ daityā varāhaṃ taṃ suvismitāḥ | papracchuḥ parivāryaiva sarve ditisutāstadā ||8 | kastvaṃ varāharūpīha tīrtvā sāgaramūrjim | ihāgataḥ kimarthaṃ vā kva vā gantavyamityuta ||9|| teṣāntadvacanaṃ śrutvā varāhosau mahāmanāḥ | uvāca dānavānsarvān tadā jaladanisvanaḥ ||8.101.1 0 || varāhohaṃ yathā daityāstādṛgrūpaṃ ca paśyata | pracārārthamimaṃ deśamāgatosmi na saṃśayaḥ ||1 1|| hṛtabhāryohamanyena vimanā daityapuṅgavāḥ | paryaṭam̐stasya duṣṭasya cintayāmi parigraham ||1 2|| dānavā ūcuḥ nāyaṃ pracāro yuṣmākaṃ daityānāmayamālayaḥ | anādṛtya kathaṃ daityānimaṃ deśamupāgataḥ ||13|| vayaṃ tvādya vadhiṣyāmaḥ sarve mṛgakulādhama | hatvā ca tvāṃ hi neṣyāmaḥ sarve daityeśvaraṃ prati ||14|| tataste dānavāssarve tamāyudhavarairbhṛśam | nijaghnuḥ parvataṃ yadvat meghā vṛṣṭyā samuddhatāḥ ||15|| balavānsopi devātmā varāhaḥ sumahābalaḥ | vadhyamānopi tāndaityānidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||16|| nahyatra bhavatāṃ kiñcidalpamapyasurottamāḥ | aparādhaṃ cakārāhaṃ na kariṣye karomi vā ||17|| kimarthaṃ mā śitaiḥ śastrairghnata (?) sarve yathā param | na hi vo vairamastīha na ca kāryaṃ mayā hi vaḥ ||18|| atha māṃsena kṛtyaṃ vastato māṃ ghnata dānavāḥ | yathā prāṇaṃ śitaiḥ śastrairyuṣmatto na ca me bhayam ||19|| etau karau prasāryāhaṃ saṃsthito ditinandanāḥ | yadā bhavantaḥ sthāsyanti tadā hantāsmi vassakṛt ||8.101.20|| adya vetsyatha daiteyā mṛgāṇāmiha yadbalam | mattā yūyaṃ surān jitvā taṃ madaṃ nāśayāmi vaḥ ||21 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān vyāsa śakradhvajanibhau karau | prasārya tasthāvudyaṃcau bhagavāniva śaṃkaraḥ ||22|| tepi tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dānavāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ | nijaghnurbhṛśamāyastā nānāśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ ||23 || meghairiva mahāvāyurgarutmān bhujagairiva | mṛgairiva yathā vyāghraḥ śaśairiva yathā hariḥ ||24|| haviṣevānalo dīpto gajo gomāyubhiryathā | tathā sa bhagavān vyāsa varāho nandivarddhanaḥ | |25|| tairardyamānogaṇayan tasthāvacalasannibhaḥ | sa yadā taiḥ śaraiścaiva gadāmuśalapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||26|| bhindipālairbhuśuṇḍībhiḥ karavālairayomukhaiḥ | etaiścānyaiśca bahubhirvadhyamāno mṛgeśvaraḥ | adṛśyo vibabhau sarve tadā te harṣitā bhṛśam ||27|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ ninadatāṃ vyāsa varāho nandivardhanaḥ | śastrakūṭāda viniṣkramya śirāṃsi samapothayat | | 28 | | karābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāñca daṃṣṭrābhiśca vyadārayat | tanmuktairāyudhaiścaiva cicchedānyān rarāsa ca ||24 | te sarve karacaraṇairvimuktaśastrairdaṃṣṭrābhirmakhamukhadāritāstathaiva | saṃkṣīṇā bahubhirivopabhujyamānā dravyāṇāmiva nicayāḥ sadā mahāntaḥ iti skandapurāṇe kiṅkarayuddhe ekottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.102> sanatkumāra uvāca atha tānnihatān sarvān varāheṇābhivīkṣya tu | ekaḥ kṛcchrādvinirmukto hyaśmakaṃ puramāviśat || 1 || sa gatvā tatsabhādvāramidaṃ vacanamabravīt | muktakeśo rajodhvasto rudhireṇābhisaṃplutaḥ | |2|| nivedayata bho daityā dānavendrāya dhīmate | dvāḥstho nyavedayadrājñe preritaḥ sodyatāyudhaḥ ||3 || ye te gatā mṛgendraṃ taṃ draṣṭuṃ hyasurasattamāḥ | te hatāstena vikramya sarva eva diteḥ sutāḥ ||4|| mā gāḥ pramādaṃ daityendra māvamam̐sthā mṛgeśvaram | mā ca kālaṃ pratīkṣadhvaṃ mṛgaṃ taṃ mā vijānata | mahānasau na sandeho jetuṃ śakyo na dānavaiḥ ||5| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ | svayamevābhisaṃkruddha utpapāta tadāsanāt ||6 || sendraketurivottasthau payoda iva connadan | bhṛkuṭīdūṣitamukhaḥ sadhūmogniriva jvalan ||7|| athotthitaṃ tato daityā vipracittiśca dānavaḥ | praṇamyocustadā daityamidaṃ ślakṣṇapadākṣaram | |8|| tvaṃ rājā sarvadaityānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca jayāvahaḥ | tiṣṭhatsvasmāsu nodyantuṃ svayameva tvamarhasi ||9|| vayaṃ taṃ saha devaiśca ye ca tasyābhirakṣiṇaḥ | hatvā māṃsaṃ mahārāja chittvā tasyānayāmahe | |8.102.1 0 || ādityānāṃ sarudrāṇāṃ vasūnāmaśvinorapi | bhṛgūṇāṃ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ tathaivāṅgirasāmapi || 11 || viśvedevāśca ye kecitsādhyā devāstathaiva ca | yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāñca piśācānāṃ sahoragaiḥ | |1 2 || gandharvapakṣiṇāñcaiva manuṣyāṇāñca dānava | udyuktānāṃ samṛtyūnāṃ lokapālaissahaiva ca || 13 | | śaktā nivāraṇe daityā vadhe caiva durātmanām | nigrahe ca yathākālaṃ svayaṃ mā tvamito gamaḥ || 14| | hatamasmābhirudyuktaiḥ paśyādya ditinandana | ājñāpayati no yatra rājā svāmī prajeśvaraḥ || 1 5|| tadvayaṃ śirasā sarve kariṣyāma na saṃśayaḥ | yadaśaktā vayaṃ kāryaṃ sarvepyasurapuṃgava | kartuṃ tasya bhavān kartā mā naḥ paśya parāniva || 1 6|| mṛgārthe danudaityānāṃ svayaṃ rājā mahābalaḥ | nirgato nāsti daityānāṃ vakṣyanti balamityuta || 17| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa rājā daityānāṃ sarvāneva samādiśat | kāle jaladharānindro yathā bhinnāñjanatviṣaḥ | |1 8| | ājñāṃ tasya gṛhītvaiva tepi daityā mudānvitāḥ | sannahyanta mahākāyā vāhanāni ca bhejire | | 19|| prahlādaścānuhlādaśca śinirbāṣkala eva ca | jambhaḥ kujambho vātāpī ilvalotha virocanaḥ | |8.102.2 0 || balirbāṇaśca vātaśca śaṃbhuḥ kaśyapa eva ca | śambaraśca mahākāyaḥ kālaśambara eva ca | |21 || pradīptaścāsilomā ca śilitāścaiva dānavāḥ | śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva dhundhurmūkaśca dānavaḥ | |22| | śatodaraśca vikhyātastathaivānyo hradodaraḥ | tāraśca tārakaścaiva mayo kālaśca viśrutaḥ ||23 || ajako namuciścaiva vyaṃsaḥ kārtasvanaḥ śubhaḥ | ilvako vilvakaścaiva vipākaḥ pāka eva ca||24|| hastī duryodhanaścaiva vipracittiśca dānavaḥ | hayagrīvo muraścaiva narakaḥ kuṇḍa eva ca ||25|| śakunirvṛṣaparvā ca śataketurmahāravaḥ | sarakaścaiva rāhuśca svarbhānuḥ kāla eva ca ||26|| virādhaśca kabandhaśca dundubhiḥ śatadundubhiḥ | śālvo drumaśca dvāvetau mayūragrīva eva ca ||27|| kālanemī meghanādo mahāvīryassa cāndhakaḥ | mahiṣānandaśamakāvāṭiśca baka eva ca ||28| | tato dānavaśārdūlā mahāmāyā mahābalāḥ | sarve sarvāstraviduṣo labdhalakṣāśca saṃyuge ||29| | rathairhayairgajaiścaiva tathaivānye padātayaḥ | jagmurvarāhaṃ taṃ vyāsa hantuṃ devā ivāsuram || 8.102.30 || sa cāpi hi mahātejā varāho nandivardhanaḥ | stuyamānastathātmasthairmunibhirbhagavān balī | | 31 | | hatvā tān kiṅkarānsarvānaśmakaṃ puramāgamat | garjamāno yathā megho yugānte vṛṣṭisarjanaḥ | |3 2 || sa gatvā tattadā vyāsa puraṃ lokamayaḥ prabhuḥ | apasavyaṃ parāvṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāgamat | |33 | | dakṣiṇadvāribhistatra dānavairbahubhirbhṛśam | kṛto halāhalāśabdo nagaraṃ yena kopitam ||34| | yo hi bhitvā śataghnīśca kavāṭaṃ kūṭamudgarān | kālacakrāṇi yantrāṇi sovācūrṇayadavyayaḥ ||35|| athājagmurbhṛśāviṣṭāste dānavamahārathāḥ | śastravarṣeṇa cogreṇa chādayanto mṛgeśvaram | |3 6| | atha taistomaraiścakrairbhindīpālaiśca tāḍitaḥ | dvāraṃ tyaktvā vinirgamya samāṃ bhūmimupāśritaḥ | |37| | tepi taṃ bhagnamityeva vijānantosurāstadā | pṛṣṭhatonuyayurvyāsa takṣayanto varāyudhaiḥ | |38|| sa takṣyamāṇaḥ śaravṛṣṭitomarairmahāgadābhirmuśalairayomukhaiḥ | tadābhiniḥsṛtya diteḥ sutānasāvayodhayaddevagaṇairadhiṣṭhitaḥ ||39| | iti skandapurāṇe asurasandeśanaṃ nāma dvyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.103> sanatkumāra uvāca atha vyāsa samāṃ bhūmiṃ saṃprāptāndānavarṣabhān | uvāca sarvān gambhīraṃ mṛgānsiṃha ivājane | | 1 || bhavanto dānavāḥ sarve daityāśca sumahābalāḥ | mayā mṛgeṇa samare yudhyatāṃ tu punarbhṛśam | | 2| | na lajjā samarebhyetya yuṣmākaṃ dānaveśvarāḥ | athavā na balaṃ vosti mithyā devā hi vo jitāḥ ||3|| bahavo balavantaśca mṛgaścāhaṃ vanecaraḥ | na manye dharmayuddhe vo matirdānavasattamāḥ ||4|| na mamāsti dhanuḥ kiñcinna śastraṃ ca tathāvidham | saśastrairbahubhiryena yuddheyamasureśvarāḥ ||5 | | te yūyaṃ yadi manyadhvaṃ śastrāṇi tyajatādhunā | mayā caikaikaśaḥ sarve yudhyadhvaṃ nyāyamāsthitāḥ ||6|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sondhako dānaveśvaraḥ | uvāca sarvāndaityendrān yugāntāmbudavannadan ||7| | evametadyathāhāyaṃ mṛgosuramahārathāḥ | santyajāmādya śastrāṇi yodhāmaikaikaśastathā | |8 || prahlāda uvāca abuddhireṣā daityendrā yathāhāyaṃ mṛgādhamaḥ | samānānāṃ samaissārdhametadyuddhaṃ praśasyate ||9|| na mṛgāṇāñca śastrāṇi na bāhubalamityuta | vadhyante ca sadā śastraireṣa dharmaḥ satāṃ mataḥ | |8.103.1 0 | | te vayaṃ kathamutmṛjya svadharmaṃ dānaveśvarāḥ | mṛgadharmaṃ samāsthāya yudhyema paśavo yathā | |1 1 || mṛgādhamoyaṃ durvṛtta avadhyo nāsmadādibhiḥ | ...mā vicāro vo mṛge bhavatu sarvaśaḥ ||12|| māyāmāsthāya duṣṭātmā kopyayaṃ surapāṃsanaḥ | asmān vañcayituṃ daityāḥ kāṃkṣate sudurātmavān ||1 3 | | kva ca śrutaṃ vā dṛṣṭaṃ vā mṛgāṇāmasureśvarāḥ | manuṣyavadbāhuyuddhaṃ puruṣaissaha saṃyuge ||14|| eṣa viṣṇurdurācāro durātmā daityakaṇṭakaḥ | aśaktaḥ svena vīryeṇa māyāmāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ ||15|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatastaṃ balavān kruddho dhanuṣā sosureśvaraḥ | śarairavākirad vyāsa bahubhirvirarāsa ca ||1 6|| andhako vipracittiśca sarve te daityadānavāḥ | avākiran śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ||17|| atha daivaḥ susaṃrabdhairviddhastai rdānavairbhṛśam | śuśubhe bhāskarakaraiḥ saṃviddho himavāniva || 18|| sa vegaṃ balavat kṛtvā vidhunvānaḥ śarān śitān | salīlaṃ prayayau devaḥ prahlādaṃ prati dānavam | | 19| | sa gatvā tasya sahasā sārathiṃ rathameva ca | daṃṣṭrābhiśca karābhyāñca nāmaśeṣaṃ cakāra ha | |8.103.2 0 || tato rathādavaplutya hanyamānopi dānavaiḥ | rathadhvajena taṃ daityaṃ mūrdhni devobhijaghnivān ||2 1 || prahlādopi tatotpatya gadayā bhīmarūpayā | ājaghānorasi kruddhaṃ vighno dharme yathā sthitam ||22| | sa tenābhihato devo muktvā tasya rathaṃ tadā | tameva deśamāyātaḥ pūrvaṃ yatrābhavat sthitaḥ | |23 | | tatondhako vipracittiḥ śambaraḥ kālaśambaraḥ | śarairāśīviṣākārairbibhidurnandivardhanam | |24|| sa viddhastaistadā vyāsa śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ | bhidyamānaśca bahudhā maṇḍalāni cacāra ha | |25|| kadācit siṃhavaccāpi plavate nardatepi ca | śārdūlavat kadācicca bhūmāvātmānamāhave | |26|| vitatya sa mahāvīryastiṣṭhate sāyakān sahan | pādena tata utthāya avakīrya vṛṣo yathā ||27|| pakṣivatsa tadākāśe maṇḍalāni mṛgeśvaraḥ | bhramitvā niścalastasthau varāhaḥ parvato yathā ||28|| evaṃ bahuvidhān mārgān vicaritvā mahābalaḥ | vegenaiva karābhyāṃ sa rathau jagrāha nādayan ||29| | vipracitteśca balavānandhakasya ca suprabhaḥ | bhrāmayitvā muhūrttaṃ tau sahāśvaiḥ sahasārathī ||8.103.30|| bhūmāvutkṣipya cikṣepa babhañja ca punaḥ padā | rathāsthitau ca tau daityau punarmūrdhanyatāḍayat ||31 || tau hatāvatisaṃkruddhau gade codyamya vegitau | varāhaṃ mūrdhni yugapatsamāhatya vinedatuḥ ||32|| tābhyāṃ sa balavān kruddho hastābhyāṃ raktalocanaḥ | gade jagrāha yattābhyāṃ balādeva mṛgeśvaraḥ ||33|| tatocaranmaṇḍalāni vividhāni janārdanaḥ | gadāviśāradaḥ samyag vicitrāṇi bahūnyapi ||34|| ākṣiptamatha vikṣiptamavākṣiptañca maṇḍalam | utkṣiptamatha vikṣiptaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ dhāvitaṃ tathā ||35|| parāvṛttaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca ardhacandramathāpi ca | viṣṭabdhaṃ codyatañcaiva haṃsodbhramitameva ca ||36|| gadāviśāradaḥ samyag bhramitvā maṇḍalāni saḥ | gadāmupari cikṣepa sondhakasya vinādayan ||37|| aparāṃ vipracitteśca balavānnandivardhanaḥ | te gade tau mahāvege dānavau sudurāsadau ||38|| vañcayitvā raṇe bhūyo varāhaṃ prati dānavau | ādhāvitau yathā deśamutpātau vegitāviva ||39|| tayorāpatatoreva varāhosau mahābalaḥ | muṣṭināndhakamāhatya vipracittiṃ padāvadhīt ||8.103.40 || andhakastasya muṣṭiṃ taṃ vipracittiḥ padañca ha | kruddhau jagṛhaturdaityau hatastvamiti vādinau ||41|| nādayānau yathā kāle kṛṣṇāviva balāhakau | sa gṛhītastadā tābhyāṃ mahātmā surasattamaḥ ||42|| utpapāta viyad vegāt pakṣirāḍiva kāśyapaḥ | viyatstho vibabhau daityāvudvahan sa mṛgeśvaraḥ ||43|| garutmāniva pakṣīśo bhakṣārthaṃ gajakacchapau | vinadya sa tadākāśe vidhūya ca karau balī ||44|| pādañcaivābhicikṣepa tau daityau bhujagāviva | tau kṣiptau prekṣya tu vyāsa dānavau yuddhadurmadau ||45|| abhiyātau mahīṃ ghorāvaśanī khāccyutāviva | asāvapi ca deveśo varāho nandivardhanaḥ | rathānvai sarvadaityānāṃ cūrṇayāmāsa vīryavān ||46|| gṛhītvā kūbare kañcit soccikṣepa mahārṇave | kañcitpadā samāhatya pāṃsusāyujyamānayat ||47|| kañcidrathaṃ rathenaiva padātiñca padātinā | gajaṃ gajena cāhatya sa ninye yamasādanam ||48|| sanatkumāra uvāca tepi vidrāvitāḥ sarve lajjāṃ paramikāṃ gatāḥ | daityadānavaśārdūlā vinivṛttā yathābalāḥ ||49|| ekena sarve vijitāsurendrāḥ parasparaṃ vīkṣya mukhāni śūrāḥ | vrīḍānvitāste punareva devaṃ varāha.......ti | |8.103.50 || iti skandapurāṇe varāhayuddhe tryuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.104> sanatkumāra uvāca atha te taṃ mṛgaṃ vyāsa dānavā bhīmagarjanāḥ | āyudhaiḥ samabhikruddhāḥ saṃtatakṣustadā bhṛśam | | 1 | | te mṛgā iva śārdūlaṃ siṃhapotaṃ gajā iva | ājaghnurdānavāḥ kruddhā varāhaṃ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ | |2|| sa cāpi mṛgaśārdūla upaviśya mahodadhim | apopibat samāviśya vahnivadvaḍavāmukham ||3 | | tatheritāni tairdaityairāyudhāni sahasraśaḥ | vyādāya sumahadvaktraṃ jagrāsa ca rarāsa ca ||4| | grasitvā tāni sarvāṇi śastrāṇi sa mahābalaḥ | dānavānprati saṃcakre vegaṃ sindhurivāparaḥ | |5|| gajānprati yathā siṃhaḥ siṃhān śarabharāḍiva | garutmān bhujagān yadvacchārdūlaśca mṛgāniva ||6| | meghavṛndaṃ yathā vāyuḥ kapotāniva pakṣirāṭ | tathā sa bhagavān vyāsa dānavānprati lokapaḥ ||7|| vegaṃ cakre yathā kṣipramindriyaṃ prati vai manaḥ | āsādya ca sa tāndaityān mahājaladaniḥsvanaḥ | |8 | | sarvān vidrāvayāmāsa rudraḥ paśugaṇāniva | kāṃścit padbhyāṃ susaṃkruddho hastābhyāmaparāniti ||9|| daṃṣṭrābhiścāparāṃstatra sa praiṣīdyamasādanam | tuṇḍena śambaraṃ bhūmau kālaśambarameva ca | | 8.104.10 || narakaṃ pādaghātena hayagrīvaṃ ca muṣṭinā | urasā namuciṃ cāpi mahāmāyaṃ ca satvaraḥ | | 11 || āhatyāhatya saṃkruddhaḥ pātayāmāsa devapaḥ | tāṃstathā drāvayānañca garjamānañca siṃhavat || 12| | vipracitirvarāhaṃ taṃ muṣṭinorasyatāḍayat | vipracittiṃ jaghānograṃ pārśvadeśe sa muṣṭinā ||13 || sa āhato varāheṇa varāhaṃ krodhamūrchitaḥ | punarjaghāna khaṅgena vakṣasyenaṃ vinādayan || 14|| amṛṣyamāṇastaṃ ghātaṃ varāhaḥ sumahābalaḥ | muṣṭinā mūrdhni taṃ daityaṃ vajrābhena vyatāḍayat || 1 5|| sa daityastena ghātena bhramitvā cakravattadā | papāta bhūmau vegena vātāhata iva drumaḥ ||16| | patitaṃ taṃ tadābhyetya vipracittiṃ prajeśvaraḥ | jagrāha padbhyāṃ deveśo drāvamāṇaṃ diteḥ sutam ||17|| bhrāmayitvā tataścainaṃ naditvā cāsakṛdbalī | puraṃ prati vicikṣepa mahātmā nandivardhanaḥ ||18| | sa kṣiptastena vibabhau dānabādhipatirbalī | sabalākataḍijjvāla paricchinna ivāmbudaḥ | |1 9|| srastahārāmbaradharaścyutamālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ | papātopari vegena hiraṇyākṣasya veśmani ||8.104.20 | | saudhamaṭṭālakaṃ tasya vimānamiva saṃsthitam | cūrṇayānopatad vyāsa parvatendramivāśaniḥ | | 21 || mahatā tasya śabdena hiraṇyākṣaḥ svayaṃ tadā | vegenāgatya dadṛśe dānavendraṃ diteḥ sutaḥ | |22| | sopi dānavaśārdūlo varāheṇāvapīḍitaḥ | tena caiva vighātena muhūrttamabhavajjaḍaḥ ||23 || taṃ samāśvāsayadrājā tadā śītena vāriṇā | tālavṛntaiśca bahubhirmaṇibhiśca diteḥ sutaḥ 24| | samāśvasyotthitañcaiva upaviṣṭaṃ varāsane | rājā papraccha taṃ daityaṃ paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ||25|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca kenādya himavān daitya pṛthivī vā sasāgarā | mahābalena sahasā tulitā viśvakarmaṇā ||2 6|| kenādya mandaraḥ srasto mṛtyuḥ kena parājitaḥ | kena tvaṃ dānaveśāna kṣiptaḥ ko balavānbhuvi ||27|| pṛthivyāstulanaṃ yādṛg mandarasya ca cālanam | mṛtyośca maraṇa tādṛk tavedaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ mahat ||28|| rudrendramṛtyupratimo lokapālabhayaṅkaraḥ | kena tvaṃ tulitaḥ saṃkhye balavānabalo yathā ||29|| kasyedaṃ balamakṣayyaṃ kena bāhvorbalaṃ mahat | khyāpitaṃ triṣu lokeṣu dānaveśvara kathyatām ||8.104.3 0|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dānavaḥ sa mahābalaḥ | tamāha dīrghaṃ niḥśvasya nirīkṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||31 || vipracittiruvāca amānuṣamidaṃ rājannatidevaṃ tathāpi ca | atidaityañca daityendra na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kvacit ||32|| varāhasya balaṃ yādṛg na ca tādṛk kvacit kvacit | na hi tulyaṃ prapaśyāmi tasya rājanmahātmanaḥ ||33|| astraiḥ śastraiśca bahubhistakṣyamāṇasya saṃyuge | nārttirna duḥkhaṃ daityendra na ca saṃjñā prahīyate || 34|| bhavettasyābhi daṣṭasya maśakenāpyanirvṛtiḥ | na daityadānavai rājan nighnasya bhayamityuta ||35|| yathā kṣudramṛgān siṃho maṇḍūkāniva voragaḥ | tathā sa kalayāmāsa sarvān daityendradānavān | |36|| na taṃ mṛgamahaṃ manye na devaṃ nāpi cāsuram | kopyasau ditiputrāṇāmanayaḥ samupasthitaḥ ||37|| tenāsmi muṣṭinā mūrdhni tāḍito bhūtalaṃ gataḥ | gṛhītvā sahasotkṣiptaḥ patitastvadgṛhopari ||38|| dānavānāṃ sadaityānāmitareṣāñca dānava | na jāne samavasthānaṃ manye te sarvaśo hatāḥ ||39|| avadhyassa mahātejā balavān durbalā vayam | śrutvaitad ditiputrāṇāṃ hitaṃ yattatsamācara ||8.104.40 || tasyāṅge munayaḥ sarve dṛśyante saha daivataiḥ | kṛtyā seti mataṃ medya tava hetorvinirmitā ||41|| manaśca tava daityendra yuddhāya kṛtaniścayam | vinivartaya taccaiva daityānāṃ hitamācara | |42|| balavān sobalā daityā vayaṃ martyāḥ sa cāmaraḥ | ajayyosau jitā daityā mā no yuddhena yojaya || 43 || hitvāśmakaṃ puraṃ sarve samudrastambhamāśritāḥ | tiṣṭhāma rājan mā yuddha tena sākaṃ punaḥ kṛthāḥ ||44| | māvamaṃsthā mṛgaṃ daitya mṛgosāviti sarvaśaḥ | narasiṃhopyabhūtpūrvaṃ mṛgastadvinibṛṃ hitaḥ | |45| | …….........| yāvattvaṃ dhriyase daitya dānavānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ | tāvatsarve surā jīvā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | |46 | | mā ruśantu diteḥ putrā danoścaiva subāliśāḥ | apayāma purādasmādasureśvara sarvaśaḥ | |47| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca dānaveśānaṃ bhītaṃ tasmān mahātmanaḥ | |48|| asaṃśayaṃ mahātmāsau mṛgo dānavasattama | yena mandarakalpastvaṃ tulitaḥ sumahābalaḥ | |49 || adya varṣasahasrāṇi divyānyasurapuṃgava | catvāri bhuñjato rājyaṃ gatāni sumahānti me | |8.104.5 0 | | pañcapañcā (?) tu saṃprāptantāvaddevāśca nāśitāḥ (?) | sabalā bahubhirghoraiḥ saṃgrāmairabalā iva | | 51 | | sohaṃ tathā balopeto bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam | bhītaḥ praviśya salilaṃ kathaṃ sthāsye bhujaṅgavat ||5 2 | | mṛgarūpī sa viṣṇuśca vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | yadi syāttacca kṛtyaṃ me dānaveśvara mā bhayam (?) | |5 3 | | mamāpi balamakṣayyaṃ tasmācca balavānaham | yo me bhayāt parityajya svaṃ rūpaṃ mṛgatāṃ gataḥ | |54| | yo hanyāddhastinaṃ saṃkhye siṃhaṃ śarabhameva ca | tasya kāsthā bhaveddaitya mṛge hyasminmahābala ||55|| madbhayāt sa varāhaśca sarvadevairadhiṣṭhitaḥ | māmāhvayati daityendra jaya eva tato hi me ||56|| bhavāneva hi me daitya tena dūtaḥ....| tvaratā mṛtyulokantu gatvā dānavapuṃgava ||57| | yadahaṃ mrātṛhantāraṃ dānavānāṃ bhayaṅkaram | ahatvā na nivartiṣye śape satyena dānava ||58|| sanatkumāra uvāca sūtaṃ tataḥ samādiśya rathaṃ sajjamacīkarat | samāśvāsayituṃ patnīḥ sa viveśa punargṛhān ||59|| sa tatra tābhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalastadā diteḥ sutām̐stām̐śca nirīkṣya sarvaśaḥ | gṛhāṇa sarvaṃ raṇayogyamujjvalaṃ mahābalaḥ śatrunivāraṇakṣamam ||8.104.60 || iti skandapurāṇe vipracittipātane caturuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.105> sanatkumāra uvāca sa dhanvī kavacī bhūtvā baddhagodhāṃgulitravān | baddhapṛṣṭheṣudhī caiva śarī khaṅgī mahābalaḥ ||1|| hariśmaśruścaturdaṃṣṭraḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahāhanuḥ | ājānubāhurdīrghākṣo nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalaḥ ||2|| hastayoḥ padmaśaṃkhau ca cakramatsyau ca pādayoḥ | dadhāno jālahastaśca jālapādolpamehanaḥ ||3|| bālādityanibhākṣaśca añjanācalasannibhaḥ | sa niryayau tadā vyāsa bhṛkuṭībhūṣitānanaḥ ||4|| dvāryapaśyacca sūtena rathaṃ samupakalpitam | sahasranalvamātrañca hayairdivyaissamanvitam | |5 || sahasrairdaśabhirvyāsa sarvopakaraṇānvitam | khaṭvāṅgena ca saṃyuktaṃ dhvajenādityavarcasā | | 6 | | āruroha jayetyukto dānavairbahubhistadā | divākaro rathaṃ yadvad bhagavān tejasāṃ patiḥ | |7| | vibabhau sa tadārūḍho rathaṃ taṃ ditinandanaḥ | sauvarṇe bhājane yadvadindranīlaṃ samarpitam | |8 | | kirīṭastvābabhau tasya śirasthaḥ sumahādyutiḥ | yathāñjanagireḥ śṛṅge dāvāgniḥ samavasthitaḥ | | 9| | sañcodayacca yantāraṃ sa daityo gamanaṃ prati | tasya pārśvebhavad vyāsa vipracittiravasthitaḥ | |8.105.1 0 | | ketoriva yathā vyomni pratiketuravasthitaḥ | śaṃkhabherīmṛdaṅgaiśca murajairveṇubhistathā | | 11 | | vādyamānairyayau rājā hiraṇyākṣośmakātpurāt | agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva pārśvayorubhayorapi | | 12 | | jagmuḥ sarvesurā vyāsa bhāskarasya yathā grahāḥ | nirgacchamānaśca purāt śakuntān bhayaśaṃsinaḥ | | 13 || apaśyad vyāsa daityendro na ca tānakarodadhṛdi | ācchinat tasya panthānaṃ bhujaṅgaḥ kṛṣṇadehavān | | 14| | gṛdhraśca raktavaktrosya nililye dhvajamūrdhani | gṛdhraścakrāyate cāsya rathasyopari gacchataḥ | | 1 5| | dhvajaścābhajyata mahān rathasya sumahāprabhaḥ | vāmaṃ cāṅgaṃ sphuratyasya śarīrasya muhurmuhuḥ | | 1 6| | heṣante na hayā dīnā hastino vimadābhavan | etānyanyāni ca bahūni daityo munisattama | |17|| sovaikṣata nimittāni bhayadānyātmanosakṛt | nātidūre sa nirgatya nagarasya mṛgeśvaram ||1 8|| apaśyad dānavaḥ saṃkhye yudhyamānamabhītavat | sopi daityavaraḥ śrīmān krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ||1 9| | visphārayanmahācāpaṃ rathenābhyapatadbalī| varāhopi mahābāhurvidrāvya ditinandanān | suvarṇākṣaṃ prati ruṣā vegenaivābhyadhāvata | |8.105.20 | | tasyāpatata evāśu dānavaḥ sumahābalaḥ | sarvasandhiṣu tīkṣṇāgrānnicakhāna bahūñcharān | |21 | | sāyakaistairvinirbhinnaḥ sarvasandhiṣu suvrata | na cacāla mṛgendrosau viṣṭabdhaḥ samatiṣṭhata ||22|| taṃ stambhitaṃ tadā vyāsa dṛṣṭavā devā mahābalam | viśalyakaraṇairmantrairviśalyamabhicakrire | |23 | | sa viśalyastadā devaiḥ kṛto mṛgapatirmahān | punarvegaṃ mahat kṛtvā jagāma ditijaṃ prati ||24| | sa vadhyamāno bahubhiśśarairmṛgapatirmahān | daityendrarathamāsādya iyeṣa rathamavyayaḥ | |25 || grahītuṃ nādayan vyāsa bahudhā viśvarūpadhṛk | yantā ca maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā bhrāmayāmāsa taṃ ratham ||26|| prasāritakaraṃ daityo mṛgaṃ taṃ sumahābalam | babandhāstreṇa nāgānāṃ sa baddho nyapatad bhuvi ||27|| patitaṃ tañca daityendrā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ | vijaghnurbhṛśamāyastā bahudhā krodhamūrchitāḥ ||28 || taṃ baddhaṃ vadhyamānañca patitaṃ nandivardhanam | garutmān bhujagendrebhyaḥ kṣiprameva vyamocayat ||29|| muktaśca sa tadotpatya drāvayāṇo diteḥ sutān | hiraṇyākṣarathaṃ tūrṇamabhyadhāvanmahāyaśāḥ || 8.105.30 | | taṃ dhāvantaṃ punardaityaḥ śareṇānataparvaṇā | vivyādha hṛdaye vyāsa nardamāno yathāmbudaḥ ||3 1 | | mṛgeśvaraśca bhinnosau hṛdaye mohamāsthitaḥ | papāta bhūmau nirvṛtte śakradhvaja ivotsave ||3 2|| tato hāhā kṛtaṃ sarvaiḥ sametairdevapuṃgavaiḥ | ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuścainaṃ bhāskaraścāprabhobhavat | |3 3 | | atha sopyāyitastatra ṛṣibhirbrahmavittamaiḥ | pratilabhya tadā saṃjñāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||34|| āpyāyayadhvaṃ māṃ kṣipraṃ mūḍhohaṃ sarvaśaḥ surāḥ | nālpavīryeṇa śakyoyaṃ daityo yodhayituṃ raṇe || 35 || tataste daivatāssarve ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | tapasā svena taṃ devaṃ sarva evābhyapūrayan ||3 6| | tasya tvāpyāyamonasya ṛṣibhirdaivataiśca ha | babhau rūpaṃ yugāntāgnikālamṛtyusamaprabham | |37| | sa dīpyamāno vibabhau mahātmā devaiśca sarvairṛṣibhiḥ stutaśca | dīptastadā bhāskarasaptakalpo lokāndahiṣyanniva devadevaḥ ||38|| iti skandapurāṇe varāhāpyāyane pañcottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.106> sanatkumāra uvāca sa tathāpyāyito vyāsa balavānbhāskaradyutiḥ | citraṃ bahu ca śīghraṃ ca maṇḍalāni paribhramat | |1 | | plutāni siṃhavat kṛtvā avalokayate sakṛt | pṛṣṭhataścāgrataścāpi punargajavadācarat | |2| | punarvyāttānano bhūtvā śastrāṇi grasate ripoḥ | punarvṛkṣaiḥ śilābhiśca dānavān sa nyasūdayat | |3 | | punarākāśago bhūtvā pakṣirāḍiva sobhramat | punarjahāsa saṃkruddho hyaśanīpātasannibham ||4|| punaśca sūkṣmamātmānaṃ kṛtvā tasthāvathāgrataḥ | evantaṃ valgamānañca nardamānañca dānavaḥ ||5|| uvāca bhṛkuṭīvaktro hiraṇyākṣobhinādayan bho kṣudramṛga durbuddhe na tvaṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi || 6| | hatvā tvāhaṃ pradāsyāmi rudrāya balimojasā | tvayā hataśchadmanā me bhrātā jyeṣṭho durātmanā | tasyādya karmaṇaḥ prāptaṃ phalaṃ duṣṭātmanastava ||7| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hiraṇyākṣasya saṃyuge | uvāca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ krodhayāno diteḥ sutam ||8 | | hatosau narasiṃhena mayā daityaḥ pratāpavān | vikramya saṃyuge tadvada bhavatopi vadho dhruvaḥ | |9| | yadi tvaṃ gacchase khaṃ vā pātālaṃ vāpyataḥ param | parvataṃ vodadhiṃ vāpi na tathāpi vimokṣyase || 8.106.10 || yatte balaṃ tapo yacca yā ca māyā tavāsura | tatsarvaṃ nirdhamāmyadya tava dehāt sajīvitam ||1 1 || hiraṇyākṣa uvāca tvaṃ mayā śaraviṣṭabdho devairmantrairvimokṣitaḥ | baddhaṃ cāstreṇa bhūyastvāṃ pakṣirājo vyamocayat ||1 2|| bhūyo mṛtastvaṃ durbuddhe devairujjīvito bhavaḥ | bhūyastvāhaṃ vadhiṣyāmi siṃho mṛgamivājane ||13 || tava kā śaktiradyeha maheśvaramṛte varam | māṃ spraṣṭumapi hastena narasyeva hutāśanam ||14|| tvaṃ lokamayamāsthāya śarīraṃ tairadhiṣṭhitam | sarvairāpyāyitaścaiva saṃyuge māmupāgataḥ || 1 5|| ahantu svena tapasā balena ca samanvitaḥ | na ca māṃ tvaṃ tathāpyadya śaktaḥ siṃhaṃ yathā mṛgaḥ ||16|| yoddhuṃ vāpyabhisartuṃ vā saha devairdurātmavān | na tvāvayoretadeva hyantaraṃ sumahattaram ||17|| yaḥ syāt kulīno vidvānvā satāṃ mārge ca saṃsthitaḥ | sonenaiva jitaṃ matvā ātmānaṃ saṃyugaṃ tyajet ||18|| nirghṛṇastyaktalajjaśca chidraghātī durātmavān | tvadanyaḥ ko bhavettiryaṅa naitaddaityasya vidyate ||19|| na tvaṃ mama kṛto mṛtyurahantu tava saṃyuge | ete siddhāḥ prapaśyantu cāraṇāśca sahasraśaḥ | āvayorantaraṃ saṃkhye bahudhā yudhyamānayoḥ ||8.106.20 || sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā hiraṇyākṣaḥ śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ | jaghne varāhaṃ saṃkruddho vajrāśanisamatviṣam ||21 || sotha tenārdyamānopi varāhaḥ sumahābalaḥ | gatvā vegena saṃkruddho rathaṃ jagrāha nādayan ||22| | gṛhītvā kūbare cāpi ākṣipyotkṣipya vegavat | sāśvaṃ sasārathiṃ devaścikṣepa ca rarāsa ca ||23 || tasya tvākṣepavikṣepaiśchinnayoktrāśca te hayāḥ | udbhrāntā rathamukhyaśca visandhiḥ samapadyata ||24|| hiraṇyākṣo rathaṃ tyaktvā padātirdhanuṣā tadā | mṛgendraṃ mohanāstreṇa balavānabhyatāḍayat ||25|| mohaḥ samāviśaccaiva taṃ devaṃ nandivardhanam | devairmantraprabhāveṇa naṣṭamohaḥ kṛtaḥ punaḥ ||26|| eṣa śastrai rbahuvidhairdetyendro hi ruṣānvitaḥ | ājaghāna na cāpyenaṃ rujā sa samayojayat ||27|| athainaṃ sa mahātejā varāhaḥ prahasanniva | vṛkṣamutpāṭya vegena daityaṃ mūrdhni vyatāḍayat ||28|| tasya tena prahāreṇa daityasyābhihatasya ha | dhanuḥ papāta vegena hastāvāpaśca pañcakaḥ ||29|| tato hāhā kṛtaṃ daityairdānavaiśca suduḥkhitaiḥ | śastraiśca bahubhiḥ kruddhā varāhaṃ samatāḍayan ||8.106.3 0 || sa hanyamānastairdaityairvyadāya sumahābalaḥ | mukhaṃ sarvāṇi śastrāṇi jagrāsa ca rarāsa ca ||3 1|| tattathā vikṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā hiraṇyākṣaḥ pratāpavān | śūlaṃ jagrāha saṃkruddhaḥ kṛtvā rudrāya vai namaḥ ||3 2|| tadyugāntānalaprakhyaṃ mahāśūlamatiprabham | cikṣepa daityaḥ saṃkruddho varāhāya mahāsvanam ||3 3 | | tamāpatantaṃ bahudhā nadantaṃ jvālāḥ sphuliṅgāśca samudgirantam | dṛṣṭvā surāḥ siddhagaṇāśca sarve hāheti cakrurbhayamūḍhacittāḥ | |34|| iti skandapurāṇe triśūlākṣepaṇe ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.107> sanatkumāra uvāca tamāpatantaṃ vegena na śūlaṃ dṛṣṭavānmṛgaḥ | daityasandhe samāsaktaḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkaram ||1 || alakṣitena tenāsau śūlenāditinandanaḥ | vibhinno hṛdaye vyāsa mṛtakalpaḥ papāta ha ||2|| tato hāhā kṛtaṃ bhūtairadṛśyairmunisattama | udvelāḥ sāgarāścāsan bhāskaraścāprabhobhavat ||3|| ulkāḥ petuśca sarvatra mlānamālyāḥ surābhavan | grahāṇāmabhavadyuddhaṃ vimānāni ca petire ||4|| jajapurmunayaḥ sarve varāhe patite tadā | mahādevaṃ namaskṛtya brahmā sasmāra taṃ tadā ||5|| tato vitimiraṃ sarvamabhavat pūrvavacchubham | mahādevaṃ namaskṛtya varāhaścodatiṣṭhata ||6|| tejo māheśvaraṃ divyaṃ viveśa madhusūdanam | sopyāyitatanustena śūlaṃ niṣkṛṣya mādhavaḥ ||7|| sahasānalasaṃkāśo babhūva sa mahābalaḥ | tatastenaiva śūlena taṃ daityaṃ devanandanaḥ ||8|| jaghāna hṛdaye kruddhaḥ krauñcaṃ śaktyā yathā guhaḥ | sa bhinnahṛdayastena varāheṇa mahāsuraḥ | |9| | nārttimānabhavad vyāsa kṛcchre vidvāniva sthitaḥ | madhye bhinnaṃ sa tacchūlaṃ niṣkṛṣya ca visṛjya ca || 8.107.10 | | khaṅgaṃ niṣkṛṣya vegena varāhaṃ mūrdhnyatāḍayat | sa tena suprahāreṇa varāho nandivardhanaḥ | |1 1 | | nārtimānabhavad vyāsa babhūva rudhirāplutaḥ | nānādhātuvicitrosau himavāniva parvataḥ | |1 2|| babhau varāho devātmā sarvāsuravimardanaḥ | punarāhantukāmasya tasya daityasya suvrata | | 13 | | apahastaprahāreṇa khaṅgaṃ hastādapātayat | akurvātāṃ tato yuddhaṃ niyuddhakuśalāvubhau | |14|| tau gajāviva saṃkruddhau mahiṣāviva darpitau | siṃhāviva ca nardantau saṃkruddhau vṛṣabhāviva ||1 5| | śarabhāviva cāyastau śārdūlāviva nirghṛṇau | parasparamayudhyetāṃ parasparajayaiṣiṇau | |1 6 | | aṃkuśairhastayoktraiśca kṣepaṇairapasarpaṇaiḥ | maṇḍalaiśca punaścitraiḥ karṣaṇairapakarṣaṇaiḥ || 17|| talaiśca muṣṭibhiścaiva bhujaissa caraṇairapi | nakhaiśca daśanaiścaiva tathānyaiśca mahābalau | | 18 | | tayorevamabhūdyuddhamubhayordevadaityayoḥ | ahāni daśa cāṣṭau ca tathānyāni caturdaśa | |19| | anyatsahasramevāsīdvarṣāṇāṃ tacca mānuṣam | eṣa kālobhavattatra tato daityobalobhavat ||8.107.20|| taṃ hīyamānamālakṣya daityādhipatimūrjitam | ākāśe vāguvācedamaśarīrāti susvanā ||21 || śṛṇu deva varāhedaṃ śrutvā caiva samācara | aśakyoyaṃ tvayā hyevaṃ hantuṃ daityo mahābalaḥ | |22|| abaloyaṃ kṛtaḥ krūro dhruvaṃ māheśvareṇa hi | tejasā paśya caivainameṣa kālosya vartate ||23 || muktvainaṃ daityarājānaṃ cakreṇa vinisūdaya | māheśvareṇa vaikuṇṭha tato mṛtyumavāpsyati ||24| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastamabhisaṃśrutya bhagavānnandivardhanaḥ | mumoca daityarājānaṃ pādenāhatya vakṣasi ||25|| sa muktastena devena vibabhau daityapuṃgavaḥ | bhuktamukto yathā sūryaḥ saiṃhikeyena rāhuṇā ||26|| bhagavānapi dīpyantaṃ śriyā daityaṃ samīkṣya tam | sasmāra tattadā cakraṃ namaskṛtya pinākinam ||27|| tataḥ sarvā diśo vyāsa vahnikuṇḍānibhā babhuḥ | śabdaśca sumahānāsīdyugāntāmbudasannibhaḥ | |28| | siddhāḥ petuśca medinyāṃ devām̐śca bhayamāviśat | svastyastu sarvabhūtānāmityūcurmunayastadā | |29|| sāgarāśca vyaśuṣyanta vineśurnāgapakṣiṇaḥ | daityāśca dānavāścaiva sarve te viviśurvilam | |8.107.3 0 || bhayatrastāni bhūtāni ulkāḥ peturnabhastalāt | āgacchati yugāntāgnikalpe cakre subhāsvare ||3 1|| kṣurāntaṃ tanmahācakraṃ majjajjalacarāntakam | durnirīkṣyaṃ sarvaghāti abhedyaṃ pratighāti ca ||32|| tathāpratihataṃ divyaṃ mohanaṃ sarvadehinām | karamāgādvarāhasya śatāśanisamasvanam | |3 3 | | tadāpatantaṃ saṃvīkṣya sarvabhūtāni sarvataḥ | peturbhūmau mahāghoramapaśyanna ca kiñcana ||34| | sopi devastadā kṛtvā rūpaṃ sumahadavyayam | trailokyavyāpi cikṣepa dānavaṃ prati nādayan | |3 5| | tadyugāntānalaprakhyaṃ kṣurāntaṃ sphoṭayannabhaḥ | jagāma dānavaṃ kṣipraṃ diśaḥ sarvā dahanniva ||3 6 || tat sa dānavaśārdūla upayāntaṃ mahāravam | jaghānāstrairbahuvidhairavyathaḥ śaktinandana || 37|| tacca tāni mahācakramastrāṇyanalasannibham | cakāra bhasmasād vyāsa jagāma ca vinādayan ||38|| atha māyāṃ samasṛjat taijasīṃ pārthivīmapi | vāyavīṃ vāruṇīñcaiva tāmasīmindriyātmikāmra ||39|| tathaivotpātakīṃ māyāṃ mohanīṃ stambhanīmapi | nivartanīṃ jambhanīṃ ca cakārānyāśca saṃyuge ||8.107.40 | | tāḥ sarvāstattadā cakraṃ nāśayad bhīmanādavat | gatvā tasya śiraḥ kāyādunmamātha yathācalam ||41 || tattena kṛttaṃ sumahacchirogryaṃ vyāttānanāgnipratimogranetram | daṃṣṭrālamatyadbhutabhīmanādaṃ papāta meroriva śṛṅgamuccam ||42 | | rathāṅganiṣpītavapurvirāgaṃ na bhāti tadvaktramatīva dīnam | niśāprahāṇe vinivṛttaraśmi vimbaṃ yathā candramaso viśobham | |43 | | taddantapaṃkticchadamādaśānaṃ muhuśca dantānapi saṃdaśānam | papāta daityasya śiro nikṛttaṃ yathā gireḥ śṛṅgamatipravṛddham ||44| | iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣavadhe saptottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ | <8.108> sanatkumāra uvāca tasminvinihate daitye surāḥ sarvebhituṣṭuvuḥ | ṛṣayaśca tapoyuktā puṣpavṛṣṭyaśca petire ||1|| devadundubhayo neduradṛśyāḥ sumahāsvanāḥ | bhūtānāṃ cābhavaccharma prakṛtisthaṃ jagadbabhau ||2|| jagāmādṛśyatāṃ cakraṃ tataḥ svasthābhavan surāḥ | ṛṣayaścaiva lokāśca daityaṃ taṃ dadṛśurhatam | |3|| asurā api te sarve puradvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ | pidhāya yatnāt sannaddhāḥ prākareṣvavatasthire ||4|| te bhītā muktakeśāśca rajodhvastā bhayārditāḥ | jīvitaṃ saṃ parīpsantaḥ sthitāḥ prākāragāstadā ||5|| bhagavānapi dīptārcirhaviṣeddha ivānalaḥ | bhīṣayānosurānsarvān pṛthivīmanvacinvata ||6 || sa bahiḥ sarvatonviṣya utpāṭya ca mahīruhān | praṇaṣṭāmiva gāṃ gopaḥ samantādanvacinvata ||7|| parvatānsa tadotpāṭya daityodyānānyacūrṇayat | ārāmān sa taḍāgāni babhañja ca rarāsa ca | |8|| tato dakṣiṇato gatvā muhūrttaṃ devasattamaḥ | śaṃkhaṃ parvatamāsādya nanarda jalado yathā ||9|| asurā hyapi te bhītāḥ prākārāntarasaṃsthitāḥ | avaikṣanta mṛgendraṃ taṃ dhāvantaṃ sarvatodiśaḥ | |8.108.1 0 || sopi devastadā śaṃkhamutpāṭya nagamuttamam | apaśyat pṛthivīṃ baddhāṃ rakṣyamāṇāṃ ca dānavaiḥ || 11 || sāgarāmbhasi vikṣipya śaṃkhaṃ taṃ parvatottamam | avadhīddānavān sarvān medinyā yebhirakṣiṇaḥ | |1 2|| tato vidrāvya nāgendrān pragṛhya pṛthivīṃ balāt | jagāma daityān sandhṛṣya ratnānyadāya sarvaśaḥ | |13 || sa tāṃ daṃṣṭrāṃkure lagnāṃ vahan bhāti mṛgeśvaraḥ | viṣāṇalagnāṃ lambantīṃ mṛṇālīṃ gajarāḍiva | |14|| sa tāṃ sāgaramadhyena vahanbhāti mṛgeśvaraḥ | varāharūpī kālānte brahmeva vasudhāṃ purā | |15|| sa sāgarantamuttīrya bhagavānnandivardhanaḥ | svasthāne sthāpayāmāsa mahīṃ tāṃ punareva hi | |16|| tataḥ śakrāya lokām̐strīnadāt sa madhusūdanaḥ | uvāca rājā tvannodya mitrañcāhaṃ tavānagha || 17|| yenyepi terayaḥ kecidbhaviṣyantyasureśvarāḥ | teṣāmapi vadhaṃ ghoraṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 1 8| | tatastamṛṣayaḥ sarve devatāśca savāsavāḥ | ūcuḥ svāṃ mūrttimāsthāya yathā pūrvaṃ tathā bhava | | 1 9| | varāha uvāca iyaṃ mūrttirmayā devāḥ prāptā paramavarccasā | na cānayā ratiḥ kācit prāptā me sadṛśī bhuvi | | 8.108.20 || sohaṃ kañcid vihṛtyeha kālaṃ mūrtyānayā sukham | bhaviṣyāmi punardevaḥ satyametad bravīmi vaḥ ||21 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ | pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya jagmuḥ sthānāni sarvaśaḥ |22||| gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu bhagavānnandivardhanaḥ | vijahāra sukhaṃ tatra hatvā dānavapuṃgavam ||23|| tasya tatropatiṣṭhantamṛgyo bhūtvā sahasraśaḥ | vaidikyopsarasaḥ śubhrāstābhissaha rarāma saḥ ||24|| sa tābhirvicarandevo mahātmā nandivardhanaḥ | reme matto mahānāgo yathāraṇye kareṇubhiḥ ||25|| sa siṃha iva siṃhībhiḥ śārdūla iva connadanan | rarāma sāgarānūpe airāvata ivāparaḥ ||26|| ramamāṇasya siddhāśca ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | puṣpāṇāṃ rucirā vṛṣṭīḥ pātayanti viyatsthitāḥ | |27|| tuṣṭuvuścāpare nityaṃ cakruścainaṃ pradakṣiṇam | devadundubhayo nityaṃ sarva evānvavādayan |28 nṛtyantyapsarasaścāsya varāhasyāgratastadā | vādayanti ca gandharvā gāyanti ca mahātmanaḥ ||29|| ramayanto varāhantaṃ devāścendrapurogamāḥ | yakṣāḥ puṇyajananā ye ca tathā devajanāśca ye ||8.108.3 0 || yātudhānāśca ye kecid brahmadhānāśca sarvaśaḥ | manuṣyāḥ paśavaścaiva ṛṣayaścaiva sarvaśaḥ | |21 || rājanyāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve nikāyāścaiva sarvaśaḥ | tatrājagmurnirīkṣanto varāhasyotsavaṃ śubham ||32|| bahvāścaryasamākīrṇaṃ bahvālakṣya sadaiva ca | evaṃ tasyābhavad vyāsa varāhasya mahātmanaḥ | utsavaḥ sumahān divyaḥ pratyahaṃ nandivardhanaḥ | |3 3 | | tasyotsovosau ṛṣisaṃghajuṣṭaḥ sadā suraiḥ siddhajanaiśca juṣṭaḥ | gandharvayakṣoragarākṣasaiśca vidyādharaiścaiva sahāpsarobhiḥ | | 34||| iti skandapurāṇe varāhotsave aṣṭottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.109> sanatkumāra uvāca tasya kālena mahatā ramataḥ śaktinandana | bhāryāyāṃ citralekhāyāṃ vṛkonāmābhavatsutaḥ ||1 | | sa vṛko balavānnityaṃ vicaran pṛthivīmimām | nardamānovadhīlloke bhūtāni śataśo mahān ||2 | | athāsasāda śailendra himavantaṃ mahāgirim | gaurīkūṭasamīpe ca kārtikeyālayaṃ śubhama | | 3 | | tamajānam̐stadābhyetya balenāvinayena ca | nādayāno drumāñchubhrān ratnahemavibhūṣitān ||4| | sarvartupuṣpaphaladān sarvakāmapradānapi | śilāmaṇimayāḥ śubhrāḥ śātakumbhamayāstathā | |5 || haritālamayāścānyāstathā mānaḥśilopālān | utpāṭyotpāṭya vegena babhañja rūṣito yathā | |6| | sa garjamānaḥ satataṃ gajo matta ivāparaḥ | babhañja tadvanaṃ śubhraṃ kārtikesya dhīmataḥ ||7| | tasya garjitaśabdena vanabhaṅgasvanena ca | skandasya gaṇapaḥ śūro nirjagāma sa mandirāt ||8| | kokavaktra iti khyāto dṛḍhaṃ skandasya vallabhaḥ | mahātmā balasaṃpanno gatvā vṛkamavaikṣata ||9|| sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahākāyaṃ taruṇaṃ priyadarśanama | jīmūtamiva nardantaṃ kiñcitprakupitānanam | |8.109.1 0 || uvāca vacanaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kokavaktro hasanniva | kasya tvamiha saṃprāpto bālo devagṛhaṃ śubham | 1 1|| na jānīṣe kimetattvaṃ skandasya sumahātmanaḥ | veśma devaissagandharvaiḥ sayakṣoragakinnaraiḥ ||1 2|| kṛtaṃ dayitabhatyarthaṃ gaṇaiścāpi supūjitam | kumāro mandaraṃ yātaḥ sarvaissaha gaṇeśvaraiḥ ||13 || rakṣārthaṃ māmiha sthāpya vārayāmi tato hi te | tuṣṭosmi tava rūpeṇa balena vapuṣā tathā ||14|| upāramasva tena tvā bravīmi sumahābala | ahaṃ kariṣye yad bhagnaṃ tathaiva punareva hi ||15|| vakṣye devaṃ ca taṃ samyak tvadarthaṃ śūkareśvara | yathā na kupyate tubhyaṃ prasādaṃ te karoti ca ||1 6|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛkaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ | uvāca kokavadanamidaṃ mṛgapatistadā ||17|| na bibhemi kumārasya tava vā pāpacetasaḥ | bale mama kumārosau na tulyaḥ sagaṇeśvaraḥ ||18|| yadvo balañca darpaśca tat kurudhvamaśaṃkitāḥ | nāmāvaśeṣametadvaḥ kartāhaṃ vanamantataḥ | |19|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa vṛkṣamutpāṭya haimaṃ vaidūryapallavam | kokavaktrāya cikṣepa nanāda ca yathā vṛṣaḥ | |8.109.2 0 | | tataḥ prahasya kokāsyastamevodgṛhya pādapam | vṛkaṃ taṃ tena saṃkruddhaḥ śirasyabhijaghāna ha ||21 || sa tena suprahāreṇa bhramitvā maṇḍalaṃ mṛgaḥ | papāta bhūmau niḥsaṃjño yathā śakradhvajo mahān ||22|| tatastaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭavā kokāsyaḥ prahasam̐stadā | babandha pāśairbahubhirveśma caiva praveśayat | |23 || taṃ vaddhaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭavā sahāyāstasya te mṛgāḥ | pradrutā sahasā sarve bhayārtā jīvitaiṣiṇaḥ | |24| | athāgāttena kālena gaṇapairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | kārtikeyo mayūreṇa kūjamānena sānugaḥ ||25| | tasya tat kathayāmāsa kokavaktro gaṇeśvaraḥ | vṛkaṃ ca darśayāmāsa pāśairbaddhaṃ mahābalam | |26| | kokavaktra uvāca bhagavan varāharūpasya sutaḥ śrīmān vṛkaḥ kila | hiraṇyākṣo hato yena dānavo devakaṇṭakaḥ ||27| | babhañjāyaṃ suduṣṭātmā sahitonyairvanaṃ tava | tataḥ pāśairmayā baddhaḥ kriyatāmasya yat param | |28|| skanda uvāca nāyaṃ śakyo mayādyeha moktuṃ mṛgakulādhamaḥ | mukte vaktavyatā loke bhaviṣyati na saṃśaya ||29| | devo māṃ vakṣyate vyaktaṃ skando bhīto na saṃśayaḥ | yo mumoca sutaṃ tasya varāhasya kṛtāgasam | |8.109.3 0 || ukto gataścāhamadya sthāṇunā paramātmanā | mā kṣamethā varāhasya tanuṃ tvā sau hvayedyadi | |3 1 || iyañca mama tenādya śaktirdattātibhāsvarā | saṃvarttiketi vikhyātā sarvāstrabalanāśanī ||3 2 || soyaṃ durātmā durvṛttaḥ sarvalokaprabādhakaḥ | gṛhyatāṃ vadhyatāṃ caiva kṣipramāviṣkṛtaṃ balāt (?) | | 33 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tata enaṃ bahissarve skandasya gaṇanāyakāḥ | baddhvā bahuvidhaiḥ pāśairyātayanta sahasraśaḥ ||34|| sa yātyamāno duḥkhārtto vilalāpa yathā naraḥ | nirayastho durācāraḥ karmabhiḥ svaiḥ supāśitaḥ ||3 5|| taṃ yātyamānaṃ sandṛśya nāradaḥ sumahātapāḥ | gatvā nyavedayattasya varāhasyāmitātmanaḥ | |36 || eṣa putro vṛkastubhyaṃ baddhaḥ pāśairanekaśaḥ | yātyate kārtikeyasya kiṅkarairduṣkṛtī yathā || 37| | na nāma tava devasya lokārthāyodyatasya ca | karoti sannatiṃ skando bālabhāvācca roṣataḥ | |38| | athavā svamalaṃ skando manyate balavattaram | tvattotmanastataḥ putraṃ tava pāśairbabandha ha ||39| | tadyāvadeva taṃ nāsau pramāpayati devapa | tāvadeva bhavān gatvā vimocayatu mā ciram ||8.109.40 | | sanatkumāra uvāca nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā varāho nandivardhanaḥ | jīmūta iva kālānte nanāda rūṣitānanaḥ ||41 || tasya krodhāttadā vahnirnetrābhyāmati dīptimān | niścakrāma jagat sarvaṃ saṃharanniva tejasā ||42| | utthāya cāsanāddevaḥ sahasaivonnirīkṣaṇaḥ | pratasthe śikharaṃ divyaṃ gauryā mṛgapatiḥ svayam | |43 || sa kampayanmahīṃ sarvāṃ stūyamāno mahātmabhiḥ | utpātānutthitān paśyan jagāmā vinivāritaḥ ||44| | gacchatastasya devasya panthānaṃ bhujagocchinat | daṃṣṭrā ca vṛkṣamāpatya papāta dharaṇītale | |45| | rudhiraṃ cāsravadvaktrāddhṛdayañca pravepata | bhayañcāsyābhavattatra vego yenābhihanyate | |46| | vāyavaḥ pratilomāśca urasā cāpatad bhuvi | snehaścāsya priyāṃ smṛtvā tadātyarthamajāyata ||47| | etām̐ścānyān subahuśa utpātān bhayasūcakān | anādṛtya mṛgendrosau jagāmaiva mahābalaḥ ||48|| taṃ prasthitamabhiprekṣya nimittāni ca suvrata | pūjāṃ sajjāmakurvante devaloke divaukasaḥ ||49| | sa siddhasaṃghairanugamyamāno yakṣaiśca gandharvamahoragaiśca | rakṣogaṇaiścāraṇakinnaraiśca jagāma gaurīśikharaṃ mahātmā | |8.109.50 || iti skandapurāṇe vṛkabandho nāma navottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.110> sanatkumāra uvāca vinirgamya kumāropi ramyāt svabhavanāttadā | rarāma gaṇapaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍanairbahubhiḥ śubhaiḥ | | 1 | | ānayāmāsa tañcāpi varāhasya sutaṃ prabhuḥ | vṛkaṃ vimucya pāśebhya utsasarja hasan vibhuḥ|| 2| | utsṛṣṭaṃ dhāvamānañca punarjagrāha vegitam | punarevotsṛjaccainaṃ jagrāha ca punaḥ punaḥ | evaṃ rarāma tenāsau varāhobhyāgamacca tam | |3 || śilāṃ gṛhītvā mahatīṃ saṃkruddhontakasannibhaḥ | cikṣepa kārttikeyāya nādayan jalado yathā ||4| | tāmāpatantīṃ bahudhā nadantīṃ vihāyasā mṛtyusamānarūpām | jagrāha vegena mahātivegāṃ kokāmukhaḥ prajvalitāmivolkām ||5| | tataścakraṃ sahasrāraṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham | vināyakasyāvyagrāya gaṇāya vyasṛjat prabhuḥ | |6 | | tadantakapratīkāśaṃ cakraṃ sarvasurāriham | viveśa (?) sagaṇastūrṇa tatastad vinyavartata | |7| | tannivṛttaṃ punaścakramakṛtvā kāryamujjvalam | na jagrāha tadā viṣṇuravamene ca tattadā | |8| | tattadānacitaṃ tena cakra dānavaghātinā | viṣṇunā prayayau kṣipraṃ svameva bhavanaṃ prati ||9|| tasmiñcakre tadā yāte bhagavānnandivardhanaḥ | vṛkṣamutpāṭya vegena kumāramabhijaghnivān | | 8.110.10 || agaṇya taṃ prahārantu bhagavānanalātmajaḥ | śaktiṃ saṃvarttikāṃ krodhāccikṣepa ca nanāda ca | | 11 || sā dahantīva tejāṃsi nadantī bahudhā tadā | hantuṃ varāhaṃ prayayau śaktirdivya ivāśugaḥ | | 12|| tāmāpamantīṃ vegena bhagavānnnandivardhanaḥ | jaghānāstrairbahuvidhairnādayan siṃharāḍiva || 13 || tāni sā bhasmasāt kṛtvā śaktiḥ saṃvarttikā śubhā | viveśa hṛdayaṃ tasya kāminīva dṛḍhaṃ priyā | | 14|| sa tayā bhinnahṛdayo yogena parameṇa ha | yogīva dehaṃ taṃ tyaktvā dehenānyena tasthivān ||1 5|| sonyaddehaṃ samāsthāya paurāṇaṃ surasattamaḥ | devaiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛto jagāma bhavamandiram | |1 6| | tatrāpaśyanmahādevaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam | candralekhāṃśujālaughanirastatimirotkaram ||17|| bhadrapīṭhe samāsīnaṃ kāñcane maṇibhūṣaṇe | bhrājamānaṃ śriyātyarthaṃ pārvatyā pārśvasaṃsthayā ||18|| gaṇaiśca vividhākārairbahubhiḥkāmarūpibhiḥ | nṛttagītapriyairnityaṃ samantāt parivāritam ||19|| taṃ dṛṣṭavā śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuḥ prasannenāntarātmanā | tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stotrairidañcovāca susvaram | |8.110.20|| vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya tvattejobṛṃhitena me | raṇe vikramya bhagavan hiraṇyākṣo niṣūditaḥ ||21|| tvaṃ deva kāraṇaṃ nityaṃ saṃbhūteḥ pralayasya ca | tvayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ jagadavyaktamūrttinā ||22|| tvatprasādena deveśa brahmāhaṃ śakra eva ca | pūjyāḥ sma loke satataṃ tathaivānye divaukasaḥ | |23|| tvayi prīte mahādeva sarve prītā vayaṃ prabho | tvayi kruddhe vināśo no bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||24|| stuvantamevaṃ bhagavān viṣṇuṃ candrārdhaśekharaḥ | sahasrasūryatejaskaḥ prītaḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ ||25|| bhaktyā tuṣṭosmi te viṣṇo devakāryodyamena ca | varaṃ varaya bhadrante yaste manasi vartate ||26|| viṣṇuruvāca yadi tuṣṭosi no deva yadi deyo varaśca naḥ | yattat pāpaharaṃ divyaṃ vratamādeṣṭumarhasi ||27|| yadāśritya vayaṃ sarve saśakrāssārvakāmikam | yuddhe jeṣyāma daiteyān duḥkhaśokavivarjitāḥ ||28|| devadeva uvāca hanta vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi guhyametat sanātanam | vrataṃ pāśupataṃ divyaṃ yena kāmānavāpsyatha | |29|| ityuktvā devadeveśo devānāṃ hitakāmyayā | yayau divamathāmantrya devīṃ girivarātmajām ||8.110.30 | | atha himagiritulyacārumūrttiṃ vṛṣabhavaraṃ bhagavām̐stadādhirūḍhaḥ | suragaṇasahitaḥ prabhussumeruṃ vratamupadeṣṭumanā jagāma śarvaḥ ||31|| iti skandapurāṇe hiraṇyākṣavadhe varāharūpasaṃhāre devadevasya devalokagamanaṃ nāma daśottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.111> vyāsa uvāca gate divaṃ mahādeve vratamādeṣṭumuttamam | ekākinī mahādevī kiñcakre tadanantaram | | 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca gate divaṃ mahādeve devīṃ girivarātmajām | upatasthurmahābhāgā devyo lokasya mātaraḥ | |2| | bharatasya sutāgnestu mālinītyabhiviśrutā | śucāvatī ca devasya parjanyasya sutāvyayā | | 3 || sāvitrī vedamātā ca gāyatrī durgayā saha | śrīḥ kīrtiścaiva lakṣmīśca dhṛtiḥ prajñā tathaiva ca ||4| | khyātirditirdanuścaiva aditiḥ siṃhikā khaśā | rākā kuhūḥ sinīvālī tathaivānumatiḥ śubhā || ||5| | gaṅgā sarasvatī caiva tathānyāḥ saritaḥ śubhāḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva yāḥ patnyo devānāṃ yakṣarakṣasām | uragāṇāṃ khagānāñca gandharvāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | | 6|| etāssarvāstathāgamya namaskṛtya ca pārvatīm | papracchuḥ sarvadharmajñā dharmaṃ dharmārthasaṃśritāḥ | |7|| kena dharmeṇa deveśe tapasā vā śubhānane | sumahat prāpya puṇyaṃ kiñcākṣayyaṃ prakīrtitam | |8 || devyuvāca yuṣmākantu hitārthāya lokānāñcaiva suvratāḥ | kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ dharmaṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | |9| | annadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ naiva kiñciddhi vidyate | annād bhavanti bhūtāni tasmāttadadhikaṃ smṛtam || 8.111.10 || annaṃ yastu susaṃskṛtya prayaccheta dvijātaye | sa sarvakāmānāpnoti pūjyate ca triviṣṭape || 11 || mayūrahaṃsayuktena sarvakāmasamṛddhinā | vimānenārkabhāsena annado yāti vai divam | | 12 || yadi mānuṣyamāyāti kadācit sa narottamaḥ | dhanadhānyasamākīrṇaḥ kulīnaḥ syācca rūpavān || 13 | | yathāśakti tu yo dadyād divase divase naraḥ | sa tena karmaṇāpnoti prajāpatisalokatām | | 14|| kadācidapi yo dadyādannaṃ viprāya saṃskṛtam | tasyāpi tacchataguṇaṃ sahasraguṇameva ca || 1 5| | upatiṣṭhati lokeṣu ihāpi ca sukhī bhavet | avadhūtamavajñātamasatkṛtamathāpi ca | |1 6 || annaṃ pradadyādyo devyo yādṛśaṃ tādṛśaṃ śubhāḥ | tasyāpi narake ghore yātyamānasya rākṣasaiḥ || 17| | upatiṣṭheta bahudhā tṛptiryenāsya jāyate | yadi mānuṣyamāyāti kadācit sa naraḥ punaḥ | | 18| | mleccheṣu bhogī bhavati ramate ca yathāmaraḥ | annemevaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ hi tasmānna paramaṃ bhuvi | | 19 | | annaṃ prajāpatiḥ proktaṃ sa ca saṃvatsaro mataḥ | saṃvatsaraśca yajñosau yajñe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | |8.111.2 0 | | tasmād bhavanti bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | tasmādannaṃ viśiṣṭhantu sarvebhya iti vai śrutiḥ || 21 || annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ naiva kiñciddhi vidyate | annād bhavanti bhūtāni tasmāttadvai praśasyate | |22 || sugandhāḥ śītalāścāpo rasairdivyaiḥ samanvitāḥ | yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyastasya dānaphalaṃ śṛṇu | |23 | | vimānaṃ sūryasaṃkāśamapsarogaṇanāditam | sodhirūhya divaṃ yāti varuṇasya salokatām ||24|| tatrāsāvayutānyaṣṭāvuṣitvā devavat sukhī | kule mahatyasaṃkīrṇo jāyate dhanadhānyavān | |25|| āpāntu pūrṇaṃ yo bhāṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati | rasāstasyopatiṣṭhanti pūjyate ca divaṃ gataḥ ||26| | bhājanāni ca yo dadyāt supūrṇāni śubhānanāḥ | bhājanaṃ syāt sa bhogānāṃ tārayecca pitṝn bhayāt | |27| | taḍāgaṃ yastu kurvīta apāṃ devyaḥ samṛddhimat | apaḥ pibanti vai yatra sarve jantava eva ca ||28| | tārayitvā ca sa pitṝm̐stathaiva ca pitāmahān | prapitāmahām̐śca lokeṣu kamikeṣu vihaṅgamaḥ ||29|| carate devavaddevyo varṣāyutaśatāni ṣaṭ | punaśca mānuṣe loke sarvarogavivarjitaḥ ||8.111.3 0 || bhogī bhavati bhogānāṃ rājamātraśca jāyate | dātā yajyā ca balavān suprabhaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 31 | | avaṭaṃ yo naraḥ kuryādapāṃ pūrṇaṃ śucismitāḥ | dadyācca brāhmaṇebhyastaṃ bhojayitvā yathārthavat | |3 2| | aṣṭābhiśca vicitrābhiḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam | dhvajena vaijayantyā ca puṣpaiśca samalaṃkṛtam | |3 3 || sa tārayitvā tu pitṝn vimānena narottamaḥ | yātyapsaropagītena varuṇasya salokatām ||34|| hiraṇyaṃ hema bhūmiṃ vā tilān ratnāni vāpi yaḥ | pradadyāt sarvabhūtebhyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||35| | sa vimānena mahatā sarvalokasamanvitaḥ | indrasya lokaṃ saṃprāpya modate vibudho yathā | |3 6|| tataścyutaśca dharmātmā sarvakāmasamṛddhimān | kule mahati lokesau jāyate subhagaśca ha | | 37|| yastu vṛkṣaṃ prakurute chāyāpuṣpaphalopagam | pathi devyo naraḥ somye sa tārayati vai pitṝn | | 38|| tathaiva dattvā viprebhyo niṣkrīya ca punarnaraḥ | sa yat phalamavāpnoti tacchṛṇudhvaṃ mahāprabhāḥ | | 39 | | yāvad vṛkṣasya puṣpāṇi upayuñjanti dehinaḥ | phalāni caiva bhakṣyante jantubhiḥ phalitasya tu | |8.111.40 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tārayitvā pitṝnapi | somalokaṃ samāsādya somṛtaṃ phalamāpnuyāt | |41 || phalāni yaḥ prayaccheta brāhmaṇebhyassamāhitaḥ phalānāṃ sa tu bhāgī syādbahūnāṃ subhagaśca ha | |42 || kāṣṭhāni yaḥ prayaccheta hemante narasattamaḥ | brāhmaṇebhyastadā devyaḥ sognilokaṃ samaśnute | |43 | | bhājanaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta haimaṃ ratnavibhūṣitam | sopsaraḥśatasaṃkīrṇe vimāne divi modate | |4 4| | rājataṃ yaḥ prayaccheta viprebhyo bhājanaṃ śubhāḥ | sa gāndharvapadaṃ prāpya urvaśyā saha modate | |55 | | tāmraṃ yo bhājanaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ | sa bhaved yakṣarājasya yakṣo balasamanvitaḥ | |46 | | gṛhaṃ yastu prayaccheta sarvakāmasamṛddhimat | sa lokaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya sarvakāmairniṣevyate | |47| | sarvakoṭīḥ sa tatroṣya catasrastena karmaṇā | gṛhamedhī yadā dātā bhogavām̐ścaiva jāyate | |48| | oṣadhīryaḥ prayaccheta dhānyāni vividhāni ca | sa sarvakāmasaṃmṛṣṭaṃ somalokaṃ samaśnute | |49 | | tatra varṣasahasrāṇi sapta sthitvā punarnaraḥ | iha sarva dhanopeto bhogāvānabhijāyate | |8.111.5 0 | | yastu kṣetraṃ prayaccheta niṣpannaṃ phalavatpunaḥ | sa tu kṣetrapatirbhūtvā prājāpatyaṃ samaśnute ||51 || yastu bhūmiṃ prayaccheta brahmaṇāya mahātmane | sa sarvalokeṣu sukhī vimānena suvarcasā | |52| | bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi carate kāmarūpavān | yaddhi mānuṣyamāyāti sa naraḥ kālaparyayāt | |53 || tatra kāmaduhā tasya mahī bhavati sarvaśaḥ | yastu vastraṃ prayaccheta brāhmaṇāya mahāyaśāḥ || 54| | sa lokaṃ prāpya vairājaṃ varṣakoṭiṃ sukhaṃ vaset | āsanaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta saṃvītaṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ||55| | sa rājyasthānamāpnoti svargaṃ cāpnoti vijvaraḥ | yastu śayyāṃ prayaccheta svāstīrṇāṃ narasattamaḥ ||56| | sa tu bhāryāḥ priyā devyo bahvīrbhaktāḥ samaśnute | yastu kanyāṃ prayaccheta brāhmaṇāya svalaṃkṛtām ||57||| sa gatvā pitṛlokaṃ vai varṣāyutaśataṃ vaset | iha cāpi punarjātaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ | |58|| bhāryāḥ prāpnoti bhaktāśca prajāvām̐ścopajāyate | aśvaṃ yastu prayaccheta hemacitraṃ sulakṣaṇam | |59 | | sa tena karmaṇā devyo gāndharvaṃ lokamaśnute | rathamaśvaṃ gajaṃ dāsīṃ kanyāṃ gṛhamathāpi ca | |8.111.60 || bhūmiñca yaḥ prayaccheta sa rājā bhuvi jāyate | ….............|| 61 || vidhinā mantrayuktena tasya dharmaphalaṃ mahat | sarvakāmadughā sāsya dhenurbhūtvopatiṣṭhati ||62|| jaladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāt tasya dānaphalaṃ mahat | prāpāṃ śubhāṃ taḍāgaṃ vā kūpaṃ vāpi supuṣkalam | |63 | | kṛtvā kumbhān susaṃpūrṇān gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtān | puṣpaiśca vivadhākārairabhyarcya dvijasattamān | |64|| bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ suptṛptām̐stān tilapātrāṇi dāpayet | dakṣiṇāṃ puṣkalāṃ dādyat tebhyastāṃ sparśayettataḥ ||65|| āpaḥ śivāśca saumyāśca tarpayantu pitṝnmama | kāmagāḥ kāmadātāro bhavantu pitaraḥ sadā | |66|| evaṃ dattvā tu tāṃ dhenuṃ punaḥ krītvā ca vai tadā | vāhayettat prapāṃ devyo brahmalokasamarpaṇīm || 67| | tilapātrāṇi dattvā ca tathā vastrayugaṃ navam | suvarṇasya ca sānnidhyaṃ phalāni vividhāni ca ||68| | tato dadyācchuciḥ snāto brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi | ................| |69 | | ghṛtaṃ gāvaḥ prasūyante ghṛtaṃ bhūmyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam | ghṛtamagniśca devāśca ghṛtaṃ me saṃpradīyatām | |8.111.70 | | evaṃ vidhānato dattvā brahmalokamavāpnuyāt | yo naro gāṃ prayaccheta savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanīm | |71 | | hemaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ dukūlakṣaumavāsitām | | śayyāstaraṇasaṃpannāṃ bahupuṣpaphalairyutām ||72 | | brāhmaṇāṃstarpayitvā tu gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtām | dānakāle tatastasyāḥ surā gātrāṇi saṃśritāḥ |73 | | brahmā tasyāḥ sthito mūrdhni śakropānaṃ samāśritaḥ | candrādityau ca netrasthau ghrāṇe vāyuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||74| | mukhaṃ tasyāḥ śrito vahnirjihvā somaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | karṇayostu diśaḥ sarvāḥ śirā rudrāḥ samāśritāḥ ||75| | pādayorlokapālāśca sarvesthīni ca parvatāḥ | samudrāssapta jaṭhare grīvāyāṃ tapanāḥ śritāḥ | |76 | | sāsnāṃ gaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā pārśvayorvasavaḥ śubhāḥ | prajāpatirupasthaśca mūtraṃ tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ ||77| | purīṣaṃ śrīrabhūttasyā nāgāścāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ | sādhyā viśvetha lokāśca pucchamāśritya saṃsthitāḥ ||78|| mantrā yajñāśca dānāni yamāśca ṛṣibhissaha | nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva tārārūpāṇi yāni ca | |79| | gāyatrī caiva triṣṭup ca jagatī paṃktireva ca | anuṣṭubṛgyajuścaiva sāmānyātharvaṇaṃ tathā | |8.111.8 0 | | lokasya mātaraścaiva meghā varṣamathāpi ca | dharmo nārāyaṇaścaiva bhūtāni saritastathā | |8 1 | | romakūpāni saṃśritya tasyā devā vyavasthitāḥ | yakṣāśca rākṣasāścaiva piśācāḥ pakṣibhiḥ saha | |82 | | yajñāśca dakṣiṇāścaiva tathā cāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ | gandharvāśca mahātmāno ye cānyepyevamādayaḥ | |83 tasyā viṣāṇayorvyāsa sarva eva samāśritāḥ | phalāni yajñadānānāṃ gatayaśca pṛthagvidhāḥ | |84| | vatsaṃ samāśritāḥ sarve sarvaṃ devamayaṃ śubham | devairadhyāsitāṃ tāṃ tu sarvalokanamaskṛtām ||85|| viprebhyo mantravaddhaste pradadyāt susamāhitaḥ | kuśān suvarṇaṃ bījāni tilān siddhārthakām̐stathā ||86|| pradadyād gāṃ tatodbhistu mantreṇānena suvrata | sarvadevamayīṃ dogdhrīṃ sarvalokamayīṃ tathā ||87| | sarvalokanimittāya sarvalokahitāya ca | prayacchāmi mahāsatvāmakṣayāya śubhāmiti | |88|| evaṃ sa dattvā tāṃ gāṃ tu yatra yatra prajāyate | tatra tatra gatā sā taṃ jantuṃ tārayate bhayāt | |89| | sarva kāmaduhā caiva sarvalokapradā tathā | sarvajñānapradā caiva sarvayajñaphalā tathā | |8.111.90 || sarvāṃllokān tayā gatvā ramate ca yathāmaraḥ | iha jātaśca tāmeva kāmagāṃ saṃprapadyate | |9 1 | | sa tayā mānuṣo jāto gosahasrī mahābalaḥ | rūpavān dhanavāṃścaiva bahuputraśca jāyate | | 92 | | prasūyamānāṃ yo gāṃ tu dadyādubhayatomukhīm | yathoktena vidhānena sa jātismaratāṃ labhet | |93 || yastu gāṃ saṃprayaccheta brāhmaṇebhyo yathātatham | tamapyasau bhayārthebhyastrāyate narakādapi | |94| | kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca yo dadyād vratine brahmacāriṇe | pṛthivīphalamāpnoti yogaścāsya pravartate | |95 | | yogibhyo brahmacāribhyo brāhmaṇebhyo yatātmavān | yaḥ prayacchedāvasathaṃ sośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||96| | āptoryāmaṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ gosahasrañca vindati | smṛñca paramā labdhvā yogamāpnoti suvratāḥ | | 97| | kamaṇḍaluṃ tu yo dadyād brāhmaṇāya narottamaḥ |. sa tena karmaṇā devyo dharmanityatvamāpnute | |98| | vyādhitaṃ yastu viprarṣe dīnaṃ mūḍhamacetasam | uddhareta yathāśaktyā sa mucyed brahmahatyayā | |99|| yaḥ suvarṇa prayaccheta daridrāya dvijātaye | daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti devatāḥ | |8.111.1 00 || yaścaivemāni sarvāṇi dānānyuktāni kṛtsnaśaḥ | dadāti yugapaddevyaḥ sa pṛthvyāmekarāḍ bhavet || 101 | | idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ dadyāccaiva svaśaktitaḥ | paṭheta ca mahābhāgāḥ sopi gacchet triviṣṭapam | | 102 || iti skandapurāṇe ekādaśottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.112> devyuvāca devyāḥ śṛṇuta bhūyopi yathā dānaṃ vinā śubhāḥ | ayamevopavāsena yathā dharmobhilabhyate | | 1 | | ekabhaktena yo devyo māsaṃ mārgaśiraṃ kṣapet | sa tena karmaṇā devyo gomān bhavati nityaśaḥ | |2| | pauṣamāsena putrām̐śca bahūnāpnoti dhārmikān | māghamāse ca kurvāṇo bhūyaḥ prāpnoti vai priyāḥ | | 3 || ekabhaktantu kurvāṇaḥ phālgune māsi nityaśaḥ | strīṣu saubhāgyamāpnoti striyaśca paramapriyāḥ ||4| | yaḥ kṣapedekabhaktena caitramāsaṃ narottamaḥ | dhanadhānyasamṛddhe sa kule jāyeta rūpavān | |5| | vaiśākhaṃ yaḥ kṣapenmāsamekabhaktena mānavaḥ | yāti sa śreṣṭhatāṃ loke pūjito dhanavānapi || 6 || jyeṣṭhamūlaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktaṃ samācaret | bhrātṝṇāṃ bhavati jyeṣṭho bhogaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam | |7|| | āṣāḍhaṃ cāpi yo māsamekabhaktaṃ samācaret | sa rājño mānyatāṃ prāpya kāmānāpnoti puṣkalān | |8| | śrāvaṇe cāpi yo māse tathā caivācarennaraḥ | senāpatyaṃ sa saṃprāpya balavānabhijāyate | |9|| yastu bhādrapadaṃ māsamekabhaktaṃ samācaret | sa tena karmaṇā devyo dhanavānabhijāyate | | 8.112.10 || yopi cāśvayujaṃ māsamekabhaktena tiṣṭhati | vāṇijyaṃ phalate tasya kṛṣiḥ paśugaṇāstathā || 11 | | kārtikaṃ tvapi yo māsamekabhaktena tiṣṭhati | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya vahniloke mahīyate ||1 2 | | yaḥ kṣapedekabhaktena yāvajjīvaṃ narottamaḥ | vimānenārkavarṇena śakralokaṃ sa gacchati | | 13 | | saṃvatsaraṃ tu yaḥ pūrṇamekabhaktena tiṣṭhati | sa pārthivasamo bhūtvā mahīṃ pāti mahendravat || 14| | ahorātraṃ tūpavāsaṃ kuryādekaṃ narottamaḥ | daśānāṃ sa suvarṇānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti śobhitam | |1 5 | | māse māse tvahoratraṃ yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ | sa tena karmaṇā śuddho vidvān bhavati dhārmikaḥ | | 1 6| | caturdaśīmaṣṭamīṃ ca pakṣayorubhayorapi | ahorātraṃ kṣapedyastu samvatsaramaśeṣataḥ | | 17|| sa tena karmaṇā yuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ | na yāti narakaṃ devyo yamañca na sa paśyati || 1 8| | māse māse ca yaḥ kuryāt trirātrakṣapaṇaṃ budhaḥ | kauberaṃ lokamāsādya sa vindet paramaṃ sukham ||19| | caturthehani yo bhuṃkte prayatātmā śucirnaraḥ | gāndharvaṃ sa padaṃ prāpya modate śakravaddivi | |8.112.20 | | pañcamehani yo bhuṃkte pratimāsamatandritaḥ | vāyulokaṃ samāsādya svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ||2 1 || yo bhuṃkte divase ṣaṣṭhe nityaṃ niyamamāsthitaḥ | vāruṇaṃ lokamāsādya sopi vindet mahatpadam ||22|| saptamehani yo bhuṃkte jitadvandvo dṛḍhavrataḥ | ādityalokamāsādya sopi vindet mahatpadam ||23 || aṣṭame caiva yo bhuṃkte divase mānavaḥ śuciḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāsādya sa bhavet paramadyutiḥ ||24| | navamehani yo bhuṃkte naro niyamamāsthitaḥ | sa vasūnāṃ priyo bhūtvā carate vasubhiḥ saha ||25| | daśamehani bhuktvā tu daśāhasya phalaṃ labhet | aśvibhyāṃ ca samo bhūtvā sūryavajjvalate sadā ||26| | mānuṣyañca punaḥ prāpya daśabhāryā labheta saḥ | subarṇamakṣayaṃ caiva na cākāle mriyeta saḥ ||27|| ekādaśe tu yo bhuṃkte divase mānavaḥ śuciḥ | ekadaśyāḥ phalaṃ prāpya sa rudragaṇatāṃ labhet ||28|| sthitvā tatra śatānyaṣṭāvatisaukhyasamanvitaḥ | brāhmaṇatvamanuprāpya yajvā sa iha jāyate ||29|| dvādaśe divase yastu devyo bhuṃkte sadā naraḥ | dvādaśāhaṃ sa saṃprāpya śakralokamavāpnuyāt ||8.112.3 0 || tatroṣya sa sukhaṃ bhūya iha jāto narottamaḥ | rājā vā rājamātro vā dhanvā vā sumahān bhavet | | 31 | | trayodaśe tu yo nityamaśnāti divase naraḥ | vaset sa bhārgavasthānaṃ prāpya divyasukhānvitaḥ | |3 2 | | atha cenmānuṣo bhūyassa naro jāyate 'śubhāḥ | dhanadhānyasamākīrṇe jāyate satkule śubhaḥ ||3 3 || caturdaśa tu yo nityaṃ divasāni kṣapennaraḥ | tauṣitaṃ lokamāsādya bhaved gaṇapatirvaraḥ | | 34| | ardhamāsaṃ kṣapedyastu nityameva hyatandritaḥ | devarājena tulyosau bhūtvā svargevatiṣṭhati | | 3 5| | iha rājā mahābhūmau bhūya evābhijāyate | yastu māsaṃ kṣapeddhīro jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 3 6| | vimānena sa divyena apsarobhissamāvṛtaḥ | pūjyamāno yathā devaḥ stūyamānaśca sarvaśaḥ | | 37 | | jvalannādityasaṃkāśo nityaṃ sukhamupāśnute | sarvalokeṣu vasate bahūnyabdāyutāni tu | | 3 8| tato brahmasadaṃ prāpya brahmaṇā sa supūjitaḥ | brahmaloke nivasate yathā brahmā narottamaḥ | | 39 | | atha cetpunarāyāti brāhmaṇo bhavatīśvaraḥ | yogañca tatra labhate yogaiśvaryaṃ samaśnute | |8.112.40 | | yogīśassa tato bhūtvā śambhorgaṇapatirbhavet | sarveṣāṃ copavāsānāṃ vidhiṃ paramapuṇyadam | |41 | | devyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ mattonyaṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | snātaḥ śucirathācānto hutāgniḥ susamāhitaḥ ||42 | | dīkṣayitvā tathātmānamupavāsaṃ cared budhaḥ | snāyāttriṣavaṇaṃ caiva juhuyādagnimeva ca ||43|| vāgyato krodhano dānto dhārmikaḥ satyavāg ghṛṇī | japansadaiva gāyatrīṃ pavitrāṇi ca nityaśaḥ ||44|| rudrānatha gaṇān vāpi rātrau ca sthaṇḍileśayaḥ | kuśānāstīrya vidhivat strīśūdraiḥ parivarjitaḥ ||45|| samaśnīyāt tato devyo vītaśoko vimatsaraḥ | yāvantyahāni tiṣṭheta tāvadviprām̐stu bhojayet ||46| | tataḥ pūrṇe tu kāle vai brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ varam | sahasramathavā śaktyā pūjayitvā tu sarvaśaḥ ||47|| haviṣyaṃ bhojanaṃ dattvā gāśca vāsāṃsi ca kramāt | suvarṇaṃ tilapātraṃ ca ekaikasya pradāpayet | tatastatphalamāpnoti yadanyairdurlabhaṃ vrataiḥ ||48|| vṛṣabhaṃ yastu nīlāṅgamutsṛjeta narottamaḥ | anyaṃ vāpi mahābhāgāḥ sa pitṝm̐stārayennaraḥ ||49|| yāvanti tasya romāṇi vṛṣabhasya mahātmanaḥ | tāvantyeva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ||8.112.50|| tilapātrāṇi yo dadyādviprebhyaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ | amāvāsyāṃ samāsādya kṛṣṇānāṃ (?) susamāhitaḥ ||51|| sa pitṝm̐starpayitvā tu akṣayaṃ narapuṃgavaḥ | pitṛlokaṃ samāpnoti cirañca sukhamaśnute ||52|| upavāsavidhistveṣa kathito me śubhānanāḥ | cāndrāyaṇavidhiṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ||53|| yastu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryādyathoktaṃ susamāhitaḥ | sa somalokamāsādya somena samatāṃ vrajet ||54|| prājāpatyaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādekaśo bahuśopi vā | prajāpatisamo bhūtvā tasya loke mahīyate | |55| | yastu sāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ karoti narasattamaḥ | ātmānamuddharet kṛcchrāt sognilokaṃ ca gacchati | |56| | mahāsāntapanaṃ yaśca karoti sumahāmanāḥ | sarvajñatāmavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca vindati | |57|| tulāpuruṣakaṃ yaśca kurute dvijasattamaḥ | sa muktassarvapāpaistu gaccheta divamūrjitaḥ ||58|| atikṛcchreṇa tu naraḥ śarvasya bhavanaṃ vrajet | kṛcchrātikṛcchreṇa tathā gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt | |59| | yastu sarvāṇi kṛcchrāṇi kurute narasattamaḥ | sa yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ tameva samupāśnute || 8.112.60 | | yasya kasyacideteṣāṃ kartā syāt susamāhitaḥ | sa tena śuddho bhavati devatvañcāpi vindati ||6 1 | | payobhakṣastu yo nityaṃ naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yatheṣṭān mokṣameva vā | aiśvaryaṃ vā mahat prāpya dīpyamānovatiṣṭhate | |66| | etānyeva ca sarvāṇi dānāni ca tapāṃsi ca | vinā mantreṇa satataṃ śūdrāṇāmapi sarvaśaḥ | | 67| | vidhīyate na sandeho || yā tu bhartrābhyanujñātā kṛtvā dharmaṃ supuṣkalam | dadyāttu patyuryā nārī tasyānantaṃ bhavet phalam | |72| | yacca prārthayate kiñcidiha loke paratra vā | tatsarvaṃ prāpnute devyaḥ subhagā cāpi jāyate | |73 | | vaśyaścāsyā bhaved bharttā priyā tasya ca sā tadā | putraprajā ca bhati na ca duḥkhaṃ samaśnute | |74| | eṣa dharmo mayākhyāto yuṣmākaṃ lokamātaraḥ | ato bhūyaśca kiṃ
