yuddhemṛtaṃ devānnītavāndaityapuṅgavaḥ | viṣṇunā nirjito yuddhe putraṃ rājyebhiṣekṣyati | |3|| vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ tadamṛtaṃ devairasuraiśca mahābalaiḥ | mathitaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putra etadicchāmi veditum ||4|| sanatkumāra uvāca brahmaṇābhyetya śakratve prahlādosurapuṅgavaḥ | abhiṣiktastadā vyāsa asurān prajugopaha ||5|| atha devaistadā saṃkhyamasurāṇāṃ babhūva ha | amantrayanta devāśca bhagavantaṃ pitāmaham ||6|| devā ūcuḥ bhagavannasurairdevā hanyante yudhi martyavat | na mriyante yathā devāstathājñāpaya suvrata ||7|| sa evamuktastānāha brahmā devānsavāsavān | kṣīrodādamṛtaṃ śīghramutpādayata gacchata ||8| | manvantareṣu sarveṣu ye ye devā bhavanti te | kṣīrodādamṛtaṃ sarva janayantya suraissaha | |9|| tadaśnanti ca deveśāstena tṛptiśca jāyate | uttiṣṭhanti mṛtāścaiva pītvā ca na mriyanti te ||8.113.1 0|| devā ūcuḥ kathaṃ tadamṛtaṃ devā bhuvi manvantareśvarāḥ | utpādayanti tatsarvamupāyaṃ kathayasva naḥ ||1 1|| brahmovāca vāruṇyāṃ somapuryāṃ tu kṣīrodaṃ tatsaraḥ śubham | samudrā yatra te sapta sadā sannihitāḥ śubhāḥ | |12 || irā mālā sinīvālī kuhū rākā irāvatī | sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī surabhī kadrureva ca | |13 || aditiśca ditiścaiva devikā viśvasaṃbhavā | gāvaḥ sarvasahā yatra sarvakāmadughāḥ śubhāḥ ||14|| kṣaranti vatsalāḥ kṣīraṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ hyamṛtopamam | ṛṣayaḥ phenapā yatra tapodamaśamātmakāḥ ||1 5|| oṣadhyastatra yāḥ kāścillokesmindevasattamāḥ | grāmyāraṇyāśca divyāśca mānuṣāśca sahasraśaḥ ||16|| vṛkṣānvallīrvīrudhaśca gulmānanyāṃśca tādṛśān | prakṣipya bheṣajañcaiva somaṃ rājānameva ca ||17|| śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā khyātiṃ yaśastuṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca | kīrttiṃ śraddhāṃ dhāraṇāṃ ca ūhāpohe tathaiva ca || 18|| balaṃ dharmamathorjjaśca tṛptiṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm | tīrthāni caiva sarvāṇi dānāni vividhāni ca || 1 9| | vṛṣaṃ rathaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva gajamaśva tathaiva ca | aṣṭau ca maṃgalānyatra tathā chandāṃsi cākṣipan | |8.113.2 0 | vedān vidyāśca yāḥ kāścidyāścaitā lokamātaraḥ | mantrānyajñān suvarṇaṃ ca mantropakaraṇāni ca ||2 1 | | yatkiñcicchobhanaṃ caiva tṛptimadrasavacca ha | prakṣipya tatra tatsarvaṃ tato manthānamāvahan | | 22 | | mandaraṃ parvataśreṣṭhamakūpārañca kacchapam | tasya pṛṣṭhe ca manthānaṃ mandaraṃ parvateśvaram ||23 | | kṛtvā viṣṇugṛhītaṃ te vāsukiṃ pragrahaṃ tathā | yato mukhaṃ tato daityā yataḥ pucchaṃ tataḥ surāḥ | | 24|| karṣantastaṃ tu manthānaṃ mathnanti bahulāssamāḥ | tato varṣasahasreṇa tasmādutthāsyate hayaḥ | |25|| gāvaścaiva sahābhāgā gajo mattaśca vai śubhaḥ | vṛṣabho bhīmanādaśca kanyāḥ kīcakaveṇavaḥ | |26| | aṣṭamaṅgalakañcaiva bhiṣag dhanvantaristathā | śrīrlakṣmīrevamādyāśca vāruṇī ca madotkaṭā | |27|| oṣadhyaśca tathā divyā grāmyāraṇyāḥ samānuṣāḥ | vṛkṣādayaśca te sarve tataḥ somaśca pārthivaḥ | |28 || amṛtaṃ nat samāhṛtya viṣaṃ tacca durāsadam | yajñādīm̐ścaiva tat sarvān yatkiñcittatra saṃbhṛtam | |29|| evaṃ manvantareṣvatra devaiḥ sāsuramānuṣaiḥ | mathyate tvamṛtaṃ devāstacca saṃjāyate tathā ||8.113.3 0|| tasmādyūyamito gatvā dānavaissaha devatāḥ | manthadhvamamṛtaṃ kṣipraṃ tataḥ prāpsyatha taddhitam | ||31|| sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā deveśā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā | imaṃ lokamupāvṛtya tathākurvanta sarvaśaḥ ||32|| tasmiṃstu mathyamāne vai viṣamagre samutthitam | devāsuratrāsakaraṃ tatpapau śaṅkarastadā ||33 || tatastasmāt punarapi hyudatiṣṭhan payonidheḥ | ratnāni bahucitrāṇi tānyagṛhṇanta devatāḥ ||34|| asurā jagṛhurnainānyaśapam̐ stām̐statosurān | maṅgalānyavamanyanta tena te nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||35|| ratnānyūcuḥ | yasmādyūyaṃ durātmāno nāsmānnandatha dāruṇāḥ | tasmāt samīhitaṃ yadvastattathā na bhaviṣyati ||36|| vāruṇīṃ nāpyagṛhṇantāsurā madabalāvahām | yasmāttatosurāste vai durātmānaśca sarvaśaḥ ||37|| tata uccaiḥśravā nāma vājī paramaśobhanaḥ | hastī caiva caturdanto bhiṣak ca sumahāyaśāḥ ||38|| ghṛtācī pūrvacittiśca devī rambhā manoramā | amṛtaṃ ca tataḥ somo gṛhītvotthitavān surāḥ ||39|| sanatkumāra uvāca tata utsṛjya te ratnānyasurā darpitā bhṛśam | somahastād balenaiva amṛtaṃ jagṛhustadā ||8.113.40 || tāndevāḥ sahitābhyetya ūcuḥ sāntvena mohitān | na yuktaṃ kartumevaṃ baḥ sahitā upayuñjmahe ||41 || sakhyaṃ hi nostu sudṛḍhaṃ mā no balamadānvitāḥ | kleśamenaṃ vṛthā yeha kurudhvaṃ dānaveśvarāḥ | |42| | tāṃstathāvādinaḥ sarvān prahlādo dānaveśvaraḥ | idamāha mahāmāyo dharmaṃ kṛtvā tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||43 |||| prahlāda uvāca yadā ratnānya gṛhaṇīdhvaṃ sāgarādutthitāni vai | tadā na yūyamasmābhiḥ kiñciduktāḥ sureśvarāḥ ||44|| idamevaṃ vayaṃ sarve ratnaṃ gṛhṇīma devatāḥ | naitad vinā hi yuddhena dāsyāmo vayamadya vai ||45|| idamasmadgataṃ devā amṛtaṃ sarvamaṅgalam | yuddhena yadi vaḥ kāryaṃ gṛhṇīdhvaṃ yadi śakyate | |46| | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktāstaiḥ krūrairdevā bhītā ivābhavan | vivarṇavadanā dīnā na kiñcittām̐stadocire | |47|| vrīḍitāstena mahāsatvā vinivṛttāḥ sureśvarāḥ | nirutsāhā babhūvurhi hatā smeti ca cintayan ||48|| tāṃstathā cintayānām̐stu sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ | uvāca kiṃ viṣādena yuddhenainānnihanmahe | |49 || viṣṇuruvāca abuddhireṣā śakrasya yuddhaṃ prati sureśvarāḥ | nahi yuddhe surāḥ śakyāḥ sarve hantuṃ mahābalāḥ ||8.113.50 || tasmātte na pibanti sma yāvadevāmṛtaṃ śubham | tāvadeva hariṣyāmi māyāmāsthāya tacchalāt ||51 || sannahyadhvaṃ surāssarve vyūhaṃ kṛtvāvatiṣṭhata | gṛhītvā yāvadamṛtamihāyāmi divaukasaḥ ||52| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ saṃ mohanīṃ māyāmāsthāya vibudheśvaraḥ | yajñaśrīrūpamāsthāya jagāma ditijānprati | 53 || sa gatvāsurarājaṃ tamidamāha mahābalaḥ | yajñaśrīrūpasaṃpannaḥ padmahastomalekṣaṇaḥ ||54|| viṣṇuruvāca abalān daivatān jñātvā balinassudurāsadān | yajñaśrīrasmi saṃprāptā dānavān baladarpitān ||55 | | pratigṛhṇantu māṃ sarve dānavāḥ suravidviṣaḥ | gatāste nidhanaṃ devā yūyaṃ devā na saṃśayaḥ ||56| | tatosurāstadotthāya prahlādaścaiva dānavaḥ | pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya hastesya kalaśaṃ daduḥ | |57| | sa prāha dānavān devaḥ strīrūpākṛṣṭamānasān | nedaṃ mayi bhavantodya kṣeptumarhanti sarvaśaḥ | |58|| māyāmāsthāya vibudhā māhārṣuste kadācana | te hi sarve durācārā māyānikṛtimāśritāḥ | |59|| prahlāda uvāca jāne māyāvidaste vai nikṛtyā balinaśca ha | māyayaiva vayaṃ tānvai nihaṃsyāmaḥ sudaṃśitān ||8.113.60 | | nikṛtyā nikṛtijñāstu hantavyā duṣṭacetasaḥ | māyāvidaśca māyābhiriti dharma prabhāṣitam ||61 || tvantu no gatiradyeha tathā caiva parāyaṇama | tvayā dattamidaṃ sarve upoyakṣyāma śobhane ||62|| tvañcenna yacchasesmākaṃ taddhi te paramaṃ hitam | vayaṃ ca tvāṃ tathā sarve nāvamaṃsyāmahe sadā ||63|| tataḥ sa taṃ tadā dhīmān prahasya śubhadarśanaḥ | uvāca yat tvayā gītaṃ satyaṃ tacca karomi te ||64| | sanatkumāra uvāca tato nirīkṣatāṃ teṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ kṛtvā svakaṃ vapuḥ | pragṛhyāmṛtamutpatya devebhyaḥ pradadau vibhuḥ |||65|| iti skandapurāṇe amṛtāharaṇe trayodaśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.114> vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ tadutthitaṃ ghoraṃ viṣaṃ sūryāyutaprabham | kathaṃ pītaṃ bhagavatā brahmapurogāya kasmin kāle mahādyute ||3|| etadākhyāhi naḥ samyag yathāvṛttaṃ tapodhana | nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kathaṃ devaḥ śarvastribhuvaneśvaraḥ | |4|| sūta uvāca yathā śrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ vāyunā jagadāyunā | śrūyatāṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭha kathyamānamidaṃ mayā | |3 9 | | umotsaṅgopaviṣṭena yathā pūrvaṃ mayā śrutaḥ | pārvatyāścaiva saṃvādaḥ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ | |8.114.40 || tamahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathātathyaṃ mahāmune | kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite | |41 || taruṇādityasaṃkāśe taptakāñcanasannibhe | vajrasphaṭikasopāne citrapaṭṭaśilātale | |42 | | jāmbūnadamaye divye nānāratnavibhūṣite | nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpaphalodake ||43 || haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇe cakravākopaśobhite | ṣaṭpadodgītakamale dhārāsaṃpātanādite ||44 | | mattakrauñcamayūrāṇāṃ nādairvikruṣṭakandare | apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe kinnaraiścopaśobhite | |45| | jīvanjīvakadātyūhavirutaiśca praṇādite | kokilārāvamadhure siddhacāraṇasevite | |46 | | saurabheyaninādāḍhye meghastanitanisvane | vināyakabhayodvignaiḥ kuñjarairmuktakandare | |47| | vaṃśavāditranirghoṣe śrotrendriyamanohare | dolālalitavikṣepai rvanitāsiddhasevite ||48|| dhvajairllambitadolānāṃ ghaṇṭānāṃ virutākule | ballakīghoṣabahule nṛttavyāpārasaṃkule ||49| | mukhairdarddaravādyaiśca valgitāsphoṭite tathā | krīḍāceṣṭāvinodānāṃ ravairākranda(?)kandare | |8.114.50 || hāsaiḥ santrāsajananairvikarālaistathā mukhaiḥ | dehabandhairvicitraiśca prakrīḍitagaṇeśvare | |5 1 | | vyāghrasiṃhamukhai rghoraissarpākhuvadanairapi | mṛgameṣamukhaiścānyairgajavājimukhaistathā ||52 | | viḍālavadanaiścograiḥ kroṣṭukākāramūrttibhiḥ | hrasvairdīrghaiḥ kṛśaiḥ sthūlairlambodaramahodaraiḥ ||53 || hrasvajaṃghaiḥ pralamboṣṭhaistālajaṃghaistathāparaiḥ | gokarṇairekakarṇaiśca mahākarṇairakarṇakaiḥ | |54|| ekapādairmahāpādairbahupādairapādakaiḥ | ekamūrdhabhiratyugrairbahumūrdhabhirulbaṇaiḥ ||55 || amūrdhabhiśca gaṇapairmahāmūrdhabhireva ca | ekanetrairmahānetrairbahunetraiśca sarvaśaḥ | |56| | kabandhākṛtibhiścānyairanetrairgaṇanāyakaiḥ | ekanāsairmahānāsairbahunāsairanāsikaiḥ | |57| | ekavaktrairmahāvaktrairbahuvaktrairavaktrakaiḥ | ekadaṃṣṭrairmahādaṃṣṭrairbahudaṣṭrairadaṃṣṭrakaiḥ | |58|| ekahastairmahāhastairbahuhastairahastakaiḥ | viśvarūpairvirūpaiśca surūpai rūpavarjitaiḥ | evaṃvidhairmahāyogairbhūtairbhūtapatirvṛtaḥ | |59|| viśuddharatnāṅgavibhūṣitāṅgadā śilātale hemamaye manorame | sukhopaviṣṭaṃ madanāṅganāśanaṃ cucoda vākyaṃ girirājyanandanā ||8.114.6 0 || devyuvāca bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa govṛṣāṅkitaśāsana | tava kaṇṭhe mahādeva bhrājatembudasannibhama | | 61 | | nātyulvaṇaṃ śubhaṃ śubhraṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam | kimidaṃ deva dīptaṃ te kaṇṭhe kāmāṅganāśana | ko hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vā yenedaṃ nīlamīśvara | etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | |62 || śrutvā vākyaṃ tato devyāḥ pārvatyāḥ pārvatīpriyaḥ | kathāṃ maṅgalasaṃyuktāṃ kathayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ | |63 | | maheśvara uvāca mathyamānemṛte pūrvaṃ kṣīrode suradānavaiḥ | agre samutthitaṃ ghoraṃ viṣaṃ kālānalaprabham || 64|| kālamṛtyurivodbhūtaṃ yugāntādityavarcasam | trailokyotsādasūryābhaṃ visphurattat samantataḥ ||65|| taṃ dṛṣṭavā surasaṃghāśca daityāścaiva varānane | viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve gatāste brahmaṇontikam ||66| | dṛṣṭavā suragaṇān bhītānbrahmovāca mahādyutiḥ | mayāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ bhavatāṃ saṃprakalpitam ||67| | trailokyasyeśvarā yūyaṃ sarve ca vigatajvarāḥ | vimānacāriṇaḥ sarve sarve svacchandacāriṇaḥ | | 68|| prajābhiḥ satkṛtāḥ samyaṅ nityaṃ bahumatā mama | kimarthe vā mahāprajñā bhṛśamudvignacetasaḥ ||69|| kena vyāvartitaiśvaryā yena māṃ samupasthitāḥ | prajāsarge na sotrāsti yojñānmama nivartayet ||8.114.70 || adhyātme cādhibhūte ca adhidaive ca nityaśaḥ | prajākarmavipāke ca śaktā yūyaṃ pravartitum | |71 || kiṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vā kuto vā bhayamāgatam | yena yūyaṃ samudvignā mṛgā siṃhārditā iva | |72| | etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śīghramākhyātumarhatha | śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasya brahmaṇaḥ sumahātmanaḥ ||73 | | ūcusta ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ suradaityendradānavāḥ | surāsuragaṇairbrahman mathyamāne mahodadhau ||74| | bhujaṅgabhṛṅgasaṃkāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham | prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ saṃvarttāgnisamaprabham | |75|| kālamṛtyurivodbhūtaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham | trailokyotsādasūryābhaṃ visphurattat samantataḥ | |76| | tejasāmiva saṃghātaṃ sumahat samupasthitam | viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve dṛṣṭodbhūtaṃ mahāviṣam | |77| | viṣeṇottiṣṭhatā tena kālānalasamatviṣā | nirdagdho raktagaurāṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ | |78|| taṃ dṛṣṭavā raktagaurāṅgaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam | sarve bhītā vayaṃ brahmam̐stvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||79| | surāṇāmasurāṇāñca śrutvā vākyaṃ bhayāvaham | pratyuvāca mahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | |8.114.80 || śṛṇvantu devatāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | yattadagre samudbhūtaṃ mathyamāne mahodadhau | |8 1 | | viṣaṃ kālānalaprakhyaṃ kālakūṭamiti śrutam | tasya prodbhūtamātrasya virājante na devatāḥ ||82| | tasya viṣṇurahaṃ vāpi sarve vā surapuṅgavāḥ | śaknuvanti na vai soḍhuṃ vegamanyatra śaṅkarāt | |83 || ityuktvā padmagarbhābhaḥ padmayonirayonijaḥ | māmevaṃ stotumārebhe brahmā vedavidāṃ varaḥ | |84|| brahmovāca namastubhyaṃ virūpākṣa namaste naikacakṣuṣe | namaḥpinākahastāya vajrahastāya vai namaḥ | |85| | namastriśūlahastāya daṇḍapāśāsipāṇaye | namastrailokyanāthāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ | |86 | | namaḥ surārihantre ca somasūryāgnicakṣuṣe | brahmaṇe caiva rudrāya viṣṇave caiva te namaḥ | |87| | sāṃkhyāya caiva yogāya bhūtagrāmāya vai namaḥ | manmathāṅgavināśāya kālakālāya vai namaḥ ||88| | rudrāya vasuretāya devadevāya raṃhase | uṣṇīṣiṇe suvaktrāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe ||89| | kapardine karālāya śaṅkarāya harāya ca | virūpāya surūpāya śivāya varadāya ca ||8.114.90 | | tripuraghne makhaghnāya mātṝṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | buddhāya caiva śuddhāya muktāya kevalāya ca | |91 | | lokatrayavidhātre ca śakrāya varadāya ca | agrāyātha tathogrāya viprāyānantacakṣuṣe ||92|| rajase caiva satvāya tamasevyaktayonaye | nityāya caivānityāya nityānityāya vai namaḥ ||93|| vyaktāya caivāvyaktāya vyaktāvyaktāya vai namaḥ | cintyāya caivācintyāya cintyācintyāya vai namaḥ ||94|| sūkṣmāya caivāsūkṣmāya sūkṣmāsūkṣmāya vai namaḥ | bhaktānāmārtināśāya priyanarāyaṇāya ca ||95|| umāpriyāya śarvāya nandivaktrāṅkanāya ca | pakṣamāsārdhamāsāya ṛtusaṃvatsarāya ca ||96|| bahurūpāya muṇḍāya daṇḍinetha varūthine | rathine dhanvine nityaṃ jaṭine brahmacāriṇe ||97|| ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya puruṣāyeśvarāya ca | namaste bhagavanū vyakṣa namaste bhagavañchiva ||98|| namaste devadeveśa namaste bhūtabhāvana | ityevamādicaritaiḥ stutaṃ stutyaṃ namostute ||99|| praṇamya mūrdhnā praṇatosmi rudraṃ jagadguruṃ devavaraṃ trinetram | sūkṣmosi yogātiśayādhigamyaṃ tejonidhe vyaktamupaimi rudram ||8.114.100|| jñātvā tu bhaktiṃ mama devadeva prasīda gaṅgāmbuniṣiktakeśa | tvāṃ saurabheyāmbudacitrayānaṃ śivaṃ prayatnāt śaraṇaṃ gatosmi ||101|| evaṃ tena tadā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā | stutohaṃ vividhaiḥ stotrairvedavedāṅgasaṃbhavaiḥ | |102|| tataḥ prīto hyahaṃ tasya brahmaṇotha mahātmanaḥ | natastaṃ mukhyayā vṛttyā pitāmahamathābruvam | |1 03 || bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa bhūtādhipa mahātapaḥ | kiṃ kāryaṃ te mayā brahman kartavyaṃ vada suvrata | śrutvā vākyaṃ tato brahmā pratyuvācāmbujekṣaṇe || 1 04| | brahmovāca bhūtabhavyabhavannātha śrūyatāṃ kāraṇeśvara | surāsuragaṇairdeva mathyamāne mahodadhau || 105 | | mayūrabhṛṅgasakāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham | prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ saṃvarttāgnisamaprabham | | 106 || kālamṛtyurivodbhūtaṃ yugāntādityavarccasam | trailokyotsādasūryābhaṃ visphurat tat samantataḥ | | 107 | viṣeṇottiṣṭhatā tena kālānalasamatviṣā | nirdagdho raktagaurāṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ || 108 || taṃ dṛṣṭavā raktagaurāṅgaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam | tataḥ sarve vayaṃ bhītāstvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||1 0 9|| tat pibasva mahādeva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | bhavānagrasya bhoktā vai bhavāndevavaraḥ prabhuḥ ||8.114.1 10 || bhavāṃstasya mahāvegaṃ samarthaḥ sanniyacchitum | nānyaḥ kaścit pumāñchakto jagatyasmim̐ścarācare ||1 11 | | pātumeko mahādeva samarthastvaṃ mahādyute | tasyaivograprabhāvasya kālānalasamatviṣaḥ(?) | | 112 || vegaṃ soḍhuṃ mahādeva samarthonyo na vidyate | tasyaivaṃ bruvato devi brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||11 3|| bāḍhamityeva tadvākyaṃ pratigṛhya varānane | tadahaṃ pātumārabdho viṣamantakasannibham ||1 14|| lokatrayahitārthāya suradaityendrasannidhau | pibato me mahāghoraṃ viṣaṃ suragaṇārcite | kaṇṭhe samabhavat kṣipraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇāmbujekṣaṇe || 115 || tad dṛṣṭvotpalapatrābhaṃ kaṇṭhe saktaṃ mahāviṣam | takṣakaṃ nāgarājānaṃ lelihānamivoragam ||1 1 6|| athovāca mahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | śobhase tvaṃ mahādeva kaṇṭhenānena suvrata ||1 17|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mayā girivarātmaje | paśyatāṃ surasaṃghānāṃ daityānāñca varānane || 1 18|| yakṣagandharvasiddhānāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām | dhṛtaṃ kaṇṭhe viṣaṃ ghoraṃ tataḥ śrīkaṇṭhatā mama ||1 19|| tatkālakūṭaṃ viṣamugratejaḥ kaṇṭhe dhṛtaṃ parvatarājakanye | paśyan samastaḥ suradaityasaṃgho hṛṣṭaḥ paraṃ vismayamājagāma ||8.114.120 || tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devi mattamātaṅgagāmini ||121 || aho balaṃ vīryaparākramaste aho vapuryogabalaṃ tavedam| aho vibhūtistava devadeva gaṅgājala plāvitacandramaule ||122|| tvameva viṣṇuścaturānanastvaṃ tvameva sūryo rajanīkarastvam | tvameva kālo niyatistvameva tvameva mṛtyurdhanadastvameva ||123|| tvameva sūkṣmaḥ puruṣovyayastvaṃ tvameva sūkṣmācca paraṃ ca sūkṣmam | vyaktaṃ tvameva prakṛtistvameva tvameva satvaṃ ca bhavodbhavaṃ ca | |124|| tvameva bhūmiḥ salilaṃ tvameva tvameva vahniḥ pavanastvameva | tvameva khaṃ bhūtabhaviṣyabhavyaṃ tvameva bhūtaṃ bhavabhavyayuktam ||1 25| | tvameva yajño niyamastvameva tvameva sarvaṃ prakaroṣi dharmam | tvameva sarvasya carācarasya pṛthag vibhaktā pralaye ca goptā ||1 26|| ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ surendrāḥ praṇamya māṃ siddhagaṇāśca hṛṣṭāḥ | vyapetaśokāḥ pravibhaktasomā gatā vimanairanilogravegāḥ ||127|| ityetat paramaṃ guhyaṃ puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ mahat | svayaṃ svayaṃbhuvā proktaṃ stotraṃ pāpapraṇāśanam | |1 28|| yastu dhārayate nityaṃ matparo niyame sthitaḥ | brahmodgītaṃ śivaṃ hyetat sarvaroganibarhaṇam || 129|| gatiṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi paratreha ca dehinaḥ | viṣaṃ tasya varārohe sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ tathā | | 8.114.130|| saṃprāpya gātraṃ suśroṇi kṣipraṃ sapratihanyate | śamametya śubhaṃ ghoraṃ duḥsvapnaṃ cāpakarṣati ||1 31 || strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti sabhāyāṃ pārthivasya ca | vivāde jayamāpnoti yuddhe caiva na saṃśayaḥ ||1 3 2|| gacchatodhvani ca kṣemaṃ satvaṃ caivopajāyate188 | śarīrabhede vakṣyāmi gatiṃ tasya varānane ||1 33 || hariśmaśrurnīlakaṇṭhaḥ śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajaḥ | tryakṣobhedyastriśūlī ca vṛṣaketurmahābalaḥ ||134|| nanditulyavapuścaiva nanditulyaparākramaḥ | vicaratyakhilaṃ siddhaḥ saptalokaṃ mamājñayā ||1 35| | na hanyate gatistasya vāyoriva nabhastale | mama pārśvacaro bhūtvā tiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavam ||1 36|| yepi caitadvarārohe sadā śṛṇvanti mānavāḥ | teṣāṃ caiva pravakṣyāmi phalaṃ phalasahasrade | | 1 37|| brāhmaṇo vedamāpnoti kṣatriyo vindate mahīm | vaiśyastu labhate lābhaṃ śūdraḥ prāpnoti sadgatim ||138|| vyādhito mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt | gurviṇī janayet putraṃ kanyā vindati satpatim ||139|| naṣṭañca labhate dravyamiha loke paratra ca | gavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyag dattasya yatphalam | |8.114.140 | | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śrutvā martyaḥ kathāmimām | akṣaraṃ vātha pādaṃ vā ślokaṃ ślokārdhameva vā ||141 || athavā sarvamadhyāyaṃ devabrāhmaṇasaṃsadi | yaḥ paṭhenmānavo nityaṃ madgatenāntarātmanā || 142|| śraddadhānaḥ sadodyukto rudraloke mahīyate | paṭhasva devi bhadrante pāṭhayasva ca bāndhavān || 143 || ataḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | nāpi yakṣāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ 144|| kuryurvighnaṃ gṛhe tatra yatrāyaṃ tiṣṭhate stavaḥ | yathāvimuktaṃ kṣetreṣu kṣetraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prakalpitam || 145| | tathā stavo variṣṭhoyaṃ stavānāṃ brahmanirmitaḥ | yaścainaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe brāhmaṇān pādamantataḥ || 146|| akṣayyamannapānaṃ vai pitṝm̐stasyopatiṣṭhati | manasā cintitaṃ yacca yacca vācāpyudāhṛtam | | 147|| sarvaṃ saṃpadyate tasya stavasyāsyānukīrtanāt | śrutvaitat paramaṃ guhyaṃ yepi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||148|| striyaḥ śūdrāśca tepīha rudralokaṃ vrajantyuta | yadā mānuṣyatāmeti kadācit kālaparyayāt ||149|| vedavedāṅgatattvajño vimale jāyate kule | devabhaktaśca bhavati dharmañca kurute tadā ||8.114.150|| itihāsamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakilviṣanāśanam | ūktaṃ mayātra tuṣṭena svayamevāmbujekṣaṇe ||151|| iti skandapurāṇe amṛtamathane nīlakaṇṭhopākhyāne brahmadevakṛtaṃ mahādevastotraṃ nāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.115> vyāsa uvāca amṛtepahṛte tasmin viṣṇunā chadmarūpiṇā | daityāśca dānavāścaiva kiṃ cakru stadantaram ||1|| sanatkumāra uvāca te krodhādvañcitāḥ sarve viṣṇunā dānaveśvarāḥ | sannahya yuddhāya tadā garhanto viṣṇumūcire ||2|| dhigbala dhik ca te śauryaṃ pāpa dhik te parākramam | viśrambhaghātī nityaṃ tvannīcakarmā durātmavān | |3 || tvayā nikṛtyā nihato hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā | hiraṇyākṣaśca daityendromṛtaṃ cedamapāhṛtam ||4|| na tavāsti balaṃ yuddhe nikṛtyā hi balī bhavān | yuddhe sthito bhavānastu na no mokṣamavāpsyati ||5|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa daityārāṭ kruddha udgiran pāvakārciṣaḥ | rathenāmbudanādena viṣṇumevābhidudruve | |6 || vipracitiśca daityendro gajena gajinaṃ tadā | samāhvayat sahasrākṣaṃ gajina vajrapāṇinam(?) | |7 | | virocanastu saṃkruddho dhaneśaṃ rākṣasādhipam | gajenaivābhidudrāva jalado bhāskaraṃ yathā | |8| | balirvairocaniścāpi yamaṃ pitṛgaṇādhipam | rathenaivābhidudrāva vighno vighnamivāparam | | 9|| anuhrāśca daityendro hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | varuṇaṃ prati dudrāva nadīvego yathārṇavam | |8.115.1 0 || mayastu dānavaśreṣṭhastārastāraka eva ca | ādityaissaha saṃsaktā gajā iva mahāgajaiḥ | | 11 | | śarabhaḥ śataketuśca balo mūkaśca dānavaḥ | rudrānevābhyabhāvanta siṃhāḥ siṃhānivājane || 12| | śambhuḥ kārtasvanaścaiva mahāmāyaśca śambaraḥ | vasubhiḥ saha saṃsaktā vyasanānīva sādhubhiḥ | |1 3 | | narakotha hayagrīvastathendradamanosuraḥ | aśvibhyāṃ saha saṃsaktā grahābhyāmiva tārakāḥ || 14| | anye cānyaissuraissārdhaṃ mahāmāyā mahābalāḥ | āhūyāhūya yudhyante sarve krodhena dānavāḥ | |1 5 | | vipracittirmahāmāyaḥ sahasrākṣaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ | ardayāmāsa nādena nādayāno diśo daśa || 1 6| | tasyendraḥ kārmukaṃ citramasyato laghuhastavān | vajreṇa śatadhāreṇa śatadhā vyabhajad balī || 17| | tatosya gajamāghore kārmukaṃ gṛhṇatoparam | gajena pothayāmāsa sa papāta yathā giriḥ | |18 | | tamāplutaṃ gajāccaiva dānavaṃ devarāḍ balī | vajreṇātāḍayat krauñcaṃ śaktyā guha ivāhave | | 1 9| | sa tena vajraghātena dānavo mūḍhacetanaḥ | apatad bhūtale kṣipraṃ vātarugṇa iva drumaḥ ||8.115.2 0 || tato hāhākṛtamabhūddānavānāṃ bale tadā | sādhusādhviti devānāṃ siṃhanādāśca bṛṃhitāḥ | |2 1 | | pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāṃ sa śaktyā bhīmarūpayā | mātaṅgaḥ tasya saṃmattamanayadyamasādanam | |22 | | tatosya pṛṣṭharakṣām̐śca kavacañca mahāprabham | śātayāmāsa devāgryassa hitvā saṃyugaṃ yayau | |23 | | baliryamasya puṇḍraṃ ca kṛtāntaṃ kalahaṃ tathā | kālañca niyatiñcaiva kiṅkarān pāśameva ca | |24|| ekaikaṃ paśyatastīkṣṇaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ | yamañcaiva catuṣṣaṣṭyā hṛdaye samavidhyata | | 25|| tasya cānadataḥ kṣipraṃ yamaḥ kruddho hasam̐stadā | daṇḍena rathamāhatya bhasmasāyujyamānayat | | 2 6|| hate rathe sasūte tu sāśve saha padānugaiḥ | tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti sannadya yamaṃ baliradhāvata || 27| | tasyāpatata evāśu yamo daṇḍamavāsṛjat | mūrdhni tena prahāreṇa tataḥ sogānmahītalam | |28 || tato hāhākṛtamabhūddānavānāṃ bale tadā | gṛhaṇa gṛhaṇeti cāpyūcuḥ kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tathāpare ||29|| anuhrādastu varuṇaṃ nārācena mahābalaḥ | āhatya hṛdaye kruddho rathopasthe nyapātayat | |8.115.3 0 | | sa utthāya kṣaṇāddevo vikṛṣya balavaddhanuḥ | sāyakām̐stasya saṃdhārya dhanuściccheda vīryavān ||3 1 || aśvāñjaghāna sūtasya śiraḥ kāyādapātayat | tasya praskandataścāpi hatāśvādrathasattamāt ||32 || bibheda hṛdayaṃ śīghraṃ sa papāta yathā mṛtaḥ | mayastārastārakaśca ādityān dṛḍhamārdayan ||3 3 || tepi tān virathāñcakruḥ sarvāñcharaśataistribhiḥ | śarabhaḥ śataketuśca balo mūkaśca dānavaḥ ||34| | rudrānastrairbahuvidhairnādayantordayanyudhi | teṣāmastrāṇi tāni sma prativārya mahābalāḥ | |3 5|| śalabhā iva kedārān muhūrtena vyanāśayan | te kālyamānāstai rudrairbahubhirvirathāstadā ||36|| raṇaṃ tyaktvā mahāmāyā vipalāyanta sarvaśaḥ | śambhuḥ kārtasvanaścaiva mahāmāyaśca śambaraḥ | |37|| vasūnabhyadravan yuddhe gajāḥ pratigajāniva | teṣāntu vasavaḥ sarve svāpanāstraṃ sasarjire ||38|| ratheṣvavasthitā yena babhuḥ suptā yathā mṛgāḥ | tān suptān rathayantāro raṇāttasmādapāharan | |39|| haratāṃ caiva sūtānāmuttamāṅgānyapātayan | te hateṣvatha sūteṣu udbhrāntairvājibhistadā | |8.115.40 | | suptā eva raṇe sarve bhrāmyante ditisūnavaḥ | narakotha hayagrīvastathendradamanopi ca | |41 || aśvinau dvau susaṃyattā yuyudhuste sureśvarāḥ | tānāpatata evātha tau devau bhiṣajāṃ varau ||42|| daṇḍenāstreṇa virathān sarvāneva pracakratuḥ | punaścāpatataḥ sarvān gadinaḥ krodhamūrchitān | |43 || vāyavyāstreṇa sahasā saṃcikṣipaturāhave | anye cānyām̐stadā devā ditiputrān vyapothayan | |44| | abhajyanta yathā siṃhairmṛgāraṇyebhisaṃhatāḥ | prahlādaścāpi daityendro viṣṇunā saha saṃgataḥ | |45|| mahat kṛtvā tadā yuddhaṃ virathaḥ samapadyata | sa cakreṇa hatāśvastu hatasūtapadānugaḥ ||46 || gadāṃ gṛhītvā praskandya janārdanamupādravat | tasyodyatakarasyātha dhāvataśca mahāmune | |47|| ciccheda tāṃ gadāmāśu cakreṇaiva janārdanaḥ | atha te dānavāḥ śūrastairdevairbhagnavikramāḥ | |48| | abhajyanta yathā siṃhairvane mṛgagaṇā bhayāt | tānbhagnān bhajyamānām̐śca dṛṣṭavā tyaktvā raṇaṃ yayuḥ | |49|| prahlādopi raṇaṃ tyaktvā tānevānujagāma ha | teṣu bhagneṣvathendrasya jayaśabdaṃ supūjitam ||8.115.50 || samaṃ cakrustadā devāḥ sanārāyaṇalokapāḥ | siṃhanādāṃśca vividhān vāditrāṇi nyavādayan ||51 | | iti skandapurāṇe amṛtamathaneyuddhe pañcadaśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.116> sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ tadabhavad vyāsa amṛtasyāvamanthanam | yuddhañca sumahāghoraṃ prahlādena sahaiva tu || 1 | | sa tu kālena mahatā kṛtvā yuddhaśatānyuta | putre virocane rājyaṃ pradadāvasureśvaraḥ | |2| | virocanaḥ punarvyāsa rājyasyārthe mahābalaḥ | āṭībake hato yuddhe devendreṇa mahaujasā | | 3 || vyāsa uvāca āṭībakaḥ sa saṃgrāmaḥ kathamāsīnmahābhayaḥ | śrotumicchāmi bhagavan paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||4| | sanatkumāra uvāca babhūva punareveha devānāmasuraiḥ saha | sakhyaṃ te dadṛśuścaiva dūrādvai vismitānanāḥ | |5|| ghorāmilāvṛte tasmin varṣe vikṛtarūpiṇīm | ugrāmātharvaṇīṃ kṛtyāmasurāṇāṃ bhayaṃkarīm ||6| | tāṃ dṛṣṭavā tebruvan keyamāṭirityeva devatāḥ | asurā baka ityeva vivādaścāpyajāyata | |7| | sāpi kṛtyā tadā ghorā devebhyo darśanaṃ dadau | āṭirityeva teṣāṃ ca asurāṇāṃ bakobhavat | |8|| teṣāṃ paṇobhavattatra rājyaṃ prati mahāmune | yo no jitaḥ sa no dāso jetā svāmī bhavatviti ||9| | tatassā hyāṭirūpeṇa sarvebhyo darśanaṃ dadau | tataste vijitā devāḥ procurnā sma jitā iti ||8.116.1 0 || baka evaiṣa suvyaktaṃ jitā yūyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | nāyamāṭirbakoyaṃ vai na bakaścāṭireva hi | | 11 || evaṃ vivadatāṃ yuddhamabhavadrājyakāraṇāt | teṣāṃ dānavamukhyānāṃ devaissaha bhayāvaham | | 12 | | varṣāṇāṃ vai sahasraṃ tu hato yatra virocanaḥ | hate virocane brahmā baliṃ teṣāṃ mahāsuram | | 13 | | abhyaṣecayadindratve sa ca rājā babhūva ha | tatassa lokāṃstrīn vyāsa balenākrāmadavyayaḥ || 14| | trailokyasyeśvaraścaiva sa jajñe hyasureśvaraḥ | jitvā yuddhena devendraṃ sthānādacyāvayat prabhuḥ | | 15 | | indratvamakaroccaiva yamatvañca mahābalaḥ | sa eva varuṇaścābhūddhaneśognistathaiva ca | | 1 6| | ādityaścaiva somaśca parjanyo vṛṣṭisarjanaḥ | sarvaṃ jagati kartavyaṃ sa eva kurute sadā | | 17| | evaṃ śāsati vai rājyaṃ devānāmasukhaṃ tadā | bhraṣṭaiśvaryā mahātmāno bhramanti śakunā iva | | 1 8| | teṣāṃ brahmā dadau buddhiṃ duḥkhitānāṃ mahātmanām | āśvāsya bahudhā vyāsa kāruṇyād devasattamaḥ | | 1 9| | brahmovāca devā na śakyo yuṣmābhirbalireṣa pravādhitum | mahātmā dhārmikaścāyamamaraśca na saṃśayaḥ | |8.116.2 0 | | brahmaṇyaśca balīyām̐śca tathā labdhavaraśca ha | taṃ gatvā viprarūpeṇa viṣṇureṣa prayācatu | | 21 | | vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya bhūmervai vikramatrayam | dāsyate sa gṛhītvā tat kramatāmeṣa sarvaśaḥ ||22|| bhūmiṃ kramasamāṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | kramaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhātāsya antarikṣe tataḥ svayam ||23|| ahaṃ caiva pradāsyāmi tṛtīyaṃ kramamityuta | evaṃ vo rājyalābhoyaṃ dṛśyate nānyathā surāḥ ||24|| yasminkāle prakramate viṣṇureṣa triviṣṭapam | tasminkāle ca rakṣadhvaṃ sarvayatnena dānavān ||25|| sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā deveśā niścitya bahudhā śubham | viṣṇumūcurmahāsatvāḥ kriyatāṃ brahmaṇo vacaḥ ||26|| dīkṣitaścāsuraśreṣṭho hayamedhena sodya vai | kalyaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ tasya gatvā yācasva taṃ prabho ||27|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamastviti tenoktā devā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ | atiṣṭhanta tadā sarve śakraṃ kṛtvā purassaram ||28|| nāradotha tadā gatvā pūjitastena bhaktitaḥ | sukhopaviṣṭaḥ prāhedaṃ vacanaṃ vadatāṃ varaḥ ||29|| dharmeṇa tava tuṣṭohamṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | anāsuramida vṛttaṃ tava dānavasattama | |8.116.3 0|| sarve hi dānavāḥ krūrāḥ brahmaghnā lokakaṇṭakāḥ | tvaṃ tu brāhmaṇabhaktaśca lokānāṃ hitakṛttathā ||31|| tasmāttava śubhaṃ cintyaṃ sadaivāsurapuṅgava | yathā ca te śubhaṃ kiñcit syād rājannityameva hi ||32|| eṣa devaiḥ praṇihito viṣṇurvipratvamāsthitaḥ | trīm̐stvā rājyārthamudyuktaḥ prārthayiṣyati vikramān | |3 3 || tanna tasya tvayā deyaṃ rājyaṃ paścānna te bhavet | ataḥ paraṃ bhavān rājan pramāṇamasureśvara | | 34|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā balirvairocanistadā | uvāca praṇato vyāsa nāradaṃ dānaveśvaraḥ || 35|| śatravaste mama dṛḍhaṃ teṣāṃ cāhaṃ mahāmune | yadi te māṃ prayācante kṛtārthosmi tato nanu ||3 6|| svadharmaṃ saṃparityajya yadi cenmadhusūdanaḥ | māṃ prayācati dīnātmā saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama ||37| | vrataṃ cedaṃ mama brahman sadaiva hi mahāmune | yācito na dadāmīti na vadeyamiti prabho ||38| | urdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yācato viprasattama | bruvato na dadāmīti narakāyotkramantyatha | |39|| dehīti ruditasyākhyā nāstīti pratirodanā | mā māṃ nārada paśyantu rudantamitare janāḥ | |8.116.40 | | eṣā bhavati sarvasya puruṣasya mahāmune | yācato mama dātāyamicchā taddhyakṣayaṃ phalam ||41 || sohaṃ yadi na dāsyāmi śatrubhyo yācitaṃ mahat | narakaṃ rauravaṃ nāma pratipatsyāmyasaṃśayam ||42| | yo hi vai yācamānāya na dadāti narādhamaḥ | sa taṃ hinasti yācantamāśācchedānna saṃśayaḥ | |43 || bhabānmama pitā vyaktaṃ putraḥ snehakṛto hyaham | nāhaṃ na dāsye viprendra nirvṛtiste bhavatviyam ||44| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa taṃ tadāmantrya tena caiva supūjitaḥ | divamakrāmadavyagraścintayānaḥ kathaṃ bhavet | |45| | gatetha tasmindivase rajanyāṃ sa mahāyaśāḥ | viṣṇurvāmanarūpeṇa vipro bhūtvā tamarthayat | |46 | | sa cāpi rājā viprendra ratnani ca vasūni ca | grāmāndāsīśca mahiṣīrgavāśvān rathahastinaḥ | |47|| vāhanāni ca citrāṇi suvarṇaṃ śayanāni ca | śayyāstaraṇavastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni gṛhāṇi ca ||48| | yaṃ yamarthayate vipro yāvadyaśca yathā yathā | tathā tathā sa daityendro dadātyevāvicārayan | |49| | taṃ tathā vartamānaṃ tu vāmanaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ | prāha mahyaṃ prayacchasva yadahaṃ prabravīmi te | |8.116.50 || sa tamargheṇa pādyena āsanādibhireva ca | saṃpūjyaivābravīd brūhi yattaveṣṭaṃ dvijottama | |51 || vāmana uvāca yadi prayacchase rājan yācamānāya kāmataḥ | tato bravīmyanyathā tu na vakṣyāmyasureśvara | |52| | baliruvāca jñātvārthaṃ pratijānīyāṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇa tadyadi | dātuṃ ca śakyaṃ tat syāttu tatohaṃ dātumutsahe | | 53 | | vāmana uvāca pratijñā bhavato nityamiyaṃ hyasurasattama | yadyatprayācate vipro dadyāṃ tattadahaṃ tviti ||54|| dīkṣitaścāśvamedhena tvaṃ dadāsyasurādhipa | yadyat prayācate viprastattaddatse na saṃśayaḥ ||55| | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto niścitya punarevāha taṃ nṛpaḥ | prahasya sumahāvīryaṃ idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ ||56|| baliruvāca bhavān viṣṇurviprarūpī chadmanā māṃ prayācase | kṣatradharmaṃ samutsṛjya kārpaṇyaṃ ca prabhāṣase ||57|| dīnānāmapi sarveṣāmahaṃ dadyāṃ prayācitaḥ | rājyaṃ vinā hi devāya tubhyaṃ dāsye yathepsitam ||58|| vāmana uvāca satyametadahaṃ viṣṇurhṛtarājyā vayaṃ tvayā | na rājyedya spṛhāsmākaṃ niḥspṛhā hi tato vayam | gṛhaṃ tvāṃ saṃprayācāma yatra vatsyāmi nirvṛtaḥ ||59| | baliruvāca kiṃpramāṇaṃ gṛhaṃ tadvai prayācasi sureśvara | kīdṛśaṃ kva ca tad dāsye brūhi vāmana sarvaśaḥ ||8.116.60|| vāmana uvāca sarvabhūmiguṇairyuktaṃ yatra tatra mahāgṛham | mama kramaistribhiryuktaṃ datsva rājan gṛhārthine ||61 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha śukrastadā vyāsa baliṃ prāha mahātapāḥ | na dātavyaṃ mahārāja viṣṇureva mahābalaḥ |||62 || ayaṃ sa hantā sarveṣāṃ dānavānāṃ durāsadaḥ | chadmanaivamihāyāto viṣṇurenaṃ visarjaya | |63 || anādṛtya vacastasya provāca ditinandanaḥ | dāsye tubhyaṃ gṛhaṃ viṣṇo yādṛśaṃ tvaṃ prayācase | |64|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā provāca madhusūdanaḥ | baliṃ rājānamanaghaṃ sarveṣāmeva sannidhau | |65| | vāmana uvāca sādhyo devohamanagha dharmaputro diteḥ suta | tataḥ pratigrahe doṣo na mamāsti mahābala | |66|| yadi deyaṃ gṛhaṃ madhyaṃ paścāt tāpo na te yadi | haste mama jalaṃ rājan pātayasvāsureśvara | |67 || sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa bāḍhamityuktvā bhṛṅgāreṇa mahābalaḥ | pradātumupacakrāma vāmanāya gṛhaṃ mahat | | 68| | atha te dānavāḥ krūrāḥ pratiṣedhanalālasāḥ | ājagmurbhṛśamāyattā baliṃ prati mahāmune ||69|| prahlādo bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ mayo jambhorddhalocanaḥ | vipracittiśca vikrānta anye ca sumahābalāḥ | |8.116.70 | | ūcuste taṃ tadā gatvā kṛtvā prahlādamagrataḥ | baliṃ vairocaniṃ vyāsa cintayantaḥ parābhavam ||71 | | prahlāda uvāca kimidaṃ putra durbuddhe tvayā vyavasitaṃ mahat | nāśanaṃ ditiputrāṇāṃ naitat kāryaṃ mahābala ||72| | viṣṇureva mahāmāyo durātmā daityaghātakaḥ | lokatrayamapi hyeṣa kramiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||72 || tvamasmākaṃ gatiḥ putra tvaṃ vīryaṃ tvaṃ parākramaḥ | tvayi jīvitamāyattaṃ mā naḥ kṣipraṃ vināśaya ||74|| hiraṇyakaśipū rājā hiraṇyākṣaśca dānavaḥ | tava rājñaḥ kalāṃ putra nārghataḥ ṣoḍaśīmapi ||75|| maitasya vibudhasya tvaṃ gṛhaṃ datsva bravīmyaham | etaddhi śreyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tava caiva mahābala ||76| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ | baliḥ praṇamya dharmātmā idamāha mahāyaśāḥ | |77|| baliruvāca jānehaṃ vibudhoyaṃ vai viṣṇuḥ sarvāsurāntakaḥ | pratijñaiva mameyaṃ hi dātavyaṃ yācitena me ||78|| ahaṃ dānapatiḥ khyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | kathaṃ tadanyathā kuryāñjīvite sati dānavāḥ ||79|| adharmyamayaśasyañca asvargyaṃ bhayadaṃ mahat | kathaṃ nāmānṛtaṃ kuryāmiti me vratamāhitam | pratiśrutya kathaṃ bhūyosurāste dharmakāraṇāt (?) ||8.116.80|| prahlāda uvāca dānavānāṃ sadaityānāṃ putra dharmaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ | adharmeṇa hi vardhante sadaiva ditidānavāḥ |81|| māyā caivānṛtaṃ caiva dambhaḥ sarvavadhastathā | yajñānāṃ parimoṣaśca dharma eṣa hi naḥ śubhaḥ | |82| | sa tvaṃ pratiśrutya vibho mā dadasva durātmane | tathā hi no bhaved vṛddhiranyatheha bhayaṃ mahat ||8 3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā balirniścintya buddhimān | uvācāsuraśārdūla idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ ||84| | baliruvāca ya eṣa dharmo dharmeṇa bhavadbhiḥ saṃpracoditaḥ | na hyasya phalamānantya krūrasyāsurasattama ||85|| hiraṇyakaśipū rājā nātyantaṃ sukhamāptavān | hiraṇyākṣastathā caiva andhakaścaiva tatsutaḥ ||86| | bhavān pitāmahosmākaṃ tathā krūreṇa karmaṇā | tasmānnedaṃ praśaṃsanti ye kecidviduṣo (?) janāḥ | |87|| ṛṣayaḥ paśya satyena dharmeṇa divi saṃsthitāḥ | devā jayanti cātyarthaṃ grahā divyanti caiva hi | |88 || na kaścid dṛśyate vyomni tathā krūreṇa karmaṇā | prasādayan kṣāmaye tvāṃ bravīmi ditijeśvara (?) ||89|| prahlāda uvāca duṣṭaṃ vāpyathavā krūraṃ śobhanaṃ vāpi dānava | svakarma na vimoktavyaṃ pāramparyāgataṃ mahat ||8.116.9 0 | | ...pitṛbhiścaiva tathā caiva pitāmahaiḥ | ācīrṇaṃ putra naitatte vimoktavyaṃ mahāmune ||91 || baliruvāca pitṛbhirhi yathā cīrṇa kartavyaṃ yadaśaṅkitaiḥ | garhitaṃ yat satāṃ cāpi pitāmaha śṛṇuṣva me ||92|| āsīdṛṣiradīnātmā vāmadeva iti śrutaḥ | tasya dṛṣṭavorvaśī mohādretaḥ skando babhūva ha || 93 | | tad bhūmāvaviddhaṃ vai cakhāda vaḍavā kila | tasyā garbhaḥ samabhavat sadyaḥ sośvatarī bhavat | |94| | tāmṛṣiḥ sa sutasnehāt pupoṣa bahulā samāḥ | athāgāttatra rājarṣiraṣṭako nāma vīryavān ||95| | sa tāmapaśyadrājendra ṛṣerāśramamadhyagām | acintayaddhṛdā caiva idaṃ paramaharṣitaḥ | |96|| mama patnyāstu sadṛśī iyaṃ lakṣaṇasampadā | yadi dadyādimāṃ vipraḥ syādagraṃ mama saṃgatam | | 97|| na cāyaṃ dāsyate vipro mahyamenāṃ sudurlabhām | upāyaṃ tu kariṣyāmi yena dāsyati suprabhām | |98| | sanatkumāra uvāca (?) tatassa rājā taṃ gatvā vāmadevamuvāca ha | praṇamya bahumānena nikṛtyā śaktinandana | |99| | rājovāca aśvataryānayā kāryaṃ mama kiñcinmahāmune | saṃvatsaraṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ prayacchasva prayācitaḥ || 8.116.100 || pariprāpte punaḥ kṛtye tubhyaṃ vai dvijasattama | punaḥ pradāsye viprendra yadi deyā pradīyatām || 101 | | tataḥ sa ṛṣiśārdūlastasmai prādādaninditām | tāṃ gṛhītvā yayau rājā labdheti hṛṣitastadā | | 102 || atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe tamāha ṛṣisattamaḥ | tamuvāca tato vipraḥ prayacchāśvatarīṃ śubhām || 103 || na dadau sa hi durbuddhirṛṣiḥ krodhājjaghāna tam | tasya putrastato rājā babhūva narapuṅgavaḥ | |1 04| | tamapyāha tato vipro na dadau sa ca tāṃ tadā | tato mamāra sopyevaṃ viprakrodhād durātmavān | | 10 5| | tasya putrobhavaccaiva rājā ditijasattamaḥ | tamuvāca tato vipraḥ prayacchāśvatarīmiti | |1 06 | | atha sopi tathā kṛtvā yācitaḥ sudurātmavān | uvāca nāhaṃ dāsyāmi pitṛhantre durātmane | | 1 07|| tatastamapyasau kruddho vipraḥ prāṇairvyayojayat | tato bālaḥ sutastasya rājābhavadatidyutiḥ || 10 8|| tamapyasau tathā vipraḥ provāca krodhamūrchitaḥ | nāśayiṣye kulaṃ tad vai aṣṭakasya durātmanaḥ ||1 09|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bālaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ dvijam | uvāca sacivān pṛṣṭvā paścāddāsyāmi vāḍavām ||8.116.1 10 | sacivān sa tadānāyya apṛcchad dānaveśvara | iyamaśvatarī brūta dātavyā neti vā śubhā || 111 | | sacivā ūcuḥ pitāmahasya te pitrā iyamaśvatarī purā | varṣamekaṃ prayācyeha samānītā nareśvara | |1 1 2|| pūrṇe varṣe tu viprasya yācatopi mahāmune | na dattā sa ca kopena viprasyāsya mamāra ha | |1 13 || tataḥ pitāmahastubhyamāsīdrājā prajeśvara | tathaiva sopyadatvaināṃ viprakrodhānmamāra ha | | 1 14|| bhavām̐stu yadi pūrveṣāṃ vṛttaṃ samanuvartate | na deyā viprarūpasya mṛtyorasya durātmanaḥ | | 11 5|| teṣāntadvacanaṃ śrutvā sacivānāṃ pramanyumān | nirbhatsya tānadharmajñānidamāha mahātapāḥ ||1 16|| pūrve te maurkhyamāsthāya kṛtavantotidāruṇam | adharmyamayaśasyañca sadbhiścaiva vigarhitam ||1 17|| ahanna teṣāṃ panthānamanuvarte kathañcana | adya tānakṛtaprajñān pitṝnatha pitāmahān ||118| | gartasthān tārayiṣyāmi kulaṃ ca sumahattathā | ityuktvā nidhane teṣāṃ jātaḥ putro mahāmatiḥ ||119|| viprasyāśvatarīdāne matiṃ cakre suniścitāma | tatastamṛṣimabhyarcya gandhamālyādibhirnṛpaḥ ||8.116.120 | tāñcaivāśvatarīṃ prādādātmīyāṃ sa narādhipaḥ | vasu caiva hi dattvāsmai ṛṣiṃ taṃ sa prasādayat ||121|| tataḥ sa ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | utthāpya rājaśārdūlamidamāha tadā vibhuḥ ||1 22|| tvayā tīrṇāḥ suputreṇa pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ | narakasthā mahābāho brāhmaṇasvena veṣṭitāḥ ||123|| na kṛtyaṃ mama ratnaiśca nāśvataryā narādhipa | tuṣṭastubhyaṃ prayacchāmi sarvametannarādhipa ||1 24|| yadyaṣṭako mamaivaṃ vai kṛtavān syād durātmavān | tatputro vā mahābāho pitā vā tava durmatiḥ | |125|| vināśaṃ na gatāste syurahantuṣṭaśca sarvaśaḥ | tadāpṛcche gamiṣyāmi tavaiṣā dravyameva ca ||1 26|| tatassa ṛṣiśārdūlo jagāma vanameva hi | rājāpyaśvatarīṃ labdhvā tayā reme yathāsukham | |127|| evaṃ hi na praśaṃsanti pūrveṣāṃ dharmavarjitam | karma sarve dvijā rājan ye cānye dharmavādinaḥ | tasmāddāsyāmyahaṃ rājyaṃ vāmanāya mahātmane ||128|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatassosuraśārdūlo vāmanasya tadā kare | pātayāmāsa vidhivajjalaṃ paramapūjitam | | 1 29| | tasya pātitamātre tu jale viṣṇormahātmanaḥ | daityendrasyopari tadā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha | | 8.116.130 | | sādhusādhviti bhūtānāmadṛśyānāñca nisvanaḥ | devadundubhayaścātra svayaṃ neduranāhatāḥ | |1 3 1| | marutaśca śubhān gandhānādāya pravavuḥ śubhāḥ | hatāḥ stha dānavāssarve iti cātrābhavat svanaḥ | | 132 tatkarma tasyātisuduṣkaraṃ tadā samīkṣya sarve ṛṣayastapodhanāḥ | praśaṃsamānā ditinandaneśvaraṃ praṇemurārānmadhusūdanaṃ tadā | | 133 | | iti skandapurāṇe vāmane ṣoḍaśottaraśato’dhyāyaḥ <8.117> sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa bhagavān viṣṇuruvācāsurapuṅgavam | kramāmi vikramaiḥ paśya dānaveśvara suprabha | | 1 | | yadi cet pūryate dattaṃ na ceddātavya ityuta | bhavatā bhūmibhāgonyaḥ satyavāg bhava dānava | |2 | | baliruvāca kramasva vāmanaśreṣṭha kramām̐strīnadya sarvaśaḥ | na cet pūryeta dātāhaṃ satyametad bravīmi te | |3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa devadeveśaṃ mahādevamumāpatim | praṇeme parayā bhaktyā kramiṣyana viṣṇuravyayaḥ | |4| | tato devāḥ susaṃyattāḥ sannaddhā yuddhalālasāḥ | ākāśena mahāsatvāstatrājagmurmahābalāḥ | |5| | tatassa puṣkaradvīpe viṣṇuḥ paramadīptimat | rūpaṃ kṛtvā bhuvaṃ dyāñca..vai kramamācarat | | 6| | sa pādamudaye kṛtvā dvitīyaṃ saritāṃ patau | puṣkarasyaivottaratastena lokamimaṃ gataḥ | |7| | kramitvā vikramaṃ caikapādamutkṣipatastadā | ajako nāma daityendraḥ pādaṃ taṃ samagṛhṇata | |8| | sa taṃ sahaivāsureṇa utkṣipanmadhusūdanaḥ | kṣiptosāvasuro vyāsa adyāpi na nivartate | |9| | tato dvitīyaṃ rudrasya yogaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ | antarikṣe bhuvarloka eka eva kramobhavat | | 8.117.10 | | tatontarikṣād bhūyopi brahmaṇo yogamāsthitaḥ | svarlokamakhilaṃ vyāsa kramamekaṃ cakāra ha || 11 | | taṃ tu lokaṃ samāsādya niḥsṛtaṃ devasattamaḥ | janalokaṃ samāsādya na samāptañca tattataḥ | | 12 | | tasya cotkrakramatastatra daityāḥ śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ | abhyakramanta vegena devāstānsannyavārayan || 13 || daśa putrasahasrāṇi tanayānāṃ balestadā | yudhyamānā hatāstena vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ | | 14| | bāṇo vātaśca dvāvetau baliputrau mahābalau | tasmād bhraṣṭau tadā vyāsa saṃgrāmādyayaturmune || 1 5|| atha brahmā tadābhyetya samayaṃ pracakāra ha | vimucya pāśāndeveśa imaṃ loka pitāmahaḥ || 16| | bale tvayākhilaṃ rājyaṃ devānāṃ pratipāditam | satye tvaṃ samaye sthitvā mā rājyaṃ kāmaye punaḥ ||17|| yāvanmanvantaramidameṣa te samayaḥ śubhaḥ | paripālyaḥ sadā vatsa gaccha caiva yathāsukham | | 18|| idaṃ yajñaphalaṃ samyagavāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ | yogañca matprasādena bhūya eva hyavāpsyasi ||1 9|| saivamuktastamāpṛcchya pātālaṃ saṃviveśa ha | devā api tataḥ prāpya svaṃ rājyaṃ mumudurbhṛśam ||8.117.20|| vyāsa uvāca kīdṛk sa bhagavān viṣṇustyaktvā svaṃ dharmamūrjitam | pratyāharata trailokyaṃ na caivāsyānayobhavat | |21 || sanatkumāra uvāca kramatastasya devasya biṣṇordīptānalaprabham | babhau rūpamatīvograṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ surairapi ||22|| atha devāḥ sahendreṇa viṣṇuṃ paramadaivatam | tuṣṭuvuḥ praśaśaṃsuśca kṛtakṛtyā mahābalam | |23 || prītyā paramayā yuktāḥ sarve divyāstradhāriṇaḥ | dānavairardyamānānāmasmākaṃ vibudheśvaraḥ | |24| | trātā rājyapradaścaiva tvamabhūssurasattama| tvayā sma sukhinaḥ sarve karmiṇaḥ sukṛtairyathā ||25|| tava deva prabhāveṇa rājyaṃ bhokṣyāma vijvarāḥ | tapanasya(?) prabhāveṇa yathā pūrvaṃ suretarāḥ ||26| | tvaṃ hi naḥ paramaṃ dhāma tathaiva ca parā gatiḥ | paraṃ pavitraṃ tvaṃ caiva ṛte devamumāpatim ||27|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasyaivaṃ stūyamānasya tridaśaiḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ | abhūt tuṣṭistadātyarthaṃ bahumānastathātmani ||28|| tatobhimānatastasya sa yogaḥ paramo mune | abhraśyata yathā vahniḥ salilena samukṣitaḥ ||29|| tatastadantaraṃ labdhvā pāpmā sā hyāsurī mune | prahṛṣṭā saṃprahṛṣyainamāviveśa janārdanam ||8.117.3 0 || sa tayā pāpmayā vyāsa āviṣṭo viṣṇuravyayaḥ | na babhau dīptimām̐statra santaḥ prāpyeva dāruṇam ||3 1|| iti skandapurāṇe vāmane trailokyakramaṇe saptadaśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.118> sanatkumāra uvāca tathā sa pāpmayā vyāsa āsuryā saṃgatastadā | tadeva rūpaṃ saṃprāpto vāmanaṃ devasattamaḥ ||1|| taṃ tathā vartamānaṃ tu devāssarve savāsavāḥ | abruvan kimidaṃ deva tava vaikṛtamīdṛśam ||2|| teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ | marīcirbhṛguratriśca aṅgirā kratureva ca ||3 | vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaśca pulaho rucireva ca | viśvāmitro vāmadevo bharadvājastathauśijaḥ ||4|| gautamaśca śaradvām̐śca kaśyapaścoddalastathā | vatsāro naidhruvaścaiva cyavanaścātmavānapi ||5|| dadhīcaśca ṛcīkaśca jamadagniśca viśrutaḥ | jāmadagnyastathā rāmo hyagastiśca mahātapāḥ ||6|| bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca śaktiśca saparāśaraḥ | kuṇiśca kuṇibāhaśca tathā sārasvataśca yaḥ ||7| | ete cānye ca ṛṣayo nāradaśca saparvataḥ | ūcurdevāṃstadā vyāsa brahmaṇā saṃpracoditāḥ ||8 | | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vayaṃ devādya saṃprāptā brahmalokāt sureśvarāḥ | ājñaptā brahmaṇā kṣipraṃ devasyāsya kṛtena ha ||9|| yadanena parityajya svadharmaṃ devabandhunā | pratigrahaḥ kṛto rājyaṃ vaikuṇṭhena mahātmanā | | 8.118.10 | | tataḥ pāpmāsurāṇāṃ yā sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarī | sāsurān saṃparityajya keśavaṃ saṃviveśa ha | | 11 | | tathābhibhūto devoyamaśaktaḥ śatrubādhane | na cāsya tejaḥ sarve vai paśyadhvaṃ pūrvavacchubham || 12 || sa eṣa yadi manyadhvaṃ tīrtheṣu susamāhitaḥ | snātvāśvamedhena punaryajatāṃ daivataissaha | | 13 | | tataḥ pinākinaṃ dṛṣṭavā tena pūtaśca sarvaśaḥ | bhavitā pāpmayā mukta evamāha pitāmahaḥ | |14|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste sahitāssarve devā munijanaissaha | tīrthayātrāmakurvan taṃ gṛhītvā viṣṇumavyayam || 1 5| | te tu puṣkariṇīṃ ramyāṃ suṣumṇeti suviśrutām | nalinīvanasaṃchannāṃ prahṛṣṭāṇḍajanāditām | | 1 6| | bahuvṛkṣavanopetāṃ phullapaṅkajaśobhitām | bahūpavanavṛkṣāḍhyāṃ sūkṣmakāñcanabālukām | | 17| | vajravaidūryanīlāṅkāmindranīlalatopalām | vividhāṇḍajaśabdāḍhyāṃ siddhacāraṇasevitām ||18|| kinnarodgītamadhurāmapsarobhiśca sevitām | mattabhramaragītāḍhyāṃ śrīniketananiketanām || 1 9|| yasyāṃ snātvā naro martyaḥ svaśarīreṇa suvrata | vimānenārkabhāsena gacchanti hyamarālayam ||8.118.2 0 || tāmāsādya tadā devāḥ suṣumnāmṛṣibhissaha | padmāni jagṛhuścaiva mṛṇālāni bisāni ca ||21 || atha tatra mahāpadmaṃ vikacaṃ sumanoharam | sahasrapatrasaṃchanna magastyoddhṛtya gṛhya tat | |22 | tasyāstīre nicikṣepa tataḥ sasnau yathāsukham | jagrāha tacca devendra adṛṣṭaḥ kenacidvibhuḥ ||23 | | athāgastyaḥ samuttīrṇo na tatpadmamapaśyata | sarvāṃśca tānupāmantrya idamāha mahāmanāḥ ||24|| agastya uvāca mama padma mahaddevāḥ kenādattaṃ supuṣpitam | sanatkumāra uvāca tatasta ṛṣayassarve devāścāpi ṛṣestadā | pratyayān vividhām̐ścakrurekaikaśyena suvrata ||25| | indra uvāca sa yajñairyajatāmiṣṭairbahubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ | vaset svarge ca niyataṃ yaste harati paṅkajam ||26|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste menire sarve devendreṇa mahātmanā | gṛhītaṃ paṅkajaṃ vyāsa indraścainamuvāca ha | |27| | indra uvāca ṛṣīṇāṃ dharmatattvāni śṛṇuyāya vayaṃ katham | upāyoyaṃ kṛtastasmād gṛhāṇedaṃ jalodbhavam ||28 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste tatra saṃpūjya agnīn devān pitṝnapi | brāhmaṇāṃstarpayitvā ca viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā tathāśiṣaḥ ||29|| jagmuranyāni tīrthāni supuṇyāni śubhāni ca | bahūni vyāsa munayo devāśca susamāhitāḥ | |8.118.3 0 | | athāpaśyanta te vṛkṣamekaṃ śuṣkaṃ mahātarum | koṭare ca śukaṃ tasya śuṣyantaṃ vyākulendriyam | |3 1 | | te dṛṣṭavā tamapṛcchanta mahendreṇa divaukasaḥ | divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā śukaṃ tuṣṭvā yaśasvinaḥ ||3 2|| indra uvāca khageśvara mṛte hyasmin kasmāttiṣṭhasi pādape | apuṣpaphalapatre tvaṃ śuṣke nirupajīvite ||3 3 | | śuka uvāca eṣa vṛkṣaḥ purā hyāsīt sumahān kalpavṛkṣavat | phalairamṛtakalpaiśca ciraścāpyupajīvitaḥ | |34|| daśāmimāṃ punaḥ prāptaḥ kālena ca vanaspatiḥ | jahyādenaṃ kathaṃ prājñaḥ kṛtajño mādṛśaḥ punaḥ | |35| | kṛtaghnaḥ syāmahaṃ deva bhṛtamenaṃ parityajan | ye lokā hyasya vṛkṣasya te me santu śacīpate | |36|| indra uvāca prajñāvānasi medhāvī mahātmā nayatattvavit | kathaṃ mūḍhamivātmānaṃ karoṣi khagapārthiva ||37|| vanaspatirayaṃ sādho dharma eṣosya nityadā | abuddhipūrvaṃ pakṣīndra svabhāvāccātra kāritaḥ ||38|| nāsyeyaṃ buddhirabhavadvayāṃsi mayi nityaśaḥ | vasantu mama khādantu phalāni ca yathāsukham ||39 || acetano yathā hadyagnirāpo vāyuśca tattvataḥ | bhūtānāmupakārāya svabhāvānnānyathā hi te ||8.118.40|| tadvat tvaṃ khaga vṛkṣasya buddhvā karma svabhāvajam | parityajyemamanyatra gaccha yatra sukhaṃ bhavet ||41|| śuka uvāca na mūḍhosmi sureśāna māvamaṃsthā vaco mama | śṛṇuṣva ca yathāprajñā mama deveśvara prabho ||42|| acetano yathā hyagnirāpo vāyuśca tattvataḥ | na tathā suraśārdūla vṛkṣagulmalatādayaḥ | |43 || vihito hyeṣa saṃsāraḥ sarveṣāmeva karmiṇām | tasmādacetanatvante na vṛkṣeṣu sureśvara ||44|| yathā ca buddhirvṛkṣāṇāṃ kathaṃ kuryāma sarvaśaḥ | upakārāstu bhūtānāmiti me tanniśāmaya ||45|| svayambhuretānavadat sṛṣṭvā mukhyānmahāyaśāḥ42 | prajānāmupakārāya vartadhvamiti sarvaśaḥ ||46|| tataste phalapuṣpatvakprabālādibhirantaśaḥ | upakārāya vartante sarvabhūteṣu lokapa ||47|| vāyuragnistathāpaśca kintavāviditaṃ prabho | buddhipūrvaṃ pravartante yathāvaddhi nagāḥ śubhāḥ | |48 || indra uvāca kathaṃ tavedaṃ vijñānaṃ ko dharmaḥ kaśca te śramaḥ | etadveditumicchāmaḥ kathayasva khageśvara | |49| | śuka uvāca janmaprabhṛti deveśa na mitradruhaṇe mama | buddhiḥ samabhavannityaṃ mṛtyāvapi samāgate | |8.118.50 | | | mātāpitṛparaścāhaṃ svadāraniratastathā | nāvamanye ca bhūtāni ṛtukāle vrajāmi ca | |51 || na bhakṣayāmi dhānyāni pareṣāṃ devatādhipa | tena me jñānamamalaṃ pravṛttaṃ surasattama | |52 | | indra uvāca tuṣṭosmi tava sadbuddhyā anayā khagasattama | varaṃ vṛṇu pradāsyāmi yad bhavānmanyate śubham ||53 | | śuka uvāca jīvatāmeṣa devendra tvatprasādād vanaspatiḥ | ato nānyamahaṃ deva vṛṇuyāṃ varamuttamam | |54|| indra uvāca karmaṇā svena jantūnāṃ gatayaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ | svenaiva karmaṇā pātaḥ kintavānena buddhiman ||5 5| | idaṃ vimānamāruhya mayā dattaṃ khagottama | mama lokaṃ vraja kṣipraṃ stūyamāno yathā nara | | 56 | | śuka uvāca na lokānahamicchāmi na vimānaṃ na vai sukham | prayācitaṃ prayacchasva jīvatāmeṣa vai nagaḥ | | 57|| sanatkumāra uvāca sadbhāvaṃ tasya taṃ jñātvā sarvaṃ ca surasattamaḥ | cakāra sa yathāpūrvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam | |58| | śukaśca karmaṇā tena dṛḍhabhaktitayāpi ca | dīneṣvabhyupapattyā ca brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha | |59| | iti skandapurāṇe vāmanatīrthayātrāyām aṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.119> sanatkumāra uvāca tataste daivatā ssarve kṛmilāṃ nāma vai purīm | upāgatā hyavaikṣanta tatra cedaṃ mahāmune || 1 | | brāhmaṇī gautamī nāma rudrāṇīva yathāparā | dhārmikī ca vadānyā ca tapasā dagdhakilviṣā | | 2| | tasyāstapasi saktāyā brahmalokaṃ gate patau | kṛṣṇasarpeṇa mahatā suto daṣṭo mamāra ha | | 3 | | taṃ deśamāgamattatra vyādhorjunaka ityuta | sa āgatastadāpaśyadviṣeṇa samabhiplutam | |4|| sa gatvā gautamīṃ prāha sutoyaṃ te tapodhane | daṣṭohinā mamārāśu kinnainamavabudhyase | |5 | | sā tathoktā samāgamya putraṃ dṛṣṭvā gatāyuṣam | ruroda bahudhā vyāsa mṛtāpatyā mahāvratā | |6 || tasyā vilapamānāyā vyādhaḥ sorjunakastadā | bilaṃ khanitvā niṣkṛṣya tamahiṃ samabandhata | |7|| sa badbastena duṣṭātmā kṛṣṇasarpaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | uvāca taṃ tadā vyādhaṃ yosāvarjunakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||8|| kiṃ mayā tava baddhena nādharmaṃ paripaśyasi | na caiva bhakṣyā martyānāṃ vayaṃ kiṃ māṃ na muñcasi ||9|| arjuna uvāca tvāmādya khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛtvā bhakṣaṃ dāsyāmi vahirṇe | tvayāyaṃ bhakṣito yasmādṛṣiputro mamāra ha ||8.119.1 0|| sarpa uvāca kālena coditohaṃ taṃ daṣṭavānṛṣiputrakam | na māṃ doṣeṇārjunaka kṣeptumarhasi tattvataḥ ||11|| arjuna uvāca codito yadi kālena daṣṭavānasi pannaga | nimittaṃ tvaṃ hi maraṇe tasmāddhaṃsyāmi te bhṛśam ||12|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatassā gautamī vyāsa kālaṃ mṛtyumathākarot | duḥkhena parameṇārtā kālo bhītastatobhyagāt ||13|| kāla uvāca ahaṃ hi sarvasatvānāṃ kālo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ | codito mṛtyunaivāhaṃ hatavānṛṣiputrakam ||14|| arjuna uvāca tvayā vā mṛtyunā vāyaṃ codito daṣṭavānyadi | vadhe nimittameṣosya tasmādenaṃ nihanmyaham ||15|| sanatkumāra uvāca atha mṛtyustadābhetya taṃ deśaṃ sumahāmanāḥ | gautamyāstapaso bhīta idaṃ provāca susvaram ||16|| ahamapyeṣa saṃbaddhaṃ niyatyā susamāhitaḥ | mārayāmi na me doṣaṃ kartumarhasi suvrate | |17|| arjuna uvāca niyatirvāstu mṛtyurvā kālo vāpyastu kāraṇam | kṛṣṇasarpo nimittaṃ tu tasmādvadhyo na saṃśayaḥ ||18|| sanatkumāra uvāca athāgānniyatistatra uvācedaṃ ca sā tadā | gautamīṃ duḥkhitāṃ vyāsa bhītā prāha tadā vacaḥ ||19|| kṛtāntavaśagā sādhvi jantūnnityamatandritā | pāśairbaddhvā vaśaṃ mṛtyornayāmi varavarṇini ||8.119.20|| kṛtānta uvāca ahaṃ hi kiṅkaraḥ sādhvi yamasya sumahātmanaḥ | tena pracodito jantūnnayāmi yamasādanam ||21 || arjuna uvāca yamopi vā kṛtānto vā ete vāpyasya kāraṇam | naivamevaṃ durācāro vimokṣyeta kadācana ||22|| sanatkumāra uvāca tato yamastadā vyāsa svayameva mahāmanāḥ | tatrāgāttāmidaṃ caiva gautamīṃ sobhyuvāca ha ||23|| nāhaṃ naite mahāsatvāsta putrasya kāraṇam | maraṇe tasya vīkṣasva śṛṇu cāpi vaco mama | |24|| jantūnāṃ dehasaṃyogo dharmādharmakṛtaḥ śubhe | viyogaścāpi dehena tābhyāmeva kṣayātpunaḥ | |25|| dehināṃ dharma evaika āyuṣo heturucyate | tatkṣaye maraṇaṃ proktaṃ kālo mṛtyuśca sa smṛtaḥ | |26| | kṛte varṣasahasraistu caturbhiḥ kāla ucyate | tretāyāntu trisāhasro dvāpare dvisahasrikaḥ | |27|| kalau tu śatamevāhuḥ kālaṃ jantormahāvrate | akālenyattataḥ proktaṃ taccāpi maraṇaṃ śṛṇu | |28|| indriyeṣvasya ye devā vasanti dvipadāṃ vare | tesya sarve harantyekaṃ bhāgaṃ daivatasattamāḥ | |2 9 | | cakṣuṣā paśyato duṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca bruvatastathā | śṛṇvato manvataścaiva budhyataścāpi paśyataḥ | | 8.119.30 || tathā sparśayataścaiva jighrato bhuñjatopi vā | ādānād gamānāccaiva ānandotsargatastathā ||3 1 | | bhāgaṃ bhūtāni cānyaṃ tu haranti punareva hi suduṣṭaṃ vartatasteṣu bhāgañca vyādhayoparam || 32 | | aparaṃ pitaro bhāgaṃ devāścānyamatoparam | aparaṃ carṣayo vahniścandrādityau grahāstathā ||3 3 || tasyaivaṃ dehinaḥ sādhvi yāvadevāhṛtaṃ bhavet | tāvadeva sa jīveta akālaḥ sa ca vakṣyate || 34|| yathā ca mriyate janturakāle tapasaidhite | tathā śṛṇu mamādyeha gadato varavarṇini | |35|| yāvanna hīyate tasya jantorāyurmahāvrate | tāvatsa jīvitaṃ prāpya tasyānte mriyate punaḥ | |3 6| | tasya yenāparādhena āyurdevā haranti tat | tenādharmo mahāntasya utpanno jīvitāntakaḥ | | 37|| prādurbhūtastadā sādhvi vyādhirmarmāṇi kṛntati | sa kṛttamarmā hyavaśo dehaṃ tyaktvā mahāvrate | |38| | anyaddehaṃ samāsādya gatimanyāṃ prapadyate | yesya vyādhiṃ na kurute sodharmonugrahāt punaḥ | |3 9 | | devānāṃ dehavāsānāṃ tamapyanyena hanti vai | viṣaśastraprapatanairjantubhiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ | anyaiśca bahubhirghorairnātra doṣaḥ prapaśyataḥ||8.119.40 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tatassā tapasā dṛṣṭavā gautamī sumahāvratā | tamarjunakamāhedaṃ vacanaṃ duḥkhavarjitā | |41 || gautamyuvāca muñcārjunaka nāyaṃ me pannago vadhamarhati | āviṣṭoyamadharmeṇa daivataiścādaśat sutam | |42 | | īśvarāste mahātmāno jantūnāviśya cetanān acetanām̐śca sarvetra prayuñjanti yathātatham | |43 | | mṛta eṣa svadharmeṇa nāsti doṣastapasvinām | gacchadhvaṃ daivatāḥ sarve svān gṛhān kimihāsyate ||4 4|| sanatkumāra uvāca tatastā devatāḥ sarvāḥ preṣitā brahmayoṣitā | samamūcustadā vyāsa gautamīṃ tāmidaṃ vacaḥ | |45 || devā ūcuḥ tuṣṭāḥ sma tava dharmajñe tapasā dagdhakilbiṣe | jīvatāmeṣa te putraḥ svadharme cāvatiṣṭhatu ||46|| sarpa eṣa svayaṃ sādhvi adharmo mūrtimān sthitaḥ | vyādharūpī ca dharmoyaṃ paśyaitau sumahāvrate ||47|| parīkṣā te kṛtā hyeṣā devairetairmahāvrate | tavākṣayā bhaviṣyanti lokāḥ sarve na saṃśayaḥ ||48|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste sahasā tatra devā indrapurogamāḥ | avaikṣanta yathāvṛttaṃ tacca sarvaṃ nyavedayam ||49|| snātvā cānyadagacchante punastīrthaṃ samāhitāḥ | sarva eva mahābhāgāstathānyāni punaḥ punaḥ ||8.119.50 || krameṇa viharantaste kṛtyāmabhyāgamatpunaḥ | yatra kṛtyā hatā pūrvaṃ devendreṇa mahaujasā ||51|| vyāsa uvāca kena sotpāditā kṛtyā kimarthaṃ kasya vā vibho | kathaṃ ca nihatā bhūya etadicchāmi veditum | |52|| sanatkumāra uvāca tṛṇabinduriti khyāta āsīdrājā mahābalaḥ | sa provāca munīn sapta idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ ||53 || yājayadhvaṃ hi māṃ viprā dāsye vittaṃ hi vo bahu | tebruvanna vayaṃ sādho yājayāma nareśvara ||54|| sa dīkṣito yadānyena anāvṛṣṭyā mahāmanāḥ | te vai bubhukṣayāviṣṭā yajñaṃ prāptā yadṛcchayā ||55|| atha tānabravīdrājā brūta kiṃ pradadāni vaḥ | ūcuste kruddhavadanāḥ sutaṃ no datsva pārthiva | |56|| tebhyaḥ satkṛtya putrañca dhanañcaiva sa pārthivaḥ | praṇamya bahumānena pārāśaryopapādayat ||57| | tathā tasyānatasyaivaṃ dravyaṃ hitvā tapodhanāḥ | sutaṃ gṛhītvāgacchante saukumāryāt sa bālakaḥ | |58|| kṣuttṛṣābhyarditastatraḥ adhvanā ca mamāra ha | dāvāgnau te ca taṃ nyasya nirīkṣantovatasthire | | 5 9|| teṣāṃ tatrekṣatāṃ vyāsa ājagāma narādhipaḥ | uvāca tānṛṣīm̐ścedaṃ prahasan divyakuṇḍalaḥ ||8.119.60 | | tṛṇabinduruvāca yūyaṃ pratigrahaṃ matto nāgṛhṇata tapodhanāḥ | yājayadhvaṃ na caivāsmān munayastapasaidhitāḥ ||61 || iha doṣaṃ na paśyadhvaṃ maraṇesya śiśordvijāḥ | adharmye cāyaśasye ca aho dharme hi vo matiḥ || 62 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste tamanādṛtya anuktvā kiñcideva ca | jagmuranyāṃ diśaṃ vyāsa vane kṣutparipīḍitāḥ | |63 | | tṛṇabinduśca tapasā tatra vṛkṣān bahūm̐stadā | asṛjat tatkṣaṇād vyāsa teṣāṃ sukhahitepsayā | |64| | te ca tadvanamāsādya bahūn vṛkṣān phalānvitān | apaśyanta tadā vyāsa parāṃ tuṣṭiṃ ca te yayuḥ ||65| | gṛhītvā bibhiduścaiva dadṛśuścaiva teṣvatha | suvarṇamannaṃ bhakṣām̐śca tathā raupyañca suprabham | |66 || tṛṇubindukṛtaṃ tacca temanyanta taponvitāḥ | tataste tadvanaṃ tyaktvā ṛṣyaḥ sapta suvratāḥ | anyāṃ diśaṃ prapadyanta tṛṇabinduścukopa ca | |67|| uvāca tānṛṣīn gatvā praṇataḥ prāñjaliśca saḥ | manyunātiparītātmā saṃvignotha narādhipaḥ | | 68 | | tṛṇabinduruvāca naivāsmi patito viprā duṣṭakarmā na caiva ha | na caiva varjito viprairna cāyajvā na pāpakṛt ||69|| narādhipānāṃ vaṃśesmi jātaḥ śuddhe tapodhanāḥ | samyak prajāḥ pālayāmi kiṃ māṃ na bahu manyata | |8.119.70 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣayaste mahāvratāḥ | ūcurna te vayaṃ rājan pratigṛhaṇīma sarvathā ||71 || śobhanosi guṇairyuktaḥ prajāpālaḥ prajāpatiḥ | santuṣṭāḥ smo na te dravyaṃ pratigṛhṇīma bhūpate | |72| sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktvā rājānaṃ sarva eva yayurmune | sopi rājā mahāmanyustadā dīptaṃ hutāśanam ||73 | | juhāva kṛtyāṃ tasmācca cakāra sumahābalām | yātudhānīmiti khyātāmuvācedaṃ ca tāṃ tadā ||74| | gatvā sapta munīn kṛtye bhakṣayasva mahābale | upadhārya hi nāmāni vasiṣṭhādīm̐stapodhanān | |75 || sā gatvā tu śubhānnāma divyāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ śubhām | tasyāstīraṃ samāsādya tasthau tān vai pratīkṣatī | |76| | ṛṣayastepi saṃvignāḥ kṣuttṛṣṇāvyākulendriyāḥ | anyāndeśān vimārgantaḥ śubhāṃ vāpīṃ yayustataḥ | |77| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadgamane vyāsa dṛṣṭvā doṣaṃ purandaraḥ | parivrājakaveṣeṇa śvadvitīyobhyagacchata | |78| | taṃ dṛṣṭvā tebruvan sarve parasparamanulvaṇam | hasantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ tridaṇḍavyagrapāṇinam | |79 | | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ nūnameṣa divārātrau nityameva hyatandritaḥ | cakhāda yata eṣotra tatoyaṃ pīvarobhavat | |8.119.8 0 | | athavottānahastoyaṃ nityameva prayācakaḥ | tapaḥsvādhyāyavikretā tenāyaṃ pīvarobhavata | |81 | | tamevaṃ bahudhā kalpya ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ | papracchuramitātmānaṃ kastvamityeva vādinaḥ | |82 | | indra uvāca ahaṃ parivrāḍ viprendrā āgacchāmi daśerakāt | prayāsyāmi śubhāṃ vāpīṃ nāmnāhaṃ tu śunassakhā ||83 || śvāno mama sadā hīṣṭāḥ śunāṃ caiva sadā hyaham | tasmācchunaḥ sakhā nāmnā khyātohaṃ dvijasattamāḥ | |84|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste saha tenaiva śubhāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ yayuḥ | dadṛśustāṃ ca kṛtyāṃ te tayā caiva nivāritāḥ | |85| | yadi vā rocate viprā asyāmabhyavagāhitum | nāmāni kathayitveha caradhvaṃ sukhamavyayāḥ | |86|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste tāṃ tadā kanyāmūcurevaṃ bhavatviti | śvasakhā cedamāhainānṛṣīn sarvānaridandamaḥ | |87|| viprā iyaṃ yātudhānī neyaṃ prakṛtamānuṣī | bhavitavyaṃ hi kāryeṇa yatheyaṃ vadate hi vaḥ | |88| | te yūyaṃ yadi manyadhvaṃ śreyaḥ paramakaṃ hitam | tathā nāmāni vibrūta yatheyaṃ nopadhārayet | |89|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ bhavatviti procya te vyāsa munayaḥ śubhāḥ | nāmāni tasyāḥ śrāvyaiva yatheṣṭaṃ te jagāhire ||8.119.90| | nairuktāni svanāmāni durbodhāni ca tebruvan | na mene yāni kṛtyā sā tataste jalamāviśan ||91|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāmalakṣayitvā sā nāmāni tu śikhodbhavā | śvasakhaṃ prāha brūhi tvaṃ tato yāsyasi vā na vā | |92|| śvasakha uvāca śunāmasmi sakhā krūre śvabhiśca saha saṃgataḥ | śvasakhaṃ tena māṃ viddhi yātudhāni niśācari ||93 || yātudhānyuvāca sakṛdeva punarbrūhi nāma tvaṃ mānuṣādhama | tato yāsyasi viprāṇāṃ samīpaṃ vidito mama ||94| | śvasakha uvāca śunāmasmi sakhā devaḥ sakhyaṃ menapagaṃ śvabhiḥ | śvasakhā tena hanmi tvā yātudhāni niśāmaya ||95|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktvā tāṃ krūrāṃ tridaṇḍena sureśvaraḥ | mūrdhnyājaghāna tenāśu bhasmasādabhavacca sā | |96|| tṛṇabindusutaścāsau kṛtyayā hatamātrayā | śakreṇa jīvitastūrṇaṃ pitaraṃ samupāgamat ||97| | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ tāṃ sa nihatyendraḥ śvasakhā śaktinandana | mṛṇālavisapadmāni ṛṣīṇāmaharatpunaḥ | |98| | tataste samyaguttīrṇā apaśyanto ruṣānvitāḥ | cakrire śapathān viprāḥ parasparamanuvratāḥ | |99|| tataste sarva evaitya śvasakhaṃ munisattamāḥ | abruvan tvayi śaṃkā no brūhi yena vimucyase | | 8.119.100 | | śvasakha uvāca yo vo harati mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca | sa sukhī miṣṭamaśnātu sasuhṛt saparigrahaḥ | |1 01 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste ṛṣayo vyāsa ūcuḥ sarve purandaram | tvayā gṛhītaṃ dravyaṃ nastat prayacchasva naḥ punaḥ || 102 || teṣāṃ sa bhagavān vyāsa mūlāni ca phalāni ca | sarvāṇyevādadat prīta idaṃ covāca tānṛṣīn || 103 || indra uvāca iyaṃ kṛtyā hatā viprā yuṣmadarthe purā kṛtā | mayā hitārthaṃ yuṣmākaṃ tridaṇḍena tapodhanāḥ | kruddhena rājñā yuṣmākaṃ kṛtaiṣā tṛṇabindunā | | 1 04| | sanatkumāra uvāca tāmāgamya tato devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | viṣṇuṃ taṃ snapayāñcakrustīrthe ṛṣigaṇārccite || 1 05| | tataste himavacchailaṃ samāgamya mudānvitāḥ | ayājayayan tadā viṣṇumaśvamedhena suvratāḥ | tasmin yajati deveśastryambakaḥ sagaṇeśvaraḥ | yajñaṃ prati mudā yukta ājagāma vihāyasā || 1 07|| vyāsa uvāca aho bata tvayedaṃ me kathitaṃ brahmaṇaḥ suta | yātudhānyā upākhyānaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sudurvidam ||1 08|| idaṃ hi guhyaṃ paramaṃ mahārthavat sadā yaśasyaṃ paramaṃ ca pāvanam | tvayā mahāyoga yathāvadīritaṃ purāmṛtaṃ pūrṇaśaśiprabhaṃ yathā | | 10 9|| iti skandapurāṇe vāmanatīrthayātrāyāṃ yātudhānyupākhyāne ūnaviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.120> vyāsa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ sa bhagavān yathāgātparameśvaraḥ | yajñena yajamānaṃ taṃ samīkṣya kathayasva naḥ || 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca sa tu śūladharo devo bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmuvācedaṃ devīṃ himavataḥ sutām ||2| | devyadya subhage loke kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī śubhā | rajanyāmadya yāsyāva śmaśānānyabhivīkṣitum | |3 || devyuvāca yathā te rocate deva tathā bhavatu lokapa | taveṣṭaṃ yanmahādeva mamāpi dviguṇaṃ hi tat ||4| | atha tasmindine vyāsa ujjayinyāṃ mahāmune | brāhmaṇasya suto bālaḥ śucirvidvānmamāra ha | |5| | taṃ tebhisaṃskṛtya tadā alaṃkṛtya yathā vidhi | krośantaśca rudantaśca śmaśānāyaiva ninyire | |6 | | te śmaśānaṃ tadā nītvā bālaṃ taṃ raktapādakam | snehād duḥkhaparītāśca rurudurbahudhā bhṛśam | |7| | tathā tān rudato vīkṣya kraddho gṛdhraḥ kṣudhānvitaḥ | prājñavat sa tu saṃdiśya tānuvāca dvijām̐stadā ||8 | viprāḥ śṛṇuta me vākyaṃ mānuṣā yadvadāmi vaḥ | buddhihīnāḥ stha suvyaktaṃ niśāmayata madvacaḥ | |9 | | mṛta eṣa hi kālena kiṃ śocatha yathābudhāḥ | rudito naiṣa jīveta svārthaṃ kuruta vijvarāḥ | |8.120.1 0 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śratvā tadā tyaktvā sutaṃ yayuḥ | muhurmuhurnirīkṣanta atha tān jambukobravīt | | 11 | | aho dhiṅ mānuṣāḥ sarve vīkṣadhvaṃ buddhivarjitāḥ | niḥsnehāścākṛtajñāśca tyaktvainaṃ yātha vai katham ||1 2| | duḥkhena labhyate putrastathā caiva prasūyate | duḥkhena ca punaḥ krūrā varddhate vyādhyupadrutaḥ | | 13 || vismṛtāni hi vastāni cāṭūni subahūni vai | akarodyānyayaṃ bāla aho niḥsnehatā hi vaḥ | | 14|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste jambukavacaḥ śrutvā vyāsa samāgatāḥ | parivārya rudantaśca tasthuḥ pitṛvane tadā | | 15 | | athāgānniśi deveśaḥ kapardī priyayā saha | gaṇaiḥ sarvairvṛto devaḥ saha nandīśvareṇa ca ||1 6|| sa tānīśaḥ samabhyetya sarvabhūtasukhāvahaḥ | varadosmīti tāṃstatra rudataḥ pratyuvāca ha || 17|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste dīnayā vācā vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ | ūcurjīvaḥ suto noyaṃ bhaveddevājñayā tava ||18|| teṣāṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra jīvayitvā sutaṃ śiśum | gaṇeśatvaṃ dadau divyaṃ vāsaṃ tatraiva cākṣayam ||19|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa tāṃ niśāṃ prāpya śmaśānāni yathāvidhi | gatvā jagāma vaidūryaṃ kūṭaṃ himavataḥ śubham ||8.120.20|| sa dīptatejā vibhuravyayātmā pinākadhṛk parvatakūṭavāsī | uvāca tān yajñavareṇa dīkṣitān varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ tridivaikasaṃśrayāḥ ||21|| iti skandapurāṇe viṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.121> sanatkumāra uvāca tetha dṛṣṭavā mahādevaṃ saptalokaikabāndhavam | ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve jānubhyāṃ śirasā natāḥ ||1 || bhagavam̐llokakāmena hariṇā devasattama | kṛtaḥ pratigrahaḥ pūrvaṃ yena pāpmā tamarcchata ||2|| tadasya jagato nātha bhaktasya praṇatasya ca | asmābhiryācyamānastvaṃ kuru śreyaḥ sureśvaraḥ ||3|| samāpyatāmayaṃ yajñaḥ pāpmanā mucyatāṃ hariḥ | svāmūrjāṃ pratipadyantāṃ devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ ||4|| sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavān hṛṣitānanaḥ | samāpya yajñaṃ śūlena giriṃ taṃ samavārayat ||5| | tasmād bhedāttato hyāpaḥ sudhāśaṃkhendupāṇḍarāḥ | niḥsṛtāstatra te viṣṇuṃ snapayāñcakrire tadā | |6|| tasyātha snātamātrasya śarīrādabhiniḥsṛtā | pāpmāsurī mahāghorā vikṛtā vikṛtānanā | |7| | devānabhidrutā hantuṃ niruddhā devabandhunā | ..................| uvāca tāṃ na hantavyā devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | |8 | | ihaiva ca tava sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati supūjitam | puṇyā ca sarvatīrthebhyaḥ sarvapātakanāśanī ||9| | sapta pūrvān parāṃścaiva tārayiṣyasi nityaśaḥ | saṃdhyeti jagati khyātā sarvatīrthavarā śubhā || 8.121.10 | | vāridhārā śubhā divyā sarvayajñaphalapradā | tvāmupāsya kulān sapta tārayiṣyanti mānavāḥ | | 11 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste daivatāḥ sarve rudrasya vacanāttadā | arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ devadevamumāpatim || 12 || devasyāyatanaṃ kṛtvā jagmustridivameva ca | gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu śivakūṭe tadā hariḥ | | 13 | | aśvamedhaṃ tadā yaṣṭvā devamārādhayat sthitaḥ | tasyātha varṣaiḥ ṣaḍbhistu sahasreṇa ca tanyataḥ | māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhiśca deveśastutoṣa vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | | 14| | somaḥ sanandiḥ sagaṇa idaṃ provāca taṃ punaḥ | hṛṣyamāṇaḥ sutuṣṭātmā brūhi kiṃ pradadāni te | | 1 5| | viṣṇuruvāca bhagavan pāpmanā vāpi tapasā vāpi lokapa | lopo na me yathā syādvai tanmamācakṣva kālahan | | 1 6|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ prahasya deveśaḥ prīyamāṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ | uvāca viṣṇumāmantrya guhyaṃ cara mahāvratam | | 17|| sa cātha kṛtarakṣastaṃ sarvadharmāvahaṃ śubham | yogaṃ yantraṃ vrataṃ caiva paramaiśvaryasādhanama || 18 || yattatpāśupataṃ divyaṃ vidhānaṃ sārvakāmikam | taccīrtvā dvādaśa samāḥ paramaiśvaryamāptavān | | 19 | | tasya devaḥ svayaṃ śūlī tuṣṭaḥ prekṣya tathāvidham | śarīrārdhaṃ dadau tasmai tadabhūdviṣṇuśaṅkaram | |8.121.20 || ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānmarttyaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu | arcayecchivaviṣṇuṃ ca sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim || 21 | | evaṃ sa viṣṇurjitvā tu vāmanaḥ sumahābalaḥ | trailokyaṃ sarvadevebhyaḥ sarvaṃ prati samarpayat ||22 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tato devaiḥ samākrānte trailokye munipuṅgava | yesurā hataśeṣāstu te samāśritya dānavau | | 23 || tārakaṃ ca mayaṃ caiva cakruryuddhaṃ sahāmaraiḥ | mayaśca tārakaścaiva putrapautrasamāvṛtau | | 24| | vipracittiśca danujo ye ca tasya sutāḥ smṛtāḥ | nivātakavacāḥ sarve paulomāḥ kālakāsutāḥ | saiṃhikeyāśca vikrāntā bāleyaśca tathā gaṇaḥ | |25 | | ete cānye ca bahavo dānavā baladarpitāḥ | sannaddhāḥ samabhikruddhā āhvayanta tadā surān | |26| | saṃprekṣya tānāhvayato devā api sudaṃśitāḥ | taissahaitya tadā cakruḥ samaraṃ samaraiṣiṇaḥ | |27|| teṣāṃ tadabhavad yuddha tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | varṣāṇāntu śatānyaṣṭau sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa | | 28| | divyāni na ca saṃgrāme ekapakṣe jayobhavat | atha devāstadā yuddhe saiṃhikeyairdurāsadaiḥ | |29|| parājitā mahāsatvāḥ siṃhaiḥ paśugaṇā iva | teṣāṃ tadbalamālakṣya sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ | |8.121.3 0 | | jagāma devadeveśaṃ śaraṇaṃ rudramavyayam | sa gatvā svarṇacūḍasya gireḥ śṛṅge kṛtālayam | |3 1 | | devyā saha mahādevamapaśyad gaṇasaṃvṛtam | dīpyamānaṃ yathā vahniṃ durdṛśyamakṛtātmabhiḥ | |3 2| | tamasau nandinā pūrvamākhyāto devasattamaḥ | dṛṣṭavā praṇamya śirasā idaṃ vacanamūcivān ||3 3 || deva varṣaśatānyaṣṭau sahastrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa | divyāni samatītāni saṃgrāmasya divaukasām ||34| | tārakaśca mayaścaiva dānavau yuddhadurmadau | tāvāśrityāsurāḥ sarve devān ghnanti yathā paśūn ||35|| teṣāṃ tu vadhyamānānāṃ devānāṃ devasattama | jīvitaṃ saṃprayacchasva yathā vā deva yujyate | | 36 || sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | cintayitvā tatastatra rāmarāmetyathābravīt | | 37| | bhagavānuvāca rāma rāma mahābāho cīrṇaṃ te sumahattapaḥ | gaccha devān suyuddhena kuru sarvān gatajvarān ||38| | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastadā rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca dīnayā vācā praṇamya bahumānataḥ | |3 9|| rāma uvāca bhagavannalpavīryosmi tapasā karṣito bhṛśam | anastravicca deveśa na śakṣye saṃyugaṃ vibho | |8.121.40 || devavava(?) uvāca gaccha śakṣyasi viprādya yoddhuṃ tvaṃ tvadya mā śucaḥ | ahaṃ tvāpyāyayiṣyāmi mā vyathāṃ kuru bhārgava | |41 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavānindraṃ prāha devapatiṃ haraḥ | eṣa haṃsyati te śatrūn rathamasmai prayaccha ca | |42| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ praṇamya śakropi rāmamādāya caiva ha | jagāma taṃ tadoddeśaṃ saṃgrāmo yatra sobhavat | |43 | | tataḥ sa rathamukhyena saṃpādya tu purandaraḥ | rāmamāha svayaṃ śakraḥ saiṃhikeyānupāhvaya | |44|| sa tena rathamukhyena rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ | kavacī baddhatūṇīraḥ śarī khaṅgī śarāsanī | |45| | baddhagodhāṃgulitraśca baddhadhvajapatākavān | abhidudrāva vegena saiṃhikeyān durāsadān ||46 | | teṣāṃ tasya ca saṃgrāmaḥ sughorassamapadyata | śārdūlānāṃ yathāraṇye siṃhena saha bhīṣaṇaḥ | |47| | tatrādbhutamapaśyanta siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ | yedekopi tadā raṅge dṛśyatenekarūpavān | |48| | nādadānaḥ śarām̐ścitrān sandadhānastathaiva ca | dhanurvikarṣamāṇo vā dṛśyate bhārgavastadā | |49 | | maṇḍalīkṛtamevāsya kārmukaṃ sumahattadā | dṛśyate śatrubhiścaiva durnirīkṣyaśca sobhavat ||8.121.5 0 || teṣāṃ sa bhārgavaḥ kruddhaḥ parāvṛtya mahābalaḥ | cikṣepaikaikaśo vyāsa mukhe tīkṣṇāñcharān daśa ||51 | | tatrādbhutamapaśyanta lāghavaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ | sādhu sādhviti bhūtānāṃ tatra śabdo mahānabhūt | |52 || sanatkumāra uvāca taiḥ śarairbhinnavadanāḥ saiṃhikeyā mahābalāḥ | sagandhā nipatantyurvyāṃ tālā vāyvāhatā iva | |5 3 | | sa tadā daśasāhasrasteṣāṃ vai devavidviṣām | bhārgaveṇa gaṇo dagdhaḥ kāleneva yathā jagat | |54| | tato devāḥ saṛṣayo gandharvāśca sacāraṇāḥ | sādhu sādhviti taṃ procya tuṣṭuvurhṛṣitānanāḥ ||55| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tatkarma saṃvīkṣya bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ | bahumānena saṃpūjya bhārgavaṃ saha daivataiḥ ||56|| idamāha mahātejāḥ pariṣvajya punaḥ punaḥ | tavaitatkarma nānyasya sadṛśaṃ divi vidyate | |57| | yadi te siṃhikāputrāḥ sahasaiva hatāstvayā | tava vai tan mahatkarma tripure tryambakasya vā | na tvayāsti samo loke satyametad bravīmyaham | |58 | | ete na tulyā devena mānuṣeṇa na kenacit | avadhyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvayaikena niṣūditāḥ | | 59| | tasmāttava vayaṃ tuṣṭāḥ prayacchāmo hyavadhyatām | akṣayaṃ ca balaṃ yuddhe yaśañca paramaṃ bhuvi | | 8.121.60 | | tryambakaśca varairdivyai riṣṭaistvāṃ pratipatsyate | yathākāmañca yuddheṣu samūhaṃ tvaṃ vijeṣyasi | |6 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamuktastairvyāsa devaistuṣṭairmahātapāḥ | jagāma tryambakaṃ devaṃ hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā yatiḥ | | 62 | | devā api susaṃyattāstārakaṃ yuddhadurmadam | avākiranta vegena mayena sahitaṃ tadā | | 63 | | te daityavegapratiruddhavegā mahābalāḥ sindhusamānavegāḥ | jaghnurbhṛśaṃ daityagaṇānnipatya siṃhā yathāraṇyacarā mataṅgān | | 64| | iti skandapurāṇe jāmadagnyavarapradāno nāma ekaviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.122> sanatkumāra uvāca saihikeyavadhaṃ dṛṣṭavā surāṇāṃ ca jayaṃ tathā | sahasā daityasainyāni prabhagnāni samantataḥ | | 1 | | .......................| ................| anyena pracyutastāro mayo vīro virocanaḥ | | 2 | | vipracittiśca ṣaṇḍaśca prahlādaśca mahāsuraḥ | kālanemistataḥ kruddhaḥ keśavaṃ prati saṃyuge || 3 | | sarathaṃ mahadāsthāya śatanalvordhvaketumat | abhidudrāva vegena keśavaṃ prati dānavaḥ | |4| | tasyāpatata evātha cakramapratighaṃ mahat | sasarja keśavo vyāsa sa tad vyaṣṭambhayattadā | |5 | | tad viṣṭabdhaṃ tadālakṣya sarve devāḥ pramanyavaḥ | parājitā babhūvurhi viśastrāḥ kālaneminā | |6| | ..............................| sa tānvidrāvya daityendro vimukhān pracakāra ha | kṛtvā cakāra ca tadā lokapālatvamavyayaḥ | |7| | bhuvaṃ dyāñca tadā vyāpya vartamāno mahābalaḥ | svayambhūriva lokām̐strīnacarallokamāyayā ||8| | sanatkumāra uvāca taṃ tathāvasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ devāḥ savāsavāḥ | bhayatrastāstadā jagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ harimavyayam | |9 | | śaraṇyaḥ sa ca deveśo haristrailokyabāndhavaḥ | teṣāṃ prādād bhayatrāṇaṃ dānavasya vadhepsayā | | 8.122.10 || sa tadā dyāṃ bhuvañcaiva vyāpya rūpeṇa sarvaśaḥ | cakraṃ tadabjaṃ sasmāra yattad rudreṇa nirmitam | | 11 || tatastena tadā vyāsa dānavasya śiro mahat | jahāra pakvaṃ tālāgrāt phalaṃ vāyurivoddhataḥ | | 1 2| | tasmin vinihate daitye tārakaśca mayaśca ha | vinivṛttau mahāyodhau pātālaṃ prativegitau | | 13 || sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ vyāsābhavadyuddhamugraṃ tattārakāmayam | kālanemirhato yatra viśrutaśca virocanaḥ | | 14| | saiṃhikeyāśca vikrāntāstuhuṇḍaśca mahāsuraḥ | surocanaḥ śatāvarto hālo gārgyaśirāstathā || 15|| vipākaḥ saha pākena caṇḍaḥ kārtasvanaḥ kubhaḥ | ete cānye ca daityendrā nihatāstārakāmaye | dhvaje punarhataḥ krūro vipracittiḥ sahānujaḥ || 16|| vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ tadabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha | kathañca dhvaja ityevaṃ tasya nāma babhūva ha | |17|| jāmadagnyaśca tatkarma kṛtvā bhṛgukulodvahaḥ | duṣkaraṃ sarvabhūtānāmāgatastryambakāntikam | kimukto devadevena etadicchāmi veditum | |18 || sanatkumāra uvāca jamadagnestadā sūnuramaraiḥ preṣitaḥ svayam | jagāma guhyaṃ devasya puriścandraṃ niveśanam ||19|| vyāsa uvāca kathaṃ tadabhavaddivyaṃ puriścandraṃ niveśanam | sthānaṃ guhyaṃ maheśasya kathayasva dṛḍhavrata ||8.122.20 | | sanatkumāra uvāca atra te saṃpravakṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ mahāmate | yacchrutvā pāpakarmāpi gaccheta paramāṃ gatim | |21 | | purābhūtāṃ mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī | tābhyāṃ kāryeṇa devānāṃ brahmavadhyā kṛtā kila ||22|| tayābhibhūtau tau devau pāpmayātimahābalau | abhūtānnaṣṭasaṃjñau tau tiryagyonigatau bhṛśam | |23 | | atha saṃvatsare divye samatītemitātmavān | āgād brahmā svayaṃ tatra daivatairṛṣibhiḥ saha | |24|| sa taṃ saṃbodhayāmāsa sanaraṃ devapastadā | tathāpi hi na tau buddhau karmaṇā saṃvṛtau bhṛśam | |25| | tān brahmā sa tadā prāha sarvāneva divaukasaḥ | yūyaṃ nārāyaṇasyārthe caradhvaṃ dharmamuttamam ||26|| tato vimokṣyate devaḥ sanaro brahmavadhyayā | tamevaṃvādinaṃ devāḥ praṇamya śirasā tadā | ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve kintapaḥ karma śādhi naḥ | |27| | brahmovāca japadhvaṃ prayatāḥ sarve vāyubhakṣā jitendriyāḥ | rudrāṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ samyak tato yogamavāpsyatha | |28 || sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamastviti procya jajapuḥ salileśayāḥ | ṛṣibhissaha deveśā varṣāyutaśatāni ṣaṭ ||29| | atha kālena mahatā teṣāṃ yuktātmanāṃ tadā | yogaḥ prādurabhūt sūkṣmo yatognirabhavacchubhaḥ | |8.122.3 0 | | tenāgninā brahmavadhyā naranārāyaṇau tadā | sā dagdhā saṃparityajya udakaṃ praviveśa ha | |3 1 || nāstayāpaḥ samāviṣṭā rasavatyo na jajñire | agandhāśca vivarṇāśca prabhāvatyo na caiva ha | pṛthivī cālpavīryābhūttejastigmaṃ ca nābhavat | |3 2 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataste tantathā dṛṣṭvā yuyujurbhūya eva ca | hṛdayaṃ jajapuścaiva rudrāṇāṃ yuktamānasāḥ | |3 3 | | athāgād bhagavāndevaḥ śūlapāṇirvṛṣadhvajaḥ | uvāca devān tuṣṭosmi brūta yadvobhikāṃkṣitam | |34| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatastā devatāḥ samyag rudraṃ dṛṣṭvābhiremire | tuṣṭuvuścānatā bhūtvā yajñajīmūtavāhanam ||3 5| | devā ūcuḥ namaḥ paramadevāya yugāntānalavarccase | saline tapyamānāya rudrāṇāṃ hṛdayāya ca | | 36 | | mahāparaśuhastāya hiraṇyāyatanāya ca | vasūnāṃ pataye caiva devānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||37| | śucaye rerihāṇāya sadyojātāya manyave | grahāṇāṃ pataye caiva grahāṇāṃ hṛdayāya ca ||38 || mahāgrahānuyātāya graharājāya vai namaḥ | namaḥ śamadamogrāya ugradaṇḍadharāya ca | |3 9| | yamāya yamanāthāya yamadaṇḍadharāya ca | namaḥ paramadevāya parāṇāṃ paramāya ca | |8.122.40 | | mahatāṃ pataye caiva kamaṇḍaludharāya ca | vāmadevāya jyeṣṭhāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | |41 | | pradhānapataye caiva pradhānasya pravartine | namaḥ sahasravaktrāya gadine śūline namaḥ | |42 | | namaḥ pavanarūpāya bahurūpāya vedhase | namaḥ kratuvihantre ca kāmānalavighātine | |43 | | namaśchandoṅgarūpāya virūpanayanāya ca | indriyagrāmaghātāya namo vedāntagāya ca | |44|| namostvaśanighātāya manasāmunmanāya ca | vedavedāṅgamālāya namaste padmamāline | |45 | | namaḥ śailapradāhāya śailajātodbhavāya ca | mahate viśvarūpāya mahadbhirmahitāya ca | |46 | | sahasraśatanetrāya lalāṭanayanāya ca | mahāyogapraṇetre ca tathā tatpuruṣāya ca ||47| | namo vedarahasyāya devavedastutāya ca | yogine dhyāyamānāya aśanīpātahāsine | |48|| hṛcchayāya namastestu namaḥ sarvagatāya ca | kumāravaranāthāya kumārajanakāya ca ||49| | daṇḍahastāya carate antakāyājitāya ca | śubhāya śubharūpāya śubhasarvapravartine | |8.122.50 | | śivāya śivanāthāya sadā sarvaśivāya ca | dhanurvedarahasyāya dhanurvedapravartine |51 | | sarvapāpāpahantre ca sarvapāpmavighātine | śivaḥ saumyaśca deveśa diśa no yanmanogatam | |52| | yadapavyāhṛtaṃ kiñcidasmābhirbhagavan vibho | tatsarvaṃ bhaktavātsalyādasmākaṃ kṣantumarhasi | |53 | | pāpmayābhiparītātmā devabandhurayaṃ vibho | nareṇa saha deveśa sa bhaveccandranirmalaḥ ||54| | sanatkumāra uvāca ya imaṃ tryambakastotraṃ bhaktimān satataṃ naraḥ | paṭhati prayato vyāsa pāpmayā sa vimucyate | |55|| sarvapāpaiśca mucyeta naṣṭañca labhate punaḥ | na ca durgatimāpnoti yadi syādvai supāpakṛt | |56| | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavān devaiḥ stutastuṣṭaśca lokapaḥ | uvāca devāndeveśaḥ sarvān satyavatīsuta | |57|| devadeva uvāca bho devāḥ parituṣṭosmi varaṃ vṛṇuta kāṃkṣitam dāsyehaṃ tanmahāprajñā mā tūṣṇīṃ brūta sarvaśaḥ | |58| | devā ūcuḥ harireṣa mahādeva pāpmayā hatamānasaḥ | tāmasya nirṇuda kṣipraṃ nīhāramiva bhāskaraḥ ||59 | | eṣa lokahitārthāya devānāñca mahābalaḥ | kurute karma deveśa pāpmānaṃ hyasya nāśaya || 8.122.60 || vayaṃ ca samatāṃ tubhyaṃ gaṇatāṃ gaṇamadhyagāḥ | labhema sarvadaiveśa yadi tvaṃ manyase vibho | |61 | | sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāmevaṃ tu vadatāṃ devānāmṛṣisattama | uvāca bhagavāñcharvaḥ prahasan prītamānasaḥ || 62| | viṣṇureṣa surāḥ sadyo mokṣyate pāpmayānayā | pāpmā ceyaṃ mahābhāgā ūṣare saṃbhaviṣyati || 63 | | niryāsaścaiva vṛkṣāṇāmapāṃ phenastathaiva ca | mahoragāṇāṃ gandhaśca strīṇāṃ nindā tathaiva ca | | 64|| dīkṣitasya ca viprasya aśubhasyāvakīrtanam | brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādo gavāmaparikīrtanam | |6 5 || agnerajvalanañcaiva nadīnāṃ bandha eva ca | ya etāni naraḥ kuryādrāgamohasamanvitaḥ sa etāṃ prāpnuyālloke svayaṃbhūrapi lokapaḥ | |66 || yadā tu vasudevasya suto viṣṇurbhaviṣyati | tadā sa rūpiṇīmenāṃ nara eṣopabhokṣyate | |67| | tatropabhujya varado harerjātāṃ svasāntadā | vimuktaḥ pāpmayā bhūya imaṃ lokaṃ cariṣyati | |68|| yathā tvasya svasāpīyaṃ naiva bādhāṃ kariṣyati | tathā caratvayaṃ ghoraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram ||69| | yūyaṃ ca ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhamihaiva susamāhitāḥ | puraścaraṇamavyagrāḥ kurudhvaṃ madanujñayā | |8.122.70 || sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā devena devāssarve tadā harim | ūcuḥ kuru tapo ghoraṃ tataḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi | |71 | | tataḥ sa candraṃ śailendramāruhya susamāhitaḥ | tapaścacāra sumahadindriyagrāmatāpanam | |72| | devā api mahātmāna ṛṣibhissaha suvrataiḥ | hiraṇyavarṇaṃ śailendre tapastepussamāhitāḥ ||73 || atha teṣāṃ samāpte tu vrate tasmin pinākadhṛk | ādideśa vrataṃ dīptaṃ yattat pāśupataṃ mahat | |74|| uvāca sa tu tuṣṭātmā ābhāṣya su(?)rapuṃgavān | meghadundubhinirghoṣaṃ dhīrambhīraśabdavat | |75| | devadeva uvāca puraścaraṇametaddhi sucīrṇaṃ lokapāḥ svayam | idaṃ pāśupataṃ cīrtvā nirvṛtā yāta nirbhayāḥ ||76|| etat paraṃ pavitrañca sāṃkhyayogādhikaṃ vratam | nāsmātparataraṃ kiñcit sūkṣmaṃ vā vidyate kvacit ||77|| bhasmanā digdhasarvāṅgo digvāsāḥ śucireva ca | śarīrasthairyajan rudraṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | |78| | ārdra snānāt paraṃ bhasma ārdre jantuvadho dhruvam | ārdrantu prakṛtiṃ vidyāt prakṛtiṃ cāpi bandhanam | |79 | | prakṛtestu prahāṇārthaṃ bhasmanā snānamiṣyate | digvāsastvaṃ ca śaucañca yena jāyenna karhicit | |8.122.80 || yantrāṇāṃ paramaṃ yantramanyadyasmānna vidyate | ṣaḍaṅga sarvakāmīyaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam || 81 | | śuci sarvapavitraṃ ca sarvapāpāpahaṃ śubham | tapaso vardhanaṃ caiva te carantu samāhitāḥ | yantraṃ tvapāpaṃ vijñeyaṃ prakṛtissā ca saṃsmṛtā | |82 | | bandhaśca trividhaḥ proktaḥ sanyāsaphalameva ca | tasmāt sarvaprahāṇārthaṃ yantrametat samācaret ||03 | asammataḥ sadā loke yena jīryenna karhicit | yogañca paramaṃ prāpya yogānāṃ yatparaṃ mahat | |84|| yasmāt parataraṃ nāsti ṣaḍaṅgaṃ sarvakāmikam | yena muktaḥ pated bhūyo na yogī maraṇādiṣu ||85|| taṃ yogaṃ samanuprāpya siddho divyena karmaṇā | na lipyate mahāyogī karmabhistu kṛtākṛtaiḥ ||86| | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ te devadevena samājñaptā divaukasaḥ | samāpya tadvrataṃ ghoraṃ śaṃkarasya gaṇā babhuḥ | |87|| te gaṇatvamanuprāpya tasya devasya śūlinaḥ | anvagṛhaṇanta taṃ deśaṃ tapasā bhāvitā bhṛśam | |88 | | devā ūcuḥ yasmādiha sucīrṇaṃ naḥ puraścaraṇamantaśaḥ | tasmādidaṃ maheśasya guhyamāyatanaṃ smṛtam | |89|| puriścandramiti khyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu dīptimat | pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ tāvadevāyataṃ śubham ||8.122.90 || siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇamapsarogaṇanāditam | bahupakṣininādañca nadīprasravaṇākulam | bhaviṣyati mahāpuṇyaṃ tapodhanatapovanam | |91 || yotrāgatya caruṃ kṛtvā bhojayitvā ca brāhmaṇam | arcayeddevadeveśaṃ rudraloke sa modate ||92|| yaścātra niyamaṃ kṛtvā bhasmasnāyī yatavrataḥ | muhūrtamapi tiṣṭheta sa gacched gaṇamadhyatām ||93| | akṣayaścāmaraścaiva jarārogavivarjitaḥ | rudrasya gaṇapo bhūtvā yogaiśvaryamavāpsyati ||94|| kāmacārī supāpātmā yopyatra divasaṃ vaset | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||95|| sakāmopi durācāro yotra prāṇān parityajet | sopi devasadaḥ prāpya devaiḥ saha cariṣyati ||96|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste daivatāḥ sarve prāpya tatparamaṃ tapaḥ | ijyāsnānaṃ tadā cakrurīśasya paramātmanaḥ ||97|| atha te kṛtakṛtyāśca mahāyogabalānvitāḥ | hariṃ prati manaścakrurgantuṃ sarve divaukasaḥ ||98|| taṃ jvalantamivādityamāgacchanto mahābalāḥ | hariścandragirau vyāsa hariṃ dadṛśuravyayam ||99|| sopi kālena mahatā dhūtapāpmā mahātapāḥ | tadaiva labdhvā devānāṃ samatāṃ muditātmavān ||8.122.1 00 || ..prati tadā vegādutthāya ṛṣisattama | śikharāt sannipatyāśu teṣāṃ madhyevatiṣṭhata || 101 || tataste muditāḥ samyagghariṇā saha saṃgatāḥ | śikharaṃ tad girestasya phalena samayojayan | |1 02 || yasmāddharirayaṃ hyatra candravannirmalo babhau | tapasā mahatā caiva tasmādeṣocaleśvaraḥ ||1 03 || hariścandra iti khyāto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | yasmādaprakṛtenaiva prapātotra kṛtaḥ punaḥ | tasmād bhṛgurayaṃ loke puṇyo bhavatu sarvaśaḥ | |1 04|| atra yobhyetya deveśā bhṛguprapatanaṃ naraḥ | sādhayeta sa gaccheta harerlokamatiprabham | |1 05| | mahāpātakasaṃyukto vyādhinā samupadrutaḥ | yotra sādhayate prāṇān sopi
