mucyenmahābhayāt || 1 06|| yadvā prārthayate nityaṃ prapāte cātra kiṃcana | tatprāpnuyānnaraḥ sarvamacirāttacca vai smṛtam ||1 07|| sanatkumāra uvāca hariścandramimaṃ yastu puriścandrantu dharmavit | paṭheta śṛṇuyādvāpi sa pāpmānaṃ viśasyati | |1 08|| idaṃ tu yaḥ śuciranasūyavān sadā naraḥ paṭhed dvijagaṇadevasaṃsadi | sa nirmalo raviriva tejasā jvalan triviṣṭape vasati yathāmarovaraḥ ||1 0 9|| iti skandapurāṇe hariścandragirivarṇano nāma dvāviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.123> sanatkumāra uvāca taṃ puriścandramāsādya sa rāmaḥ śaktinanda | apaśyat parameśānamasuraiḥ kliṣṭamānasaḥ | | 1 | | sa dṛṣṭavā tu mahādevaṃ sāmbaṃ sagaṇamavyayam | praṇataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tasthau prahvastadāgrataḥ | |2|| sanatkumāra uvāca sopi devastadā prīto jāmadagnyaṃ mahāmanāḥ | uvāca vacasāṃ yoniridaṃ gambhīraśabdavat | | 3 | | kiṃśukairiva saṃchannaṃ candanenokṣitaṃ yathā | tathā taṃ kṣatajenaiva sarvataśca samukṣitam | sravantaṃ gairikaṃ dhātumacalendramivāparam | |4|| devadeva uvāca jāmadagnya mahat karma kṛtaṃ surahitepsayā | tvayā putrādya saṃgrāme saiṃhikeyān vinighnatā ||5|| tavānena mahābāho karmaṇā paritoṣitaḥ | prayacchāmi varān sapta tānvadasva yathecchasi | |6| | rāma uvāca bhagavan yadi tuṣṭosi mama dehi svayaṃ prabho | sarvajñānasamutpattiṃ sarvavedapravarttitām | |7| | avadhyaḥ syāmahaṃ yuddhe dhanurvedañca yaccha me | paraśuṃ sarvahantāramasaṅgaṃ rathameva ca | |8| | astragrāmañca vipulamamaratvaṃ tathākṣayam | varānmahyamimāndeva prayacchasva namastava ||9| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasyaivaṃ vadatau vyāsa prahasya bhagavān haraḥ | uvāca sarvametatte bhaviṣyati mamājñayā | | 8.123.10 | | dhanurvedavratañcaiva varṣamekaṃ cariṣyasi | tasmādihaiva vastavyaṃ tvayā bhṛgukulodvaha | | 11 | | tatastasmai sa bhagavān svayameva trilocanaḥ | ādideśa vrataṃ ghoraṃ cacāra sa ca saṃyataḥ | | 1 2|| samāpte tu vrate devaḥ svayamāgamya yajñahā | dhanurvedaṃ dadau tasmai samantraṃ sahasaṅagraham | |1 3 || saśulvaṃ saparistomaṃ sodyamaṃ sānukarṣaṇam | astragrāmaṃ ca vipulaṃ pratyastrasahitaṃ tathā | | 14|| prādāttasmai tadeśāna idaṃ covāca susvaram | ayaṃ tvayā dhanurvedaḥ sahāstraiḥ sumahābala | | 15 || kṣatriyebhyo na dātavya iti macchāsanaṃ smara | yadi ceddāsyase mohāt kṣatriyebhyaḥ kadācana | laghutvaṃ yāsyase teṣāṃ yuddhe cāpi jayo na te || 1 6| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa paraśuṃ datvā rathaṃ kāmagameva ca | manasā cintite yuktamupatiṣṭhantamakṣayam | | 17| | yantṛṇā yakṣarājena amareṇābhisaṃbhṛtam | jagāmādarśanaṃ tasya sahasaiva pinākadhṛk ||18|| sopi labdhvā varān vyāsa jagāma piturantikam | na cāpaśyata taṃ tatra kārtavīryasutairhatam | | 1 9| | akṛtvā tasya kartavyaṃ sopi rāmaḥ pratāpavān | niḥkṣatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ cakre saptakṛtvañca satrikam | |8.123.2 0 || rudhireṇa sa teṣāñca hradān sapta cakāra ha | samantapañcake vyāsa pitṝm̐stenābhyatarpayat | | 21 | | tataśca kṛtvā niḥkṣatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ bhṛgusattamaḥ| mahādevaprasādāttu trailokyasyeśvaro babhau ||22| | taṃ śrīstuṣṭirdhṛtiścaiva siddhiḥ kīrtiryaśastathā | śraddhā medhā tathā kṣāntiranasūyā prasaṃyamaḥ | | 23 | | ūhā hyapohā tarkaśca damaśca śama eva ca | rūpiṇyo bhārgavaṃ sarvā mātarassamupasthitāḥ | |24|| tānsarvān sa tadā prāha viśadhvaṃ māmaśaṅkitāḥ | śrīriyaṃ tu durācārā dūra evāvatiṣṭhatām || 25|| sanatkumāra uvāca taṃ tathāvādinaṃ sādhvī uvāca śrīrmahābalam | kimartha māṃ mahābāho nābhinandasi durlabhām ||26| | rāma uvāca capalā madanīyā ca adhruvā cāsi śobhane | atastvāṃ nābhinandāmi mama tvaṃ dūrato bhava ||27|| tvayāviṣṭo naraḥ sarvo yadi syāt svayamīśvaraḥ | aiśvaryamadasaṃmūḍha akāryeṣveva vartate | |28|| sanatkumāra uvāca sa rājā bhārgavaḥ śrīmān yajñairīje mahāmanāḥ | adhogamacca pṛthivī tasya yajñe purā dvija | | 29| | vyāsa uvāca kimarthaṃ pṛthivī tasya yajñe pātālamāviśat | kāraṇaṃ tatra kiṃ manye etadicchāmi veditum | | 8.123.30 || sanatkumāra uvāca sa gatvā pṛthivīpālaḥ kaśyapaṃ munisattamam | uvāca mama hotā tvaṃ bhava satvavatāṃ vara ||3 1 || taṃ tathāvādinaṃ vyāsa tadovāca narādhipam | kaśyapaḥ kupitastatra nindamāno bhṛgūttamam ||3 2|| patitastvaṃ durācāro bhinnaśīlaḥ supāpakṛt | kathaṃ tvā yājayiṣyāmi bhrūṇavadhyābhikāriṇam | |3 3|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa tena vākyena uvāca ṛṣisattamam | viṣaye mama mā tiṣṭha tvamadya munisattama || 34|| svāmyahaṃ jagato vipra nāhaṃ yatra tato vraja | tatassa tasya taṃ deśaṃ parityajyā vrajattadā | |35| | nāsasāda ca taṃ deśaṃ yatrāsau na bhavet prabhuḥ | anāsādayamānaśca aṭavīmāśritastadā | antardhānagato bhūtvā cacāra bahulāḥ samāḥ | |3 6|| athāpaśyat samāsīnaṃ kapotaṃ vṛkṣasaṃsthitam | anaṅgenābhisaṃbaddhaṃ kapotyā hāryatāṃ gatam || 37|| kapota uvāca yadāprabhṛti suśroṇi mayā dṛṣṭāsi śobhane | tadāprabhṛti śuṣyāmi ratiṃ nāpnomi śobhane ||38| | kapotyuvāca maivaṃ brūyā durācāra adharmyaṃ hi kadācana | kapota uvāca na ceddāsyasi metra tvaṃ balāttvāhaṃ sumadhyame | svīkariṣyāmi yacchasva natosmi tava pādayoḥ || 39|| kapotyuvāca kinna testi bhayaṃ krūra jāmadagnyānmahābalāt | yena tvaṃ dharṣasedyeha patihīnāṃ pativratām | |8.123.40 || sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktaḥ sa tu tayā kapotaḥ śaktinandana | uvāca rāmaḥ koyaṃ vai mama tulyo na kenacit | |41 || tasyaivaṃ vadatastatra rāmanāmāṅkitastadā | bāṇaḥ śiro jahārāśu kaśyapastadapaśyata ||42|| sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvṛttaṃ bhītastasmānmahābalāt | yājayāmāsa rājānaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ mahāmanāḥ ||43 || kaśyapa uvāca yājayāmyahamadyaiva rājan bhārgavasattama | yadi cedīpsitāṃ me tvaṃ dadāsi śubhadakṣiṇām ||44|| rāma uvāca yad bravīṣi na sandeho dātāhaṃ tanmahātapaḥ | māṃ yājaya yathānyāyaṃ tavāsmyadya vaśe sthitaḥ ||45 || sanatkumāra uvāca tatastasyābhavad vyāsa sumahān bhūridakṣiṇaḥ | yajñośvamedho devānāṃ yatra tṛptirajāyata ||46|| tasyātha dakṣiṇākāle jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca kasyapaṃ brūhi dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃ dadāni te | |47|| sa prāha pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām | dakṣiṇāṃ datsva mahyaṃ tvaṃ yacca testi gṛhe vasu | |48 | | sa tasmai tattathā kṛtvā viśuddhenāntarātmanā | cīrāṇyādāya taṃ prāha kaśyapaṃ kiṃ karomyaham ||49| | kaśyapa uvāca imaṃ deśaṃ parityajya deśamanyaṃ prayāhi bho | mama deśe na vastavyaṃ tvayādya bhṛgunandana | |8.123.50 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamastviti procya kṛtvā cābhi pradakṣiṇām | jagāma saritāṃ yoniṃ samudraṃ varuṇālayam | |51 | | taṃ gatvā sāgaraṃ bhīmamuvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ | mama deśaṃ prayacchasva nivāsāya mahodadhe | | 52 | | samudra uvāca yojayasva yathānyāyaṃ bhavān mādya vaśe sthitaḥ | velāsamīpe tvaṃ sthitvā vikṛṣya balavaddhanuḥ | muñcasva sāyakaṃ rāma parīpsan deśamuttamam | | 53 | | yāvatsa sāyakaḥ kṣiptastava prāṇasamīritaḥ | yāsyate tāvadevāhaṃ pradāsyāmi tavālayam | | 54| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlaḥ kṛtvādaramatandritaḥ | yuyoja sāyakaṃ vyāsa vikṛṣya balavaddhanuḥ | |55| | kṛtvā manasi saṃkalpaṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ tadā | gamiṣyati mamāyaṃ vai athainamabhimantrayat | | 56 | | sāgareṇa tadā śambhuḥ stutastadupaśāntaye | surāṇāṃ hitakāmārthaṃ sāgarāśoṣaṇāya ca | |57| | taṃ kṣiptaṃ jāmadagnyena rurodhāpratimaṃ śaram | sa ruddho yojanānyetya nyapatad dvādaśaiva tu | |58|| tāvacca deśamudadhirvisasarja hasanniva | āvasacca mahātejā jāmadagnyopi taṃ tathā | | 59| | taṃ deśaṃ bhṛgutanayaḥ surendrakalpo hṛṣṭātmā mṛgagaṇapakṣisaṃghajuṣṭam | siṃhendradvipaśarabharkṣaghoranādaṃ śrīmantaṃ puramiva devatā cakāra || 8.123.60 || iti skandapurāṇe rāmamāhātmye trayoviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.124> sanatkumāra uvāca jāmadagnyena sā dattā tathā pṛthvī mahātmane | giriśṛṅgaṃ ivāpātādadhastāt sā tadāvrajat | | 1 | | tāmuvāca muniḥkruddhastiṣṭhatiṣṭha vasundhare | kimarthaṃ māṃ parityajya adhastād vrajase śubhe || 2| | pṛthivyuvāca jāmadagnyaṃ vinā rāmaṃ priyaṃ patimatidyutima | na śaknomi mune sthātuṃ tadguṇāhṛtacetanā | |3 | | yadi mā yacchasedya tvaṃ rāmāya munipuṅgava | yāsyāmyahamadho nātha na tiṣṭheyamatonyathā ||4|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā kaśyapastapyatāṃ varaḥ | uvāca vasudhāṃ kruddho dahanniva tadaujasā | |5| | kaśyapa uvāca gaccha tvaṃ sudurācāre adhaḥ punaravāggatim | vasudhāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi paśya me tapaso balam ||6|| tatassa bhagavān vyāsa yogaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ | pṛthivītvamanuprāpto dhārayāmāsa mānuṣān ||7|| bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi yadasau pṛthivī babhau | tadā pṛthvī viṣaṇṇā taṃ prasādayata kaśyapama ||8|| pṛthivyuvāca bhagavan tapasā tubhyaṃ yogena ca balena ca | na kaścidapi tulyosti divi vā bhuvi vā vibho ||9|| prasādaye tvāṃ śirasā dṛṣṭante balamuttamam | yanmayāpakṛtaṃ kiñcittat kṣamasva mahāmune ||8.124.1 0|| ahameva hi lokeṣu pṛthivī syāṃ tavājñayā | dīnāyā mama viprendra prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||1 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca tāṃ tathopasthitāṃ dṛṣṭavā bhagavānṛṣisatamaḥ | uvāca prahasan devīṃ pṛthivīṃ praṇatāṃ tadā ||1 2|| tavaiva hyapacāreṇa mayedaṃ kṛtamīdṛśam | tvamidānīṃ mayā dattaṃ pṛthivītvaṃ samācara ||1 3 || mama tvaṃ duhitṛtvaṃ ca gatvā kaśyapavaṃśajā | kāśyapī viditā loke bhaviṣyasi vasundhare ||14|| sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sā pṛthivī vyāsa adhogatvā punaḥ sthitā | pṛthivītvaṃ samāsādya babhūva vigatajvarā ||1 5|| ya imaṃ pṛthivībhāvaṃ kaśyapasya mahāmuneḥ | pṛthivyāgamanañcaiva punarbhāvaṃ tathaiva ca | | 16 || śṛṇuyātpaṭhate vāpi śucirbhūtvā sadaiva hi | sa labhetākṣayām̐llokān pṛthivīphalameva ca | |17|| tāṃ sarvalokaprabhavāmanekaśo mune praṇamyeha sadā narottamaḥ | prakīrttayedyo vasudhāṃ vasupradāṃ sa lokamāpnoti ṛṣerathākṣayam | | 18|| iti skandapurāṇe kaśyapasya pṛthivībhāvo nāma caturviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.125> sanatkumāra uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhvajasaṃgrāmamūrjitam | devānāmasurāṇāñca prāṇayogavināśanam | | 1 | | āsīd danusutaḥ śrīmān vipracittirmahābalaḥ | tapastepe sa yuktātmā bhastrāpada iti śrutiḥ | |2 || sa rādhya tatra deveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ trilocanam | varaṃ vavremaratvañca tasmai prādāt sa devapaḥ | | 3 || dhvajaṃ māyāmayaṃ divyaṃ sarvagaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham | uvāca cainaṃ tuṣṭātmā bhagavāndānaveśvaram ||4|| ayaṃ tava danoḥ putra viśvarūpo dhvajottamaḥ | enamāśritya yuddheṣu tvamajayyo bhaviṣyasi | |5| | amaraśca mahābāho śabdaṃ cenna kariṣyasi | atonyathā tu te bhāgyairbhavitā vijayo raṇe || 6||| sa evamukto devena dhvajena mahatā yudhi | danujaiḥ saha viprendra devānsarvānsamāhvayat | |7| | tadyuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | varṣāṇāntu śatānyaṣṭau daśa caiva sudāruṇam | |8 || tatrādbhutamapaśyante danuputrasya dhīmataḥ | dhvajena viśvarūpeṇa yadeko nyavadhīd bahūn | |9|| yudhyataścāsya saṃgrāme dhvajamāśritya māyayā | na devāḥ praharantyasya paśyamānāstu mohitāḥ || 8.125.10 || nāpaśyante danusutānnāpi daityām̐stathā raṇe | dhvajamevābhipaśyanti sarve mūḍhā divaukasaḥ | | 11 | | mumucuryānyamoghāni āyudhāni divaukasaḥ | tāni channānyabhūvan hi dhvajacchāyānilena vai | | 12| | agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva pārśvayorūrdhvameva ca | dhvajamevābhipaśyanti na daityānnāpi dānavān | |1 3 | | tatra te sāyakāstīkṣṇā jvalantaḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ | niḥsṛtya tu dhvajād vyāsa dārayanti surottamān || 14|| gadāśca parighāścaiva bhindipālāssatomarāḥ | niḥsṛtāni tathānyāni dṛśyantestrāṇi vai dhvajāt | | 15 | | te devāstena daityena dhvajamāśritya sarvaśaḥ | bhagnā vicetasaḥ saṃkhye kṛtā naṣṭaparākramāḥ || 1 6| | tān bhagnān bhajyamānām̐śca sarvāndṛṣṭvā surottamān | jagarja jalado yadvad dhvajamāśritya dānavaḥ || 17| | tasya tacchidramālakṣya bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ | dhvajamālakṣya cikṣepa vajraṃ paramamanyumān | | 1 8| | jvaladādityasaṃkāśaṃ tad vajraṃ bhīmaśabdavat | sadhvaja dānaveśānamakarodyamagocaram | | 1 9| | dhvaje lakṣyaṃ samāviśya devendreṇa mahātmanā | hatāste nānavāssarve sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ||8.125.2 0 | | te tena śabdena mahānubhāvā hatāssamālakṣya surendrakalpāḥ | dhvaje niveśyaindrasamānacihnā vajreṇa devendrabalena sarve | |2 0 || iti skandapurāṇe dhvajayuddhe pañcaviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.126> vyāsa uvāca bhastrāpadamiti proktaṃ tvayā brahmasutāvyaya | kathaṃ tadabhavat sthānametadicchāmi veditum || 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ikṣvākukulasaṃbhūto bāhurnāma prajeśvaraḥ | haihayaistālajaṃghaiśca tasya rājyamaśeṣataḥ | hṛtaṃ viprendra vikramya sabhāryaḥ sa vanaṃ yayau | | 2 || sa ṛcīkāśramaṃ gatvā ṛcīkenānupālitaḥ | uvāsa vanamadhye tu garbhiṇyā bhāryayā saha | |3 | | tasyāḥ prasavakāle tu bhāryāyāḥ śaktinandana | sapatnyā rāgamohena garosyai saṃpradāpitaḥ | |4| | sā tena vedanāṃ prāpya tapyamānā rujānvitā | śītaṃ toyamiti procya mūrcchitā nyapatad bhuvi | |5| | tāṃ tathā patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rājā manyutāpitaḥ | kumbhamādāya vṛddhopi toyārthaṃ saritaṃ yayau | |6|| sa pūrayitvā kumbhaṃ taṃ skandhenādāya duḥkhitaḥ | vṛddhabhāvācchramāccaiva pāpāta ca mamāra ca | |7|| mṛto mṛta itītyevamṛṣibhiḥ samudāhṛte | sā devī mūrcchitottasthau patiśokasamāhatā | |8 || sā garasya ca tāpena patimṛtyukṛtena ca | samāhatā tadā vyāsa kurarīva vyanādayat | |9 | | bāhostu ṛṣayassarve vasiṣṭhādyāḥ samāgatāḥ | kṛtvā tu cayanaṃ samyak saṃskāramabhirocayan | |8.126.1 0 | | tamagniṃ praviśantī sā śaivyā garbheṇa dūṣitā | vāritā ṛṣibhirvyāsa aurveṇa ca mahātmanā || 1 1| | tasyāstatra dine vyāsa sāyāhne manyunāśanaḥ | gareṇa saha garbhosau niḥsṛtonalasaprabhaḥ | | 1 2| | tasmai5 sagara ityeva nāma cakre ṛṣistadā | saṃskārañcākarottasya sarvameva kṛpānvitaḥ ||1 3 || dhanurvedaṃ dadau caiva vedān sāṅgām̐stathaiva ca | astragrāmañca vipulaṃ rathañcāsaṅgamavyayam | | 14|| sa tena rathamukhyena yudhi śatrūñjaghāna ha | aurvāstraṃ caiva sandhāya teṣāṃ dharmamanāśayat || 1 5| | sa hatvā tāṃstathā vyāsa prāpya rājyamathāpi ca | vainateyasvasāṃ prāpya śaivyāñcaiva sumadhyamām | |1 6| | anapatyo mahābāhustryambakaṃ devasattamam | ārādhayan mahātejāḥ putrahetornarādhipaḥ | | 17| | tasmai prādāt sa bhagavān putravaṃśakaraṃ prabhuḥ| ṣaṣṭi caiva sahasrāṇi sutānāṃ sumahātmanām | | 18| | sanatkumāra uvāca labdhvā sa tu varaṃ rājā bhāryādvayamuvāca ha | vainateyasvasāṃ caiva śaivyāñcaiva mahāmanāḥ | | 19 | | sagara uvāca mahyaṃ devena dattaśca putro vaṃśakaraḥ śubhaḥ | ṣaṣṭiṃ caiva sahasrāṇi putrāṇāṃ sumahātmanām ||8.126.20 || tatra kā vṛṇute devyau varaṃ devī śubhaṃ hitam | brūta nāhaṃ vibhāgaṃ vaḥ karomi viditātmanām ||21|| vainateyasvasovāca ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi mama santu narādhipa | śaivyābravīt suto mahyameko vaṃśakarostu vai ||22| | sanatkumāra uvāca asamañjasutaṃ śaivyā tataḥ sā saṃprasūyata | vainateyasvasāstumbaṃ mahāntaṃ saṃprasūyata ||23 || tasmāttumbāttatastāni sahasrāṇi daśaiva tu | guṇitāni vyāsa ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃbhavanta mahābalāḥ ||24|| asamañjaḥ parityaktaḥ sagareṇa sutastataḥ | adhārmika iti jñātvā anācāre vyavasthitaḥ ||25| | aṃśumām̐stasya putrastu bāla evāti dhārmikaḥ | tasmin prītiṃ tadā cakre sagaro rājasattamaḥ ||26|| asamañje parityakte hayamedhena dīkṣitaḥ | ṣaṣṭiṃ tāni sahasrāṇi hayasyārakṣaṇe dadhau ||27|| teṣāṃ hayaṃ cārayatāmudyuktānāṃ mahātmanām | antardhānagataḥ śakra ākṣipattaṃ hayottamam ||28|| te lokān sarvaśo gatvā apaśyanto hayottamam | pitaraṃ dīkṣitaṃ prāpya taṃ hayaṃ saṃnyavedayana ||29|| sa saṃkruddhastadā rājā nirdahanniva tānsutān | uvāca krodhatāmrākṣo naśyadhvaṃ kṣipramadya vai | |8.126.3 0 | | nāgantavyaṃ vinā vodya hayaṃ krūrā vimārgata | sutaiḥ kiṃ mama yuṣmābhiryāta sarve yamakṣayam || 31 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā viprendra trailokyamakhilaṃ tadā | vimṛgya khānayāmāsurimāṃ sarvāṃ vasundharām | |3 2| | diggajām̐ste tato dṛṣṭavā ṛṣīm̐śca niyatavratān | dhārayantovaniṃ sarvān dṛṣṭvā cābhipraṇamya ca | | 33 || kapilaṃ te muniṃ suptamavaikṣanta jalāśaye | adūresya hayaṃ caiva kruddhāste menire tadā | |34|| preritā bhāvitārthena kāle pakvā mumūrṣavaḥ | pitṛśāpādathocuste kapilaṃ munisattamam || 3 5|| eṣa no hayamukhyasya hartā supto durātmavān | enamadya vayaṃ sarve nayāma piturantikam | | 3 6| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste kālapāśena baddhāssarve mahābalāḥ | niyatervaśagāścaiva padbhistaṃ samatāḍayan | |37| | sa tairabhyarditaḥ kruddhaḥ śaradāmayutaṃ tadā | niruddhaṃ sahasā vāyumutsasarja yathāhirāṭ | | 38| | tasya vaktrādviniḥsṛtya sa vāyurjvalanātmakaḥ | dadāha sāgarān sarvān nyāyadharmabahiṣkṛtān | |3 9 | teṣu dagdheṣu sarveṣu ṛṣayo nāradādayaḥ | sagarāya yathāvṛttamācakhyu ratiduṣkaram | |8.126.40 | | tatassa rājā duḥkhārttaḥ saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā | aṃśumantaṃ priyaṃ pautramādideśa mahāmanāḥ | |41 | | sagara uvāca imaṃ rathaṃ samāruhya gaccha taṃ hayamuttamam | ihānaya mahābāho kālo no nātyagādyathā | |42 || samācarethāstadvākya yathāsāvṛṣisattamaḥ | krodhaṃ na kurutesmāsu tvayi naḥ santatirdhruvā | |43 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sa evamukto rathamāsthito nṛpo mahānubhāvaḥ surasiddhapūjitaḥ | jagāma vegena surendravikramaḥ sa yatra yogī sagarāntako babhau ||44| | iti skandapurāṇe sagarotpattirnāma ṣaḍviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.127> sanatkumāra uvāca sa gatvā taṃ tadoddeśaṃ mahāgajaniṣevitam | apaśyad bhasmabhūtāṃstānmuniñca jvalanaprabham | | 1 | | tatastaṃ sa tadā vāgbhiḥ stavayuktābhirantike | praṇamyākṣāmayat sarvaṃ pūrvairyad duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | | 2|| kapila uvāca rājannihāhamekānte yuktastiṣṭhāmi vijvaraḥ | tairarditosmi sahasā vāyuṃ vaktrādavāsṛjam | |3 | | daśavarṣaśatāni sma saṃruddhaḥ sonilo mayā | vimuktaḥ sahasā sarvām̐stān dadāha pitṝm̐stava ||4|| na buddhipūrvaṃ te dagdhā mayā rājan ruṣāpi vā | hatāste kālapakvena phalenaiva yathā khagāḥ ||5| | aśvoyaṃ mama pārśvasthaḥ kenāpi viditātmanā | hṛtasteṣāṃ vināśāya mā krudho nīyatāṃ hayaḥ | |6 || sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tvanumate vyāsa aṃśumān sa narādhipaḥ | pānīyamupacakrāma teṣāṃ dātuṃ mahāmanāḥ ||7| | vainateyastamāhedaṃ svasrīyāṇāṃ mamodakam | na dātavyaṃ mahābāho naitatteṣāṃ gamiṣyati | |8|| aṃśumānuvāca kathaṃ me pitaraste vai lokān divyānavāpnuyuḥ | etadicchāmi kathitaṃ tvayā kaśyapandana ||9|| vainateya uvāca devaloke sarit puṇyā gaṅgānāmāśubhāpahā | tadambhomi stavāsthīni bandhūnāmiha sarvaśaḥ | | 8.127.10 || saṃspṛṣṭāni yadā rājan tadaite mokṣamāpnuyuḥ | aśubhādrājaśārdūla anyathā kiṃ jalena te ||11 || sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sośvaṃ samādāya nivṛtto vyāsa bhūpatiḥ | pitāmahāya pradadau tamaśvaṃ sukṛtātmavān ||12| | sopi rājā tadā prāpya hayamedhaṃ mahāmanāḥ | samudranāśane buddhiṃ cakre sutavadhārditaḥ | | 13 | | atha taṃ saritāṃ bharttā praṇamyābhiprasādya ca | jagāma putratāṃ tasya idaṃ covāca taṃ tadā | |14|| rājaṃstvadvaṃśajenāhaṃ kartavyaḥ kila suprabhaḥ | yathāpūraṃ mahābāho pūrṇo gaṅgāmbhasā nṛpa ||15|| mā krudhastava putrohaṃ yaśaskṛdamitaprabha| ratnāni ca pradāsyāmi śamamehi mama prabho ||16|| śāntaḥ krodhastatastasya samudraṃ prati bhūpateḥ | viṣṇuścāsmai tadā tuṣṭaḥ pradadāvīpsitān varān ||17|| hayamedhaśataṃ sāgraṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam | vaṃśasya cākṣayaṃ nityaṃ yaśaścāgryaṃ tathākṣayam ||18|| vayasyatvaṃ tathā caiva parāṃ dharme ca saṃsthitim | etānvarān sa labdhvā tu bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ||19|| jagāma vanamevātha tapastaptvā tato divam | tatoṃśumān babhau rājā dhārmikaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ ||8.127.20 || putraṃ rājyebhiṣicyaiva gaṅgāvataraṇāśayā | tapastaptvā divaṃ yāto mahābalaparākramaḥ ||21 || tato dilīpaḥ putrosya mahātmā devarāḍiva | kṛtvā rājyaṃ yayau vyāsa vanameva mahābalaḥ ||22|| tatra gaṅgārthamudyuktastapastaptvā divaṃ gataḥ | anavāpyaiva taṃ kāmamasya putrobhavat punaḥ ||23|| rājā bhagīratho nāma jambūdvīpapatiḥ śubhaḥ | dhārmikaḥ satyavāk śūro dharmo vigrahavāniva | |24|| tasya janmaprabhṛtyeva hṛdaye munisattama | sthitaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ kathaṃ kuryāmiti prabho ||25 || atha kālena mahatā kṛtvā sarvakriyāṃ nṛpaḥ | tapastatāpa sumahadyenātuṣyajjagatprabhuḥ | |26| | brahmā svayamathābhyetya tamuvāca yatavratam | brūhi kinte prayacchāni varān vṛṇu naradhipa | |27| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatassa rājā taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya hṛṣitānanaḥ | uvāca dharmasyākṣayyaṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam ||28 || vaṃśasya cākṣayaṃ samyak putrāṇāṃ ca śataṃ varam | śūrāṇāṃ dhārmikāṇāñca samareṣvanivartitām ||29|| jayañca yuddhe satataṃ loke kīrttiṃ tathākṣayām | gaṅgāyāssaritaścāpi avatāramanuttamam | |8.127.3 0 | | bhāgīrathīti ca yathā loke khyātatamā bhavet | etadicchāmi deveśa yadi tvaṃ manyase vibho ||3 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktasya bhagavān sarvametadaśeṣataḥ | prādāttasmai svayaṃ sraṣṭā idaṃ covāca taṃ nṛpam || 3 2|| gaṅgā tvaṃ rājaśārdūla svargānneṣyasi bhūtalam | tāṃ patantīṃ divaḥ kaścicchakto dhārayituṃ nahi | ṛte lokagurordevāt tryambakācchūlapāṇinaḥ | |3 3 || tasmāttvaṃ devadeveśamārādhaya yatavrataḥ | sa dhārayiṣyate vyaktaṃ varadānena te vibhuḥ ||34|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktastu rājendro vāyubhakṣonimeṣaṇaḥ | nirūcchavāsobhavat tatra himavacchikhare śubhe | | 3 5| | tasya varṣasahasreṇa tatparasya tadāśiṣaḥ | tutoṣa bhagavāndevaḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ | | 3 6| | varadosmīti cāpyuktvā ityuvāca punaḥ prabhuḥ | divyaṃ cakṣuḥ prayacchāmi paśya māṃ rājasattama | | 37| | sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā maheṣvāsaṃ tridṛṣṭiṃ devamīśvaram | uvāca saritaṃ deva dhārayasva varaṃ vṛṇe | |3 8| | gaṅgāṃ tripathagāṃ divyāṃ yadi me tuṣyasevyaya | mama kāmo mahādeva mṛtān pūrvapitāmahān ||3 9|| svargaṃ nayeyaṃ nirayāttārayitvātha tān śubhān | teṣāmarthe mahādeva prayāsoyaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ | prasādāttava te svargaṃ gaccheyurgaṅgayāplutāḥ ||8.127.40 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ | uvāca rājaśārdūlaṃ sutuṣṭenāntanātmanā | |41 | | devadeva uvāca bhagīratha tathā tatte bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | matprasādācca gaṅgā te duhitā sā bhaviṣyati | |42| | dhārayiṣye tvadarthe ca tāṃ patantīṃ triviṣṭapāt | vismāpanāya lokānāṃ hitārthañca nṛpottama ||43 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gaṅgā sā saritāṃ varā | uvāca ko dhārayitā mama vegaṃ surottamaḥ | |44 | | ahaṃ taṃ sahasaivādya gṛhītvāśu suduḥsahā | gamiṣyāmi na sandeha pātālaṃ sudurāsadam | |45|| svayaṃbhūryadyasau brahmā śakro vāpi sureśvaraḥ | viṣṇurvāpyaditeḥ putro nayāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ | |46 | | adya paśyantu me lokā mahadvegaṃ durāsadam | patantyā bhuvi durdharṣamevaṃ sā saridabravīt | |47| | sanatkumāra uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāvalepaṃ ca śaṃkaraḥ | cakāra nigrahītuṃ tāṃ saṃkalpaṃ saritāṃ varām ||48|| tasya saṃkalpamātreṇa devān vai jvara āviśat | mamlurmālyāni sarveṣāmutpātāścaiva jajñire ||49| | viparyayobhūllokānāṃ vimānāni ca petire | asurāśca balonmattā dṛśyantetimahābalāḥ | āhvayanto diteḥ putrān jvalanādityavarcasaḥ | |8.127.50 || sanatkumāra uvāca vaikṛtaṃ tadathālakṣya devā ūcuḥ śatakratum | viparyayoyaṃ nākasmācchīghraṃ vijñāyatāṃ prabho ||51 | | samohaścābhavattasya devasya ṛṣibhiḥ saha | tasmin kāle samāgamya brahmā tānavabodhayat | |52|| brahmovāca mā viṣaṇṇāvatiṣṭhadhvaṃ yūyaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ | yad brabīmi nibodhadhvaṃ kālo mā votigādayam | |53 || eṣa devo maheṣvāsaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ | gaṅgāṃ nāśayituṃ buddhimakarodbhīmavikramaḥ | |54| | tenaivaṃ manasā devāścintite lokanāśane | viparyayo yathā na syāt tathā kuruta mā ciram || 55| | mayā saha ito gatvā ṛṣibhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ | āpadbhāvena deveśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāta śaṅkaram ||56|| sanatkumāra uvāca te sahaiva tadā devā brahmaṇā padmayoninā | jagmurhimavataḥ kūṭaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ||57| | nāmnā hiraṇmayaṃ nāma yatra hairaṇvatī nadī | apaśyanta ca taṃ devāstapobhaktyā sureśvaram ||58|| sanatkumāra uvāca te taṃ kruddhamivālakṣya yugāntānalasaprabham | durnirīkṣyaṃ tadā vyāsa devīṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ ||59| | devā ūcuḥ sadevatānāṃ lokānāṃ jananyasi vibhāvari | atosi bhastrā rudrāṇi yaccha nobhayadaṃ padam ||8.127.60|| śaraṇāgatā vayaṃ mātaḥ putrāstava vayaṃ śubhe | rakṣa no devadeveśe etadicchāmahe vayam | |61 || sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhītānāṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇām | devānāmabhayaṃ devī dadau varamanuttamam || 62|| tatastaṃ devadeveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ pinākinam | praṇamya śirasovāca bhītavatsācalātmajā ||63|| sanatkumāra uvāca tāṃ bhītāṃ praṇatāṃ devaḥ pādayorgatamūrdhajām | utthāpayāmāsa tadā pāṇinābjadalatviṣā ||64|| uvāca ca tadā sādhvīṃ bhītāsi himavatsute | kimarthaṃ kiñca te subhru bhayaṃ brūhi śubhānane ||65 || sanatkumāra uvāca uvāca taṃ tadā vyāsa bhītavat himavatsutā | dṛḍhaṃ bhītāsmi te deva rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvātibhāsvaram ||66 || saṃvarttakānalaprakhyaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ surairapi | lokā viṣaṇṇā deveśa devāśca ṛṣibhissaha ||67|| upāsate bhītabhītāḥ sarva ete sureśvarāḥ | bhītāhaṃ te mahādeva mattodhikamime surāḥ | |68|| māṃ caiva śaraṇaṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tvamabhayaṃ diśa | tvaṃ kartā sarvalokānāṃ devānāmṛṣibhissaha | mā vināśaya tān kṛtvā yāce tvāṃ śirasā natā ||69|| sanatkumāra uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devāndṛṣṭvā ca yajñahā | uvāca na bhayaṃ vosti mattastridaśasattamāḥ ||8.127.70 || iyantu strīsvabhāvena himavattanaye sarit | mayi duṣṭaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā patiṣyati mamopari ||71 || tāmahaṃ sannirotsyāmi patantīṃ saritaṃ divaḥ | yūyamapyālayān svānsvān viśrabdhā vrajatānaghāḥ ||72| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste tadvacaḥ śrutvā praṇatā vibudhottamāḥ | ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā vācā te lajjamānayā ||73|| devā ūcuḥ eṣā lokahitārthāya tvayā sṛṣṭā saridvarā | capalāḥ saritaścaiva strīsvabhāvaśca tādṛśaḥ ||74|| saiṣā tena svabhāvena asmākaṃ cābhisaṃśrayāt | garvaṃ mahāntamāsthāya katthate hyakutobhayā ||75|| garvoyaṃ ca yatastasyā yena sā katthate nadī | tannaḥ śṛṇuṣva deveśa mā krudho bhīmavikrama ||76|| kāryārthaṃ prārthyamāno hi sarvo bhavati garvitaḥ | loke tanurapi svāmin kimuteyaṃ saridvarā | |77| | saiṣā sarinmahādeva dhāraṇāyepsitā tvayā | sarvaśreṣṭhena devena garvitā katthate tataḥ | |78| | tvayā daivatanāthena dhāriteyaṃ saridvarā | puṇyā bhavitrī lokesmin sarvakilviṣanāśanī||79| | yaḥ kaścit pātinīmenāṃ saritaṃ devatādhipa | śakto dhārayituṃ devo na tu śreyo bhavettataḥ ||8.127.8 0 | | tasmāttvaṃ yācito devai rājñā cānena kālahan | dhārayasva nadīmenāṃ śivo bhūtvā surottama ||8 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca evaṃ sa bhagavān devaistathyaṃ bahvavirodhi ca | uktaḥ sabrahmakairdevaḥ sanārāyaṇalokapaiḥ ||8 2|| rājño varapradānaṃ ca tadavekṣya punaḥ punaḥ | uvāca devāndeveśa idaṃ gambhīraśabdavat | |83 || etaṃ rājānamuddiśya kṣudhāparyākulendriyam | bhavatāṃ caiva mānyānāṃ vacanāddevasattamāḥ | |84|| na nāśayiṣye saritamidaṃ tu śṛṇutānaghāḥ | yad bravīmi mahāsatvā garvasyāsya vināśanam ||85|| parvatendrosya garvasya vighāto bhavitā mahān | anu jahnuśca dharmātmā garvaṃ nāśayitā punaḥ ||86 | | macchāpopahatā ceyaṃ durācārā mahānadī | patiṃ mānuṣamāsādya putrān sapta nihaṃsyati ||87|| sanatkumāra uvāca evamuktvā tataḥ śarvo devān daivatasattamaḥ | uvāca brūta kiṃ vonyad dadānyadya yathepsitam ||88|| devā ūcuḥ bhagavan sthānamicchāmo devasya sumaharddhimat | samantapañcakaṃ kṣetraṃ sadāvirahitaṃ tvayā ||89|| bhastretyuktā yadasmābhihimavattanayāvyayā | padaṃ cābhayamicchanti tasmād bhastrāpadaṃ smṛtam ||8.127.90|| yotrāgacchenniyamavānarcayed vṛṣabhadhvajam | sośvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya rudralokamavāpnuyāt ||91|| ahorātropavāsena caruṃ yaśca nivedayet | sa nandīśvaratulyaste bhavitā devasattama ||92|| prāṇān yaścātra deveśa tyajet saniyamo naraḥ | athavāniyamāddeva yadṛcchāmaraṇena tu ||93 || sopi bhūtvā gaṇaistulyaḥ sthāsyatyābhūta saṃplavam | yukto divyena vapuṣā tavānucaratāṃ gataḥ ||94|| namo bhastreśvarāyeti yaśca kṛtvā sadā śuciḥ | uttiṣṭhedvā svapedvāpi śakraloke sa modate ||95|| idaṃ mahad divyamanantalābhaṃ paṭhet sadā yo dvijadevasaṃsadi | mahānubhāvo gaṇapo mahājavo bhavet sa divyastava deva saṃśrayāt ||96|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṅgāvatāre saptaviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.128> sanatkumāra uvāca tasmin sabrahmakā devāḥ sthāṇoḥ sthāne manorame | liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya tīrthāni sarve cakruḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||1|| ..............................| ...dityatīrthañca vikhyātaṃ cāśvamedhikam | |2|| rudratīrthaṃ sthāṇutīrthaṃ brahmaṇastīrthameva ca | indratīrthaṃ vasūnāñca aśvinoraparaṃ smṛtam ||3|| yamasya cāparaṃ tīrthaṃ vāyostīrthamathāparam | viṣṇoścāpyaparaṃ tīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ surapūjitam ||4|| snāta eteṣu viprarṣe caruṃ kṛtvā nivedya ca | eṣu sthāneṣu divyeṣu carate hyakutobhayaḥ ||5|| adyāpi tatra brahmarṣe śrūyate madhuraḥ svanaḥ | mekhalāvalayonmiśro vaṃśavīṇāravotkaṭaḥ ||6| | gāyantīnāṃ varāṅgīnāṃ nṛtyantīnāṃ tathaiva ca | nityamapsarasāṃ vyāsa stuvantīnāṃ trilocanam ||7|| sanatkumāra uvāca tataste sahitā devā brahmaṇā devasattamam | ūcuḥ paśyema bhagavannasyā dhāraṇamuttamam ||8|| devadeva uvāca yatheṣṭaṃ śvaḥ prabhāte māṃ paśyadhvaṃ vibudheśvarāḥ | dhārayantaṃ tripathagāṃ nadīṃ svaguṇagarvitām ||9|| te tathoktāḥ praṇamyeśaṃ jagmurgaṅgāntikaṃ tadā | uvāca tāṃ tato brahmā devīṃ lokasukhāvahām || 8.128.10 || mā garva tvaṃ kṛthā gaṅge mā vināśamavāpnuhi | ṛjubhāvaṃ samāsthāya patethāstvaṃ saridvare | | 11 | | stuvatī tryambakaṃ somaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutā | tavākūtaṃ viditvāsau vināśāyodyataḥ prabhuḥ | | 12 | | kṛcchreṇa toṣitaḥ śambhustavaiva hitakāmyayā | māparādhaṃ kṛthā bhūyo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 13 | | nāśāttava saricchreṣṭhe dhruvaṃ lokakṣayo bhavet | evaṃ te tāṃ samādhāya devāḥ sabrahmakāstadā | | 14| | dvitīyehani lokeśāḥ samājagmurdidṛkṣavaḥ | himavacchikharaṃ divyaṃ nāmnā vajropalaṃ mahat | |1 5|| brahmā viṣṇurathānanto narā ṛṣaya eva ca | ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau samarudgaṇāḥ ||1 6|| sādhyā devāssapitaro yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | piśācāścāsurāścaiva śṛṅgiṇaḥ pṛśnayastathā || 18 || ṛṣiratrirvasiṣṭhaśca marīciḥ pulahastathā | pulastyaścāṅgirāścaiva bhṛguḥ kaśyapa eva ca | | 1 9| | auśijo vāmadevaśca gautamaśca mahatapāḥ | cyavanotha bharadvāja indrapramatireva ca | |8.128.2 0 | | raibhyaśca jamadagniśca kuṇibāhuśca vīryavān | atharvā śvetaketuśca dattātreyaśca viśrutaḥ | | 21 | | rucirdharmaśca dakṣaśca sāvarṇī munayaśca ye | agniśca vedabāhuśca śaṅkhapānnāmataśca yaḥ | |22|| ambarīvām̐śca vikhyātaḥ ketumānapi cāparaḥ | ete cānye ca bahava ṛṣayo devatāstathā | | 23 | | vimānāni ca sarvāṇi gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | jambhakā ṛtavaścaiva nikāyāścaiva sarvaśaḥ | |24| | tatrājagmurmudā yuktāḥ sarve paramavarcasaḥ | teṣāṃ gaganasaṃsthānāṃ devānāṃ prekṣatāṃ tadā | |25 | | merumandarasaṃkāśe tasmiñchikharasattame | umāsahāyo deveśaḥ sahasaivānvadṛśyata | |26| | taḍijjvalanapiṅgena jaṭābhāreṇa rājatā | ūrdhvasthitena mahatā bhagīrathamuvāca saḥ | |27|| devadeva uvāca bhagīratha kva sā gaṅgā pitṝṇāṃ tava tāraṇī | samāhvaya mahābāho dhārayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ | |28| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ sa rājaśārdūlaḥ smṛtvā tad brahmaṇo vacaḥ | sasmāra saritaṃ vyāsa śirasā prāñjalirnataḥ || 29| | sā tena manasāhūtā svarlokanilayā nadī | kṣaṇenābhyāyayau devī bhuvarlokaṃ śubhāvahā ||8.128.3 0 | | taṃ lokaṃ sā samāsādya manonilajavā nadī | alaṃcakre mahāvegā sarvaṃ śubhaśatāraṇiḥ | |3 1 || tataḥ sā tiryagāgamya ākāśasthā mahānadī | ākāśagaṅgā saṃjajñe nāmnā oghavatīti vai ||3 2 || ākāśagaṅgā sā bhūyo mahāvegā mahānadī | śivamastu mametyevaṃ pāpātārdhapathāttu sā | śivagaṅgā tataḥ proktā nāmnā śivatarā hi sā ||33 || kurvatī vipulaṃ śabdaṃ nadī vajrāśanisvanam | yato devaiḥ samaṃ dṛṣṭā devagaṅgā tataḥ smṛtā | |34|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve devalokāśca sarvaśaḥ | jepuste sahasā śāntiṃ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhā | |3 5|| teṣāṃ sā japatāṃ vyāsa nadī lokasukhāvahā | stuvaṃtī bhītabhīteva tridhā bhūtvāpatad bhuvi | |3 6|| tāṃ patantīṃ mahādevastribhirvegairmahājavām | jaṭābhāreṇa jagrāha devānāmeva sannidhau ||37|| taṃ jaṭābhāramāsādya sā trisrotā nirulvaṇā | na tasyāntaṃ samāsede niruddhā yogamāyayā | | 38| | yasmātsā bhītabhītā tu stuvaṃtī patitā tadā | tasmātsā bhītagaṅgeti stotragaṅgeti cocyate ||3 9 || tribhirvegaiśca patitā yasmātsā sariduttamā | trisroteti tataḥ sā vai procyate brahmavādibhiḥ ||8.128.40 || sanatkumāra uvāca sā tu tasminnipatitā dhṛtā devena māyayā | jaṭārandhraṃ vicinvānā uvāsa bahulāḥ samāḥ | |41 | | pūrṇaṃ sahasraṃ varṣāṇāṃ saṃsthitāṃ tāṃ jaṭāgṛhe | devāstāṃ dadṛśussarve koṭarāntargatāmiva | |42 | | tataste sahasā devāḥ praṇipatya vṛṣadhvajam | ūcurvimanaso vyāsa saritaṃ mā vināśaya | |43 || sanatkumāra uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭavā rājānameva ca | vidudhāva jaṭābhāraṃ devadevo dayāmaya ||44|| vidhunvato jaṭābhāraṃ peturvai tatra bindavaḥ | te muktāphalasaṃkāśāḥ pūrṇacandrāṃśunirmalāḥ ||45| | cakrurbindusaro divyaṃ sāgarākāravarcasam | tasmācchrotāṃsi saptaiva niḥsṛtāni mahānti ca ||46|| nalinī hlādinī caiva plāvanī caiva pūrvagā | sītā cakṣuśca sindhuśca tisrastā vai pratīcigāḥ ||47|| madhyamaṃ tvanvagātsroto rājā yena bhagīrathaḥ | bhāgīrathīti sā gaṅgā procyate brahmavādibhiḥ ||48|| dārayantī jagāmātha himavantaṃ saridvarā | niruddhā himavatpāde ratnaśṛṃge śiloccaye ||49|| tāṃ niruddhāṃ tato vīkṣya viṣaṇṇavadanastadā | rājā bhagīratho vyāsa brahmāṇaṃ manasāsmarat ||8.128.50 || tatassa bhagavān brahmā supratīkaṃ mahāgajam | uvāca dantavajrābhyāṃ dārayainaṃ śiloccayam | |51 || sa yatra girirāḍ bhinnaḥ supratīkena hastinā | gaṅgādvāraṃ tu tat proktaṃ supuṇyaṃ caiva tat smṛtam | |52|| gajaścābhimukho yāvannātiṣṭhata mahāyaśāḥ | srotasā tāvadadhvānamūḍho dvādaśayojanam ||53 || sanatkumāra uvāca etat puṇyatamaṃ vyāsa gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ smṛtam | sthānaṃ bhastrāpadaṃ nāma mayā yat parikīrtitam ||54| | ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānmartyaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu | sa devalokaṃ saṃprāpya devaiḥ saha cariṣyati | |55| | idaṃ mahatpāpavimocanaṃ śubhaṃ vimānayānāpsarasāṃ vilambhanam | śṛṇoti yo nityamadīnamānasaḥ sa yāti lokānviditāndivaukasām ||56 || iti skandapurāṇe gaṅgāvataraṇe aṣṭāviṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.129> sanatkumāra uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hālāhalamaśeṣataḥ | saṃgrāmaṃ ditiputrāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca bhayāvaham || 1 || hālāhala iti khyāto gaṇo vikrāntapauruṣaḥ | asurāṇāṃ babhau vyāsa dāruṇo brahmakaṇṭakaḥ | |2| | gateṣu danuputreṣu sa gaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | balaṃ kṛtvā mukhaṃ sarvān devānyuddhe samāhvayat | | 3 || teṣāṃ teṣāñca saṃgrāmaḥ sughoraḥ samavartata | asurāṇāṃ jayaścaiva sadaiva samapadyata ||40 | | tataste vibudhāḥ sarve vidarpā hatavikramāḥ | hṛtarājyābhyagacchanta brahmāṇaṃ lokakāraṇam ||5|| te tamūcūśca saṃhatya hṛtarājyāḥ sma sāṃpratama | kathaṃ rājyaṃ punardeva labhema tava tejasā | |6|| teṣāṃ śrutvā vacastadvai devaḥ salilasambhavaḥ | uvāca devān deveśaṃ prasādayata mā ciram ||7|| sa vo dātā mahāvīryo balaṃ devastrilocanaḥ | yena tān samare sarvān vikrameṇa vijeṣyatha | |8| | sanatkumāra uvāca ta evamuktā deveśaṃ tapasārādhya śaṅkaram | ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devā balaṃ no dehi yajñahan | |9| | teṣāṃ tu japatāmevaṃ tapasā toṣito haraḥ | dadau mantramanādhṛṣyaṃ sarvamantrottamaṃ tadā | | 8.129.10 || taṃ te saṃprāpya viprarṣe kṛtarakṣā divaukasaḥ | amūḍhā mūḍhavat sarve asureṣvacaran tataḥ | | 11 | | asurāstu tadā mūḍhān dṛṣṭvā sarvāndivaukasaḥ | amanyanta durācārā mūḍhā iti yathātatham | | 12 | | hṛtarajyā ime devāḥ sarve mūḍhena cetasā | unmattā vibhramantyevaṃ paśyataitān suretarāḥ | | 13 || ākrośantopare tām̐stu abhijaghnuśca dāruṇam | babandhuśca yathākāmaṃ mumucuśca tathāpare | | 14| | evaṃ teṣāṃ tadā vyāsa vartatāṃ śubhakarmaṇām | sumahānabhavad dharmaḥ asurāṇāṃ vyanīnaśat | | 1 5| | teṣāṃ tenāpacāreṇa asurāṇāṃ durātmanān | dharmanāśād balaṃ kṣīṇaṃ bubudhurdevatāgaṇāḥ ||1 6| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste brahmaṇābhyuktāḥ sarve divyāstradhāriṇaḥ | āhūyāsuraśārdūlān yuddhe sarvānnyasūdayan | | 17| | balo yatra hataḥ saṃkhye vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | devendreṇābhivikramya balahā sa yataḥ smṛtaḥ | |18| | sanatkumāra uvāca andhakārakamanyacca yuddhamāsīt subhairavam | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi śatāni ca punardaśa || 1 9| | āsīd danusutaḥ śrīmān devatāntaka ityuta | sa māyāṃ saṃparīpsan vai rudramārādhayat purā | |8.129.20| | tasmai varṣasahasreṇa varakāla upasthite | brahmā dadau varaṃ vyāsa danoḥ putrāya dhīmate ||2 1 || sa vavre tāmasīṃ māyāṃ sarvabhūtaprabādhanīm | abhedyāmanivāryāñca yāṃ tu vetti na kaścana ||22 || tasmai prādāt sa tāṃ māyāmidaṃ covāca taṃ tadā | bhaviṣyati hi māyeyaṃ yathoktā te mahābala | kariṣyasi na cecchabdaṃ yathākāmaṃ danoḥ suta ||23 || sanatkumāra uvāca atha labdhavaro vyāsa māyācchantosurastataḥ | bahubhirdānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvām̐llokānabādhata | |24| | devā api bhayāttasya nāvatiṣṭhan tadagrataḥ | devāḥ sarve bhayodvignāstasthurnaiva tadagrataḥ | sthānāni te parityajya yatra tatrāvatasthire ||25| | āhūtāḥ krūraśabdena dānavairbaladarpitaiḥ | tathāpi nāvatiṣṭhanta teṣāmagre divaukasaḥ | | 26| | ṛṣayastānidaṃ prāpya ūcuḥ sarve pramanyavaḥ | rakṣāṃ kuruta lokānāṃ māvalīnāvatiṣṭhata | |27| | vayaṃ ca tapasā devā dhārayiṣyāma saṃyatāḥ | mā bhayaṃ vostu yudhyadhvaṃ kurudhvaṃ vijvaraṃ jagat | | 28 | | ta evamuktāstairvyāsa ṛṣibhirlokakāraṇāt | bhayānnaivāvatiṣṭhanta tasya dasyostadāgrataḥ ||29| | yadā naivāvatiṣṭhante tathāpyuktā divaukasaḥ | upāyamaparaṃ prāhustadā te munisattamāḥ | |8.129.3 0 | | āhūyāpsarasaḥ sarvā visṛjyantāṃ surottamāḥ | kāmenāviṣṭamanasāmasurāṇāmupāntikam | |3 1 | | tām̐stāsvāsaktahṛdayān pītamaireyavihvalān | vikramya haṃsyatha surā balādyuddhe balīyasaḥ | |32| | tatastāḥ prahitā devairvañcanārthaṃ suradviṣām | kvaṇannūpuranirhrādakūjitotkarṇasārasāḥ | | 33 | | pīnottuṅgastanābhogahāravikṣiptayaṣṭayaḥ | vitrastabālahariṇīsadṛśāyatalocanāḥ | |34| | calatkuṇḍalasaṃghṛṣṭapāṇḍarāgaṇḍamaṇḍalāḥ | śikhikaṇṭhacchavihara ślakṣṇavāsodharāḥ parāḥ | |35|| pratyagravidrumacchedatāmroṣṭhādharapaṃktayaḥ | vastrāntakusumāpīḍasaṃsaktakarapallavāḥ | |36 || naikaratnaprabhākīrṇṇakeyūrābaddhabāhavaḥ | mayūrabarhasaṃkāśacārukuñcitamūrdhajāḥ | | 37|| kalpadrumasamudbhūtakusumasragvibhūṣaṇāḥ | śukāṅgaharitākārakañcukottaṃsitastanāḥ | |38| | mattamātaṅgavikrāntalīlāvibhramarecakāḥ | mattakokiladātyūha kalanisvanabhāṣitāḥ ||39| | mahatāmapyupāttānāṃ tapasāṃ vighnahetavaḥ | darśayāmāsurātmānaṃ vidviṣāṃ vadhahetavaḥ | |8.129.40 | | atha tepsaraso dṛṣṭavā daiteyāḥ kāmamohitāḥ | tāsāmarthe varāṅgīnāmabhijaghnuḥ parasparam ||41 | | gadā parighacakrāsiśūlamudgaraśaktibhiḥ | dhanuḥkuliśatīkṣṇāgra bhindipālaparaśvadhaiḥ | |42| | mameyañcārusarvāṅgī na taveyaṃ sumadhyamā | athavā yuddhaśulkāstu muñcaināṃ praharasva mām ||43 | | ityuktvā vividhā vāco daiteyāḥ kālacoditāḥ | anyonyavadhamāsādya prajagmuste yamakṣayam | |44| | hataśiṣṭāstu ye tatra dānavāḥ śāntapauruṣāḥ | vibudhairugratejobhistepi sarve raṇe hatāḥ | |45 | | ya idaṃ paṭhate viśuddhabuddhirnidhanaṃ saṃsadi dānaveśvarāṇām | manujo yuvatīrihaiva loke sa labhedapsarasāṃ samānarūpāḥ ||46 | | iti skandapurāṇe andhakārayuddhe ūnatriṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.130> vyāsa uvāca andhakaḥ sa kathaṃ daityo hareṇa vinipātitaḥ | yasya trailokyamakhilaṃ bhayāt sarvaṃ vaśe sthitam | | 1 | | sanatkumāra uvāca andhako nāma daityendra ādau trailokyakaṇṭakaḥ | brahmaṇastu varān prāpya sovadhyo devamānuṣaiḥ | |2| | na tasya yuddhe kruddhasya viṣṇuḥ śakro yamothavā | śakto hyabhimukhe sthātuṃ kimutānye divaukasaḥ | |3 | | sa kadācid balodvṛttaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām | apaśyanmandaraprasthe devīṃ himavataḥ sutām | |4| | sa tāmālokya daityendraḥ kāmopahatacetanaḥ | ahameva prabhuriti devyāṃ dauṣṭyamacintayata | | 5 | | cintayitvā tu tāṃ prāha dānavānanuyāyinaḥ | ānayadhvamimāṃ śīghraṃ matsamīpaṃ nagātmajāma | |6| | tacchrutvā tasya vacanaṃ manmathāviṣṭacetasaḥ | prahlādo vadatāṃ śreṣṭha idaṃ vacanamabravīt | |7|| dānavendra hitaṃ vākyaṃ yadāyatyāṃ viśudhyate | avaśyaṃ tanmayā vācyaṃ bandhusnehādviśeṣataḥ ||8|| eṣā himavataḥ putrī patnī śarvasya dhīmataḥ | nāsyāṃ dauṣṭya tvayā cintyaṃ mā no dhakṣyati tejasā ||9|| jagato mātaraṃ devīṃ pūjyā duṣprekṣyatejasam | umāṃ dānavaśārdūla nādhikṣeptumihārhasi ||8.130.1 0|| kiṃ kaṇṭhe mahatīṃ baddhvā śilāṃ mūḍhena cetasā | gambhīrāvartinīṃ bhīmāṃ nadīṃ tvaṃ tartumicchasi ||11 || bhūtvā pataṅgaḥ kiṃ mohācchikhāṃ dīptāṃ vibhāvasoḥ | dānavānāmadhipate nāśāya spraṣṭumicchasi || 12| | mā vināśaṃ nayeḥ sarvān samūlāndānaveśvara | nivartyatāṃ mano devyā naitadyukta vipaścitām ||13 || tvaṃ vipaścit kulīnaśca kulīnānāṃ ca gotrajaḥ | yajvā ca dharmanityaśca naitadyukta tava prabho ||14|| tava santi striyo bahvyaḥ sarvāśca sthirayauvanāḥ | prakṛtyaiva surūpāṅgyo devyāśceto nivartyatām ||15|| yosmākaṃ tapasā tuṣṭo yacchate kāṃkṣitān varān | tasya tvaṃ devadevasya devyāḥ pāpaṃ cikīrṣasi ||1 6|| yena dakṣaḥ kratuḥ kālaḥ kāmaśca gamitaḥ kṣayam | tasya tvaṃ devadevasya dehārdhaṃ hartumicchasi ||17|| liṅgeṣu yorcyate devaḥ surāsuramahoragaiḥ | tasya devī jagaddhātrīṃ kathaṃ tvamavamanyase ||18|| sa caiko nābhimantavya stvayā devaḥ pinākadhṛk | icchan kuryāddhi rūpāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca | | 19 || pramathānāṃ sahasrāṇi yogināṃ bhīmakarmaṇām | tasyāgrato vrajantyete yathaiva tava dānavāḥ | | 8.130.20 | | yo hared bhāskarāddīptiṃ candrātkāntiṃ kṣiteḥ kṣamām | vāsukeryo hared daṃṣṭrāṃ sa harettasya pārvatīm | |21 | | tasyottamāṅgaṃ sakalaṃ śatadhā śakalībhavet | yaḥ śarvabhāryāṃ tāmāryāmavamanyeta bāliśaḥ | |2 2 | | pitāmahena yaccoktastadā tvaṃ padmayoninā | varadānāvasāne tu vacastat smartumarhasi | |2 3 | | yaiṣā śrīste ditisuta mayā dattā sudurlabhā | durnayena tavaiveyaṃ yāsyatyanyatra dānava | | 24| | kaṭukānyapi pathyāni bandhūnāṃ vacanāni ye | na śṛṇvantyanayopetāste yānti nidhanaṃ narāḥ | |25| | sameṣyāma vayaṃ devaṃ priyārthe tava śaṅkaram | sametyānusameṣyāmaḥ sarve vaivasvatakṣaye | |2 6| | ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena bandhunā śobhanaṃ vacaḥ | naitadevamiti prāha prahasan kālacoditaḥ | | 27 | | tasminnaparihārye tu kāryākārye priye mama | yadi yuddhe kṣayo me syāt kṣayopi vijayo mama ||28|| manasaiva hi bhūtānāṃ vidadhānaḥ śubhāśubham | tathā vāpyanyathā vāpi kāla eva kariṣyati | |29 | | pratyākhyāya tato rāgāt prahlādaṃ dānaveśvaraḥ | devīṃ spraṣṭuṃ dadhe cetaḥ pataṅgogniśikhāmiva | |8.130.3 0 || atha buddhvā bhagavatī duṣṭabhāvaṃ durātmanaḥ | gaṇānājñāpayāmāsa yuddhāya sumahābalān ||3 1 || atha te jñāpitā devyā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ | dānavābhimukhībhūtāḥ somanandipurassarāḥ | |3 2| | te kṛtvā sumahadyuddhaṃ dānavānucaraiḥ saha | vikṣiptā dānavendreṇa vāyunā jaladā iva | |3 3 | | etasminnantare devī dṛṣṭvodīrṇṇaṃ tamandhakam | svayamevābhidudrāva gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ | | 34|| andhakaṃ pacaviṃśatyā sā jaghāna stanāntare | śarāṇāṃ niśitāgrāṇāṃ sa mumoha papāta ca || 3 5| | sa muhūrttāttadā saṃjñāṃ labdhvā mānācca dānavaḥ | uttasthau vegavāñchīghramugrodyataśarāsanaḥ | |3 6|| tataḥ sa utthāya punardevīṃ prati mahāsuraḥ | mumoca śaravarṣāṇi varṣāṇīva balāhakaḥ | |37| | tatastriśūlamudyamya devīṃ dīptāgnitejasam | andhakaṃ hantumārabdhāṃ śanairdevo nyaṣedhayat | |38|| dānavendro mamaivāyaṃ śāsyo mā tvaṃ śramaṃ kṛthāḥ | ahamevāsya śūlena bhetsyāmi hṛdayaṃ raṇe || 3 9|| evamuktā tu sā devī devadevena pārvatī | virarāma tato yuddhādadṛśyā saṃbabhūva ca | | 8.130.40 | | tato devaḥ svayaṃ prāha nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam | yudhyadhvaṃ dānavaissārdhaṃ gaṇānāhūya sarvaśaḥ | |41 || āhūya nandī tānsarvān gaṇāñcharvājñayā tadā | uvāca bhūyo deveśaṃ śṛṇu yebhyāgatā gaṇāḥ ||42 || viśiṣṭeṣṭāstvayā sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃ sṛṣṭau sanātanāḥ | prajābhāvena nānātvaṃ yeṣāṃ tatvaṃ sudurvacam | |43 || vṛṣadhvajā vṛṣarathāścandrāvayavabhūṣaṇāḥ | ta ime samanuprāptā rudrā rudra tava priyāḥ | |44| | koṭīśatasahasrāṇāṃ śatameṣāṃ mahātmanām | tāvanti ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca tathā vibho | |45| | ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi yeṣāṃ tulyo na vidyate | devānāṃ nīlakaṇṭhānāṃ nīlakaṇṭhamahātmanām | |46| | ete śūrā baleṣūgrā ugrodagraparākramāḥ | yudhyamānāḥ kariṣyanti tava pramuditaṃ manaḥ | |47| | eteṣāmeva rudrāṇāmanurūpāḥ prabhāvataḥ | tanmātrā dvārapālā vai vikrāntāḥ krāntamanyavaḥ | |48| | itīme kapisiṃhāsyāḥ kapisiṃhabalā raṇe | dānavaissaha yotsyanti vāraṇā iva vāraṇaiḥ | |49 || rudrāśca rudraputrāśca rudrāṇāṃ ye ca pārṣadāḥ | rudrādhipa na kiñciddhi yeṣāṃ sādhyaṃ na vidyate | |8.130.5 0 | | ekaikasyāsya rudrasya putrāḥ putravatāṃ vara | pañca pañca mahāvīryāḥ kākapakṣadharāśca te ||5 1 | | bhujataḥ sahasotpannāstava ye krodha sambhavāḥ | vīrabhadraṃ puraskṛtya ta ime samupasthitāḥ || 52| | eṣāṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ smṛtāḥ koṭyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa | gaṇapānāṃ gaṇādhyakṣa tvatpriyāṇāmihāgatāḥ ||5 3 | | evaṃ deva priyārthaṃ te dakṣayajñaḥ samṛddhimān | yairdhvastaḥ purahan deva paśya tān punarāgatān ||54| | āpadbhāvaprapannāstu yena dhyātāstvayānagha | koṭīśatasahasrākhyāstepyamī samupasthitāḥ | | 56 | | mahānalā yathā vṛkṣān pradīptān vāyunā saha | etebhinirdahiṣyanti dānavām̐stvatpriye ratāḥ | | 57 | | guhāvāsa guhyasyāpi krīḍamānasya ye suraiḥ | priyārthaṃ gaṇapā dattā nānāmṛgaśatānanāḥ | |58| | jvalanācalavatteṣāṃ triṃśatkoṭyo maheśvara | gaṇapānāmanuprāptāḥ priyaṃ kartuṃ tavānagha | |59| | ime raktambaradharā raktasraganulepanāḥ | oṣṭhajādrudhirājjātā raktā nāma gaṇeśvarāḥ | | 8.130.60 || aṅgārakasyānucarā mahābalaparākramāḥ | ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ta ime samupasthitāḥ | |6 1 | | mantavyaṃ na balaṃ cāpi etanmātraṃ tvayānagha | ete hyaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryaṃ tava deva prasādajam | | 62 | | saṃvibhrāṇā maheśāna kariṣyanti bahūnapi | lokānete samudyuktān sadevāsuramānuṣān | | 63 | | saṃyuge yugamūlāntaṃ daheyuḥ suradānavān | ya ete kundasaṃkāśāḥ svarṇotpalavibhūṣitāḥ | | 64| | daṃśitā gaṇepeśāna sarve yuddhakutūhalāḥ | brahmaṇyāsta ime śūrāścandrāvayavabhūṣaṇāḥ | | 65| | rudrā rudrapate prāptāḥ paśyemān yuddhalālasān | bālārkasamavarṇābhāḥ saśastrāśca caturbhujāḥ || 66| | dvārapālā hyamī deva kapīndrasadṛśānanāḥ | raktāmbarā raktamālyā raktacandanarūṣitāḥ ||67| | brahmaṇyā varadāḥ śūrāḥ kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ | mattabarhisamārūḍhāḥ sarve vai śaktipāṇayaḥ ||68| | ete vikrāntavikrāntāḥ skandā nāma kumārakāḥ | uccaiḥśravaḥpratisamānaśvān ye hemamālinaḥ || 68|| virejurāsthitā deva pītakauśeyavāsasaḥ | bālārkasamavarṇābhā bālotpaladalekṣaṇāḥ ||8.130.70 || viśākhā nāma te putrā rudrāṇāṃ śaktipāṇayaḥ | yānetānīkṣase deva sitavastrān sitānanān | |71 || vidyotamānān vapuṣā bahūm̐ścandrānivoditān | kākapakṣadharānmuṇḍām̐stāmracūḍeṣvavasthitān | |72| | ete vikhyātavīryāste śākhā nāma kumārakāḥ | ya ime chāgameṣasthāḥ kiṃśukāśokavarcasaḥ | |73 | | śūrāścaudāryavantaśca śiśutāmarasānanāḥ | naigameṣasya putrasya tava tulyaparicchadāḥ | |74| | naigameṣā iti khyātā hyete deva kumārakāḥ | ya ime kālameghābhāḥ kālameghanibhasvanāḥ | |75| | keśajāstava te deva pramathāḥ samupasthitāḥ | ime ca raktā bahavo gaṇāḥ parabalārdanāḥ | |76 | | varūthino varmiṇaśca rathinaścitrayodhinaḥ | nānāpraharaṇāḥ sarve sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ ||77|| kṛtino yuddhaśauṇḍāśca sarva eva ca daṃśitāḥ | sitāsitānāṃ meghānāṃ girīṇāṃ ca samatviṣaḥ | sanakramīnamakarā ye samudrā ivoddhatāḥ | |78|| siṃhavyāghravarāhāsyāḥ parighāśanipāṇayaḥ | tavaivānugrahādete pramathāstvāmupasthitāḥ ||79 | | ete vai pārṣadāḥ śūrāḥ skandasya paramātmanaḥ tridaśaiḥ krīḍanaṃ dattāḥ sarvaśastvāmupasthitāḥ ||8.130.8 0 | | dṛptapramuditaṃ sphītaṃ pramathānīkamīśvara | dānavānīkabhedārthe samarthamiti me matiḥ | |81 | | pravihāyānyakāryāṇi paramādaramāsthitam | devārīṇāmanarthāya vidhvaṃsayadanantaram (?) | |82| | karigiritarutoraṇaprabhāstaruṇadivākaratulyatejasaḥ | gaṇapatipatayastava hyamī ripubalamīśvara jetumudyatāḥ | 83 | | acaracarapate tatondhakaḥ pratisamatāṃ labhate raṇe sthitaḥ | gaṇapatiśatayūthasaṃvṛto visṛja vibhovanatān gaṇeśvarān | |84|| iti skandapurāṇe andhakayuddhopakrame triṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.131> sanatkumāra uvāca athāpaśyattadāyātān bhagavān gaṇanāyakān | svairanīkaissubahuśaḥ sannaddhān yuddhalālasān ||1 || diṇḍiñca bhārabhūtiñca somaśarmāṇameva ca | karikaṃ meghanādaṃ ca udaremaṇimeva ca | |2 | | āsattiṃ dhūtapāpaṃ ca candramaulinameva ca | ādityamālaṃ vikrāntaṃ sukeśaṃ ca mahābalam | |3 || tālaketuṃ jvarañcaiva daṇḍapāṇinamūrjitam | etāṃścānyāṃśca vikhyātān guhyām̐śca gaṇanāyakān ||4|| mahāgaṇapatiñcaiva khoṭhāmudgarameva ca | saṃpūjya bhagavān sarvān prasādya ca punaḥ punaḥ | |5|| uvāca meghanirhrādaḥ śatadundubhinisvanaḥ | dānavaiḥ saha yūyaṃ me yoddhumarhatha sattamāḥ | | 6 | | yūyameva gaṇādhyakṣāḥ paryāptāstānprabādhane | tasmādyūyaṃ mahāsatvāḥ sagaṇāḥ sapadānugāḥ | gacchadhvaṃ saṃvināśāya pūjitosmi mahābalāḥ | |7| | ta evamuktā devena praṇamya śirasā haram | viprajagmurmahātmāno devopi saṃpratiṣṭhata | | 8 || tataḥ samabhavacchabda udadheriva bhidyataḥ | andhakāsurasainyasya mandaraṃ samupeyuṣaḥ | | 9| | niśamya dānavārāvaṃ śrotrāyāsakaraṃ bhṛśam | pramathā rurudhurghoraṃ yugānte jaladā iva | | 8.131.10 | | tāvanyonyabaloddhūtāvabhūtāṃ sainyasāgarau | pralayānta ivoddhūtau bhidyamānau mahārṇavau || 11 || devadeva uvāca juhudhyarivināśāya brahmannasmajjayāya ca | tvaṃ cāpi nandin rakṣasva sarvairetairgaṇairvṛtaḥ | | 1 2| | ākāśasthāśca ye hyete nadantyambumuco yathā | ākāśagāneva ripūnete bādhantu dānavān | | 13 | | sanatkumāra uvāca ityuktau tau prārabhetāṃ kartuṃ bhagavato vacaḥ | bṛhaspatirjuhāvāgniṃ nandī cāpi rarakṣa tam | | 14| | vyāyacchadbhirmahadbhiśca pramathairmandaro giriḥ | viprasthita ivābhāti srastakuñjarakesariḥ | | 1 5| | tatondhakabala dṛptaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhabalaṃ yathā | ārohamāṇaṃ tattūrṇaṃ cālayattamivācalam | | 1 6| | tato halahalāśabdaḥ pramathānāmajāyata | daityān vārayatāṃ yuddhaṃ tarupāṣāṇasāyakaiḥ | |17|| dānavā vāryamāṇāstu pramathairjitakāśibhiḥ | vidārya pramathānīkaṃ śīghramāruruhustadā | | 18|| pramathā hyapi nissaṅgaṃ yoddhavyamiti niścitāḥ | cicchidurbibhiduścaiva paphaluśca suretarān | | 1 9| | gṛhṇīṣva muñca tiṣṭheti sthitastvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi | evaṃ vācaḥ samuttasthuḥ pramathāsurasainyayoḥ | |8.131.2 0 | | samūlāgraistaruvaraiḥ parvataiśca sapādapaiḥ | anyonyaṃ cūrṇayanti sma nirghṛṇāḥ pramathāsurāḥ ||21 || tato dākṣāyaṇīputrairdakṣādhvaravināśanāḥ | parāṅmukhā na śakitāḥ kartuṃ bhaktyaparāṅmukhāḥ sanatkumāra uvāca arohaṇecalāgrasya aśaktān nirjitān ripūn | devopalabhya pramathānavārayadaśeṣataḥ | | 23 | | devadeva uvāca ārohantu danoḥ putrā mandaraṃ cārukandarama | krīḍārthaṃ mama yudhyadhvamebhissaha gaṇādhipāḥ | | 24| | dadṛśuranekacārukuñjasthitamṛgarājavimuktabhīmanādam | prasṛtagajakulābhighātarugṇa kṣitiruhapuṣpasamācitapradeśam bhujagapatiśiromaṇipradīpapratihatacāruśilāgṛhāndhakāram | śiśiravimalanirjharāmbuvegasphuṭitamahopalajāladṛṣṭarandhram | |26|| kvacidabhinavatāmrapallavāgrapratihatabāladivākarāśujālam | kvacidamaravilāsinīmukhendupraviracitasphuṭacārupatralekham | | 27| | kvacidanilavidhūtacārupuṣpastabakavicitritakānanapradeśam | sphaṭikamaṇiśilā talopaviṣṭasthitakapiyūthavilokitātmadeham ||28|| surayuvatiniketabarhikekāśravaṇasukhapratibuddhasiddhasārtham | kamaladalarajaḥsugandhitoyasthitakalahaṃsakalapralāparamyam | |29| | dinakarakarataptasūryakānta pravigalitāgnivilīnahemadhātum | kvacidabhi patitāṃśucandrakānta pravisṛtaśailanadīvikīrṇatoyam | |8.131.3 0 || varaharikaravajrasannipātasphuṭitamahāgajakumbha mauktikaughaiḥ | sitakusumacayairiva prakīrṇaiḥ kvacidupaśobhitavistṛtopakaṇṭham | | 31 | | pramuditagaṇabhairavāṭṭahāsaprasṛtamahāravapūritāntarālam | tarugahanalatāgṛhāntalīnapramuditasiddhavadhūpranṛttaramyam | | 3 2| | bahukaṭakavicārimattanāgaṃ bahumṛgaśāva nipītanirjharāmbum | bahuviṣamataṭaprapātakuñjaṃ bahuvidhagulmalatāvatānavṛkṣam ||34|| marakatamaṇipadmarāgaśṛṅgadyutiśabalīkṛtapādapādapāgryam | alikulakalakokilāvinādapracuravināditacārukānanāntam ||34| | yasmin sadā pramuditā jitamṛtyuśokā gorocanāñjanaśilālanidhānasiddhāḥ | siddhāḥ sadā pramuditā vanitāsahāyāstiṣṭhanti candrakiraṇopamacāruhārāḥ || 35| | vidyādharāḥ priyatamāvinibaddharāgāḥ pīneṣu tuṅgataṭavatsu payodhareṣu | dhātūtkarairharitaraktapiśaṅgavarṇairyatrālikhanti vividhān kusumāvataṃsān | | 3 6| | yasmina sadā suratakheditagātrayaṣṭayaḥ kāntāgrahastaviniveśitahastapadmāḥ | sevanti nirjharajalapraṇayātiśītamabhyāgataṃ pavanamapsarasotihṛṣṭāḥ || 37 || nūpurarāvavibodhitahaṃsaṃ hasatanūruhaghaṭṭitapadmam | padmarajoruṇitāmalatoyaṃ toyapariṣkṛtakāñcanaśṛṅgama | | 38|| śṛṅgasamutthitacandanavṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣasamāsthitakokilavṛndam | vṛndavimuktagajendraninādaṃ nādabhayākulitarkṣatarakṣum | |39|| ṛkṣatarakṣunilīnanikuñjaṃ kuñjaguhāmukhanirgatasiṃham | siṃhavidāritanaikapakumbhaṃ kumbhavinirgatamauktikaratnam | |8.131.40| | ratnamayūkhavibhāsitapṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhasamāsthitaśaṅkarapādama | pādasamutthitapādapaṣaṇḍaṃ ṣaṇḍalatākusumotkaramārgam | |41 || mārgamārgamaṇitoraṇacitraṃ citracitramaṇitoraṇapaṭṭam | paṭṭapaṭṭaviniveśitapuṣpaṃ puṣpapuṣpaparicumbitabhṛṅgam | |42 | | nānādhātuvicitranitambaṃ nānāpuṣpalatāgṛharamyam | nānāmattavihaṅgamaghuṣṭaṃ nānāśṛṅgasamāsthitasiddham ||43 || tanmandaraṃ vividhacāraṇasiddhasaṃghai ramyaṃ svayaṃ trinayanena kṛtādhivāsam | daityāstadā bhagavatānumatapraveśāḥ sarve samāruruhurātma(?) jayaiṣiṇaste | |44|| tato visṛṣṭāḥ pramathairārohanta diteḥ sutāḥ | manvānāḥ pramathā bhītā nivṛttā iti satvaram ||45| | mandarasya tataḥ pṛṣṭhe nānādrumasamākule | baddhaskandhāḥ sthitā daityā ādityasadṛśaprabhāḥ | |46|| sa mandaro bhīmaśilopaladrumo vivṛddhaśārdūlatarakṣuvāraṇaḥ | mahāsurairdarpitavājivāraṇairvikīryate megha ivānilairbhṛśam | |47|| kṣipanti śubhrābhranibhāḥ śilāḥ kvacit tarūnsamutpāṭya nadanti meghavat | nivāryamāṇāḥ pramathān samārdayan vaneṣu siṃhā mṛgayūthapāniva ||48|| tatastu tad gajarathavājidānavaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ kṣubhitamahodadhiprabham | virājate ditisutabāhupālitaṃ vanaṃ yathā mṛgapatibāhupālitam ||49| | iti skandapurāṇe andhakayuddhopakrame mandaravarṇanaṃ nāma ekatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.132> sanatkumāra uvāca mandaraprasthamāsādya sondhako dānavādhipaḥ | prāñjaliḥ śukramāhedaṃ śakrārkasadṛśadyutim || 1 | | andhaka uvāca prāptāḥ sma bhagavañchailaṃ mandaraṃ cārukandaram | pramathairbhīmasaṃkāśaiḥ sanniruddhaśilātalam | | 2 | | khecarā māyinaścaiva yoginaśca mahābalāḥ | prasabhaṃ dānavairjetuṃ na śakyā gaṇanāyakāḥ | |3 || prāyeṇa balavantopi hyupāyenaiva sādhavaḥ | kāryeṣvādau pravartante paścāttu viparītavat | |4| | tadupāyaṃ samāsthāya viśeṣeṇa samāhitāḥ | pramathān saṃprabādhāma yathā vā rucitaṃ tava ||5|| sa tvamasmajjayaprepsurdānavānāṃ jayāya ca | kuru deva girivyūhaṃ paravyūhavidāraṇam || 6| | ke ceme sūryakoṭīnāṃ prabhāvarṇavapurdharāḥ | pramathānīkamadhyeṣu sthitāḥ paśyanti māṃ muhuḥ ||7| | sanatkumāra uvāca tatondhakavacaḥ śrutvā kruddho daityapurohitaḥ | uvāca daityādhipatiṃ gopatiṃ darśayanniva | |8| | śukra uvāca ya eṣa madhupiṅgākṣastryambakaścandrabhūṣaṇaḥ | vyāghracarmāmbaradharo deva eṣa pinākadhṛk | |9|| yastveṣa kapisiṃhāsyo nīlavastraścaturbhujaḥ | taruṇārkasamo bhāti nandyeṣa gaṇanāyakaḥ || 8.132.10 | | tanuruccognisaṃkāśo ya eṣognirivojjvalaḥ | brāhmaṇādhipatirhyeṣa bṛhadbuddhirbṛhaspatiḥ | |1 1 | | ya eṣa nātidūrastho vṛṣaketostriśūladhṛk | eṣondhaka mahākāyo mahāgaṇapatirvaraḥ | | 12 || yaiṣa āsthāya kūjantaṃ bhāti citrakalāpinam | mayūraṃ bālasūryābhaḥ śaktipāṇirmahābalaḥ | | 13 | | brahmaṇyo brahmanirato brahmacārī yatavrataḥ | skanda eṣa hi devānāmagraṇīrdānavā raṇe | | 14| | ya eṣa tāmracūḍasthastāmracūḍaśilāprabhaḥ | śaktimullolayan bhāti toyadastaḍitaṃ yathā | | 15 | | kākapakṣadharo hyeṣa pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ | viśākho nāma kaumāraḥ kaumārabrahmacaryavān || 1 6|| taruṇastaruṇaprajñastaruḥ śākhāyuto yathā | svāhāyāstanayo hyeṣa śākho nāma mahādyutiḥ | | 17| | etasya yo hyasau pārśvaṃ savyamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati | darśayānaḥ pradeśinyā māñca tvāñca punaḥpunaḥ | | 1 8| | meṣamāsthāya balavān bāla eva vyavasthitaḥ | naigameṣa iti khyāta eṣondhaka harātmajaḥ || | 19 || caturbhireṣa putraistu dṛśyatesurahā vṛtaḥ | devaiścaturbhiḥ saṃpṛkto yathaiva hi pitāmahaḥ | 8.132.20 | | devamīśaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ nandisūnupurassaram | vyatiyudhyā suraśreṣṭha manmantraparipālitaḥ | |2 1 | | pramathairnihatān daityān śataśotha sahasraśaḥ | ahamutthāpayiṣyāmi śasyāni jalado yathā | |22 | | sanatkumāra uvāca taṃ bhārgava iti procya dānavān dānavādhipam | girivyūhena tatsainyaṃ prākramad vyūhituṃ tataḥ ||23|| mūlendhakarathaṃ kṛtvā sāndhakaṃ sāśvasārathim | pādātairbahusāhasraiḥ pādān tasya cakāra ha ||24|| teṣu pādasahasreṣu girivyūhasya dānavaiḥ | vṛkṣaśailaśilāsaṃghān kārayamāsa bhārgavaḥ ||25|| koṭibhirdaśabhistasya dānavānāṃ mahātmanām | nitambām̐stāmranayanān pracakāra graheśvaraḥ ||26|| dhātuniṣyandacitreṣu nitambeṣvapi dānavān | tṛṇavat kṣupavaccāpi sthāpayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ ||27|| triṃśatā koṭibhiścāpi tridaśādhipavidviṣām | girivyūhasya śṛṅgāṇi cakārārkasamaprabhaḥ ||28|| teṣu śṛṅgeṣu tuṅgeṣu dānavānsāyudhānatha | amī prapātā ityevamācakhyau bhṛgunandanaḥ ||29|| te prapātasthitā daityā nīlāmbudharavarcasaḥ | śastratoyāni muditāḥ kṣaranta iva saṃsthitāḥ ||8.132.30 || balasthā ye javopetā daityā daivatakaṇṭakāḥ | śyenavatte bhramitvā tu nilīnāḥ syurgirivraje ||31|| nivātakavacān sarvān vividhāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | akarod bhārgavo devo girivyūhasya sānuvat ||32| | prahrādamatha saṃhrādamanuhrādaṃ śiniṃ tathā | jambhaṃ kujambhaṃ tārañca mayaṃ namucimeva ca ||33|| virocanaṃ baliṃ bāṇaṃ vātaṃ kārtasvanaṃ kuśam | śambhuṃ ca bhāvayatyaṃ ca ilvakaṃ vilvakaṃ tathā || 34|| vitaṃ vṛttaṃ tuhuṇḍaṃ ca huṇḍaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca dānavam | añjanaṃ ruṣaṇaṃ rāhuṃ svarbhānumajakaṃ gajam | |35|| hastiduryodhanau caiva pākaṃ dhundhuñca dānavam | etāṃścānyāṃśca balino daityāndaivatakaṇṭakān | |36|| vyūhaṃ rakṣata yudhyadhvamityuvācāsurādhipaḥ | himavāniva śailendro vindhyo vādbhutagahvaraḥ ||37|| sa girivyūha ābhāti śastrakaṇṭakitadrumaḥ | andhakāramivaikasthaṃ meghānāmiva saṃcayam | | 38| | dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā girivyūhaṃ pramathā vismayaṃ yayuḥ | parvatavyūhamālokya parvatavyūhasaṃsthitāḥ || 3 9|| nedustesuraśārdūlā meghā lokātyaye yathā | ūcuśca na hi śakyoyaṃ bhettuṃ devaissavāsavaiḥ ||8.132.40 || pramathāḥ kiṃ kariṣyanti svalpavīryaparākramāḥ | jīvayiṣyati naḥ śukro mṛtānapi na saṃśayaḥ | yudhyadhvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭhā niśśaṅkairantarātmabhiḥ | |41 | | sanatkumāra uvāca girivyūhaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā bhārgavottamanirmitam | devaḥ kapardī prāhedaṃ bṛhadbuddhiṃ bṛhaspatim ||42|| vācaspate girivyūhaṃ paśya śukreṇa nirmitam | śṛṅgavantaṃ darīvantaṃ himavantaṃ yathā girim | |43 | | lokān sajalapātālān saviṣṇūn sapitāmahān | grasedeṣa girivyūha upekṣā kriyate yadi ||44| | nainaṃ devā na gandharvā na nāgā na nagāstathā | śaknuyurbhettumudyuktā vinaitān gaṇanāyakān | |45 | | girivyūhasya viprendra nānyaṃ paśyāmi bhedanam | vajravyūhamṛte dhīman sarvavyūhabhidaṃ mahat | |46| | sa tvaṃ brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha girivyūhavidāraṇam | vajravyūdahaṃ kuruṣvādya pramathāyutasaṃvṛtam | |47 | | śambhunā caivamuktastu brāhmaṇendro bṛhaspatiḥ | vajravyūhena taṃ vyūha pratyavyūhattadā navam | |48 | | bāhujān bahusāhasrān bhaktām̐ścaiva gaṇādhipān | vajravyūhasya madhye vai sthāpayāmāsa buddhimān | |49| | skandasya pārṣadaiḥ śūraiḥ surāsuranighātibhiḥ | sahasra parvaṇāṃ tasya vajravyūhasya nirmamau || 8.132.50 | | koṭiṃ koṭipravīrāṇāṃ pramathānāṃ prahāriṇām | vajradhārāsu sarvāsu sthāpayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ | |51 | | kumārañca viśākhañca śākhaṃ chāgamukhaṃ tathā | cakāra soṅagirā devo vajravyūhasya kuḍmalam | |52 || kuḍmalāgre caturbāhuḥ kapīndravadanorihā | sthito vajrodyatakaro nandī dinakaraprabhaḥ | | 53 | | kuṇḍodaraṃ nandiṣeṇaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ mahodaram | paścārdhe tasya vajrasya kuḍmalaṃ sannyaveśayat | | 54| | somanandī tu tasyāgre vyāghravaktro gaṇeśvaraḥ | sārkacandrāyutaprakhyaḥ sthito vai paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ ||5 5 || rudrāṇāṃ dvārapālāśca rudrā rudrasutāśca ye | itaścetaśca vinyastā vajravyūhābhirakṣiṇaḥ | |56 | | vajravyūhasya madhye tu rathavarye pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasthāvīśo bhavaḥ śarvaḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ ||57|| tasya keturmahāñchveto vibhātīndradhvajopamaḥ | mandaraścandrabimbena juṣṭaśrṛṅga ivācalaḥ ||58|| śatadhāro naikaparvā cāruśobhitakuḍmalaḥ | vajravyūho girivyūhaṃ bhettu kāma ivābhavat ||59|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā nirmitaṃ vyūhaṃ devagandharvaguhyakāḥ || sādhusādhviti vai nedurvismayotphullalocanāḥ ||8.132.60|| atha gaṇapabaleṣu siṃhanādāḥ paṇavamṛdaṅgamaśaṃkhanādamiśrāḥ|| || dititanayabhayapradāḥ pravṛttāḥ kṣubhitasamudrapayodanādakalpāḥ ||61 || iti skandapurāṇe andhakamathane vyūharacanānāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || <8.133> sanatkumāra uvāca tau dṛṣṭavā nirmitau vyūhau pramathāsurayoḥ surāḥ | vimānakoṭibhiḥ śīghraṃ rurudhuḥ sarvato nabhaḥ ||1|| sarvaṃ tejobhirākīrṇaṃ tadambaratalaṃ babhau | merukūṭavanaṃ ramyaṃ dahyamānamivāgninā ||2|| devadundubhiśabdāḍhyaṃ divyastrīśatasaṃkulam | taddevamaṇḍalaṃ bhāti yathaivādityamaṇḍalam ||3|| divyapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ divyagandhādhivāsitam | prekṣakaiḥ śataśaḥ pūrṇaṃ khatalaṃ divyamābabhau ||4|| vāditrāṇyabhyahanyanta jaguśca suragāyanāḥ | rambhādyā nanṛtuścāpi śubhāpāṅgāḥ surāṅganāḥ ||5|| atha vajragirivyūhau parasparajayaiṣiṇau | samīyatu rmahānādairvātoddhūtau yathārṇavau ||6|| mā tvaradhvamiti proktāḥ śukreṇa sumahātmanā | yodhā nivāryamāṇāpi cakruryuddhamasaṃhatam ||7|| tataḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavā goviṣāṇikāḥ | āḍambarā ḍiṇḍimāśva maṇḍūkāḥ paṇavā hyapi ||8|| bheryo dundubhayaścāpi mṛdaṅgāḥ kiṃkharānakāḥ | ubhayatra bale gāḍhaṃ prāvādyanta sahasraśaḥ |9|| tataḥ suragaṇairnādāḥ saha gandharvacāraṇaiḥ | kṛtāstūryaravaṃ śrutvā pramathāsurasainyayoḥ ||8.133.10|| balayostūryaśabdena devasiṃharaveṇa ca | mandare ruruvurghoraṃ siṃhaśārdūlakuñjarāḥ ||11|| tūryārasitabdena tena temitavikramāḥ || 2 || abhindantaḥ svakaṃ vyūhaṃ yuyudhuḥ pramathāsurāḥ ||12|| prathame sannipāte tu teṣāṃ yuddhe kṛtātmanām | abhavad dāruṇo rāvo hastināmiva garjatām ||13|| devāsurāḥ karasthaistu āyudhaiste sahasraśaḥ | viśeṣayanti yuddhe sma parasparajighāṃsavaḥ ||14|| tacchūlavajropalavṛkṣabāṇa dṛḍhaprahārātiśayātiharṣam | vivardhate pāriṣadāsurāṇāṃ yuddhaṃ yugaṃ tiṣyamivātighoram ||15|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | <8.134> sanatkumāra uvāca| saṃkule vartamāne tu pramathāsurasainyayoḥ | śrūyante kārmukaravāḥ siṃhanādāśca dāruṇāḥ ||1|| vyāviddhāṅgulayo devaścāraṇoragaguhyakāḥ || neduruddhūtavastrāntā yuddhoddhavakṛtasvanāḥ ||2|| śūrārasitaśabdena tenodīritavikramāḥ | cakruḥ karmāṇyasahyāni darpitāḥ pramathāsurāḥ ||3|| asibhirvyāyitaiśchinnāḥ paṭṭiśai rbhinnavakṣasaḥ | śarasaṃkṛttamarmāṇaḥ patanti pramathāsurāḥ ||4|| śirasāṃ pātyamānānāṃ bahūnāṃ corubhiḥ saha | rāśayastatra dṛśyante pramathāsurasaṃyuge ||5|| bhagnacakrā vidhvajāśca vivarūthā vikūbarāḥ | dṛśyante śataśo vyaśvā hatasārathayo rathāḥ ||6|| sapatākāḥ sakeyūrāḥ savarmāyudhaketavaḥ | niṣkṛṣṭadantamuśalāḥ patanti gajapuṅgavāḥ ||7|| śaraprahārarugṇāṅgāścāmarāpīḍakojjvalāḥ | sasādino nipātyante hayāḥ sūryahayopamāḥ ||8|| udbhrāntaisturagaistrastairdānavaiḥ sarathairapi | tadbalaṃ prababhau mattaṃ bhrāntagrāhārṇavopamam ||9|| vāsobhirātapatraiśva mukuṭairmaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ | hārārdhahāraiḥ keyūrairaṅgulīyaiḥ sraguttamaiḥ ||8.134.10|| karānanaiḥ prakṛttaiśca caraṇaiśca nipātitaiḥ | yuddhabhūmirvṛtā bhāti dyaurnakṣatrairivoditaiḥ ||11|| rudhirāsrāvavasanā nānābharaṇabhūṣaṇāḥ | raktavastrāvṛtairgātrairmahī mṛtyurivābabhau ||12|| atha vājigajaughānāṃ śoṇitodakavāhinī | nadī pravavṛte ghorā yamasādanavāhinī ||13|| mṛgahastikharāśvoṣṭramahāgrāhasamākulā | māṃsamedoyakṛtpaṃkā dhanurdhvajaśatadrumā |14|| chinnaśīrṣopalaśatā hastapaśvānanoragā | keśaśaivālasaṃchannā dhanurjyāśatatantukā ||15|| pāṇḍarāmbaraharṣā vai mukuṭāṭikulākulā | bherīkacchapasaṃkīrṇā varābharaṇadardurā |16|| śaramīnasamākīrṇā khaḍganakradurāsadā | rathacakramahānakrā gada yādoviloḍitā |17|| viśīrṇahārasikatā kaphasaṃjātapheninī | raktotpalānāṃ māleva kauṅakumī sragibojjhitā ||18|| jihvevoragarājasya yamasyājñā ivādbhutā | bhayadā bhīruyodhānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ harṣavardhinī | pravṛttā rudhirāmbhobhiḥ svargalokavahā nadī ||19|| saṃrabdhadaityendravivṛddhadhūmaṃ nandīśvarāgnijvalitāntarālam | babhau balaṃ sāgaratulyanādaṃ vināśi yadvajjagadantakāle ||8.134.20|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | <8.135> sanatkumāra uvāca vivardhamāne saṃgrāme tasmin pāriṣadāsure | girivyūhaprapātasthāḥ kruddhā dānavasattamāḥ ||1|| te krodhācchūlaśaktyṛṣṭiṃ gadāvarṣamatandritāḥ | vavarṣuḥ pramathānīke varṣaṃ jaladharā iva ||2|| śastravarṣaṇa panatāttāḍyamānā hyanekaśaḥ | acintayitvā tatsarvaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhuḥ ||3|| meghāḥ sasyāni hi yathā dviradāḥ pādapāniva | pṛṣatāniva śārdūlāḥ śarabhā iva vāraṇān ||4|| vajrā iva yathā śailān kāladūtā narāniva | vidhnāniva ca śāntyarthā nathānavinayā iva | 5 || bhāvāniva yathā bhāvā doṣā doṣānyathāpi ca | tathā nivātakavacān śūlaśaktyṛṣṭivṛṣṭibhiḥ|5 || nijaghnuḥ pramathāḥ śūrāḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ||6|| śūlanirdāritoraskā muśalairbhinnamastakāḥ | vajrāvaghātamlānāṅgā dānavāḥ patitā bhuvi ||7|| teṣāṃ ninādāḥ śrūyante nadatāmatidāruṇāḥ | saṃvarttakānāṃ meghānāṃ nadatāmiva sarvataḥ || 8 || iṣubhirbahudhā viddhā bhagnatrikakaśeravaḥ || 9 || ceṣṭante hyasurā bhūmau bhagnapṛṣṭhā ivoragāḥ ||9|| tatotikadanaṃ vīkṣya śūrāstatra mahāsurāḥ | nivṛttāḥ śataśastatra krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ ||8.135.10|| tairbhṛśaṃ pramathāstepi viddhā vyāsa trapānvitāḥ | saṃmīlitākṣā vṛṣabhā varṣaṃ nipatitaṃ yathā ||11|| sahante tattathā varṣaṃ pramathā dānaveritam | te cāpi yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ kṛtvānte pīḍitāstadā |12|| bhagnāḥ parāṅamukhā jātā śchinnabhinnāṃgasandhayaḥ | tasmin bhagnetha sainye tu prāmathe pramathottamāḥ ||13|| daśa cakrurmahāvegaṃ daśanāgaśatopamāḥ | śaṃkukarṇaśca balavān ghaṇṭākarṇaśca vīryavān |14|| mahākālaśca kālābho nandiṣeṇaśca viśrutaḥ | piṅgalo lohitākṣaśca somanandī ca vīryavān ||15|| vināyakaśca...nandī ca.....|| chāgaḥ kuṇḍodaraḥ skando mayūravaramāsthitaḥ ||16|| ete saha samunneduḥ payodā iva sāmbhasaḥ | viviśuścāsuraṃ sainyaṃ samudraṃ makarā iva ||17|| śaṃkukarṇahatā daityā ghaṇṭākarṇavidāritāḥ | nandiṣeṇaśarābhyastā mahākālaprakālitāḥ ||18|| kuṇḍodaragadāvegaiścūṇitāstravibhūṣaṇāḥ | piṅgalāloḍitā neśuḥ skandaśaktividāritāḥ ||19|| muṣṭiprahārabhinnāsyai stalatāḍitamastakaiḥ | apāhastaprahāraiśca kṣipyamāṇeritastataḥ ||8.135.20|| viśastravastrakavacairmuktamurddhajabandhanaiḥ | prabhagnairdānavaistūrṇaṃ vyūhabhedo babhūva ha ||21|| bhidyamāno girivyūho vibabhau ghoradarśanaḥ | indravajrāhtaḥ pūrvaṃ yathā vindhyo mahāgiriḥ |22|| bhinnavyūhām̐stato daityān pramathā jitakāśinaḥ | drudruvuḥ śataśo vṛkṣān pakvāñchakunayo yathā ||23|| tataḥ punarabhūdyuddhaṃ kolāhalasamākulam | pramathānāñca śūrāṇāmasurāṇāñca dāruṇam |24|| sannipāte punasteṣāṃ gajānāmiva dāruṇe | nedurdevāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca divi harṣitāḥ |25|| nānāvidhāstūryaravāstato dānavapārṣadaiḥ || aśrūyanta kṛtā ghorā meghānāṃ nadatāmiva ||26|| gajaiśca nīlācalasannikāśai rathaiśca gandharvavimānakalpaiḥ|| hayaiśca vāyupratimānavegaiścaranti daityāḥ samare hyabhītāḥ |27|| te śūlaśaktyṛṣṭibhuśuṇḍibāṇaiḥ śailopalaiścakrasaśūlavajraiḥ | anyonyamutsādayituṃ pravṛttā gaṇeśvarā dānavapuṃgavāśca |28|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddha paṃcatriśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.136> sanatkumāra uvāca virocanastu daityedro virocana ivoditaḥ | viveśa pramathānīkaṃ meghānīkamivāṃśumān |1| mandarāgrapratīkāśamīṣādantaṃ kṣaranmadam | caturdantaṃ samāsthāya dantinaṃ dantabhūṣitam ||2|| sa nāgaskandhagastatra bhrājatesurapuṃgavaḥ | udayāgraṃ samāsthāya sahasrāṃśujvalanniva ||3|| tomaraiḥ saśaraiścāpi divākarakaraprabhaiḥ | pramathānapatastāra śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ||4|| vainateyo yathā nāgān siṃho govṛṣabhān yathā | drāvayāmāsa pramathān tathā śūro virocanaḥ ||5|| yāntamāyāntamaprāptaṃ prāptaṃ dūrasthameva ca | pramathaṃ paśyate yaṃ yaṃ taṃ taṃ dairayatesuraḥ ||6|| mṛgāḥ sihaṃ yathā dṛṣṭvā garuḍaśca yathoragāḥ | virocanaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā pramathā dudruvurbhayāt ||7|| gaṇeśvarabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇeśvaravaro drutam | vināyakaḥ sannivṛttaḥ pramathānīkanāyakaḥ ||8|| prasārayan karaṃ ghoraṃ pūrvamairāvato yathā | virocanaṃ sobhyadhāvacchārdūlo hariṇaṃ yathā ||9|| tamāpatantaṃ saṃvīkṣya tīkṣṇadantaṃ gajānanam | kumbhāntare tomareṇa dārayāmāsa dānavaḥ ||8.136.10|| taṃ tomaraṃ karāgreṇa niṣkṛṣya sa vināyakaḥ | hastā kṣiptena tenaiva virocanamadārayat ||11|| sa tomareṇa nibhinnaḥ karaghātāturaśca ha | cacāla vihvalo raktaṃ cakṣāra ca virocanaḥ ||12|| ghūrṇamānaṃ tadālakṣya dānavendraṃ virocanam | dantābhyāṃ candraśubhrābhyāṃ nirbibheda vināyakaḥ |13|| vaināyakaṃ tat samīkṣya karma devāḥ śaśakrā mumucuḥ praṇādān | tasyotamāṅgopari puṣpamālā papāta devasya yathā trimārgā ||14|| tayā tu nānāvidhapuṣpavatyā vibhāti devaḥ sa tadā srajā raṇe | nakṣatramālāvalicāruśobhaḥ samunnato merurivāparaḥ sthitaḥ ||15|| udbhinnaraktaṃ tu vidāryamāṇaṃ virocanaṃ vīkṣya vināyakena | jambhombudābhīturamārasitvā dudrāva mā bhairiti bhāṣamāṇaḥ ||16|| tamāpatantaṃ bahudhā nadantaṃ jambhaṃ viyanmeghamivāprameyam | rurodha nandī samatāḍayacca vajreṇa vajrī kupito yathādrim ||17|| sa vajraghātācchithilaḥ kriyāsu vyasuryathā dānavadevaputraḥ | papāta bhūmau muhurutthitaśca ghṛtāvasiktaḥ sadasīva vahniḥ ||18|| jambhevasanneribale prasanne ṣaḍ dānavāḥ ṣaṇmukhapūrvajaṃ tam | kuṭhāraśūlāsiparaśvadhaistu mlecchā yathā kruddhamukhāstatakṣuḥ |19|| vināyakastairavatakṣitastu prahlādidehāt pravikṛṣya dantau | mumoca taṃ vai rudhirāvasiktaṃ rāhurvivasvantamivārdhabhuktam ||8.136.20|| sa tena muktotirujāvṛtaśrīrvirocano nātibabhau manojñaḥ | meghābhiruddho navameghakāle saṃpūrṇabimbo nabhasīva candraḥ ||21|| vināyakābhānsa vināyakastu ṣaḍ dānavān ṣaṇmukhasannikāśaḥ | viśāladantāśanisaṃprahārairvyarthadrāvayat siṃha iva dvipendrān ||22|| karīndravaktraḥ karamucchrayitvā karī surāṇāmiva jātadarpaḥ | | prākālayad dānavapuṅgavām̐stān yathā gajān darpitasihapotaḥ |23| siṃhekṣitānāmiva gopatīnāṃ kālekṣitānāmiva mānavānām | vināyakenekṣita kālitānāṃ bhayaṃ tadāsīnmiṣatāṃ balānām |24|| yato yataḥ prekṣati vai sa devo hastīva hastaṃ svakamucchrayitvā || tatastato daityabalaṃ prabhagnaṃ caṇḍānileneva vanaṃ sapuṣpam |25|| dṛṣṭvā balaṃ tad balinābhibhūtaṃ baleḥ sutosau balināṃ variṣṭhaḥ | vināyakaṃ hantumanāḥ sasāra mattaṃ raṇe matta iva dvipendraḥ |26|| tamāpatantaṃ tapanābhiveśaṃ kruddhaṃ raṇe kālamivātavāpam | sasāra roddhuṃ samare ca yoddhuṃ kuṇḍodaraḥ siha ivānyasiṃham |27|| tau siṃhapotāviva jātadarpau prakīrṇahastāviva hastipotau | samāgatau yuddharasābhimattau kuṇḍodaro vai balinandanaśca |28|| śatāni paṃceva sa kārmukāṇāṃ vikṛṣya vajrāśaninisvanānām | kuṇḍodarāyeṣuvarān sasarga garjan sa bāṇastu yathā payodaḥ |29|| tānāgatāṃstīkṣṇamukhāṃstadānīṃ bāṇasya bāṇān kupitāhikalpān | kuṇḍodaraḥ śailaruheṇa sarvān manorathān vighna ivājaghāna |8.136.30|| tānniṣphalān prekṣya śarān surāriḥ suretarāriprahatān kṣitisthān | śaktyā sa kuṇḍodaramājaghāna śaktayā guhaḥ krauñcamivācalendram |31|| vakṣaḥ pradeśāttu gaṇeśvarasya bāṇasya śaktiḥ kṣatajaṃ papau sā | śakropanītaṃ ruciraṃ sugandhi yathāmṛtaṃ vajradharasya bhāryā |32|| śaktiprahārābhihatastu yakṣaḥ kuṇḍodarodardaramandarābhaḥ || papāta saṃjñāṃ vipulāṃ prahāya dāvāgninā dagdha ivoccavṛkṣaḥ ||33|| kuṇḍodaraṃ tannihataṃ samīkṣya vināyakosau cyutapadmamālaḥ | drudrāva bāṇaṃ prati hantukāmaḥ karīva bhṛṅgārakarocchrayeṇa ||34|| tamānane vajranibhānanaiḥ śarairvināyakaṃ hyātatameva bāṇaḥ | bibheda bhitvā ca tato rarāsa grīṣmavyapāye nabhasīva meghaḥ |||35|| tṛṇāgrapātāniva seṣupātānacintayitvaiva gajendravaktraḥ | īṣeṣa netraṃ savarūthacakraṃ babhañja bāṇasya rathaṃ sasūtam |36|| bāṇasya vāhān tu tamārujantaṃ vināyakaṃ bhūmigataṃ yathebham | siṃhīsutaḥ siṃha ivābhipatya sa bāhupāśena babandha rāhuḥ |37|| sa rāhuṇā bahuyugāvabaddho vināyakaḥ sarpasahasramālaḥ | praspadanta bhrāmitapuṣkarāgro gajastaran devanadīṃ yathaiva |38|| taṃ rāhubāhupratibaddhaceṣṭaṃ vināyakaṃ vīkṣya tadā divisthāḥ | devāḥ saśakrāḥ saha yakṣasiddhairhāheti hāhetyasakṛdvineduḥ ||39|| kuṇḍodaro yakṣavarastu sotha āṃśvasya sasyaṃ hi yathāmbusiktam | kuṭhāramādāya jaghāna rāhuṃ jatrvantare saṃhatamuṣṭinā ca ||8.136.40|| kuṭhāraghātāt sa tu muṣṭinā ca dṛḍhāhato yakṣavareṇa rāhuḥ | vināyakaṃ bhīmabalo mumoca śubhetaraṃ karma yathā kulīnaḥ |41|| taṃ vai parāvṛtya karīva matto gajānanaḥ kānanaṣaṇḍavāsī | padbhiśca dantaiśca jaghāna rāhuṃ prakīrṇahastena ca bhīmahstaḥ |42|| vināyakenābhihatastu rāhurdarpañca garvañca balañca hitvā | nistoyameghapratimomarāriḥ sthito yathā siṃhahato gajendraḥ |43|| rāhau tu kuṇḍodaramuṣṭighātairvināyakenaiva ca pīḍayamāne | kujambhasaṃhrādamayāḥ satārā huṇḍastuhuṇḍaśca tadā tamīyuḥ |44|| mayastu kuṇḍodaramājaghāna śūlena tāro muśalena kukṣau | balastu lambāmbudasannikāśaṃ taṃ muṣṭinā vajranibhena cāpi ||45|| hiraṇyanetrāvarajātmajaśca vināyakaṃ bhīmabalaṃ talena | tasyātmajaścāpi jaghāna roṣāt sa cāpi gatvā balavām̐stuhuṇḍaḥ |46|| vināyakastaṃ tu tadā gṛhītvā kareṇa vikramya tuhuṇḍamājau | āākṣipya cotkṣipya ca bhīmavegaścikṣepa dūraṃ yamadūtakalpam |47| | prahrādamāhatya tataḥ sa devo mayaśca mattāñjanatulyavakṣāḥ | utpāṭya taṃ ghoraravaṃ nanāda śubhrāmbupūrṇo nabhasīva meghaḥ ||48|| kuṇḍodaraścāpi balaṃ satāraṃ kujambhamāhatya ca yakṣavaryaḥ | ubhau raṇasthau gajayūthapālau vyādhūtamālau bhṛśajātakopau ||49|| sasarjatustau śaravṛṣṭimugrāṃ yathāmbuvṛṣṭiṃ jaladau sanādau | tataḥ punaścāyudhasarjagani payodavisphūjitagajitāni || balāni tānyāsurapārṣadānāṃ saṃsaktabhāvaṃ paramaṃ gatāni |8.136.50|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.137> sanatkumāra uvāca tato vyatikaro bhūyaḥ pārṣadāsurasainyayoḥ | saṃbabhūvodadhikṣobhānmakarāṇāmivādbhutaḥ ||1|| paṭṭiśāsidhanuṣmanto vidyutvanta ivāmbudāḥ | vibabhurdānavāstatra pramathāśca yuyutsavaḥ ||2|| sahasva praharasveti naśya naṣṭastvamityapi | teṣāmevaṃ pravadatāmaśrūyanta giro muhuḥ ||3|| śūlaistriśūlaiścakraiśca huṇḍairlaguḍakampanaiḥ | bhindipālaiḥ karasamaiḥ prasṛtairnikharairapi ||4|| ṭaṃkaiḥ kaṭaṃkaṭaiḥ prāsaiḥ pāśaiḥ paraśupaṭṭiśaiḥ | drumopalaśilāghātairgirīṇāṃ śikharairapi ||5|| etaiḥ praharaṇaiste vai sūdayanti parasparam | ghaṇṭākarṇohamasura jambhohaṃ pramatheśvara ||6| somanandyahamindrāre kujambhohaṃ gaṇādhipa | bilvakohamahaṃ yakṣa piṅgalo nāma dānava |7|| prahrādohamahaṃ nandī śaṃkukarṇo balo hyaham | tvaṃ kaḥ kuṇḍodarohaṃ vai vṛtrohaṃ kuṇḍakodara ||8|| nandiṣeṇosmyahaṃ śaṃbhurmahākāla mayo hyaham | viśākhohaṃ balirahamahaṃ bāṇo guho hyaham |9|| prahrādohamahaṃ śākho naigameṣohamandhakaḥ | ityevaṃ dānavānāṃ ca pramathānāṃ ca bhairavāḥ | 8.137.10 || darpodrekādadhikṣepāḥ śrūyante yudhyatāṃ raṇe | gajānāmiva mattānāṃ meghānāmiva cāgame |11| bhidyatāmiva śailānāṃ samudrāṇāṃ kṣayeṣviva | pralayānteṣu mahatāṃ vāyūnāṃ javatāmiva ||12|| teṣāmāsīnmahāñchabdaḥ parasparanijaghnuṣām || brahmadaṇḍapratīkāśairyamadaṇḍanibhairapi | āāyudhaissūdayanti sma tenyonyakupitā bhṛśam ||13|| vajrāṇāmiva śaileṣu vaṃśānāmiva dahyatām | abhūccaṭacaṭāśabdaḥ śastrāṇāṃ pātyatāṃ tadā ||14|| gaṇeśvaravimuktābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sudṛḍhāhatāḥ | nipeturārasantaste solkā iva yathā ghanāḥ ||15|| drumaprahārabhagnāṅgā gadācūṇitasandhayaḥ | dānavā nipatantyurvyāṃ vājinaścyutajīvitāḥ ||16|| chinnadhvajapatākeṣā bhagnākṣayugakūbarāḥ | vidhvastāstatra dṛśyante vimānapratimā rathāḥ ||17|| mātaṅgaiśca turaṅgaiśca syandanaiścāvacūrṇitaiḥ | vindhyākrānteva sā bhūmirdurgamā samapadyata ||18|| tatra devāḥ sa gandharvāḥ sayakṣoragakinnarāḥ | utkruṣṭavaraśabdāḍhayaṃ cakruḥ subahuśombaram ||19|| divyānāṃ suvicitrāṇāmamṛtopamagandhinām | varṣaṃ papāta puṣpāṇāṃ yudhyante yatra te raṇe ||8.137.20|| tathā tu te gajaghananādagarjanāḥ śarāsiśaktyṛṣṭi gadāvisarjanāḥ | parasparaṃ yuyudhuratīva saṃhatā diteḥ sutāḥ pramathagaṇāśca darpitāḥ ||21|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddha saptatriṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.138> sanatkumāra uvāca tāmyamāneṣu daityeṣu daityayūthapayūthapāḥ | cakrurvegaṃ mahāvegā yugānteṣviva sāgarāḥ ||1|| prahrādaścānuhrādaśca saṃhrādaḥ śinibāṣkalau | prahlādasya ca ye putrāścatvāro bhīmavikramāḥ ||2|| balirbāṇaśca vātaśca śambhuḥ kārtasvanaḥ kubhaḥ | karabho namucistārastārakaścendratāpanaḥ ||3|| añjano rūṣaṇo vyaṃso gaviṣṭhaḥ pṛthivīñjayaḥ || ilvakaḥ pilvakaścaiva dhundhurmūkaśca dānavaḥ ||4|| kharo murotha narakaḥ keśī dhenuka eva ca | lambaḥ pralambo hyajaro bhāvayavyomamārdavāḥ ||5|| vṛṣaparvā śatāvatoṃ gavākṣo gomukhastathā | saro nisundaḥ sundaśca mahābalaparākramāḥ ||6|| pāko vipākaḥ santāpo hastī duryodhanastathā | mohano mathanaścāpi sacakraścakra eva ca ||7|| kālakāvadanaḥ kālaḥ kālanemī kalidrumaḥ || hyaśīrṣaścendraśirāstriśirāḥ śaṃkureva ca ||8|| tathā gaganamūrdhā ca aviromā mahāmanaḥ | asilomā tuhuṇḍaśca huṇḍo vṛtraśca dānavaḥ ||9|| daśagrīvaśca bāliśca meghanīlaḥ prabhākaraḥ | yaścādityarathāccakraṃ jahāra baladarpitaḥ ||8.138.10|| sa vipracittiḥ sabalaḥ sanyavartata daṃśitaḥ(?) | ete cānye ca ditijāḥ samadāste gajā iva ||11|| cakrurutsāhamutsartuṃ pramathya pramathān raṇe | āāmiṣārthe yathā siṃhā vāsitārthe yathā gajāḥ ||12|| dānavā viviśustadvat pramathān saṃjighāṃsavaḥ | teṣāmāpatato vego bhīmobhūddevavidviṣām | sanakramakaro ghoro vegaḥ sindhupateriva ||13|| te vai śastropalaśilāpādapāśanipāṇayaḥ | pramathairuddhatai ruddhā nadīvegā ivārṇavaiḥ | 14 || gaṇeśvarādhipo nandī mahākāyaśca vīryavān | ghaṇṭākarṇaḥ śaṃkukarṇaḥ kuṇḍodaramahodarau |15|| nandiṣeṇaḥ somanandī karikaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ | vighno vināyakaścaiva sa ca sarvavināyakaḥ | |||16 || piṅgalo lohitaścaiva mayūraḥ kukkuṭopi ca || pañcākṣo vīrabhadraśca viṭpatiḥ pāvakārdanaḥ ||17|| adityāpyāyanaścaiva somāpyāyana eva ca | samudrāpyāyaścānyaḥ pāvakāpyāyanastathā ||18|| varabarhidhvajaścaiva viśākhaḥ śākha eva ca | naigameṣaśca balavān rudravīryaparākramāḥ ||19|| bāhuleyodbhavā ye ca pramathā bhīmarūpiṇaḥ | tebhyayurdānavān yuddhe vṛṣabhā vṛṣabhāniva ||8.138.20|| teṣāṃ teṣāṃñca saṃgrāmastumulaḥ samapadyata | ajane gandhahastīnāṃ (?) śarabhairiva dāruṇaḥ ||21|| mahāgajairiva gajāḥ parvatairiva parvatāḥ | sāgarāḥ sāgarairyadvat pāvakairiva pāvakāḥ ||22|| tathā surā jātadarpāḥ krodhavaiśvānarāvṛtāḥ | dhṛtāḥ pāriṣadaiḥ śūrairvighnā dharmaparairiva ||23|| ṭaṅkairvidāryamāṇāni giryagrāṇi samantataḥ | gṛdhracakrāyamāṇāni patantyurvyāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||24|| cakrāṇi cakrai cchidyante śūlaiḥ śūlā vidāritāḥ || iṣubhiśceṣavo viddhāḥ patanti bhujagā iva || 25 || vadanaiścandrapadmābhaiḥ karaiśca parighopamaiḥ | āāstṛtā medinī bhāti vyāghacarmāmbarairiva ||26|| medo majjāsthipaṅkāṅkaṃ keśakaśmalasaṃkulam | babhūvāyodhanaṃ ghoraṃ śmaśānavanasannibham ||27|| hayā gajā rathāścāpi dānavānāṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ | saṃcūrṇitāḥ pradṛśyante tatra tatra mahītale |28|| parīkṣaṇīyassamitau tvamadya suretarāṇāṃ surarājaśatro ||29|| nandinyathaivaṃ bruvatīndrakalpe śakrenduvāyu pratitulyavīryaḥ | | baddhvā triśākhāṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ lalāṭe sa nandinaṃ prāha tadā kujambhaḥ ||8.138.30|| vānarānana kiṃ vāgbhirmāṃ bhīṣayitumicchasi | hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pautro nāhaṃ prākṛtadānavaḥ ||31|| yamātsadaṇḍādvaruṇā tsapāśādindrātsavajrātsagadāddhaneśāt | nāhaṃ raṇastho bhayamāharāmi bhayanna daityeṣu palāyitaṃ vā ||23|| adyeha te piṅgalalolanetraṃ mukhaṃ tvapātraṃ vikṛtā manojñam | madbāṇalūnaṃ patatāmavanyāṃ tālādyathā tālaphalaṃ supakvam ||33|| ityevamuktvā śarajālavṛṣṭayā nandīśvaraṃ dānavarājameghaḥ | siṃho yathātīva vimucya nādaṃ prācchādayan megha ivācalendram |34|| taruṃ yathā pakvaphalaṃ śakuntā valmīkamuccaṃ bhujagā ivogrāḥ | tathā śarā dānavarājamuktā nandīśvaraṃ dīptamukhā viśanti ||35|| vajreṇa vajrī sa tu tāñcharaughān śailaḥ payodhāniva sannivārya | kujambhamuddiśya mumoca vajraṃ nanāda coccernabhasīva meghaḥ ||36|| tadvisphuliṅgodgataghorarūpaṃ samāhatārāvavimuktarāvam | vajraṃ pradhāvatyasuraṃ nihantuṃ giriṃ yathā devatarājavajram |37|| tadvatsadantaiḥ suvipāṭavastaiḥ samīpagairdigdhavikarṇṇibhiśca | jaghāna vajraṃ śatadhā kujambhaḥ saṃvarttakāgniṃ samayeva meghaḥ ||38|| tadvāṇavegaprahatātivegaṃ śailādinirmuktamamoghavegam | vajraṃ kujambhābhihataṃ nivṛttaṃ dattaṃ yathonmādavikāradattam |39|| viṣṭambhitaṃ vajravaraṃ niśāmya niśāmya nādaśca kujambhamuktam | sasāra nandī kupito ripuṃ taṃ rāhuryathā ve khatale tamonghram |8.138.40|| balātsa saṃgṛhya rathaṃ kareṇa īṣāvarāgre pramatheśapālaḥ | ākṣipya cikṣepa sasūtavāhaṃ kṣiptvā ca bhūyassa rarāsa ghoram |41|| saṃbhrāntavakraḥ savisandhitāśvaḥ prabhraṣṭasūtāsiśirogranemiḥ || kujambhavāhaḥ khatalāt papāta giriryathā vajranikṛttapakṣaḥ |42|| tasmādrathānnandigajapranunnādapetya prahrādiradīnasatvaḥ | śaktiṃ samādāya na dīnasatvastasthau savidyutsaravo yathābdaḥ |43|| tāṃ sarpajihvāmiva lelihāno mṛtyuṃ kṣudhārtāmiva bhoktukāmām | śikhāṃ mahāgneriva dīpyamānāṃ sa nandine saṃ pramumoca jambhaḥ ||44|| sā śaktirindrāribhujapramuktā ugrātidīptāṅgirasīva kṛtyā | abhyāhatā nandimukhānalena dagdhā pataṅgīva yathānalena |45|| śaktiṃ sa dagdhvā vadanānalena kapīndravaktrastapanaprabhāvaḥ | vajreṇa taṃ satvaramājaghāna vajreṇa meruṃ bhagavānivendraḥ |46|| sa vajraghātādavacūrṇitasthiḥ saṃśīrṇadantekṣaṇabhagnajānuḥ | kubjaḥ kujambho nipapāta bhūmau śakreṇa vajrābhihato yathādriḥ |47|| tasmin hate devagaṇā vineduḥ seduḥ surāṇāmarayaśca dainyāt| bhūtādhipaṃ bhūtapatiśca devaṃ prapūjayāmāsa śāśāṅkacihnam |48 || iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddha jammavadhe aṣṭatriśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.139> sanatkumāra uvāca kujambhaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā nandinā devanandinā | ninādaṃ cakrire devāścāraṇāśca mahoragāḥ ||1|| tena devaninādena kujambhanidhanena ca | jambho dānavaśārdūlaḥ krodhamāhārayanmahat ||2|| tasya kruddhasya gātrebhyo niṣpetuḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ | merorvajrāhatasyeva visphuliṅgāḥ samantataḥ ||3|| solkāmbudanibhābhāso jambhaḥ krodhasamāvṛtaḥ | drudrāva nandinaṃ hantuṃ kuñjaraṃ siṃharāḍiva ||4|| sordhabhārasahasrasya kṛtaṃ saikyāyasaṃ mahat | udvahan parighaṃ ghoraṃ daityo dudrāva nandinam ||5|| tiṣṭhedānīṃ durācāra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kva yāsyasi | eṣa tvaṃ vajrasaṃkāśaḥ parighaścūrṇayiṣyati ||6|| ityuktvā ghorayā vācā jaṃbho nandinamagrataḥ | parighaṃ tasya cikṣepa daṇḍaṃ yama ivāparaḥ |7|| sa tasya karanirmukto nirmuktoragasannibhaḥ | parigho nandinaṃ yāti hantuṃ kālānalopamaḥ || 8 || taṃ vāsukibhujaṅgābhaṃ brahmadaṇḍanibhaṃ mahat | vajreṇābhyahnannandī devarājo yathā balam ||9|| vajraprahāraṃ tṛṇavadvicintya parighaḥ sa tu | śakrāgniriva durdṛśyaḥ pradhāvannandinaṃ prati ||8.139.10|| kṛto ninādaḥ sumahān pramatheśca sahasraśaḥ | śrutvā ninādaṃ devānāṃ parighaṃ vīkṣya cāgatam ||11|| śaṃkukarṇobhidudrāva parighaṃ prati vegitaḥ | sa taṃ karkoṭakaprakhyaṃ durnivāryaṃ mahāstravat |12|| śaṃkukarṇena parighaṃ gṛhṇītaṃ vīkṣya tadbalāt ||13|| vinedurmuditā devāḥ śaṃkukarṇaśca tuṣṭuvuḥ | śaṃkukarṇopi parighaṃ gṛhītvā balavān punaḥ ||14|| rarāsa jambhamuddiśya sasāra ca raṇapriyaḥ || tato dānavaśārdūlaḥ sasāra raṇalālasaḥ ||15|| tato gaṇeśvarabale dānavānāṃ bale tathā || jajñe vāditraninadaḥ siṃhnādavimiśritaḥ ||16|| atha gaganatale babhūva śabdaḥ kṣubhitasamudrapayodanādakalpaḥ | danutanayagaṇādhipeśayuddhaṃ tadupaniśāmya divaukasāṃ tadānīm |17|| pramathagaṇavarāssanāgarudrā hyasuravarāśca sahāndhakā raṇasthāḥ | vyuparatakalahāstadāvatasthurgaṇapatidānavayuddhamīkṣamāṇāḥ | 18 || iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddha ūnacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.140> sanatkumāra uvāca śaṃkukarṇa tu dhāvantaṃ jambhaṃ prati
