mahābalaḥ | vṛtrobhyadhāvattaṃ hantuṃ paṃcānana iva dvipam ||1|| utsṛjya śaṃkukarṇopi jambhaṃ gaṇapapuṃgavaḥ | vṛtramevābhidudrāva vighāto vai damaṃ yathā ||2|| parigheṇāhanaccainaṃ śaṃkukarṇo gaṇeśvaraḥ| mahāgiriṃ yathā śakro vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||3|| vṛtropi cātha daityendraḥ parigheṇāyasena vai | brabhrāma tāḍitotyartham̐ vāyununna iva drumaḥ ||4|| sa tena suprahāreṇa rudhirasrāvacitritaḥ | svarṇadhāturasodgārī nīlācala ivābabhau ||5|| vṛtre ghūrṇati daityendra parighābhihate bhṛśam | vinedurdevagandharvāḥ pūjayanto gaṇeśvaram ||6|| tataścirāt samāśvasya vṛtro dānavapuṅgavaḥ | gireḥ śrṛṅgaṃ samutpāṭaya śaṅakukarṇamadhāvata | sa tasya tatsavṛkṣarkṣaṃ sadhātūpalapannagam | gaṇeśvarāyācalāgraṃ cikṣepa ca rarāsa ca || 8 || tadvṛtrabhujanirmuktaṃ giryagraśikharaṃ mahat | bibheda nandī vajreṇa keśarīva mataṅgajam ||9|| atha tau gaṇadaityendrau bhujairbhujagakopanau | sametau ghorasaṃhrādau niyuddhakuśalāvubhau ||8.140.10|| niṣṭanantāvivādityau dīpyamānāvivānalau || garjamānāviva ghanau bṛhantāviva kuñjarau ||11|| mattāviva ca śārdūlau niḥśvasantāvivoragau | nardamānau yathā siṃhau valgamānau vṛṣāviva ||12|| calantāviva śailendrau ghūrṇamānāvivārṇavau | pūrayantau yathā meghau spardhantau makarāviva ||13|| ityevaṃ śaṃkukarṇaśca vṛtraścāsurapuṃgavaḥ | prayuddhau yuddhakuśalau parasparajighāṃsayā |14|| muṣṭibhirvajrakalpaiśva talaiścāśanisannibhaiḥ | pādaprahārairghoraiśca ūrdhvamutkṣepaṇaistathā ||15|| ākṣepairatha vikṣepaiḥ karṣaṇairapakarṣaṇaiḥ | pauruṣākhyāpanairugrairnāmasaṃśrāvaṇairapi ||16|| karajāgrapratudanairgalagrahaṇanigrahaiḥ | siṃhanādaiḥ savāditrairvṛkṣaśailaśilopalaiḥ | | 17| | śaṃkukarṇo gaṇādhyakṣaḥ sa ca vṛtro danossutaḥ | jaghnatustāvathānyonyamanyonyasyāntaraiṣiṇau | | 1 8|| śaṃkukarṇena vṛtrastu dṛḍhamūla iva drumaḥ | hastāvabandhanotkṣiptaḥ sahasā pātitaḥ kṣitau | | 1 9| | tatogaṇeśvarabale dānavānāṃ tathā bale | sādhuśabdo babhūvoccairvṛtre tu vinipātite | | 8.140.20 | | muṣṭinā tamathāhatya vṛtraṃ bhuvi nipātya ca | śaṃkukarṇo hyapakrānto dehājjīva ivāśugaḥ | | 21 | | vṛtrastu sumahāvīryo muṣṭitāḍanavihvalaḥ | indraketurivottasthau dudrāva ca gaṇeśvaram || 22 | tamāpatantaṃ vṛkṣeṇa śaṃkukarṇo gaṇeśvaraḥ | śālena tāḍayāmāsa ita ehīti cābravīt ||2 3 || kruddhena śaṃkukarṇena vṛtro vai śālatāḍitaḥ | upetya pāde jagrāha śaṃkukurṇaṃ balī balāt | | 24| | śaṃkukarṇaṃ gṛhītvā tu vṛtro nāga ivāṇḍajam | bhrāmayāmāsa vivaśaṃ lokaṃ moha ivodyataḥ || 25| | śaṃkukarṇasya vṛtreṇa bhrāmyamāṇasya sarvaśaḥ | śarīrātsamadīryanta bhūṣaṇāni sahasraśaḥ | | 26 | | taṃ bhrāmyamāṇaṃ prasamīkṣya devā vṛtreṇa sarve ca tadā gaṇeśāḥ | hāheti kṛtvā dhṛtaśastrabāṇāḥ pradudruvustasya vimokṣaṇārtham ||27|| āgacchātastān prasamīkṣya vṛtraḥ sarvān gaṇeśān śitaśastrahastān | mumoca taṃ saṃsadiśaṃkukarṇaṃ nāgaṃ garutmāniva pakṣirājaḥ ||28|| vṛtramuktastu gaṇapaḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ | yoddhukāmaḥ punarvṛtraṃ nivṛtto hastirāḍiva | |2 9| | tataḥ punaḥ siṃharavāḥ samantāt tasminbale dundubhinisvanāśca | he śaṃkukarṇeti ca sādhuvādo manoharastasya raṇe babhūva | | 8.140.30 | | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe catvāriṃśottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.141> sanatkumāra uvāca śaṃkukarṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā vṛtrastyaktvā ca bhūtale | mamarda pramathānīkaṃ vanaṃ matto yathā gajaḥ ||1 || sa nandinaṃ nandiṣeṇaṃ somanandinameva ca | āhatya drāvayitvā ca nanarda jalado yathā ||2|| tasyātha nardamānasya viṭpatī rudrasattamaḥ | mumoca vajrāgnisamaṃ ripukṣayakaraṃ śaram ||3|| sa viṭpativinirmuktaḥ śaro ravikaraprabhaḥ | viveśa vṛtraṃ nirdārya siddhombudamivāmbare ||4| | ucchritya svakaraṃ sotha karaṃ hastīva dānavaḥ | viṭpatiṃ dudruve saṃkhye payodamiva mārutaḥ ||5| | taṃ śūlena mahākāyo nandī vajreṇa dānavam | somanandī kuṭhāreṇa nandiṣeṇastalena ca ||6 || bāṇānāñca sahasreṇa viṭpatirvṛtramāhave | bibheda paramakruddhaḥ punaścānyaistrisaptabhiḥ ||7|| sordito gaṇayūtheśairdānavaḥ parvatopamaḥ | pātyamāno rarāsoccaissadaivata iva drumaḥ ||8|| athamayabalamūkatārajambhā namucigaṇelvalabāṇabāṇaputrāḥ | vividhaśaravarāyudhāvatasthurgaṇapativīratamaṃ nivārayantaḥ | |9|| rucirakanakacāruhāraśobhāścalavalāyābharaṇā mahendrakalpāḥ | ditivaratanayātihṛṣṭarūpāḥ pramathabaleṣu caranti kālarūpāḥ || 8.141.10 || muśalahalaśarāvadāritāsyā giriśikharāśanivajracūrṇitāṅgāḥ| .....................| | giraya iva ca vajratāḍitā gaṇapatayaḥ kṣitimāpurāturāḥ || 11|| vraṇajapṛṣatavipruṣokṣitāścyutasitahāravibhūṣaṇasrajaḥ | bhayacakitamukhāḥ pradudruvuste pramathagaṇā ripubhirbhṛśārditāḥ ||1 2| | divi sitavirajā yathocchritā navajaladā navatoyavṛṣṭayaḥ | visasṛjururuvegadāruṇā dititanayāḥ śaravṛṣṭimardanīm | | 13 | | atha karigirimeghasannibhā jvalanadivākaratulyatejasaḥ | vimalaśitavisṛṣṭabāṇajālāḥ pramathagaṇān praharanti daityamukhyāḥ | |14| | atha parighaśarāsipadṛśaiḥ karavarayantraśatapraniḥsṛtaiḥ | tridaśaripubhayapradā raṇe samaramupetya vicakramurgaṇāḥ | | 1 5| | giriśikharanibhāśca dantivaryā drutagamanā bahavaśca vājimukhyāḥ | surasadananibhā rathāśca bhīmāḥ samaramukhe nipatanti bhagnadagdhāḥ ||1 6| | iṣuvadanadṛḍhāvatakṣitā vraṇajasamukṣitasūkṣmavāsasaḥ | prasṛtanayanasatvajīvitā danutanayāḥ śataśovapothitāḥ | |17 | | cyutasitavarahārakuṇḍalairmukuṭakirīṭamaṇisragambaraiḥ | samaramukhamahī virājate ruciravarābharaṇairivorvaśī | | 1 8|| kṣubhita iva yathā mahārṇavo jalasamaye ca yathā nabho mahat | asuragaṇabalaṃ tathābhavat prajavitavāraṇavājidānavam || 19 || yamavaruṇadhaneśavāsavā bhagavasusūryaśaśāṅkamārutāḥ | hṛṣitanayanavaktrapaṅkajā rurudhuḥ ramitragaṇārdanoddhatāḥ | |8.141.2 0 | | pravicaritagajendratoyadaṃ turagavidhāvitavāyusañcaram | aśaniśaraśatahradāvilaṃ na tu virarāma raṇāntadurdinam | |2 1|| kamaladalanikāśalocanaiḥ kamaladivākaracandrasannibhaiḥ | danutanayavarānanairmahī prativibabhau kamalairivāvṛtā | |22 | | vimathitagaṇadānaveśvaraṃ rudhiravapāmadasekarūṣitam | samaramatisuraudradāruṇaṃ garuḍapiśācabalāvalokitam | | 23 | | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe ekacatvāśiṃdutaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.142> sanatkumāra uvāca tasmin vartati saṃgrāme pramathāsurasainyayoḥ | dhanuṣāṃ śrūyate śabdaḥ prāvṛḍambudharopamaḥ | | 1 | | garjatāñca gajendrāṇāṃ hreṣatāñcaiva vājinām | yuddhagāndharvaraktānāṃ nādāścāmararakṣasām | | 2 | | śrotrāyāsakarā ghorā vajrāśaniravā iva | śrūṣante hi vivardhante hyarthā hyādharmaṇāmiva(?) ||3|| tataḥ kārtasvano nāma dānavo meghanisvanaḥ | jaghāna pramathān yuddhe kālo martyānivāgataḥ | |4| | sa rathī kārmukī bāṇī kavacī kuṇḍalī tathā | pramathānīkamadahacchuṣkaṃ tṛṇamivānalaḥ | | 5 | | kārtasvanadhanurmuktāḥ kārtasvaramahāśarāḥ | pramathāndārya nissaṅgaṃ dārayanti raṇāvanim | |6 | | śalabhā iva kedārānanayā iva mānavān | khagā iva tarūn pakvāna garuḍaḥ pannagāniva | |7| | tathā te pṛthavo bāṇāḥ kārtasvanadhanuścyutāḥ | pramathān vyākulīcakrurvāsavṛkṣānivāṇḍajāḥ | |8| | ..........................|| śaravrātā gaṇānīke nipatanti girāviva ||9 | | praśāntavādyaninadaṃ śaraghātātivejitam | gaṇeśvarabalaṃ jajñe bandhujīvavanaṃ yathā | | 8.142.10 | | ghanāniva yathā vāyurvainateya ivoragān | pṛṣatāniva śārdūlastamaughāniva bhāskaraḥ | | 11 | | tathā kārtasvanaḥ kruddhaḥ śaravajraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ | nirdadāha gaṇādhyakṣān lokān saṃvartako yathā | | 12 || gaṇeśvarabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dagdhaṃ jagdhaṃ rujāturama | viṭpatiḥ kupito devaḥ kārtasvanamathābravīt | | 13 | | śarapātetha saṃsthityā rudro rudraparākramaḥ | dānavendraṃ prakupito niṣaṅgāduddharañcharam | | 14|| kārtasvana balaṃ vīryaṃ pratāpaśca tavottamaḥ | kimetānabalān haṃsi dānavendra gaṇeśvarān | | 1 5| | āgaccha yadi te śaktiryadi vā vidyate balam | mayā kuruṣva saṃmardaṃ mānadaṃ(ḥ?) paśya me balam | | 16 | | kuṇḍalālaṃkṛtaṃ tedya daṃṣṭrāṃkuravibhūṣaṇam | pātayāmi śiro daitya tālād vātaḥ phalaṃ yathā | | 17| | yadyapi tvādya rakṣanti dānavāḥ sāndhakā raṇe | tathāpi te hariṣyāmi prāṇānasurapāṃsana | | 18 | | ityevaṃ nardamānasya viṭpaterdānavo nadan | sasarja bāṇaṃ muktvā(?) ca jagarja jalado yathā || 1 9| | jvalamānaḥ sa tu śaro ghṛtasikta ivānalaḥ | gharmārkasadṛśo bhāsā prādhāvad viṭpatiṃ prati || 8.142.20 || niṣprabhorkobhavattatra tasya bhāsā patatriṇaḥ | kārtasvananinādena patanti vihagāḥ kṣitau ||21 | | sopi bhāsāyuto vāṇaḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ | viṭpateḥ kaṃkaṇe magno niraye duṣkṛtī yathā | |22 || tatastameva niṣkṛṣya dānavaprahitaṃ śaram | kārtasvanāya cikṣepa viṭapatirvinanāda ca || 23 | | sa viṭpativinirmuktaḥ śaro dānavanāśakṛt | dānavasya śiro yanturjahāreṣupathān daśa | |24| | hate yantari tasyāśvāścapalāḥ śabalāḥ raṇe | udbhrāntā rathamādāya śyenā iva yathāmiṣam ||25| | kārtasvanarathaṃ yāta kimāsata nigṛhṇata | ityevaṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ babhūva ninado mahān | |26 | | vistīrṇe mandaraprasthe bhraman bhāti rathottamaḥ | sāditya iva saptāśvo merau rathavaro bhraman | |27|| avaplutya tatastasmād drutāśvād rathasattamāt| kārtasvano dhanuṣpāṇirabhidudrāva viṭpatim || 28| | balayostu tato nādaḥ sādhusādhviti saṃbabhau | kārtasvane yoddhu kāme bhūyo viṭpatinā saha || 29|| sa viṭpatiṃ vajranibhairbahubhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | dānavovākiranmegho yathā dhārotkarairgirim | | 8.142.30 | | sa kārtasvanabāṇaughairghanaughairiva sāgaraḥ | viṭpatiḥ pūryamāṇopi vyathāṃ naiva tadāgamat ||3 1 | | ākarṇāt kārmukaṃ sotha vikṛṣya balavān balāt | ciccheda daityendraśarān dvidhaikaikaṃ tridhā tathā | |3 2 || tāniṣūn śātayitvā tu patribhiḥ prāṇabhojanaiḥ | kārtasvanaṃ sahasreṇa bibheda ca nanāda ca | |3 3 || pṛṣṭhato dṛśyamānāsyaiḥ śaraistairdānavo babhau | yathācalo nāgavarairvivarārdhavinirgataiḥ || |34|| athāsya kārmukaṃ khaḍgaṃ śarāvāpañca pañcakama | ciccheda rudraḥ saṃkruddha staṃ ca sobhyardayadbalī ||35|| atha bāṇamindrakuliśena samaṃ kupitaṃ śvasantamiva nāgapatim | visasarja viṭpatirudārabaloditinandanārdanamajihmagatim ||36|| śararāṭ sa rudravarasaṃprahitaḥ samarāṅgaṇe visṛtadhūmalavaḥ | asurānanaṃ yudhi jahāra balāt kamalaṃ yathā munirudāramatiḥ ||37|| atha daivatairmunivaraiśca kṛtaḥ pramathaiśca bhīmaninadairninadaḥ | tadarermukhaṃ hṛtamudīkṣya tadā vaḍavāmukhāgnidamanena raṇe ||38|| sa tu viṭpatiḥ pramathasainyapanistvabhisṛtya bhūtapatinā suciram | abhipūjitaḥ samarakarmapaṭustridaśārisiṃhadamano damanaḥ ||39|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.143> sanatkumāra uvāca kārtasvanamariṃ hatvā kārtasvaramaheṣuṇā | dadāha viṭpatirdaityānanalaḥ śalabhāniva | |1 | | sa vyāyata dhanurdevaścārukāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ | jagarjeṣūndānaveṣu sṛjan sūryaḥ karāniva | | 2 | | te kāñcanamayaiḥ pukhaigaruḍāṅgaruhacchadaiḥ | daivasṛṣṭā ivānarthā dānaveṣvapatañcharāḥ | | 3 || chinnānanā śchinnakarāśchinnapādodaroravaḥ | dānavāḥ śataśaḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣitidharā yathā | |4|| pṛṣṭheṣvabhihatāḥ kecit kecit pārśveṣu dāritāḥ | nayaneṣvapare viddhā bhramantyandhā ivāpare ||5 | | mṛgāniva ca śārdūlo garuḍaḥ pannagāniva | kṛtaghnaḥ sukṛtānīva tamāṃsīva divākaraḥ ||6 | | tathā tānasurāndevo viṭpatiḥ pāvakārdanaḥ | anāśayata tīkṣṇāgraiḥ śarairvajrānalānanaiḥ ||7 | | virathāḥ pātitagajāḥ śarāturaturaṅgamāḥ | dhāvante dānavāstrastā viṭpateḥ śaravejitāḥ | |8 || atha dṛṣṭvāsurabalaṃ muktaśastrayaśombaram | bhagnaṃ viṭpatinā yuddhe gajeneva yathā vanam | |9| | ye ye balotkaṭāstatra prakhyātāśca suretarāḥ | abhidrutā viṭpatinā siṃhenevetare mṛgāḥ || 8.143.10 || prahrādaścānuhrādaśca saṃhrādaḥ śinibāṣkalau | jambho virocano bāṇo baliścaiva sa dānavaḥ ||1 1 | | ajako namucirvyaṃsaḥ ilvako vilvakastathā | vipracittistuhuṇḍaśca huṇḍo vakraśca dānavaḥ || 12 | | mayastārastārakākṣo vidyunmālī prabhañjanaḥ | ariṣṭaścaiva riṣṭaśca añjano rūśabhaḥ kubhaḥ ||1 3 | | kālaśca kālanemiśca kālakāvadanastathā | saṃpātirilvalaścāpi balo naraka eva ca | | 14 | madhukaiṭabhayoḥ putrau dhundhurmūkaśca dānavaḥ | hastirvipāka pākaśca vikarṇaḥ śambhureva ca | | 15 | | udyatairbahubhiḥ śastrairulkāpātasamaprabhaiḥ | viṭpatiṃ dudruvuḥ kruddhāḥ siṃhā iva vineduṣaḥ | | 16 | | te taṃ śūlopalai rhuṇḍaiḥ sāyakaiścāśanisvanaiḥ | nijadhnurbhīmaninadāḥ payodā iva parvatam ||| 17| | toyavṛṣṭiṃ yathā meghā visṛjantyanileritāḥ | sasṛjurdānavā deve śaravṛṣṭiṃ tathaiva te | | 18 | | tāṃ śastravṛṣṭimāmitrīmamitragaṇamardanaḥ | acchinadviṭpatistūrṇa saṃprītiṃ kalaho yathā | | 1 9| | tataste danudaiteyā viyatsthā viṭapatiṃ prati | nardamānā ivāmbhodā girivarṣaṃ sṛjantyuta | |8.143.2 0 | | anye ca mandarāgrasthā mandārasragivāsthitāḥ | mumucuḥ sālasaralān devadārūm̐śca viṭpatau | |2 1 || sombarasthaiḥkṣitisthaiśca dānavairdaḍhamarditaḥ | viṭpatirvimukho jajñe toyasikta ivānalaḥ | | 22 | | viṭpatiṃ vimukhaṃ dṛṣṭavā dānavaiḥ parvataiścitam | namarṣeyu bhīmabalāḥ prakhyātā ye gaṇeśvarāḥ | |2 3 | | somanandī ca nandī ca nandiṣeṇaśca pārṣadaḥ | prabhāmayo vīrabhadraḥ sūryāpyāyana eva ca | |24|| pañcākṣaḥ kopapālaśca trinetraḥ piṅgalekṣaṇaḥ | rākṣasaḥ piṅgalaścaiva śmaśānaninalayonnadaḥ || 25|| ghaṇṭākarṇaḥ śaṃkukarṇaḥ sa ca kuṇḍodaro balī | airāvatamukhaścaiva annapālaḥ kapāladhṛk | pralambapīvarakaraḥ svayameva vināyakaḥ || 26| | ete cānye ca gaṇapāḥ śataśaḥ śabditā gaṇaiḥ | viviśurdānavāndagdhuṃ drumāñchuṣkānivānalāḥ || 27|| te viṭpatiṃ saṃparivārya sarve gajendrapotā iva garjamānāḥ | triśūlacakreṣubhuśuṇḍihastā gaṇeśvarā yuddhadhiyaḥ pratīyuḥ ||28|| teṣāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca tato babhūva saṃsaktayuddhaṃ samaroddhatānām | madoddhatānāṃ sahavāsitānāṃ mahāgajānāmiva kānaneṣu ||29|| taṃ dānavānāṃ sagaṇeśvarāṇāṃ mukhyāhavaṃ vīkṣya divaukasāste | cerurnabho divyavimānayānaiḥ sasiṃhanādāḥ satalābhighātāḥ ||8.143.3 0|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe tricatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.144> sanatkumāra uvāca tetisaṃrambhasaṃyuktā darpitāḥ pramathāsurāḥ | saṃsaktayuddhaṃ yuyudhuḥ parasparakṛtāgasaḥ | | 1 | | śaktyullālitahastena kumāreṇāvaniñjayaḥ | kālanemiḥ kālakalpo viśākhaṃ samayodhayat | |2 || yaścādityarathāccakraṃ jahāra baladarpitaḥ | sa vipracittiḥ śākhena saṃsakto yuddhalālasaḥ | 3 || naigameṣo hayagrīvaṃ sugrīvaṃ dānavādhipam | yodhayāmāsa sogneyo madhuṃ madhunihā yathā | |4| | prāyudhyan nandinā jambhastuhuṇḍaḥ somanandinā | huṇḍo vināyakaṃ śūramayodhayata dānavaḥ ||5|| mahākāyastu kālena ghanena namucissaha | piṅgalābhyāṃ gaṇeśābhyāmilvakaḥ pilvakassa ca ||6 | | śaṃkukarṇena hrādastu hyanuhrādena viṭpatiḥ | ādityāpyāyano rudraḥ saṃhrādena samāgataḥ ||7| | kuṇḍodaraśca yakṣendro ghaṇṭākarṇaśva pārṣadaḥ | balelvalābhyāṃ saṃsaktau siṃhābhyāmiva kuñjarau | |8| | pañcākṣeṇa balissārdhaṃ rudreṇādityavarcasā | balerjanayitā sakto vīrabhadreṇa dānavaḥ ||9 || sumukhena mayassārdha tāro durmukhamāsarat | mayūro vajraromāṇaṃ kukkuṭo muramāgamat ||8.144.1 0 | | śeṣā hyapi gaṇādhyakṣāḥ śeṣairdaityaissamāgatāḥ | paraspareṇa saṃsaktā gajāḥ siṃhairivāhave || 11 | | dahyatāmiva veṇūnāṃ vijane kṛṣṇavartmanā | abhūt taṭataṭāśabdaḥ śastrāṇāṃ vinipātyatām | |1 2 || mā dravīrdrava tiṣṭheti paśya paśyetivādinaḥ | anyonyamabhijaghnuste saṃsaktā gaṇadānavāḥ | | 13 | | vapāmedobhidigdhāṅgāśchinnānanakaroravaḥ | dānavāḥ pramathāścaiva hyadhāvan śastramakṣitāḥ || 14| | ānanairurubhiḥ pādaiḥ karadantekṣaṇairapi | hārairvikīrṇaiḥ keyūraiḥ sragambaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ | | 1 5||| gajendrāstaparistomaiḥ kambalairāyudhairapi | rarāja sa raṇoddeśo nabhastārāgrahairiva | | 16 | | nakhadantāgrajanitaiścitraiḥ kṣatajabindubhiḥ | raktacandanadigdhāṅgī bhūmiḥ strīriva nirbabhau | | 17| | vināyakasya sa śaraṃ tuhuṇḍaḥ sūryatejasam | preṣayitvā jahāsoccaiḥ kopaṃ tasya vivarddhayan | | 18| | tasyāpi hasato vaktraṃ bṛhatkuṇḍalamaṇḍitam | asinā tīkṣṇadhāreṇa ciccheda sa vināyakaḥ | | 1 9| | tuhuṇḍaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā huṇḍo bhrātṛvadhāturaḥ | śaktiṃ cikṣepa nāgāsye śakrośanimivācale || 8.144.20 | | vināyakasya sā śaktirmaṇau maṇiśatācitā | patitāsṛk papau kroḍāj jvaladagniśikhopamā ||21 || vināyakasya sā kroḍe lagnā śaktivinirbabhau | indranīlaṃ maṇiṃ prāpya rekhā cāmīkarī yathā | | 22 || sa huṇḍaśaktiṃ karapuṣkareṇa nikṛṣya devo ravirasmikalpām | tayaiva huṇḍaṃ sahasā jaghāna tasyānujaḥ krauñcamivāvanīdhram || 23 | | pramāpitau vīkṣya tuhuṇḍahuṇḍau vināyakenārivināyakena | balaṃ samastaṃ gaṇanāyakānāmunmattagaḥṅgāpratimaṃ babhūva | | 24| | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe catuścatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.145> sanatkumāra uvāca vināyakena huṇḍe ca tuhuṇḍe ca pramāpite | gaṇeśvarāsurāṇāṃ tadyuddhaṃ saṃkulamābabhau | | 1 || te naditvā yathā meghā jalamattā jalāgame | saṃsādhayante yudhyantastvarayaiva parasparam | | 2 | | asṛksravaissuraktāṅgāssandaṣṭadaśanacchadāḥ | anyonyamabhisaṃjaghnuḥ śūlaśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ ||3 | | śaktīnāṃ kṣipyamāṇānāmasīnāñca nipātyatām | śrāvyatāṃ nāmadheyānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ kūjatāmapi | |4| | śrotrāyāsakarāñchabdān niśamya balināṃ varaḥ | jambho bhrātṛvadhāmarṣī praviṣṭaḥ prāmathaṃ balam | |5| vyāghrapūrvaṃ triśūlena jambho bhittvā gaṇeśvaram | nanarda mahiṣaṃ hattvā vane vanapatiryathā | |6 | | nardamānasya tasyātha prathamo magapūrvakaḥ | śirobhihatya śaktyā tu śeṣāndaityān pradudruve | |7 gaṇapāpi tataḥ khyātāḥ khyātavīryayaśaḥśrutāḥ | pratīyurasurān yuddhe śarabhāḥ kuñjarāniva | |8| | tatosuragaṇeśānāṃ sannipātobhavanmahān | saṃghaṭṭa iva vajrāṇāṃ saha kāñcanaparvataiḥ | |9 | virocanaścāndhakaśca vavarṣaturamarṣaṇau | śaravṛṣṭīssusaṃrabdhau jalavṛṣṭīrivāmbudau | | 8.145.10 | | svayaṃprabheṇa tau daityau śaravarṣavisarjanau | vimukhau saṃyugamukhe kṛtau śaravarārditau | | 11 | | svayaṃprabho dānavasainyasāgaraṃ śarairanekairdhanuyantraniḥsṛtaiḥ | saśoṣayad dīptamarīcimaṇḍalo yathā vivasvān jagataḥ kṣayerṇavam | | 12 | | tatondhako dānavalokasārathiḥ svasārathiṃ prāha vivṛttalocanaḥ | śukraṃ prati prāpaya sārathe māṃ sa naḥ sadā huḥkhaharo guruśca || 13 || sa taṃ rathaṃ dānavayūthapāsthitaṃ tatheti ca procya sadaśvasaṃyutam | saṃ prāpayāmāsa payodanisvanaṃ sa yatra śukro grahasattamo dvija | |14|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.146> sanatkumāra uvāca apasṛtya tato yuddhādandhakosurasattamaḥ | śukrāntikamupāgamya idamāha natānanaḥ | | 1 | | bhagavam̐stvāṃ samāśritya vayaṃ devān sahānugān | gaṇayāmastṛṇaistulyān sadā satyaṃ bravīmyaham | | 2 | | kuñjarā iva siṃhānāṃ garuḍānāmivāhayaḥ | asmākaṃ bibhyati sadā devā yuṣmatprasādataḥ | | 3 | | durgaṃ devagaṇavyūhaṃ bhavatā pratipālitāḥ | viviśurnirbhayā daityā hradamuṣṇārditā iva | |4| | vayaṃ tvaccharaṇā bhūtvā pāṣāṇā iva niścalāḥ | sthitvā vadhāma niḥśaṃkā brāhmaṇendrendramāhave | | 5| | āpadbhāvena ca vayaṃ pādau tava sukhapradau | sadārāḥ sasutāścaiva śuśrūṣāmo divāniśam | | 6| | abhirakṣasva satataṃ sa nastvaccharaṇāgatān | bhayeṣu satataṃ devān nārāyaṇa ivāparaḥ | |7| | paśya huṇḍaṃ tuhuṇḍaṃ ca kujambhaṃ jambhameva ca | pākaṃ kārtasvanaṃ caiva vipākaṃ ca mahāsuram | |8| | taṃ cendradamanaṃ śūraṃ śūrāmaranipātanam | pramathairbhīmavikrāntaiḥ krāntamṛtyuvyathādibhiḥ ||9|| sūditānpatitānetān hariṇairiva candanān | yā pītvā kaṇadhūmaṃ vai sahasraṃ śaradāṃ purā | vidyā harādvarā prāptā tasyāḥ kāloyamāgataḥ ||8.146.1 0|| atha vidyāphalaṃ tatte jīvayānasya dānavān | paśyantu pramathāḥ sarve lokāścotphullalocanāḥ ||11|| tvayā sañjīvitān dṛṣṭvā dānavā dānavān yudhi | sarve mṛtyubhayaṃ hitvā yotsyante pramathaiḥ saha ||12 || .............| vidyā kila tvayā sā vai dānavānāṃ hitārthinā ||13|| ārādhya devaṃ saṃprāptā tāṃ darśaya namastava | ityandhakavacaḥ śrutvā sthiradhīrbhārgavo muniḥ ||14|| īṣatsmitaṃ tadā kṛtvā dānavādhipamabravīt | dānavādhipa tatsatyaṃ yattvayā preritaṃ vacaḥ ||15|| vidyopārjanametaddhi dānavānāṃ mayā kṛtam | pītvā varṣasahasra vai kaṇadhūmaṃ sudussaham ||16|| eṣā prāptā mayā vidyā bāndhavānāṃ sukhāvahā | etayā vidyayā sohametān daityān parairhatān ||17|| utthāpayiṣye sasyāni mlānānyambudharo yathā | nirvraṇānnīrujān svasthān suptveva punarutthitān ||18| | asmin muhūrte draṣṭāsi dānavāndānavādhipa | utthitāndānavān dṛṣṭvā hatān yuddhe gaṇeśvaraiḥ ||19|| vismayācca bhayāccaiva draviṣyanti gaṇeśvarāḥ | ityevamuktvā sa tadā bhārgavo dānaveśvaram ||8.146.20|| ekaikaṃ daityamuddiśya vidyāmāvartayat kaviḥ | āvartamānayā tatra vidyayā brāhmaṇena ha ||21 || uttasthurdānavāḥ suptāḥ śayanādiva nidrayā | vedārthā iva cābhyastāḥ samayeneva cāmbudāḥ | |22 || kālena pralayaṃ prāptau yathā vā dhūmaketavaḥ | tathā śukreṇa te daityāḥ pramathaiḥ sanniṣūditāḥ ||23|| utthāpyamānā vibabhuryathā svasthāḥ purātanāḥ | śukreṇojjīvitān dṛṣṭavā dānavān tān gaṇeśvarāḥ ||24|| āścaryametaddeveśā iti tenyonyamabruvan | ujjīvitām̐stu tāndṛṣṭvā tuhuṇḍādyān mahāsurān | vineduḥ pūrvadevāste jalamattā ivāmbudāḥ ||25|| tānutthitānvīkṣya sahasraśonye kuṭhāravajrāśaniśūlahastāḥ | pradudruvuḥ śaṅkarakiṅkarāṇāṃ balaṃ samuddhūtamahārṇavābham||26| | samāgamastatra punarbabhūva gaṇāsurāṇāmatibhīmanādaḥ | yugātyaye mārutavejitānāṃ yathā samudyoga ivārṇavānām ||27|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe daityojjīvane ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.147> sanatkumāra uvāca utthāpiteṣu daityeṣu bhārgaveṇograkarmaṇā | nedurdevāḥ sagandharvā dānavāśca sahāndhakāḥ | | 1 | | tataḥ śaṃkharavonmiśrā māḍukānakanisvanāḥ | babhūvuḥ siṃhanādāśca ratha hastiravaissaha | | 2 | | huṇḍastuhuṇḍo jambhaśca kujambhaśca mahāsuraḥ | śailaśūlaśilāghātairyuyudhurdevatārayaḥ | |3 | | pākendradamanau tau ca sa ca kārtasvano baliḥ | mamarduḥ pramathānīkaṃ vairaṃ praticikīrṣayā | |4 | | teṣāṃ vegaṃ sannivārya pramathā api darpitāḥ | śilātarukarāḥ sarve dānavānabhidudruvuḥ | | 5 | | gaṇeśvarāḥ surāṇāṃ tu tasminyuddheti bhairave | śrūyante dhanuṣāṃ śabdā rathaśabdāśca bhairavāḥ | |6 | | pramathānāṃ jaye saktā dānavānāṃ tathāpare | cakruḥ kolāhalaṃ ghoraṃ pakṣavādāṃstathāmbare ||7| | garjatāṃ dhāvatāṃ caiva balānāṃ samabhūt svanaḥ | garjatāṃ dhāvatāṃ caiva samudrāṇāmivātyaye | |8 | | yuddhātiśayamattāśca siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ | neduścaivotsasarjuśca nānākusumasañcayān | | 9| | nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi patamānāni rejire | siddhacāraṇamuktāni nakṣatrāṇi yathātyaye || 8.147.10 | | devagandharvatūryāṇi prasasvanuranekaśaḥ | yuddhasaṃsaktabhāvānāṃ viremuśca punaḥ punaḥ | | 11 | | vināyakena smṛtvā tu jambho yudhi parābhavam | taṃ sakrodhobhidudrāva gajaṃ gaja ivāparaḥ || 12 | tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dānavaṃ jambhamāhave | siṃho gajamiva kruddho rurudhe sa vināyakaḥ || 13 || airāvatakaraprakhyaṃ karaṃ karinibhānanaḥ | utkṣipya dānavaṃ yuddhe tatāḍa sa vināyakaḥ | | 14| | kumbhayorantare taṃ tu jambho dānavakuñjaraḥ | bibheda śaramukhyena yathā siddhorkamaṇḍalam || 15 || kumbhayorantare tasya nimamajja sa vai śaraḥ | śṛṅgayoracalendrasya taḍitvāniva cāmbudaḥ || 16 | | sa śarāroṣitamanā vidhūya saśiraḥkaram | karāgreṇa mahādaityamānamyāhatya sonadat || 17|| praspandamāno jambhastu vināyakakarāhataḥ | vināyakaṃ śarairugrairavatastāra roṣitaḥ | | 18| | śalabhā iva kedāraṃ bhramarā iva pādapam | jambheṣavastadā devaṃ viviśuste vināyakam | |1 9 || rudhiraṃ kṣaramāṇāste trivittrai(?)rdāritānanāḥ | śarā vināyake rejuḥ sarpā merumivāśritāḥ | |8.147.20 || sa jambhabāṇairatibhinnagātraḥ kumbhāsrutāvāplutaraktanetraḥ | dhunvan karāgraṃ ca śiraśca devo dudrāva jambhaṃ tṛṣito yathāmbhaḥ ||21 | | sa taṃ karāgreṇa dṛḍhaṃ dṛḍhena muhuḥ samāhatya muhurvinadya | rathaṃ gṛhītvā balavām̐stadājau cikṣepa sāśvadhvajaśastracakram || 22|| soddhūta bhagnātipatākaketuścyutāsiśaktyṛṣṭisahasrabāṇaḥ | rathaḥ papātāsuranandanasya manorathastīvra ivādhanasya ||23 | | patīṣyamāṃṇaṃ tu rathaṃ vihāya prahrādirindrāmbudharaprabhāvaḥ | sthitombare śaktidharo rarāja sthitombare śaktidharo yathaiva ||24|| sa tāṃ saghaṇṭāṃ kanakāvadātāṃ kṛśānulekhāmiva dīpyamānām | vināyakāyāsurarājaputraścikṣepa śaktiṃ samudīrṇaśaktiḥ ||25| | sā khātpatantī bhujagāṅganeva śastrāṅganā prajvalamānavaktrā | śarāhatā viṭpatinā papāta śaktiryathāgryā puruṣe hatāśe ||26| | āścaryabhūte pramathāsurāṇāṃ tasmin tathā vartati yuddhayajñe | amarṣito bhārgavakarma dṛṣṭvā śilādaputrobhyagamanmaheśam ||27| | jayeti soktvā jayayonimugramuvāca nandī kanakāvadātam | gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ raṇakarma deva devaiḥ sahendrairapi duṣkaraṃ yat | |28| | tad bhārgaveṇādya kṛtaṃ vṛthā na saṃjīvayānena hi dānavendrān | ete hi te dānavayūthapālā yamālayādadya punarnivṛttāḥ | |29|| vidrāvayantaḥ pramathām̐ścaranti nāgānivājau śarabhāḥ sadarpāḥ | yadi hyasau daityavarānnirastānujjjīvayatyeva punaḥ sadaiva | | 8.147.30 | | jayaḥ kuto vai bhavitā maheśa gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ kuta eva śāntiḥ | vakrasthitaścaiṣa na caiṣa vadhyo ayudhyamāno vṛṣavāha śukraḥ ||31|| naivābhināśosti tava prasādād hataṃ ca taṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe prasādam | bhavettaveśāna mataṃ sa vadhyo yathā jayaste samareniśaṃ syāt | tathā kuruṣvottamabuddhibuddha na te maheśāna samosti buddhyā | |3 2|| sanatkumāra uvāca ityevamuktaḥ pramatheśvareṇa nandīśvareṇeśvaradevadevaḥ | uvāca devaḥ prahasastadānīṃ sa nandinam sarvagaṇeśanāyakam ||33 || nandin prayāhi tvaritotimātraṃ dvijendrabandhuṃ ditinandanānām | madhyātsamutpāṭya tamānayasva yathopahāraṃ dhanavān manuṣyaḥ ||34|| sa evamukto vṛṣabhadhvajena vṛṣadhvajo vai vṛṣasiṃhanādaḥ | jagāma tūrṇaṃ pravigāhya senāṃ yatrābhavad bhārgavavaṃśadīpaḥ ||35|| taṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ ditinandanaistaiḥ pāśāsivṛkṣopalaśūlahastaiḥ | vikṣobhya daityān vṛṣarāḍ jahāra śukraṃ sa nandī śarabho yathebham ||3 6 | | srastāmbaraṃ taṃ cyutabhūṣaṇaṃ ca vimuktakeśaṃ ripuṇā gṛhītam | vimokṣayiṣyanta ivābhyadhāvan surārayaḥ siṃharavān sṛjantaḥ | | 37| | te vajraśūleṣuparaśvadhānāṃ sacakradaṇḍopalakampanānām (?) | nandīśvarasyopari dānavendrā varṣaṃ vavarṣurjaladā ivogrāḥ | | 38 | | sa bhārgavaṃ prāpya gaṇādhipāgryo vaktrāgninā śastraśatāni dagdhvā | āyāt sa śukrantu kare gṛhītvā nandīśvaro dānavayūthapālam ||3 9| | teṣāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca tato babhūva pramuktaśastrāstrasubhīmapātaḥ | jahīti gṛhṇeti ca vādināṃ vai mahāhavo devamanaḥpratoṣaḥ | |8.147.40 | | tenāntareṇaitya bhavasya pārśva nandīśvaraḥ krodhavivarṇanetraḥ | ayaṃ sa śukro bhagavannitīśe nivedayāmāsa bhavāya śīghram | |41 || jagrāha śukraṃ sa ca devadevo yathopahāraṃ śucinā pradattama | vakrasthitaṃ śukramariṃ jagāra na kiñciduktvā sa hi bhūtagoptā ||42|| tataḥ punardānavadaityasainyaṃ gaṇeśvarāstasya tadā vijaghnuḥ ||43 | | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe bhārgavaharaṇe saptacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.148> sanatkumāra uvāca śukretha śukrapatināgīrṇenneva bhujaṅginā | babhūvurdānavāḥ sarve daridrā iva niṣkriyāḥ | | 1 | | viśarīrā yathā jīvā garuḍā virayā iva | vihastā iva mātaṅgā viśṛṅgā iva govṛṣāḥ || 2| | nirviṣā iva nāgendrā nirvidyā iva ca dvijāḥ | sāgarā iva nistoyā vivegā iva mārutāḥ | | 3 | | payodā iva niśśabdā viśikhā iva cāgnayaḥ | gatotsavā va divasā vipuṣpā iva pādapāḥ ||4|| hariṇā iva saṃtrastā vipakṣā iva pakṣiṇaḥ | grahā iva praśāntābhā grāhā iva jaloddhṛtāḥ | |5| | nandināpahṛte śukre gīrṇe cāpi kapardinā | dānavā jajñire śūrā dīnamānaparākramāḥ | |6 || vaimanasyaṃ paraṃ prāpto dānavānāṃ raṇendhakaḥ | uvāca meghaninadaḥ saṃyugasthaḥ sa dānavaḥ | |7|| vikramya nandinā śukraṃ nayatā nayināṃ varam | hṛtāni nodya sarveṣāṃ jīvitāni na saṃśayaḥ | |8 | | pramathairnihatāndaityān kaḥ punarjīvayiṣyati | bhārgavaṃ tamṛte śukraṃ konyo no dhārayiṣyati | | 9| | dhairyañca vikramastejaḥ satvaṃ vīryaṃ balaṃ dhṛtiḥ | śatrubhirno hṛtaṃ sarvaṃ deve śukrepavāhite | | 8.148.10 | | bhārgavepahṛte deve mamāpi vyathitaṃ manaḥ | na tvahaṃ saṃyugaṃ jahyāṃ pramathaissamabhidrutaḥ | | 1 1 | | saṃstambhayata mābhaiṣṭa yudhyadhvamaribhiḥ saha | sūdayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvān pramathān saha nandinā | | 12 | | adyaitān vivaśān kṛtvā hatvā ca tridaśānapi | bhārgavaṃ mokṣayiṣyāmi pañjarasthaṃ yathā harim | | 13 | | sa cāpi yogī yogena yadi nāma svayaṃ prabhuḥ | śarīrān niṣkramettasya asmākaṃ śeṣapālitaḥ | | 14| | ityandhakavacaḥ śrutvā dānavā meghanardanāḥ | pramathānardayāmāsurmarttavyakṛtaniścayāḥ | | 15 | | tatra ṣāṇāsivajraughaiḥ kaṭaṅkakaṭaśilopalaiḥ | anyonyamavakṛntantaste cakruḥ kadanaṃ mahat | |1 6 | | kārmukāṇāṃ vikṛṣṭānāṃ visṛṣṭānāṃ ca patriṇām | nipātyatāmasīnāṃ ca śabdobhūd bhṛśadāruṇaḥ || 17|| bhagnadhvajapatākāni kṣīṇapraharaṇāni ca | rudhirāsrāvacitrāṇi vraṇākusumitāni ca | |1 8| | pipāsitāni śrāntāni hatavājigajāni ca | samudrāmbarakalpāni balānyāsan samantataḥ | | 1 9|| atha bhūyo gajendreṇa caturdantena garjatā | añjanācalakalpena añjanadvipavarcasā | |8.148.2 0 | | satūṇīrapatākena aṃkuśāroṣitena ca | jambho dānavaśārdūla abhidudrāva nandinam ||2 1 | | gajaskandhagato daityo babhau jambhaḥ satomaraḥ | kṛṣṇāparvataśṛṃgasthassabalāka ivāmbudaḥ | | 22 | | stabdhalāḍatgūladṛkkarṇaḥ prasāritamahākaraḥ | cadito dānavendreṇa samadhāvanmahāgajaḥ | | 23 | | yugānterṇavavātasya anaupamyo yathā javaḥ | anaupamyastathā tasya javo nāgasya dhāvataḥ||24| | turaṅgā ye ca mātaṅgā pramathā ye ca dānavāḥ | tasya mārgādapakrāntā mṛtyoriva yathā narāḥ | | 25|| taṃ mattanāgaṃ dhāvantaṃ nadantamiva nīradam | vārayāmāsa balavān vikramya sa vināyakaḥ ||26|| sa taṃ devavaro dantī kariṇaṃ parvatopamam | prakīrṇena karāgreṇa pramukhebhijaghāna ha | |27| | vināyakenābhihato nāyakaḥ sarvahastinām | sa rujā ghorayā nunno muhūrttamabhavajjaḍaḥ | |28 || athāśvasya ca viśramya saṃvartyātmakaraṃ karī | vināyakamurodeśe tāḍayāmāsa nardayan ||29| | sa vindhyakūṭakalpena tena nāgena tāḍitaḥ | padātpadaṃ na calito mahāsatvo vināyakaḥ | |8.148.3 0 || nāsayā sa gṛhītvā taṃ nāsāyāṃ dānavadvipam | ākṣipya pātayāmāsa girivarṣmā vināyakaḥ ||3 1 | | sa siṃha iva siṃhena vanamadhye nipātitaḥ | rarāsa visphurannāgo megho vāyvāhato yathā | |3 2|| taṃ nāgaṃ pātayayānaṃ tu nāgavaktramasṛksravam | bibheda tomareṇāśu kareṇārka ivāmbudam ||3 3 | | mocayantaṃ tu caraṇau grīvāyāṃ dānavottamama | tenaiva tomareṇātha ājaghāna vināyakaḥ ||34| | sa suprahārābhihato gajavaktreṇa dānavaḥ | cakṣāra rudhiraṃ jambho nirjjarāmbho giriryathā ||3 5|| punaścāsya vadhākāṃkṣī asiṃ jagrāha vīryavān | tasyodyatāsernadataścicchitsorjambhakandharām ||3 6 || asiṃ kujambhaściccheda garuḍaḥ pannagaṃ yathā | tañcāpi suvikṛṣṭena śareṇāsṛgbhujā tadā ||37| | kujambho hyahanadbāhau vajreṇendra ivācalam | sa dṛḍhābhihatastena ghūrṇitassālavṛkṣavat || 38|| kujambhamabhidudrāva kesarī kuñjaraṃ yathā | samucchritakaro devastaṃ dānavamabhidravan ||39|| airāvata ivābhāti balodvṛtto vināyakaḥ | vyaṃsastaṃ dhāvamānaṃ tu kujambhavadhakāṃkṣiṇam | |8.148.40 | | vavāra sa gatoṃsena pātayāmāsa taṃ kṣitau | vyaṃsamaṃsena hatvā tu nāgavaktro mahābalaḥ | |41 | | kujambhasyāntikaṃ prāpa siṃhasya śarabho yathā | kujambhastasya bhitvā tu śareṇa karamudyatam | |42|| gadayābhyahanan mūrdhni mudgareṇa ca vakṣasi | tribhiḥ prahāraiḥ sa babhau śoṇitākto vināyakaḥ | nāgāyutasahasraujāstriprabhinna iva dvipaḥ | |43 || dharāyāṃ nāsayādāya kujambhaṃ tu vināyakaḥ | pracikṣepa mahāvīryo yathā bhūtabaliṃ naraḥ ||44| | kujambhe mandaraprakhye vināyakabhujerite | cukrudhurdānavāḥ sarve terdayaṃśca vināyakam | |45|| sordito dānavaśatai rnānayudhavitakṣitaḥ | cacāra devo daityeṣu pṛṣateṣu yathā hariḥ | |46 | | sa dantaiścaraṇaiścāpi śuṇḍayātatayāpi ca | mamarda dānavān kruddhaḥ kuñjaro naḍvalāniva ||47| | tato gaṇeśā hyapi vīkṣya dānavairvināyakaṃ śastraśataiḥ parikṣatam | gṛhītaśastrā gajasiṃhavikramā vimuktarāvāḥ śataśobhidudruvuḥ ||48|| tataḥ punaḥ śastrasahasravejitaṃ śarāsiśaktyṛṣṭinipātaduḥsaham | gaṇāsurāṇāmasunāśanaṃ mahad babhūva yuddhaṃ hatavājikuñjaram ||49| | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe aṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.149> vyāsa uvāca nigīrṇo brāhmaṇaḥ sotha candrāvayavadhāriṇā | kiṃ cakre koṣṭhagastasya devadevasya bhārgavaḥ | | 1 | | kathaṃ ca tapatāṃ śreṣṭho yogī yogena sa dvijaḥ | na niḥsṛto yogabalād devadehānmahātapāḥ | | 2 | | andhakaścāsuraśreṣṭhaḥ sa tadā bhārgavaṃ vinā | cakāra kathamāvāpaṃ gaṇeśaiḥ samabhidrutaḥ | | 3 | | etanme sarvamakhilaṃ khilavedavidāṃ vara | kathayasva na me tṛptiḥ śṛṇvānasyeśaceṣṭitam | |4| | sūta uvāca athaivaṃ pṛcchatastasya vyāsasya munisattamaḥ | sanatkumārokathayacchukrasyātha viceṣṭitam ||5|| sanatkumāra uvāca nigīrṇe bhārgave tena bhūtomādevabandhunā | andhako niṣprabho jajñe ghanaruddho yathā raviḥ | | 6| | dṛṣṭavā svasainyaṃ pramathairbhajyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | dudrāva rathamāsthāya svayamevāndhako gaṇān | |7| | śaravajraprahāraistairvajrāghātairddharā (?) iva | pramathāḥ petirevanyāṃ nistoyā iva toyadāḥ | |8 | | kroḍeṣūrukapoleṣu pṛṣṭhabāhūdareṣu ca | ruruvurbāṇanirbhinnāḥ pramathāḥ kuñjarā yathā | | 9| | yāntamāyāntamaprāptaṃ prāptaṃ dūrasthameva ca | apaśyadyaṃ yatastaṃ taṃ nirbibheda śarairbhṛśam | | 8.149.10 | | bibheda śatamekena śatena ca śataṃ punaḥ | sahasraṃ ca sahasreṇa koṭiṃ koṭyā tathaiva ca | | 11 | | dhvajāḥ patākāśchatrāṇi vaijayantyoṅkuśāḥ kuthāḥ | cāmarāṇi kirīṭāni kuṇḍalānyambarāṇi ca ||12|| pramathānāṃ bale yacca kampate dhāvatepi vā | tatsarvaṃ cicchide tūrṇaṃ śarairandhakadānavaḥ || 13 || visphuliṅgān yathaivāgnirdhārāsārān yathāmbudaḥ | sindhurājo yathodgārān karāniva divākaraḥ ||14|| nādān siṃhā ivāraṇye sīkarāniva kuñjarāḥ | mumoca bāṇām̐stīkṣṇāgrān parasainyavimardanān ||15|| andhake yudhyamāne tu niścayenāsurottame | asurā apyayudhyanta niścayenāndhakādanu ||1 6| | nivātakavacā ye te anyonyasadṛśā bhṛśam | cakruste bahavo yuddhaṃ rudraiśca bahubhiḥ saha | |17|| kāleyāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrāḥ kālakalpā mahāsurāḥ | bāhujaiḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasraiḥ pramathairyuyudhuḥ saha | | 18|| prahrādaścānuhrādaśca saṃhrādaḥ śinibāṣkalau | virocano balirbāṇaḥ kujambhothāvaniñjayaḥ | |1 9|| añjakaḥ kālanemiśca namucirvyaṃsa eva ca | ekādaśaite prakhyātā ekādaśaraviprabhāḥ | |8.149.2 0 || ekādaśaiva pramathānardayan kalahaiṣiṇaḥ | prabhāmayaṃ vīrabhadraṃ viṭpatiṃ piṅgalaṃ tathā | | 21 || vegapaṃ pavanādaṃ ca somārkāpyāyanāvapi | saṃvarttakānalañcaiva pāvakāpyāyanāvapi (?) || 22 | | yakṣonnadaśca balavān vidyutkeśaśca rākṣasaḥ| prahrādapramukhairetairdānavairdevapuṅgavāḥ ||23 | | vihastaśastrakavacāvṛtāḥ śastraśatācitāḥ | dvārapālāśca rudraṇāṃ rudrāṇāṃ ye ca sūnavaḥ | |24| | skandapāriṣadā ye ca ye ca śaktigaṇeśvarāḥ | te danostanayaissārdhaṃ danoḥ putrānvayāśca ye | cakruḥ kṛtāntasadṛśāḥ kalahaṃ kalahapriyāḥ ||25|| tasmin tathā vartita saṃprahāre viśīrṇaharābharaṇasragastraiḥ | vyāviddhavastrā vikasatsunetrā neduḥ surāḥ siddhagaṇāśca khasthāḥ | | 26|| iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe ūnapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.150> vyāsa uvāca māyāvīryaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca andhakasyāmaradviṣaḥ | sṛṣṭaṃ bhagavatā samyag devarūpanimittajam || 1 || nigīrṇo yasya devena śarīre bhārgavo muniḥ | kathaṃ tu kṛtavāṃstatra devadevaśarīragaḥ | |2| | kathaṃ ca tapaso vīryād yogavīryācca sa dvijaḥ | śvetābhrādiva vai candro niḥsṛto bhṛgunandanaḥ |13 | | etat kautūhalaṃ jātaṃ mamādya munisattama | kathayeśānacaritaṃ bhārgavasya ca dhīmataḥ ||4| | sūta uvāca sa evamukto vyāsena padmagarbhasutaḥ prabhuḥ | sanatkumārokathayacchivācchukrasya nirgamam | |5| | dehe tasya tadā śambhoḥ śukro vinihatadyutiḥ | chidrānveṣī bhramanneva aniketo yathānilaḥ ||6|| sa lokānagnivarṇābhān rudrakoṭiśatairvṛtāna | rudrakanyāvicaritān rudradehebhyapaśyata | |7 | | kundenduśaṃkhavarṇānāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ nakhināmapi | dīrghalāṅgūlajuṣṭānāṃ sadarpāṇāṃ kṣamāvatām | |8 || jvalanaprabhakeśānāṃ nandyāvartakadhāriṇām | kiṃśukaprabhajihvānāṃ kailāsagirivarṣmaṇām | | 9| | agnibandhanabaddhānāṃ siṃhānāṃ bhīmarūpiṇām | sahasraṃ dadṛśe dehe devadevasya bhārgavaḥ | | 8.150.10 | | surāṃśca sendrān sādityān sāpsarogaṇamānavān | gaṇeśāsurayuddhaṃ ca sopaśyaddharadehagaḥ | | 11 || varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ kukṣau bhramamāṇo bhavasya saḥ | na tasya dadṛśe chidraṃ śuceriva yathā kaliḥ | |1 2 | | yogamapyasya saiśvaryamaṇimādiguṇānvitam | prajahāra mahādevo manovāgyatacetasaḥ | | 13 | | atha śabdo mahānāsīt pramathāsurasainyayoḥ | taṃ śrutvā śabdamāvigno bhārgavaḥ pratibodhitaḥ ||14| | sontargata umābharturbrāhmaṇastapasaidhitaḥ | tuṣṭāveṣṭaiḥ stavairdevaṃ somaṃ somavibhūṣaṇam | | 1 5| | āpadbhāvaṃ prapannasya tasya devena śūlinā | liṅgena niṣkramasveti prasādābhyudayaḥ kṛtaḥ | |1 6|| sūkṣmarūpastato bhūtvā sa śukro munisattamaḥ | śukravanniḥsṛto liṅgād devadevasya dhīmataḥ | | 17|| śukravanniḥsṛto yasmācchiśnād bhārgavanandanaḥ | tasmācchukra iti khyātiṃ gato gatimatāṃ varaḥ | | 18 | | vandamānaśca tenoktaḥ payodapatiketunā | śukravanniḥsṛto medya yasmāttvaṃ bhṛgunandana | | 1 9| | karmaṇā tena śukrosi mama putraśca gamyatām | ityevamukto devena śukrorkasadṛśadyutiḥ | |8.150.2 0 | | viveśa dānavānīkaṃ meghānīkaṃ śaśī yathā | taṃ dṛṣṭavā candrasaṃkāśaṃ candrodayanibhodayam | | 21 | | candrodaye yathā nṝṇāṃ prītirāsīt suradviṣām | te dṛṣṭavā danudaiteyāḥ śukraṃ candrasamaprabham | | 22 || sarve siṃharavām̐ścakruḥ saṃprahṛṣṭā yuyutsavaḥ | nihatā dānavā ye tu pramathairjitakāśibhiḥ | | 23 | | tānāgatānmṛtyumukhānmenire bhārgavāgamāt | vavandustaṃ nananduśca praseduśca mahāsurāḥ | |24|| śukrodayamudaṃ lebhe sa dānavamahārṇavaḥ | yathā candrodaye nityaṃ sāgaro rākṣasairyutaḥ || 25|| atha śākho viśākhaśca chāgavaktraścaturmukhaḥ | nandī ca somanandī ca nandiṣeṇaśca vīryavān | | 26 | | ghaṇṭākarṇaḥ śaṃkukarṇaḥ kuṇḍodaramahodarau | viṭpatirvīrabhadraśca sa ca devaḥ prabhāmayaḥ | |27| | saṃvartakānalorvau ca yaśodīpto vibhākaraḥ | vegapaśca śikhaṇḍī ca tāmracūḍaśca kukkuṭaḥ | | 28 | | annadaḥ piṅgalo yakṣaḥ piṅgalaśca vaṭuḥ paṭuḥ | vidyutkeśaḥ sukeśaśca rākṣasau cāparājitau | | 29 | | ete cānye ca gaṇapā lokapālasamatviṣaḥ | viviśurdānavānīkaṃ śukrodayasamuddhatam | | 8.150.30 | | atha vāditraśabdāstu siṃhanāharavaiḥ saha | babhūvuḥ senayorugrāḥ sarvabhūtaprakampanāḥ | | 31 || tataḥ prahararṇerghoraistuṇḍanirvāpitaistalaiḥ | parasparaṃ samāsādya nirjaghnuste parasparam | |3 2 | | nandīśvaraṃ puraskṛtya kārttikeyañca ṣaṇmukham | mṛdranti pramathā daityān sarpām̐stārkṣya ivāhave | |3 3 || asipātāvalūnāgrā muśalāhatamastakāḥ | dānavāḥ śerate bhūmau vajrabhinnā ivācalāḥ ||34|| śaranirbhinnanirbhagnāḥ saṃbhagnoruprabāhavaḥ ririṅgussamare daityāḥ sarpāstārkṣyārditā iva ||35| | bhagnatrikorujaghanā ghanabāṇāvapīḍitāḥ | daityā viniṣṭanantyārttāstoyapūrṇā ivāmbudāḥ | |3 6|| tasmin gaṇapadaityānāṃ mathane bhṛśadāruṇe | babhūva pūrṇā daityānāṃ dharā dyauriva nīradaiḥ | | 37|| kirīṭairmukuṭairhārairvalayābharaṇāṅgadaiḥ | pārihāryaissa keyūraiḥ śroṇīsūtraissakuṇḍalaiḥ | |38|| śirastrairmaṇibhiḥ śubhrairgraiveyairapi suprabhaiḥ | sragdāmaiścārukusumairnetrai ratnāgrabāhubhiḥ | | 39 || astraiḥ śastraiśca vastraiśca chatrai ścendusamaprabhaiḥ | raktakuṃkumacitrāṅgī nānābharaṇabhūṣaṇā | |8.150.40 || dhanāḍhyā strīrivābhāti tatra tatra raṇāvaniḥ | siṃhānāmiva dṛptānāṃ hastināmapi vā yathā | |41 || utsāhobhūd gaṇeśānāṃ dānavān saṃmaprardatām | te hanyamānāśaraṇā bhayārttāḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ | |42| | pramathairanubaddhāśca dānavāḥ sāgaraṃ śritāḥ | dṛṣṭvā tadrecitaṃ sainyaṃ dānavaiḥ pramathārditaiḥ | |43 || praviṣṭeṣu ca daityeṣu sāgaraṃ makarālayam | bhārgavaḥ sumahātejā yathāgniriva mūrchitaḥ | |44| | sa samudrālayān daityāñchaśāpa kupito bhṛśam | yasmātsahāyānutsṛjya māṃ cāpi pitṛvaddhitam | |45| | prāṇatrāṇārthamabalāḥ praviṣṭāḥ stha payonidhim | tasmāttatraiva nirhrīkā mama śāpaparikṣatāḥ ||46|| mīnabhāvamanuprāptā jātājātā bhaviṣyatha | yāvallokā bhaviṣyanti parvatāśca sasāgarāḥ ||47| | tāvadyūyaṃ jale matsyā bhaviṣyatha jalecarāḥ | naramāṃsāśanāḥ pāpā narabhakṣyā bhaviṣyatha ||48| | kṣapayiṣyatha macchāpaṃ varṣakoṭīśatānyuta | iti śāpahatān śeṣān kṛtvārṇavajalaukasaḥ | virarāma mahātejāḥ śukraścandrasamadyutiḥ ||49| | sanatkumāra uvāca tataste vārdhitoyeṣu guruśāpahatāsurāḥ | sāyudhāḥ satanutrāśca dṛśyante daṃśitāśca ha | |8.150.50 || andhakaṃ tu tataḥ śukraḥ śukrāribhayavihvalam | uvāca pāṇinā spṛśya jīvayanniva taṃ girā | 51 | | mābhaistvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha pratiyudhyasva śatruṣu | ahaṃ tvāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi āhāra iva jīvitam ||52 | | ityevamuktaḥ śukreṇa sondhako dānaveśvaraḥ | evametaditi procya rurodha pramathān raṇe | |53 | | tataḥ praviṣṭeṣvasureṣu sāgaraṃ nihanyamāneṣu ca śaṅkarānugaiḥ | dadhāra sarvānpramathān tadāndhako nadīnadān bhūrijalo yathārṇavaḥ | |54| | sa nandinaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ parābhinat tadāndhakaḥ pañcabhireva cāgnijam | viśākhaśākhau daśabhiḥ śatena ca sa naigameṣaṃ pratutoda dānavaḥ | |5 5 | sa vīrabhadraṃ ca tathā ca viṭpatiṃ prabhāmayaṃ yakṣavaraṃ ca piṅgalam | vibabheda bāṇaistapanīyabhūṣaṇairyathāṅkuśāgrairiva hastipo gajam | |5 6; | na sosti tasmin purato na pṛṣṭhato hayo gajo vā pramathothavetaraḥ | śarānna yo dhārayatendhakeritān pradīptakālānalasūryasannibhān | |57 || vivṛścitāścandanavad gaṇeśvarā bhujodare vakṣasi mūrghni cāsakṛt | nirudyamāstasthuramitranandanā yathā gajāḥ pañjarabandhabandhanāḥ | |58|| tatosuraiḥ siṃharavāstadā kṛtāḥ saśaṃkhabherīśatadundubhotkaṭāḥ | punaśca yuddhaṃ prababhau bhayānakaṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ saha dānaveśvaraiḥ ||59| | iti skandapurāṇe gaṇayuddhe suraśāpe pañcāśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.151> sanatkumāra uvāca vartamānendhake yuddhe vidravatsu gaṇeṣu ca | tridaśādhipatiṃ śakramityuvāca pitāmahaḥ | | 1 || vimukhānpaśya bhadrante pramathānamaradhipa | kālyamānān raṇe ghorairdānavairandhakena ||2 || nihatānnihatāneṣa prathamairdānavān yudhi | śukra ujjīvayannāste sasyāni jalado yathā | |3 | | asau vikṛṣṭacāpaśca sendrāyudhaghanopamaḥ | sṛjatīṣumayaṃ varṣamandhakaḥ kṣapayan ripūn ||4| | pramathābhyardanaṃ hyetadahitaṃ hyayaśaskaram | kṣamamāṇā hyatiṣṭhadhvaṃ kasmādetat parājayam | | 5| | jitvā hyeṣa gaṇansarvānandhako dānaveśvaraḥ | asmākamapi mūlāni nirmūlāni kariṣyati | | 6| | tadyāvadeṣa no bāṇaiḥ pramathānnayati kṣayam | tāvadeva vayaṃ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāma kṛttivāsasaḥ | |7|| evaṃ tava ca kāryārthaḥ setsyate devatādhipa | rudrasya ca kṛtaṃ hyevaṃ bhaviṣyati mahat priyam | |8| | svayambhuvacanaṃ śrutvā balavṛtranibarhaṇaḥ | yuktametaditi procya surān surapatirjagau | | 9| | gṛhītavarmaśastrāstrāḥ śīghraṃ śīghraparākramāḥ | sāhāyyaṃ karavāmādya gaṇānāṃ yudhyatāṃ raṇe | | 8.151.10 | | tato nārāyaṇānantau narendrau candra eva ca | svayambhuranalo vāyuḥ sūryo dhanada eva ca | | 11 | | pūṣāryamā bhago mitro yamaśca ravinandanaḥ | aṃśastvaṣṭā jayaścaiva jayantaścaiva śakrajaḥ | | 1 2| | maruto vasavaḥ sādhyāstathāśvigaruḍoragāḥ | tuṣitāścaiva lekhāśca viśvedevāśca guhyakāḥ | | 13 || gandharvāścaiva yakṣāśca ye cānye dānavānāṃ viloḍitam | prabhūtamīnaṃ kṣīṇāmbu rājahaṃsairyathā saraḥ ||1 6| | tato halahalāśabdaḥ saṃjajñetīvabhairavaḥ | devatādhyuṣite sainye dānavānāṃ samākule | | 17| | sa tvevamuktaḥ pārvatyā andhakorcitamānitaḥ | anujñātaśca pārvatyā mumude harapārśvagaḥ ||38|| ityevamandhakaṃ devastamorikṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ | anugṛhya girau tasmin vijahāra yathāsukham | |39|| iti skandapurāṇe andhakavarapradānaṃ nāma saptapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.158> vyāsa uvāca andhakaṃ gaṇapaṃ kṛtvā devyā saha maheśvaraḥ | kiṃ cakretaḥ paraṃ brūhi nuda kautūhalaṃ mama ||1|| sanatkumāra uvāca jitvāndhakaṃ tato vyāsa kṛtvā ca gaṇanāyakam | girīndrasutayā sārdhaṃ vijahāra surārttihā | |2|| atha bhūteśajananī ṣaḍānanatanūkarī | apṛcchat putrasambaddhaṃ praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ varā | |3 || kimarthaṃ gīyate deva gātheyaṃ sadbhiruttamā | varaṃ bhūmiruhāḥ pañca na ca koṣṭharuhā daśa ||4|| ṣoḍaśehāṅgamaṅgāni bhittvā putrobhijāyate | tasmātputrāt kathaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ koṣṭhajād bhuvijaḥ sutaḥ | |5|| ityevaṃ vṛcchatīṃ pṛcchāṃ śikṣāṃ dīkṣāṃ kriyāṃ matim | umāmanupamāṃ deva idaṃ vacanamabravīt | |6| | sūkṣmārthaṃ eṣa rambhoru yaṃ pṛcchasi varānane | ahaṃ te taṃ pravakṣyāmi śailendratanayevyaye | |7| | koṣṭhajāttanayādyasmād bhūmijastanayo varaḥ | śālmalau vaitaraṇyāṃ ca asipatravaneṣu ca | |8|| kumbhīpāke raurave ca mahāraurava eva ca | evamādyeṣu cānyeṣu kukṛtairanuveṣṭitān | śāsyato mṛtyuvacanādrākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ | |9| | pitṝm̐stathāśubhairghorairveṣṭitān rākṣāsārditān | satputrastrāyate devi netaraḥ pāpaniścayaḥ | | 8.158.10 | | narasya na ca satputrāḥ sarva eva bhavantyuta | eka evātra bhavati yaḥ pitṝm̐strāyate bhayāt | |1 1 | | tatra ye duṣṭacāritrāḥ putrasaṃkhyāṃ na te gatāḥ | śaṭho yadvadbalīvardaḥ ṣaṇḍho vāpi narādhipaḥ ||1 2 | | tatrāpi codyate duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca narakaṃ viduḥ | yat pitṝm̐strāyate tasmāt sutaḥ putrastataḥ smṛtaḥ | | 13 || nānyaḥ sambaddhako devi pituḥ putrasya cobhayoḥ | pāti putraṃ pitā tasmāt putro yat trāyate bhayāt || 14|| indriyāṇāṃ tu prābalyāt tat putreṣvapi pārvati | pāpakānyapi kurvanti te satputrā bhavantyuta || 15| | ime hi taravo devi dakṣaśāpād hatendriyāḥ | pāpakāni na kurvanti saṃvṛtaiḥ karaṇaiśca ha | | 16 | | etasmāt kāraṇād devi koṣṭhajānāṃ śatādapi | eko bhūmiruhaḥ putraḥ śasyate na tu koṣṭhajaḥ | | 17|| chedaṃ bhedaṃ tathā trāsaṃ pāṭanañca niśācaraiḥ | kurvadbhistaravaḥ putrāḥ pitṝṇāṃ.......| | 18|| umovāca chedaṃ bhedaṃ trāsanaṃ ca rākṣasairnirayopagaiḥ | kathaṃ pitṝṇāṃ taravo vārayanti yamakṣaye | | 1 9| | devadeva uvāca śṛṇuṣva chedaṃ bhedaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yamasādane | yathā vai pārayantyete taravo nāganandini || 8.158.20 | | ete nirudyamā devi vihīnāḥ karaṇairuta | yajñerthitāste devānāṃ taravo......| | 21 | | ........| dakṣaśāpena bhagavan vayaṃ hyupahatendriyāḥ ||22 || tamobāhulyatāṃ prāptā niṣkriyā niṣparikramāḥ | asukhāḥ karaṇairhīnā mahatā tamasāvṛtāḥ | |23 | | etāṃ daśāmanupraptā dharmayuktān kuruṣva naḥ | ityeṣāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devaḥ salilasambhavaḥ | |24| | yajñavṛkṣārthamāhedaṃ vṛkṣān vṛkṣapatirvacaḥ | sthāvarāḥ svāgataṃ vostu tuṣyāmi śaraṇaiṣiṇāma | nāśayāmyeṣa vo vatsā dakṣaśāpakṛtaṃ tamaḥ | | 25 || śālā bilvāḥ palāśāśca varuṇāḥ kiṃśukāstathā | rohītakāśca ye cānye yajñāṃgaprabhavā drumāḥ | | 26 || te sūpayuktā yajñeṣu tvakpatraphalaśākhinaḥ | mūrttīḥ subhāsvarāḥ prāpya mama loke nivatsyatha || 27|| eṣāṃ yajñiyavṛkṣāṇāṃ yūyamapyanugāminaḥ | yajñopayuktā gacchadhvaṃ teṣāmeva salokatām | |28| | sthāṇuliṅgopayuktāśca janairbhaktipurassaraiḥ | dharmeṇa śuddhadehāśca gatimiṣṭāmavāpsyatha | | 29 | | upayogaṃ ca gacchanto yajñāyatanavastuṣu | dakṣaśāpatamomuktā mama loke cariṣyatha | | 8.158.30 || putrahīno naro yaśca putrakānvaḥ kariṣyati | taṃ bhayāt trāyatāṃ caiva dharmo vo bhavitā mahān ||3 1 || tarava ūcuḥ kathaṃ vayaṃ putrakṛtāstān pitṝnnirayopagān | ……..........| | 3 2| | somavikrayiṇo ye ca ye ca viśvastaghātinaḥ | ye ca prāṇivadhe yuktāḥ pṛṣṭhamāṃsāśinaśca ye | |3 3 | | rājñāmākrośakā ye ca ye ca piṇḍāpahārakāḥ | ete svakarmabhirghorairveṣṭitā lomaharṣaṇaiḥ ||34|| pacyante niraye ghore krośanto bhairavān ravān | aho bhṛśaṃ yātanābhiraśivābhirabhidrutāḥ | |3 5 || śāsyante mṛtyuvacanādrākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ | tāneva tudyamānām̐śca kuṭyamānām̐śca rākṣasaiḥ | pitṝnnirayasaṃmagnānuddhariṣyāmahe katham | |2 6| | brahmovāca tām̐stathā tudyamānāṃśca kuṭyamānām̐śca rākṣasaiḥ || | pitṝnniraya saṃmagnān yūyamabhyuddhariṣyatha||37|| nirayasthān yathā caitān pitṝn nistārayiṣyatha | tanme sumanaso bhūtvā niśāmayata pādapāḥ || 38| | putraprakṛtakā yūyaṃ yasya yasya bhaviṣyatha | tasya tasya smṛtāḥ śīghraṃ taṃ deśaṃ yāsyathānaghāḥ ||39|| ...nirayaprāptān pitṝn kleśairupadrutān | sukhāya dhāsyatha yathā sthāvarāstannibodhata | |8.158.40 | | mantravad vidhitaścaiva yo vaḥ saṃskāramantaśaḥ | garbhādhānādibhiḥ kṛtvā putratve kalpayennaraḥ | | |41 | | ye cāpi pūrvajātān yo vidhinā niṣparigrahān | putraprakṛtakān kuryyustām̐śca nistārayiṣyatha | |4 2 | | sarvakāmām̐śca dāsyadhvaṃ sukhañcaiva tathottamam | karmakṣayaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ lokām̐ścaiva tathākṣayān ||43 | | sanatkumāra uvāca tataḥ śailasutā bhūyopṛcchattadvidhimuttamam | tāṃ pṛcchatīṃ mahādeva idaṃ vacanamabravīt | |44| | devi nāgendranāsoru nāgendragatigāmini | śṛṇuṣva yena vidhinā gṛhyatevanijaḥ sutaḥ ||45| | śvo bhūtehaṃ bhuviruhaṃ grahīṣyāmīti pārvati | sopavāsā bhavennārī śuciśīlā śucivratā | |46| | tataḥ śatasahasrāṃśāvastaśṛṅgaṃ gate ravau | udite vimale cāpi candre candranibhānane | |47| | āpadbhāvena subhage pareṇa paramātmike | viprānāmantrayedrātrau pāvanān vedavādinaḥ | |48| | śrutīnāmākarā hyete ratnānāmiva sāgarāḥ | viprā viprādhipamukhi pūjanīyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||49| | yatra mantravido viprā na prāśnantyuttamaṃ haviḥ | na tatra devā deveśe havirbhuñjanti karhicit ||8.158.50 | | na skandate na vyathate nainamākramate tamaḥ | variṣṭhametaddānānāṃ yad brāhmaṇamukhe hutam | |51 || brahmaṇatve (?) mahāsatve aṇadhātustu bhakṣaṇe | brahma bhakṣayate yasmād brāhmaṇastena sa smṛtaḥ | |5 2| | jāyante ye punarjātā hyupanītā mahātmabhiḥ | tato devi dvijākhyeyaṃ teṣu nityaṃ nipātyate ||53 | | viyadityucyate vyoma prakāraḥ prāpaṇe smṛtaḥ | divaṃ saṃprāpayantyete devi viprāstataḥ smṛtā | |54|| satya sāramayā hyete viprāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā | siddhirna teṣvatuṣṭeṣu śakyā prāptuṃ surairapi | |55|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇonanto brahmā śakronilaḥ śikhī | taddānaṃ nābhinandāmo viprā yatra na pūjitāḥ | |5 6| | yeṣāṃ prasādāt sulabhā āyurdharmo balaṃ sukham | śrīryaśaḥ svargavāsaśca tān viprānarcayed budhaḥ | |57| | viprānāmantrayitvātha śucivastrā śucismitā | śayīta sanamaskārā sadarbhā bhūmimāśritā ||58|| gamayitvā tato rātriṃ savitaryutthitepi ca | bhakṣyabhojyaṃ samādāya vrajet yatra bhavettaruḥ ||59| | tatastaṃ sapatākaṃ ca sātapatraṃ sabhūṣaṇam | tarukaṃ pramadā kṛtvā tarucchāyānugāminī ||8.158.60|| yathopapannamannaṃ tu bhojayitvā dvijottamān | puṇyāhaṃ kārayitvātha ṛtvijā hyathavātmanā ||61| | tṛptānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tattvenākūtamātmanaḥ | nivedya paramuddiśya sadbhāvena pareṇa ha ||62| | aputrā bhagavantohaṃ putraprakṛtakaṃ tarum | grahīṣye tadanujñāṃ vai kartu marhatha menaghāḥ ||63|| tatastairabhyanujñātaṃ taṃ taruṃ taruṇaṃ priye | bhūmidevasamakṣaṃ vai gṛhṇīyāttanayaṃ priye ||64|| anena vidhinā devi gṛhītastarukaḥ sutaḥ | pitṝṇāṃ nirayasthānāṃ madhu somañca varṣati ||65|| gṛhīto vidhinānena subhru bhūmiruhātmajaḥ | śubhe sukhāya bhavati viparītena duḥkhadaḥ ||66|| satputrāṇāṃ śatāccāpi devi candranibhānane | eko bhūmiruhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ putratve kalpitaḥ sutaḥ ||67|| ityetatte mayā śiṣṭaṃ śriṣṭamliṣṭa vacoraṇi | yathā bhūmiruhaḥ putro viśiṣṭaḥ koṣṭhajāt sutāt ||68|| tataḥ punardevadevī praṇipatya maheśvaram | praṇayāt kautukāccaiva idaṃ vacanamabravīt ||69|| proṣite tvayi deveśa bhramantyā mandare mayā | aśokataruko dṛṣṭaḥ komalaḥ sumanoramaḥ ||8.158.70|| āsīcca me tadā bhāva eṣa me tarupotakaḥ | bhaviṣyati suto rudre nirvighnaṃ punarāgate ||71|| ābhyāṃ ca me mahādeva kucābhyāṃ dvijapāvana | kṣīramāgāt sudhāsāraṃ putrasnehāt sukhapradam | |72|| tamahaṃ deva gṛhaṇīyāṃ putraprakṛtakaṃ tarum | yadi me kuruṣenujñāṃ tavāhaṃ vaśavartinī ||73|| devaiḥ putraphale kṣipte sa hi me tarupotakaḥ | tuṣṭiprado hyaputrāyāḥ putrako bhavitānagha | |74|| ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇāntu bhavānīṃ bhagavān bhavaḥ | sadbhāvānniḥsṛtaṃ vākyamavadat paratāpanaḥ ||75||| devi phullāravindākṣi kathaṃ nāma na te sutaḥ | bhaviṣyati tapasvinyā aiśvaryaparame mayā ||76 || śaktā janayituṃ putrān tapasā tvamanindite | ahaṃ ca te pradāsyāmi putrān paramaśobhanān | |77|| athavāyamanugrāhyastavāśokataruḥ priye | anujñātā mayā devi kurvaśokataruṃ sutam ||78|| anukūlaṃ patiṃ jñātvā taṃ tāmarasalocanā | praṇipatyāvyayā tuṣṭā idamāha maheśvaram ||79|| deva jānāmyahaṃ dharmaṃ yathā strīṇāṃ na vidyate | daivataṃ patimutsṛjya pūjanīyaṃ hi yad bhavet ||8.158.80|| anāmantrya hi bharttāraṃ yaddadāti yadarcati | na phalaṃ vindate tasya nārī ityeva naḥ śrutam ||81 || yā tu bhartāramāmanpaya nārī dharma samācaret | tasyā devāśca tuṣyanti dharmaśca sumahān vibho | |82| | avamanya tu yā nārī bhartāraṃ daivataṃ gurum | svabuddhyā kurute puṇyaṃ nirayaṃ sā prapadyate | |83 | | atītamapi yā nārī bhartāraṃ paripṛcchati | anumānya yathāvaddhi jīvantamiva śobhanā | |84| | anujñātā hi sā tena prīyamāṇena cetasā | dharmakṛtyeṣu deveśa phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam | |8 5| | tapopavāso dānaṃ ca ārjavaṃ satyameva ca | patiśuśrūṣaṇasyaite kalāṃ nārghanti ṣoḍaśīm | |86| | yā hyanyanaralolāpi sadbhāvācchayanāsane | śuśrūṣāṃ kurute bhartuḥ sā satyeva vibhāvyate ||87|| ityevaṃ giritanayā girīśamuktvā giryagre giritarupuṣpapuñjacitre | tenāgyrā saha vicacāra cārurūpā bhānorbhā iva saha bhānunā bhavānī ||88|| iti tau surapūjitāvaparasparapūjitau | sahitau praviceratuḥ pravareśvaravanditau | |89| | iti skandapurāṇe bhūmijaputravarṇane aṣṭapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.159> sanatkumāra uvāca pārvatyā niścayaṃ jñātvā bhagavān tryambakastadā | sumāliṃ piṅgala yakṣaṃ prāha vākyavidāṃ varaḥ | | 1 | | bhaktimantaṃ mahāyogaṃ purā labdhavaraṃ gaṇam | pārśvasthaṃ nandinaṃ tatra bhagavān śaṅkaraḥ svayam ||2| | parvatendrasutāśokaṃ taruṃ putraṃ grahīṣyati | tvayyāyattaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ tasmāt kuru mamājñayā |||3|| yatrāśokatarustatra yathānnamupalakṣitam | bhavet supracuraṃ vīra tathā kuru gaṇeśvara ||4||(?) pradeśaśca girestasya yathā ramyo bhaviṣyati | tathā vidhatsva yakṣendra yatrāśokataruḥ sthitaḥ ||5|| ityuktaḥ parameśena piṅgalaḥ piṅgalekṣaṇaḥ | uvāca somayā sārdhaṃ tridaśānāṃ patiṃ patim ||6|| gaṇādhipa yathājñaptaṃ tat kariṣyāmi yajñahan | yathā somaḥ sa nandī ca prasanno me bhaviṣyati ||7|| ityuktvā sobhyanujñāto yakṣo lokāntadastadā | tasyāśokataroḥ pārśve vidadhāvannamuttamam ||8|| sumālāvatha niṣkrānte siṃhakrodhastrilocanaḥ | nandinaṃ tejasāṃ rāśirdiṇḍi caṇḍeśvarobravīt ||9|| brahmaṇyān brahmaṇān nandin devī yajñena yakṣyati | śvaḥ prabhāte mahābuddhe tatra vipraiḥ prayojanam ||8.159.10 || sa tvaṃ matprahito deva yatra yatra vadāmyaham | tatra tatra gato viprān nimantraya padatraye ||11|| audakāyāṃ virūpāsya brāhmaṇā brahmasaṃbhavāḥ | upāsate ye varuṇaṃ pātālatalasaṃśrayāḥ ||1 2|| ye surevyāsurādyāśca rasāvayavamuttama | pibanti phenapā nāma tānnimantraya mā ciram ||13 || saṃyamanyāṃ tathā caiva ye yamaṃ paryupāsate | brāhmaṇā brahmaṇā tulyāstānnimantraya bhūtapa ||14|| tathodayagireḥ śṛṅge satyo nāma mahāhradaḥ | rājahaṃsānucaritaḥ kāntatāmarasāvṛtaḥ ||15|| vasanti yatra te satyāḥ satyānāma tapodhanāḥ | satyena yeṣāmādityo dinaṃ nayati nityaśaḥ ||1 6|| teṣāṃ niṣkalmaṣastasmin hrade snāto divākaraḥ | pratyahaṃ kurute devaḥ prayāṇaṃ śubhakarmakṛt ||17|| teṣāṃ praṇamya śirasā hyātmānaṃ sannivedya ca | sadbhāvaṃ darśayannagre nandīśvara nimantraya ||18|| ye cādityarathaṃ śaśvat parivārya vrajantyuta | atharvāṅgirasastāṃśca nimantraya gaṇa dvijān ||1 9|| ye ca cakracarāḥ siddhā ye kapotoñchavṛttayaḥ | upāsate ye ca śakraṃ tānāmantraya vai dvijān ||8.159.20 || tato brahmasado gatvā brahmaṇyān brahmaṇaḥ priyān | brahmāṇaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca nimantraya ||21|| kṣīrodavelānilayāstapovananivāsinaḥ | brahmaṇo bhavanādetya bālakhilyān nimantraya ||22|| ye māṃ sadārāḥ sasutāḥ sāgnihotraparicchadāḥ | bhaktā yeṣāmahaṃ nityaṃ prasādasumukhograṇīḥ ||23|| tān bālakhilyān vāgīśa vyālāniva durāsadān | āmantraya yato bhūtvā suyaśāḥ suyaśāpate ||24|| sañcaram̐śca tribhuvanaṃ vāyuravyāhato yathā | yānyataḥ paśyase viprān sarvāneva nimantraya ||25|| ye cāpi pramathāḥ kecid gocare te surārihan | te ca sarve samāyāntu viprāṇāṃ pariveśakāḥ ||26|| kapardinaivamuktastu nandī sūryasamaprabhaḥ | śūlaṃ jvalantamudyamya prayayau varuṇālayam | |27| | sāgaraṃ sombarākāraṃ sāmbarombagocaraḥ | āsasāda pravalgantaṃ raṅgasthamiva vāraṇam | |28| | sa taṃ timiśatākīrṇamarṇavaṃ pramathāgraṇīḥ | praviveśa pradīptorkaḥ payodanicayaṃ yathā | | 29|| sutale sa tu pātāle gāṃ gajendrendravikramaḥ | apaśyat kṣaratīṃ kṣīraṃ divyaṃ tadamṛtākaram | 8.159.30 || surabhīmabhivādyaiva śaṅkarānucarorihā | viveśa nandī varuṇo yatrāste sagaṇorcitaḥ | |3 1 || sa divyavastrābharaṇaṃ putrapautragaṇānvitam | apaśyadambugoptāmādityayutasannibham | | 32 | | varuṇaṃ dvārapālena pūrvameva niveditaḥ | praviveśa tadā nandī varuṇasya niveśanam | |3 3 || sa cāpyapāttadā (?) rājā dūrādeva prahṛṣṭavat | dṛṣṭvā nandinamuttasthau pūjayanmanmathārdanam | |34| | tasyārghaṃ gāñca pādyañca nivedya varuṇaḥ svayam | āsīnaṃ tamapāṃ goptā papraccha vadatāṃ varaḥ | | 35 | | bhagavan kiṃ cirasyādya tvayā vayamapekṣitāḥ | darśanaṃ devadevasya manyāmastava darśanāt | | 3 6| | vivakṣoriva te vaktramindragopāyatenagha | vada sarvānabhiprāyān kartā tehaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | |37|| varuṇenaivamuktastu tatpareṇa śilādajaḥ | tataḥ sa varuṇaṃ prāha dānavairaparājitam ||38 | | aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | krīḍārthamumayā sārdha nimantrayati te haraḥ ||3 9| | taddeva putrābhivṛtaḥ sadāraḥ saha phenapaiḥ | śvo yāhi mandaragiriṃ prītiṃ varddhaya śūlinaḥ | |8.159.40 || ityuktvā sobhyunujñāto varuṇena gaṇeśvaraḥ | niṣkrānto varuṇāvāsācchvetābhrādiva bhāskaraḥ | |41 || sa pūjyamānaḥ siddhaiśca cāraṇaiśca surairapi | prāpodayagiriṃ nandī hareṣustripuraṃ yathā | |42|| sotha tasya gireḥ śṛṅge rañjite tāpanaiḥ karaiḥ | nililye garuḍaḥ pakṣī prabhañjanapathe yathā | |43 | | hradaṃ tatrārṇavākāraṃ kāñcanāmbujaśobhitam | śīrṇotpalataraṅgāḍhyamapaśyatsopsarovṛtam | |44| | hradasya tasya rodhassu sāśokeṣu sahasraśaḥ | apaśyata ṛṣīn satyānādityāyutasannibhān | |45| | sa tān tapodhanān dṛṣṭvā tapanābhān tapodhanān | nandī prahvāñjalipuṭo hyāsādyāvandata dvijān ||46| | te sarve niyamān hitvā niyamasthāstapodhanāḥ | nandinaṃ samayujyanta vāsadrumamivāṇḍajāḥ | |47| | taiḥ sūryakiraṇāpītaiḥ pītacīrāmbarairapi | saṃvṛtaḥ sa babhau nandī jambudvīpa ivācalaiḥ | |48| | sa pūjyamāno gaṇapaḥ satyaḥ satyaistapodhanaiḥ | atīva prababhau vyāsa tīrtheṣviva maheśvaraḥ | |49| | te nandinaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ satyaṃ satyāstapodhanāḥ | ūcurharṣākulairvākyairvismitānanalocanāḥ | |8.159.50 || nandīśvara cirasyādya hyudayo hyudayaprabhaḥ | samākrāntastvayā tāta dharmeṇa nirayo yathā ||51 || kimihānagha deveśastrinetrastripurārdanaḥ | vihartumāgato devo dṛṣṭosmābhistato bhavān | |52| | satyaṃ sucaritaṃ śuddhaṃ taposmābhirgaṇeśvara | sahomaṃ yat tvayā sārdhaṃ drakṣyāma iha śaṅkaram ||53 || evaṃ kapīndravadano vandamānām̐stapodhanān | sa satyān satyavacana idamāha śilādajaḥ ||54| | ...mandaraṃ śailaṃ na kathañcittyajedajaḥ | ahantu kāryavānāgāṃ yuṣmākamimamāśramam ||55|| aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | nimantrayati vastatra savāñcharvo dvijottamān ||56| | mānayanto bhavaṃ sarve sāmbamambāpatiṃ drutam | śvo gacchata taponityā mandaraṃ dharaṇīdharam ||57|| tatra śarvamamarādhipaprabhuṃ tārakādhipavibhūṣaṇaṃ śivam | drakṣyatheśamasurapramardanaṃ devatārtinikhilaṃ haraṃ haram | |58| | iti skandapurāṇe taruputrakagrahaṇe brāhmaṇāmantraṇe ūnaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.160> sanatkumāra uvāca āmantrya tānṛṣīn sarvān satyavīryayaśaḥśrutān | nandī visarjitastaistu yayau sūryarathaṃ prati ||1 || sa taṃ saptottamahayaṃ śakuntavarasārathim | harājñayā raviṃ devamupāsarpata bhūtapaḥ ||2 || sūryaraśmisahasreṣu tāpasān sa marīcipān | apaśyat sa sukhāsīnān chāyāsviva vihaṅgamān ||3 || tataḥ sūryarathaṃ śīghramupetyāruṇasārathima | soṃśumālinamatriñca atharvāṅgirasāvapi ||4|| devānṛṣīn bhujaṅgām̐śca aśvām̐ścāmantrayacchubhaḥ | ādityāśvādibhirnandī rudrapiprīṣubhistadā | 5|| tathetyuktopacakrāma sūryavāhādatha drutam | devānṛṣīn bhujaṅgām̐śca tata āmantrya bhūtapaḥ | |6|| sa vāyuriva śīghrastu garuḍo vā yathāṇḍajaḥ | dhaneśabhavanaṃ nandī kailāsaṃ samupāgataḥ | |7|| sa taṃ pāṇḍaramedhābhaṃ kundendurajataprabham | parvataṃ dhanadāvāsaṃ paśyamānaḥ prahaṣyata ||8| | sa bhūteśo dhaneśasya girośavacanaṅkaraḥ | āsasāda nagasyāgre bhavanaṃ kāñcanaṃ śubham | |9| | kailāsāgre sanniviṣṭaṃ kailāsāgrasamatviṣam | harmyaprāsādasaṃpannaṃ sampannamiva bhāsitam || 8.160.10 | | patākābhirdhvajaiścāpi kiṅkiṇījālamālibhiḥ | hāsaiśca puraghoṣāṇāṃ sannāditamaharniśam | |1 1 | | bheryā paramaghorāṇāṃ vāditraśatanāditam | ijyādhyayanasaṃpannāstiṣṭhantyatra sabhāsadaḥ | |1 2|| bhābhirjuṣṭāṃ sabhāṃ tasya tato rudrasabhāsadaḥ | āsasāda sa yatrāste munerviśravasaḥ sutaḥ || 13 | | tamṛddhyā parayā yuktaṃ sevyamānaṃ śriyā tathā | apaśyad dhanadaṃ nandī divyastrīgaṇasevitama ||14|| śuktikaṇaṃ śuktikarṇairyakṣendrairabhisavṛtam | upagīyamāna gandharvairekapiṅgāyatekṣaṇamū ||15|| maheśvarasakhatvena varadānamadena ca | mādyantaṃ svarṇayā naddhamālayāmalalolayā ||16|| dhanadaścāpi taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkarānucaraṃ varam | pūjayañchaṅkaraṃ soma mutpapātāsanād drutam ||18|| svarṇādutpatamānastu āsanād dhanado babhau | sāśokādiva puṣpāḍhyādudagrāt parvatādraviḥ ||18|| tamutpatantamutpeturyakṣā yakṣapatiṃ drutam | grahā yathā dīpyamānā dinahānau grahādhipam ||19|| nandine sa tadārghañca pādyañcāvedya vittadaḥ | saputradāraḥ sāmātyaḥ praṇeme manasā haram ||8.160.20|| tataḥ kathā bahuvidhāḥ kṛtvoddiśya maheśvaram | papraccha dhanado nandiṃ cirasyāgamanaṃ kṛtam ||21|| nandyuvāca aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | nimantrayati tatra tvāṃ draviṇeśa maheśvaraḥ ||22|| śvaḥ saputraḥ sadāraśca sānugaḥ sāpsarogaṇaḥ | mandaraṃ yāhi vitteśa deveśaḥ prīyate tvayā ||23 || evamāmantrya dhanadaṃ dhanadena visarjitaḥ | yayau saṃyamanīṃ nandī yamasya yamasannibhaḥ ||24|| sa yamaṃ dharmavaktāraṃ hartāraṃ prāṇināṃ prabhum | sāgniṃ sadharmaṃ savyādhimapaśyad gaṇanāyakaḥ ||25|| āyāṃtaṃ nandinaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamo bhūtaśatāvṛtaḥ | pādābhyāṃ nandinaḥ sotha nipapāta tutoṣa ca ||26 | | rudrasyeva yamastasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā hyanuttamām | papraccha nandinaṃ yatnāccirasyāgamanaṃ kṛtam | | 27|| nandyuvāca aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | tatra tvāṃ sānugaṃ devo nimantrayati śaṅkaraḥ ||28 | | ye caiva viṣaye hyasmin nivasanti dvijātayaḥ | tām̐ścāmantrayate devaḥ saṃmānya bahumānataḥ | | 29|| kalyaṃ sa bhagavān kalyaḥ kālaḥ kālapriyaṃ girim mānayan prabhumīśānaṃ gantumarhasi mandaram | | 8.160.30 | | tathetyukto yamenātha taiścāgnisadṛśairdvijaiḥ | sūryātmajagṛhānnandī śakralokaṃ tato gataḥ || 31 | | sukṛtīnāṃ tamāvāsaṃ vāsavaṃ lokamadbhutam | viveśa tvaritaṃ nandī ditigarbhaṃ yathāhihā | |3 2|| sa sudharmā sudharmāyāṃ sudharmamamarairvṛtam | gāndharvamupaśṛṇvānaṃ nandī śakramapaśyata ||3 3 | | śakraśca nandinaṃ devaṃ devadevasya kiṅkaram | harṣānnetrasahasrasthaṃ kṛtvā samyagapaśyata || 34|| sa pūjāṃ rudrasadṛśīmavāpya tridaśeśvarāt | upāviśadameyātmā śakrābhyāse varāsane | | 35 | | tamāsīnamupāsīnaḥ śatakraturarindamaḥ | pibannetrasahasreṇa na tṛptiṃ sobhyagacchata || 36 | | tato vṛtrabalāristaṃ nandinaṃ dinakṛtprabham | paryapṛcchata harṣeṇa kiṃ cirādāgato bhavān | | 37| | ityuktaḥ sa tu devena devaḥ svarganivāsinā | mandāravāsitovyagraḥ provāca kuliśādharaḥ ||38| | aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | tatra tvāṃ sāmaraṃ devo nimantrayati bhūtapaḥ |3 9|| dvijapūrvaṃ dvijā ye ca tavālayanivāsinaḥ | saputradārām̐stām̐ścāpi nimantrayati śaṅkaraḥ ||8.160.40 || śvassaputraḥ sadārastvaṃ devadevasya śāsanāt | mandaraṃ gaccha deveśa girīśamabhinandaya | |41 | | tvayi yāte suraśreṣṭha aśokatarukotsave | prītiṃ yāsyati deveśaḥ parāṃ suranarārttihā ||42| | śitaśūladharaṃ pinākinaṃ girirājendrasutāpatiṃ prabhum | praṇipatya maheśamūrjitaṃ punarevaiṣyasi nākasaṃsadam | |43 || iti skandapurāṇe viprāmantraṇe ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.161> sanatkumāra uvāca śakreṇa tu kṛtānujño nandī pramathanāyakaḥ | brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ gantuṃ matiṃ dadhre mahādyutiḥ || 1 || sa muhūrttānmahāvego mahāvega ivānilaḥ | vairājaṃ bhavanaṃ prāptaścaturvaktrasya pārṣadaḥ ||2|| hataklamāṃ sa tu sabhāṃ sabhāṃ merugireriva | viveśa nandī tejasvī divākarakaro yathā | |3 || tāṃ kathāmiva citrārthāṃ citrārthairbahubhiryutām | dadarśa sa sabhāṃ nandī bahvāścaryasamākulām | |4| | tasyāṃ sabhāyāmālīnaṃ yatibhissaha sodbhutam | apaśyadabjajaṃ nandī devaiḥ pañcabhirāvṛtam | |5| | vedārthaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ taṃ yatīnāṃ paripṛcchatām | tām̐śca bhāṣyavidaḥ sarvān śrutvā sādhviti vādinaḥ | |6| | nandī pitāmahaṃ samyak pūjayāmāsa satvaram | tataḥ pitāmahaḥ prāha nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam | |7| | kiṃ cirādāgatosīti sa ca taṃ pratyabhāṣata | aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati ||8 | | bhagavam̐statra devastvāṃ nimantrayati śaṅkaraḥ | imāṃśca tapasāgnyābhān savedān vedavādinaḥ | |9|| nimantrayati deveśo yajñakoṭīnimantritaḥ | yatibhissaha sarvastvaṃ mandaraṃ citrakandaram | | 8.161.10 | | vraja mānada devānāmevamājñāpayatyajaḥ | ityevaṃ vacasāṃ kartā vacaḥ śrutvā sa nandinaḥ | |1 1 | | japyapriyamuvācedaṃ hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pitāmahaḥ | nandīśvara vrajasva tvamavighnena śivena ca | |1 2| | ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi ebhissaha śivāntikam | mokṣyate cāpyaśokosau dakṣaśāpakṛtaṃ tamaḥ || 13 || putrī himavato devī yaṃ grahīṣyati putrakam | ityuktaḥ pratimānyeśamīśasya dayitograṇīḥ | |14|| brahmaṇo bhavanāttūrṇaṃ kṣīrodamudadhiṃ yayau | mālāmiva samudrasya sa tu velāmamālinīm | | 1 5| | gaṇeśvarasadomukhya āsasāda durutsahām | sa velānilayān viprān vālakhilyām̐ stapodhanān ||1 6| | nānāniyamasaṃyuktānapaśyad gaṇanāyakaḥ vandamānaṃ tamālokya gaṇeśaṃ suyaśāpatim ||17 | āśībhiranukūlābhirnananduste tapodhanāḥ | tapodhanānāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ nandī madhyagato babhau | | 18|| grahāṇāṃ saumyarūpāṇāṃ yathā madhyagatoḍupaḥ | atha pādyārghyadānena phaladānena vaiva hi | |19| | saṃpūjya nandinaṃ devaṃ bālakhilyāstamabruvan | kutaścirasyāgamanamiha te pramathādhipa | kaccid drakṣyāma deveśaṃ sāmbamambāpatiṃ bhavam ||8.161.2 0 || tato nandī dvijaśreṣṭhān śreṣṭho vai pramathādhipaḥ | sālāṅkāramidaṃ vākyamabravīd dvijasaṃsadi | |2 1 || mandare sāmbiko devo nehāgacchati śaṅkaraḥ | iha cāgamanaṃ yanme tacchṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||22 || aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ giriputrī grahīṣyati | tatra vo gopatirdevo nimantrayati śaṅkaraḥ || 23 || śvaḥ sarve dārasahitāḥ saśiṣyatanayāgnayaḥ | mandaraṃ yāta viprāgryā māmambāṃ cānugṛhaṇata ||24|| ityevaṃ nandinā proktā bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ | deve bhakti prakarṣeṇa gaṇeśamidamabruvan || 25|| bho nandinnāgamiṣyāmaḥ śvaḥ prabhāte vayaṃ prabho | parvataṃ yāhyavighnena mandaraṃ cārukandaram | |26| | sa bālakhilyaiḥ praṇatobhipūjito nimantrya sarvān tripade dvijottamān | punarnivṛtobhijagāma mandaraṃ sa yatra devyā sahitovatiṣṭhate | |27| | atha bhuvanapatiṃ patiṃ surāṇāṃ giritanayāmukhapaṅkajadvirepham | dhanadavaradametya bhūtanāthaṃ gaṇapatinātha idaṃ tadāvabhāṣe | |28 | | divi ca bhuvi ca ye caranti viprāḥ śamadamasaṃyamaśaucasatvayuktāḥ | tripuradamana kālanāśa sarve tava vacanādvinimantritā mayā te | | 29|| iti skandapurāṇe taruputragrahaṇe viprāmantraṇaṃ nāma ekaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.162> sanatkumāra uvāca āmantriteṣu vipreṣu nārāyaṇapadatraye | nandinyatha nivṛtte ca gaṇayūthapayūthape | | 1 | | bhagavān kratukāmaghnaḥ pūṣṇo dantanipātanaḥ | mālī maulī balī kālaḥ kāle vacanamavravīt | | 2| | ambike jagataḥ sarve brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaḥ samāḥ | āmantritā varārohe kuru yatte manogatam | | 3 | | sa yatrāśokatarukaḥ putrakaste bhaviṣyati | tatra sajjīkaropyannamannadaḥ piṅgalaḥ priye | |4|| śvaḥ prabhāte yathā devi nandinā saha nandini | yāmośokataroḥ pārśvaṃ tathā kuru girīndraje ||5|| sākāśajalapātālaṃ jagajjanani tatra hi | piṇḍīkṛtaṃ tvaddhitārthe bhaviṣyati gireḥ sute || 6|| anena cāmantrayatā nandinā vai dvijottamān | krāntaṃ trivikramākrāntaṃ nārāyaṇapadatrayam ||7|| sohamasya varārohe vareṇye varadāyini | varaṃ dāsyāmi varade yadi te rucitaṃ priye ||8| | atha devī divonāthaṃ ḍiṇḍimuṇḍeśvaraṃ haram | avadadvaradaṃ kāntaṃ kāntaṃ candrārdhabhūṣaṇam | |9|| ayannandīśvaro deva āvayoḥ paramo hitaḥ | varakoṭīsahasrāṇi tvattorhati na saṃśayaḥ | |8.162.1 0 || varado hyasi lokānāṃ lokānāmapi ceśvaraḥ | yadi tuṣṭosi śailāderdiśasva pravaraṃ varam | | 11 | | kṛttivāsāstato devo mūrdhnyupāghrāya nandinam | uvāca pramatheśānaṃ vriyatāmīpsito varaḥ | |1 2 || tataḥ kapīndravadanaḥ sureśasadṛśadyutiḥ | praṇamya śirasā prāha nandī śaṅkaravallabhaḥ ||1 3| | prabhāvāttava deveśa varadāsmyajarāmaraḥ | bhogavān pūjitaḥ pūjyairdevadānavakinnaraiḥ ||14| | kiṃ me vareṇa yohaṃ te varakoṭiprapūjitau | paśyāmi caraṇau śarva sāmbasya pramathārcitau || 15|| vareṇa tu mamānena gopate yadi tuṣyasi | nityā bhavatu me bhaktistvayi sāmbe maheśvara || 1 6| śiṣṭānāṃ madviśiṣṭānāṃ gaṇānāṃ gaṇapādhipaḥ | tvayā kṛto devavara kimatonyat kariṣyasi | | 17| | ityevaṃ nandinaṃ devo bhāṣamāṇaṃ tadā natam | prītyāpaśyad virūpākṣaḥ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharaḥ || 18 || tatotpalanikāśena kareṇa bhagavān haraḥ | pramṛjya prāha harṣeṇa harṣayan nandinaṃ bhṛśam | | 1 9| | bhaktimānasi me nandin sadāraṃ sagaṇāśrayam | tāṃ ca bhaktiṃ puraskṛtya pārśvasthosi mayā kṛtaḥ || 8.162.20 || satyāddharmāttapodānād gobhyo vedebhya eva ca | ebhyo me tvaṃ priyataraḥ sarvebhyo gaṇapeśvara | | 21 | | prabhāte yaśca te nāma kīrtayiṣyati lokapa | sośvamedhasya ca phalaṃ samyagiṣṭasya lapsyate ||22| | yaśca tvāṃ dveṣṭi vidviṣṭaḥ sa me dharmaratopi hi | yasya tvaṃ dayitosau me dayitastu bhavet sadā | |23 | | namo nandīśvarāyeti procya yaḥ svapsyate naraḥ | tasya kuṣmāṇḍarājebhyo na bhaviṣyati vai bhayam || 24| | ityevaṃ bruvatastasya nandīśvaraguṇastavam | brahmaṇastanuratyugrā sandhyā samabhivartata | | 25 || saṃdhyākālantu kālajñaḥ kālaḥ kālanihā haraḥ | upoḍhaṃ vīkṣya nṛttasya devaḥ kālamamanyata | | 26| | upaspṛśya tataḥ sodbhirapāṃ sraṣṭā trilokapaḥ | anvāsta bhagavāni sandhyāṃ lokasaṃsthāṃ nu pālayan ||27 prasāritakaro devo nyastajānukamaṇḍalaḥ | prasaritakaro vyomni divākara ivābhavat | |28| | japtvā tu paramaṃ japyaṃ trivedarasasaṃbhavama | bhavaḥ pranṛttyaccaturaścaturaṃ caturānana | |29| | bharttāraṃ vīkṣya nṛtyantaṃ viṣaktakarapallavam | sahadharmacarī devī bharttāraṃ sānvanṛtyata | |8.162.3 0 | | dampatī vīkṣya nṛtyantau sāṭṭahāsaṃ gaṇāgraṇīḥ | prānṛtyata tato nandī devayoḥ prītimāvahan | |3 1 | | devamambāñca nṛtyantau nandinañca samīkṣya tu | pramathā nīlameghābhāḥ pranṛttāstūryanisvanaiḥ ||3 2| | tato bheryo jharjharāśca kikhirānakamaṇḍukāḥ | āḍambarā ḍiṇḍimāśca śaṃkhāścaiva prasasvanuḥ | | 33 || muhurmuhuḥ sādhayate nṛttaṃ caturamambikā | nandī visṛjate hāsaṃ pramathā nedurulbaṇāḥ | | 34| | tattūryavaraśabdāḍhyaṃ śivāśaniravākulam | sandhyāmukhaṃ babhau raudraṃ vaḍavāmukhasannibham | |35|| nanṛturjahasuścānye jajapuśca tathāpare | jaguścānyetimadhuraṃ gandharvā iva pārṣadāḥ | |3 6 | | tatombaratalāpīḍe pūrṇavimbetinirmale | mṛgāṅke hyudite candre candrāvayavabhūṣaṇaḥ ||37|| samāpya niyamaṃ devaḥ sāmbanandīśapārṣadaḥ | virarāmotsavāttasmāt pārvatīṃ cedamabravīt ||3 8|| uṣitvā śarvarīmetāṃ śarvaryamitavikrame | aśokatarukaṃ putraṃ tataḥ śvastvaṃ grahīṣyasi | |3 9| | dhāreyī sā sadarbhāyāṃ dharāyāṃ dhāraṇīdharā | suṣvāpa devavacanādekāṃ rātriṃ yatavratā | |8.162.40 | | tataḥ śatasahasrāṃśāvuditerkerkabhāvanaḥ | umāmāha prayāmeti yatrāśokaḥ sutaḥ sa te ||41 || tato bhagavatī dhanyā dhanadā dhanadārcitā | bhavamāha prayāmeti siñjamānavibhūṣaṇā ||42| | pādacāreṇa bhagavān pādapaṃ pādapālayaḥ | tamaśokataru prāpa sanandī sāmbiko haraḥ ||43 | | sa tatra piṅgalaṃ yakṣaṃ piṅgalānalasannibham | sādhayānaṃ dadarśānnamannadaṃ pramathaiḥ saha ||44|| athātra bhakṣyabhojyasya coṣyalehyasya ca prabhuḥ | sopaśyat parvataprakhyān rāśīn rāśividāṃ varaḥ | |45|| sa sādhitaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā yakṣeṇānnaṃ pinākadhṛk | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe sāmbikaḥ saha nandinā ||46| | tataḥ pitāmaho devaḥ saha devāpsaroragaiḥ | tatrāgānmudito bhūtvā yatra sāmbombikāpatiḥ ||47|| te praṇamya mahādevaṃ devāstenābhipūjitāḥ | parivārya tejasāṃ ślāghye naitaccitraṃ tvayi prabho | śaktā evaṃ na sajjante bhogeṣu sumahatsvapi | |44| | senāpatyebhiṣicyasva surāṇāmarthasiddhaye | vapuḥ (?) saṃmānayāmīha nāhamājñāpaye vibho | |45| | atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā puruhūtaṃ mahābhujaḥ | dvādaśākṣaḥ sahasrākṣamidamāhoruvikramaḥ | |46 | | mama prabhavati śrīmān lokānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ | ananyabhūrameyātmā vṛṣaketuḥ purandara | |47| | tamārādhya prabhuṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇājñāṃ śatakrato | tāmahaṃ pratipatsyāmi yāmasau dāsyati prabhuḥ ||48|| tasyābhiprāyamājñāya devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ | ājagāma sapatnīko didṛkṣustanayaṃ tadā ||49|| svāhayā sahito vahnirgaṅgā ca saritāṃ varā | kṛttikāśca susaṃhṛṣṭāḥ śvetaṃ śikhariṇāṃ varam ||8.163.50|| yugapatte tadā tatra śvetasya śikharottame | cintayāmāsurāyāntaḥ kannu skandobhiyāsyati ||51 || atha teṣāmabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā matimatāṃ varaḥ | ṣoḍhā samabhavat skando yogīśo balavattadā ||52|| skandobhyagānmahādevaṃ viśākho himavatsutām | naigameṣo yayau gaṅgāṃ vahniṃ śākho mahādyutiḥ ||53|| svāhāṃ jagāma saṃhṛṣṭaḥ kākapakṣadharo guhaḥ | kṛttikāḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ śrīmān vegādabhisasāra ca ||54|| manorathān sa sarveṣāṃ devadevātmajaḥ prabhuḥ | yugapadyogināmīśaḥ pūrayāmāsa mūrtibhiḥ ||55| | atha tasmai dadau śambhurastragrāmaṃ caturvidham | sudhākaṇaparisrāvi cūḍāratnaṃ ca pārvatī ||56|| svamanonirmalāṃ gaṅgā viśuddhāmamṛtodbhavām | ekāvaliṃ dadau tasmai guhāyotphullalocanā ||57| | dviṣatprāṇaharāṃ gurvīmamoghāṃ havyavāhanaḥ | arciṣmatīṃ dadau cāsmai śaktiṃ śaktāya sūnave ||58|| patākāṃ mahatīṃ raktāṃ jvalatpāvakasaprabhām | kiṅkiṇīnāditāṃ divyāṃ prādāt svāhā mahātmane ||59|| supuṇyagandhāmutphullāṃ svarajaḥparipiñjarām | kṛttikāśca dadustasmai mālāmañcitakesarām ||8.163.60 | | athājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve pitāmahapuraḥsarāḥ | śvetādreḥ śikharaṃ ramyaṃ vṛṣaketuṃ didṛkṣavaḥ | | 61 || tānāgatān samaṃ sarvān tadā tatra divaukasaḥ | dṛṣṭvā saṃbhāvayāmāsa mahādevaḥ prasannayā | |62 | | praṇamya devadeveśaṃ labdhvānujñāṃ divaukasaḥ | śilāsu śaśigaurīṣu niṣeduramitaujasaḥ | |63 | | prottuṅgaśikharaḥ śveto dyutimānapi bhūdharaḥ | tejasāṃ sannipātena babhūva dyutimattaraḥ | |64| | atha pracoditaḥ sarvairvibudhairvibudhādhipaḥ | vyajñāpayanmahādevaṃ praṇamya vadatāṃ varaḥ | | 65| | tārakākhyena no lakṣmīrāmṛṣṭā prasabhaṃ prabho | vajraṃ vakṣaḥsthale tasya kaṭhine kuṇṭhatāṃ yayau || 66 || cakraṃ hareḥ sahasrāraṃ jvalitaṃ jvalitaujasaḥ | āsādya mṛdutāṃ bheje kaṇṭhaṃ tasyāmaradviṣaḥ || 67| | daṇḍo vaivasvatasyāpi pradīptānalabhāsvaraḥ | alātamiva toyaughe nirvāṇo dānavorasi | | 68 || samare ripudurvāro mahāpāśaḥ pracetasaḥ | tasya kaṇṭhe samabhavanmantreṇeva vaśīkṛtaḥ || 69| | utpāṭya prasabhaṃ tena nandane kalpapādapāḥ | niveśitā yathākāmaṃ svagṛhodyānabhūmiṣu ||8.163.70 || samīpe tasya sāśaṅkastālavṛntāyatenilaḥ | svapuṣpanikarairbhītā ṛtavastamupāsate | |71 | | havirbhuji hutaṃ havyamācchinatti balādasau | miṣatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ devadeva diteḥ sutaḥ | |72 | | abhiṣicya surāḥ skandaṃ senāpatye mahādyutim | jetumicchanti daityendra prasādāttava śaṅkara | |73 || evaṃ vijñāpitastatra vajriṇā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | dādāvanujñāṃ skandāya senāpatyābhiṣecane | |74|| atha vibudhasamūhairvandito vandanīyo madanatanuvihantā bālacarndrārdhamauliḥ | tanayamabhisamīkṣya snehasaphullanetraḥ śaśikiraṇasitādrerāśu sontarbabhūva ||75|| iti skandapurāṇe skandābhiṣekānujñāne triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.164> sanatkumāra uvāca atha te skandamādāya surā brahmapurassarāḥ | samantapañcakaṃ puṇyamājagmuramitaujasaḥ | |1 || tasmim̐stīre sarasvatyāḥ prāgudakpravaṇe same | vistīrṇe śvabhrapāṣāṇa kaṇṭakoṣaravarjite || 2|| skandasya paritaḥ sarve tadā saṃhṛṣṭacetasaḥ | niṣeduste suraśreṣṭhā jvalitānalavarcasaḥ | | 3 | | tat puṇyamamaraiḥ pṛktaṃ sthānaṃ puṇyataraṃ punaḥ | abhūd gāṅgairivāmbhobhiḥ sametaṃ yāmunaṃ payaḥ | |4|| ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ kṣitirmūrttimatī tadā | skandābhiṣeke sañjāte harṣasaṃphullalocanā ||5 | | athāsau kṣipramabhavad deśaḥ kanakabālukaḥ | vicitraḥ paritaścitraiḥ sphuradratnagabhastibhiḥ ||6 | adhyāsata mahātmāno yaṃ deśamapamatsarāḥ | nirastaduritaḥ sobhūttatra teṣāṃ vibhūtibhiḥ ||7| | atha siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ śātakumbhaṃ susaṃskṛtam | gṛhītvā giribhiḥ sārdhamājagāma himalayaḥ ||8|| ratnairoṣadhibhirgandhaiḥ pūrṇān puṇyaiśca vāribhiḥ | ādāya kalāśān haimān phullāmburuhamālinaḥ ||9|| udanvantaḥ susambhrāntāḥ pracalanmaṇikuṇḍalāḥ | ājagmustvaritāstatra hāravibhrājitorasaḥ ||8.164.1 0|| gaṅgā ratnamayām̐ścārūn kalaśān sphuritatviṣaḥ | haimāmbujakṛtottaṃsān pūrṇān paramavāriṇā ||1 1 || gṛhītvā saha sarvābhissaridbhissaritāmbarā | ājagāma tadā harṣāt praskhalantī sameṣvapi ||1 2|| abhiṣecanikān kumbhān grāhayitvā susaṃskṛtān | nānāratnaprabhodyotapratiraktārkadīdhitīn ||13 || devībhiḥ saha bahvībhirājagāma divaukasām | ākrāmantīva tejāṃsi tejasā svena pārvatī ||14|| adbhiḥ paramapuṇyābhiḥ pūrṇān ratnāṃśumālinaḥ | kalaśān sphāṭikān śubhrān grāhayitvā susaṃskṛtān ||15|| mukuṭaṃ ca mahacchralāghyaṃ dīptimaccāruvigraham | nānāratnavivitrāṃśusamūhasphuritodaram | |16|| hārañca nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ śaśāṅkakiraṇatviṣam | kāntaṃ muktāvitānañca cetohāri sunirmalam | |17|| abhyāgamattadā tatra prahṛṣṭo yādasāṃ patiḥ | dānavādhipamātaṅgaviṣāṇollikhitāṅgadaḥ ||18|| ratnāṅgadāni cārūṇi dyutimanti dhaneśvaraḥ | samādāyābhyagāt sāraṃ sarvāsāmiva sampadām | |1 9|| niśākarāṃśugaurāṇi dīrghāṇi rucimanti ca | ādāya ratnadaṇḍāni cāmarāṇi nahādyutiḥ || 8.164.20 || vaivasvatopi saṃpūrṇaśaraccandrāṃśunirmalam | prodvahan vakṣasā hāramājagāma tadantikam | |21 || ātapatrāpadeśena dadau tasmai mahātmane | phalaṃ surādhipatyasya samagramiva vāsavaḥ | |22| | bhūṣayantastarūm̐statra khapuṣpānekarodgamaiḥ | ṛtavastaṃ tadā deśamājagmustuṣṭacetasaḥ ||23 | | arundhatī śacī svāhā sinīvālī girīndrajā | aditirdevamātā ca niśā sānumatiḥ kuhūḥ ||24| | hrīḥ śrīḥ puṣṭirdiśo dyauśca sutāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpateḥ | rākā ca dhiṣaṇā caiva surabhirdevayoṣitaḥ | |25| | oṣadhyo mūttimatyaśca kauśiko vanadevatā | ahaḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ kalāḥ | | 26|| airāvaṇaḥ supratīko vāmanaḥ kumudoñjanaḥ | puṣpadanto mahāpadmaḥ sārvabhaumaśca diggajāḥ | ābhiṣecanikaṃ sarvamupaninyurmahātmanaḥ || 27|| jvalitavahnisamānaruco jaṭāḥ pariniyamya himācalavāsinaḥ | tamabhijagmurudīrṇatapobalā munivarā muditā dahanātmajam ||28 || vibudhasadmaratā jvalitaujasastridaśavanditapādasaroruhāḥ | ṛṣigaṇāstvaritābhiyayurguhaṃ niyamitorjitanityatapaḥkriyāḥ | |29|| samuditā muditotsukamānasāḥ kamalayonisutāśca mahaujasaḥ | tamabhijagmurudārayaśobhṛtastrinayanātmajamagryabalodayam | |8.164.3 0 | | abhiyayustvaritā bhujageśvarāḥ svaphaṇiratnamarīcivitāninaḥ | viṣabhṛtopyatisaumyavapurdharā dahanasūnumalaṃghyaparākramam || 31 | | upayayurgaruḍāśca vimatsarā bhujagarājasurūḍhabalodayāḥ | drutataraṃ taruṇārkasamadyutiṃ pavanavegavijihmitapādapāḥ | | 32 | | nanṛturāyatalolavilocanā vividhabhāvavilāsarasānvitāḥ | paramayauvanarūpaguṇānvitāḥ pramuditāḥ paritopsarasolasāḥ ||3 3 || vividhapuṣparajoruṇamūrttayaḥ surabhigandhavahā vivavustadā | virajasotitarāṃ mṛduvṛttayo vibudhacittasukhāśca samīraṇāḥ | |34|| ābhiṣecanikaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vidhiṃ tasya bṛhaspatiḥ | samiddhya jvalanaṃ samyak cacāra śarajanmanaḥ | |35 || āśīrbhirāśiṣāṃ dhāma samāśliṣya śivātmajam | stutyaṃ stutibhiragryābhistuṣṭuvurmunayastadā ||36|| maṅgalāni jagustasya gandharvā nāradaśca yaḥ | pratisārya tadā vīṇāṃ tāraṃ raktamanākulam || 37|| atha taṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇau gṛhītvā kṛtamaṅgalam | guruḥ siṃhāsane tasmin prāṅmukhaṃ saṃnyaveśayat | |38| | anāhatāstadā vyomni neduruccairdivaukasām | bhṛśaṃ dundubhayaścitrāḥ samyak cetopahāriṇaḥ | |3 9 || mattadvirephasaṃgītāḥ svakiñjalkāruṇatviṣaḥ | puṇyagandhā vicitrāśca nipetuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ | |8.164.40 || caturbhirvadanaiḥ skandaṃ stuvan gīrbhiḥ prajāpatiḥ | ādade kalaśaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrṇaṃ puṇyena vāriṇā | |41 || samādhāyāmbaraṃ pītaṃ tato viṣṇuḥ samādade | kalaśaṃ kaustubhamaṇeḥ parāmṛṣṭaṃ gabhastibhiḥ | |42|| tataḥ keyūraratnāṃśukhacitaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ | uttarīyaṃ niyamyāśu jagrāha kalaśaṃ tadā ||43 || nibadhya śaśilekhāṅkā jaṭā jvalanapiṅgalāḥ | jagṛhuḥ kalaśān rudrā bhujaṅgakṛtakaṅkaṇāḥ | |44| | bibhratopi parāṃ dīptiṃ sukhasaṃsparśamūrttayaḥ | ādityā jagṛhuḥ pūrṇān kalaśān puṇyavāribhiḥ ||45|| vasavopi surendrārigajadantakṣatorasaḥ | ādaduḥ kalaśām̐statra pūrṇān puṇyena vāriṇā ||46| | aśvināvapi puṇyābhiḥ pūrṇāvadbhiḥ susaṃskṛtau | ādadāte tadā kumbhau haimau ratnāṃśumālinau ||47| | kumbhānādadire tatra jvalanā jvalitatviṣaḥ | haimāmburuhasaṃchannān citrān ratnagabhastibhiḥ | |48| | nāgagandharvarājāno lokapālā marudgaṇāḥ | ṛṣayo bālakhilyāśca pitaraḥ patageśvarāḥ | |49| | dharmo dhātā vidhātā ca kālo mṛtyurvasundharā | sandhyā kāntirdhṛtirmedhā kīrtirlakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | |8.164.5 0 || samudrāssarito vedāstīrthāni girayo grahāḥ | kumbhānādadire tatra pūrṇān paramavāriṇā ||51 | | atha te hṛṣṭamanasaḥ prahṛṣṭaṃ pāvakātmajam | abhyaṣiñcan tadā sarve senāpatye mahaujasam ||52| | jayaśabdaṃ tataścakruḥ samaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ | jayinaḥ śarvaputrasya ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ ||53 || jagrāha maghavā tasya śvetamātapavāraṇam | sarvaratnaprabhāvrātavitānapariveṣavat | |54| | dudhuvuścāmarairdīrghaiḥ śaraccandrāṃśunirmalaiḥ | parito ratnadaṇḍaiśca lokapālā mahādyutim | |55|| amṛtādutthitaṃ divyamupanītaṃ pracetasā | maulimāropayāñcakre sutasya himavatsutā | |56| | hemāvadāte vistīrṇe śaśāṅkakiraṇadyutim | tasya vakṣaḥsthale hāraṃ babandha saritāṃ varā | |57| | hāreṇālaṃkṛtaṃ vakṣaḥ kinnu hāro guhorasā | iti tatra vitarkobhūttadā vibudhasaṃsadi | |58| | ābabandha mahābāhoraṅgadāni svalaṃkṛtā | bhujeṣu pāraṇālānastambhapīneṣvarundhartā | |59|| dīptimān pāvakasutastadābhūddīptimattaraḥ | sarpiṣā hūyamānena jvalitognirivādhvare | |8.164.6 0 || dadau tasmai caturvaktraḥ prabhuḥ prīto mahātmane | mahāpāriṣadān śūrān balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ||61 | | ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ suraktākṣaṃ nandiṣeṇaṃ ca durjayam | caturthaṃ balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ khyātaṃ kumudamālinam | |62 | | dadau sthāṇurmahāvīryaṃ mahāpāriṣadaṃ kratum | saṃpravṛtte tadā ghore saṃgrāme tārakāmaye ||63 || kruddho jaghāna daityānāṃ yoyutāni caturdaśa | vibudhāśca dadustasmai senāṃ nairṛtasaṃkulām | | 64|| daityayakṣakṣayakarīmajeyāṃ viśvarūpiṇīm | dadau vaivasvatastasmai mahāpāriṣadāvubhau ||65|| unmāthañca pramāthañca mahāvīryaparākramau | subhrājaṃ bhāsvarañcaiva dadau sūryonuyāyinau | |66| | kārttikeyāya saṃhṛṣṭo raṇe paramadurjayau | kailāsaśikharākārau śvetasraganulepanau ||67| | candramāpi dadau tasmai maṇiṃ sumaṇimeva ca | jvālājihvaṃ tathā jyotimātmajāya vibhāvasuḥ | |68 || dadau paramasaṃprītaḥ śatrusainyanibarhaṇau | parighaṃ paṭahaṃ bhīmaṃ dahātidahanau tathā ||69| | aṃśopyanucarān pañca dadau skandāya dhīmate | utkrośaṃ satvarañcaiva vajradaṇḍadharāvubhau ||8.164.70 || sutāya devadevasya dadau prītaḥ śatakratuḥ | cakraṃ vikramakañcaiva saṃkramañcātidurjayam | |71 | | dadau jvalanaputrāya viṣṇuḥ prīto mahāyaśāḥ | varddhanaṃ nandanañcaiva sarvavidyāntagāvubhau | |72| | skandāya dadatuḥ prītāvaśvinau ca mahābalau | kundaraṃ kumudaṃ cograṃ kumudañca mahābalam | |73 || ḍambarāḍambarau caubhau dadau dhātāgnisūnave | vakrānuvakrau balinau meṣāsyau durjayau raṇe | |74| | dadau tvaṣṭā mahāmāyau skandāyānucarāvubhau | suvrataṃ satyasandhañca dadau mitro mahātmane ||75|| suprabhañca mahāmāyaṃ śubhakarmāṇameva ca | prādādvidhātā skandāya śatrupakṣaniṣūdanau ||76|| pālintakaṃ mahāvīryaṃ kālakañca mahābalam | dadau pāriṣadau pūṣā skandāyāmitatejase | |77|| balañcātibalañcaiva mahākāyau mahābalau | pradadau kārttikeyāya vāyuḥ prīto mahātmane ||78 || ghasañca praghasañcaiva timivaktrau mahodarau | dadau jvalanaputrāya varuṇaḥ pāśadhāriṇau ||79| |
