suvarcasaṃ mahāvīryaṃ tathā cāpyativarcasam | himavān pradadau tasmai skandāyātibalāvubhau | |8.164.80 | | kāñcanañca mahāmāyaṃ tathā jīmūtamālinam | dadāvanucarau merurubhau jvalanasūnave | |8 1 | | sthirañcātisthirañcaiva tathā pariṣadāvubhau | punardadau mahāmeruḥ skandāyāmitatejase | |82 || ucchṛṅgaṃ ca viśṛṅgaṃ ca śilāpāṣāṇayodhinau | prādādvindhyo mahāsatvau skandāya jvalitaujase ||83 || saṃgrahaṃ vigrahaṃ caiva samudraśca gadādharau | pradadau kārttikeyāya mahāpāriṣadau tadā | |84| | unmādaṃ puṣpadantaṃ ca śaṅakukarṇañca durjayam | mahāvīryānmahāsatvān prādāt putrāya pārvatī ||85|| jayaṃ mahājayaṃ caiva dadurnāgā mahātmane | dadau ca paramaprītaḥ skandāya vṛṣavāhanaḥ ||86| | bahūnpāriṣadāñchūrān samare durjayānparaiḥ | gajakarṇaṃ nikumbhañca padmaṃ kumudameva ca | |87| | sanandaṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ tathā kṛṣṇopakṛṣṇakau | kṛtagrīvaṃ kapiskandhaṃ kāñcanākṣaṃ jalandhamam | |88 || akṣisantardanaṃ kuṇṭhaṃ pārśvagrīvaṃ mahodaram | ekākṣaṃ dvādaśabhujamekapādaṃ mahājaṭam ||89|| sahasrabāhuṃ vikacaṃ vyāghrāsyaṃ kṣitikampanam | pṛṣṭhavaktraṃ sunāmānaṃ pārśvānanamahānanau || 8.164.90 | | parisrutaṃ kokanadaṃ priyamālyānulepanam | ajodaraṃ gajaskandhaṃ skandhākṣaṃ śatalocanam | |91 | | jvālājihvaṃ karālaṃ ca śitakeśaṃ tatodaram | aṣṭajihvaṃ caturdaṃṣṭraṃ meghanādaṃ pṛthūdaram ||92 || vidyudakṣaṃ dhanurvaktraṃ jaraṭhaṃ mārutāśanama | udarākṣaṃ jhaṣākṣaṃ ca vajranābhaṃ ca suprabham ||93|| samudravegaṃ gokarṇaṃ śailakampanameva ca | patrameṣaṃ prabāhuṃ ca tathā nandopanandakau | |94| | dhūmraṃ śvetaṃ kaliṅgaṃ ca siddhārthaṃ varadaṃ tathā | priyakaṃ gardabhāsyaṃ ca gonardaṃ bhūtatāpanam ||95 || ānandaṃ ca pramodaṃ ca svastikaṃ dhruvakaṃ tathā | kṣepavāpaṃ sujātaṃ ca siddhayātraṃ mahāvaram ||9 6 | | govrajaṃ kanakāpīḍaṃ mahāpārśvaṃ mahodaram | gāyanaṃ hasanaṃ caiva bāṇakhaṅgadharaṃ prabhum | | 97| | vaitāliṃ cātitāliṃ ca tathā śaṭhikavātikau | māṃsajaṃ paṅkadigdhaṃ ca samudronmāthamavyayam ||98|| raṇotkaṭaṃ prabhāsaṃ ca śvetamūrdhānamacyutam | kālakaṇṭhaśarīrañca kuṣmāṇḍaṃ śatrutāpanam || 99 || gomāyuvaktraṃ śyenāsyaṃ bhūtalonmāthanaṃ tathā | yajñavāhaṃ pravāhaṃ ca kākāsyaṃ kākalocanam ||8.164.1 00 | | mañjulaṃ vakranāsaṃ ca mahānāsaṃ gajodaram | tuhanaṃ ca tuhānaṃ ca citradevamajaṃ kharam | | 101 | | madhuraṃ suprasādaṃ ca kirīṭaṃ bhakuṭotkaṭam | vasanaṃ madhuvarṇañca kalaśaṃ kalaśodaram || 102 || revantaṃ manmathakaraṃ sūcīvaktraṃ gajānanam | śvetavaktraṃ suvaktraṃ ca cāruvaktraṃ ca pāṇḍaram | | 103 || kaṇṭhabāhuṃ subāhuṃ ca bakaṃ kokilakaṃ tathā | acalaṃ kanakākṣaṃ ca balānāmagranāyakam || 1 04| | sañcāraṃ ca kokamukhaṃ gṛdhrāsyaṃ jambukaṃ tathā | lomaśañca jarāsyaṃ ca uṣṭragrīvaṃ kamaṇḍalum | |1 05|| daṇḍakaṃ dīrghavaktraṃ ca haṃsavaktraṃ mahābalam | ṭuṇḍukaṃ śatapādaṃ ca śatākṣaṃ cāpapṛṣṭhakram | | 10 6|| śikṣakaṃ cāpavaktraṃ ca śākhavaktraṃ ca kuṇḍakam | mahāyogānmahāsatvān satataṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ || 1 07|| apradhṛṣyānmahāvīryān samare ripusūdanān | nānāśastrapraharaṇān nānārūpān mahaujasaḥ | | 108 | | nānāvaktraiḥ parivṛtān gaṇaiśca gaṇanāyakān | gajendracarmavasanān vyāghrakṛṣṇājināmbarān | | 10 9|| raktakeśān hariśmaśrūn muṇḍān digvāsasoparān | jaṭinaḥ piṅganetrām̐śca bhujaṅgakṛtamekhalān || 8.164.110 | | pannagāṅgadinaḥ śūrāñchvasadbhogīndrakuṇlān | pāvanaiḥ paridigdhāṅgān bhasmabhiścandrapāṇḍaraiḥ || 11 1|| nṛtyato valgamānām̐śca hāsotphullavilocanān | gaṇaiḥ parivṛtānanyairbahubhirgaṇanāyakān || 112 | | kūrmakukkuṭavaktraiśca śaśagodhāvṛkānanaiḥ | kharoṣṭrāśvamukhairbhīmairvarāhamahiṣānanaiḥ | | 113 | | manuṣyameḍhavaktraiśca śvaśṛgālamṛgānanaiḥ | bhīmairmakaravaktraiśca śiśumāraruṣānanaiḥ | mārjāravṛkavaktraiśca dīrghavaktrairavaktrakaiḥ | |1 14|| lakulolūkacakrāhvaśatapatranibhānanaiḥ | ākhubabhru viḍālānāṃ tulyāsyai ripudurjayaiḥ || 11 5| | chāgameṣamukhaiścānyaiḥ śukakāraṇḍavānanaiḥ | ṛkṣaśārdūlavaktraiśca dvipisiṃhānanaistathā || 11 6|| bhīmairdviradavaktraiśca tarakṣuvadanaistathā | garuḍakroṣṭukāsyaiśca kākakokilavaktrakaiḥ || 1 17| | govānaramukhaiścānyaiḥ śyenagṛdhramukhaistathā | mahājaṭharapādāṅgaistārakākṣairmahābalaiḥ | |1 18 || pārāvatamukhaiścānyaiḥ kṛkavākumukhaistathā | lāvatittirivaktraiśca kṛkalāsamukhairapi || 11 9|| pītakauśeyavāsobhiścīravalkaladhāribhiḥ | phaṇīndrānaddhagātraiśca citragonasakaṅkaṇaiḥ | |8.164.1 20 | | sthūlodaraiḥ kṛśāṅgaiśca sthūlāṅgaiśca kṛśodaraiḥ | hrasvagrīvairmahākarṇairnānāvyālavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 121 | | gajendracarmavāsobhiḥ śūraiḥ samaradurjayaiḥ | skandhavaktrairavaktraiśca pṛṣṭhāsyaiḥ sarvatomukhaiḥ | |1 22| | nānākṛtibhujairvīrairnānābhujagabhīṣaṇaiḥ | nānāveṣai mahāyorgarnānāsthānanivāsibhiḥ | | 123 | | nānāvastradharaiścānyai rnānāmālyānulepanaiḥ | nānācarmāmbarairanyairnānābharaṇadhāribhiḥ ||1 24|| uṣṇīṣibhirmukuṭibhiḥ kambugrīvaiḥ susaṃsthitaiḥ | kirīṭibhiḥ pañcaśikhairjaṭāmukuṭadhāribhiḥ ||1 25|| triśikhairdviśikhaiścāpi tathā saptaśikhairapi | śikhaṇḍibhirdīrghajaṭairmuṇḍaiḥ kapilamūrdhajaiḥ || 1 26|| citrākṣakaiścitramukhaiścitrasraganulepanaiḥ | citrāmbaradharaiḥ vīraiḥ satataṃ priyavigrahaiḥ | | 127| | kṛṣṇanirmāṃsavaktraiśca dīrghapṛṣṭhaiḥ kṛśodaraiḥ | sthūlapṛṣṭhairmahāgrīvairlambodaramahodaraiḥ ||1 28|| mahābhujairmahāvaktrairhrasvagrīvaiḥ kṛśānanaiḥ | kubjaibhra dīrghajaṃghaiśca hastikarṇaśirodharaiḥ | |1 29| | dīrghoṣṭhardīrghajihvaiśca dīrghākṣairdīrghanāsikaiḥ | mahādaṃṣṭraiḥ sudaṃṣṭraiśca citradaṃṣṭrairmahābalaiḥ | | 8.164.130 | | suvibhaktaśaroraiśca dīptimadbhiḥ svalaṃkṛtaiḥ | piṅgalākṣairmahākarṇaiḥ śaṃkukarṇairakarṇakaiḥ || 131 || dīrghadaṃṣṭaiḥ pṛthūraskaiḥ sthūloṣṭhairharimūrdhajaiḥ | nānāpādoṣṭhadaṃṣṭraiśca nānāhastaśirodharaiḥ | | 13 2|| nānācarmabhirācchannairnānāvāsobhirāvṛtaiḥ | hṛṣṭaiḥ paripatadbhiśca nṛtyadbhiśca mahāravaiḥ | |1 33 || lambakarṇairmahoraskairnīlakaṇṭhai strilocanaiḥ | śukodaranibhaiḥ kaiścit kaiścidañjanasannibhaiḥ | |1 34|| śvetāṅgairlohitagrīvaiḥ piṅgākṣairbhīmadarśanaiḥ | kalmāṣapāṇipādaiśca jātīhiṅgulakaprabhaiḥ | | 13 5| | cāmīkarāpīḍanibhaiḥ śvetairlohitarājibhiḥ | rājāvarttasavarṇaiśca mayūrasadṛśaprabhaiḥ ||1 3 6| | pāśodyatakaraiḥ kaiścid vyāttavaktrai rmahāravaiḥ | piṅgākṣairnīlakaṇṭhaiśca mahāparighabāhubhiḥ || 137|| śataghnīśaktihastaiśca gadāmuśalapāṇibhiḥ | śūlāsipāṇibhiḥ kaiścinmahākāyairmahābalaiḥ 138 | | bhuśuṇḍīprāsahastaiśca vīraiḥ paraśupāṇibhiḥ | pāśamudgarahastaiśca cakratomarapāṇimiḥ | | 139 | citrāyudhadharairvīrairāvṛṇvadbhirdiśo diśam | ghaṇṭājālavinaddhāṅagaiḥ kiṃkiṇījāladhāribhiḥ | | 8.164.140 | | vṛtā gaṇairgaṇādhyakṣā mahāsatvairmahābalaiḥ | upatasthurmahātmānaṃ kārttikeyaṃ yaśasvinam | | 141 || mātṝśca pradadau tasmai kauśikīdehasaṃbhavāḥ | mahābalā mahāsatvāḥ samareṣvaparājitāḥ || 142 || prabhāvatīṃ viśālākṣīṃ palitāṃ vṛṣanāsikām | śrīmatīṃ bahulāṃ siṃhīṃ vijayāṃ bahuputrikām | |143 | | gopālīṃ suprabhāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ bṛhadambālikāṃ kṛśām | jayāvatīṃ mālatikāṃ dhruvaratnāṃ prabhākarīm || 144|| suprabhāṃ vasudāṃ caiva viśokāṃ nandinīṃ tathā | vajracūḍāṃ mahacūḍāṃ vajranemiṃ mahāprabhām | | 145| | añjanīñca bharatsenāṃ kamalākṣīṃ śaśiprabhām | śatruñjayāṃ mahānāsāṃ krodhanāṃ śalabhīṃ khaṣīm | | 146|| mādhavīṃ śukavaktrāñca kīrtinemimaninditām | gītapriyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ vāyasīmamṛtāṃ satīm | | 147| | sarasvatīṃ bhogavatīṃ subhrūñca kanakāvatīm | sutāṃ lakṣmīṃ vīryavatīṃ vidyujjihvāṃ mahābalām | | 148|| padmāvatīṃ sunakṣatrāṃ kandarāṃ bahuyojanām | santānikāṃ śivāṃ caiva kamalāṃ maladāmapi | | 149| sudāmāṃ bahudāmāṃ ca suprabhāṃ ca yaśasvinīm | nṛttapriyāṃ varārohāṃ sitolūkhalamekhalām || 8.164.150 || śataghaṇṭāṃ śatānandāṃ śatanetrāṃ yaśasvinīm | vapuṣmatīṃ ca śīlāñca bhadrakālīñca bhairavām | |1 51 || saṃhārikāṃ niṣkuṭikāṃ bhūtāṃ catvaravāsinīm | sumaṅgalāṃ svastimatīṃ vṛddhikāmāṃ janapriyām | | 152| | dhanadāṃ supradāṃ caiva bhavadāṃ sukhadāmapi | ailīṃ bhelīṃ samelīṃ ca vetālīṃ jananīṃ niśām ||153 || kaṇḍūṃ piṅgalikāṃ caiva devamitrāṃ yaśasvinīm | lambuṣīṃ sanakāṃ caiva citrasenāmathācalām | | 1 54| | kukūnikāṃ śaṃkhinikāṃ tathā jharjharikāmapi | kuṇḍālikāṃ kolavilāṃ kaṇḍarāñca śatodarīm | |1 55| | utkvāthanīṃ jurelāñca mahāvelāṃ ca kaṅkaṇām | manojavāṃ kaṇṭakinīṃ vighasāṃ pūtanāṃ tathā || 1 56| | vaiśayāṃ carcikāṃ vāmāṃ krodhanāṃ mukhamaṇḍikām | maṇḍodarīṃ ca ṭuṇḍāñca koṭarāṃ meghavāsinīm | | 1 57|| subhagāṃ lambinīṃ lambāṃ vāmadhūlīṃ vikatthanām | ūrdhvaveṇīdharāṃ caiva lalāṭanayanāṃ tathā | |1 58 | | pṛthubarhāṃ mahākāyāṃ madhukumbhāṃ taḍitprabhām | manthānikāmunmanikāṃ jarāyuṃ jarjarānanām | | 1 59|| khyātāṃ dahadahāṃ caiva tathā dhamadhamāmapi | khaṭaṃkhaṭāṃ mahāvīryāṃ vṛṣaṇāṃ maṇituṇḍikām || 8.164.160 || baddhaveṇīṃ dharādhārāṃ piṅgākṣīṃ lambakarṇikām | āmodāṃ ca pramodāṃ ca tathā lambapayodharām | | 161 || śaśolūkamukhīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kharajaṃghāṃ mahāravām | śiśumāramukhīṃ śvetāṃ lohitākṣīṃ vibhīṣaṇām | |162|| jaṭālikāṃ kāmacarīṃ dīrghajihvāṃ ca lolupām | kanelikāṃ vāsanikāṃ mukuṭāñca mahābalām | | 163 || lohitākṣīṃ mahākāyāṃ haripiṇḍīñca durjayām | paśudāṃ vittadāṃ vīrāmaṅgadāñca mahabalām | | 164| | payodāṃ gopradāṃ śaṃkhāṃ suniṣaṇṇāṃ tarasvinīm | pratiṣṭhāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ ca rocamānāṃ surocanām | |1 65|| gokarṇīmaśvakarṇīñca saśirāṃ kharikāṃ tathā | kacakracāṃ megharavāṃ meghamālāṃ virocanām | | 166 | | etāścānyāśca bahulā mātaro mārutasyadāḥ | ekākṣarāṃ sugandhāṃ ca kṛṣṇakarṇīṃ ca dāruṇām ||1 67|| kṣurakarṇīṃ catuṣkarṇīṃ karṇaprāvaraṇāṃ tathā | catuṣpathaniketāṃ ca gokarṇīṃ mahiṣānanām ||1 68 | | kharakarṇīṃ mahākarṇīṃ bherīsvanamahāsvane | śaṃkhakuṃbhaśravāṃ caiva saṃgrāmeṣvaparājitām | |1 69|| gaṇāṃ ca sugaṇāṃ caiva tathā vātīṃ ca kāmagām | catuṣpatharavāṃ caiva bhūtinīṃ vanyagocarām | |8.164.170 | | kārttikeyānuyāyinyo nānārūpāḥ sahasraśaḥ | dīrghadantyotinakhyaśca dīrghavaktrātibhīṣaṇāḥ ||171 || caturā madhurāścaiva yauvanasthāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ | māhātmyena ca saṃyuktāḥ kāmarūpā mahābalāḥ ||172| | nirmāṃsagātryaḥ śvetāśca jāmbūnadasamaprabhāḥ | kṛṣṇā jīmūtavarṇāśca dhūmrakeśyo mahābhayāḥ | |173 || asurāṇāṃ mahādaṃṣṭrā dīrghadaṃṣṭrāḥ sitāmbarāḥ | ūrdhvakarṇodharāścaiva piṅgākṣyo lambamekhalāḥ ||174|| lambodaryo vilamboṣṭhyo lamvakarṇapayodharāḥ | tāmrākṣyastāmravaktrāśca haryakṣyo harimūrdhajāḥ | |175|| vṛ kṣacatvaravāsinyaścatuṣpathaniketanāḥ | guhāśmaśānavāsinyaḥ śailaprasravaṇālayāḥ ||176 || nānābharaṇadhāriṇyo nānāsraganulepanāḥ | nānāvastrāṇi bibhratyo nānāyudhadharāstathā || 177| | etāścānyāśca saṃhṛṣṭā dadau skandāya kauśikī | vaijayantīṃ dadau tasmai mālāmañcitakesarām | | 178| | viṣṇurvividhagandhāḍhyāmutphullāṃ cārudarśanām | vāsasī virajaske ca taruṇārkasamaprabhe | | 179| | saṃprītā prītamanase dadau skandāya pārvatī | kamaṇḍaluṃ sudhāvārisaṃpūrṇamamṛtodbhavam ||8.164.1 80 | | dadau prītā kumārāya gaṅgā gambhīracetase | garutmān dayitaṃ putraṃ citrabarhaṃ śikhaṇḍinam | |181 | | dadau skandāya saṃprīto balinaṃ kāmarūpiṇam | tāmracūḍamadādvīramaruṇaścaraṇāyudham | | 182 | | bhavavīryajavopetaṃ skandāya priyadarśanam | mahābhārasahaṃ chāgaṃ kāmagaṃ kāmarūpiṇam | pradadau varuṇastasmai skandāya balavattaram ||18 3 | | brahmaṇyāya dadau brahmā medhyaṃ kṛṣṇājināmbaram | pramadāhāvavibhrāntaṃ locanodarasannibham | | 184| | tejasāṃ nidhaye tasmai dadau daṇḍaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | skandāya paramaprītaścārucāmīkarasrajam | | 1 85|| senāpatiṃ tamabhiṣicya hutāśaputraṃ samyak prahṛṣṭamanaso vibudhāḥ sametāḥ | daityeśvarasya nidhanāya mahāprabhāvā yātrāṃ surārijayinī sahitāḥ pracakruḥ | | 18 6| | iti skandapurāṇe senāpatyābhiṣeke catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.165> sanatkumāra uvāca skandaṃ purodhāya surāḥ samastāḥ sannāhayāmāsuranīkamāśu | āhatya bherīḥ śataśo mahadbhirdaṇḍairdṛḍhaṃ hāṭakaratnacitraiḥ | | 1 | | digvāraṇān bhūdharakūṭakalpān mandākinīvāribhirāplutāṅgān | ānāyya gandhairvividhaiśca mālyairabhyarccayāñcakruranīkamukhyāḥ ||2| | citrāṇi varmāṇi tato babandhurbadghvā prayatnātiśayena kakṣe | teṣāṃ suyatnād gajavājimukhyāna haimāni yantrāṇi tayāyudhānām | | 3 | | citrāḥ samucchiśriyire patākā dhvajāśca cāmīkaracārudaṇḍāḥ | kṣurapramālā vividhā babandhuḥ pakṣeṣu ghaṇṭāśca samāsasarjjuḥ | |4| | rathañca kārtasvaracārucakraṃ sāṃgrāmikaṃ ratnamarīcicitram | saṃyojayāmāsurudāraveṣaiḥ prahṛṣṭacittaiḥ khagamaisturaṅgai dve | |5| | paryacchamambhoruhagarbhagauraṃ babandha śakraḥ kavacaṃ mahārham | vakṣasyabhedye haricandanākte vajraprabhāprajvalitaprakāśam | | 6 | | babandhuruccairviniyamya piṅgā jaṭā bhujaṅgairbṛhatīḥ śvasadbhiḥ | citrāṇi hṛṣṭāḥ kavacāni rudrā vakṣassu daityadvipavikṣateṣu | |7| | citraṃ dadhānaḥ kavacaṃ mahādyutirnibaddhanistriṃśatalāṅgulitravān | bibhraddhanuḥ sajjamapīddhapauruṣo jahau śaśāṅkaḥ sahajāṃ na saumyatām | |8| | yatnād bandbadhuḥ kavacāni sūryāḥ kiñcitpradīptāni tadā svadīptyā | lauhānyabhedyāni śaraiḥ parāstaiścārūṇi cāmīkaracitritāni ||9| | nibaddhabhāsvatkavacaḥ sudhanvā supīnanistriṃśanibaddhapārśvaḥ | gṛhītadaṇḍo vinibaddhamaulirbhayānakobhūt sutarāṃ yamopi | | 8.165.10 || rucā parītaḥ parayātimātraṃ sphuranmuhuḥ pronnatapūrvakāyaḥ | parābhavaṃ vidviṣatāṃ samāje pracetasaḥ khyāpayatīva pāśaḥ | | 11 || dṛṣṭiṃ dhaneśopi hutāśapiṅgāṃ dadhad gadāyāṃ parighorubāhuḥ | īśaprasādena nijena veti suradviṣāmāhanane vināśam ||1 2| | sainyetha devadviṣatāṃ nipeturulkāḥ sphuradvahnikaṇā bṛhatyaḥ | vinā ghanairvyoma rarāsa bhīmaṃ savṛkṣaśailā vicacāla corvī | | 13 | | rajo nabhastaḥ paritaḥ papāta vāteritaṃ rāsabhapṛṣṭhadhūsram | dhvajā nipeturdṛḍhahemadaṇḍhā raktāmbuvṛṣṭiṃ sasṛjuḥ payodāḥ ||14| | muhurmuhurdainyaparitacitāḥ kaduṣṇamasraṃ mumucusturaṅgāḥ | kapolabhittīḥ prajahau gajānāṃ madaśca pārāvatakaṇṭhanīlaḥ | | 15 | | sthāneṣu dīpteṣu vineduruccairdīptasvarāḥ pakṣimṛgāśvasaṃghāḥ | prasādamālāḥ parito vimṛdran vavau vivṛddhaḥ paruṣo nabhasvān || 1 6|| senā prahṛṣṭā mahatī surāṇāmabhyāyayau daityapatiṃ rarāṇā | daityopi devāgamanaṃ viditvā sannāhayāmāsa tadā svasainyam | |17| | sainyāni tāni tridaśāsurāṇāmanyonyamāsedurudāyudhāni | kṣubdhānyatīva pralaye mahābdheḥ pūrvāparāṇīva tadā jalāni || 18| | niśāmya daityā raṇatūryanisvanaṃ prarūḍhagarvā balino jayotsukāḥ | atipraharṣādasamāptamaṅgalā gṛhītaśastrāḥ samarāya niryayuḥ || 1 9|| rathāśvapādātasamuddhataṃ rajo raṇājire vānarakaṇṭhadhūsaram | svanaśca teṣāmatidāruṇo mahān nabhastadā vyāpa diśaśca sarvataḥ | |8.165.20 | | samudyatairdānavadevatāyudhairdhvajaiḥ patākātapavāraṇaistathā | babhau savidyucchaśiśakrakārmukaṃ sahaṃsapaṃktīva tadā nabhastalam | |21 || śastrāṇi gātreṣu tanutravatsu nipātyamānāni parasparasya | daityāmarairāhanane pracakruḥ śabdaṃ sphuradvahnakiṇaiḥ sametam | |22 | | dṛṣṭvāsurān satvabalopapannān surāssahāyānanapekṣya kecit | sannehire mattagajānivebhā madāmbubhiḥ śyāmakapoladeśāḥ ||23 || balāni vegādabhisṛtya dūramagresarāṇi tridaśāsurāṇām | svajīvitāśāmapahāya jaghnuranyonyamāviṣkṛtapauruṣāṇi ||24| | nikāmavairāśayamānasānāṃ jighāṃsatā tatra paraspareṇa | sa saṃprahārastumulastadāsīt surāsurāṇāmanavo mahājau || 25| | sedurgajāstomaraśaktibhinnāsturaṅgamā bāṇahatā nipetuḥ | saphenamāsyai rudhiraṃ vamanto dṛḍhaprahārānmumuhuśca yodhāḥ ||26|| chinnāni peturniśitaiḥ kṣurapraiḥ sakuṇḍalānyānanapaṅkajāni | anyonyamāviṣkṛtadarparoṣairmahāhave dānavadevamukhyaiḥ | |27| | tā mātaraste ca gaṇā vicerurvipothayantaḥ samarerisaṃghān | muṣṭiprahāraistalapārṣṇighātairvikarṣaṇāveṣṭanapīḍanaiśca | .....................||28|| mātaṅgamukhyān dviradaiḥ prabhinnaisturaṅgamān vājibhiruttamām̐śca | rathān rathaiḥ pattigaṇān padātairgaṇā nijaghnuryudhi dānavānām ||29|| utpatya vegādiṣubhirgaṇendrā gajādhirūḍhān ditijendrayodhān | muṣṭiprahāraiḥ kuliśograpātairvibhinnamastiṣkavinirgatākṣān || 8.165.30 || paraśvadhaiścicchidurāttaroṣāḥ khaḍgaiścakarturbibhiduśca śūlaiḥ | mahādvipālānanitāntapīnaiḥ prapothayāñcakrurarīn bhujaiśca ||3 1 || devyopi tān daityagaṇān nijaghnurmahāsamāje samupāttaśastrān | utpatya vājipravarādhirūḍhān rathasthitān vāraṇadhūrgatāṃśca ||32|| pracukṣubhe tadbalamāsuraṃ tadā gaṇendraniṣpiṣṭabalāgranāyakam | gurutmataḥ pakṣasamīraṇāhataṃ mahāhradaṃ yadvadagādhamambudheḥ ||3 3 || athābhivīkṣya prasabhaṃ gaṇādhipairnihanyamānāni balāni tārakaḥ | ruṣā tadā tāmratarāyatekṣaṇaḥ samabhyagānmaulibalābhipālitaḥ ||34|| visphārya śakrāśanitulyanisvanaṃ ratnaprabhāprajvalitaṃ sa kārmukam | saṃchādayan bāṇatalairnabhastalaṃ marmātigaiḥ kaṅkamayūrapatribhiḥ || 3 5|| tasyāgamaṃ daityapaterviditvā tadānanādānalasūnuruccaiḥ | svapāṇisasthāmabhivīkṣya śaktiṃ vicitracāmīkaracārughaṇṭām ||36| | nabho vigāhya pradiśo diśaśca sa kārttikeyasya tadā ninādaḥ | manāṃsi devadviṣatāṃ prasahya vimohayāmāsa mahāsamāje ||37|| athāpatantaṃ samabhīkṣya tārakaṃ balena guptaṃ mahatā mahāhave | mumoca śaktiṃ jvalitānalaprabhāṃ vināśanāyāmaravidviṣāṃ guhaḥ ||38| | sā tena muktā jvalanātmajena jvālābhirāvṛtya nabho diśaśca | anekadhā vyomnyabhavat sughorā māyeva daityān parimohayantī || 39| | papāta vakṣaḥsu ca sahateṣu suradviṣāṃ citratanutrabhṛtsu | samaṃ samastaistvanivāryavegā vidārya corāṃsi viveśa tūrṇam | |8.165.40 | | devadviṣastebhihatāssamastāḥ paryastapṛthvāyataraktanetrāḥ | sandaṣṭajihvādharavihvalāṅgāḥ prāṇāñjahuḥ śoṇitamudvamantaḥ ||41 | | tamāṃsi yadvat savitā bhinatti samaṃ mayūkhairatiraskṛtāni | bibheda tadvad dviṣatāṃ balāni raṇājire śaktibhiragnisūnuḥ ||42| | nihatya devadviṣataḥ samastān raṇājire pronnatadarpavīryān | prabheva sūryaṃ paritapya lokān punastadā skandamiyāya śaktiḥ | |43 || dititanayasamūhaiḥ sārdhamāvipratāpaiḥ (?) samaraśirasi hatvā tāraka daityarājam | tridaśasamitimukhyaiḥ stūyamānaḥ prahṛṣṭaiḥ pratigamadamitaujāḥ śūlapāṇeḥ samīpam | |44|| iti skandapurāṇe tārakavadhe pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.166> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan sarvadharmajña mahāyogabalānvita | śrutametanmayā kṛtsnaṃ skandasya caritaṃ mahat ||1 | | tvattaḥ paramayogeśa guhyaṃ bhagavataḥ param | tataḥ paraṃ sa deveśastripurārirvṛṣadhvajaḥ | | 2 | | saṃpreṣya sahitaṃ devairmahāsenāpatiṃ guham | saṃnyasya devatāḥ skande kimanyadakarot prabhuḥ | |3 | | kva jagāma ca deveśaḥ kimuvācācalātmajā | kāni cainamumā prāha śaṃsaitat pṛcchato mama | |4| | sūta uvāca vyāsenaivaṃ tadā pṛṣṭa ākhyātumupacakrame | sarvāgamaparārthajño brahmasūnurmahātapāḥ | |5| | sanatkumāra uvāca saṃnyasya ṣaṇmukhe devān devadevo bhavastadā | jagāma sahito devyā mandaraṃ hemakandaram || 6 || ta tasthāvāsane tatra haime mahati suprabhe | nānāratnasamākīrṇe hemaśṛṅga ivocchrite ||7|| tasya pārśve sthitā devī rarāja himavatsutā | vyabhre viyati pūrṇendo rohiṇīva samīpagā | |8|| sovāca parameśānaṃ praṇamya girijā tadā | sahadharmacarī yasmāt priyā cāhamatīva te | |9| | pūrvapraṇayalabdhā ca tena pṛcchāmyaśaṅkitā | pāvanāni pavitrāṇi nāmāni tava kāmada | | 8.166.10 | | sārthāni śrotumicchāmi kathitāni tvayā vibho | evaṃ pṛṣṭastadā gauryā prāha sarvaṃ surādhipaḥ || 11 || sarvayajñaphalaistulyaṃ nāmnāmarthaprabodhanam | mama devi paraṃ guhyaṃ brahmādyā yadvijānate | | 1 2| | tat pravakṣyāmi te devi yena devatvamāpyate | rujaḥ sarvagato yasmād drāvayāmi jagatyaham | |1 3 || rodanaṃ hanmi yasmācca rudrastasmādahaṃ priye | saṃharāmi jagat kṛtsnamantakāle yato hyaham | |14|| mṛtyuharttā yataścāpi harastena prakīrttitaḥ | puraṃ śarīramākhyātaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiha | | 1 5|| sarvaprāṇigataṃ yasmāt tatpuraṃ śayanaṃ mama | tasmāt puruṣa ityeva mama nāma maharddhimat | | 1 6| | kadācinnaiva jātohaṃ na ca me janma yat kvacit | ajastatohamīśāni sarvadaiva prakīrttitaḥ | |17| | abhāvaṃ mayi gatvā tu jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | punarbhavati mattaśca bhavastena nirūpitaḥ | |1 8 || mahatāmapi devānāmahameva mahān yataḥ | na ca matto mahānanyo mahādevastato hyaham | | 19|| pālayāmi paśūn yasmāt sṛjāmi ca yadṛcchayā | teṣāñca patirevāhaṃ tasmāt paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ | | 8.166.20 | | īśa evāhamanyeṣāṃ na ca māmīśate pare | nayāmi ceśatāṃ bhaktānīśānastena kīrttitaḥ ||2 1 | | diśo hi mama vāsāṃsi sarvadikṣu vasāmyaham | vāsaścāhaṃ diśāṃ yasmād digvāsāstena saṃsmṛtaḥ ||22|| bhūtānāṃ śaṅkaro yasmāt tenāhaṃ śaṅkaraḥ smṛtaḥ | lokānāṃ śibakṛd yasmācchivastasmādahaṃ smṛtaḥ ||23 | | nīlaṃ yena mamāṅgasya saṃraktaṃ lohitatviṣam | nīlalohita ityeva tenāhaṃ parikīrtitaḥ ||24|| śūlī śūlena saṃprokto lakulena ca lākulī | rudreti kīrtite devi agniṣṭomaphalaṃ smṛtam | |2 5 | | haretyabhihite cāpi gosavasya phalaṃ labhet | bhaveti kīrtite sadyaḥ sarvapāpairvimucyate ||26 || puruṣeti paraṃ saukhyamajeti ca salokatām | īśāneti mahaiśvaryaṃ mahādeveti cākṣayam | |27 || digvāseti paraṃ mokṣaṃ śaṅkareti sukhaṃ mahat | śiveti śivamatyarthaṃ śūlīti paramaṃ balam | |28|| lākulīti parāṃllokān kīrtaryellabhate naraḥ | sarvayajñaphalānīha kīrttayannīlalohitam ||29| | labhate devi madbhakto mayi cāvāsamavyayam | evaṃ tat kathitaṃ vyāsa nāmnāmarthaprabodhanam | |8.166.3 0 || śūlinā devadevena devyāḥ priyahitecchayā | kimanyat pṛcchasi brahman vada yāvad bravīmi te | |3 1 | | vyāsa uvāca śvetajīvaprado rudra iti pūrvaṃ tvayā mune | proktaṃ paramadharmajña tanme brūhi samāsataḥ || 3 2|| pradadau kathamīśānastajjīvaṃ munaye vibho| kimarthaṃ kva ca yogeśa kaścāsau śveta ucyate ||3 3 || sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vatsa yathā dattaṃ punarjanma pinākinā | yamena hriyamāṇāya śvetāya vigatāyuṣe | |34| | āsīd darbhadhvajo nāma bṛhaspatisamo muniḥ | sarvavidyāvinītātmā yasya putraḥ kuśadhvajaḥ || 35| | babhūva sumahātejā viśvāmitra ivāparaḥ | priyastasyābhavatputraḥ śveto nāma mahādyutiḥ ||3 6| | tasya janmaprabhṛtyeva kuśaghvajasutasya vai | chāyevānapagā bhaktirbabhūva vṛṣabhadhvaje | | 37| | tiṣṭhato gacchataścāpi svapatastapyatastathā | sarvabhāvena deveśaṃ dhyāyan tasthau mahāmuniḥ | | 38 || atha kālena viprendra vipṛthurnāma dānavaḥ vavre duhitaraṃ gatvā śvetasya pitaraṃ balī ||39|| na ca tasmai sutāṃ prādāt tāmasau suravidviṣe | sa tena nihato rātrau balād darbhadhvajopi ca ||8.166.40 || jāmātā kāṃkṣitaścāsīt tena cakragadādharaḥ | viṣṇuḥ paramadharmātmā duhitrā cāsya suvrata | |41 | | tasya taṃ duhitā jñātvā hataṃ pitaramātmanaḥ | jagāma tapase sādhvī parahetormahāvratā | | 82 || śvetopi tattato jñātvā vairāgyaṃ paramāsthitaḥ | narmadātīramāsādya ekacitto jitendriyaḥ ||43 | | rūdramevārpitāvastha stanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ | tapyamānastapo ghoraṃ tasthau yuktastapodhanaḥ ||44 athāgāt sumahān kālastapyatastasya dhīmataḥ | āyuryadvihitaṃ dhātrā tattasya kṣayamabhyagāt | |45| | kṣīṇāyuṣamatho jñātvā śvetaṃ mṛtyuviceṣṭitam | suto vivasvato hṛṣṭaḥ kālamṛtyupurogamān ||46|| kiṅkarān preṣayāmāsa tamānetuṃ dvijottamam | tamathā bhyetya te dūtāḥ sthitāḥ śvetajighāṃsayā 47| | tān dṛṣṭvā sa tadā śveto yamadūtānavasthitāna | hāheti maraṇādbhītastrāsād duḥkhapariplutaḥ | |48| | anvacintayadavyagraḥ paritrāṇāya śaṅkaram | atha cintitamātrastu girīndraśikharasthitaḥ | |49 | | bhaktānugrahakṛddevaḥ śvetaṃ veda yamārdditam | taṃ tathā duḥkhitaṃ jñātvā bhaktaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam | |8.166.50 | | śaṅkaraḥ prahasan devīmidamāha sureśvaraḥ | śveto nāma munirdevi madbhaktastapasaidhitaḥ ||51 || kṣīṇāyurabhavanmūḍho mṛtyupāśavimohitaḥ | vyavasthaiṣā purā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā | | 52 | | prāṇināmāyuṣo hāniḥ kālasaṃsthānasaṃkṣaye | brahmāpi hi sṛjam̐llokān mūḍho bhavati śailaje | |53 | | mṛtyuduḥkhānvitām̐llokān yasmātsṛjati mohitaḥ | sopi bhakto mamātyantaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | | 54|| tasya bhaktiviśeṣācca gauravācca girīndraje | anujñātā mayāpyeṣā sṛṣṭirmṛtyusamanvitā ||55| | tathā tu sa munirdevi mayi sarvārpitakriyaḥ | ekabhaktitayā tasya dṛḍhaṃ prītosmi pārvati ||56| | trātā tasya bhaviṣyāmi jīvayiṣyāmi taṃ munim | tato bharturvacaḥ śrutvā girijā vākyamabravīt | |57|| evaṃ kuru mahādeva bhaktānugrahamīpsitam | śaraṇaṃ ko bhavedanyastasya bhaktimato muneḥ ||58|| evamuktaḥ sa pārvatyā devadevo kṛṣadhvajaḥ | nandīśvarapurogām̐stān gaṇeśān gaṇapādhipaḥ | |59|| śaṃkukarṇañca gaṇapaṃ tathānyāṃśca sahasraśaḥ | muneḥ śvetasya rakṣārthaṃ preṣayāmāsa śūladhṛk | |8.166.6 0 || mahābalāste gaṇanāyakendrā ājñāṃ gṛhītvā parameśavaktrāta | tūrṇa yayuḥ śvetamunerupāntaṃ dūtān didhakṣanta ivāntakasya | |61 | | te gatvā śvetamaikṣanta yamadūtairathādirtam | mṛgamekamivāraṇye vyādhairbahubhirāvṛtam | | 62 | | grīvāyāṃ kālapāśena hastapāde ca yantritam | mṛtyunā svayamākṛṣṭaṃ sravadrudhiracakṣuṣā | |63 | | vikṛtāsyairmahādaṃṣṭraissaṃraktaśmaśrumūrdhajaiḥ | vidyutsadṛśanetraiśca lohadaṇḍograpāṇibhiḥ | yamadūtairmahāghoraiḥ kṣipyamāṇaṃ samantataḥ | |64| | dṛṣṭvā tathā taṃ munimārttamuccaiḥ krośantamīśetyasakṛd gaṇendraḥ | mumoca pāśānmunimāśu tasmāt pāśātpaśūnāmiva bandhamīśaḥ || 65| | gacchadhvaṃ yamakiṅkarā munimitastyaktvā śarīrairdṛḍhaiḥ bhakto hyeṣa surāsureśvaramajaṃ śambhuṃ jagatkāraṇam | yaḥ sraṣṭā pavanāgniśakramarutāṃ brahmādibhirvanditastrātā sosya vṛṣendraketurajito nainaṃ yamo drakṣyati | |66|| te dṛṣṭvā gaṇapān dūtāḥ kālamṛtyupurassarāḥ | bhayānmuktvā muniṃ śvetamabruvan dūrataḥ sthitāḥ ||67|| pūrṇaḥ kālo munerasya kṣīṇamāyurgaṇeśvarāḥ | kimanena vimuñcadhvaṃ nayāmainaṃ yamāntikam | |68| | atha nandīśvaraḥ prāha kruddhastān pradahanniva | akṣatā gacchata kṣipraṃ kṛpaṇā yamakiṅkarāḥ | |69| | yāvaccaite na kupyanti pramathendrāḥ suroṣaṇāḥ | mā vaḥ siṃhā ivāraṇye vāraṇānmadamohitān | sakṛdeva samāhatya kariṣyanti gatāyuṣaḥ | |8.166.70 | | athaivamuktā gaṇanāyakena nandīśvareṇāmitavikrameṇa | bhītā yayuste pitṛrājadūtā gatvā ca cakruḥ kathayāṃ yamasya ||71 || teṣāmupaśrutya tadā vacāṃsi tīvrāṇi nandīśvarabhāṣitāni | ādityasūnuḥ pracukopa mohāt svayaṃ prayātuṃ ca matiṃ cakāra ||72| | athābhyayāt krodhaviraktanetraḥ sarvairvṛto mṛtyupurassaraistaiḥ | viniḥśvasannāga iva pracaṇḍo jagaddidhakṣanniva kṛtsnamekaḥ | |72|| dṛṣṭā muniṃ śvetamapetamohaṃ vṛtaṃ gaṇendrairharatulyarūpaiḥ | muñcadhvamenaṃ tarasetyavocan nandīśvarādyān graharājasūnuḥ | |74|| kastvaṃ yama śvetamuniṃ vinetuṃ bhavasya dhanyaḥ pramatheśabhaktam | saṃrakṣyamāṇaṃ svayameva mūḍhaṃ gacchākṛtātmanniti nandyuvāca | |75|| atha śrutvā vacastasya nandinaḥ paruṣaṃ mahat | yamaḥ provāca saṃkruddha idaṃ sarvagaṇādhipam ||76|| gaṇendrā gatajīvoyaṃ viprastiṣṭhati mūḍhavat | kimanena vimuñcadhvaṃ mā vṛthā khedamāpsyatha | |77| | rakṣitopi ciraṃ hyeṣa māmeva samupaiṣyati | kālena paripūrṇena kṣīṇāyuriha kaścana ||78| | tapodharmasamāyukto vidvānapi na jīvati | yadanena kṛtaṃ karma dharmyaṃ garhitameva vā | |79| | santyajya tadimaṃ dehaṃ prāpnotu gaṇapādhipāḥ | mamāyattamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtagrāmaparīkṣaṇam | |8.166.80 | | puṇyapāpīyasornitthaṃ karmaṇoḥ pravicāraṇam | tenārpayata me kṣipraṃ śvetamenaṃ gatāyuṣam | |81 | | athavainaṃ gṛhītveha sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ | prayāma śūlinobhyāsaṃ niyataṃ sa vimokṣyati | |82 | | pitṛrājavacaḥ śrutvā nandīśvarapurogamāḥ | evamastviti taṃ prāhuryamaṃ krodhavaśaṃ gatam | 83 | | tataste sahitāḥ sarve śvetaśca munisattamaḥ | jagannāthaṃ haraṃ draṣṭumājagmuvindhyaparvatam | |84|| nyavedayadyathāvṛttaṃ nandī sarvagaṇādhipaḥ | praṇamya parayā bhaktyā bhavāyāmitatejase | |8 5 | | śrutvā tu bhagavān vākyaṃ nandinā saṃprabhāṣitam | prāha vaivasvataṃ sākṣāt snigdhagambhīrayā girā | |86| | śvetasyāsya parā bhaktirmayi pretagaṇādhipa | ataḥ kṣīṇāyuṣopyasya mṛtyurna prabhaviṣyati | |87| | mahatā tapasā bhaktyā mayi bhāvitacetasaḥ | matprasādājjito mṛtyuḥ śvetenānena tāpana | |88| | mamādeśāttvayāpyasya naiva kāryaḥ parābhavaḥ | kinna vetsi raveḥ putra madbhaktā narapuṅgavāḥ | |89| | na paśyanti tavāvāsaṃ dehabhedepyupasthite | asya bhaktiviśeṣeṇa pareṇa paritoṣitaḥ | |8.166.90 || anenaiva śarīreṇa amaratvaṃ dadāmyaham | iti matvā visandehastvarā gaccha svamālayam | |9 1 | iti devavacaḥ śrutvā praṇamya tapanātmajaḥ | paramārthamavijñāya provācedaṃ pinākinam | |9 2 || tvayaiva bhagavanneṣā sthitiḥ sṛṣṭā purātanī | karmaṇyasminniyuktohaṃ janmamṛtyuvicāraṇe | | 93 | | adhikāra nivṛttau hi śakrasyāpi vṛṣadhvaja | tvayaiva pavanaḥ sṛṣṭo hyahaṃ caiva sureśvara | |94| | na kenacidayaṃ panthāḥ kālamṛtyukṣayātmakaḥ | vyabhicīrṇo mahādeva kālātikramadhāraṇāt | | 95 | | evametāṃ parāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vicintya vibudheśvara | moktumarhasi viprāgryaṃ kāle pūrṇe gatāyuṣam | | 96 | | evaṃ sthitirabhinnā syādahaṃ ca na vimānitaḥ | mṛtyuścāntaḥśarīrasthaḥ śvetastadvaramāpsyati | | 97 | | ityuktaṃ pretarājena śrutvā vākyaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ | diptāṅgāra ivaikasmāt saṃhāra iva pāvakaḥ | | 98 | | jagatkṣobha ivākasmādutprekṣyaḥ samapadyata | nandīśasya tataḥ skandhamupāśritya pinākadhṛk | | 99 | | idaṃ prāha vaco vyāsa taṃ dṛṣṭvā yamamāsthitam | aho dinakṛtaḥ sūnorasya śāṭhyaprabhāṣitam | | 8.166.100 | | kārkaśyaṃ vacasaḥ paśya pratyuttarasamīritam | paritrāto mayā śveto yama gaccheti bhāṣitaḥ | | 101 | | muñca śvetamiti prāha māmeva gatacetanaḥ | kintvayaṃ mūḍha eva syāduta pauruṣagarvitaḥ | | 102 | | gaccheti ko mayājñapte sthātumatra bhavatyalam | pratyuttaraṃ punaḥ prāha māmeva purataḥ sthitaḥ | | 103 | | evaṃ sa bhagavānuktvā jagatprabhavakāraṇaḥ | tiryag dṛṣṭi samādhāya saroṣaṃ yamamaikṣata | | 104 | | sa tena cakṣuṣā dagdho nipapāta mahītale | mahāvṛkṣa ivāraṇye mahāvāyusamīritaḥ | bhasmasāttvaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ prajahāsa tato bhavaḥ | | 105 | | śvetaṃ tatastaṃ praṇataṃ muniṃ tu sagadgadaṃ mṛtyubhayādviṣaṇṇam | pasparśa mūrdhni tripurāsurārirvaco na bhetavyamiti bruvāṇaḥ ||1 0 6| | prādādvaraṃ śūladharaśca tasmai mṛtyurna te vipra bhaviṣyatīti | dadau ca nityaṃ gaṇapatvameva provāca cainaṃ parituṣṭa īśaḥ | | 1 07|| kruddhaśca yasmādahamarkasūnorasmin girau puṇyatamastatoyam | vatsyāmi cehācalarājamūrdhni krodheśvarastena bhaviṣyatīha | | 1 08| | vindhyapradeśemarasiddhajuṣṭe krodheśvare puṇyagirau pumāṃsaḥ | tyakṣyanti ye dehamapetamohāsteṣāṃ gatiḥ śvetasamā smṛtā me ||1 09|| drakṣyanti śveteśvaramatra ye ca te cāpi divyā gaṇapā mamaiva | tavaiva nāmnā ca nadī supuṇyā śvetasya gaṅgeti bhaviṣyatīyam ||8.166.1 1 0|| santarpaṇānnaikavidhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ svarlokadaṃ sthānamatīva yasyām | ityuktamātre jagadīśvareṇa śveto munirdivyavapurbabhūva | |1 11 || nandīśacaṇḍeśasamānadharmā praṇamya devaṃ purataḥ sthitobhūt | dṛṣṭvātha sūnuṃ vigatāsumarkaḥ śokābhitaptastvarito javena || 112 || brahmādibhiḥ śakrapurassaraistaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagatkāraṇamājagāma | vijñāpayāmāsurathāmarāste ādityasūnu pratijīvahetoḥ || 113 | | mūḍho yatoyaṃ jagadīśvareśa kṛcchraṃ tatastīvramidaṃ prayātaḥ | prasīda deveśa kuru prasādaṃ jīvatvayaṃ pretagaṇādhirājaḥ | 1 14| | yathāpurā caiṣa bhavatvidānīmārttiṃ hi naśchindhi surāsureśa | vijñaptimevaṃ tridivālayānāṃ brahmādiśakrārkapurassarāṇām ||1 1 5| | śrutvā yamaṃ taṃ karuṇāyamāna uttiṣṭha putreti vibhurbabhāṣe | divyaṃ tataḥ pūrvavadadrikalpaṃ vibhrat sa dehaṃ graharājasūnuḥ || 116 || protthāya tūrṇaṃ bhagavantamāśu nanāma padbhyāṃ sahasā gṛhītvā | brahmādayaste ca surendrasaṃghā dṛṣṭvā tatastān praṇatānavocat | |117|| brahmārkaviṣṇujvalanādināthaḥ kartā surāṇāṃ suranātha ekaḥ | sureśvaraḥ somajaṭārdhamaulirdevāḥ prayāta svaniketanāni | | 118 || vijñaptireṣā saphalā kṛtā vo maivaṃ kṛthāstvaṃ punarātmamoham | preteśvaraṃ ceti vacobhyuvāca jagmustato devagaṇāḥ praṇamya | | 119 || pragṛhya sauriṃ pitṛrājamāśu śvetopi tasthau maraṇādvihīnaḥ | nandī yathā nirvṛtaduḥkhabhāvastathaiva vipraḥ parameśabhaktaḥ || 8.166.120 || iti kathitamidaṃ te śvetamṛtyupraṇāśaṃ himagiritanayāyā bharturīśasya śambhoḥ | phalamavitathabhakti prāptisaṃpadviśeṣaṃ jagati śaraṇamekaṃ taṃ śaraṇyaṃ namasye | |1 21 | | iti skandapurāṇe śvetavarapradāne ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.167> vyāsa uvāca yat proktaṃ bhavatā guhyaṃ māhātmyamidamuttamam | nānyasyaitad bhavenmuktvā jagadārttiharaṃ haram ||1 || puṇyānyāyatanānīha dedevasya śūlinaḥ yāni dṛṣṭvā na śocanti janmamṛtyū mahāmune | |2|| tāni me brūhi dharmajña yadyanugrāhyatā mayi | evaṃ kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mucye yanmunisattama | |3 | | vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaputrobravīdidam | sādhu vyāsa mahābuddhe bhaktimānasi śaṅkare | |4| | sthānāni śūlino yastvaṃ puṇyāni śrotumicchasi | kṛtārthastvaṃ mahāyoga muktaḥ saṃsārabandhanaiḥ | |5| | śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te vatsa guhyametat paraṃ hi me | sthānānuvarṇanaṃ śambhormṛtyujanmabhayāpaham || 6| | ādityabandhanaṃ nāma kūṭaṃ vindhyagireḥ śubham | sthāpitaṃ tatra liṅgaṃ tu tapanena mahāprabham ||7 || tad dṛṣṭvā manujo vyāsa janmaprati na śocati | hemasomodbhavaṃ nāma kūṭaṃ himagireḥ śubham | |8| | puṇyamāyatanaṃ tatra cyavanenābhinirmitam | ye tadāyatanaṃ śambhorabhigacchanti mānavāḥ | |9| | na cyavanti punaḥ svargāt pralayepi samāgate | udaye tu girau puṇye siddhasaṃghairniṣevite | | 8.167.10 | | satyo nāma hradaḥ puṇyo hemapadmasamāvṛtaḥ | yatra te munayaḥ satyāḥ satyānalaraviprabhāḥ | | 11 | | dhārayanti mahātmāna āśīrbhissarathaṃ ravim | puṇyamāyatanaṃ tatra sthāpitaṃ taiḥ pinākinaḥ | | 1 2| | amarairarcitaṃ vyāsa siddhavidyādharairvṛtam | yaistadāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavabhaktairviyadgamaiḥ || 13 || te bhavasya priyā bhūtvā bhavanti pramatheśvarāḥ | uśīravījaḥ śailendrastatrāśramapadaṃ mahat | | 14| | āgastyasya tṛṇāṅgasya devadānavapūjitam | mahānīlamayaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmin vyāsa mahocchrayam || 1 5|| tasminnāyatane rudraṃ tṛṇāṅgaḥ sa mahānṛṣiḥ | dakṣiṇāmūrttimāsthāya stauti nityaṃ kapardinam | divaukasastamabhyarcya bhavanti gaṇapādhipāḥ || 16 || uttareṇa nirāloke ravicandravivarjite | meruśṛṅge mahotsedhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ sthāpitaṃ mahat | |17| | liṅgaṃ bhagavato vyāsa yatrāste śūladhṛk svayam | uttānapādaputreṇa bhavabhaktiparātmanā | |18| | nityamabhyarcitaṃ liṅgaṃ dhruveṇāste mahāmune | devānāmapyagamyaṃ tad dhruvaṃ muktvā paraṃ varam | | 1 9|| jaigīṣavyeṇa muninā aste parvatarājani | sthāpitaṃ sumahalliṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 8.167.20 || tad dṛṣṭvā mānavo vyāsa rudralokamavāpnuyāt | mokṣavidyāsvabhijñāśca sāṃkhyayogaviśāradāḥ ||21 || bhavanti manujā dṛṣṭvā talliṅgaṃ paramādbhutam | nandane devarājena sthāpitaṃ liṅgamuttamam | |22|| tapanīyamayaṃ śubhraṃ devatā yadupāsate | tad dṛṣṭvā devatā liṅgaṃ prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam | |2 3 | | kṣīrode sāgare divyaṃ bālakhilyaiḥ svayaṃ kṛtam | mahadāyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhakinnarasevitam | |24| | tasmim̐ścandraprabhaṃ liṅgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ maṇirañjitam | bālakhilyāstamabhyarcya jagmurīśasalokatām || 2 5|| sauvarṇaṃ yakṣarājena sthāpitaṃ gandhamādane | liṅgaṃ bhagavato divyaṃ yat kubereśanāmakam | |26 || mandārakusumairdivyairhemapadmaiśca bhaktitaḥ | tamabhyarcya maheśānaṃ kubero nirvṛtobhavat | |27| | yaistadāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kuberasya surāsuraiḥ | sarvayajñaphalaṃ tebhyo dadāti vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | |28 | | ebhyaḥ puṇyatamānīha yāni gamyāni mānuṣaiḥ | śṛṇu tāni mahābuddhe sthānāni śaśimaulinaḥ | |29| | sarvaparvatarājasya śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe | mahālayamiti khyātaṃ sthānamādyaṃ svayambhuvaḥ | |8.167.3 0 || yatra sarvāmarā vyāsa caturvaktrapurassarāḥ | saṃsiddhā munayaścaiva ye ca yogīśvarā bhuvi | |3 1 | | samabhyarcya haraṃ bhaktyā tadavāptāḥ paraṃ padam | yatra sākṣānmahādevo nyastavān padamātmanaḥ || 3 2|| yaṃ praṇamya narāḥ sarve mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | abhigamya tamīśānaṃ mahālayanivāsinam || 33 || dehabhedaṃ samāsādya yatra tatra yathā tathā | na punarjāyate martyo yātaḥ siddhimanuttamām | |34|| na taṃ paśyantyadharmajñā yepi pāpakṛto narāḥ | mahāgaṇapatistatra dvārasaṃstho mahābalaḥ || 3 5|| sa teṣāṃ gamanaṃ hanti ye narāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ | yogino yatra devāśca siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | |3 6| | taṃ praṇamya yayuḥ siddhiṃ puṇyaṃ paśupateḥ padam | tasya saṃkalpanādeva drakṣyāmīti mahālayam || 37| | karmabhirmucyate janturmahāpātakasaṃjñitaiḥ | mahālayaṃ mahatkṣetraṃ mokṣasiddhipradaṃ śubham||38| | kulānyubhayataḥ sapta dṛṣṭatvā trāyati mānavaḥ | tataḥ puṇyatamaṃ vyāsa kedāraṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||39| | paraṃ dhāma vṛṣāṅkasya tasyaivottarataḥ śubham | svayaṃ kila haro devastasminnacalasattame | |8.167.40 | | jaṭābhārājjalaṃ puṇyaṃ mumoca.....| ...dabhavattatra haramauliviniḥsṛtam ||41 || narāstadamṛtaprakhyaṃ ye pibanti jalaṃ śubham | te bhavanti gaṇā vyāsa kuṣmāṇḍā rudravallabhā | |42 || mahārūpā mahātmano nandinopyadhikaprabhāḥ | kedāravāsinaṃ dṛṣṭavā devadevaṃ jagatpatima | |43 | | ..........| brahmā śakrastathā viṣṇuḥ somo yakṣagaṇādhipaḥ ||44| | arcayanti sthitaṃ tatra bhaktitaḥ parameśvaram | kedārasalilaṃ pītaṃ yairnaraiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ ||45| | kathaṃ śocanti te vyāsa prāptaṃ kinnu na taiḥ sukham | kedāre himavanmahīdhraśikhare yattatpayaḥ prasrutaṃ mūrdhnaḥ somamahendraviṣṇumarutāṃ sraṣṭurvibhoḥ śūlinaḥ | pātuṃ yanna labhantyadharmarucayaḥ śaivaṃ vinānugrahaṃ tatpītvā bhavabandhanapratibhayānmuktā bhaveyuḥ prajāḥ | |46|| madhyameśvaramatraiva sthānamādyamumāpateḥ | gatvā tamapi deveśaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt | |47|| tatrāpi svayameveśaḥ sadā sannihito mune | abhigamya tamīśānaṃ na śocenmaraṇaṃ pratiṃ ||48| | trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ pradeśe himavadgireḥ | eṣa śreṣṭhatamo vyāsa sarvasiddhipradaḥ śubhaḥ ||49|| asyābhigamanādeva sarvayajñaphalaṃ smṛtam | vipannasya pramādādvā gāṇapatyā gatirvarā | |8.167.50 || nātaḥ puṇyatamaṃ kiñcit sarvalokeṣu vidyate | trailokye cakravarttitvamasmin vā maraṇaṃ girau | |51 || cakravarttipadāttasmādiha mṛtyurviśiṣyate | yāti sāyujyatāṃ śambhoḥ paramaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ ||52 | | girāviha mṛto jantuḥ kintataḥ paramaṃ padam | mahaddhimavatastvanyat kūṭaṃ siddhaniṣevitam ||53 || yatra devī tapastepe gauravarṇasamīpsayā | gaurīśikharamityeva triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ||54| | kucakuṇḍa iti khyāte tīrthe yatromayā kṛte | tad gaurīśikharaṃ puṇyaṃ yebhigacchanti mānavāḥ | |45|| aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim | ṛṣabhaṃ śṛṅgamaparaṃ vajrasphaṭikasannibham | |46|| yatra nandī tapastepe varañcāvāpa śaṅkarāt | ṛṣabhaṃ prāpya tatkūṭaṃ sthānaṃ puṇyamumāpateḥ | |57| | dṛṣṭvā pāpavinirmukto rudralokamavāpnute | anyaddhimagireḥ kūṭaṃ hemakūṭasamaprabham ||58| | yatra bhastreśvaraṃ nāma rudrasyāyatanaṃ śubham | rudrastasmin girau devo bhastreśvara iti smṛtaḥ | 59| | taṃ namasya mahādevaṃ kinnaroragacāraṇāḥ | mṛtyubhītāśca puruṣā janmaduḥkhaistathārditāḥ | | 8.167.60 || tadāyatanamāsādya kāmānāpuryathepsitān | taṃ dṛṣṭvā manujo vyāpta rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||61 | | gaṅgādvāre śubhadvāre mahāpuṇye mahātmanā | dakṣeṇa sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhaktihetoḥ kapardinaḥ ||62| | vṛkṣāḥ kanakhalā nāma yatrāsan kanakātmakāḥ | mānuṣāṇāmaśīlatvāt saṃvṛkṇā dāravo babhuḥ ||63 || viśvātmā yatra viśveśaḥ śambhurambikayā saha | bahurūpeśvaro nāmnā naikaprāṇivarapradaḥ | |64| | mānavā yanna paśyanti janma ceṣa(?) mumukṣavaḥ | vājimedhaṃ daśaguṇaṃ yaṃ dṛṣṭavā prāpnute naraḥ | |65| | yaṃ devavidyādharasiddhasaṃghā gandharvayakṣoragadānavāśca | dṛṣṭveśvaraṃ nīlapayodakaṇṭhaṃ saṃsārapaṅke na punaḥ patanti | 66|| japyeśvaramiti khyātamanyadāyatanaṃ vibhoḥ | yatra japyaṃ purā kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sthāpitavān dvijaḥ ||67| | japyeśvaraṃ tadāsādya prāṇām̐styakṣyanti ye narāḥ | te janmamaraṇānmuktā vatsyanti śivasadmani | | 68| | anyadāyatanaṃ vyāsa śaśibimbārdhamaulinaḥ | mahābhairava ityeva khyātaṃ jagati yanmune || 69|| yatra śūladharo devaḥ svayameva vṛṣadhvajaḥ | cakāra bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ nandyumāgaṇabhīṣaṇam | |8.167.70 | | yad dṛṣṭavā himavatputrī babhūva bhayavihvalā | krīḍāhetorbhavo yatra trāsayitvā rirīndrajām | |71 | | saumyarūpobhavad bhūyaḥ sāntvayāmāsa śailajām | mahābhairava ityeva tadāyatanamucyate | |72 | | bhairaveśvaramāgamya yaḥ paśyeta pinākinam | maraṇaṃ janma ca vyāsa nāsau punaravāpnuyāt | |73 | | yadevāśramiṇāṃ puṇyaṃ tatheśavratacāriṇām | tatphalaṃ bhairavaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāpnoti narapuṅgavaḥ | |74|| kumbhakāreśvaraṃ caiva tathaivotkuṭukeśvaram | chagalaṇḍeśvaraṃ caiva mahābhairavajaṃ sthalam | |75|| dṛṣṭairebhistribhiḥ sthānaistrilokādhipatirbhavet | rudrakoṭīti cāpyanyacchivāyatanamucyate ||76|| rudrakoṭītrayaṃ japtvā tatra nandī varottamān | avāpa śaṅkarād vyāsa gaṇeśatvaṃ tathottamam | |77| | yaistadāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ te yānti paramāṃ gatim | devadāruvane cāpi bhavasyāyatanaṃ varam | |78| | devadāruvanaiśchannaṃ saralaiśca sugandhibhiḥ | sadā saṃsevitaṃ taddhi gandharvoragakinnaraiḥ ||79 | | yatra vaikhānasā viprāḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | bhāskarānalasaṃkāśā nivasanti tapodhanāḥ | |8.167.80 || bhikṣāhetorvanaṃ tattu prāviśat kila śūladhṛk | sa dṛṣṭastatra deveśo munibhiḥ stabdhamehanaḥ ||81 || īrṣyayā munibhirliṅgaṃ tasya devasya tanmahat | vimūḍhaiḥ pātitaṃ vyāsa devadāruvanāśrame ||82| | tasmin nipatite liṅge liṅgahīnamabhūjjagat | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva babhau sarvaṃ napuṃsakam | |8 3 || brahmādayastato devāste ca siddhā mumukṣavaḥ | jñātvā śaṅkarajaṃ sarvaṃ tadapāyaṃ sudāruṇam || 84| | saṃstutya vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śaṅkaraṃ paryatoṣayan | tatastadabhavalliṅgaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pinākinaḥ | |85|| jagataśca tataḥ puṃstvaṃ tatkṣaṇāt samapadyata | tatra taiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ parameśasya bhaktitaḥ | |86|| tad dṛṣṭavā vājimedhānāṃ daśānāṃ prāpnute phalam | evaṃ dāruvanaṃ puṇyamīśasyāste mahāmune ||87|| abhigamya narāḥ kṣipraṃ mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ | dadhīcena mahaddivyaṃ puṇyamāyatanaṃ kṛtam | |88|| sthāneśvaramiti khyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | naraḥ sthāneśvaraṃ prāpya yastyajedātmanastanum ||89|| yogaiśvaryamanuprāpya svargaloke sa modate | takṣakena bhujaṅgena dṛḍhabhaktena śaṅkare | |8.167.90 || takṣakeśvaramityevaṃ sthāpitaṃ jāhnavītaṭe | devadevasya rudrasya yatra sānnidhyamuttamam ||91 | | tandṛṣṭatvā puruṣo devamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | agastyena kṛtaṃ cānyat puṇyamāyatanaṃ mahat | |92 || āmrāteśvaramityeva khyātaṃ jagati suvrata | dṛṣṭvā paramayā bhaktyā puruṣastaṃ śucivrataḥ | |93|| dehabhedamanuprāpya śarvalokamavāpnuyāt | girau kālañjare liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthānamumāpateḥ | | 94| | aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya rudralokamavāpnuyāt | puṣpabhadramiti khyātaṃ vindhyaprasthe drumāvṛtam | |95|| bhavasyāyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ devagandharvasevitam | yattadrāvaṇaputreṇa meghanādena rakṣasā | sthāpitaṃ toṣayānena sarvabhūtapatiṃ bhavam | |96| | yatra mandodarīputraḥ sthāṇunā śaśimaulinā | māyārathapradānena kṛtaḥ prāptamanorathaḥ | |97|| tada dṛṣṭvā tatra gatvā ca praṇamya ca jagatpatim | puruṣāḥ svargamāyānti divyayogasamanvitāḥ ||98| | andhreṣvāyatanaṃ cānyaccharvasya paramātmanaḥ | nāmnā citrarathaṃ nāma yogasiddhivarapradam | |99| | tripurasya vadhe yatra ratho devasya dhīmataḥ | amaraiścitrito vyāsa somādityayamādibhiḥ || 8.167.100 || samyagiṣṭe tu yat proktamaśvamedhe phalaṃ budhaiḥ | taccitrarathamāsādya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||1 01 | | anyaduktarathaṃ nāma bhavasyāyatanaṃ śubham | surakinnaragandharvaiḥ sadā saṃsevitaṃ śubham | | 102 | | tatra śrīparvato nāma parvataḥ śrīniketanaḥ | siddhāmaraśatākīrṇṇaṃ siddhikṣetraṃ taduttamam || 103 || śūlino yatra liṅgānāṃ puṇyānāṃ varadāyinām | sahasraṃ sthāpitaṃ vyāsa śilādena mahātmanā | |1 04|| ye paśyanti tamīśānaṃ śrīparvatanivāsinam | | janmamṛtyubhayaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti puṃsāṃ kadācana || 10 5| | anenaiva śarīreṇa tasmin kṣetre bhavātmake | yogābhyāsaparā viprāḥ siddhiṃ yānti yathepsitām || 106 | | manasāpyabhigacchanti ye narāḥ śrīgiriṃ mune | na te yānti yamāvāsaṃ mṛtyāvapi samāgate || 107 || tataścottaragokarṇaṃ haraliṅgāṅkitāśramam | taptaṃ yatra tapastīvraṃ rākṣasaiḥ piśitāśanaiḥ | |1 08| | rāvaṇādyairmahābhāgairlabdhaśca vara īpsitaḥ | purā yatra tapaḥ kṛtvā prasādya ca pinākinam || 1 09| | trailokye cakravartitvaṃ rāvaṇassamavāptavān | aśvamedhaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tad dṛṣṭavā labhate naraḥ | | 8.167.110 | | mṛtaśca rudrasāyujyaṃ gacchatyatra na saṃśayaḥ | tato dakṣiṇagokarṇaṃ sthānaṃ puṇyaṃ pinākinaḥ ||1 11 || spṛkkayā jātayā yatra laṅkāmalayasānuṣu | arcyate bhagavāndevaḥ sarvāmaravareśvaraḥ | | 112 | | eko rākṣasaśārdūlo yatrādyāpi vibhīṣaṇaḥ | samabhyarcyāmareśānaṃ bhuṃkte rājyamaśaṅkitaḥ || 113 || mānavā yebhigacchanti gokarṇāyatanāśramam | daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ prāpnuvanti phalaṃ śubham | |1 14| | hariścandra iti khyāto girirnaikavinirjharaḥ | jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yasminnāyatanaṃ kṛtam ||1 15 || yatra devāśca siddhāśca yakṣaguhyakakinnarāḥ | vratino yoginaścaiva nemire vṛṣabhadhvajam | |1 16 | | hariścandragire śṛṅgamākūṭaṃ yairnirīkṣitam | na te vasanti martyeṣu devā bhūtvā punarmune || 1 17|| uttare narmadātīre yojanaikapathāntare | kārohaṇamiti sthānaṃ trinetrāyatanaṃ mahat || 11 8| | yatra kākāṃ tapasyantīmāruroha prajāpatiḥ | āruroha yataḥ kākāṃ tasmin deśe prajāpatiḥ || 11 9| | tasmāt kārohaṇo nāmnā sa deśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | tasmin deśevatīrṇaśca bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | | 8.167.120 || puṇyosau sarvadeśebhyo deśo yena nibodha tam | kṣīṇe kṛtayuge vyāsa tretāyugamukhodaye || 121 || tasmin pādaṃ mumocaikaṃ dharmodharmanipīḍitaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dvāpare prāpta tṛtīyaṃ ca kalau yuge ||1 22|| caturthenāvatasthe ca yataḥ sa bhagavān prabhuḥ | evaṃ sa dharmasaṃvāsād deśaḥ puṇyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ | | 123 || bhārabhūtistvasau bhūtvā tasmindeśe pinākadhṛk | bhārān baddhvā dvijātīnāṃ narmadāyāṃ vicikṣipe || 1 24|| kāruṇyena mahādevo marttyajanmamumukṣayā | tretāyāṃ diṇḍimuṇḍaśca śirāṃsi vinikṛttavān || 1 25|| dvāpare cāṣaḍhirbhūtvā nṛttenānugṛhītavān | evaṃ pratiyugaṃ vyāsa tasmindeśe śivaḥ svayam | |1 26| | avatīrṇaścānugṛhya brāhmaṇān śuddhamānasān | teṣāmāyatanāni sma sarveṣāmeva suvrata | | 1 27|| yena dṛṣṭāni devasya īśānalokamāpnuyāt | vartamāne kalau cāpi jñātvā duḥkhārditaṃ jagat || 1 28|| caturaḥ puruṣān sṛṣṭvā svasmānmukhacatuṣṭayāt | provāca parameśāno lokānugrahalipsayā || 1 29| | yūyaṃ yāta mahīṃ sarve dvijā bhūtvā tapasvinaḥ | māmevaiṣyatha yogośā nītvā viprān paraṃ padam || 8.167.130 || te tathoktvā tato vyāsa saṃbabhūvuḥ pṛthak pṛthak | mānuṣeṣu tadā viprā mokṣadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | |1 31 || ujjayinyāṃ gurujyeṣṭhaḥ kauśiko nāma nāmataḥ | dvitīyo gārgya ityeva jaṃbūmārge satāpanaḥ (?) ||1 32| | tṛtīyaścābhavanmitro mathurāyāṃ mahāmanāḥ | brahmacārī caturthastu kuruṣveva sugotrajaḥ | | 133 || bhagavānapi deveśo hyamareśvarasaṃyutaḥ | atrivaṃśaprasūtasya nāmnā vai somaśarmaṇaḥ || 1 34|| rūpaṃ kṛtvā sitāṅgaṃ tu jagāmātrergṛhaṃ śubham | sa taṃ brahmavidaṃ vipramātreyaṃ sakulaṃ vibhuḥ | | 1 35| | yogasiddhipradānena anujagrāha śaṅkaraḥ | anugṛhya tadā vyāsa sakulaṃ dvijasattamam || 13 6|| jagāmojjayinīṃ devaḥ śmaśānaṃ ca viveśa ha | sa tatra bhasmanātmānamavaguṇṭhya vṛṣadhvajaḥ | |1 37| | ulmukaṃ vāmahastena gṛhītvā samupāviśat | tatra prathamamādāya śiṣyaṃ kauśikamīśvaraḥ | |1 38| | jambūmārge dvitīyaṃ ca mathurāyāṃ tatoparam | kānyakubje tataścānyamanugṛhya jagatpatiḥ || 139|| svasiddhāntaṃ dadau yogamuvācedaṃ ca lākulī | rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hīdaṃ pañcārthaṃ iti saṃjñitam | | 8.167.140 | | viprānmocayituṃ datto yuṣmabhyaṃ marttyabandhanāt | anayā dīkṣayā viprān prāpayadhvaṃ paraṃ padam | | 141 || nadītīreṣu medhyeṣu puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca | śūnyāgāreṣvaraṇyeṣu vāso vaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ | | 142| | vaco bhagavataḥ śrutvā śiṣyāḥ paśupateḥ svayam | yathājñaptamakurvanta sarve te bhavatejasaḥ | | 143 || dharmapādāṅkite deśe avatīrṇo yato bhavaḥ | sa deśaḥ paramastasmānmahāpuṇyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||144|| āśramo yogināṃ yatra pravṛttaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | aṣṭāyatanamityevaṃ sthānamatra mahātmanaḥ ||145| | yad dṛṣṭavā manujā vyāsa prāpnuvanti paraṃ padam | kārohaṇaṃ śivasthānaṃ yebhigacchanti mānavāḥ || 146| | garbhaśayyābhayaṃ teṣāṃ na bhavenmunisattama | mahīnarmadayormadhyaṃ sahyasya ca yadantaram | |147|| etatpaśupateḥ kṣetraṃ purāṇamṛṣibhiḥ stutam | tadāgatya naro vyāsa yadyapi syāt supāpakṛt | sarvapāpavinirmukto yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyād gatim || 148| | kārohaṇaṃ sthānamatīva puṇyaṃ śaivāni yatrāyatanāni dhīman | gatvā narāstāni mahāphalāni saṃsāragehaṃ na punarviśanti || 149|| puṇyamāyatanaṃ cānyat saptalokābhivanditam | vārāṇasyā muniśreṣṭha yatra sannihito haraḥ | | 8.167.150 || tatra bhāgīrathī puṇyā uttarāṃ bhajate diśam | siddhikṣetraṃ bṛhatkṣetraṃ lokeṣu triṣu viśrutam ||1 51| | avimuktaṃ smṛtaṃ nāmnā na vimuktaṃ hareṇa tu | avimukteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tatra hyumāpatim ||152|| gāṇapatyā gatiḥ proktā mṛtyukāle mahāmune | yatrāste gaṇapo dvāri vidyutkeśo mahābalaḥ ||153 || daṇḍapāṇirmahātejāḥ samādeśāt svayaṃbhuvaḥ | tamadṛṣṭavā na paśyanti devadeveśvaraṃ haram ||1 54| | yoginopi mahātmānaḥ puṇyaṃ tasyāpi darśanam | daṇḍapāṇiṃ śucirdṛṣṭvā haradattavaraṃ gaṇam ||155|| iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya yānti tasya salokatām | yatra siddhā mahātmāno yogaiśvaryabalānvitāḥ | | 1 56|| channāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamanti svayaṃbhuvam | śakraḥ pitāmaho viṣṇurdhaneśo varuṇo yamaḥ | | 1 57|| hutabhuk pavanaḥ somaḥ svayaṃ caiva divākaraḥ | tathā saptarṣayaḥ siddhā gandharvāḥ pannagāstathā | |158| | avimukteśvaraṃ devamarcayanti yatavratāḥ | tataḥ puṇyatamaṃ nāsti siddhikṣetramiti śrutiḥ || 1 59| | yatra jantorvipannasya muktiḥ saṃsārabandhanāt | prasādājjāyate śambhorguhyametata paraṃ smṛtam | | 8.167.160 | | gaṅgā dakṣiṇatastasminnuttareṇa varāṇasī | tattayormadhyataḥ kṣetramavimuktaṃ pinākinaḥ | |1 6 1| | liṅge yat sthāpite śambhoḥ prāpyate phalamanyataḥ | tat sahasraguṇaṃ proktamavimukte niveśite | | 162 | | sthāpayedvidhinā yoṣā pumānvā vidhipūrvakam | sahasraṃ sthāpitaṃ tena liṅgānāṃ bhavati prabhoḥ | | 163 | | tryakṣaḥ sa gaṇapo bhūtvā rudrasāyujyatāṃ vrajet | ataḥ kṛtvā muniśreṣṭha brahmādityapurassaraiḥ | liṅgāni sthāpitāni sma sarvaistatra surottamaiḥ | |1 64| | tasmin bhagavataḥ kṣetre kāśipuryāmanekaśaḥ | dṛśyantedyāpi liṅgāni sthāpitāni mahātmabhiḥ | |1 6 5| | smaraṇādavimuktasya pṛthivyantepi saṃsthitaḥ | kalmaṣairmucyate janturmṛtaśca labhate sukham ||1 6 6|| brāhmaṇāstatra muñcanti vedatattvārthavedinaḥ | siddhāḥ pāśupatā ye ca bhavabandhamumukṣavaḥ | | 1 67| | prāpya vārāṇasīṃ puṇyāṃ siddhikṣetramanuttamam | punarniṣkrāntumanyatra kasya jantormatirbhavet | | 168 || vedeṣu gīyate vyāsa tat kṣetraṃ śaśimaulinaḥ | dehinastyajataḥ prāṇān mokṣasiddhigatipradam || ta69| | yevimukte vasanti sma narā rudraparāyaṇāḥ | rudrasya bhavane vyāsa te vasanti na saṃśayaḥ | | 8.167.170 | | tiṣṭhan gacchan svapan bhuñjan karma kurvan hasannapi | yovimuktaṃ smareddehī tasya janmabhayaṃ kutaḥ | |171 | | nāvimuktāt paraṃ kṣetraṃ nāvimuktātparaṃ padama | nāvimuktātparaṃ puṇyaṃ nāvimuktātparā gatiḥ | | 172 || yā gatirdhyāyato nityaṃ pare brahmaṇi līyata | saiva saṃtyajataḥ prāṇānavimukte smṛtā gatiḥ | |173 | | puṇyamumāpateḥ suravṛṣairjuṣṭaṃ sadā siddhaye bahmādyairavimuktametaditi yat saṃsevitaṃ śāntaye | ye sevanti tadīśabhaktiparamā martyāḥ śamaprāptaye muktāste bhavasaṃbhavapratibhayād gacchanti mokṣaṃ param ||174| | prayāge ca tapaḥkṣetre devasyāyatanaṃ mahat | tad dṛṣṭvā manujaḥ samyagiṣṭāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt | |175|| naimiśe devadevasya rudrasyāyatanaṃ mahat | dṛṣṭvā pāpavinirmuktaḥ svargalokamavāpnuyāt | | 176|| dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre sthānaṃ yogeśvaraṃ mahat tena dṛṣṭena viprendra gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt ||177|| rudralokaṃ mṛtaścāsau prāpnuyāt sarvakāmikam | gayāyāmanyadīśasya sthānaṃ bhagavataḥ śubham | |178|| gadhrakūṭeśvaraṃ nāmnā sarvapāpavimocanama | na taṃ dṛṣṭvā vimuhyanti mṛtyukāle narottamāḥ | | 179|| tatra bhasma samālabhya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | dvādaśābdavatasyāpi dvijaḥ phalamavāpnuyāt || 8.167.180 || anyadāyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ magadhāmu pinākinaḥ | nagare pāṭalīputre nāmnā prahasiteśvaram | | 181 | | vājimedhamavāpnoti abhigamya tamīśvaram | magadhāsu smṛtānyaṣṭau sthānāni śaśimaulinaḥ|| 182 | | śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto yāni babhrāma nakulīśvaraḥ | yāni dṛṣṭavā bhavetsadyaḥ pumān pāpavivarjitaḥ ||183 || yavaneṣu smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ puṇyamanyadumāpateḥ | tripiṣṭapamavāpnoti tandṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ prabhum ||184| | aṅgadeśe paraṃ puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ proktaṃ pinākinaḥ | hemacūḍeśvaraṃ nāmnā taṃ dṛṣṭvā na vimuhyati || 185|| bhāgīrathyāstato vyāsa sāgarasya ca saṃgame | brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra pinākinaḥ || 186 || tasyābhigamanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāpnute phalam || 1 87|| prabhāse śūlinaṃ dṛṣṭvā dehabhede gaṇo bhavet | puṣkare śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā na śocenmṛtyujanmanī ||1 88|| mahendre ca nagaśreṣṭhe rudrasyāyatanaṃ śubham | abhigamya naro vidvānaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||189| | mahākāleśvaraṃ devamujjayinyāṃ mahāvrataḥ | abhigamyāpnuyādvidvān gaṇatvaṃ tripuradviṣaḥ | | 8.167.190 || drimicaṇḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā trāyati mānavaḥ | kulānyubhayataḥ sapta sarvayajñāni cāpnute ||191 || śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā na śocenmaraṇaṃ naraḥ | tathā himagireḥ śṛṅge siddhakinnarasevite ||1 92 || ḍiṅgeśvaramiti khyātaṃ rudrasyāyatanaṃ mahat | abhigamya ca dṛṣṭavā ca taṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhum | |1 93 || śivabhaktiparo vyāsa sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt | mṛtasya ca gatiḥ proktā gāṇapatyaṃ mahātmanaḥ | |194| | suvarṇākṣe paraṃ sthānaṃ devadevasya saṃsmṛtam | tad dṛṣṭavā manujo vyāsa rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 195|| saptagodāvare sthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ kapardinaḥ | aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya svargaloke vasennaraḥ || 1 96| | sthānaṃ puṇyatamaṃ cānyacchreṣṭaṃ jagati kīrtitam | nāmnā bhadreśvaraṃ khyātaṃ devagandharvasevitam | | 197| | taṃ vīkṣya mānavo vyāsa sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet | janmaprabhṛti yatkiñcit kṛtaṃ karmāśubhaṃ mahat || 1 98| | tatkṣaṇānnaśyate sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadreśvaraṃ haram | yatra tatra mṛtaścāpi gāṇapatyaṃ labhennaraḥ | | 199|| dhanyāste mānavā vyāsa rudrabhaktā mahaujasaḥ | ye prapaśyanti bhadreśaṃ janmamṛtyubhayāpaham ||8.167.2 00 | | ekāmre ca vibhoḥ sthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā svargamavāpnuyāt | virajāyāṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā vājimedhamavāpnuyāt | | 201 | | nepāleṣu ca deveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupatiṃ prabhum | daśāśvamedhānāpnoti rudralokaṃ ca gacchati | |2 02 | | dehabhedaṃ ca saṃprāpya paśutvādvipramucyate | anyaddhimagirau sthānaṃ naikatuṅgādhipeśvaram | | 203 || dṛṣṭvā tanna punarmarttyo jāyate munisattama | bhaktānāṃ praṇatānāñca sarvakāmapradaṃ smṛtam | |2 04|| evametāni puṇyāni rudrasyāyatanāni te | kathitāni mayā vyāsa yairgatiḥ prāpyate śubhā | | 20 5|| ya etāni paṭhedvipraḥ prayatātmā dine dine | tasya sāyujyatāṃ devo dadāti vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | |2 0 6|| maṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ medhyaṃ sarvabhayāpaham | sthānānāṃ kīrtanaṃ śambhornityaṃ kuryācchucirnaraḥ | |2 07|| iti girivaraputrīviṣṇugaṅgādharasya jagati vasatireṣā sarvakāmapradā te | munivarasutaśiṣṭā pāpasaṃśuddhikartrī vada kimaparamanyad vyāsa tubhyaṃ vadāni | |2 08|| iti skandapurāṇe śivāyatanavarṇane saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.168> sūta uvāca śrutvā kathāmāyatanānubaddhāṃ candrārdhabimbā sthitamaulinastu | vyāso munistaṃ vacanaṃ babhāṣe brahmātmajaṃ brahmavidaṃ munīndram | | 1 | | dharmyā supuṇyā bhagavan tvayaiṣā guhyā kathā me vidhivat pradiṣṭā | sthānāni śambhordayitāni konya evaṃ parijñātumṛṣiḥ samarthaḥ || 2 || icchāmi vettuṃ tripuraṃ pradagdhamekeṣuṇā divyapinākadhartrā | yathā purā bhaktavarapradena tanme mune brūhi yathāpravṛttam || 3|| pṛṣṭastathaivaṃ muninā munīndraḥ praśnaṃ yathāvat kathayañcakāra | dagdhaṃ yathā tat tripuraṃ tathā tvaṃ śṛṇuṣva putreti vaco bruvāṇaḥ | |4|| tasmin hate daityavṛṣendrasiṃhe purā hiraṇyākṣasute pravīre | bhagneṣu daityeṣu sadānaveṣu mayo babhūvādhṛtiduḥkhataptaḥ | |5| | sa viśvakṛddānavarājalakṣmyā ratyeva hīno makaradhvajobhūt | ādāya daityaṃ sa hi tārakākṣaṃ vidyutprabhaṃ cendrasamaprabhāvam ||6 | | tapaścacārogramahīnakarmā daityau ca tāvandhakatulyavīryau | te śītakāle himaparvatasthā grīṣme ca pañcajvalanābhitaptāḥ | |7| | vyabhre payaḥplāvitabhūmibhāge cerustapaḥ prāvṛṣi ca prayattāḥ | teṣāmagāddivyasamāsahassraṃ tathā sutīvre tapasi sthitānām ||8 | | carmāsthiśeṣā jvalanaprabhāvāstapo viśeṣād ditiputrasiṃhāḥ | ādityatejaḥpratimānavīrā babhūvurādityavapuḥprakāśāḥ | |9|| pitāmahastānabhigamya sarvān priyaṃ bahūktvā vacanaṃ babhāṣe | taptaṃ tapo vo vigatapramohā varaṃ tvidānīṃ vṛṇuteti hṛṣṭāḥ | | 8.168.10 || taṃ prāñjalirbhūminiviṣṭajānurmayaḥ sureśaṃ praṇatobhyuvāca | avadhyatāmapratimaṃ balañca jñānaṃ ca divyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ ca ||1 1 || mṛtyuryathā no na bhavecca deva varaṃ prayacchainamabhīpsitaṃ naḥ | karomyahaṃ yacca sureśa durgaṃ tribhiḥ purairdivyavimānakalpaiḥ | |12|| tanme bhavet sarvasurairagamyaṃ svacchandasaṃsthānagatipracāram | ityevamukto danujādhipena brahmā vacastaṃ mayamābabhāṣe || 13 || dātuṃ na śakyo vara eṣa tubhyaṃ tasmāt paraṃ sāntarameva cānyam | tvaṃ putra yācasva tataḥ pradāsye cintā ca te mā danujānyathābhūt ||14| | tato mayaḥ prāha vaco vimūḍho varo yathā mārgita eva nostu | bravīmi yaccānyadahaṃ sureśa tanmerhasi tvaṃ pradadātu madya || 15| | pūrṇe sahasre tripuraṃ samānāṃ sameṣyate hyardhanimeṣamātram| tasminkṣaṇe yastriṣu saṃgateṣu pureṣu divyeṣu surapravīra | |16|| ekeṣuṇā tat tripuraṃ daheta sa no vināśī tripurasya bhūyāt | śrutvā tatastadvacanaṃ mayasya brahmā varaṃ taṃ hṛṣitāntarātmā | prādādabhīṣṭaṃ danujādhipāya dattvā ca tūrṇaṃ svapure jagāma ||17|| tato mayastattripuraṃ sasarja jagadvidhāteva purādikalpe | ayomayaṃ tatprathamaṃ cakāra tatoparaṃ rājatamadrikalpam || 18 || tṛtīyamanyatpuramāśu haimaṃ sasarja meroriva śṛṅgamuccam | sṛṣṭaṃ tatastattripuraṃ mayena svargasya rūpaṃ prajahāra divyam | | 19|| dvārairmanojñairvaḍabhīgavākṣairbīthyaṅgaṇairhemamayaiḥ suyuktam | candrāṃśusaṃsṛṣṭatalaiśca harmyaiḥ śītānilāhlādasukhapraveśaiḥ | |8.168.20 | | muktāpravālairmaṇikhaṇḍacitrai rālambitaiścitrataḍitprakāśaiḥ | dhvajairvicitraiḥ pavanāvadhūtaiścalatpatākābhiratīva reje | | 21 | | prāsādapaṃktisthitaratnakhaṇḍai rmahāmaṇīndudyutisannikāśaiḥ | satoraṇābhyucchritaharmyapṛṣṭhairalakṛtaṃ tat tripuraṃ rarāja | | 22 | | sarvartupuṣpaiḥ phalitairmanojñairvṛtaṃ samantāttarubhirmahoccaiḥ | ramyastathodyānaśatairupetaṃ prabhrāntaṣaṭpādamayūrahaṃsaiḥ | | 23 | | vāpībhirākrāntavihaṅgamābhiḥ praphullanīlotpalasaṃvṛtābhiḥ | daityālayaṃ tacchuśubhe tathaiva pranṛttakekāvihagaissarobhiḥ || 24| | tathā nakhodbhinnapayodharābhirākarṇaraktāntavilocanābhiḥ | savrīḍamīṣaccapalekṣitābhiryoṣidbhirākīrṇamatīva reje || 25| | lauhaṃ puraṃ yattadadhaścakāra tattārakākṣāya mayaḥ pradatvā | pura dvitīyaṃ rajatāmayaṃ yadvidyutprabhāyāsurarājabhartre | |26| | haimaṃ tṛtīyaṃ svayameva divyaṃ jagrāha rājā maya ātmanorthe | adhiṣṭhitaṃ tattripuraṃ tadābhūtsamaṃ tribhistairdanurājasiṃhaiḥ ||27|| te sarvataḥ svaḥ prabhavān vijitya priyāsahāyāḥ sahamitrabhṛtyaiḥ | sukhāni tasmin vividhānyavāpu strailokyacintāmavicintayantaḥ | | 28| | te darpamohapratibaddharāgā nyūnānamanyanta balena devān | matvā ca teṣāṃ prasabhaṃ nipatya nānāvidhāścakruratīva pīḍāḥ ||29| | vanāni vaibhrājapurassarāṇi saṃchinnavīrutkusumāni cakruḥ | vāpīḥ pracakruḥ kamalairvihīnā jahruśca rambhādipurassarāstāḥ ||8.168.3 0 | | santrastagātrīḥ surayoṣitastairanyāśca cakrurmahatīḥ prapīḍāḥ | teṣāmatītaḥ sumahānathaivaṃ prakurvatāṃ devavināśanāni | |3 1 || kālo mayaṃ pratyatha jātakopāḥ saṃgatya sarve tridivaukaseśāḥ | vṛttaṃ yathā sarvamaśeṣatastannyavedayannāśu pitāmahāya ||3 2| | tānāha devaḥ kamalāsanasthaḥ sarvānsureśānparisāntvayitvā | mahābalāste tripurāsurendrā hantuṃ na śakyā hi balādbhavadbhiḥ | |3 3 | | tasmādayaṃ viṣṇurahañca yuṣmān pragṛhya śambhuṃ śaraṇaṃ prayāma | gatiḥ sadā naḥ śaśibhṛt sureśāḥ sa tān balāddhaṃsyati śūlapāṇiḥ | |34|| tatheti tepi praṇipatya devā brahmārkaśakrānilapāvakādyāḥ | kailāsamāgamya sureśvareśaṃ dṛṣṭavā haraṃ tuṣṭuvurādṛtārthāḥ | |35| | namastrilokeśvaravanditāya priyādharāyāmitavikramāya | namostu candrārdhajaṭākalāpakānti prabhodyotitaśekharāya ||36| | trailokyadevāya namostu nityaṃ pinākacāpāya namastathaiva | namaḥ pradīptāsiparaśvadhāya triśūlahastāya namostu nityam ||37|| namo namo nandivarapradāya jagaccharaṇyāya sureśvarāya | namaḥ sadā bhaktavarapradāya namostu yakṣeśavarapradāya | |38 || sthitāya nityaṃ himavadgirīndre kailāsavāsāya namassadaiva | namo vimukte śaniketanāya sthitāya sarvatra ca te namostu | | 39| | bhasmāṅgaliptāya kapardine ca namostu nityaṃ vṛṣabhasthitāya | digvāsase śvetavarapradāya sarvarddhiyuktāya jagadvidhātre ||8.168.40 | | haryarkaśakrāgnipitāmahānāṃ sraṣṭre namo deva...rāya | sūkṣmāya nityaṃ parameśvarāya nityaṃ namaḥ sarvagatāya dhātre ||41 | | namaḥ parāyātipare pumāṃse purāya ṣaḍviṃśakasaṃjñitāya | namostu śarvāya dhanurdharāya sarvāya sarvaprabhavāya nityam ||42| | somānilārkajvalanāmbubhūmivyomātmakāyādisṛje namostu | pūṣṇo namo dantavināśanāya kāmāṅganāśāya namostu nityam ||43 | | namaḥ pradhānāya parāya puṃse yogādhigamyāya sadā namostu | raudrāya saumyāya vapuṣmate ca namo namaḥ sarvajagatsṛje ca | |44| | vidyāsṛje dharmasṛje namostu sraṣṭre namo yajñasurāsurāṇām | namastṛtīyekṣaṇadhāriṇe ca namo namo nīlaśikhaṇḍine ca | |45| | namostu nityaṃ puruṣottamāya śmaśānavāsāya namaḥ sadaiva | namostu daityāndhakanāśanāya namaḥ sadā mohavināśanāya | |46 || tamovināśāya namostu nityamajñānanāśāya namostu nityama | namaḥ sadā mokṣavarapradāya namaḥ sadāyāmṛtasaṃsthitāya ||47| | bhartre namo bhūmidharendraputryāḥ pitre kumārasya namostu nityam | namostu vitteśavarapradāya namaḥ sadā śukravarapradāya | |48| | brahmātmane brahmasṛje namostu namo namo devasṛje vidhātre | namostu dakṣāmarayajñahantre namostu caṇḍeśavarapradrāya | |49| | yogeśvarāyāmarasaṃstutāya namostu rudrāya parāya dhāmne | harātha śarvāya śivāya goptre namostu bhīmāya ca śambhave ca | |8.168.5 0 || guṇairvihīnāya guṇotkaṭāya guṇeṣvatītāya guṇāsthitāya | gītāya sāṃkhye puruṣāya nityaṃ namostu yogopaniṣatsthitāya | |51 | | mahāpurāṇāya parātparāya sthūlāya sūkṣmāya namassadaiva | prasādyamānaḥ kuru naḥ prasādaṃ tuṣṭaḥ pareśāna varaṃ prayaccha | śambhustathaivaṃ stuvatāṃ surāṇāṃ brahmendraviṣṇvarkapuraḥsarāṇām | |52|| prītastayā stotraviśeṣabhaktyā jagāda vākyaṃ paramādbhutārthama | tuṣṭosmi devā śṛṇutādya śīghraṃ samīhitaṃ vo yadi kiñcidasti | dātāsmi sarvaṃ tadaśeṣatodya kiñcinna yuṣmabhyamadeyamasti ||53 | | iti skandapurāṇe tripuravadhopakrame devatāvarapradānaṃ nāma aṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.169> devā ūcuḥ brahmadattavarairdeva mayādyairdānavaistribhiḥ | durgaṃ tattripuraṃ kṛtvā bādhyāmo baladarpitaiḥ | |1 | | hṛtā apsarasaḥ sarvā dhvaṃsitāni vanāni ca | sarvāndevānnihanmodya śvo hanmeti ca tebruvan ||2|| na teṣāṃ nigrahe śakto brahmāpyeṣa pitāmahaḥ | viṣṇurvāpi mahādeva tena naḥ sumahad bhayam | |3 || tad yathā tripuraṃ naśyet te ca syurnihatā yathā | tathā kuru suraśreṣṭha varoyannaḥ pradīyatām ||4|| iti vijñāpitaḥ śambhussarvaistairhi surottamaiḥ | idamāha mahātejāḥ surānāśvāsayanniva | | 5| | śatamaṃśaṃ sureśā vai gṛhītvā mama tejasaḥ | rudratejomayā bhūtvā dānavān vinihaṃsyaśca | | 6 || tataste punareveśaṃ prāhurvākyamidaṃ surāḥ | śaktāḥ sahasramapyaṃśamudvoḍhuṃ na vayaṃ tava ||7| | kā naḥ śaktiḥ sureśāna tejo māheśvaraṃ param | draṣṭuṃ dhārayituṃ vāpi prasādaṃ kuru naḥ prabho | |8| | na kathañcidvayaṃ śaktāstānhantuṃ dānavān balāt | bhagavan svayameva tvaṃ tripuraṃ jahi śaṅkara ||9 | | tebhyaḥ kila varo datto brahmaṇānena śūladhṛk | divye varṣasahasre tu sameṣyati puratrayam | | 8.169.10 | | nimeṣārdhaṃ kṣaṇe tasminnetadvastripuraṃ balī | sakṛdekamiṣuṃ kṣiptvā yaḥ pradhakṣyati dānavān | | 11 | | bhaviṣyati sa vo mṛtyurnānyathā maraṇaṃ hi vaḥ | tacca kartuṃ na śaktāḥ smaḥ prasādaṃ tena naḥ kuru | |1 2 || tataḥ sa bhagavāndevaḥ praṇatān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | punarāśvāsayan prāha samudvignān divaukasaḥ | | 13 | | yadyevaṃ suraśārdūlāstripuraṃ durgamaṃ mahat | iṣumekaṃ sakṛt kṣiptvā pradhakṣye nimiṣe kṣaṇe | |14|| brahmaviṣṇupriyārthaṃ hi śakrasyānugrahāya ca | tripuraṃ rathamāsthāya haṃsyāmi svayameva tat | |1 5|| kriyatāṃ sa rathaḥ sajjo yamāruhya divaukasaḥ | dhakṣyāmi tripuraṃ durgamākrāntaṃ dānavaistribhiḥ || 1 6| | yādṛśaśca hi māṃ voḍhuṃ śaktaḥ syāt surapuṅgavāḥ | balavān himavatkalpaḥ kartavyastādṛśo rathaḥ | | 17|| tato devāḥ praṇamyeśaṃ prahṛṣṭamanasobhavan | rathaṃ ca sahitāḥ sarve kalpayāmāsuruttamam || 18| | tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā tathā viṣṇuhutāśanau | sarvadevamayaṃ divyaṃ cakrustaṃ rathamuttamam | | 1 9|| dhātāraṃ bhāskaraṃ śakraṃ pavanaṃ dhanadaṃ yamam | vasūn rūdrām̐stathādityān gandharvānaśvināvapi | |8.169.2 0 || garuḍān parvatānnāgān guhyakānsamahodadhīn | ṛṣīm̐tu siddhām̐stathā yakṣān grahām̐.....|21 || ....sitaṃ kālaṃ tathā caiva vanaspatīn | divasāni muhūrtāni kṣaṇān kāṣṭhālavām̐stathā ||2 2| | ayane ca ṛtūnmāsān pakṣān saṃvatsarām̐stathā | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ yacca nakṣatrāṇi tathaiva ca ||23 || aṣṭau devanikāyām̐stān rathe tasminnakalpayan | kām̐ściccakradvaye cakruḥ pratāpa.....| |24| | ...ścidrathecānyān yuyujuḥ surapuṅgavān | kṛtvāśvām̐ścaturo vedān rathe tasminnyayojayan ||25|| samvatsaramayaṃ cakraṃ dhanurgirimayaṃ tathā | jyāñcaiva dhanuṣaścakrurdeva devīṃ jagatsthitim | | 2 6| | te tamevaṃvidhaṃ devā rathamagryamacīkaran | sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā girikalpaṃ rathottamam | |27| | viṣṇuḥ pitāmahogniśca praṇamya parameśvaram | rathaḥ sajja iti prāhurvināśāya suradviṣām | |28 | tataḥ sa bhagavāñchambhuḥ stūyamānaḥ suraistribhiḥ | avaikṣata rathaṃ divyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtam | |29 | | sukṛtaṃ sādhviti procya dhanurjagrāha tanmahat | tatpragṛhya dhanurdīptaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ param | | 8.169.30 || adhaścordhvañca saṃprekṣya tutoṣa bhuvaneśvaraḥ | pitāmahaṃ tato vīkṣya provāca vacasāṃ patiḥ|| 31 | | ratha eṣa dhanuścaitat tvayā brahman sukalpitam | dagdhavyaṃ tripuraṃ yena tamiṣuṃ śīghramānaya | | 32 | | tataḥ provāca taṃ brahmā praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam | ratha eṣa kṛto deva dhanuretacca te mayā | |3 3 | | tamiṣuṃ bhagavāneva tadyogyaṃ kartumarhati | tataḥ pārśvasthitau dṛṣṭvā śambhuviṣṇuhutāśanau | | 34| | dṛṣṭipātena tau devau samāhvayadarindamaḥ | tau dvāvañjalimādhāya sureśānamupasthitau | |3 5| | svayameva tataścakre śambhurviṣṇuṃ śarottamam | oṣadhīnāṃ patiṃ somaṃ puṃkhe tasya nyayojayat | | 3 6| | śalyaṃ ca pāvakaṃ cakre brahmāṇaṃ sa tatobravīt | sārathiḥ ko rathe brahmam̐stvayeha parikalpitaḥ || 37| | tamuvāca tato brahmā prāñjalirjagataḥ patim | mahyaṃ dadāsi yadyājñāmahameva hi sārathiḥ || 38|| prāpsye kimaparaṃ deva sārathyādadhikaṃ tava | sarva śobhanamityuktvā tato devaḥ pinākadhṛk ||39|| haste pragṛhya deveśamāruroha rathottamam | rudrapāriṣadā ye ca nandīśvarapurogamāḥ ||8.169.40 || śaṃkukarṇapurogāśca ye ca caṇḍeśvarādayaḥ | gaṇeśvarā mahāyogāstryakṣāḥ paṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ | |41 | | nānāśastrapraharaṇā nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ | nānābharaṇavastrāśca nānāvidyāviśāradāḥ | |42| | vādayantaḥ samaṃ vādyān bherīśaṃkhasvanān bahūn | ājagmurgaṇamukhyāste sahasrāṇi caturddaśa | |43 | | nānāvidhānāṃ puṣpāṇāmupariṣṭāt sahasraśaḥ | nipeturvṛṣṭayo mūrdhni rathasthasya pinākinaḥ | |44| | svayameva ca vādyāni vineduḥ sarvatodiśam | rathe yuktāśca te sarve devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||45|| aśaktā bhāramudvoḍhuṃ mumuhurdevatā bhṛśam | tatastāndevadeveśo jñātvā mūḍhān divaukasaḥ | |46|| sahanīyaṃ vapuścakre surāste mumuhustataḥ | athāsminnantare vyāsa nārado bhagavānmuniḥ ||47|| jagāma tripuraṃ śīghraṃ viśvakarmadidṛkṣayā | athāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvakarmā mayastadā ||48|| saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā nanāma munisattamam | sa dattvā hyāśiṣastasmai vetrāsana upāviśat | |49| | upaviśyāsane tasminmayamāha mahāmuniḥ | prasādya daivataissarvereṣa devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ||8.169.5 0 || ānītastripuraṃ hantumatra yatsādhu tatkuru | rathaṃ devamayaṃ divyaṃ samāruhya jagatpatiḥ ||51 || brahmāṇaṃ sārathiṃ kṛtvā svayamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ | nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa tadā dānavādhipaḥ ||52|| tārakākṣaṃ samāhūya vidyunmālinameva ca | tathānyānasurān bhrātṝn bāṇanemipurassarān ||53| | nāradena yadākhyātaṃ sarvamaśrāvayattadā | tacchrutvā daityarājastu tārakākṣobravīdidam | |54 || na tavāsti samaḥ kaścit trailokye surapuṅgava | yodhayennirbhayo yastvāṃ cintāṃ tvaṃ maya mā kṛthāḥ ||55| | kimatra cintyate rājan sarvevadhyā yadā vayam | kasya tattripuraṃ hantuṃ śaktirvidyeta dānava || 56|| saṃgatya daivatāssarve yadi yoddhumihāgatāḥ | paśya tānnihatānadya mayaivaikena daityapa | |57| | durbalaḥ kurute bhedaṃ dānaṃ sāntvamathāpi vā | praṇāmaṃ jyāyasaḥ śatrorvayantu balinaḥ sadā ||58| | durbalasya ripordaṇḍo balinā vijigīṣatā | kartavyo vikramaiṇeti prāha śukrastadā guruḥ | |59| | tadvayaṃ balino daityā hīnāśca tridivaukasaḥ | hatvā daṇḍena tān sarvān sthāsyāmo nirvṛtāḥ sukham ||8.169.60 || tārakākṣavacaḥ śrutvā vidyunmālī vacobravīt | mamāpyetadatīveṣṭaṃ rājñosya vacanaṃ śubham | |6 1 | | na śaktā yoddhumasmābhirdevatā balavarjitāḥ | te cedyotsyanti saṃmūḍhāḥ prayāsyanti tataḥ kṣayam | |62|| anyonyantu vayaṃ yuddhādupāyaṃ teṣu yuñjmahe | yuddhe naiva sadā daityāḥ prāpnuvanti jayaṃ param | |63 || adya hatvā surānsarvān kuru rājyaṃ triviṣṭape | trailokyaṃ nirvṛto bhuṃkṣva tvamindro bhava viśvakṛt | |64| | saptalokeśvaraṃ tvadya paśyāmastvāṃ purandaram | hiraṇyakaśipuṃ smṛtvā hiraṇyākṣaṃ ca daityapa | |65| | bhoktārau jagato rājyaṃ tvaṃ prayāhi tayorgatim | tataḥ śrutvā mayo vyāsa vidyunmālivibhāṣitam | |66|| naitadevamiti prāha kampayannasakṛcchiraḥ | yastulyaḥ svabale śatrurhīno vā daityapuṅgavāḥ ||67|| bale vā yo bhavejjyāyānekajātivapurdharāḥ | budhāstasmin prayuñjanti tadupāyacatuṣṭayam | |68 || samā divaukasosmākaṃ balenāsurapuṅgavāḥ | tairdevaiḥ sārdhamasmākaṃ yuktaṃ sāmādiyojanam || 69|| ya eṣa bhagavānīśaḥ sarvabhūteśvareśvaraḥ | asmākaṃ devatānāñca sraṣṭā hartā ca sa prabhuḥ ||8.169.70 | | sa hantuṃ svayamāyāti upāyastasya kīdṛśaḥ | praṇāmaḥ saṃśrayaścaiva guṇopāyau kapardinaḥ ||71 | | dvāvimau sādhane tasya prayojyāviti me matiḥ | yadi kārkaśyamāsthāya yodhayāmaḥ pinākinam | |72| | tasya jihmekṣitenaiva nihatāḥ sma tatosurāḥ | brahmādyāḥ śaraṇaṃ śambhumarditā yānti śāntaye ||73 | | yobhiyuktaḥ svayaṃ tena śaraṇaṃ tasya ko bhavet | yasya sarvamidaṃ daityā brahmādi prathitaṃ jagat | |74| | abhidhyānāt kṣaṇenaiva praṇaśyeta bhavedapi | yo heturapavargasya kāraṇaṃ jagataśca yaḥ ||75| | kīdṛśaṃ tena yuddhaṃ no devadevena śambhunā | kinna vettha śiśuprajñā loṣṭugiryoryadantaram | |76 | | bhavanto loṣṭavo bhūtvā girikalpamumāpatim | īpsadhve mohitā yuddhe kālapāśena yantritāḥ | |77| | ahaṃ bhakto mahādevaṃ jāne tasya balāntaram | sa praṇāmamupasthāsye na yotsye śambhunā saha | |78 || yadi yūyamapi prājñā mama śuśrūṣavo yadi | mā kṛḍhvaṃ śambhunā yuddhaṃ gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śivam | |79|| tamevaṃ vādinaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmāṇamūrjitam | nārado bhagavān prāha dānavāntakaraṃ vacaḥ | |8.169.80 || viśvakarman yattvayeda mukta vistaraśorthavat | sarvaṃ yuktamidaṃ kintu kāloyaṃ nāsya vartate | |8 1 | | bhavatāṃ tattapaḥ kṣīṇamaiśvaryaṃ bhuktameva ca | klībatāmapi kurvanto yūyaṃ nakṣyatha dānavāḥ ||82|| vṛtaḥ sarvāmaraiḥ śambhurvadhārthaṃ bhavatāmiha | praṇatānapyasau yuṣmām̐statpriyārthaṃ nihaṃsyati | |83 || kathaṃ danusutā bhūtvā rājāno baladarpitāḥ | bhītā mṛtyuṃ jigīṣadhvaṃ kṛpaṇā iva dānavāḥ | |84| | prāpsyathādhikamaiśvaryaṃ tyakṣyathāsūn raṇe yadi | vinā yuddhaṃ vipannānāmaśubhā vo gatirbhavet | |85| | api cedyadi hanyedhvaṃ devadevena śūlinā | pramathendrāstato yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ | |86| | guṇaṃ sandhigataṃ nāsti yuṣmākaṃ devataissaha | vigrahe vo matiryuktā sā ca vyaktā vayaṃ ca vaḥ (?) | |87| | śauryeṇa bhavatāṃ prītaḥ kadācid vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | bhavedvaraprado daityāḥ śreyān vastena vikramaḥ | |88 || kariṣyāmi ca vo rakṣāṃ śastrāghātaniṣedhanīm | uttiṣṭhata danoḥ putrā vijayāya yuyutsayā | |89| | nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tārakākṣo mahābalaḥ | vidyunmālī ca daityendrā bāṇādyāśca mahāsurāḥ | |8.169.90 || kālapāśārditā mūḍhāḥ kṣīṇapuṇyā gatāyuṣaḥ | sādhvetacchobhanaṃ proktaṃ nāradeneti tebruvan | |91 | | mayopi tadvaco budadhvā jñātvā nāśamupasthitam | śobhanaṃ nāradenoktamiti vākyamuvāca ha | |92|| nāradopi tato hṛṣṭo rakṣāṃ baddhvā tu māyayā | yuyutsūnasurān kṛtvā yayau śarvarathaṃ prati | |93 | | tataste dānavāḥ sarve yuddhāya kṛtaniścayāḥ | nānāpraharaṇopetā babhūvuryuddhalipsavaḥ | | 94| | tarakākṣo balo bāṇo vidyunmālī ca dānavaḥ | sannahya sahitāḥ sarve rājānastasthuragrataḥ | |95| | avādyanta tataḥ śaṃkhāstūryāṇi ca sahasraśaḥ | dānavānāṃ bale ghore kātarāṇāṃ bhayaprade | |9 6 || sarathoyamihāyāti asāvanyaḥ pradṛśyate | kathamāgata ityevaṃ vacāṃsyūcuḥ parasparam | |97| | vigatabhayaviṣādāstraipurā daityasaṃghāḥ prakupitavadanāste yuddhasajjā babhūvuḥ | praharaṇavarahastāstaṃ rathaṃ vīkṣamāṇāḥ paśava iva makhāgneranvagacchan samīpam | |98 || iti skandapurāṇe tripuravadhesuravarṇane ūnasaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ | <8.170> sanatkumāra uvāca athābhyagāt paścimasāgarasya mūrdhni sthitantattripuraṃ rathosau | nānāpatākojjvalacitramaulirhaimopalo merurivādrirājaḥ | |1 || te vīkṣya durgaṃ tripuraṃ gaṇeśā nandīśacaṇḍīśamukhāḥ suyattāḥ | nādaṃ pracakruḥ sahitāḥ pravīrā yuyutsavo dānavarājasiṃhaiḥ || 2 || caṇḍeśvaraścaṇḍavapurmahātmā jvalatpradīptograkuṭhārapāṇiḥ | vyādāya vaktraṃ purataḥ sthitobhūd devasya śambhoḥ pramathendravīraḥ ||3 | | dīptaṃ triśūlaṃ parigṛhya nandī tryakṣaḥ pratasthe haratulyavarṣmā | pārśve sthitobhūt sa ca śaṃkukarṇaḥ pragṛhya dīptaṃ muśalaṃ gajendraḥ | |4|| bhṛṅgirharātmā sa ca vīrabhadrastathā gaṇendrāḥ śataśaḥ pravīrāḥ | vajratriśūlāsibhuśuṇḍihastā yuyutsavastasthurupetaharṣāḥ | |5| | samāgataṃ taṃ rathamīkṣya daityā yuddhāya nirjagmurupetamohāḥ | te tārakākṣapramukhāḥ suvīrā sannahya nānāyudhadīptahastāḥ | |6| | sārdhaṃ gaṇendraiḥ samaraṃ pracakrurdanoḥ sutāḥ kopavaśaṃ prayātāḥ | devopi candrārdhaniketamauliḥ śaraṃ na cikṣepa puraṃ pradagdhum ||7|| tasthau tathaivāsakṛdātmanā ca paśyan raṇaṃ tadgaṇadaityapānām | tataḥ sa nandī gaṇapaiḥ pravīrairacīkaradyuddhamadīnasatvaiḥ | |8| | vivyādha bhṛṅgiṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkairvidyutprabhaḥ kopaviraktanetraḥ | bhṛṅgiṃ samāsādya śilīmukhāste nāśaknuvam̐stasya rujaṃ prakartum || 9| | vidyutprabhaṃ bhṛṅgiriṭistatosau śūlena dīptena jaghāna pṛṣṭhe | sa tena śūlena hato jughūrṇa tyaktvā ca bhṛṅgiṃ prayayayau bhayārttaḥ || 8.170.10 || bhagnastathāsau ditijādhipeśo bhṛṅgiṃ samutsṛjya gaṇendramukhyam | vivyādha tīkṣṇairniśitaiḥ pṛṣatkairvināyakaṃ saptabhiraṃsadeśe || 11 | | punastriṣaṣṭyā daśabhiśca bhūyo vidyutprabhastaṃ gajarājavaktram | jaghāna marmasvabhilabdhalakṣya stataścukopāsya vināyakendraḥ || 12 || sa puṣkarāgreṇa gajendrasiṃho grīvāṃ tadā daityapaterviveṣṭya | utpāṭayāmāsa śiraḥ śarīrāta padmaṃ hradānnāga iva pramattaḥ | |1 3 || daityasya kṛttaṃ śuśubhe śirastadvindhyācalendrapratimāccharīrāt | sahaṃsacakrāhvarutopagītād hradānnavotkhātamivāśu padmam | | 14|| tatoparau daityapatī suyattau nemirbalaścāndhakatulyakalpau | kruddhāvupāgamya hi śaṃkukarṇaṃ śilīmukhairvivyadhaturgaṇendram ||15| | tau śaṃkukarṇaḥ prasabhaṃ nipatya chinnadhvajāśvau virathau cakāra | anyau samāruhya rathau punustau bhūyassamāgamya gaṇapravīram | | 16 || taṃ jaghnaturnaikavidhaḥ pṛṣatkairvajrābhighātapratimaissutīkṣṇaiḥ | kruddhastadā sa prasabhaṃ gaṇendrastau daityarājau suciraṃ nirīkṣya ||17|| dīptena hatvā muśalena vīrau saṃpreṣayāmāsa puraṃ yamasya | anye ca daityāstripurādhivāsāḥ kruddhā viniṣkramya gaṇendrasiṃhaiḥ || 18|| nārācacakrāsikuṭhārahastā ghoraṃ mahadyuddhamatīva cakruḥ | daityādhipāste haratulyakalpairgaṇeśvaraiḥ prāptaśivaprasādaiḥ | | 19| | hatā babhūvurhi gatāsavastu mṛgā yathā kesaribhirvanānte | prabhraṣṭanānāyudhavastrahārāśchinnairbhujaiśśoṇitamudvahantaḥ ||8.170.2 0 | | vajrāhatā.......petuḥ samudre giriśṛṅgakalpāḥ | śrutvāthadaityau balanemisaṃjñau tau śakukarṇena hatau prasahya | |21 || purādviniṣkramya sa tārakākṣaḥ kruddho gaṇendraṃ svayamabhyadhāvat | taṃ śaṃkukarṇo ditijādhipeśaṃ muñcantamugraṃ śaravarṣamāśu | |22 | | bhallena daityaṃ girisannikāśaṃ jaghāna mūrdhni prasabhaṃ gaṇeśaḥ | nipatya kiñcinnihataḥ sa tena bhallena daityādhipatirmumoha | |23 | | protthāya tūrṇaṃ sa hi tārakākṣaścikṣepa tasmai gaṇapāya cakram | kruddhastatosāvabhavad gaṇendrastaṃ tārakākṣaṃ sa hi śaṃkukarṇaḥ | |24|| nipātya muṣṭyā prajaghāna mūrdhni samāhataḥ sopi jagāma kṛcchram | jughūrṇa babhrāma mumoha tasthau papāta tatyāja varāyudhañca | |25| | mumoca roṣaṃ virarāva tīvraṃ mamāra paścādasuvipramuktaḥ | dṛṣṭavā vipannaṃ ditijādhipendraṃ pragṛhya daityā bhavanaṃ mayasya ||26| | gatvā nivedyāsurarājabhartre nādān pracakrurvividhairvilāpaiḥ | tato mayastān rudato sureśānāśvāsayan prāha vacosureśaḥ | |27|| sṛṣṭaṃ mayā vomṛtametadāste tenainamutthāpayatāśu daityāḥ | tato gṛhītvāmṛtamuttamaṃ tad daityādhipaṃ daityavṛṣāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ | |28| | cakruḥ sajīvaṃ hi yathā purāṇaṃ mayaṃ praṇemuśca muhuḥ śirobhiḥ | sa tārakākṣastata āśu bhūyo yuyutsayā yuddhapathaṃ jagāma ||29| | āyāntamālakṣya pitāmahastaṃ pūrvaṃ mṛtaṃ jīvitamāśu bhūyaḥ | provāca vākyaṃ sa surāsureśaṃ nivedayan vāmakareṇa daityam | |8.170.3 0 | | hatopyayaṃ śaṅkara tārakākṣaḥ kṛto mayenāśu sajīva eva | tasyāsti devāmṛtamuttamaṃ hi tenāsurān jīvayatesurendraḥ ||3 1 || doṣo mahāneṣa surendrahetormatānmṛtān jīvayate yadājau | tatomṛtaṃ tanmayasaṃsthamāśu pradhyānamātreṇa jahāra śambhuḥ | |3 2 | | pitāmahastaṃ punareva hṛṣṭaḥ pinākinaṃ prāha vacaḥ praṇamya | dṛṣṭaṃ mayā yuddhamidaṃ gaṇānāṃ daityādhipaiḥ sārdhamahīnasatvaiḥ | |3 3 || divyaṃ sahasraṃ vigataṃ samānāṃ kṣayaṃ na caitat tripuraṃ jagāma | kṣipasva dīptaṃ tamiṣuṃ sureśa prayāntu nāśaṃ suravidviṣaste | | 34| | pūrṇe sahasre tripuraṃ sametya punarviparyastamabhūt sureśa | kṣiptastvayeṣurna ca devadeva yogena kiṃ vā tava devanātha | | 3 5| | saṃkalpamātrādidameti nāśaṃ daityādhivāsaṃ tripuraṃ taveśa | yadi tvahaṃ mānayitavya īśa vimuñca śīghraṃ tripure śaraṃ tam | |3 6|| vijñapta evaṃ caturānanena pratīpamālīḍhamanaṅgahantā | kṛtvā dhanustadbalavadvikṛṣya yuyoja dīptaṃ tamiṣuṃ pināke ||37| | saṃkalpamātreṇa tadā sa tāni purāṇi devassahitāni trīṇi | cakre jagatsṛṣṭivināśakartā jagacca niṣpandamabhūttadāśu | | 38 | | viṣṇvātmakaṃ pāvakasomapuṃkhaṃ trailokyasaṃhāra iva pradīptam | cikṣepa devastamiṣuṃ tadograṃ kṣiptvā ca kaṣṭaṃ dhigitīti cāha | |3 9| | nandī samāgamya tato maheśaṃ provāca vākyaṃ kimiti praṇamya | nandīśvaraṃ taṃ bhagavānuvāca mayasya bhaktasya śubhaṃ cikīrṣuḥ | |8.170.40 | | nandīśa bhakto mama viśvakarmā dahet puraṃ tasya yathā na vahniḥ | tathānalaṃ somaharī ca devau mamājñayā gaccha nivārayasva ||41 | | nandī pragṛhyātha sureśvarājñāṃ tūrṇaṃ yayau viśvakṛtaḥ puraṃ tat | ......tulyavego jyotiṣmataḥ pūrvataraṃ jagāma | |42 | | dṛṣṭvā mayaṃ tatra sa dānaveśaṃ mūrdhnā natāṅgaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajasya | mṛtyorbhayārttaṃ śaraṇārthinaṃ ca nandī samāśvāsayadīśabhaktam ||43 || bhayaṃ kṛthā mā maya rakṣitastvaṃ bhaktyā bhaveneti vacobhyuvāca | nandīśvaraṃ dānavarāṭ sa dṛṣṭvā śrutvā priyaṃ tacchivasaṃprasādam | |44|| yathaiva rudrāya nanāma mūrdhnā cakre praṇāmaṃ sa tathaiva tasya | athāgnirāgāt tripuraṃ didhakṣan pradīpayitvā sakalaṃ samantāt | |45| | saṃvarttavahnipratimo yugānte jagat prasaṃharttumiva pradīptaḥ | tamāgataṃ viśvakṛto nivāsaṃ viṣṇvinduyuktaṃ jvalanaṃ sa nandī | dagdhavyametanna hutāśaneti vacobhyuvācāśu vibhorniyogāt | |46 | | tataḥ sa vahnistamuvāca devaṃ kasmānna dagdhavyamidaṃ mayeti | nandī hutāśaṃ sa tatobhyuvāca mayotra tiṣṭhatyamareśabhaktaḥ | |47|| taṃ vahnirāhāsurarājamāśu tūrṇaṃ vinirgaccha mayeti vākyam | haimaṃ gṛhītvā sa maheśaliṅgaṃ purādviniṣkramya mayosurendraḥ | |48| | pātālamāśu praviveśa hṛṣṭaḥ kurvannamaskāramumāpriyasya | nandīśvaraḥ sopi sureśapārśvamāgamya cākhyāya ca saṃsthitobhūt || 49|| tataḥ pradīptaṃ tripuraṃ babhūva viśliṣṭayantrārgalanaṣṭaveśma | naikāsurāmuktamahogranādaṃ vitrastadaityendravadhūjanāḍhyam | |8.170.50 || vātāyane harmyavimānasaṃsthāścandrānanāḥ pīnapayodharāḍhyāḥ | paryaṅkasuptā madavihvalākṣyo mārgaṃ priyāṇāṃ muhurīkṣamāṇāḥ | |51 | | vilocanaistāmranibhāṅgarāgaiḥ śyāmāvadātā jaghanairviśālaiḥ | daityāṅganāḥ svaṃ dadṛśuḥ pradīptamāliṅgyamānāḥ śarapāvakena | |52| | prāsādasaṃsthāḥ prayayurbhayārttāstrāsena kinnarya ivācalasthāḥ | priyānathodvīkṣya samāgatām̐stān mohaṃ samāliṅgya bhṛśaṃ vijagmuḥ ||53 || priyā gṛhītvā ditijāstataste pranaṣṭakāmāstarasābhijagmuḥ | niṣkrāntamātrāśśivaśaktimūḍhāḥ petuḥ samudre balaviprayuktāḥ ||54|| daityān samudre patitām̐statastān matsyā mahānto girisannikāśāḥ | tīvrāśca nakrā makarāśca ghorāḥ saṃjagrasurnaṣṭabalān vimūḍhān | |55| | jalecarendrāstvapare mahāntassaṃchinnahārāḥ patitāḥ striyastāḥ | hīnāḥ priyairbhakṣayituṃ pravṛttāḥ karāladaṃṣṭrā vivṛtānanāśca | | 5 6|| tā bhakṣyamāṇāḥ patitāstaruṇya priyānsaroṣaṃ bahuśo nirīkṣya | rujā mahatyā parikhidyamānāḥ saṃcukruśurdīnataraṃ yuvatyaḥ | |57| | tāsāṃ tadā daityavilāsinīnāṃ reje bhṛśaṃ krodhanirīkṣitaṃ tat | ratāvasāne parikheditānāṃ priyairivānyāmabhigantukāmaiḥ | |58|| sarve tato daityavṛṣāḥ sabhāryāḥ pradahyamānāstripurānalena | magnāḥ samudre makarairvibhinnā gatāsavo mṛtyuvaśaṃ prajagmuḥ | |5 9 || śaraśca sognīndujanārdanātmā pradahya kṛtsnaṃ tripuraṃ puraṃ tat | kṣiptvā samudre sma śamaṃ prayātaṃ śaśāma śambhośca karaṃ jagāma ||8.170.60 | | daityairhataistaistripure ca dagdhe devān rathasthān punareva devaḥ | pūrvaṃ yathā divyaśarīrayuktān cakāra sṛṣṭipralayādihetuḥ ||61 | | brahmādayaste tridivaukaseśā nemurvacaścedamathocurīśam | kṛtaṃ tvayedaṃ bhagavannaśakyaṃ śubhaṃ mahadraudrataraṃ ca karma | |62| | daityā hatāstattripuraṃ pradagdhaṃ śāntiḥ kṛtā naḥ sma surāsureśa | namostu sarvatra sadā sthitāya sraṣṭre surāṇāṃ parameśa tubhyam | nityaṃ navijñātagamakriyāya namo namaḥ sarvagatāya tubhyam ||63 | | tānāha devaḥ sa tadā surendrān brahmārkaviṣṇvindradhaneśvarādyān | sadaiva yūyaṃ pratipālanīyā rakṣyāśca devāḥ sutavanmayaiva | |64|| pūrṇābhilāṣā hatavidviṣaśca prayāta hṛṣṭāḥ svaniveśanāni | devāstato devavaraṃ praṇamya jagmuḥ svakīyāni niveśanāni | | 65 | | devopi siddhairabhivandyamānaḥ kailāsaśṛṅgaṃ sahito gaṇendraiḥ | caṇḍeśanandīśvaravīrabhadrairjagāma kartā jagatastrinetraḥ | | 6 6| | iti kathitamasahyaṃ devadevasya karma tripuradahanasaṃjñaṃ vyāsa tubhyaṃ mayaitat | manuja idamadhīte yaḥ śuciḥ śarvabhaktaḥ sa bhavati gatapāpaḥ svargabhāg devajanmā || 67| | iti skandapurāṇe tripuravadhe saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.171> vyāsa uvāca śrutaṃ mayaitad bhagavan dahanaṃ tripurasya tu | vicitrārthaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ ka evamabhidhāsyati || 1 | | kasmāt kruddho nagendraṃ taṃ krauñcaṃ dāritavān guhaḥ | pakṣān sarvagirīndrāṇāṃ kasmācciccheda vāsavaḥ | |2 | sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa mahābuddhe yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi | kumāreṇa yathā bhinno mainākiḥ krauñcaparvataḥ ||3 || girirājamathābhyetya meruṃ sarvasurālayam | apaśyadvāsavaḥ skandaṃ saṃghātaṃ tejasāmiva | |4| | śarastambavane dṛṣṭvā kumāramanalaprabham | surarājyamadāviṣṭaḥ śakraḥ papraccha ṣaṇmukham | |5|| kastvaṃ divyavapurbāla meruparvatamāśritaḥ | na māṃ pūjayase dṛṣṭvā devarājamihāgatam | |6| | tamevaṃ vādinaṃ śakraṃ prāha śūladharātmajaḥ | brahmādyā māṃ vijānanti siddhā vedavidaśca ye | |7|| tapasā labdharājyena na cirādastameṣyatā | kiṃ tvayā jānatā śakra kāryaṃ kiṃ pūjitena vā | |8 | | athovāca punaḥ śakrastaṃ devamanalātmajam | mattaḥ parataro nāsti muktvā śarvapitāmahau ||9| |
