kathamevamavocastvaṃ vibudhādhipamāgatam | yadi mattastvamātmānaṃ mahāntaṃ manyasenagha | | 8.171.10 || mainākatanayo hyeṣa krauñcasiddhaniṣevitaḥ | suvistīrṇo mahāśailo naikanirjharanisravaḥ | | 11 | | ehyehi tvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ kuru śīghra pradakṣiṇam | ya enamāvayorekaḥ pūrvameva kramiṣyati | | 12 | | prabhāvāttejasā caiva sa mahānnau bhaviṣyati | bāḍhamityevamuktvātha kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhastadā | | 13 | | śakreṇa saha saṃgatya mayūravaramāsthitaḥ | mahendrasyāgrato gacchan cakre krauñcaṃ pradakṣiṇam | | 14| | atha buddhvā mahendrastu nyūnamātmānamānalāt | kumāramabhisandhitsurmanasaiva pradakṣiṇam | | 1 5| | kṛtvā sunirvṛtastasthau upaviṣṭaḥ śilātale | javenātha kumārastaṃ krauñcaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | |1 6| | provācendraṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā jetāhamiti satvaraḥ | ahameva hi jeteti śakrastamavadad guham | | 17| | asakṛd bruvatorevaṃ tayoḥ śakrakumārayoḥ | krauñcobhyetya vacaḥ prāha kimetaditi bhūcaraḥ | | 1 8| | tataḥ śakra uvācedaṃ kumāraṃ vacanaṃ tadā | eṣa evāvayoḥ krauñco jayasākṣī mahābalaḥ | | 1 9| | nānṛtaṃ vakṣyati hyeṣa pautro himagirervaraḥ | pṛcchyatāṃ śakra ko doṣa ityāha jvalanātmajaḥ | |8.171.2 0 | | taṃ śakraḥ sādaraṃ prāha kena tvamacalāgrataḥ | kṛtapradakṣiṇo brūhi pramāṇaṃ hi tvamāvayoḥ | | 21 | | tataḥ krauñco vimūḍhātmā saṃcintya suciraṃ nagaḥ | ayaṃ śacīpatiścakre māmihāgre pradakṣiṇam || 2 2| | ..ryaṃ prahasan devānityuvāca nagādhipaḥ | athaivaṃ bruvatastasya satyahīnaṃ tadā gireḥ | |2 3 | | papāta śikharaṃ tūrṇaṃ kuliśena yathā hatam | tatrāsan yāni bhūtāni surādyāni girīśvare | tāni saṃtyajya śīghra taṃ prayayuḥ sarvato diśam | |24|| jahṛṣe vāsavaścāpi manasā pūjayan girim | tataścukrodha rudrātmā gireḥ krauñcasya ṣaṇmukhaḥ | |25| | ....guhaṃ draṣṭuṃ saṃkruddhaṃ vāsavastadā | ekasthe tejasī pūrṇe vahnibhāskarayoriva | | (?) 26 || atha śaktiṃ samutkṣipya yamānalasamaprabhām | cikṣepa bhagavān skandaḥ kruddhaḥ krauñcajighāṃsayā ||27|| sā papāta girermūrdhni śaktiḥ krauñcasya satvaram | kṣīṇāyuṣo yathā puṃso mṛtyupāśa....||28|| sa tayā bhinnamarmā tu śaktyā krauñco nagottamaḥ | sarvataśchinnasarvāṅgaḥ sravadrudhiranirjharaḥ ||29 | | mūrttimānapatad bhūmau saṃjñāprāṇavivarjitaḥ | patiṃ vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā patnyastasya suduḥkhitāḥ | |8.171.3 0 || vilapantyastadā dīnaṃ petuḥ krauñcācalopari | merurhimācalo vindhyaḥ kailāso gandhamādanaḥ ||3 1 | | pāriyātraśca sahyaśca niṣadhodayavāmanāḥ | krauñcasya janakaścāpi mainākaḥ parvatottamaḥ ||3 2 || sarve parvatarājāna ājagmuḥ śokapīḍitāḥ | parivārya giriṃ krauñcaṃ rurudurduḥkhitā bhṛśam | | 33 || bhrātṛputra hataṃ jñātvā devadevī girīndrajā | śarveṇa sahitā krauñcamājagāma mahāvratā | | 34| | kumāreṇa hataṃ dṛṣṭvā krauñcaṃ bāndhavamātmanaḥ | pīḍitābhūttadā devī dṛṣṭvā pitaramarditam | |35|| himavantaṃ mahāśailaṃ vadhāt pautrasya duḥkhitam | śuśoca girijā dṛṣṭvā muhurvīkṣya sureśvaram || 36 || bhagavantamathāyātaṃ devyā saha pinākinam | śokenāpi susantaptā namaścakrurmahābalāḥ | |37| | atha praṇamya deveśaṃ himavānacalottamaḥ | vyajñāpayata dīnātmā śakto yāsye pautragatiṃ tvaham | |42 || evaṃ vilapatastasya meruvindhyapurogamāḥ | vinedurduḥkhasaṃtaptā bāndhavābhāvapīḍitāḥ ||43 || pitaraṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathānyān bāndhavān girīn | vyāsa kruddhaṃ devagaṇādhipam | prahlādasya bhayāddeva mahādaityapatervayam | | 32 | | imaṃ vyatikramaṃ prāptā na doṣo naḥ kathañcana | atha cenmanyase doṣamasmākamamarādhipa | |3 3 || prahrādāntikramāgaccha prayāma sahitā drutam | tenedaṃ kāritaṃ sarvaṃ yajñadeśopamardanam | daityarājena balinā yuṣmadapriyalipsayā | |3 4| | nāparādhoyamasmākaṃ tathā tvaṃ viddhi devapa | tāneva bruvataḥ śakraḥ sutarāṃ manyumān girīn | | 35| | pakṣahīnān tadā cakre kṣiptvā vajraṃ punaḥpunaḥ | hīnapakṣāstataste tu sarva evācaleśvarāḥ | | 36 | | peturmahītale vyāsa chinnapakṣāḥ khagā iva | atha daityapatiḥ śrutvā prahrādosurapuṅgavaḥ | |37|| pakṣacchedaṃ nagendrāṇāṃ bhṛśaṃ cukrodha pīḍitaḥ | kiṅkaromīti saṃcintya ciraṃ daityagaṇādhipaḥ | |38| | vadaryāśramamāgatya dadarśa viṣṇumāsthitam | tasyāsīt sumahadyuddhaṃ viṣṇunā sārdhamadbhutam ||3 9|| na śaśāka ca taṃ viṣṇurjetuṃ prahlādamojasā | tayoryuddhamabhūd ghoraṃ divyamabdaśataṃ purā ||8.172.40 || ātmānaṃ veda hīnaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ prahlādadānavāt | sobhiyuktastadā yuddhe viṣṇuḥ paramadharmavit ||41 || aśakto dānavaṃ jetuṃ manyumānabhavat prabhuḥ | atha dhyātvā mahādevaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ | |42| | sasmāra para...........| ............pinākinaḥ | |43 | | avadhyatvamajayyatvaṃ sarvalokanivāsibhiḥ | prasādaṃ tamanusmṛtya śaivaṃ viṣṇuḥ surottamaḥ | |44|| mahāsatvabalo bhūtvā daityamabhyadravad balī | hīyamānamathātmānaṃ hiṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | |45| | jñātvā ca balinaṃ viṣṇuṃ yuddhadeśādapākramat | ajitaṃ viṣṇunātmānaṃ śivatejovimohitaḥ | |46 | | prahrādo jitamātmānaṃ bubudhe dānaveśvaraḥ | brahmaṇopi varaṃ labdhvā ajayayyatvamathātmanaḥ | |47|| jitameva tadātmānamamanyata mahāsuraḥ | prahrādāsurasaṃgrāmaṃ ghoraṃ devabhayaṃkaram | |48| | abhūdabdaśataṃ divyaṃ viṣṇunā sārdhamadbhutam | na śrutena na vīryeṇa na śauryeṇa na tejasā | |49|| na buddhyā na ca dharmeṇa prahrādasadṛśosuraḥ | hiraṇyakaśipurnāsīdrājā tatsadṛśo mahān | |8.172.50 | | nāndhako na hiraṇyākṣaḥ prahlādasadṛśo bale | bhṛguśāpāt kilāyāto daityatvaṃ viṣṇureva saḥ ||51 | | śauryeṇa spṛhayanti sma śrutena vinayena ca | divaukasopi saṃsiddhāḥ prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ | |52| | nābhavaṃstasya rājye tu duḥkhaśokānvitāḥ prajāḥ | evaṃ sa dānavaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā yuddhaṃ tu viṣṇunā | |53 || paścāttāpopataptāṅgo viṣayebhyo gataspṛhaḥ | varadānamanityaṃ taj jñātvā ca tapasaḥ phalam ||54| | niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāryeṣu viṣayepsāvivarjitaḥ | sarvasannyastakarmā tu dhyānābhyāsaparāyaṇaḥ | |56 || pravavrāja mahādaityaḥ śamepsurmokṣasiddhaye | punarāvartakaṃ janma buddhvā cānityatā parām ||57| | kaṣṭaṃ rājyamiti jñātvā prahrādaḥ paramārthavit | abhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye ditijānāṃ virocanam ||5 8 || daityadānavarājānaṃ kṛtvā tamasureśvaram | mokṣasiddhiṃ parāmicchan pravrajyākṛtaniścayaḥ | |59| | varaṃ tattvamathānveṣṭuṃ guṇātītamajaṃ śivam | sākṣād bhagavataḥ śiṣyaṃ kapilasyāsuriṃ munim ||8.172.60 || śiṣyatvenopasaṃgamya mokṣavidyāmavāptavān | prakṛtīnāṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vikārāṇāṃ paraṃ tathā || 61 || kṣetrajñaṃ puruṣaṃ jñātvā bhoktāraṃ bhoktṛvarjitam | mokṣavidyāparārthajñaḥ sāṃkhyasiddhāntapāragaḥ | |62 || siddhaḥ pañcaśikho nāmnā sobhavanmunisattama | sa yogaṃ paramaṃ labdhvā sāṃkhyācāryo mahāmuniḥ | duḥkhatrayavinirmuktaḥ prāptavān padamavyayam | |63 || śrīmānevaṃ tribhuvanaripurdaityarājo mahātmā kṛtvā vairaṃ vibudhaguruṇā viṣṇunā dīrghakālam | siddhaḥ paścājjagadabhayadaḥ prāptayogaśca bhūtvā muktaḥ paścāt sa padamamṛtaṃ brahma cādyaṃ hyavāpa | |64|| kṣetrajñaboddhā guṇaviprayukto duḥkhairvihīno bhavapāśabandhaiḥ | tāmisramohapratibandhamukto yogośvarosau ditijādhipobhūt ||65| | evaṃ tām̐śchinnapakṣām̐stu girīn sarvān purandaraḥ | pracakāra muniśreṣṭha prāk pṛṣṭo yadahaṃ tvayā ||6 6|| iti skandapurāṇe prahrādacarite parvatapakṣacchedonāmā dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.173> vyāsa uvāca nagendro jīvite krauñce toṣite ca surairguhe | yāto himavataḥ śṛṅgaṃ pārvatyā sahito haraḥ | |1 || kimanyadakaroddevaḥ kiṃ cainaṃ prāha pārvatī | etat kathaya viprendra na tṛptiḥ śṛṇvato hi me | | 2 || sūta uvāca evamukto munīndreṇa brahmaṇastanayovyayaḥ | ṛṣiḥ paramayogīśaḥ kathayāmāsa tattvataḥ | | 3 | | prayāte himavacchṛṅgaṃ devadeve sahomayā | babhāṣe girijā devaṃ praṇamya parameśvaram | |4| | uñchavṛtterhiraṇyasya naimiśāraṇyavāsinaḥ | śaucena tapasā bhaktyā yuktasya ca śamena hi | |5| | svayameva prayātāhaṃ dvijaṃ pūjāṃ pratīcchitum | māhātmyaṃ tasya tad dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇasya tapasvinaḥ | |6 || gatāhaṃ vismayaṃ deva dvijāḥ śreṣṭhatamā iti | devebhyopi garīyāṃso brahmaṇā iti me matiḥ | tvattotha śrotumicchāmi dvijamāhātmyamuttamam ||7|| devadeva uvāca evametajjagaddhātri surāsuranamaskṛte | śreṣṭhāstapasvino viprā devebhyopi garīyasaḥ | |8| | madīyā yāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ prathamāḥ prabhavo hyaham | rudrā dvijātayaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā sṛṣṭā mahaujasaḥ | |9| | madīyāṃ mṛṣṭimālokya brahmaṇāpi sisṛkṣuṇā | brāhmaṇā mūrdhataḥ sṛṣṭāḥ pūrvameva mahāprabhāḥ | | 8.173.10 | | agrabhūto hyahaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhastadābhavam | tataste matsakhāḥ sarve babhūvurviprasattamāḥ | | 11 || uttamaiṣāparā sṛṣṭirbrāhmaṇāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | dharmādikaṃ caturvarṇaṃ sarvaṃ teṣu pratiṣṭhitam || 12 | | yajjuhvati havirviprāstena tṛpyanti devatāḥ | jagat pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hi tejasā | | 13 | | mṛtyujanmāpahaṃ yattanmama pāśupataṃ vratan | na varṇāḥ sādhayantyanye muktvā brāhmaṇasattamān ||14| | lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvijātīnāmidaṃ śṛṇu | śaucārjavavidhānaṃ ca prabhāvaṃ karma caiva ha | |1 5| | brāhmaṇastu bhavejjātyā saṃskārād dvija ucyate | vidyayā vipratāṃ yāti brāhmaṇyaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam | | 16|| yaśca jātyā bhaved vipro yaśca syād vedapāragaḥ | tayostrāṇe vadhe cāpi puṇyapāpe same smṛte || 17| | jātyā ca yo bhavedvipraḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaḥ | tapaśaucasamāyuktastryavadātaḥ sa ucyate | | 18 | | tādṛśaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe daive karmaṇi vāpi yaḥ | akṣayaṃ tad bhavet tasya vyavadātasya tarpaṇāt ||1 9|| vedavidyo bhavedvipro nityaṃ homaparāyaṇaḥ | sopi śreṣṭhaḥ smṛto devi pūjitastārayet kulam ||8.173.20 || sarvathā jātimātreṇa yopi syād brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit | sopi lokagururdevi pūjitaḥ svargado bhaveta | |2 1 | | agnihotraṃ tapo yajñaḥ śaucamārjavameva ca | satyaṃ vedaprasaṅgaśca dvijakarma paraṃ smṛtam | |22 || nānṛtaṃ brāhmaṇo brūte na hanti prāṇinaṃ dvijaḥ | na sevāṃ kurute vipro na dvijaḥ pāpakṛdbhavet || 23 || brāhmaṇaśca tapasvī ca na janma punarāpnute | vidvadbrāhmaṇatāṃ labdhvā kinna labdhaṃ hi dehinā | | 24| | mūrttayo yāḥ smṛtā hyaṣṭāvarkasomādayo mama | sarvāstā nivasanti sma brāhmaṇe tapasaidhite ||25|| dvijatejo hyavaṣṭabhya amṛtaṃ gāva eva ca | prabhavanti sadā devi viprāḥ śreṣṭhatamāstataḥ ||26|| nāsādhyaṃ vidyate teṣāṃ dvijānāṃ paramaujasām | ruṣitāste prasannā vā prayacchanti śubhāśubham | |27|| dvijāstapasvino ye tu vedavidyāviśāradāḥ | muktidāstu bhaveyuste devānāmapi devatāḥ | |28| | ahaṃ pitāmahaścaiva teṣāṃ yonidvayaṃ smṛtam | mattaḥ pūrvaṃ prasūtāste tato devi pitāmahāt ||29|| āvāṃ hetū dvijātīnāṃ prakṛtitvāt tvameva ca | prakṛtistvaṃ samākhyātā puruṣaḥ paramo hyaham ||8.173.3 0 | | brahmaviṣṇū smṛtau yau tau rajaḥsatvaguṇātmakau | āvābhyāṃ tau prajāyete sṛṣṭikāle prajāpatī | |31 || ahaṃ hyagnistamo viṣṇuḥ satvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃsthitam | rajastvaṃ vyāpitaṃ viddhi guṇabhūteṣu karmasu ||3 2|| mohātmako smṛtāvetau tamo rāgastathaiva ca | satvaṃ nāśayate tau hi sa cāgneḥ saṃprajāyate | |3 3 || vahnitejāḥ smṛtā hyete mahātmāno dvijātayaḥ | sarvataḥ prabhavantyete nāsti teṣāṃ nivāraṇam || 34| | ārjavaṃ samatāṃ caiva viddhi tejo dvijātiṣu | tapovidyāsamāyuktādārjavastu viśiṣyate ||3 5| | aśāṭhyaṃ hanti pāpāni samatā mohabandhanam | ubhepyete nihanti sma ārjavaṃ sevitaṃ dvijaiḥ || 3 6|| purā bhāgīrathītīre dvijaḥ paramadharmavit | nāmnā dānarucirnāma uñchavṛttirbabhūva ha ||37| | sarvavidyāvinītātmā sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ | saha patnyā ca madbhakto vahnihomaparāyaṇaḥ ||38|| atithiṃ bhojayitvā ca pūrvaṃ devi yathāgatam | ṣaṣṭhe kāle tatośnāti tasyedaṃ vratamuttamam | |3 9 | | athaivaṃ vartamānasya bhūyān kālo jagāma ha | atithāvāgate tasya na vikalpaḥ prajāyate | |8.173.40 || tapaśaucasamāyukta ārjavaikarato dvijaḥ | babhūvātyarthamarciṣmānarkāgnī iva tejasā | |41 || tasyaivaṃ tapaso vahniḥ prītastuṣṭimagāt parām | śubhaditsurabhūccāsya samīhitaphalapradaḥ | |42 | | kadācidatha kālena ṣaṣṭhe kāle samāgate | himamegholbaṇe śīte durdine paryaṭan dvijaḥ | |43 || nāpaśyadatithiṃ kañcid bubhukṣāklamakheditaḥ | yadā nāsaditastena dināntepyatithiḥ kvacit | |44|| aprāśyaiva tadā kiñcidupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ | babhūva dvijamukhyosau nātmakhedamacintayat | |45|| patnyapyasya mahābhāgā patibhaktivrate ratā | yathaivāsyāḥ patiścakre tathā sāpyakarottadā ||46| | śītakṣudupataptāṅgo naikadvandvasamāvṛtaḥ | kleśena mahatātīva khinnobhūddevi sa dvijaḥ | |47|| dvitīyetha samāyāte ṣaṣṭhe kāle sa ha dvijaḥ | śītadurddinajāddoṣānnaivātithimavaikṣata | |48 | | athāgnistasya tajjñātvā niścayaṃ paramaṃ mahat | śvapākasadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ vikṛtaṃ kutsitaṃ ca hi ||49|| kṛtvā pādapamūlasthaḥ pradadau tasya darśanam | kṣudhārtotha sa viprendraḥ paryaṭannatithīpsayā | |8.173.50 | | apaśyad vṛkṣamūlasthaṃ ghoraṃ vikṛtarūpiṇam | śvapākaṃ śītasaṃkhinnaṃ naikavraṇaśatāṅkitam ||51 || durdṛśaṃ vṛddhamārttañca prasravatkṛmiśoṇitam | vikrośantaṃ ca tāteti sopaśyad dvijasattamaḥ ||52 | | kṛpaṇaṃ tamatho dṛṣṭvā śvapākaṃ dvijasattamaḥ | samāśvasihi bhadreti provāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ | |53 | | śītāpanayanārthañca vahnimasyānayad dvijaḥ | atha taṃ vahnisaṃsargāt samāśvastamuvāca saḥ | |54|| ehi bhuṃkṣvātithirme tvaṃ bhava bhadreti sādaram | tamuvāca tato dīnaṃ śvapākastapasāṃ nidhim ||55| | śvapākohaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mahyamannamihaiva hi | kutsitāya prayacchasva yathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇām || 56 | | nāhaṃ saṃskṛtamāhartuṃ yogyonnamiti cābravīt | tamevaṃ vādinaṃ dhyānājjñātvā vahnimupasthitam | |57| | provāca dvijaśārdūla idaṃ vacanakovidaḥ | nāhaṃ jātiṃ garhayāmi pūjayāmi na cānagha | |58| | ātmā sarvagato hyeṣa sarvaprāṇiṣu saṃsthitaḥ | ātmānaṃ tamahaṃ bhaktyā pūjayāmi paraṃ śivam | |59| | sarvatra saṃsthitaṃ matvā puruṣaṃ parameśvaram | tiryakṣu nahi me kutsā tvadvidheṣu viśeṣataḥ | | 8.173.60 | | sarvameva sa eveti tapaḥśaucaparāyaṇaḥ | pūjayāmyahamavyagrastatra nissaṃśayo bhava | |61 | | kṛmikīṭākhusarpeṣu śvapāgdevadvijātiṣu | yadā sarvagato hyātmā tadā kutsā kathañca naḥ | | 62 || na hi me kutsito bhadra ehi me tvamakutsitaḥ | bhuṃkṣva saṃskṛtamannantu prāpayāsmānanugraham || 63 | | evamukto dvijendreṇa śvapākaḥ prītimām̐stadā | gṛhaṃ jagāma viprasya tasyānugrahalipsayā | | 64|| atha dānarucistasya atitheriva pūjitam | ātithyaṃ vidhivaccakre bhāvaśuddhena cetasā ||65 || mūrttimān sobhavat prīto bhojito havyavāhanaḥ | pradadāvīpsitaṃ cāsmai yogaiśvaryamanuttamam | |6 6 || sa yogaṃ paramaṃ prāpya uñchavṛttirdvijottamaḥ | vimuktaḥ saha patnyā tu prāptavānamṛtaṃ padam | | 67|| yathaiva kapilaḥ siddhastattvavit paramo muniḥ | evamārjavasaṃpanno brāhmaṇaḥ kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ | na kiñcinnāpnuyāddevi śubhācchubhataraṃ padam | |68 || etatte kathitaṃ nagendratanaye māhātmyamagryaṃ paraṃ viprāṇāmamaratviṣāṃ subahuśaḥ puṇyāyuṣaḥ prāpakam | śṛṇvannityamidaṃ paṭham̐śca vidhivadvidvāñchucirmānavaḥ puṇyaṃ saukhyamathāyurīpsitaphalaṃ tejo balaṃ cāpnuyāt | |69|| māhātmyametat kathitaṃ yathāvat mahāmahīdhrendrasute dvijānām | sṛṣṭeḥ prabhavānmama te dvijendrā māhātmyamitthaṃ paramaṃ hyavāpuḥ | |8.173.70 | | sanatkumāra uvāca dvijamāhātmyamullikhya pārvatīparameśayoḥ | babhūvetthaṃ susaṃvādaḥ puṇyaḥ pāpavināśanaḥ ||71 | | ........pārāśarya tapodhana | śrotavyaṃ manyase mattastat pṛcchasva samāhitaḥ ||72| | iti skandapurāṇe dvijamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.174> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan yattvayā proktaṃ dakṣayajñavadhe tadā | prāpya pāśupataṃ yogaṃ brahmādyāstridivaukasaḥ || 1 || lebhire paramaṃ tattvaṃ jñānena hi mahāmune | tanme kathaya bhaktāya śiṣyāya paripṛcchate | |2 || kīdṛśaṃ tatparaṃ yogaṃ jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ śubham | yajjñātvā brāhmaṇāḥ siddhāḥ prāpnuyurmokṣamuttamam | iti pṛṣṭastu śiṣyeṇa provāca munisattamaḥ ||3 | | sanatkumāra uvāca sādhu vyāsa mahābuddhe mumukṣurasi putraka | yanmāṃ pṛcchasi tajjñānaṃ yogaṃ māheśvaraṃ param ||4| | sarvāsāṃ yogavidyānāṃ yattattvaṃ parikīrtyate | sāṃkhyayogāgamopetāḥ sarvādhyātmaviśāradāḥ || 5| | yogaiśvaryamapi prāpya tattvaṃ naivopalebhire | yadabuddhvā mahābhāga jñānaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitam || 6| | tadyathā kathitaṃ teṣāṃ tryambakeṇa divaukasām | tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepāttattvaniścayam | |7| | vistareṇa na tacchakyaṃ vaktuṃ 5|| bhavajanmāpahaḥ sūkṣmaḥ prapannānāṃ divaukasām | śarīre tiṣṭhataḥ puṃso yadātmani manaḥ sthitam | | 16 | | avitarkaṃ bahiścaiva sūkṣmamabhyāsayojitam | kṛtānāṃ pratyayaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃjñinām || 17| | aśeṣalopa ityakta sādhakasya tu yuñjataḥ | paro maheśvaro devaḥ sobhisandhistu yojakaḥ | |1 8 | | abhisandhistadā yasmādīśvarasyātmanaśca ha | sukhādānamathaikena bhāvanā..yojanāt | | 19| | pra..........tiṣṭhatassataḥ | sādhakasya bhavennityaṃ hyadriḥ siddhamidaṃ phalam | | 8.174.20 | | athādhikaraṇaṃ tatra kramaśaḥ parikīrtyate (?) pratyāhāramato vidyā prāṇāyāmastathaiva ca | dhyānañca dhāraṇā caiva yogābhyāsa udāhṛtaḥ ||21 | | tisro mṛtyumatikramya kriyā hi caturātmikāḥ | varttante na ca vai..mṛtyuḥ prabhavate mune | | 22 || vaśyā hi dhātavastasmād bhavantyasya na saṃśayaḥ | tatosau pavamṛtyuśca sādhako bhavati..|| 23 | | imāstarkkakriyā vyāsa mastake hṛdi caiva hi | antarikṣe ca sarvāstu kīrtitā hi na saṃśayaḥ | | 24| | sthānatrayanibaddhāstu caturlakṣaṇasaṃsthitāḥ | kriyāḥ pramādinā naitāḥ śakyāḥ sādhayituṃ kvacit | | 2 5|| tisra etāḥ sadā mṛtyuṃ pravṛttā mohalakṣaṇāḥ | viyogo na bhavettāsu kriyāsvekaika...| | 26 | | ajñānaṃ kampate tāsu bahirantaścarāsvapi | kriyāsu sādhako yuktastathā madhyagatāsu ca | | 27| | bhūtendriyamanaḥkāladiṅnivṛttiḥ prabhāvataḥ | daśaivāśāstrayaḥ kālā bhūtānīndriyavistaraḥ || 28 | | manaḥpracārasaṃyukto viṣayābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ | pratyāhāra iti proktaḥ purā bhagavatā svayam | | 29 | | digantaragamābhāvāt manasyavicalasthitau | pratyāhārasamutpatiryogotpattau sakṛd bhavet | | 8.174.30 | | trikālaviṣayaṃ jñānamaiśvaryodagrameva ca | cale manasi nābhūtāṃ bhavetāṃ saṃsthite samam | | 31 || manaḥ sarvamidaṃ yasmāt sādhanaṃ yogakarmaṇaḥ | ekato manasaḥ sthāne tasmād yatnaṃ samācaret | |3 2 | | prāṇanigrahaṇe dhyānaṃ prāṇāyāmamiti smṛtama | prāṇa eva hi vāyūnāṃ sārathye vartate sadā | || 33 | | prāṇanigrahaṇe yogī nityamabhyāsamācaret | uttarottarasaṃsiddhyā vāyu...gocare | | 34| | jyotiḥ pravartanaṃ vidyānnityamabhyāsayojitam | dvirapāne sakṛtprāṇe samāne ca....| | 35 | | ...….......| ..............| | 36 | | kumbha eṣa tṛtīyastu yogavahnipradīpakaḥ | |37| | ebhirdhyānagatiḥ sūkṣmā vāyusaṃrodhakāritā | pravartate yayā yogī paramaṃ veṣṭi pudgalam | | 3 8|| sakṛdeva samāhārādasakṛtparimokṣaṇāt | kumbhakaṃ caitaduddiṣṭaṃ prāṇāyāmādidhāraṇāt | | 3 9| | prāṇo vāyurasāvātmā śarīre jīva...| vidyād rūpadvayaṃ tasya sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca sarvataḥ ||8.174.40|| avyaktaṃ sūkṣmarūpaṃ tu sthūlamākāralakṣaṇama | sthūlādārabhya sūkṣmaṃ tu dhyānābhyāsānnirūpayet ||41 | | sūkṣmasaṃropaṇājjyotiḥ prakāśo jāyate mune | dhyāyataḥ sthūlalakṣyaṃ tu sarvadikṣu sṛtaṃ manaḥ | yadā dīptimadutpadyet tadāśu sthāpayet punaḥ ||42 | | girau vṛkṣe marutpṛṣṭhe śvabhre prāsādapaṃktiṣu | samudre vasudhāyāṃ vā manaḥsaṃyogamācaret | |43 || sthāpitaṃ tanmanastatra punaḥ saṃhāramāvrajet | acaitanyaṃ diśenmohād vāyurdṛṣṭamatonyathā | |44| | saṃhṛtya ca tato vyāpi bhūyo dhyānagatiṃ caret | dhyāyato nityamabhyāsānmano vāyu....| |45| | pravṛttajñānayogasya viṣayāsaṃgasaṃkṣaye | prātibhāni hi vighnāni satvādiguṇajāni tu | vighnabhūtāni yogasya prodbhavanti hi yuñjataḥ | |46|| tāni vidvān prayatnena viṣayecchāvivarjitaḥ | jitvā nirvāṇamārgastho bhavet traiguṇyavarjitaḥ ||47| | ākāśagamanaṃ divyamapsarogaṇasaṃgajam | abhiṣekaśca devebhyaścitrakāvyapravartanam | |48 | | aiśvaryasukhasaṃsaktirhemaratnāgamaṃ bahu | satvādetāni vighnāni prātibhāni tu lakṣayet ||49|| utpattimadayuktāni bhinnācārakramāṇi tu | rajovighnāni saṃvidyāt prātibhāni na saṃśayaḥ | |8.174.50 || kṣayaśūlajvaronmādakuṣṭasarpagrahāṇi tu | yātanodgamapūrvāṇi tāmasāni vinirdiśet ||51| | guṇatrayasamutthāni prātibhāni sadā muniḥ | yuñjan saṃlakṣayecchīghraṃ cikitsedāśu caiva hi ||52 || prāṇādyānabhisandhāya manaḥ saṃhṛtya caiva hi | prāṇāyāmena kumbhena hanyādvighnāni sarvataḥ | |53 || rajaḥ satvaṃ tamaścaiva pradhānasya guṇāstrayaḥ | tasyaiva hi maheśasya prajāsaṃsargahetavaḥ || 54|| yogamohād bhavantyete sābhimānasya yuñjataḥ | nirīho nirvṛto yogī sacetā ghaṭate yadā | |55| | prātibhāni tadā yānti vighnāni hi samaṃ kṣayam | prādurbhāvastatasteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ mohakāraṇam (?) ||56 || tamo raudraṃ vijānīyāt satvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃsthitam | rajastu baiṣṇavaṃ vidyātteṣāṃ hantā maheśvaraḥ | |57| | mahādevaṃ paraṃ jñātvā yogābhyāsarato dvijaḥ | guṇatrayavinirmuktaḥ śaṅkare layamāpnuyāt ||58 || yamaiḥ saniyamaiḥ pūrvaṃ śodhayedātmanastanum | tataḥ śāstrapraṇītena dharmādharmavivarjitaḥ ||59|| krameṇa sopadeśena dhyānābhyāsaṃ samācaret | śabdādīn viṣayān jitvā śrotrādīndriyagocarān ||8.174.60 | | samo daivatatiryakṣu nirmamaḥ sarvavastuṣu | sarvārambhavinirmuktaḥ puṇyapāpavivarjitaḥ | |6 1 | | nirdvandvo nirjane īśe yogābhyāsaṃ samācaret | sābhimānaṃ saniyamaṃ tyaktvā sāṃkhyaviniścayam || 62 | | pare māheśvare yoge nityamamyāsamācaret | aṣṭau prakṛtayo nityā vikārāścaiva ṣoḍaśa | |63 || puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśaśca sāṃkhyasiddhāntagocaraḥ | etadeva paraṃ guhyaṃ drye sāṃkhyānāṃ tattvaniścaye | prakṛterantaraṃ jñātvā puruṣasya ca mucyate | |64| | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇanaṃ nāma dhyānavidhau prathamoyaṃ catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.175> sanatkumāra uvāca yogaṃ sāṃkhyañca sarvatra dvividhaṃ jñānamucyate | tatra sāṃkhyaratāḥ kecit kecid yogapathāśritāḥ || 1 || avyaktaṃ prakṛtiścaiva tathāhaṅkāra eva ca | aṣṭau prakṛtayo hyetāstanmātraḥ pañcabhiḥ saha | | 2 | | pañca buddhīndriyāṇyāhuḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi ca | manaḥ pañca ca bhūtāni vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ ||3 || puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśaśca sarvārambhavivarjitaḥ | nityaḥ sarvagataḥ sūkṣmaścetāvān triguṇejjhitaḥ | |4| | saṃśuddho vimalo bhoktā akartā sākṣivat sthitaḥ | viditvā na viśantyenaṃ bhūyaḥ saṃsārapañjaram || 5|| pañcaviṃśati tattvāni sāṃkhyairetāni yogibhiḥ | proktāni yad viditvā hi mucyate kila janmanaḥ | |6 | | sūkṣmā prakṛtiravyaktā bhojyā sarvaratā calā | nityā cācetanā caiva vijñeyā sarvakāmikī ||7|| tamaḥ satvaṃ rajaśceti viṣayasthaṃ guṇatrayam | yeṣāmavyabhicārāddhi sarvametadavasthitam ||8 || prakāśajananaṃ satvaṃ rajaḥ saṅgapravartanam | tamo vimohanañcaiva guṇavistara ucyate | |9 | | bhinnakāryapracārāṇāmeteṣāṃ guṇasaṃjñinām | hetunā puruṣārthena sādhikā vṛttirucyate | |8.175.1 0 | | daivamaṣṭavibhedantu tiryak saptavidhaṃ smṛtam | avikalpyaṃ ca mānuṣyaṃ sarvatetad guṇātmakam | |1 1 | | mūḍhaṃ niścetanaṃ bhūtaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmamathāpi vā | amūrttaṃ mūrttimadvāpi triguṇaṃ sarvamucyate | | 12 | | mokṣavighnakarā hyete kīrtitā yogino guṇāḥ | saktasyaiva hi bandhaḥ syādasakto mukta ucyate | vibhāgāt prakṛtisthasya sthitā nityaṃ guṇatrayam (?) || 13 | | vibhāgena vikārasthā yathādharmaṃ samāśritāḥ | bhūtasargastridhābhūtaḥ sāṃkhyajñaiḥ paripaṭhyate | | 14 | saṃsiddhaḥ prākṛtaścaiva tathā vaikṛta ucyate | tatra dharmeṇa saṃsiddhā yoge māheśvare sthitāḥ || 1 5| | necchanti saṃbhavaṃ vyāsa dharmo (?) pañcātmataḥ smṛtaḥ | te punardravyasaṃbandhāt sāṃkhyadṛṣṭāntapaṇḍitāḥ | | 1 6|| icchanti kāryamāśritya kāraṇāśrayiṇo na hi | pradhānāt puruṣād buddhirabhūt satvādhikāsakṛt ||17| | guṇānāṃ pariṇāmena prākṛtānāṃ jalādivat | byavasāyastathā rūpaṃ niścayaśceti bhāṣyate | | 18 | | buddhireva hyahaṅkāraḥ pratyayāntarasaṃbhavāt | manaḥ kecit tamicchanti kriyājaṃ guṇasaṃgraham || 19 | | ahameva hi karteti ahaṅkāra udāhṛtaḥ | manasaḥ kalpanaṃ vāpi smṛtamindriyagocaram | buddhibhūtādahaṅkārāt satvotpannāt prakāśinaḥ || 8.175.20 || buddhīndriyāṇi jātāni pañca sattvodayāni tu | bodhyate budhyate vāpi mumukṣustvindriyairyataḥ | | 21 | | tato buddhīndriyāṇīti kīrtyante tattvacintakaiḥ | ................| | 22| | ataḥ karmendriyāṇyāhurguṇājjātāni rājasāt | tāmasādapyahaṅkārāt tanmātrāṇyabhavan punaḥ ||2 3 | | kecit sarvagatānyāhu........| ....vidhaṃ tacca dharmādharmasamudbhavam || 24| | yāti sarvatra siddhārthaṃ bhūtavyāpi vimohanam | śaktaṃ sarvāśrayaṃ sūkṣmamanivāritadikpatham | | 25|| liṅgaḥ tacca samākhyātaṃ dehināṃ yacca kāraṇam | yaśca sargastridhā proktaḥ sa eva navadhā punaḥ | | 26|| prākṛtasya vikārasya dehabhedāḥ sahasraśaḥ | tattvasargaḥ smṛtaḥ pūrvaḥ piṇḍasargastatoparaḥ | | 27| | pratyayānāṃ tataḥ sargastṛtīyaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | asakti rvilayastuṣṭiḥ siddhiśceti catusthi ||28|| bhedāḥ pratyayasarge tu vaiṣamyādapare smṛtāḥ | pañcāśat parito bhedā ye ca teṣāṃ guṇā daśa | | 29 || ṣaṣṭirete padārthā hi gīyante kapilādibhiḥ | sā tuṣṭirnavadhā bhinnā siddhiścaivāṣṭadhā punaḥ ||8.175.3 0 | | smṛtaḥ pañcavidhaścāpi teṣāmeva viparyayaḥ | aṣṭabhedāstribhinnā syād daśabhiḥ kāryabandhanaiḥ ||3 1 || ete ṣaṣṭipadārthāstu saṃkhyājñānamiti śrutiḥ | nyūnāmekādhikāmeke ṣaṣṭimanye tu jānate ||32|| mamaiva hi purā vatsa guṇaje padapañcake | antaraṃ tattvamanveṣṭuṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca | |3 3 || sāṃkhyatantraṃ mahad buddhvā jñātvā tat prakṛteḥ param | pacaviṃśamajaṃ tattvaṃ bhoktāramabhimāninam ||34|| sandehāpagamo nābhūdabuddhvā parameśvaram | yadāhaṃ devadevena svayameva jagatsṛjā | |3 5| | svayogaṃ śambhunā vatsa grāhito gatasaṃśayaḥ | tadā ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ tattvaṃ jñātvā sarvagamīśvaram || 3 6|| vimukto yogasaṃsiddhau jātohaṃ mohavarjitaḥ | bhoktā cet prakṛterasti bhuṃkte ca puruṣaḥ svayam | ............napi dvija ||37|| yastayoḥ parato nityam ṣaḍviṃśastvīśvaro vibhuḥ | taṃ jñātvā paramaṃ tattvaṃ mucyate janmabandhanāt ||38|| sāṃkhyaṃ kṛtsnamapi jñātvā guṇāntaravicāraṇāt | pañcaviṃśakasaṃbodhānnaiva muktiḥ prajāyate | sa baddho bhoktṛpāśaistu guṇaiḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavaḥ | |3 9|| abhimānātmako bhoktā puruṣatvādamocakaḥ | taṃ viditvāpi naiva syānmuktiḥ pratyayavarjitā | |8.175.40 || eṣa uktassamāsena sāṃkhyasiddhāntavistaraḥ | yogatattvaṃ pravakṣyāmi duḥkhajanmavināśanam ||41 || saṃbhavaṃ dehinaścaiva vairāgyaṃ yena codbhavet | dharmādharmaparityāgaṃ satyānṛtavivarjitam | |42| | yogābhyāsaṃ parāsaṅgaṃ sūkṣmajñānamaninditam | sarvasaṃsaktinirmukta mīśvaraprāptikāraṇam | |43 | | siddhinirdvandvasaṃyogamaśubhodayanāśanam | paropalabdhivijñānaṃ tattvārthapadaniścayam ||44| | bhavajanmāpahaṃ yogaṃ viṣayendriyavarjitam | mataṃ paśupateḥ kṛtsnamamṛtāspadalambhanam | |45 | | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau dvitīyoyaṃ pañcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.176> sanatkumāra uvāca utpadyate yathā janturvairāgyaṃ vrajate yathā | yathā prabudhyate caiva tatte vyāsa vadāmyaham || 1 | | ākāśaḥ pavanastejo bhūmirāpastathaiva ca | eṣāmekatra saṃghātāccharīraṃ nāma jāyate || 2| | rasāḥ somātmakāḥ sarve tathāhāraścaturvidhaḥ | dehināntu rasotpattirāhārasya niṣevaṇāt | |3 | | rasādraktasamutpattiḥ śoṇitāt piśitaṃ smṛtam | meda utpadyate māṃsāttasmādasthīni cābhavan ||4| | majjā cāsthibhavā jñeyā tataḥ śukrasamudbhavaḥ | raktaśukrasamāyogād garbhaḥ saṃbhavati striyāḥ | |5 | | ṛtuyogasamādhānād daivakarmavaśādapi | striyāḥ puṃsaśca ratyante dvāvapyekatvamāgatau | | 6 || tāvekatvamathāpannau preritau pavanena ca | kalalaṃ tvekarātreṇa pañcarātreṇa cārbudam | |7| | piśitaṃ saptarātreṇa māsāccāṅkurasaṃbhavaḥ | tataḥprabhṛti garbhasya vibhāgo bhavati dvija | |8|| śiraḥ pāṇimukhaskandhagrīvāpṛṣṭhādisaṃyutaḥ | pañcānāmatha māsānāmakṣikarṇādisambhavaḥ | |9|| sarvasaṃpūrṇagātrastu srotobhirnavabhiryutaḥ | vyaktībhavati tadgarbho māsairaṣṭabhireva tu || 8.176.10 | | saṃprāpte navame māsi sarvadravyasamanvitaḥ | pañcabhūtātmakaṃ tattu cetovadavatiṣṭhati | | 11 || garbhakledena siktāṅgaḥ sarvaduḥkhasamanvitaḥ | jātiṃ smaredvasam̐statra jantuḥ sarvasamudbhavām | | 12 | | mṛtaḥ punarahaṃ jāto jātaścaiva punarmṛtaḥ | idānīṃ jātamātrastu yogamevābhyasāmyaham | | 13 || na punaryena saṃsāraṃ pravekṣyāmyaśubhodayam | evaṃ cintayatastasya navame māsi saṃgate | | 14|| svakarmavinibaddhasya jātamātrasya dehinaḥ | dahemāviśate vāyuḥ smṛtimākṣipya tāmasaḥ | | 1 5|| yena mūḍho nirānando naivādhyātmaratirbhavet | agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham | | 1 6| | saṃyogādevamutpannamutpatsyati ca suvrata | tatra ye sādhusaṃparkācchubhakarmodayādapi | |17| | āgamānveṣaṇe saktāḥ pāpānuṣṭhānavarjitāḥ | matvā saṃsārajaṃ kleśaṃ janmamṛtyubhayārditam ||1 8 || kāmakrodharatidrohalobhamohasamāvṛtam | vairāgyaṃ janmataḥ kṛtvā sarvārambhaparikṣayāt || 1 9| | anviṣanti śubhārthaṃ hi guhyamadhyātmadarśanam | te yogaṃ paramaṃ prāpya brahma vindanti tat param | |8.176.2 0|| tasya te saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmasaṃbodhakāraṇam | sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ guhyaṃ sarvayoganidarśanam | |21 | | tato māheśvaraṃ yogamākhyāsye tatparantava | tejogniḥ kāmajo vahniḥ krodhāgnirvīkṣaṇānalaḥ | |22| | jaṭharāgniśca bhūtātmā pañcaite dehavahnayaḥ | prāṇāpānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca | |23 || pañcaite vāyavo nityā dehino dehasaṃbhavāḥ | ākāśaprabhavā hyete śarīraṃ caiṣu tiṣṭhati | |24| | māṃsaraktasamākīrṇaṃ snāyumedosthisaṃcayam | tvacāvanaddhaṃ durgandhaṃ śakṛnmūtrasamāvṛtam ||25|| taḍidabhrāgamānityaṃ mṛtpātrāpātasannibham | sarvānarthasamāyuktaṃ nacirānnāśagāmi ca ||26| | ekarūpaṃ navadvāraṃ tristhūṇaṃ pañcadevatam | viṣayendriyasaṃkīrṇaṃ naikavyādhisamārditam || 27|| prāṇādibhiravaṣṭabdhaṃ śarīraṃ yantravat sthitam | vimuktamasakṛt taistu vāyubhirjīvasaṃhataiḥ || 28| | āmapātramivāpātācchīryate kālaparyayāt | pañcabhūtāni bhūtāni dehānniṣkramya sarvaśaḥ | |29| | āviśanti tathātmānamātmā ca viśate drutam | bhūteṣu pavanaḥ śreṣṭho jīvastadvinibandhanaḥ || 8.176.3 0| | vāyvagnī sahitau jīvo na jīvaḥ prāṇināṃ pṛthak | mūrtiranyā na jīvasya mṛtyau dṛśyati dehinaḥ ||31 || pañcarūpātparo devaḥ sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataro mataḥ | nāsau paśyati na ghrāti na śṛṇoti na jalpati | |32|| na jānāti na ca sparśejjīvaḥ prāṇasamāvṛtaḥ | prāṇo nāma mahāvāyurjīvaṃ dhārayate dvija ||3 3|| bhāsate śvasate caiva sarveṣvapi hi dehiṣu | sa prāṇo dhārayatyagniṃ sa ca jīva iti smṛtaḥ | |34|| vāyusandhāraṇo hyagniḥ kriyāsu parivartate | yo vahnimānasau dehe sa jīva iti śabdyate ||3 5|| antargato hi bhūtānāṃ karmārambhanibandhanaḥ | evametaccharīrantu pañcabhūtaguṇātmakam | |36|| tadvikāre pranaṣṭe tu mṛta ityabhidhīyate | bhūtendriyamanojīvaviṣayā rāgabandhane (?) ||37| | hṛdaye karṇikāyāṃ tu madhyasthastejasāṃ nidhiḥ | ātmā sarvagato nityaṃ varjito viṣayādibhiḥ | |38|| tiṣṭhate sa vibhustatra yaṃ viditvā vimucyate | sa yena yogasaṃsiddhyā dhyānakarmakriyāvidā ||39|| nāḍīkarmasamādhānāt satatābhyāsayogataḥ | bhābhiḥ prakāśito dṛṣṭo vikārairvipramocitaḥ ||8.176.40 || dṛṣṭo bhavati viprendra muktiścaiva tataḥ smṛtā | ṣaḍviṃśakaparijñānāllayamādhāya tatra hi ||41 || sarvaprāṇigataṃ sūkṣmamātmadehe ca saṃsthitam | yaṃ prapaśyanti saṃsiddhā yogino gatabandhanāḥ ||42 || yobhyupāyaḥ parastasya vijñānādīśvarasya tu | yogābhyāsaṃ paraṃ taṃ te pravakṣyāmi dvijottama | |43 | | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau tṛtīyaḥ ṣaṭsaptatyuraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.177> sanatkumāra uvāca antarātmā ca cetovānmanaḥ saṃkalpajaṃ smṛtam | mahābhūtapracārācca kṣobhāgnirjova ucyate | | 1|| na śarīraṃ vinā cetastaccen nāsti kutaśca tat | cetopi na vinā jīvaṃ sa cāpi na vinā manaḥ | |2| | prāṇo jīva iti proktaḥ sparśādanyat pravartate | manaḥ sarvaṃ nibadhnāti karmārambhamiti śrutiḥ || 3 || sarva ete hi saṃgatya dhārayanti śarīriṇam | yasya cetodhikanteṣāṃ sa cetovān prakīrtitaḥ | |4| | cetasā tu vijānāti śubhāśubhanibandhanam | tanmanaścetasi sthāpya nityādhyātmaratirbhavet ||5| | śabdādiviṣayātīta indriyāṇi nigṛhya tu | dhyānārambhaparo dehī sa syāt karmavivarjitaḥ | |6| | indriyāṇi na badhnanti mano dehasamāsthitam | jīvo bandhātmako jñeyaḥ śubhāśubhanibandhanāt ||7| | rajasastamasaścaiva guṇayoraśubhātmanoḥ | udrekājjāyate duḥkhaṃ saukhyaṃ satvāt prajāyate | |8|| saukhyasya pariṇāmāddhi duḥkhotpattiḥ śarīriṇām | jāyate ca sukhaṃ vipra bhūyo duḥkhaviparyayāt ||9|| evamanyonyasaṃbaddhaṃ guṇatrayavikārajam | sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ mohaṃ bhūtānyāviśya tiṣṭhati | |8.177.10 || manaścetaḥsamādhānādviṣayodvijanādapi | tasya nāśaḥ samākhyātaḥ saṅgasya ca vivarjanāt ||1 1| | icchānigrahaṇe saktāḥ krodhādiparivarjitāḥ | nirmamā nirahaṅkārā badhyante naiva karmabhiḥ | | 1 2| | ātmā sarvagato hyeṣaḥ sūkṣmaḥ saṃbhogavarjitaḥ | yoginastaṃ prapaśyanti dhyānādvāyuvivarjanāt || 13 | | tāvad bhramati saṃsāre caturyoniṣu jantuṣu | yāvannātmānamanveṣṭi sa ca vinno na janma ca (?) ||14|| yadyapi dhyānasaṃsargādabuddhvā brahma naśyati | tathāpi brahmasāyujyānna tu janma punarlabhet | |15| | athaiśvaryaṃ paraṃ dhyānādyogajaṃ prāpnute muniḥ | viditvā paramātmānaṃ tato na punarāvrajet | | 16 || asukhānyapi karmāṇi mahāpāpakṛtānyapi | kṛtvā dhyānarato jantustarasā nayati kṣayam | |17| | prāpya karmakṣayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dhyānayuktyā mahāmune | tiṣṭhate nirbhayo yogī paramaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ | | 18| | kāmaroṣau tathā saṅgo dveṣo rāgaviniścayaḥ | ete kṣudratarā bhāvā mukta ebhirvimucyate | |1 9 | | garvo dambho hyahaṅkārastarko mānotha matsaraḥ | pāruṣyaṃ krūratā caiva bhāvāḥ kṣatranibandhanāḥ | | 8.177.20 | | yasyaite mohanā na syurvindantyātmānamīśvaram | mohabhāvāntarātītaḥ samaduḥkhasukhassadā || 21 | | nirmamatvādibhiryukto yogīti paripaṭhyate | yajñakarma samutsṛjya vaiṣṇavaṃ mohabandhanam ||22 | | adhyātmaparamo nityaṃ mumukṣurbrāhmaṇo bhavet | trivargaṃ saṃparityajya yopavarge ratiṃ labhet | | 23 || divaukasāmasau pūjyo vipra ityabhidhīyate | dhyānena kṣīyate karma pāpaṃ vā yadi vā śubham | | 24| | kṣīṇakarmā tato yogī tatparaṃ brahma vindati | prāptayogo munirdhyānī yadyat kartumabhīpsate | |25|| tattad bhavati tasyāśu manasā cintitena vā | yoginaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpairmucyanti tatkṣaṇāt | yopi saṃbhāṣate tena sopi sadgatimāpnute ||26 || yogameva paraṃ jñātvā sarvāśubhavimocanam | sacetaso dvijā vipra babhūvurhi mumukṣavaḥ | |27|| dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ paraṃ caiva dhātāraṃ caiva ye viduḥ | tāpanāt tapanāt tāpyānmuktāste duḥkhabandhanāt | |28| | sarvārambhaparityāgānmamatvādivivarjanāt | sāṃkhyayogāgamāvekau bhedastatvavimocane | |29 | nirguṇaḥ sāṃkhyamukhyānāṃ puruṣaḥ paripaṭhyate | dīpanirvāṇavatteṣāṃ dehabhede gatiḥ smṛtā | | 8.177.30 || īśvaraḥ sarvanirmuktaḥ kṣetrajño yogināṃ mataḥ | paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktāstaṃ viśanti hi yoginaḥ ||3 1 | | dhāraṇābhiḥ samaṃ tābhiḥ prāṇāyāmaistathaiva ca | ātmānaṃ yojayedyastu sa yāgaṃ labhate param | |3 2| | ahiṃsādisamāyukto yogī vigatamatsaraḥ | dhyānamabhyasate yastu sa jayenmṛtyujanmanī | | 33 | | nirguṇo nirahaṅkāro jitadvandvonavagrahaḥ | bhikṣopāttarasāhāro mumukṣuriti śabdyate | |34|| sarvārambhasamāvasthaḥ sarvāśrayavivarjitaḥ | karmamārgādatikrānto dhyānīti parikīrtyate ||3 5| | yasya nodvijate ceto duḥkhāpattau mahāmune | na haṣyati sukhe caiva dhyānīti sa viśabditaḥ | |36| | mokṣasiddhipradaḥ panthāstrividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | pūrvaḥ saṃketanaḥ proktaḥ paścāt saṃkathanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||37| | saṃsaktaśca tṛtīyastu teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śṛṇu | pratirūpaṃ vibhoḥ kṛtvā daśabhirniyamairyutaḥ | |38 || upāste yo munirdhyāyan sa saṃketana ucyate | vedādṛtasukhāsaṅgaḥ satvakarmā tvabāndhavān ||39|| parityajyeśvaraṃ dhyāyet tatsaṃkathanamucyate | sarvārambhaparityāgāt kapilādiniṣevitaḥ | |8.177.40 | | smṛtaḥ saṃkathanaḥ panthā yogāgniparidīpakaḥ | nirvikalpastu yatsarvaṃ brahma eveti paśyati | |41 || bhinnasarvakriyācāro dhyānī saṃsakta ucyate | trividhasyāpi mārgasya niyamāniyamāni ca ||42|| tānyeva parikīrtyante caryābhedā stvanekadhā | trayopi hetavo mukterime dhyānapathā mune | |43 || samyagetānmunirjñātvā nirmamonyatamaṃ śritaḥ | tadāpnoti paraṃ dhyānaṃ yena vindati tatparam ||44| | sarvāndhyānavidhīm̐stvetānucyamānānimānmayā | śṛṇu vyāsa mahābuddhe yogaiśvaryaphalapradān | |45|| iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau caturthaḥ saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.178> sanatkumāra uvāca dvividhaṃ brahma nirdiṣṭaṃ kṣaramakṣarameva ca | viditvobhayametaddhi mucyate sarvabandhanaiḥ | | 1 | | pañcaviṃśatimaṃ tattvaṃ kṣaraṃ tat prakṛteḥ param | akṣaraṃ ca paraṃ brahma ṣaḍviṃśakamiti smṛtam | |2 || mana ekagataṃ kṛtvā dhāraṇābhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ | vāyunigrahaṇaṃ kuryāt pratyāhārapurassaram || 3 | | muhūrtārdhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi pratyāhāraṃ samācaret | talāt triṃśacchataṃ cordhvaṃ prāṇāyāmanibandhanam | |4|| abhyastamāsanaṃ yat syāt svastikādi prakīrttitam | tad baddhvā vijane deśe dhyānābhyāsaṃ samācaret ||5|| kṣudhārtto vātibhukto vā rujā duḥkhānvitopi vā | na dhyāyīta punarvidvān ya icched dhyānamātmanaḥ | |6 | | yogahastaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vāmasyopari dakṣiṇam | adhomukho bhavet kiñcit paśyannāsāgramātmanaḥ | |7|| aspṛśan daśanairdantānoṅkāraṃ brahma saṃsmaran | dhyāyīta nirmamo vidvāna prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram | |8|| ātmānamātmanā yojya sarvāṅgāni tu saṃharet | nirīhaḥ pihitākṣaśca nikṣipya hṛdi dhāraṇām | |9| | pāṣāṇa iva niṣpando munirdhyānaṃ samācaret | ekatrāspandasandhānaṃ manaso dhāraṇā smṛtā || 8.178.10 || evaṃ pratidinaṃ tasya dhyāyato yogino mune | vikārā guṇajāḥ sarve naśyante vighnahetavaḥ | | 11 | anveṣṭi ca paraṃ brahma svaśarīraṃ samāsthitam | kṛtvaikyaṃ prāṇamanasāmindriyāṇāṃ vinigrahāt | | 12 || sarvabhāvaparityāgānmokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayam | pratyāhārarataṃ kṛtvā sarvamindriyagocaram | | 13 | | tato yuñjati nirdvandvo manassandhānamācaran | sarvaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya paraṃ tattvaṃ nirūpayet | | 14| | athaiśvaryagatāṃ siddhiṃ dhyāyannaṣṭavidhāṃ yadā | paśyate yogasaṃsiddhyā tadā yogī prakīrtyate | | 15 | | brahmasomādikān devān yadā yuktaḥ prapaśyati | yogibhiḥ kathyate hyeṣā siddhiryogavikārajā || 16 || manasā yogināṃ siddhiḥ sākhyāstattvaviniścayāt | na viśeṣosti yogānāṃ muktvā māheśvaraṃ vidhim | | 17|| yogino dhyānasaṃsiddhiṃ sāṃkhyāstattvaviniścayam | avibhinnāvubhāvetau dhyānatattvārthaniścayau | | 18 | | sarvabandhaparibhraṣṭaḥ saṅgadoṣavivarjitaḥ | rāgamohādisaṃtyakto mukta ityabhidhīyate | | 19 | | śabdādīn viṣayān yukto na dhyāyanvetti vai yadā | asakṛd yogasaṃsiddhyā tadā paśyati tatparam | |8.178.2 0 | | mṛtyujanmabhayodvignaḥ saṅgadoṣavivarjitaḥ | araṇye maunamādhāya dhyāyedoṅkāramakṣaram || 21 | | vedādau yaḥ svaraḥ prokto vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ paraḥ sa mahān smṛtaḥ ||2 2 || trisaṃsthānaṃ trimātraṃ ca tribrahma tryakṣaraṃ tathā | mātrāhīnaṃ samātraṃ ca yo vidyāt sa vimucyate || 23 | | nāgnistatra na vāyuśca na somo na divākaraḥ | prabhavanti maheśāne īśvare trivikalpite | |24|| oṅkāraḥ paramaṃ tattvamātmā brahma ca kīrtyate | kṣetrajñairātmasaṃbodhādyogibhiḥ sūkṣmadarśanāt | |25|| evameva sadā dhyāyan mana ātmani yojayet | īśvaraṃ prāpnute yogī yamavāpya vimucyate | |26| | indriyāṇi tu sarvāṇi śabdarūpādinigrahāt | viditvā karmajān hanti yogī doṣānaśeṣataḥ | |27| | dhyānaśaktyā tataḥ śuddhaḥ sarvajinmokṣamāpnute | yuñjan pratidinaṃ vyāsa ṣaḍmāsād yogamāpnute ||28|| paśyate ca paraṃ brahma yena mucyeta bandhanāt | tamātmānaṃ paraṃ jñātvā yogaśaktyā mahāmuniḥ | paramaiśvaryasaṃyukta amṛtaṃ padamāpnuyāt | |29 | | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau pañcamaḥ aṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.179> sanatkumāra uvāca antaḥkaraṇasaṃsiddho yo mahān kathito mayā | pañca karmendriyāṇyatra pañca buddhīndriyāṇi ca | | 1 || pañcabhūtaṃ manaścātra vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | mahān buddhirahaṅkārastanmātrāṇi ca pañca hi | |2| | imāḥ prakṛtayo vyāsa dehamaṣṭau samāśritāḥ | tattvāni tu caturviśatyetānyuktāni yogibhiḥ | dehamebhiravaṣṭabdhaṃ trailokyavyāpibhiḥ sthitam ||3 | | nābhimadhye tu nāḍīnāṃ śatamekaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | sarvāṅgeṣu tu yāstvanyā jalānnarasavāhikāḥ ||4| | tāsāṃ triṃśat sahasrāṇi vyānasrotasi saṃsthitāḥ | udānasyāparā nāḍyo brahmamūrdhni pratiṣṭhitāḥ | |5| | cakranābhī samāśritya bhūtasaṃghātamāsthitam | tanmadhye tu guṇaspṛṣṭaḥ karmātmā bhūtamohanaḥ ||6| | nakṣatrodyotasaṃkāśo jyotsnā puñjanibhaḥ prabhaḥ | vighātajananonyeṣāṃ sūryāyutanibhaḥ sthitaḥ ||7| | saṃbhūtognirivotpātī girinīhārasannibhaḥ | guṇastho bhūtayonistu puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ||8|| tasyāpi parataḥ śuddho mahānagnirivotthitaḥ | arciṣmān sarvato dīpto nirvikalpo nirañjanaḥ ||9|| nirdhūmāṅgārasakāśo navijñātāgamakriyaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśaḥ puruṣaḥ sūkṣma īśvaraḥ paramo vibhuḥ || 8.179.10 || sa eṣa kathito vyāsa pareṣāṃ parataḥ sthitaḥ | mahādevamimaṃ jñātvā mucyate tatkṣaṇānmuniḥ ||1 1 | | guṇatrayavikārasthaḥ kathitaḥpañcaviṃśakaḥ | bhūyaḥ saṃsarate tasmādajñānenaiva mohitaḥ | | 1 2| | devamānuṣatiryakṣu bhrāmyate rāgamohitaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśakasamādhānāt siddhistasya vikārataḥ || 13 | | kriyākāryavinirmuktaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvasṛk prabhuḥ | paramaiśvaryasaṃpūrṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyo maheśvaraḥ ||14|| ajaḥ svayambhūḥ ṣaḍviṃśaḥ kūṭastho hyacalo dhruvaḥ | tatastattvāni jāyante puruṣaśca guṇaiḥ saha || 15| | tasminneva ca līyante ṣaḍviṃśe tu maheśvare | viditvainaṃ maheśānaṃ muktisiddhiravāpyate ||1 6 || etajjñātvā na lipyeta karmabhirmohabandhanaiḥ | yathāgnirnirdahedante bhūtagrāmamaśeṣataḥ | | 17 | | ṣaḍaviṃśakapadārthajñastathā karmāṇi nirdahet | sarvavyāpi yathākāśaṃ sūkṣmaṃ naiva tu lipyate | |1 8| | ṣaḍviṃśakarato yogī tathā pāpairna lipyate | ṣaḍviṃśāt parato nāsti tasmāt tatparamo bhavet | | 1 9| | ekatvaṃ saha tenaiva tyaktvā dehamavāpnute | brahmaviṣṇvādikaṃ sarva bhūtagrāmamaśeṣataḥ | |8.179.2 0 || īśvarājjāyate vyāsa tasminneva pralīyate | nāsti tasmāt paro hyanyastaṃ vidyāt sarvataḥ sthitam ||21 || yamadhyātmavidaḥ siddhāḥ paramātmetyupāsate | sa eṣa sarvago devaḥ ṣaḍviṃśaḥ parameśvaraḥ | |22 || prāṇopānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca | ye pañcavāyavo dehe teṣāṃ nigrahaṇaṃ yatet || 23 | | apānañca samānañca kṛtvaikagatamādṛtaḥ | vyānena sahitaṃ prāṇamudāne sanniveśayet | |24|| nāsāgre tu sakṛt prāṇaṃ prāpayed yogaśaktitaḥ | bhadrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ samāsthāya ṣaḍviṃśaṃ cintayettataḥ | |25| | mātrāḥ pañcadaśa proktāḥ prathamaṃ sandhibandhanam | mātrā viṃśati vijñeyāḥ pañcamaḥsandhivigrahaḥ | |26| | niśśabde vijane deśe nirīho vijitendriyaḥ | svastikaṃ padmakaṃ bhadramathavā siṃhakacchapau | | 27|| ekamāsanamāsthāya ṣaḍviṃśaṃ samanusmaran | sarvāṅgāni samāhṛtya niṣpando dhyānamācaret | |28|| śanaiḥ saṃcārayedvāyuṃ nāḍībhiḥ srotasi sthitam | tāvattiṣṭheta yuktātmā dhpānayogād gataspṛhaḥ | |29|| somamaṇḍalasaṃkāśaṃ yāvat paśyeddhṛdi sthitam | jyotirdehāśritaṃ dṛṣṭvā yogaiśvaryaṃ pravartate | | 8.179.30 || tata evaṃ sadābhyāsād yogasiddhipravartanāt | trikālaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yogino bhaved | |3 1 | | vyādhayo nāviśantyenaṃ na ca duḥkhānvito bhavet | svadehasya ca saugandhyaṃ vapurdivyaṃ ca jāyate | |3 2 || amoghañca vacastasya śāpānugrahakāritam | pratyavāyo na caivāsya bhavet karmanibandhanaḥ | | 33 || sarvavidyāvidāṃ vyāsa yatīnāṃ vratacāriṇām | tapasvināṃ ca viprāṇāṃ yogī śreṣṭha udāhṛtaḥ || 34| | nānyathā mucyate jantuḥ saṃsārāt tamasaḥ parāt | ṣaḍviṃśakaparijñānaṃ muktvā yoganibandhanam | |3 5 || ṣaḍaṅgena tu yogena tathā pañcavidhena ca | jitvā hyaṣṭaprakārantu āsanānāṃ nibandhanam ||3 6|| mātrotkarṣeṇa jitvā ca prāṇāyāmaṃ caturvidham | tanmātrāṇīndriyairjittvā viṣayairindriyāṇi ca | |37|| ahaṅkārabhayāyāsakrodhalobhavivarjitaḥ | vimatsarotha niḥsaṅgo niḥsneho niḥspṛhastathā | | 38| | yogāspadaṃ samādhāya pūrvoktaṃ guṇavarjitam | dhyāyīta hṛdi taṃ devaṃ viśvaṃ viśveśvaraṃ vibhum ||3 9| | anādinidhanaṃ śāntaṃ traiguṇyaparivarjitam | tālau jihvāṃ samādhāya dantairdantān na ca spṛśan | |8.179.40 || indriyāṇi manaścaiva paramātmani yojayet | kṛtvā manasi tatsarvaṃ prāṇāpānau niruddhya ca | |41 | | oṅkāraṃ tvasakṛd dhyāyan saṃhṛtyāṅgāni kūrmavat | śarīraṃ sarvamāpūrya vikṣipet sarvamātmani | |42|| tatsaṃhṛtya munirbhūyo vyāpi bhūtaṃ pravistṛtam | nāḍīvāyupracāreṇa bhūyobhūyastathārabhet | |43 | | sa pūrvāpararātre tu sātvikaṃ ceta ucyate | madhyāhne cāparāhṇe ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyīta tāmasam | |44|| sandhyayorubhayornityaṃ rājasaṃ dhyānamācaret | taijasaṃ sarvataścāpi dhyānādeva jayed guṇān ||45 || sadaivaṃ dhyayato vyāsa tadaiśvaryaṃ pravartate | yena ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ buddhvā hṛdayasthaṃ maheśvaram ||46|| svecchayā svatanuṃ tyaktvā tasminneva pralīyate | paramātmā paraṃ brahma kāraṇaṃ puruṣo mahān ||47| | īśvaro nirguṇo bhoktā ṣaḍviṃśaḥ samudāhataḥ | yaccā sat sadasaccaiva bhūtibhūto vibhuḥ paraḥ ||48|| jāgartti svapate bhuṃkte santiṣṭhati dadāti ca | sa sraṣṭā sa ca saṃhartā guṇātīto maheśvaraḥ | |49|| ityetat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvayoganidarśanam | yogaṃ pāśupataṃ tubhya mādyaṃ mokṣagatipradam | |8.179.5 0 || sarvaprasaṅgarahitaṃ haravaktraviniḥsṛtam | sūkṣmaṃ tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tavānagha | yasya samyak parijñānād vijñeyaṃ nāparaṃ bhavet | |51 | | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau ṣaṣṭhaḥ ūnāśītyuttara śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.180> sanatkumāra uvāca brahmādyā devatā vyāsa dakṣayajñavadhe purā | śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurvīrabhadrabhayārditāḥ | |1 | | gaṇendreṇābhiyuktāstu bhasmakūṭāni bhejire | yadā bhasma praviṣṭāste tejaḥ śāṅkaramuttamam ||2| | abhavaṃste tadā raudrāḥ paśavo dīkṣitā iva | bhasmābhasitagātrāṇāṃ śaṅkaravratacāriṇām | |3 || svaṃ yogaṃ pradadau teṣāṃ tadā deva umāpatiḥ | sarvāsāṃ mokṣavidyānāṃ yattattvamatiricyate ||4|| hiraṇyagarbhapramukhairyogimukhyaiḥ pravartitaḥ | yo yogaḥ sakalo vyāsa kṛcchropāyaprasādhanaḥ ||5|| janmāntarasahasraistu tamabhyasya mahāmune | prāpnuvanti paraṃ jyotiryogaiśvaryamathāpi vā | yoyaṃ bhagavatā sākṣād yogo māheśvaraḥ paraḥ | |6| | tattvataḥ kathitasteṣāṃ prapannānāṃ divaukasām | asya samyak parijñānādanenaiva tu janmanā | |7| | vrataṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya ṣaḍmāsāj jñānamāpnute | yogaiśvaryaṃ mahad vyāsa yadavāpya vimucyate ||8| | sarvadharmaṃ bahiḥ kṛtvā niṣkalasya prabhāvataḥ | dīkṣāṃ pāśupatīṃ prāpya taṃ viśanti maheśvaram | |9|| sarvajñānasamāyuktaṃ tapodharmabahiṣkṛtam | bhasmasādhanamātraṃ tu śivena kathitaṃ vratam ||8.180.1 0 || pāpiṣṭhā dharmavanto vā bhaktāḥ kevalamīśvaram | sevanādyasya mucyante tannibodha mahāvratam || 11 | | adharmaṃ na vinā dharmo na ca dharmaṃ vināśubham | etau parasparaṃ baddhau tyaktvā tasmādimāvubhau ||1 2 | | dharmādharmaparityaktaścaret pāśupataṃ vratam | tato yogamimaṃ prāpya mahadaiśvaryamāpnute || 13 || bhasmagrahaṇamātrāttu te sarvabandhapramocanam | mucyate spṛṣṭamātrastu brahmapūtena bhasmanā || 14| | dahet somakṛtaṃ vahnirīśvaraṃ cānalaṃ viduḥ | kṛtākṛta dahatyagnirbhūyaḥ somasamāgataḥ | | 1 5| | bhasmanā mocitāḥ sarve brahmādyā abhimāninaḥ | bhasmanastejaso vīryaṃ bhasma pāvanamīśvaram ||1 6|| ātmānamuddhared vyāsa yaḥ snānaṃ bhasmanā caret | bhasmanā śivayogena mucyate pāśabandhanāt ||17|| prabhavanti surāḥ somāt pitaro vahnisaṃbhavāḥ | vahnisomātmakaṃ tasmājjagatsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | |18| | īśvarogniśca somaśca bhasma tatteja ucyate | tejasā tasya saṃspṛṣṭo mucyate janmanā dvija ||1 9 || sāṃkhyaṃ vidyāstapaścaiva tyaktvā dharmāṃśca vaidikān | kevalaṃ bhasmasaṃsnānāt pūto gacchati tatpadam ||8.180.2 0 || viṣayānapi saṃsevya bahvadharmaratopi san | paścād bhaktiparaḥ śambhorbhasmanaiva hi śuddhyati ||2 1 || ātmānaṃ yaḥ paśuṃ kṛtvā mahādevaṃ hutāśanam | dīkṣito brahmabhasmabhyāṃ śivayājī munirbhaveta ||22|| śīghrameva paraṃ yogaṃ prāpya mucyeta bandhanāt | evaṃ vratamanuprāpya bhūtvā pāśupato muniḥ | | 23 || idaṃ māheśvaraṃ jñānaṃ guhyaṃ paramamabhyaset | jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ tathā jñātā trayaṃ dehe yathā sthitam || 24|| ātmā yaśca yathā cāsau sthānatrayasamāsthitaḥ | nāḍīṣu ca yathā hyātmā ātmanyevānutiṣṭhati ||25|| sarvataḥ sarvabhūteṣu nigūḍhastiṣṭhate yathā | payasīva ghṛtaṃ vyāsa yaṃ viditvā vimucyate | |26|| na sa vettuṃ vinā jñānaṃ śakya ātmā kathañcana | rūpaśabdarasātītaṃ kastaṃ vetti maheśvaram ||27| | tathā hyahaṃ mahābhāga prasādāt tryambakasya tu | ātmajñānaṣaropāyaṃ kathayāmi tavānagha | | 28| | sarvameva tamaḥ pūrvamidamāsījjagat kila | na devā nānilo na dyaurna sūryaścandramā na ca || 29|| na kiñcit sarvathā bhūtaṃ dṛśyate jagati sthitama | śuddhaṃ vimalamābhāti akṣaraṃ paramaiśvaram | |8.180.3 0 || sarvabhāvaguṇātītaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirañjanam | bahirantaścaraṃ dīptamavināśi varaṃ dhruvam | yathā tadakṣaraṃ brahma procyamānaṃ tathā śṛṇu | | 31 | | omityekākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ kṣaraṃ tasmādvinirgatam | vyakṣaraśca trimātraśca oṅkāro brahma śabdyate | |3 2 || akāre tatra viṣṇustu ukāre tu pitāmahaḥ | makāre bhagavānīśo mātrāyāṃ prakṛtiḥ smṛtā ||3 3 | | brahmaviṣṇū smṛtau yau tau devāvīśvaranirgatau | prakṛtistrītvamāsthāya nityantāvīśapārśvagau | |34|| patnīrūpeṇa sā śambhuṃ bhajate prakṛtissadā | kṣarantu prakṛtiḥ khyātākṣarastu svayamīśvaraḥ ||3 5|| īśvarānnirgatā sā hi prakṛtirguṇabandhanā | tasyāḥ sraṣṭā mahādevo yato viṣṇupitāmahau || 3 6|| prajāpatī samutpannau guṇatrayanibandhanau | tāvākramya maheśastu prakṛtisthau guṇātmakau ||37|| makārastho vibhurbhūtvā bhuṃkte saṃcarate ca hi | guhyametat paraṃ jñātvā mayoktaṃ tattvamakṣaram ||38| | yenaiva ghyāninā vyāsa īśvarosau vikalpitaḥ | sa tamāviśya muktātmā kṛtārtho jāyate muniḥ | |39| | nainaṃ jānantyamārgasthāstarkahetuparāyaṇāḥ | bhoktāraṃ prakṛterīśaṃ paraṃ ṣaḍviṃśasaṃjñitam ||8.180.40 | | oṅkāraḥ prakṛtirnityaṃ tanmadhye ceśvaraḥ sthitaḥ | payomadhye yathā vyāsa sarpirantargataṃ sthitam ||41 || oṅkāraṃ dhyāyatā yena atītya prakṛtiṃ mune | īśvarosau mahān vinnaḥ sa muktaḥ paśubandhanaiḥ ||42|| īśvarī prakṛtiḥ khyātā guṇabandhādvimohanī | brahmatvād bṛṃhaṇī hye ṣā viṣṇutvādvibhavāśritā | |43|| prasādādīśvarasyaiṣā prakṛtistriguṇātmikā | sābhimānā bhavasraṣṭrī bhoktā tasyā maheśvaraḥ ||44| | aṣṭabāhustripādā ca pañcadehamukhī tatho | dvinetrā paṃcakarmasthā saptavājirathopagā ||45| jaganmātā smṛtā hyeṣā guṇatrayavikārajā | ubhe śubhāśubhe tasyān vidyāvidye tathā hyubhe | |46| | udbhavotha praṇāśaśca kriyānuṣṭhānameva ca | nimittaṃ cābhavadyonirbhāvāḥ saṃkṣepatastvamī ||47 || īśvarājjāta oṅkāraḥ sa ca tasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ | oṅkārāt sarvamutpannamābrahmabhavanaṃ jagat ||48 || ataḥ kṛtvā mahābhāga yoginaḥ kapilādayaḥ | oṅkāraṃ paramaṃ brahma nirvikalpamupāsate | |49| | sa eva sarvago hyātmā kāraṇaṃ ca sa eva tu | evaṃ prakṛtibhūtau tāvoṅkāraprabhavau sthitau | |8.180.5 0 | | īśabhojyau guṇātmānau jñāttvā viṣṇupitāmahau | tatsṛṣṭau vedayajñākhyau muktvā dharmanibandhanau ||5 1 | | mahāmohau tamoniṣṭhau viṣayāsaṅgasaṃyutau | satvapūrvau rajomadhyau sukhaduḥkhānvitau sadā | |52| | saṃsārabhramaṇau mūḍhau sarvānityasamāyutau | īśvarepsurbhavedvidvān dhyāyogaparāyaṇaḥ | |53 | | tasmāt prakṛtirutpannā tasminneva praṇaśyati | yenāsāvīśvaro vinno yogenātmani saṃsthitaḥ | prakṛtistaṃ na badhnāti mucyate ca bhavārṇavāt | |54| | iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane dhyānavidhau saptamaḥ aśītyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.181> sanatkumāra uvāca ātmā sūkṣmo manobuddhirahaṅkāro guṇāstathā | bhūtānīndriyasaṃghātastanmātrāṇi daśānilāḥ ||1 || vibhaktāḥ kramaśo dehe vibhāgena yathāśrayam | svapnajāgratsuṣupteṣu sthāneṣu triṣu suvrata ||2 | | hṛdaye karṇikāyāntu yat padmaṃ sarvatomukham | veṣṭitaṃ tantubhiḥ sūkṣmaistadūrdhvaṃ sarvadehinām | | 3 || ātmā tatra sajīvastu samanaskaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tat suṣuptamiti prāhuḥ saṃsiddhāḥ śivayoginaḥ ||4| | jvālinī stimitā dhūmrā vidyunmeghā viśālinī | mālinī śaṅkarī caiva sumaitrī bodhanī tathā ||5|| etā daśa mahānāḍyo jīve tasmin pratiṣṭhitāḥ | śayānaṃ pratibuddhaṃ vā yāstā bibhrati dehinam | | 6 | | śabdādiviṣayebhyastu ātmā sarvagataśca yaḥ | agnivāyusamāyukto jīva ityucyate punaḥ ||7|| ahaṅkāro mato buddhirbhāvāścetaśca dehajāḥ | saha jīvena tiṣṭhanti dhārayantaḥ śarīriṇam ||8| | ta eva sahitāḥ sarve jīvaścaiva tu pañcamaḥ | karṇikā tantubhirvyomni saṃsthitā sarvatomukhāḥ ||9|| sthito manasi sūkṣmastu śītāṃśurnāma tantukaḥ | cetaḥ sa eva saṃproktaḥ sa eva puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ | | 8.181.10 | | ahaṃkārotha jīvastu tanturbhāskarasaṃbhavaḥ | manaḥ somaḥ sukhaṃ brahmā jñānaṃ dharmo ratistathā | |1 1 || rasamātmā mahauṣadhyaḥ satvajo bhāvavistaraḥ | ahaṃkāro hutāśaśca mṛtyurduḥkhamathāmayam | |1 2| | kāmaroṣau jarā tṛṣṇā adharmaśceti tāmasāḥ | viṣṇurbuddhistathā kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhūmireva ca | | 13 | | jñānaṃ vairāgyamākāśaṃ rājaso bhāvavistaraḥ | jīvamadhye sthitā sūkṣmā vidhūmā pāvakī śikhā | |14|| amṛtaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ gatiścaiva hi sā parā | madhye tasyāḥ sthitaṃ saumyamamṛtaṃ śaśimaṇḍalam | | 1 5|| madhye tasyāgnisaṃkāśo jīva īśaḥ pradṛśyate | sarasā lohitā mukhyā prītā rasavatī tathā ||1 6|| vidhūmā cāmṛtā caiva nikuṇṭhā bahuvistarā | etāḥ sūkṣmatarā nāḍyaḥ saṃbhidya daśapāvakam | tarpayanti sadā somaṃ bhūtādhāraṃ payomṛtam | | 17| | sa tābhistarpitaḥ somaḥ sarvānnarasavīryataḥ | saṃchādayati vṛddhastāṃ jīvamadhyagatāṃ śikhām || 18 || tadevāmṛtamākhyātamīśvarāspadamuttam | raso yadā hi somasya śikhayā karṣitodhikam | | 1 9|| jāgartyeṣa tadā jantuḥ sarvayonisamudbhavaḥ | yāmṛtetyaparā nāḍī sā tu svapne pratiṣṭhitā || 8.181.20 || yadāsau somamāpīti(?) supta ityucyate tadā | ubhāvetau munirjitvā svapnajāgaraṇāśrayau | | 21 | | ajāgrannasvapam̐ścaiva dhyānayogena cintayet | mamatvādyāśca ye bhāvā manasaścaiva yāḥ ghṛṇā | |2 2 | | na buddheryacca vairāgyaṃ tena budhyanti yoginaḥ | manyate yanmanaḥ kiñcid buddhiryacca vikalpayet | |23 || yadvā kuryādahaṅkārastajjñānāt sarvamutsṛjet | niṣkriyasya kutaḥ karma tadvinā bandhanaṃ kutaḥ | | 24| | karmabandhavihīnastu saṃśuddho baddhyate katham | ya imān viṣayān kecinna vidyuḥ somasaṃbhavān | |25| | bhoktā vahniḥ smṛtasteṣāṃ tajjñātā kena baddhyate | iti jñātvā tyajeccintāṃ bhavedyogaparaḥ sadā | |26| | vahveryadauṣṇyaṃ tatpāpaṃ tejodharma udāhṛtaḥ | prakṛtiryā sa jīvastu yā śikhā sa maheśvaraḥ | |27|| yo dahet tejasā vahniṃ na ca tena vidahyate33 | atītā prakṛtistena vittastena maheśvaraḥ | |28|| karmabandho hyayaṃ loko niṣkarmā baddhyate kathama | nirmamā yogaviduṣaḥ śaṃkaravratamāsthitāḥ | |29|| gacchanti svatanuṃ tyaktvā hitvā māyāṃ paraṃ padam | idamanyat paraṃ jñānamasmāt sūkṣmataraṃ punaḥ | |8.181.3 0 || pravakṣyāmi tava vyāsa bhaktastvamasi śaṅkare | yoginonye na jānanti yad guhyaṃ paramādbhutam || 31 | | muktvā pāśupatān siddhān yanna bhūteṣu vidyate | mano buddhirahaṅkāra indriyāṇi guṇatrayam || 32 | | na spṛśanti tadātmānaṃ vikārāstasya te bahiḥ | sarvatra dṛśyate sotha na ca sarvaiḥ pradṛśyate | sa evaṃ dṛsyate dhyānānnānyopāyāt kathañcana ||3 3 | | sarvabhāvaguṇātītaṃ sucintyaṃ parameśvaram | jñānena ye prapaśyanti yoginaste pare smṛtāḥ | |34| | chāyaiṣā dṛśyate yā tu cakṣurviṣayamāśritā | sa jīvaḥ kīrtito vyāsa sthitihetuḥ śarīriṇām | |3 5| | tatrāste sa paro hyātmā sūkṣmo madhyagatovyayaḥ mahānāgaḥ smṛto nāmnā vāyurākāśagocaraḥ ||3 6|| ākāśe karṇikāyāṃ ca nāḍyāṃ jīve ca saṃsthitaḥ | gāndhārī vijayā caiva sañjñayā talavartinī || 37| | nāga etāsu nāḍīṣu vāyuḥ saṃparivartate | sā jayā vijayā yā ca dve te prāṇavahe smṛte ||38 | | apāne talagāndhāryau nāḍyau nāgena saṃyute | yogādapānamanasornāgena samudīritāḥ | |3 9 || sa prāṇo bahirantaśca tarpayan havyavāhanam | vṛddhaṃ saṃdhārayed dehamāyuṣā ca balena ca | |8.181.40 || nāḍī tvanyā suṣumṇeti somavahnimanaḥsthitā | sāsmin sadhātuke dehe kūrmāre cānile sthitā ||41 | | gulphe karatale saktā nikuñcā saprasāriṇī | samānavyānasaṃyuktā raktamāṃse hi tarpayet ||42| | udāno yoparo vāyuryañja kūrmāra ucyate | nāḍyāṃ nābhinibaddhāyāṃ tulāyāṃ tau pratiṣṭhitau | |43 || adha ekaścarennāḍyā vāyuranyastadūrdhvagaḥ | adhaḥsthaḥ pādasaṃbaddha ūrdhvagaḥ śirasi sthitaḥ | |44|| yo vāyurdevadattākhyaḥ kṛtako yoparonilaḥ | vahnisomanibaddhau tau prāṇahetū mahābalau ||45|| eko vivarddhayatyagnimanyaḥ somañca tarpayet | devadattamahānāgakṛtakūrmadhanañjayāḥ | |46 || prāṇāste pañca vikhyātā vahnayo..yājinaḥ | hutameṣu yadiṣṭaṃ vā somaṃ tadupatiṣṭhati ||47|| somaṃ viśanti yajvāno na teṣāṃ muktilakṣaṇam | dīptiragneḥ smṛtā yā tu oṣadhibhyaśca yadrasam ||48|| tarpaṇaṃ yacca somasya karṇikāyāṃ tadāsthitam | netreṣu dṛśyate yoyaṃ jyotiḥ chāyāprakāśakaḥ ||49|| sa jīvaḥ sarvasatvānāmātmā tatra samāsthitaḥ | jyotiṣontargataḥ sūkṣmastaddharmaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | |8.181.50 || taccāmṛtaṃ samākhyātaṃ jñānalabhyaṃ taducyate | tasmāt paratarā nāsti jñānavijñānayorgatiḥ | |51 | | jñātvaivaṃ santyajenmohaṃ guṇatrayavikārajam | abhinnasyātmanastasya ṣaḍviṃśasyeśvarasya | |52 | | bhedaṃ bhagavataḥ kuryāt konyo yogaviśāradaḥ | nirañjanaṃ nirvikalpaṃ prabhuṃ taṃ na vikalpayet ||5 3 | | vimohāstyaktasaṃsargāḥ kriyākāryavivarjitāḥ | taṃ viśanti maheśānamīśvaravratacāriṇaḥ | |54|| itīdaṃ yogamākhyātaṃ vyāsa māheśvaraṃ tava | samyagīśvarasandhānaṃ yadanyatra na vidyate | |55|| sandeho yatra te vipra praṣṭavyaṃ yacca manyase | tad brahman paripṛcchāśu nāvaktavyaṃ tavāsti me ||56 || iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane yogavidhāvaṣṭamoyamekāśītyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.182> vyāsa uvāca bhagavan sarvayogīśa sarvāmaranamaskṛta | aho jñānaṃ tvayākhyātamajñānavinivartanam | |1 || adyāhaṃ gatasandeho mahādevaṃ paraṃ prati | śaṅkarāt prakṛtirjātā brahmaviṣṇū tadātmakau | |2| | jñātvā ṣaḍaviṃśamīśānaṃ mucyate bandhanāditi | sarvayogapathāt pūrvamuktvā sakalasaṃhitām ||3 || niṣkalaṃ sakalaṃ jñānaṃ konya evaṃ prabhāṣate | śravaṇādasya viprendra dehaṃ muktamabodhiṣam ||4| | tvatprasādādahaṃ tāta prāptajñāno gatāśubhaḥ | visandeho bhavaṃ śāntaḥ praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcidasti me | |5|| tattvāṃ vijñāpayāmīdaṃ niṣṭhāmākhyātumarhasi | evaṃ vijñānasaṃpannaḥ prāptayogo munirmune | |6| | vinākleśaṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā yogī yogabalānvitaḥ | kathamāpnoti tad brahma niṣkalaṃ parameśvaram | 7| | īśvarādhānasaṃprāpterupāyaṃ mokṣalambhanam | kathayasva muniśreṣṭha praṣṭavyaṃ nānyadasti me | |8| | evamuktaḥ sa śiṣyeṇa vyāsena sumahātmanā | kathayāmāsa viprendraḥ śivasiddhāntaniścayam | |9| | sanatkumāra uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa paraṃ jñānamīśvarādhānakāraṇam | svecchayā yena mucyante yogino jñānatatparāḥ | | 8.182.10 | | tridhotkrāntimimāṃ jñātvā muhurabhyasya caiva hi | svadehaṃ ripuvat tvaktvā ṣaḍviṃśe layamāpnuyāt ||1 1 || yā nāḍyo vāyvavaṣṭabdhāḥ saṃvaranti śarīriṇam | śataṃ tāsāṃ śatānāṃ tu karṇikāmadhyamāśritam | | 12|| tamāśrityā sthitā nāḍyo nābhyāṃ pādeṣvadhogatāḥ | śirobaddhāḥ smṛtā bhūyastā eva karamāsthitāḥ | |13 || karamāśritya tā bhūyaḥ karṇikāṃ punarāśritāḥ | dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍonāmaparā mune || 14|| tāsāmekaikaśo bhedāḥ sūkṣmasūkṣmatarāḥ smṛtāḥ | tāsu sañcarate prāṇaḥ karṇikāvyomasaṃbhavaḥ || 1 5| | tatrātmā sūkṣmasaṃlakṣyaḥ prāguktastiṣṭhati dvija | yā prabhā durdṛśā tasya tāṃ bhajed yogavinmuniḥ || 1 6| | tattejaḥ sarvanāḍīṣu vibhaktaṃ sarvadehinām | tena nāḍyo bahiḥ sparśānmanaḥ kurvanti vistṛtam | | 17|| tattejaścakṣuṣā hṛtvā sarvanāḍīsamāśritam | mana ekagataṃ kuryāt taccātmani niyojayet | | 18|| vāyurdhanañjayo nāmnā yo hṛdi sphurate sadā | trīṇi tasya mukhānyāhuḥ śiro nābhi rhṛdeva ca | |1 9| | yenye prāṇā navākhyātā vāyavaḥ kīrtitā mayā | dhanañjayasya sarve te vaśagāstannibandhanāḥ | |8.182.2 0 || tadvaśādutkramantyete tasmim̐tiṣṭhanti saṃsthitāḥ | nābhībandhanamāsādya nāḍīnāṃ vaktramāsthitam | | 21 | | dvitīyaṃ karṇikāyāntu tṛtīyaṃ tālusaṃsthitam | kṣurikā paraśuḥ śūlaṃ trividhotkrāntirucyate | |22 || śūlaṃ hṛdi kṣuraṃ nābhyāṃ tālau paraśurāsthitaḥ | tāluke hṛdi vā baddha trayaṃ nābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||23 || tālau viyojitaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇameva vimuñcati | ākṣiptaṃ tritayaṃ nābhyāṃ karṇikāyāṃ viyojitam | | 24|| sthitam (?) ātmani saṃyojya vikṣipedūrdhvato manaḥ | prayogādasya viprendra mucyate tatkṣaṇānmuniḥ | |25| | svacchandatanusaṃtyāga eṣa te parikīrtitaḥ | dharmādharmanibaddhaistu karmabhiḥ prāganuṣṭhitaiḥ ||26 || yathā jīvo na baddhyeta yoginastadidaṃ śṛṇu | bāhyaḥśarīrajaścaiva mṛtyurdvividha ucyate | | 27 || viṣaśastrāgniyogaistu sarpadaṃṣṭrimarujjalaiḥ | bāhyo mṛtyuriti khyātaḥ śārīraṃ tu nibodha me | |28 || rogajaḥ kālajo vāpi mṛtyurābhyantaro bhavet | kālajo jarayā prokto rogajo vyadhisaṃkṣayāt(?) | |29| | durlabho mṛtyuranyoyaṃ yogasaṃdhānajo mune | yogopāyakṛto yaśca yaśca kālakṣayāgataḥ ||8.182.3 0 | | tayorbhedavikāre tu śṛṇu vyāsa samāsataḥ | kālakṣayād bhavatyeko dvitīyo manasepsitaḥ | |3 1 | | yoyamāghoṣajaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate śrotrasandhitaḥ | sa pūrvaṃ līyate kūrme tena vahnistyajet prabhām ||3 2|| niṣprabhaḥ sa tato vahniḥ śabdayogādviyujyate | śabdasparśaguṇātīto rūpayogaṃ vimuñcati ||3 3 || evamagnau praṇaṣṭe tu sarva evānilāstataḥ | ekato yogamicchanto marmāṇi vinikṛntate | |34|| kūrmāro devadattaśca kṛkaro nāga eva ca | udānenāśu saṃyujya karṇikāyāṃ viśanti hi ||3 5| | tata ūrdhvo bhavecchvāso manojīvavinirgamaḥ | tato jyotiryadakṣibhyāṃ tatsomaṃ viśati drutam ||3 6|| indriyāṇi mano yānti manaḥ prāṇavinirgamam | teṣu sarveṣu līneṣu prāṇān vāyurnipīḍayet | |37|| pīḍyamānāstataḥ sarve te bhavantyekatonilāḥ | svaṃ svaṃ tyaktvā tataḥ sthānaṃ yacca karma yadātmakam ||38|| ekasthā vāyavaḥ sarve pūrayanti dhanañjayam | śeṣastatra hi kūrmāro jīvaṃ tyaktvā sa tiṣṭhati || 39 || manobuddhirahaṅkāraśceto jīvastathaiva ca | niṣkramanti tato dehāttvaritaṃ vāyuneritāḥ ||8.182.40 | | prāgupāttastatosyānyo dehaḥ sūkṣmo vijāyate | sa tatra sandhito jīvo bhūyo mūḍhaśca tiṣṭhati | |41 || evaṃ kālakṛtā hyeṣā sarvabhūtagaṇasthitiḥ | vinā yogaṃ na jīyeta sūkṣmaṃ māheśvaraṃ padam | |52 | | upaviṣṭaḥ prasupto vā utkrāntyabhyastasaṃyamaḥ | svecchayā mucyate vyāsa jñātvā tantuḥ maheśvaram | |43 | kṣurikāṃ paraśuṃ vātha śūlaṃ vā dhārayenmuniḥ | tataḥ sarvesya līyante vikārāḥ karaṇaiḥ saha ||44| | vīkṣate ceśvaraṃ brahma ṣaḍviṃśaṃ svatanusthitam | manastīvraṃ jaḍaṃ jantoḥ prayacchati vipadyataḥ | |45 || sa rujā mohamāpanno jñānavastu na vindati | anena karmaṇā vipra sarvarukparivarjitaḥ ||46 || sukhamārohati brahma harmyapṛṣṭhaṃ talādiva | padārthaṃ pañca vijñāya duḥkhāntapariniṣṭhitaḥ | |47| | pañcabhirbrahmabhiḥ pūto bhasmasā dīkṣito dvijaḥ | śaṅkaraikamanā yogī jñānametadavāpnute | |48 | | māheśvaramimaṃ yogaṃ niṣkalaṃ muktikāraṇam | yatnādapi na vindanti vratamaprāpya śāṃkaram ||49 | | sa tvaṃ vyāsa mahābuddhe caran pāśupataṃ vratam | mahādevaparo bhūtvā jñānametadavāpnuhi | |8.182.50 | | naivametat paraṃ brahma anye vindanti yoginaḥ | mahādevaṃ prapannā ye tānmuktvā śivayoginaḥ ||51 | | eṣa mokṣavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ sarvapratyayavajitaḥ | niṣkalaḥ kathito vyāsa paro yasmānna vidyate || 52| | evaṃ pāśupatā viprā niṣkalaṃ taṃ maheśvaram | yogādāviśya mucyante punarjanmavivarjitāḥ ||53 || sakalasyāspadaṃ divyaṃ brahmalokāt pare sthitama | mahādevasya vakṣyāmi tadbhaktā yatra yānti te | |54|| iti skandapurāṇe pāśupatayogavarṇane yogavidhau navamaḥ dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ <8.183> sanatkumāra uvāca satyasya mahataścaiva janasya tapasastathā | bhavyabhūtabhavānāṃ ca saptānāmūrghvataḥ sthitaḥ | | 1 || loko bhagavataḥ śambhoryatrāste sakalaḥ śivaḥ | nāsau tarkavinirdeśyo lokāstasmin pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||2 | | ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhastācca lokāstadvinibandhanāḥ | brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ tasmiñchivaloke pratiṣṭhitam ||3 | | nāsau naśyati saṃhāre dhruvaḥ sthāṇuḥ surālayaḥ | yatrāhaṃ sanakādyāśca brahmā caiva pitāmahaḥ ||4|| bālakhilyapurogāśca siddhāśca kapilādayaḥ | śivayogapariprāptyā satvādiguṇavarjitāḥ ||5 | | tiṣṭhāmo nirvṛtā vyāsa sevamānāstamīśvaram | paramāṇurasāvīśo bhāvagamyo manīṣiṇām | |6|| paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktastatrāste vigraheśvaraḥ | kṣamā satyaṃ dhṛtiścaiva tapo vairāgyameva ca | |7|| sraṣṭṛtvaṃ jñānavairāgyādātmabodho maheśatā | nityametāni tiṣṭhanti tasmindeve maheśvare | |8| | yogavahnirasāvātmā brahmasṛkparameśvaraḥ | sākalyānmūrttimāsthāya karoti jagataḥ sthitim | |9| | aṣṭamaṃ dhruvamadhyeya(?)makṣaraṃ muktikāraṇam | māyādhāma tadīśasya jagatsaṃhārahetumat | |8.183.1 0 || ūrdhvato brahmalokasya yojanānāṃ mahātmanaḥ | viṃśatīnāntu koṭīnāṃ puraṃ sthāṇoḥ samāsthitam | |1 1|| etāvānūrdhvasañcāro gatyantaśca tataḥ smṛtaḥ | asaṃkhyātāḥ pure tasminnityāḥ sūkṣmāstathāvyayāḥ ||12|| jñānādhikāradharmiṇyaḥ śaivīprakṛtayaḥ sthitāḥ | yābhyo jajñe maheśānau brahmaviṣṇū prajāpatī | | 13 | | tābhyāṃ prakṛtibhūtābhyāṃ sraṣṭṛtvaṃ paramaṃ dadau | akṣayo vimalaḥ sūkṣmo niṣkalaḥ sakalopi ca | | 14|| sthire mūrte pare divye paramāṇupade sthitaḥ | manasaḥ prāktamasyādau tattejaḥsaṃprakāśanam || 15|| yadāsīddhaimamaṇḍantu laukikaṃ tvāpavargikam | mahattat sarvato nityamīśvarāttadabhūttadā | |16|| tasmādbījasya nirbhedaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ sa vibhuḥ smṛtaḥ | prakṛtirvaiṣṇavī proktā sā ca tasmādvinirgatā ||17 || surāsurādisṛṣṭyarthaṃ brahmatvaṃ punarāsthitā | aṇḍasya bhedataḥ padmabrahmaṇaḥ śaṃkarātmanaḥ | brahmalokapurastācca puraṃ tejomayaṃ mahat ||18| | yat sthānaṃ vigraheśasya īśvarasya parātmanaḥ | nāmnā śivapuraṃ vyāsa gatirīśvarayoginām || 19|| śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ taducyate | mahīmaṇḍalasaṃsthānaṃ tanmadhye vistṛtaṃ smṛtam ||8.183.2 0 || sphuradādityarūpeṇa vahneradhikatejasā | mahatā haimajātena prākāreṇa suveṣṭitam | |21 | | caturbhirhemajairdvārairmaṇimuktāvibhūṣitaiḥ | śobhitaṃ tatpuraṃ ramyaṃ śuśubhe siddhasevitam || 22| | jarāmṛtyuśramavyādhikopamohamadādayaḥ | na kramantyaśubhāstasmin bhāvāḥ śivapure mune | |23 || śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ yathādiśam | tat puraṃ vṛṣabhāṅkasya sarvavyāpi samṛddhimat | | 24|| divyā mārakatī bhūmiḥ sparśamātrasukhāvahā | vaidūryamaṇikalpāni bālārkasadṛśāni ca ||25| | kvacidraktāni padmāni kvacicchvetāni rejire | mahāhradapramāṇāni nālairvaidūryasannibhaiḥ || 26|| gandhavanti mahārhāṇi vinyastāni mahītale | indranīlanikāśāni mahāmaṇinibhāni ca ||27|| kacit kṛṣṇārdharaktāni divyagandhavahāni ca | ......tatra utpalāni samantataḥ ||28|| pravahanti mahānadyo yāstasminnamṛtodakam | pure bhagavataḥ śambhoḥ pārāśarya nibodha tāḥ ||29| | varadā ca vareṇyā ca vareśā varavarṇinī | vārāhī vāribhadrā ca varā caiva mahāpagāḥ || 8.183.30 || nānākusumasaṃmiśraṃ tā vahanti jalāmṛtam | na devā na munīndrāśca nāsurāḥ pitaro na ca | |3 1 || na caivānye samarthāḥ syurjñātuṃ tatpuramadbhutam | antarmanasi buddhā ye sarvato bhaktibhāvitāḥ | śivaikamanaso vyāsa tasminmodanti te narāḥ ||32| | tasya madhye purendrasya sūryajvalanavarcasaḥ | meruśṛṅgapratīkāśo digbhadrastapanaprabhaḥ ||3 3 | | prāsādo lakṣapādastu kāmagaḥ kanakāmayaḥ | anirīkṣyairmahāratnaiḥ samantāt pariśobhitam || 34|| vaidūryairvyomasaṃkāśaiḥ sphāṭikaiścandrasaprabhaiḥ | pravālairarkasaṃkāśairindranīlamayaiḥ paraiḥ | | 35 || śaśiraśmiprakāśābhiḥ kvacidarkāṃśurūpibhiḥ | śobhitaṃ tatpatākābhirvirarāja sukhānilam | |3 6| | sarvartukusumaiścitrairicchāratnaphalairapi | śuśubhe tatpuraṃ kīrṇaṃ pādapairgirisannibhaiḥ | |37| | mahīdhrāṇāṃ yathā merussarveṣāṃ pravaro mahān | tathaiva tatpuraṃ reje sarvalokopari sthitam | |38| | tatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣānmahābhūtapatirharaḥ | sadāste sahitaḥ patnyā ṣaḍviṃśaḥ parameśvaraḥ || | |43 | | ......śiṣyaḥ siddhaḥ pañcaśikhastathā | munirhayaśirā yaśca yajñavalkādayastathā ||44|| tryakṣāḥ śaṅkaravarṣmāṇaḥ paramaiśvaryasaṃyutāḥ | tiṣṭhantīśvaramūlasthā guṇātītā mumukṣavaḥ | |45| | utpanne jagato nāśe mahāpralayasaṃjñake | īśvaraṃ te samāviśya prāpnuvantyapavargikam ||46 || yaiśca dṛṣṭāni viprendra śivaliṅgāni tāni tu | kedāro madhyamaścaiva girīśaśca mahālaye | |47| | catuḥśṛṅgeśvaro devaḥ śrīgirau ca maheśvaraḥ | kārohaṇo ca deveśo gaṅgādvāre ca śaṅkaraḥ | bhadreśaśca mahādevaḥ śaṃkukarṇeśvarastathā | |48|| mahākāleśvaraścaiva gokarṇe ca tathā hyubhau | bhaktiryeṣāṃ bhave nityaṃ kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ | |51 | | mṛtāḥ śivapure vyāsa tryakṣāḥ paṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ | nandīśaskandasaṃkāśā yogaiśvaryabalānvitāḥ ||52|| rudrā bhavanti te vyāsa sadā śaṃkarapārśvagāḥ | eṣa te kathitaḥ sarvo yogo māheśvaraḥ paraḥ | |53 | | sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva jñātvaivaṃ paramīśvaram | sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi | |54|| bhaviṣyasi ca yogātmā jñānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | jagātsthitikaro yogī smārttadharmapravartakaḥ ||55| | jñānaśaktyā smṛ...brahmāṇḍodbhakāraṇe | sthitidharmanibodhārthaṃ purāṇāni kariṣyasi ||56|| yajñadharmapracārārtha vedaṃ
